sections.Actions: Multiattack. The tarrasque can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes five attacks: one with its bite, two with its claws, one with its horns, and one with its tail. It can use its Swallow instead of its bite. Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 20). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the tarrasque can’t bite another target. Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) slashing damage. Horns. Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (4d10 + 10) piercing damage. Tail. Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. Frightful Presence. Each creature of the tarrasque’s choice within 120 feet of it and aware of it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if the tarrasque is within line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature’s saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the tarrasque’s Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours. Swallow. The tarrasque makes one bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target takes the bite’s damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the tarrasque, and it takes 56 (16d6) acid damage at the start of each of the tarrasque’s turns. If the tarrasque takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the tarrasque must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the tarrasque. If the tarrasque dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 30 feet of movement, exiting prone.
sections.Legendary Actions: The tarrasque can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Any creature but the djinni that enters the whirlwind must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be restrained by it. The effect can penetrate barriers, but 3 feet of wood or dirt, 2 feet of stone, 2 inches of metal, or a thin sheet of lead blocks it. While the target is in range, the doppelganger can continue reading its thoughts, as long as the doppelganger’s concentration isn’t broken (as if concentrating on a spell). While reading the target’s mind, the doppelganger has advantage on Wisdom (Insight) and Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, and Persuasion) checks against the target.

If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target’s saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this ghost’s Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring. Possession (Recharge 6). One humanoid that the ghost can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by the ghost; the ghost then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. The ghost now controls the body but doesn’t deprive the target of awareness. The ghost can’t be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target’s statistics, but doesn’t gain access to the target’s knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, the ghost ends it as a bonus action, or the ghost is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. Baby Burst. When the spider dies, a Swarm of Spiders (MCDM) emerges and acts on its initiative count.
Rider Launcher. Allied riders can jump off up to 30 ft. horizontally or 15 ft. vertically without a running start. The jumping rider has advantage on their first melee weapon attack that turn.
Spider Climb. Can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
Web Walker. Webbing doesn't restrict movement.
Wide Back. Two Small or Tiny riders can share a space on its back. Capacity is 18 Small riders or 72 Tiny riders.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing plus 7 (2d6) poison.
Bladed Leg. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing.
Web Spray. Creatures in a 15-ft. cube must pass a DC 14 Dexterity save or be restrained by webs. A creature can spend an action on a DC 14 Strength or Dexterity check to free itself or a creature within reach.
Trample (recharge 6). Move up to the spider's speed through other creatures' spaces, treating them as difficult terrain. It can make one Bladed Leg attack against each creature whose space it enters. A hit prevents that creature from taking reactions until the start of its next turn.

ruleNotes: Brute. Publisher's Jagged Edge Hideaway stat block.
appearance: An enormous spider that can carry goblin riders and hide smaller spiders in its body.

name: Amalgam
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Constitution saves +6. Immune to Charmed, Frightened and Prone. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Can speak every language but understands none.

sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. Powers, spells and other effects cannot change its form.
Lake Rebirth. After being destroyed, it returns at full HP in the Lake of Rot after 24 hours.
Primordial Influence. If a Dazed enemy starts its turn within 20 ft., it attempts a DC 16 Wisdom save. Failure causes a strange physical alteration chosen by the GM without changing its statistics. Cure Ailment of 4th order or higher, Greater Restoration or comparable magic reverses it. The altered creature repeats the save at every long rest. Failure worsens or adds an alteration. Three failures after the first alteration turn the creature into a GM-controlled amalgam. Only Wish restores its original form.
Viscous Vicinity. The space within 20 ft. is difficult terrain for other creatures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Reality Rend twice, with the option to substitute Pull for one attack.
Reality Rend. Melee power attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 15 (2d10 + 4) psychic damage, then the target makes a DC 16 Wisdom save or becomes Dazed until the start of the amalgam’s next turn.
Pull. Select up to three visible creatures within 60 ft. Each makes a DC 16 Strength save. Failure pulls it directly toward the amalgam by up to 30 ft.
sections.Psionics:
Power attacks are psionic and deal nonmagical damage. Counterspell, Dispel Magic and Antimagic Field do not stop them. If an enemy provokes an opportunity attack, the amalgam can use Reality Rend as its reaction instead.
MCDM Dazed. On its turn the affected creature chooses only one of movement, an action or a bonus action. Becoming dazed during its turn ends that turn. Additional actions granted by effects such as Haste are still available. Lesser Restoration, Greater Restoration or Cure Ailment can remove Dazed.

ruleNotes: Controller. Terminal Excrescence, Where Evil Lives.

name: Hulking Brain
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Blindsight 120 ft. and blind beyond it, passive Perception 8. Deep Speech, Undercommon and telepathy 120 ft.

sections.Traits:
Psionic Immunity. Voiceless Talker powers affect this creature only if it chooses to allow them.
Psychic Scream. At 0 HP, it forces every creature within 30 ft. to attempt a DC 16 Wisdom save. Failure deals 21 (6d6) psychic damage. Success halves it.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Bash three times.
Bash. Melee attack +8, reach 10 ft. One target takes 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning on a hit and is Grappled (DC 15 to escape). While held, it is Restrained and has disadvantage on saves against psionic powers. It can hold four creatures at once.
Squeeze. Each creature it has Grappled makes a DC 16 Strength save, taking 22 (4d10) bludgeoning on failure or half on success.
sections.Bonus actions: Psionic Invigoration (1/day). Each willing Voiceless Talker within 60 ft. can regain a spent psionic power of its choice. It gains advantage on attacks until the end of the brain’s next turn.

ruleNotes: Brute. Terminal Excrescence, Where Evil Lives.
appearance: A long-armed psionic brute with an enlarged brain and a lumbering build.

name: Lord Syuul
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Constitution saves +9, Intelligence +11, Wisdom +10. Arcana +16, Deception +10, Insight +10, Perception +10, Persuasion +10, Stealth +8. Resists bludgeoning. Immune to Charmed and Frightened. Darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 20. Deep Speech, Undercommon and telepathy 120 ft.

sections.Traits: Draw In. On failing a save while he has an enemy Grappled, Syuul can release every creature he is holding to succeed instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Tentacle attacks or two Psionic Repeater attacks, then use one power or Memory Transfer.
Tentacle. Melee attack +11, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit for 28 (4d10 + 6) psychic. A target no larger than Large is Grappled (escape DC 19).
Psionic Repeater. Ranged attack +11, range 150/600 ft. Hit for 22 (3d10 + 6) force.
Brain Overload (1/day, 6th-order power). Pick one visible creature within 120 ft. It makes a DC 19 Constitution save, taking 77 (14d10) psychic on failure or half on success. If the damage leaves a target with a brain at 0 HP, its brain bursts. The target dies if it needs that brain to survive.
Flay (6th-order power). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 19 Intelligence save. Failure deals 35 (10d6) psychic. Success halves it.
Memory Transfer. Each creature Syuul is holding attempts a DC 19 Intelligence save. Failure deals 44 (8d10) psychic damage. A creature that failed and remains held at the end of its next turn chooses one of the two effects below.
Memory Transfer, stripped memory. The target loses its proficiency bonus, cannot speak or form new thoughts, and has disadvantage on checks, attacks and saves. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration or a similar supernatural effect ends this. Syuul gains +5 damage cumulatively until his next long rest.
Memory Transfer, command. Syuul Charms the target for 1 hour. His telepathic commands require no action and the target tries its best to follow them. Whenever it takes damage, it can make a DC 19 Wisdom save to end the effect.
Guise (3rd-order power). For 1 hour, project the appearance of a Medium creature previously seen, including alterations to carried gear. Physical contact reveals discrepancies. A creature can use an action and pass a DC 19 Intelligence (Investigation) check to detect the projection.
sections.Bonus actions: Grappling Jaunt. Teleport Syuul and every creature he is holding up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space he can see.
sections.Reactions: Brain Drain. Give a creature Syuul is holding disadvantage on its save against his Memory Transfer.
sections.Villain actions:
Use each once per encounter, after an enemy’s turn, with a limit of one per round.
Mindblind. Visible enemies within 60 ft. make a DC 19 Wisdom save. Those that fail can see only Syuul among creatures for 1 minute. They repeat the save at the end of each turn.
Was I Ever Here? Syuul becomes Invisible, teleports 60 ft. to an unoccupied visible space, and can Hide. An illusion remains in his former space and behaves as he directs without an action. On first touching it on a turn, or on making a melee attack against it, a creature must pass a DC 19 Constitution save or take 21 (6d6) psychic damage. Both effects end at the end of Syuul’s next turn.
Mindshatter. Visible enemies within 60 ft. attempt a DC 19 Wisdom save. Failure deals 55 (10d10) psychic and leaves the enemy Dazed for 1 minute, with a new save at the end of each turn. Success halves damage and avoids Dazed.
sections.Psionics:
Syuul’s psionic powers work through Antimagic Field and are unaffected by Counterspell and Dispel Magic.
MCDM Dazed. On its turn the affected creature chooses only one of movement, an action or a bonus action. Becoming dazed during its turn ends that turn. Additional actions granted by effects such as Haste are still available. Lesser Restoration, Greater Restoration or Cure Ailment can remove Dazed.

ruleNotes: Solo. Terminal Excrescence, Where Evil Lives.
appearance: A regal, tentacled Voiceless Talker who carries a psionic repeater.

name: Mindkiller
otherStatistics: Deception +4, Stealth +4. Darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 12. Deep Speech, Undercommon and telepathy 120 ft.

sections.Traits:
Amorphous. Fit through a gap 1 inch wide without squeezing.
Psionic Immunity. Voiceless Talker powers affect this creature only if it chooses to allow them.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee attack +4, 5-ft. reach. Hit for 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing and 7 (2d6) psychic. Targets no larger than Medium are Grappled (escape DC 12).
Concealing Strike. Ranged power attack +5, range 30 ft. A creature takes 13 (3d6 + 3) psychic on a hit. The mindkiller is Invisible to it until the end of the mindkiller’s next turn.
Mindwipe. A Humanoid it has Grappled makes a DC 12 Strength save. On failure the mindkiller enters the host. It has total cover from effects outside the host. Its only action while inside is to leave into an unoccupied space within 5 ft.
Host damage. At the end of each host turn, the host makes a DC 13 Constitution save, taking 10 necrotic on failure. At 0 HP the host dies and the mindkiller takes over a body restored to full HP. It retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, telepathy and understanding of Deep Speech and Undercommon. It inherits the host’s other statistics, actions and knowledge. If the controlled body drops to 0 HP, it must leave.
Removal. Within reach of the host, spend an action with a sharp weapon or tool. Against an unwilling host, roll against its AC. A hit, or a willing host, takes 11 (2d10) slashing. A DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check then extracts the mindkiller on success. On failure it kills the host if the cut reduced the host to 0 HP, and otherwise remains inside.
sections.Psionics: Concealing Strike is psionic. Counterspell, Dispel Magic and Antimagic Field do not stop it.

ruleNotes: Ambusher. Terminal Excrescence, Where Evil Lives.
appearance: A small floating aberration with grasping claws and a body that squeezes through minute gaps.

name: Mindkiller Whelp
otherStatistics: Darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 11. Deep Speech, Undercommon and telepathy 120 ft.

sections.Traits:
Amorphous. Fit through a gap 1 inch wide without squeezing.
Minion. Damage from an attack or failed saving throw drops it to 0 HP. Other damage kills it only if the damage is at least 9. Otherwise it takes none.
Psionic Immunity. Voiceless Talker powers affect this creature only if it chooses to allow them.
Resistance Drain. An enemy within 5 ft. of at least three whelps takes a penalty on saves against powers and psionic effects equal to the number of whelps within 5 ft.
sections.Actions: Claws (group attack). Melee attack +4, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 2 slashing.
sections.Minion rules:
Group attack. Two to five whelps on the same turn, all within reach of the target, can spend their actions to make one attack. Add the number participating to +4 and deal 2 slashing per participant on a hit. This also works with qualifying opportunity attacks using reactions. A single whelp just uses +4. Whelps cannot score critical hits. Advantage or disadvantage applies only when all participants have it. Separate participants into groups if cover or concealment differs. The target chooses one participant for any reaction that can affect only one attacker.
Overkill. A weapon hit dealing more than 9 damage leaves the excess to defeat another eligible whelp. Drop one for each 9 excess damage or fraction thereof. Melee targets must stay within the weapon’s reach. Ranged targets must lie along the line from attacker through the first target and within the weapon’s short range. This does not apply to opportunity attacks.

ruleNotes: Minion. Terminal Excrescence, Where Evil Lives.
appearance: A small flying psionic minion with claws and a flexible body.

name: Orc Conduit
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Perception +3. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13. Common and Orc.

sections.Traits:
Affinity. Choose cold, fire or lightning. The orc resists that damage type and uses it for Elemental Discharge and Power Burst.
Relentless (once per turn). If brought to 0 HP but not killed outright or Incapacitated, the orc can attack an enemy before its HP drops, without an action. If that hit drops the enemy to 0 HP, the orc drops to 1 HP instead.
sections.Actions:
Elemental Discharge (cantrip). Melee or ranged spell attack +5, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit for 9 (1d12 + 3) damage of the affinity type.
Power Burst (2/day, 1st-level spell). A 15-ft. cone becomes difficult terrain on the ground. Each creature in it makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. Failure deals 10 (3d6) affinity damage and pushes the target 10 ft. away from the orc. Success halves the damage and prevents the push.
sections.Bonus actions: Rush. Use Dash.

ruleNotes: Artillery. Terminal Excrescence, Where Evil Lives.
appearance: An orc spellcaster in studded leather who channels magic at range.

name: Troll (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Constitution saves +8. Athletics +7, Perception +5. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15. Giant.

sections.Traits:
Relentless Hunger. The troll remains conscious and can act at 0 HP. It dies if it ends its turn at 0 HP, if acid or fire reduces it to 0, or if it takes acid or fire at 0.
Sluggish. Half speed and no Multiattack for the hour after waking from sleep or unconsciousness.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Bite once and Claw twice.
Bite. Melee attack +7, reach 5 ft. Hit for 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is not a Construct, Elemental or Plant, heal the troll for the damage dealt, or twice that if the bite drops the target to 0 HP.
Claw. Melee attack +7, reach 10 ft. Hit for 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.
Crash Through. Move up to its speed in a straight line through mundane obstacles and spaces occupied by creatures of Large size or smaller. Those creatures make a DC 15 Strength save, taking 14 (4d6) bludgeoning and falling Prone on failure. On success they take half damage and stay upright. Unattended mundane objects in its path also take 14 (4d6). If an object of Large size or larger survives, movement stops and the troll is Stunned until the end of its next turn.
sections.Reactions: Spiteful Retort. If left alive when reduced to 0 HP, make a Bite against a creature within 5 ft.
sections.Encounter options: Mutated troll. The lair suggests adding the Hulking Brain’s Psychic Scream or a Voiceless Talker’s Flay to the cold-storage troll. Treat the extra power as a deliberate change to the encounter.

ruleNotes: Brute. Terminal Excrescence, Where Evil Lives.
appearance: A large, long-limbed troll with claws and a hide that knits back together.

name: Voiceless Talker
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Constitution saves +5, Intelligence +7, Wisdom +5. Arcana +7, Deception +5, Insight +5, Perception +5, Persuasion +5, Stealth +6. Resists bludgeoning. Darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 15. Deep Speech, Undercommon and telepathy 120 ft.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use a power and then make one Tentacle or Psionic Pistol attack.
Tentacle. Melee attack +7, reach 10 ft. Hit for 15 (2d10 + 4) psychic damage. A target no larger than Large is Grappled (escape DC 15).
Psionic Pistol. Ranged attack +7, range 80/320 ft. Hit for 15 (2d10 + 4) force damage.
Memory Thief (4th-order power). A visible target within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Intelligence save. Failure deals 22 (4d10) psychic damage, lowers its proficiency bonus by 1 cumulatively until it finishes a long rest or dies, and gives the voiceless talker a cumulative +2 to damage rolls for the same duration. Success halves damage and avoids the penalty. A target whose proficiency bonus reaches 0 cannot speak or form new thoughts and has disadvantage on checks, attacks and saves.
Flay (3/day, 5th-order power). Every creature in a 15-ft. cone attempts a DC 15 Intelligence save. Failure deals 28 (8d6) psychic damage. Success halves it.
Guise (3rd-order power). For 1 hour, project the appearance of a Medium creature previously seen, including alterations to carried gear. Physical contact reveals discrepancies. A creature can use an action and pass a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check to detect the projection.
sections.Reactions: Brain Drain. Impose disadvantage when a creature the voiceless talker has Grappled saves against one of its powers.
sections.Psionics: Its powers work through Antimagic Field and are unaffected by Counterspell and Dispel Magic. It cannot keep more than one active manifestation of the same power.

ruleNotes: Controller. Terminal Excrescence, Where Evil Lives.
appearance: A cephalopod-faced aberration who floats and attacks with psionic powers.

name: Voiceless Talker Artillerist
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Constitution saves +7, Intelligence +9, Wisdom +7. Arcana +9, Deception +7, Insight +7, Perception +7, Persuasion +7, Stealth +7. Resists bludgeoning. Darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 17. Deep Speech, Undercommon and telepathy 120 ft.

sections.Traits: Phasing Rifle (once per turn). After a rifle hit, the artillerist can force a DC 17 Wisdom save without spending an action. Failure teleports the target into an unoccupied space the artillerist can see within 60 ft. of the artillerist.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Fire Psionic Rifle twice, or use a power and one Phasing Tentacles attack.
Psionic Rifle. Ranged attack +9, range 150/600 ft. Hit for 21 (3d10 + 5) force.
Phasing Tentacles. Melee attack +9, reach 10 ft. Hit for 21 (3d10 + 5) psychic. A target no larger than Large is either Grappled (escape DC 17) or teleported up to 15 ft. into an unoccupied space the artillerist can see, at the artillerist’s choice.
Memory Thief (5th-order power). A visible target within 30 ft. makes a DC 17 Intelligence save. Failure deals 33 (6d10) psychic damage, lowers its proficiency bonus by 1 until it finishes a long rest or dies, and gives the artillerist a cumulative +2 to damage rolls for the same duration. Success halves damage and avoids the penalty. A target whose proficiency bonus reaches 0 cannot speak or form new thoughts and has disadvantage on checks, attacks and saves.
Guise (3rd-order power). For 1 hour, project the appearance of a Medium creature previously seen, including alterations to carried gear. Physical contact reveals discrepancies. A creature can use an action and pass a DC 17 Intelligence (Investigation) check to detect the projection.
sections.Bonus actions: Vanish for One (3/day, 3rd-order power, Concentration). One visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On failure, the artillerist is Invisible to it for up to 1 minute, with a new save at the end of each of its turns. The effect also ends if the artillerist attacks it, damages it, or creates an effect that forces it to make a save.
sections.Psionics: It can use a bonus-action power and another power as an action on the same turn. Its powers work through Antimagic Field and are unaffected by Counterspell and Dispel Magic. Concentrating on Vanish for One precludes concentrating on another effect, and it cannot keep more than one manifestation of the same power active.

ruleNotes: Artillery. Terminal Excrescence, Where Evil Lives.
appearance: A tentacled psionic marksman equipped with a rifle that displaces its targets.

name: Plainscow
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Resists bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks. Insight +2, passive Perception 10. No languages.

sections.Traits: Trampling Charge. Moving straight at least 20 ft. toward a creature before hitting it with Hooves on the same turn forces it to attempt a DC 14 Strength save. Failure knocks it Prone. If the target is Prone, the plainscow can use a bonus action for another Hooves attack against it.
sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 248.

name: Trinket
otherStatistics: Plate armor. Perception +10, passive Perception 20. Understands Common without speaking it.

sections.Traits:
Chosen Companion. The printed totals already include +10 HP and +6 to attack, damage and Wisdom (Perception) rolls.
Empowered Attacks. Treat the bear’s attacks as magical when checking resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.
Keen Smell. Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks using scent.
Raven’s Slumber. At 0 HP, if Trinket is within 100 ft. of Vex, the item immediately moves him into its demiplane and stabilizes him.
Working with Vex. Trinket moves and acts on Vex’s turn. Her bonus action can order him to Dash, Dodge, Disengage or Attack. Her Multiattack can order him to move and use Multiattack. Trinket takes at most one action on her turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Bite once and use Claws once.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +13, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 14 (1d8 + 10) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack +13, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 17 (2d6 + 10) slashing damage.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 266.

name: Vex’ahlia
speed: 30 ft., fly 50 ft. on a Broom of Flying
otherStatistics: AC includes +2 studded leather and a +2 Ring of Protection. Saves Str +6, Dex +13, Con +3, Int +4, Wis +5, Cha +5. Acrobatics +17, Athletics +4, Deception +9, Insight +9, Investigation +8, Perception +15, Persuasion +9, Stealth +17, Survival +9. Cold resistance. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 25. Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Elvish, Thieves’ Cant and Undercommon.

sections.Traits:
Assassinate. On her first turn, Vex has advantage against creatures that have yet to act. Any hit against a Surprised creature is a critical hit.
Evasion. When a Dexterity save would halve damage, Vex instead takes none on success and half on failure.
Fey Ancestry. Advantage on saves against being Charmed. Magical sleep does not work on her.
Ranged Master. The attacks already include +2 to hit. Ranged weapon attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover and take no range penalty. Vex can choose −5 to hit for +10 damage.
Sneak Attack (once per turn). A weapon hit deals 14 (4d6) extra damage if Vex had advantage or if an ally who is not Incapacitated is within 5 ft. of the target and Vex did not have disadvantage.
Equipment. Cold-resistant +2 studded leather, +2 Ring of Protection, Broom of Flying, Raven’s Slumber and Fenthras.
Trinket. The bear moves on Vex’s turn. Vex can spend a bonus action to order him to Dash, Dodge, Disengage or Attack, or use her command in Multiattack. He has one action per turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
Wisdom, 13th-level ranger casting, save DC 17 and spell attack +9.
1st level, 4 slots. Cure Wounds, Hunter's Mark.
2nd level, 3 slots. Pass without Trace, Protection from Poison.
3rd level, 3 slots. Lightning Arrow, Nondetection.
4th level, 1 slot. Freedom of Movement, Grasping Vine.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two ranged attacks and optionally order Trinket to move up to his speed and Multiattack.
Fenthras. Ranged weapon attack +16, range 600 ft., one target. Hit for 22 (1d8 + 18) piercing plus 3 (1d6) lightning.
Bramble Shot (twice per short rest). Add 18 (4d8) piercing to a Fenthras hit. The target must pass a DC 17 Strength save or become Restrained, repeating the save at the end of each turn.
sections.Bonus actions:
Cunning Action. Use Dash, Disengage or Hide.
Hunter's Mark. Mark one visible creature within 90 ft. While she concentrates, for up to 1 hour, Vex’s weapon hits deal 1d6 extra damage, and she has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks to find the target.
sections.Reactions: Uncanny Dodge. When an attacker Vex can see hits her, halve the damage from the attack.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 267.

name: Ashari Firetamer
otherStatistics: Red Dragon Scale Mail. Arcana +4, Nature +7. Fire resistance. Passive Perception 14. Common, Druidic, Ignan.

sections.Spellcasting:
9th-level druid casting with Wisdom. Save DC 15, spell attack +7.
Cantrips at will · Druidcraft, Mending, Produce Flame (2d8).
1st level, 4 slots · Cure Wounds, Faerie Fire, Jump.
2nd level, 3 slots · Flame Blade, Heat Metal, Lesser Restoration.
3rd level, 3 slots · Daylight, Dispel Magic, Protection from Energy.
4th level, 3 slots · Freedom of Movement, Wall of Fire.
5th level, 1 slot · Conjure Elemental.
sections.Actions:
Scimitar. Melee attack +5 within 5 ft. Hit for 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing and 14 (4d6) fire.
Flamecharm (once per short or long rest). Cast Dominate Monster against a Fire Elemental or another elemental fire creature. The save DC is 15. A target with 150 HP or more rolls with advantage.
sections.Bonus actions:
Flameform (once per short or long rest). Use the Fire Elemental stat block, retaining the firetamer’s personality, alignment, mental ability scores and skill and save proficiencies. The firetamer cannot cast spells in this form. It reverts after 5 hours, by spending a bonus action, or when it reaches 0 HP, loses consciousness or dies.
Druidic Recovery. During Flameform, spend a spell slot and regain 1d8 HP per level of that slot.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 226.
The hit points and Hit Dice are given as printed.

name: Ashari Skydancer
otherStatistics: Dexterity saves +7. Acrobatics +7, Perception +6. Passive Perception 16. Auran, Common, Druidic.

sections.Traits:
Evasion. When an effect allows a Dexterity save for half damage, the skydancer takes none on a success or half on a failure.
Flyby. It can fly out of an enemy’s reach without provoking an opportunity attack.
Skysail. With the wings open, it can glide 60 ft. without gaining altitude. It must descend at least 10 ft. by the end of each turn while gliding.
sections.Spellcasting:
3rd-level druid casting with Wisdom. Save DC 14, spell attack +6.
Cantrips at will · Guidance, Shillelagh.
1st level, 4 slots · Entangle, Fog Cloud, Jump.
2nd level, 2 slots · Gust of Wind, Pass without Trace.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Skysail Staff attacks.
Skysail Staff. Melee attack +7 within 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning. When the skydancer makes this attack in flight, the target makes a DC 14 Dexterity save against 21 (6d6) lightning, taking half on a success.
Skysail flight (1/day). Use the skysail to cast the Fly spell on oneself. Its duration is up to 1 minute and it requires no concentration.
sections.Reactions: Slow Fall. Halve falling damage when it is taken.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 227.

name: Ashari Stoneguard
otherStatistics: Granite half plate. Saves Strength +7, Constitution +8, Wisdom +5. Athletics +7, Intimidation +2. Immune to Petrified. Tremorsense 30 ft., passive Perception 12. Common, Druidic, Terran.

sections.Spellcasting:
3rd-level druid casting with Wisdom. Save DC 13, spell attack +5.
Cantrips at will · Druidcraft, Resistance.
1st level, 4 slots · Goodberry, Speak with Animals, Thunderwave.
2nd level, 2 slots · Hold Person, Spike Growth.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Granite Maul attacks.
Granite Maul. Melee attack +7 within 5 ft. On a hit, deal 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning. The stoneguard can immediately use its bonus action to cast Thunderwave, spending a slot and using no components.
sections.Reactions:
Sentinel. If a creature within 5 ft. attacks someone else, the stoneguard can make one attack against that creature.
Skin to Stone. When attacked, gain resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing attacks until that attacker’s turn ends.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 229.

name: Ashari Waverider
otherStatistics: Hide armor of cold resistance. Constitution saves +4, Wisdom +6. Athletics +8, Nature +3. Cold resistance. Passive Perception 13. Aquan, Common, Druidic.

sections.Traits:
Healing Tides. A nonhostile creature affected by a spell the waverider casts at 1st level or above also regains 3 HP.
Marine Empathy. The waverider can communicate with aquatic animals and plants.
sections.Spellcasting:
7th-level druid casting with Wisdom. Save DC 14, spell attack +6.
Cantrips at will · Druidcraft, Poison Spray (2d12), Resistance.
1st level, 4 slots · Create or Destroy Water, Cure Wounds, Healing Word.
2nd level, 3 slots · Animal Messenger, Lesser Restoration, Moonbeam.
3rd level, 3 slots · Conjure Animals (aquatic beasts only), Water Breathing, Water Walk.
4th level, 1 slot · Control Water.
sections.Actions: Harpoon. Melee or ranged attack +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. On a hit, deal 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing. A Large or smaller creature that loses a Strength contest against the waverider is pulled toward it by up to 20 ft. Underwater attacks with the harpoon take no disadvantage from being underwater.
sections.Reactions: Fishform (once per short or long rest). Use the Hunter Shark or Giant Octopus stat block, retaining the waverider’s alignment, personality, mental ability scores and skill proficiencies. Add the form’s skill proficiencies. It reverts after 3 hours, by spending a bonus action, or when it reaches 0 HP, loses consciousness or dies.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 230.
Fishform is printed as a reaction without a specified trigger.

name: Cinderslag Elemental
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Resists bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Immune to fire and poison damage. Condition immunities include Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained and Unconscious. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Searing Presence. A creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the elemental takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.
Molten Form. The elemental fits through openings as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing and can enter and remain in a hostile creature’s space. On its first entry into a creature’s space on a turn, the other creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and makes a DC 14 Strength save. Failure leaves it Restrained. It takes another 5 (1d10) fire damage if it starts its turn Restrained by this trait. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to break free.
Water Susceptibility. It takes 1 cold damage for each 5 ft. it moves through water or each gallon splashed on it.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack +5 within 5 ft. One target takes 12 (3d6 + 2) bludgeoning and 5 (1d10) fire on a hit. Hit creatures and flammable objects catch fire and take 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of their turns until a creature spends an action to put out the flames.
Molten Gaze. Ranged spell attack +8 against one target within 30 ft. A hit deals 21 (6d6) fire. The target also makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, the elemental destroys one nonmagical item of its choice that the target is carrying.
sections.Encounter context: An Ashari Firetamer can be an ally at Thordak’s Crater. The Fire Ashari have worked to contain the elemental damage there.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 231.
description: These elementals rise from places scarred by Thordak’s fire, including the damaged ground around his crater.

name: Clasp Cutthroat
otherStatistics: Leather armor. Dexterity saves +6. Deception +3, Stealth +8. Passive Perception 12. Common and Thieves’ Cant.

sections.Traits: Sneak Attack (once per turn). Add 14 (4d6) damage to a weapon hit made with advantage. The extra damage also applies without advantage when the target is within 5 ft. of a cutthroat ally who is not Incapacitated and the attack does not have disadvantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks with a shortsword or dagger.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack +6 within 5 ft. Hit for 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +6, with a 5-ft. reach or 20/60-ft. range. Hit for 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing.
sections.Bonus actions: Cunning Action. Take Dash, Disengage, or Hide.
sections.Reactions: Uncanny Dodge. When the cutthroat can see the attacker that hits it, it can halve the damage from that attack.
sections.Encounter context: A Clasp Enforcer collects debts or applies pressure in the open. The cutthroat handles jobs that require stealth.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 232.
description: A Clasp operative who favors cover, surprise, and a clear way out.

name: Clasp Enforcer
otherStatistics: Half plate. Athletics +6, Intimidation +8. Passive Perception 10. Common and Thieves’ Cant.

sections.Traits: Intimidating Presence. Whenever the enforcer hits a creature with a melee attack, that creature makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On failure, it is Frightened of the enforcer through the end of its own next turn. The enforcer and its allies have advantage on attacks against it while it is Frightened by this trait. A successful save or the end of the effect makes the target immune to this enforcer’s Intimidating Presence for 24 hours.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Warhammer attacks.
Warhammer. Melee weapon attack +6 within 5 ft. Hit for 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning.
sections.Bonus actions: Second Wind (once per short or long rest). Regain 12 HP.
sections.Encounter context: Use a Clasp Cutthroat when the Clasp needs the job done unseen. An enforcer comes when it wants the target to know who sent it.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 233.
The printed block lists Second Wind twice. Both entries describe the same bonus action and recharge.
description: The Clasp sends enforcers to collect debts or make a threat in person.

name: Cold Snap Spirit
otherStatistics: Dexterity saves +8, Wisdom +1. Perception +1, Stealth +8. Resists piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks. Immune to cold and poison damage. Vulnerable to fire. Condition immunities include Charmed, Frightened, Poisoned, Paralyzed and Stunned. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 11. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Sense Heat. It detects heat sources within 60 ft.
Frozen Aura. A creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the spirit takes 5 (1d10) cold damage.
Jealous Spirit. A hit deals an extra 10 (3d6) cold damage if the target is within 5 ft. of a different Cold Snap Spirit.
sections.Actions:
Consume Warmth. Melee spell attack +8 within 5 ft. A hit deals 21 (6d6) cold and cuts the target’s speed in half until the end of the spirit’s next turn.
Subzero Wave (1/day). Each creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Constitution save. It takes 18 (4d8) cold damage on a failure or half on a success.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 234.
description: Cold Snap Spirits drift through frozen places and can turn hostile when they sense warmth nearby.

name: Cyclops Stormcaller
speed: 30 ft., fly 60 ft. outdoors in stormy weather
otherStatistics: Chain mail, Cloak of Protection and Ring of Protection. Saves Strength +5, Dexterity +2, Constitution +6, Intelligence +4, Wisdom +5, Charisma +11. Arcana +6. Passive Perception 9. Common, Elvish, Giant.

sections.Traits:
One-Eyed. Attacks against targets farther than 30 ft. are made with disadvantage.
Storm Wings. It has a flying speed of 60 ft. only outdoors in stormy conditions.
Supernatural Focus. It has advantage on Constitution saves to maintain spell concentration. Turbulent weather cannot break its concentration.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma-based, spell save DC 17 and spell attack +9. These spells require no material components.
At will · Ray of Frost (3d8), Water Walk.
3/day each · Ice Storm, Sleet Storm, Wind Wall.
1/day each · Control Weather, Storm of Vengeance.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Ice Claw attacks.
Ice Claw. Melee weapon attack +7 within 5 ft. Hit for 13 (3d6 + 3) slashing plus 3 (1d6) cold.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 235.
description: A storm-touched giant whose magic is strongest in the open during a storm.

name: Demonfeed Spider
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Dexterity saves +7. Perception +3, Stealth +7. Resists cold, fire and lightning. Immune to poison damage and the Poisoned condition. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 13. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Spider Climb. Move across difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
Web Walker. Webbing does not restrict its movement.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Stinger attack, or use Web Spinner and then make one melee attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +7 within 5 ft. Hit for 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing. The target then makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On failure it takes 27 (6d8) poison damage and is Poisoned for 1 minute. Success halves the poison damage and avoids the condition. If the poison damage drops it to 0 HP, it stabilizes and is Poisoned for 1 hour even if it regains HP. It is Paralyzed while that longer poison lasts.
Stinger. Melee weapon attack +7 within 5 ft. Hit for 9 (1d12 + 3) piercing. The target must pass a DC 14 Constitution save or be Paralyzed for 1 minute. Repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the condition on a success.
Web Spinner. Ranged weapon attack +7 with a 40-ft. range. On a hit, pull the target 40 ft. toward the spider and Grapple it (escape DC 14). Only one creature at a time can be held by Web Spinner. The spider can spend an action to cocoon that creature. The cocoon leaves it Restrained and ends the grapple.
sections.Reactions: Arterial Spray. When the spider takes damage while below half its maximum HP, it can spray venomous blood in a 15-ft. cone. Each creature in the cone makes a DC 14 Constitution save. Failure deals 13 (3d8) poison damage and leaves it Poisoned for 1 minute. Success halves the damage and avoids the poison condition. If the spray’s poison damage drops it to 0 HP, it stabilizes and is Poisoned for 1 hour even if it regains HP. It is Paralyzed while that longer poison lasts.
sections.Encounter context: Use the separate Demonfeed Spiderling block for the younger creatures in its nest.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 237.
The printed cocoon rule specifies no separate escape DC or duration.
description: A fiendish spider that can pull prey into its web and spray venom when badly wounded.

name: Demonfeed Spiderling
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Dexterity saves +3. Perception +0, Stealth +5. Resists cold, fire and lightning. Immune to poison damage and the Poisoned condition. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 10. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Spider Climb. Move across difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
Web Walker. Webbing does not restrict its movement.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack +3 within 5 ft. Hit for 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing. A DC 13 Constitution save halves the additional 10 (3d6) poison damage.
sections.Encounter context: Use the Demonfeed Spider block for the adult.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 237.
description: A young member of a demonfeed nest with a venomous bite.

name: Ember Roc
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Dexterity +5, Constitution +9, Wisdom +5, Charisma +4. Perception +5. Immune to fire damage. Passive Perception 15. Understands Ignan without speaking it.

sections.Traits:
Keen Sight. Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
Searing Presence. A creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the roc takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.
Illumination. Bright light within 40 ft., then dim light for another 40 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Beak and one Talons attack.
Beak. Melee weapon attack +13 within 10 ft. Hit for 26 (4d8 + 8) piercing plus 7 (2d6) fire.
Talons. Melee weapon attack +13 within 5 ft. Hit for 22 (4d6 + 8) slashing plus 7 (2d6) fire.
Inferno (recharge 5–6). Each creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. Failure deals 21 (6d6) fire damage. A successful save avoids the damage.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 238.
The encounter lore describes the roc seizing prey. The printed Talons action deals damage without an automatic grapple.
description: An enormous bird of prey whose feathers burn with elemental fire.

name: Cobalt Golem
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Immune to fire, lightning, poison and psychic damage. Immune to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons that are not adamantine. Immune to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified and Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 10. Understands its creator’s languages but cannot speak.

sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. Effects and spells cannot change the golem’s shape.
Magic Resistance. It rolls saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks count as magical.
Conductive Body. Lightning causes no damage. Instead, through the end of the golem’s next turn, its weapon attacks deal an extra 11 (2d10) lightning damage. In that window, a creature takes 11 (2d10) lightning damage if it touches the golem or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Slam and Sword, or use Magnetic Pulse followed by Spinning Cleave.
Slam. Melee weapon attack +15 within 5 ft. Hit for 25 (3d10 + 9) bludgeoning.
Sword. Melee weapon attack +15 within 10 ft. Hit for 28 (3d12 + 9) slashing.
Spinning Cleave. Make a Sword attack against every creature within 10 ft.
Magnetic Pulse (recharge 6). Unattended metal objects within 30 ft. are pulled into unoccupied spaces within 5 ft. of the golem. A creature within 30 ft. that is made of metal or wearing metal armor must pass a DC 20 Strength save or be pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the golem and knocked Prone.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 240.
description: A lodestone-powered construct that guards the most restricted archives of the Cobalt Soul.

name: Forge Guardian
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Strength saves +18, Constitution +15. Immune to fire, poison and psychic damage. Immune to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons that are not adamantine. Immune to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified and Poisoned. Truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 10. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. Effects and spells cannot change the golem’s shape.
Magic Resistance. It rolls saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks count as magical.
Fire Absorption. Fire deals no damage and restores HP equal to the damage it would have dealt.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks.
Runeblade. Melee weapon attack +18 within 15 ft. A hit deals 36 (4d12 + 10) slashing. The target must pass a DC 23 Constitution save or become Blinded until it deals damage to the guardian.
Kick. Melee weapon attack +18 within 10 ft. A hit deals 23 (2d12 + 10) bludgeoning, pushes the target away by up to 15 ft., and knocks it Prone.
Bladestorm (recharge 5–6). Make a Runeblade attack against every creature within 15 ft. On each hit, also push the target away by up to 15 ft. and knock it Prone.
sections.Legendary actions:
The guardian can spend up to three legendary actions. It chooses one option at a time, only at the end of another creature’s turn, and recovers the spent actions at the start of its own turn.
Runeblade (1 action). Make one Runeblade attack.
Kick (1 action). Make one Kick attack.
Trample (2 actions). Move up to 50 ft. without provoking opportunity attacks. The guardian can pass through creature spaces. Each creature it passes through makes a DC 23 Dexterity save. Failure deals 23 (2d12 + 10) bludgeoning and knocks the creature Prone. Success halves the damage and avoids Prone. If any creature still shares the guardian’s space when it stops, move that creature to the nearest unoccupied space.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 241.
The printed Dexterity score is 10 with a listed modifier of +1. Both values are retained.
description: A towering construct built to guard the All-Hammer’s forges.

name: Mage Hunter Golem
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Wisdom saves +5, Charisma +0. Perception +5. Immune to poison and psychic damage. Immune to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons that are not adamantine. Immune to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified and Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft., truesight 30 ft., passive Perception 15. Understands its creator’s languages but cannot speak.

sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. Effects and spells cannot change the golem’s shape.
Magic Resistance. It rolls saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks count as magical.
Antimagic Cone. The golem projects the effect of the Antimagic Field spell in a 60-ft. cone from itself. At the start of its turn it chooses the cone’s direction and whether it is active.
Magic Absorption. If a spell of 4th level or lower would damage it, the golem instead heals for that amount.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Antimagic Jolt and make two melee attacks, or make three melee attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack +12 within 5 ft. Hit for 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning.
Claw (recharge 5–6). Melee weapon attack +12 within 5 ft. A hit deals 11 (1d8 + 7) bludgeoning and forces a DC 16 Dexterity save. On a failure, a magical collar prevents the target from speaking or casting any spell. A successful DC 25 Dexterity check using thieves’ tools removes the collar.
Antimagic Jolt. Each creature in the active cone that can cast a spell of 1st level or higher makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. It takes 21 (6d6) psychic on a failure or half on a success.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 242.
description: A construct built to suppress spellcasting and capture mages.

name: Platinum Golem
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Immune to acid, cold, fire, poison and psychic damage. Immune to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks that are not adamantine. Immune to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified and Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 11. Understands its creator’s languages but cannot speak.

sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. Effects and spells cannot change the golem’s shape.
Magic Resistance. It rolls saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks count as magical.
Divine Custodian. A creature hit by the golem’s opportunity attack has a speed of 0 for the rest of that turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack +11 within 5 ft. Hit for 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing.
Mace. Melee weapon attack +11 within 10 ft. Hit for 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning.
Radiant Blast (recharge 6). Each creature within 20 ft. makes a DC 18 Constitution save. Failure deals 18 (4d8) radiant damage and leaves it Blinded until the end of its next turn. Success halves the damage and avoids blindness.
sections.Reactions: Divine Judgment. When a creature within 10 ft. attacks a target other than the golem, it can make a Mace attack against the attacker.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 243.
description: A platinum-plated protector fashioned from the spirit of a warrior.

name: Jourrael, the Caedogeist
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Saves Dexterity +12, Constitution +10, Wisdom +8. Acrobatics +12, Perception +13, Stealth +17. Resists acid, fire, lightning, cold and thunder, plus bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks. Immune to poison damage and the Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Prone and Restrained conditions. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 23. Abyssal, Common, Infernal, Undercommon.

sections.Traits:
Incorporeal Movement. They can cross objects and creatures as difficult terrain. Ending a turn inside an object deals them 5 (1d10) force damage.
Sneak Attack (once per turn). Add 35 (10d6) to a weapon hit made with advantage. The extra damage also applies when the target is within 5 ft. of an ally of Jourrael who is not Incapacitated and the roll has no disadvantage.
Inevitable. At 0 HP, they become an Invisible, incorporeal spirit instead of falling Unconscious. For up to 24 hours, they cannot attack, interact with corporeal creatures or objects, or be targeted by spells. They return to their normal form early only at full HP. At 24 hours they regain 1 HP, return to their original form, and take four levels of Exhaustion.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma-based, spell save DC 15. No material components are required.
At will · Dancing Lights.
1/day each · Darkness, Faerie Fire.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee or two ranged attacks.
Spectral Blade. Melee weapon attack +12 within 5 ft. A hit deals 10 (1d6 + 7) slashing and forces a DC 14 Constitution save. Failure leaves the target Poisoned for 1 hour. A failure by 5 or more also leaves it Unconscious during that poison. Damage or another creature spending an action to shake it wakes it.
Void Dagger. Ranged weapon attack +12, range 60/120 ft. A hit deals 9 (1d4 + 7) piercing.
sections.Bonus actions:
Cunning Action. Take Dash, Disengage, or Hide.
Mirrored Form (once per short rest). Create three illusory duplicates in Jourrael’s space. When someone targets them with an attack, roll a d20 to see if it targets a duplicate instead. Redirect on 6 or higher with three duplicates, 8 or higher with two, or 11 or higher with one. A duplicate has AC 17 and is destroyed when hit. Jourrael can spend a bonus action to hide the duplicates.
sections.Reactions: Parry. Gain +5 AC against one melee attack that would hit, provided Jourrael can see the attacker.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 245.
description: The Spider Queen’s assassin returns from apparent defeat as an incorporeal spirit.

name: Kraghammer Goat-Knight
otherStatistics: Plate and shield. Saves with Aura of Protection active: Strength +5, Dexterity +1, Constitution +4, Intelligence +2, Wisdom +2, Charisma +5. Nature +2, Religion +4. Poison resistance. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Common and Dwarvish.

sections.Traits:
Aura of Protection. While conscious, the knight grants +2 to its own saving throws and those of friendly creatures within 10 ft. The knight’s printed saves already include that bonus.
Divine Health. The knight cannot contract disease.
Dwarven Resilience. The knight resists poison damage and has advantage on saves against poison.
sections.Spellcasting:
6th-level paladin casting with Charisma. Spell save DC 13 and spell attack +5.
1st level, 4 slots · Bless, Cure Wounds, Protection from Evil and Good, Sanctuary, Shield of Faith.
2nd level, 2 slots · Branding Smite, Find Steed, Lesser Restoration, Zone of Truth.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Warhammer attacks.
Warhammer. Melee weapon attack +5 within 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning one-handed or 8 (1d10 + 3) with two hands.
sections.Mount: Use the linked Goat-Knight Steed block for the celestial mount summoned by Find Steed.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 246.
description: A dwarf paladin of the All-Hammer who patrols Kraghammer’s mountain trails.

name: Goat-Knight Steed
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Passive Perception 11. Understands Dwarvish without speaking it.

sections.Traits:
Charge. After moving at least 20 ft. straight toward a target, a Ram hit against it on the same turn deals an extra 5 (2d4) bludgeoning. If the target is a creature, it must pass a DC 13 Strength save or fall Prone.
Sure-Footed. Advantage on Strength or Dexterity saves against being knocked Prone.
Summoned mount. A spell its goat-knight casts with a range of Self also targets this steed. It vanishes without a body at 0 HP or if its knight spends an action to dismiss it. The same steed returns when that knight casts Find Steed again.
sections.Actions: Ram. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning.
sections.Base creature: This block applies the printed modification to the 2014 Giant Goat.
sections.Rider: The Kraghammer Goat-Knight has the corresponding rider stats and spell slots.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 246.
description: A celestial mountain goat summoned to carry a Kraghammer paladin.

name: Magma Landshark
speed: 50 ft., burrow 50 ft., swim 50 ft. in lava only
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Immune to fire damage. Perception +7. Darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 120 ft., passive Perception 17. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Searing Presence. A creature that starts its turn within 10 ft. of the landshark takes 11 (2d10) fire damage.
Standing Leap. It can long jump 40 ft. or high jump 20 ft., even without a running start.
Illumination. Bright light within 15 ft., then dim light for another 15 ft.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack +11 within 5 ft. A hit deals 45 (6d12 + 6) piercing and 14 (4d6) fire. A target of Large size or smaller must pass a DC 18 Dexterity save or be swallowed.
Swallowed creatures. They are Blinded and Restrained, have total cover from outside attacks and effects, and take 42 (12d6) fire damage at the start of each landshark turn. If one creature inside deals 30 damage or more to the landshark in a single turn, the landshark makes a DC 23 Constitution save at the end of that turn. On failure it expels every swallowed creature, Prone within 10 ft. If the landshark dies, a creature inside is no longer Restrained and can exit Prone by spending 15 ft. of movement.
Deadly Leap. After jumping at least 15 ft. during its movement, it can land in a space occupied by one or more other creatures. Each makes a DC 18 Strength or Dexterity save of its choice. On a failure it takes 27 (6d6 + 6) bludgeoning plus 21 (6d6) fire and falls Prone. On success it takes half damage and is pushed 5 ft. into an unoccupied space it chooses outside the landshark’s space. If no such space is within range, it falls Prone where the landshark lands.
Lava Pool (recharge 6). While on solid ground, melt the area within a 10-ft. radius. Any creature that starts its turn in the pool or enters it for the first time on a turn takes 44 (8d10) fire damage.
sections.Related creature: Use Young Magma Landshark for the juvenile encounter.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 247.
The source gives Lava Pool no duration.
description: A Huge predator that tunnels through rock and can swallow creatures whole.

name: Young Magma Landshark
speed: 40 ft., burrow 40 ft., swim 40 ft. in lava only
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Immune to fire damage. Perception +4. Darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 120 ft., passive Perception 14. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Searing Presence. A creature that starts its turn within 10 ft. of the landshark takes 11 (2d10) fire damage.
Standing Leap. It can long jump 40 ft. or high jump 20 ft., even without a running start.
Illumination. Bright light within 15 ft., then dim light for another 15 ft.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack +9 within 5 ft. A hit deals 31 (4d12 + 5) piercing plus 14 (4d6) fire.
Deadly Leap. After jumping at least 15 ft. during its movement, it can land in a space occupied by one or more other creatures. Each makes a DC 16 Strength or Dexterity save of its choice. On a failure it takes 19 (4d6 + 5) bludgeoning plus 14 (4d6) fire and falls Prone. On success it takes half damage and is pushed 5 ft. into an unoccupied space it chooses outside the landshark’s space. If no such space is within range, it falls Prone where the landshark lands.
sections.Related creature: Use Magma Landshark for the adult encounter.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 248.
description: A lava-dwelling juvenile that leaps from its burrow onto nearby prey.

name: Ravager Slaughter Lord
otherStatistics: Unarmored Defense. Saves Strength +10, Constitution +9, Wisdom +7. Intimidation +11, Religion +5. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13. Abyssal, Common, and one other language.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (2/day). After failing a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
Unarmored Defense. Add its Constitution modifier to AC while it has neither armor nor a shield.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Wisdom-based, spell save DC 15, spell attack +7. It casts these spells without material components.
At will · Thaumaturgy.
3/day each · Flame Strike, Spirit Guardians.
1/day each · Control Weather, Divine Word, Fire Storm.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make four Dual Greatswords attacks or three Spear attacks.
Dual Greatswords. Melee weapon attack +10 within 5 ft. Hit for 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing and 3 (1d6) fire.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack +10, thrown range 20/60 ft. Hit for 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing and 3 (1d6) fire. A two-handed melee hit raises the piercing damage to 15 (2d8 + 6).
sections.Bonus actions: Aggressive. Move up to its speed toward a hostile creature it can see.
sections.Legendary actions:
It has three legendary actions, regaining spent actions at the start of its turn. Use one option at a time and only at the end of another creature’s turn.
Attack (1 action). Make one Spear or Dual Greatswords attack.
Move (1 action). Move up to half speed.
Cast a Spell (3 actions). Cast one innate spell.
sections.Encounter context: A Ravager Stabby-Stabber can accompany a Slaughter Lord’s raiding party.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 250.
description: A Ravager warlord who combines heavy weapons with blessings of the Ruiner.

name: Ravager Stabby-Stabber
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Wisdom saves +1. Immune to Charmed. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 9. Common and one other language.

sections.Traits: Stabby Frenzy. On a melee hit, it can make another attack and keep making additional attacks until it misses. It cannot move between attacks made through this trait.
sections.Actions:
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack +5 within 5 ft. Hit for 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +5, with a 5-ft. reach or 20/60-ft. thrown range. Hit for 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing.
sections.Bonus actions: Nimble Escape. Take Disengage or Hide.
sections.Encounter context: A Ravager Slaughter Lord leads the warband these fighters serve.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 250.
description: A quick Ravager whose melee hits can start a chain of attacks.

name: Remnant Chosen
otherStatistics: AC increases to 15 with Mage Armor. Saves Charisma +9, Wisdom +7. Arcana +10, Deception +9. Resists damage from spells. Immune to necrotic damage. Truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 13. Abyssal, Common, Infernal.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Withering Spells. After casting a spell of 1st level or above, its next Withering Touch attack before the end of its next turn deals 1d6 extra damage per level of the spell.
sections.Spellcasting:
18th-level sorcerer casting with Charisma. Spell save DC 17, spell attack +9.
At will · Chill Touch (4d8), Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Message, Shocking Grasp (4d8).
1st level, 4 slots · Charm Person, Mage Armor, Shield.
2nd level, 3 slots · Blindness/Deafness, Detect Thoughts.
3rd level, 3 slots · Counterspell, Fly, Hypnotic Pattern.
4th level, 3 slots · Greater Invisibility.
5th level, 3 slots · Dominate Person, Seeming.
6th level, 1 slot · Eyebite.
7th level, 1 slot · Finger of Death.
8th level, 1 slot · Power Word Stun.
9th level, 1 slot · Power Word Kill.
sections.Actions: Withering Touch. Melee spell attack +9 within 5 ft. Hit for 17 (5d6) force and apply any bonus from Withering Spells. If this damage drops a creature to 0 HP, the creature and its possessions turn to dust, except for magical items. Only True Resurrection or Wish can restore it to life.
sections.Bonus actions: Inescapable Sight. Choose one creature or object affected by an illusion spell of 4th level or lower and dispel one such illusion affecting it.
sections.Encounter context: Use the Remnant Cultist block for other members of the order who serve the same master.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 251.

The printed Withering Spells trait calls its attack Withered Hand. The only attack in the block is Withering Touch, which calls back to the bonus damage trait. These names are treated as referring to each other.
description: A high-ranking servant of the Whispered One who can dispel illusions and turn foes to dust.

name: Remnant Cultist
otherStatistics: AC increases to 16 with Mage Armor. Wisdom saves +2. Deception +5, Stealth +6. Resists necrotic and psychic damage. Passive Perception 9. Common and Infernal.

sections.Traits:
Unknowable Secrets. A creature fails if it attempts to form a mental link with the cultist or targets it with Scrying or Speak with Dead. The creature that tried takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage.
One-Eyed. Attack rolls against targets farther than 30 ft. have disadvantage.
Spellsteal. After negating a spell with Counterspell, the cultist can cast the negated spell once before the end of its next turn. It spends a slot of the same level or higher and uses no material components.
sections.Spellcasting:
11th-level wizard casting with Intelligence. Spell save DC 15, spell attack +7.
At will · Chill Touch (3d8), Message, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation, Ray of Frost (3d8).
1st level, 4 slots · Detect Magic, Tasha's Hideous Laughter, Mage Armor, Shield.
2nd level, 3 slots · Detect Thoughts, Suggestion.
3rd level, 3 slots · Counterspell, Fear, Vampiric Touch.
4th level, 3 slots · Greater Invisibility, Phantasmal Killer.
5th level, 2 slots · Dream, Mislead.
6th level, 1 slot · Circle of Death.
sections.Actions:
Dagger of Wounding. Melee or ranged weapon attack +6, with a 5-ft. reach or 20/60-ft. thrown range. Hit for 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing. HP lost to the weapon can be recovered only by finishing a short or long rest.
Wounds. Once per turn on a dagger hit, the cultist can wound a creature. At the start of each wounded creature’s turn, that creature takes 2 (1d4) necrotic damage per wound and can then make a DC 15 Constitution save to end every wound on a success. The wounded creature or another creature within 5 ft. can use an action to make a DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check, ending the wounds on a success.
sections.Encounter context: Use the Remnant Chosen block when a senior member leads the cultists.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 252.
description: A Remnant spellcaster who can turn a spell it counters back on its opponents.

name: Rivermaw Brawler
otherStatistics: Unarmored Defense. Strength saves +5, Wisdom +5. Acrobatics +4, Athletics +5, Perception +5. Passive Perception 15. Common, Giant.

sections.Traits: Unarmored Defense. Its AC includes its Wisdom modifier when it wears no armor and carries no shield.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Unarmed Strikes.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack +5 within 5 ft. Hit for 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning. On a hit against a creature of Large size or smaller, the brawler can choose Bruise, Disarm or Suplex.
Bruise. The target makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On failure its speed drops by 5 ft. until it receives at least 1 HP of magical healing. A creature can instead spend an action to attempt a DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check on an affected creature within 5 ft., including itself. Success restores the lost speed.
Disarm. On a failed DC 13 Strength save the target drops a held item of the brawler’s choice. The brawler can then pick it up.
Suplex. On a failed DC 13 Strength save the target falls Prone.
sections.Reactions:
Clever Fighter. After it hits with an attack or becomes the target of an attack, the brawler can add its Intelligence modifier (+2) to damage rolls or AC until the end of its turn.
Endurance (once per short or long rest). After taking damage, reduce that damage by 8 (1d12 + 2).
sections.Encounter context: The Rivermaw Stormborn uses the separate storm magic and greataxe block.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 254.
description: A Rivermaw fighter who uses unarmed strikes to slow, disarm, or throw opponents.

name: Rivermaw Stormborn
otherStatistics: Hide armor. Constitution saves +7, Charisma +4. Athletics +7, Intimidation +4. Resists lightning damage. Passive Perception 10. Common, Giant.

sections.Traits: Reckless. At the start of its turn it can choose advantage on all its melee weapon attacks that turn. Attacks against it then have advantage until the start of its next turn.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma-based, spell save DC 12. No material components are required.
3/day · Lightning Bolt.
1/day · Call Lightning.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greataxe attacks. If already concentrating on Call Lightning, it can also call down a bolt from the spell.
Greataxe. Melee weapon attack +7 within 5 ft. Hit for 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing plus 3 (1d6) lightning.
sections.Reactions: Endurance (once per short or long rest). After taking damage, reduce that damage by 10 (1d12 + 4).
sections.Encounter context: Use the Rivermaw Brawler block for the herd’s unarmed warriors.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 254.
description: A Rivermaw warrior who can bring down lightning while pressing with a greataxe.

name: Centaur Skeleton
otherStatistics: Vulnerable to bludgeoning. Immune to poison damage, Exhaustion and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 9. Understands Common but cannot speak.

sections.Traits:
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, water or sleep.
Charge. If it travels at least 30 ft. straight toward a target and hits it with Pike on the same turn, the hit deals 10 (3d6) extra piercing damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Pike and one Hooves attack, or fire the Longbow twice.
Pike. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 10 ft. Hit for 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing.
Hooves. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit for 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack +4, range 150/600 ft. Hit for 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing.
sections.Variant: The Centaur Skeleton (Variant) adds the printed Spirit Away customization.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 256.
description: An animated skeleton assembled from the remains of multiple creatures.

name: Centaur Skeleton (Variant)
otherStatistics: Vulnerable to bludgeoning. Immune to poison damage, Exhaustion and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 9. Understands Common but cannot speak.

sections.Traits:
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, water or sleep.
Charge. If it travels at least 30 ft. straight toward a target and hits it with Pike on the same turn, the hit deals 10 (3d6) extra piercing damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Pike and one Hooves attack, or fire the Longbow twice.
Pike. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 10 ft. Hit for 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing.
Hooves. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit for 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack +4, range 150/600 ft. Hit for 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing.
sections.Customization: Spirit Away. The skeleton and up to three creatures within 5 ft. of it magically cross between the Material Plane and the Ethereal Plane. An unwilling creature can prevent its own transfer with a successful DC 13 Charisma save.
sections.Base creature: This version adds Spirit Away to the Centaur Skeleton.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 256.
The printed Spirit Away customization does not give an activation time or recharge limit.
description: A Parchwood centaur skeleton with the optional Spirit Away feature.

name: Flaming Skeleton
otherStatistics: Vulnerable to bludgeoning. Immune to fire damage, poison damage, Exhaustion and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 9. Understands its languages from life but cannot speak.

sections.Traits:
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, water or sleep.
Heated Weapons. A hit with a metal melee weapon deals an extra 3 (1d6) fire damage. The Shortsword damage already includes it.
Illumination. Bright light extends 10 ft., followed by 10 ft. of dim light.
sections.Actions:
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft. Hit for 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing and 3 (1d6) fire.
Ignite. Choose a Large or smaller creature within 5 ft. It makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On failure it is Grappled (escape DC 12) and catches fire. It takes 3 (1d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns, even if the grapple ends. The target or a creature within 5 ft. can spend an action to put out the flames. Another effect that quenches them, such as submersion in water, also stops the damage.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 256.
description: A burning skeleton found where Thordak’s fire scarred the land.

name: Adranach
otherStatistics: Strength saves +11, Dexterity +8. Athletics +11, Perception +7. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 17. Understands its creator’s languages but cannot speak. Natural armor. Resists damage from spells. Immune to poison damage and to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks. Immune to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified and Poisoned.

sections.Traits:
Arcane Nature. It can function without air, food, drink or sleep.
Immutable Form. Its shape cannot be changed by magic or other effects.
Magic Resistance. It rolls saves against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
Magic Weapons. Treat its weapon attacks as magical.
Arcane Leak. Once reduced to half its maximum HP (85), its mask cracks. A creature that starts its turn within 10 ft. of it or first enters that radius on a turn takes 10 (3d6) radiant damage. Casting in the radius requires a DC 14 check with the caster’s spellcasting ability. On failure the spell fails, the slot is expended, and the caster takes 3 (1d6) force damage per slot level.
Powerful Build. Treat it as one size larger for carrying, pushing, dragging and lifting.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claws attacks.
Claws. Melee weapon attack +11, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 32 (4d12 + 6) slashing.
Force Bolts (Recharge 5–6). Choose up to four creatures it can see within 60 ft. Each takes 28 (8d6) force damage on a failed DC 18 Dexterity save.
sections.Customization:
Most adranachs have one optional feature. Most masters have three.
Advanced Tracking (once per long rest). When a creature fails its Force Bolts save, it may mark the creature for 24 hours. On the same plane, the adranach knows the direction to the creature and which way it is moving.
Arcane Bond. Its creator can speak with it telepathically within 1 mile. The creator may spend an action to use the adranach’s hearing and sight, including its special senses, until the creator’s next turn starts. The creator is Blinded and Deafened to their own surroundings during that time.
Slipstream. It can cast Invisibility on itself at will. Double its speed while Invisible.
Master only · Astral Form (once per long rest). Cast Astral Projection on itself.
Master only · Truesight. It has Truesight to 30 ft. It can spend an action to extend that range to 120 ft. through the end of its next turn.
sections.Encounter context: The Master Adranach has its own combat profile.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 224.
The printed Charisma modifier is +1 for a score of 11. The ability grid uses the standard +0. The book does not specify how Arcane Leak handles a spell cast without a slot.
description: An arcane construct bound into a mithral mask by a spellwright.

name: Master Adranach
otherStatistics: Strength saves +14, Dexterity +10, Wisdom +9. Athletics +14, Perception +16. Darkvision 360 ft., passive Perception 26. Speaks its creator’s languages. Natural armor. Resists damage from spells. Immune to poison damage and to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks. Immune to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified and Poisoned.

sections.Traits:
Arcane Nature. It can function without air, food, drink or sleep.
Immutable Form. Its shape cannot be changed by magic or other effects.
Magic Resistance. It rolls saves against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
Magic Weapons. Treat its weapon attacks as magical.
Arcane Leak. Once reduced to half its maximum HP (145), its mask cracks. A creature that starts its turn within 20 ft. of it or first enters that radius on a turn takes 21 (6d6) radiant damage. Casting in the radius requires a DC 18 check with the caster’s spellcasting ability. On failure the spell fails, the slot is expended, and the caster takes 7 (2d6) force damage per slot level.
Colossal Build. Double its carrying capacity and push, drag and lift limits.
Slipstream. It can cast Invisibility on itself at will. Double its speed while Invisible.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). It can turn a failed save into a success.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claws attacks and one Tail attack.
Claws. Melee weapon attack +14, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 33 (4d12 + 7) slashing.
Tail. Melee weapon attack +14, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit for 20 (2d12 + 7) bludgeoning.
Force Bolts (Recharge 5–6). Choose up to six creatures it can see within 120 ft. Each takes 35 (10d6) force damage on a failed DC 22 Dexterity save.
sections.Legendary actions:
It has three actions, replenished at the start of its turn. Spend them on one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Claw Attack (1 action). Make one Claws attack.
Vanish (2 actions). Cast Invisibility and move up to its walking or flying speed without doubling the movement from Slipstream.
Starry Burst (3 actions). Each creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 22 Constitution save. Failure deals 27 (5d10) force damage and leaves the creature Blinded through the end of its next turn. Success halves the damage and avoids the condition. The adranach becomes Invisible until its next turn starts or it attacks.
sections.Customization: See Adranach for the optional features, including Astral Form and Truesight for a master.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 225.
The printed Charisma modifier is +1 for a score of 11. The ability grid uses the standard +0. The book does not specify how Arcane Leak handles a spell cast without a slot.
description: An immense adranach made by a master spellwright.

name: Vos’skyriss Serpentfolk
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +2, Stealth +4. Immune to poison damage and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Common, Draconic.

sections.Traits: Hold Breath. It can go 30 minutes without breathing.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma, spell save DC 12. No material components required.
At will · Animal Friendship, Speak with Animals (snakes only).
2/day each · Sleep, Suggestion.
1/day · Pass without Trace.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Scimitar attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit for 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing plus 7 (2d6) poison.
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit for 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning and leave the target Grappled (escape DC 13). While Grappled this way the target is Restrained and the serpentfolk cannot constrict another target.
