sections.Encounter context: Use the Vos’skyriss Serpentfolk Ghost for the incorporeal form.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 258.
description: A serpentfolk warrior who can lull intruders to sleep or pin them with its coils.

name: Vos’skyriss Serpentfolk Ghost
otherStatistics: Perception +2, Stealth +7. Resists acid, fire, lightning and thunder, and bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks. Immune to cold, necrotic and poison damage. Immune to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Prone and Restrained. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Common, Draconic.

sections.Traits:
Ethereal Sight. It can see 60 ft. into the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane and the other way around.
Incorporeal Movement. It passes through objects and creatures as Difficult Terrain. Ending its turn inside an object deals it 5 (1d10) force damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Spear attacks.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit for 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing plus 7 (2d6) necrotic. A thrown spear reappears in its grasp after the attack.
Etherealness. Move between the Material Plane and Ethereal Plane. While in the Border Ethereal, it and creatures on the Material Plane can see one another. It cannot affect anything across that boundary or be affected from the other side.
Terrifying Hiss. Each non-Undead creature within 30 ft. that hears it makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened for 1 minute and can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns. A successful save or the end of the effect gives that creature immunity to this ghost’s hiss for 24 hours.
sections.Encounter context: See Vos’skyriss Serpentfolk for the living creature.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 258.
description: A serpentfolk spirit with a returning spear and a hiss that terrifies living intruders.

name: Wraithroot Tree
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +8. Resists bludgeoning and piercing. Vulnerable to fire. Immune to Stunned, Frightened, Charmed, Paralyzed and Poisoned. Passive Perception 18. Common, Druidic, Elvish, Sylvan.

sections.Traits:
False Appearance. While motionless, it cannot be distinguished from an ordinary tree.
Wraith Shift. On its turn it passes through other creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain without provoking Opportunity Attacks. It must finish moving clear of Large or larger creatures and objects. Any Medium or smaller creatures sharing its space choose a nearest unoccupied space and are pushed there. The tree chooses the nearest unoccupied spaces for Medium or smaller objects it displaces.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack +11, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit for 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack +11, range 60/180 ft., one target. Hit for 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning.
Wraithstorm (Recharge 5–6). Each creature within 30 ft. other than a Construct or Undead makes a DC 16 Constitution save. On failure its speed is halved and it becomes vulnerable to bludgeoning until the end of the tree’s next turn.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 259.
description: A tree animated by necromancy and posted to guard buried secrets.

name: Grog Strongjaw
otherStatistics: Strength saves +14, Constitution +12. Animal Handling +6, Athletics +14, Intimidation +7, Survival +6. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Common, Dwarvish and Giant, with limited literacy.

sections.Traits:
Brutal Critical. Roll three extra weapon dice after the usual doubled weapon dice on a critical hit.
Feral Instinct. Roll initiative with Advantage.
Melee Master. He may trade a −5 penalty on a melee attack roll for +10 damage on a hit.
Reckless. At the start of his turn he may take Advantage on his melee weapon attacks that turn. Attacks against him then also have Advantage until his next turn starts.
Relentless Rage. If he drops to 0 HP during his Rage, a DC 10 Constitution save lets him stay at 1 HP.
Spellbreaker. When he damages a creature concentrating on a spell, it makes the save to keep that spell with Disadvantage. He has Advantage on saves against spells cast by creatures within 5 ft.
Toughness. His listed HP include 40 extra points.
Equipment. Belt of Dwarvenkind, Bloodaxe (+2), Dwarven Thrower and Titanstone Knuckles.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks with Bloodaxe, Dwarven Thrower or Titanstone Knuckles. While raging, add a third melee weapon attack.
Bloodaxe. Melee weapon attack +16, reach 5 ft. Hit for 20 (1d12 + 14) slashing plus 3 (1d6) necrotic. If he drops the target to 0 HP, he gains 10 temporary HP.
Dwarven Thrower. Melee or ranged weapon attack +17, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit for 24 (2d8 + 15) bludgeoning.
Titanstone Knuckles. Melee weapon attack +14, reach 5 ft. Hit for 14 (1d4 + 12) bludgeoning.
Enlarge (once per long rest). Cast Enlarge/Reduce on himself to grow for 10 minutes. He resists cold, fire, lightning and thunder while enlarged this way.
sections.Bonus actions: Rage (once per short or long rest). Until he ends it without an action or falls Unconscious, he has Advantage on Strength checks and saves, resists bludgeoning, piercing and slashing, and cannot become Charmed or Frightened. He gains the extra melee attack in Multiattack and +4 damage on melee weapon hits. The listed attacks already include that bonus. He gains one level of Exhaustion when the Rage ends.
sections.Reactions: Opportunist. If a creature within 5 ft. casts a spell or damages him, make a melee weapon attack against it.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 261.
description: Vox Machina’s half-giant brawler, armed with the Bloodaxe and Titanstone Knuckles.

name: Keyleth, Voice of the Tempest
otherStatistics: +2 leather armor and +2 Ring of Protection. Strength saves +4, Dexterity +4, Constitution +5, Intelligence +10, Wisdom +14, Charisma +4. Athletics +8, Insight +12, Intimidation +8, Nature +12, Perception +12, Persuasion +8, Stealth +8, Survival +12. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 22. Auran, Common, Druidic, Elvish.

sections.Traits:
Fey Ancestry. She has Advantage on saves against Charmed and cannot be put to sleep by magic.
Focused. She has Advantage on Constitution saves to keep Concentration.
Equipment. Circlet of wisdom (+2 Wisdom, included), her protective gear and the Spire of Conflux.
sections.Spellcasting:
Level 20 caster. Wisdom, save DC 22, +14 to spell attacks.
Cantrips · Druidcraft, Guidance, Mending.
1st (4 slots) · Cure Wounds, Faerie Fire, Fog Cloud, Healing Word, Thunderwave.
2nd (3 slots) · Alter Self (at will), Flaming Sphere, Gust of Wind, Pass without Trace.
3rd (3 slots) · Call Lightning, Wind Wall.
4th (3 slots) · Blight, Control Water, Grasping Vine, Polymorph, Stone Shape.
5th (3 slots) · Conjure Elemental, Greater Restoration, Scrying, Wall of Stone.
6th (2 slots) · Heroes’ Feast, Move Earth, Transport via Plants.
7th (2 slots) · Fire Storm, Plane Shift.
8th (1 slot) · Control Weather.
9th (1 slot) · Foresight, Shapechange.
sections.Actions:
Shapechange. Cast Shapechange to become a Planetar, an Adult Bronze Dragon or another creature up to CR 20, excluding Constructs and Undead.
Meteor (Earth Elemental form only). If she falls at least 20 ft., creatures within 20 ft. of her landing point make a DC 19 Dexterity save. A failure deals 1d6 bludgeoning per 10 ft. fallen. Keyleth still takes falling damage.
Chain Lightning. With the Spire of Conflux, cast Chain Lightning (DC 22) at a creature she can see within 150 ft.
sections.Bonus actions:
Wild Shape. Become a Beast or Elemental up to CR 6. Use its statistics and its HP and Hit Dice, keeping her alignment, personality, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and any skill or save proficiencies she already had. Add the form’s proficiencies. Her gear merges or stays worn as she chooses. Revert as a bonus action or when Unconscious and return to her pre-transformation HP. She can cast spells in the form and its attacks count as magical.
Healing Word (4th level). She or a creature she can see within 60 ft. regains 16 (4d4 + 6) HP.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 263.
description: The Ashari archdruid who leads from Zephrah as the Voice of the Tempest.

name: Percival de Rolo
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Strength saves +7, Constitution +8. Acrobatics +12, History +11, Perception +9, Persuasion +8. Resists lightning. Passive Perception 19. Celestial, Common, Elvish.

sections.Traits:
Action Surge (2 per short rest). Once during his turn he can take an additional action.
Cabal’s Ruin. He has Advantage on saves against spells and other magic. When his weapon attack hits he can spend any of the cloak’s ten charges to add 1d6 lightning per charge spent.
Indomitable (3 per long rest). Reroll a failed save.
Misfire. A natural 1 or 2 with Animus or Bad News misses and jams the weapon until he spends an action on repairs. An Animus misfire also deals Percy 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
No Mercy. His weapon attacks critically hit on a natural 19 or 20.
Quick Draw. Add his proficiency bonus to initiative, for +12 total.
Ranged Master. His ranged weapon rolls already include a +2 bonus. He ignores Half Cover, Three-Quarters Cover and long range penalties. He can trade −5 to a ranged attack roll for +10 damage on a hit.
Toughness. His listed HP include 40 extra points.
Equipment. Ring of Lightning Resistance, Cabal’s Ruin, Animus (+1) and Bad News (+1).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Fire Animus four times or Bad News twice. Each hit can apply Deadeye or Disarm.
Deadeye. His next attack that turn against the target has Advantage.
Disarm. On a failed DC 20 Strength save, the target drops a held item he chooses.
Animus. Ranged weapon attack +15, range 320 ft. Hit for 11 (1d10 + 6) piercing plus 3 (1d6) psychic.
Bad News. Ranged weapon attack +15, range 800 ft. Hit for 19 (2d12 + 6) piercing.
sections.Reactions: Absorb Magic (once per short or long rest). When an enemy targets him with a spell, the cloak gains charges equal to the spell’s level. The spell still affects him. Through the end of his next turn he resists one type of damage that spell deals.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 266.
description: Whitestone’s inventor and marksman, carrying the firearms Animus and Bad News.

name: Pike Trickfoot
otherStatistics: Plate of the Dawnmartyr and Shield. Wisdom saves +11, Charisma +8. Athletics +10, Perception +11, Persuasion +8, Religion +8, Stealth +7. Resists fire and nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing attacks. Immune to Frightened. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 21. Common, Dwarvish, Gnomish, Undercommon.

sections.Traits:
Gnome Cunning. She has Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves against magic.
Equipment. Mace of Disruption, Gauntlets of Ogre Power, Boots of Speed and Plate of the Dawnmartyr.
Dawnmartyr’s Grace (once per long rest). When she reaches 0 HP in her armor, she can regain 1 HP and stand. Enemies within 10 ft. take 7 (2d6) fire or radiant damage, her choice.
sections.Spellcasting:
Level 20 caster. Wisdom, save DC 19, +11 to spell attacks.
Cantrips · Light, Sacred Flame (4d8), Spare the Dying, Thaumaturgy.
1st (4 slots) · Command, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Healing Word, Sanctuary, Shield of Faith.
2nd (3 slots) · Aid, Lesser Restoration, Spiritual Weapon.
3rd (3 slots) · Glyph of Warding, Mass Healing Word, Protection from Energy, Revivify, Speak with Dead.
4th (3 slots) · Death Ward, Freedom of Movement, Guardian of Faith.
5th (3 slots) · Flame Strike, Greater Restoration, Hallow, Mass Cure Wounds, Scrying.
6th (2 slots) · Heal, Heroes’ Feast, Planar Ally.
7th (2 slots) · Resurrection.
8th (1 slot) · Holy Aura.
9th (1 slot) · Mass Heal.
sections.Actions:
Mace of Disruption. Melee weapon attack +10, reach 5 ft. Hit for 17 (3d8 + 4) bludgeoning, plus 7 (2d6) radiant against a Fiend or Undead. If that creature is left with 25 HP or fewer, it makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. Failure destroys it. Success leaves it Frightened of her through the end of her next turn.
Guiding Bolt (5th level). Ranged spell attack +11, range 120 ft. Hit for 28 (8d6) radiant. The next attack on that target before the end of her next turn has Advantage.
sections.Bonus actions:
Battle Priest (5 per long rest). After using the Attack action, make one weapon attack.
Healing Word (4th level). She or a creature she can see within 60 ft. regains 16 (4d4 + 6) HP.
sections.Reactions:
Dawnmartyr’s Rebuke. When hit by a creature’s melee attack from within 5 ft., choose fire or radiant and deal 7 (2d6) damage of that type.
Everlight’s Guidance (3 per short rest). Add +10 to her own attack roll or that of a creature she sees within 30 ft., after rolling and before determining the outcome.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 269.
The printed Healing Word uses +6 despite Pike’s listed Wisdom modifier of +5. The action keeps the printed healing value.
description: The Everlight’s armored cleric and a member of Vox Machina.

name: Scanlan Shorthalt
otherStatistics: +2 studded leather and +2 Ring of Protection. Strength saves +3, Dexterity +7, Constitution +5, Intelligence +5, Wisdom +0, Charisma +13. Acrobatics +5, Arcana +8, Athletics +6, Deception +16, Intimidation +11, Investigation +13, Performance +16, Persuasion +16. Resists acid. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 8. Common, Gnomish, Marquesian.

sections.Traits:
Gnome Cunning. He has Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves against magic.
Focused. He has Advantage on Constitution saves to keep Concentration.
Toughness. His listed HP include 40 extra points.
Equipment. Mythcarver, +2 acid-resistant studded leather, +2 Ring of Protection, Hat of Disguise and Wand of Magic Missiles.
sections.Spellcasting:
Level 20 caster. Charisma, save DC 19, +11 to spell attacks.
Cantrips · Mage Hand, Message, Minor Illusion, Vicious Mockery.
1st (4 slots) · Healing Word, Thunderwave.
2nd (3 slots) · Blindness/Deafness, Hold Person, Invisibility, Suggestion.
3rd (3 slots) · Counterspell, Lightning Bolt, Stinking Cloud.
4th (3 slots) · Dimension Door, Polymorph, Resilient Sphere.
5th (3 slots) · Bigby's Hand (Arcane Hand in the book), Dominate Person, Modify Memory, Seeming.
6th (2 slots) · Eyebite.
7th (2 slots) · Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion, Reverse Gravity.
8th (1 slot) · Dominate Monster.
9th (1 slot) · True Polymorph.
sections.Actions: Mythcarver. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 5 ft. Hit for 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing plus 3 (1d6) force.
sections.Bonus actions:
Arcane Fist (8th level). While concentrating on Bigby's Hand, make a melee spell attack +11, reach 5 ft., dealing 45 (10d8) force on a hit.
Bardic Inspiration (6 per short rest). Choose another creature within 60 ft. that can hear him. Within 10 minutes it can add a d12 once to an ability check, attack roll or save. He gains Advantage on Mythcarver attack rolls until his turn ends.
Healing Word (5th level). He or a creature he can see within 60 ft. regains 18 (5d4 + 6) HP.
sections.Reactions: Cutting Words. When a creature he sees within 60 ft. rolls an attack, ability check or damage, expend one Bardic Inspiration use and subtract a d12 from its roll. That creature also has Disadvantage on its next saving throw.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 271.
description: Vox Machina’s gnome bard, armed with Mythcarver and a deep spell list.

name: Doty X
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Dexterity saves +4, Constitution +5. Athletics +7, Perception +8. Immune to poison damage and Charmed, Exhaustion and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 18. Understands Taryon Darrington’s languages.

sections.Traits:
Arcane Surge (4/day). When Doty hits, Taryon Darrington can add 14 (4d6) force damage to the hit if Taryon is not Incapacitated.
Dedicated Servant. Includes 20 extra HP and grants +2 to saves, proficient ability checks and attack rolls.
Limited Vocabulary. The six Common words Doty can say are Tary, Yes, Correct, Absolutely, Soon and Handsome.
Vigilant. Doty cannot be Surprised.
sections.Actions:
Empowered Fist. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft. Hit for 8 (1d8 + 4) force.
Repair (3/day). Doty restores 15 (2d8 + 6) of its own HP.
sections.Reactions: Deflect. When an attacker Doty can see within 5 ft. attacks someone else, Doty can impose Disadvantage on the attack roll. The attacker also takes 6 (1d4 + 4) force damage.
sections.Encounter context: For commands, use the Doty trait and Multitask action in the Taryon Darrington stat block.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 272.
The printed Dexterity and Constitution saves are +4 and +5. Dedicated Servant separately grants a +2 bonus on saves without saying whether the listed saves already include it.
description: Taryon Darrington’s mechanical scribe and protector.

name: Taryon Darrington
speed: 40 ft., fly 50 ft. on Broom of Flying
otherStatistics: +1 breastplate. Constitution saves +7, Intelligence +9. Arcana +9, History +9, Perception +4, Survival +4. Passive Perception 9. Common, Draconic, Gnomish, Sylvan, Undercommon.

sections.Traits:
Alchemical Defense. He resists acid and poison damage and is immune to Poisoned.
Doty. Doty X moves and acts on Taryon’s turn and may take only one action on that turn. As a bonus action Taryon can command Dash, Dodge, Disengage or Attack. He can also issue commands through Multitask.
Focused. He has Advantage on Constitution saves to keep Concentration.
Toughness. His listed HP include 30 extra points.
Equipment. Helm of Brilliance, Robe of Useful Items, Ring of the Ram, Rod of Mercurial Form, Bag of Holding, 1d4 + 4 Beads of Force, Broom of Flying and Chime of Opening.
sections.Spellcasting:
Level 15 caster. Intelligence, save DC 16, +8 to spell attacks.
Cantrips · Mending, Prestidigitation, Ray of Frost (3d8).
1st (4 slots) · Detect Magic, Heroism, Identify, Shield.
2nd (3 slots) · Alter Self, Branding Smite, See Invisibility, Warding Bond.
3rd (3 slots) · Dispel Magic, Fly, Haste, Magic Circle, Revivify.
4th (2 slots) · Banishment, Fabricate, Fire Shield.
sections.Actions:
Multitask. Make two weapon attacks or cast a spell with a casting time of one action. He may also order Doty X to use Empowered Fist or Repair.
Mercurial Longsword. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. Hit for 6 (1d10 + 1) slashing.
Bead of Force. Throw a bead up to 60 ft. Each creature within 10 ft. of its landing point must make a DC 15 Dexterity save or take 12 (5d4) force damage. A transparent sphere encloses that area for 1 minute. A creature entirely in the area that failed its save is trapped inside.
sections.Reactions: Brilliant Intellect. Give +4 to his own ability check or saving throw, or to one made by another creature he sees within 30 ft.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 273.
description: An adventurer and author who fights in tandem with his mechanical scribe, Doty X.

name: Champion of Ravens
otherStatistics: Deathwalker’s Ward. Strength saves +5, Dexterity +15, Constitution +5, Intelligence +13, Wisdom +5, Charisma +6. Acrobatics +19, Intimidation +10, Investigation +10, Perception +16, Persuasion +10, Sleight of Hand +12, Stealth +19. Resists radiant, necrotic and poison damage and nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing attacks. Immune to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened and Unconscious. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 26. Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Druidic, Elvish, Thieves’ Cant.

sections.Traits:
Assassinate. On his first turn he attacks creatures that have yet to act with Advantage. Any hit against a Surprised target is critical.
Aura of Protection. While conscious, he and allies within 10 ft. add +3 to saves. His printed save bonuses already include it.
Eternal Champion. At 0 HP or death his body is destroyed. His spirit returns to the Raven Queen and takes a new body in 1d4 days.
Evasion. On a Dexterity save for half damage he takes no damage on success and half on failure.
Fate-Touched (4/day). Reroll his own attack, check or save, then choose either roll. Or require a creature he sees to reroll an attack targeting him or a save against his spell or feature. It must use the new result.
Shadow Smite (once per turn). On a weapon hit made without Disadvantage, add 49 (14d6) radiant or necrotic damage, his choice.
Unerring Sight. His ranged weapon attacks ignore Half Cover, Three-Quarters Cover and long range penalties.
Equipment. Boots of Haste, Deathwalker’s Ward and Whisper.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma, save DC 18, +10 to spell attacks. No material components required.
At will · Bane, Bless, Druidcraft.
1/day · Greater Invisibility.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Attack three times with Whisper.
Whisper. Melee or ranged weapon attack +15, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit for 10 (1d4 + 8) piercing plus 4 (1d8) psychic. A critical hit Frightens the target of him for 1 minute unless it passes a DC 18 Wisdom save. When he throws Whisper, he can teleport with it to within 5 ft. of the target on a hit or to a random space within 30 ft. of it on a miss.
Touch of Life and Death (once per short or long rest). Touch a creature within 5 ft. and choose to restore 55 (10d10) HP or deal 55 (10d10) necrotic damage. An unwilling target avoids the effect on a successful DC 20 Dexterity save.
sections.Bonus actions:
Cunning Action. Dash, Disengage or Hide.
Boots of Haste (1/day). Cast Haste on himself without the period of lethargy when it ends.
sections.Reactions: Uncanny Dodge. Halve the damage of a hit by an attacker he can see.

ruleNotes: Tal’Dorei Campaign Setting Reborn, p. 275.
description: An emissary of the Matron of Ravens who carries Whisper and holds the spirit of Vax’ildan.

name: Bodak
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +4, Stealth +6. Resists cold, fire, necrotic and nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing attacks. Immune to lightning and poison damage, and to Charmed, Frightened and Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 14. Abyssal and languages it spoke in life.

sections.Traits:
Death Gaze. At the start of the turn of a creature within 30 ft. that can see its eyes, the bodak can force a DC 13 Constitution save if it can see the creature and is not Incapacitated. On a failed save the creature takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage. If it fails by 5 or more and is not immune to Frightened, it drops to 0 HP instead. A creature that is not Surprised can avoid the save by averting its eyes, taking Disadvantage to attack the bodak until its next turn starts. Looking at it sooner triggers the save immediately.
Sunlight Hypersensitivity. It takes 5 radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. In sunlight it has Disadvantage on attacks and ability checks.
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, drink or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Fist. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.
Withering Gaze. One creature it sees within 60 ft. makes a DC 13 Constitution save. Failure deals 22 (4d10) necrotic damage. Success halves the damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Aura of Annihilation. Turn the aura on or off. While active it deals 5 necrotic damage to creatures that end their turns within 30 ft., except Fiends and Undead.
sections.Appearance: A gaunt undead humanoid with sunken eyes and a long, hollow mouth.

ruleNotes: Rules source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 127.

name: Deep Scion
speed: Humanoid 30 ft. · Hybrid 20 ft., swim 40 ft.
otherStatistics: Wisdom saves +3, Charisma +4. Deception +6, Insight +3, Sleight of Hand +3, Stealth +3. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 11. Aquan, Common, Thieves’ Cant.

sections.Traits: Amphibious (hybrid only). It can breathe air and water.
sections.Actions:
Shapechanger. Switch between its humanoid and hybrid forms. Only its speeds change. Worn and carried gear keeps its shape. Death returns it to its humanoid form.
Multiattack. In humanoid form make two melee attacks. In hybrid form make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Battleaxe (humanoid only). Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing, or 9 (1d10 + 4) if wielded in two hands.
Bite (hybrid only). Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit for 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing.
Claw (hybrid only). Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing.
Psychic Screech (hybrid only, once per short or long rest). The screech carries 300 ft. Each creature within 30 ft. must pass a DC 13 Wisdom save or be Stunned through the end of the scion’s next turn. If the scion and its master are in the same body of water, it also sends the master its last 24 hours of memories telepathically at any distance.
sections.Appearance: An apparently ordinary humanoid that can take a fishlike form with claws and a biting maw.

ruleNotes: Rules source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 135.

name: Dolphin
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +3. Blindsight 60 ft., passive Perception 13. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Charge. After swimming at least 30 ft. straight at a target, a Slam hit against it on the same turn deals 3 (1d6) extra bludgeoning damage.
Hold Breath. It can go 20 minutes without breathing.
sections.Actions: Slam. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Appearance: A streamlined marine mammal about five to six feet long as an adult.

ruleNotes: Rules source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 208.

name: Kraken Priest
classification: Medium Humanoid (any race), any evil alignment
otherStatistics: Perception +5. Resists bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks. Passive Perception 15. Any two languages.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. It can breathe air and water.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Wisdom, save DC 13 and +5 to spell attacks. No material components.
At will · Command, Create or Destroy Water.
3/day each · Control Water, Darkness, Water Breathing, Water Walk.
1/day each · Call Lightning, Evard's Black Tentacles.
sections.Actions:
Thunderous Touch. Melee spell attack +5, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit for 27 (5d10) thunder damage.
Voice of the Kraken (once per short or long rest). The kraken uses the priest to speak in Abyssal, Infernal or Primordial. The voice carries 300 ft. Creatures the priest chooses that can hear it make a DC 14 Charisma save or become Frightened for 1 minute. Each affected creature can repeat the save at the end of its turns, ending the effect on success.
sections.Appearance: The changes vary by priest. Some have ink-dark eyes and tentacles, such as a suckered tentacle in place of the tongue. Others have eyes and mouths across their body.

ruleNotes: Rules source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 215.

name: Maw Demon
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Resists cold, fire and lightning. Immune to poison damage and to Charmed, Frightened and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 9. Understands Abyssal but does not speak.

sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Rampage. After it drops a creature to 0 HP with a melee attack on its turn, move up to half its speed and make one Bite attack.
sections.Appearance: A squat, clawed demon with several bulging eyes and a jagged mouth splitting most of its body.

ruleNotes: Rules source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 137.

name: Sea Lion
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +4, Stealth +5. Passive Perception 14. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. It can breathe air and water.
Keen Smell. It has Advantage on Perception checks that use smell.
Pack Tactics. It attacks with Advantage if an ally within 5 ft. of the target is not Incapacitated.
Swimming Leap. After swimming at least 10 ft. it can long jump up to 25 ft. out of or across the water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Habitats: Coastal waters and islands at sea.
sections.Appearance: A scaled, catlike face and clawed forelimbs give way to a finned body.

ruleNotes: Rules source: Tales from the Yawning Portal, p. 242.
Also published in Ghosts of Saltmarsh, p. 252. The 2014-era stat block lists piercing damage for Claw.

name: Storm Giant Quintessent
otherStatistics: Strength saves +14, Constitution +10, Wisdom +10, Charisma +9. Arcana +8, History +8. Resists cold and nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing attacks. Immune to lightning and thunder. Truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 20. Common, Giant.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. It can breathe air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Lightning Sword twice or Wind Javelin twice.
Lightning Sword. Melee weapon attack +14, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit for 40 (9d6 + 9) lightning damage.
Wind Javelin. Choose one creature it sees within 600 ft. A magical javelin of wind hits without an attack roll for 19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage and then vanishes.
sections.Legendary actions:
It has three legendary actions each round and regains them when its turn starts. Use one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn.
Gust (1 action). A creature it sees within 60 ft. must make a DC 18 Strength save or be pushed up to 20 ft. horizontally in a direction the giant chooses.
Thunderbolt (2 actions). A creature it sees within 600 ft. makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. Failure deals 22 (4d10) thunder damage and success halves it.
One with the Storm (3 actions). Disperse into the storm within its lair. Only lair actions remain available, and attacks, spells and other effects cannot target it. It can re-form anywhere within the lair at the start of its turn. It cannot disperse outside its lair or while Control Weather or comparable magic is calming the storm.
sections.Lair actions:
At initiative count 20, after ties, choose one action. The giant can do this in either form and cannot repeat the same effect in consecutive rounds.
Thunderclap. Choose a point in the lair. Creatures within 20 ft. must pass a DC 18 Constitution save or be Deafened through the end of their next turn.
Fog or murk. Make a 20 ft. radius sphere of fog, or murky water underwater, at a point within the lair. It spreads around corners and heavily obscures the area until the giant dismisses it without an action. Wind cannot disperse it.
Gust or current. Make a 60 ft. by 10 ft. line of wind or underwater current in the lair. On a failed DC 18 Strength save, creatures in the line move 15 ft. in its direction. It disperses gas, extinguishes exposed flames and has a 50 percent chance of extinguishing protected flames.
sections.Regional effects:
Within 1 mile, strong wind prevents fire from being lit unless sheltered and persistent precipitation or dust can flood waterways or create drifts. Lightning and thunder persist within 5 miles.
Wind, lightning and thunder stop at once if the giant dies. Precipitation and dust subside over 1d8 days.
sections.Habitats: Mountains, coasts, underwater, deserts and arctic regions. Its lair surrounds a persistent storm.
sections.Appearance: A giant that can spread its body into a living storm and coalesce again inside its lair.

ruleNotes: Rules source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 151.

name: Swarm of Rot Grubs
classification: Medium Swarm of Tiny Beasts, unaligned
otherStatistics: Resists piercing and slashing. Immune to Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone and Restrained. Blindsight 10 ft., passive Perception 6. No languages.

sections.Traits: Swarm. It can share a space with creatures and fit through an opening that admits a Tiny maggot. It cannot regain HP or gain temporary HP.
sections.Actions: Bites. Melee weapon attack +0, reach 0 ft., one creature sharing its space. On a hit, 1d4 grubs infest the creature. At the start of each of its turns it takes 1d6 piercing per grub. Before the end of the creature’s next turn, fire applied to the wound inflicts 1 fire damage and kills those grubs. After that they have burrowed too far for fire. Disease-curing effects kill all infesting grubs. An infested creature that ends its turn at 0 HP dies.
sections.Encounter context: Single rot grub. On contact, a DC 10 Dexterity save avoids infestation. On a failure, use the swarm’s infestation rules for one grub, including 3 (1d6) piercing damage at the start of each host turn. Burning an infested corpse kills the grubs inside.
sections.Habitats: Underdark and swamps, especially corpses and decaying material.
sections.Appearance: A mass of finger-sized maggots that burrow into flesh.

ruleNotes: Rules source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 208.

name: Amphisbaena (Monstrosity)
otherStatistics: Perception +2. Blindsight 10 ft., passive Perception 12. No languages.

sections.Traits: Two Heads. It rolls Wisdom (Perception) checks with Advantage, as well as saves against Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned and being knocked Unconscious.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing. The target makes a DC 11 Constitution save, taking 3 (1d6) poison damage on failure or half on success.
sections.Habitats: Coastal wetlands around Dunwater, where the adventure places it.
sections.Appearance: A snake-shaped creature with a venomous head at each end. It can grasp its other neck to roll like a hoop.

ruleNotes: Rules source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh, p. 230.
Amphisbaena and Amphisbaena (Monstrosity) are two catalog labels for the same Saltmarsh printing.

name: Assassin Vine
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Resists cold and fire. Immune to Blinded, Deafened, Exhaustion and Prone. Blindsight 30 ft., passive Perception 10. No languages.

sections.Traits: False Appearance. An unmoving assassin vine cannot be distinguished from an ordinary plant.
sections.Actions:
Constrict. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 20 ft., one creature. Hit for 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning. The target is Grappled (escape DC 14) and Restrained while the grapple lasts. It takes 21 (6d6) poison at the start of each of its turns during the grapple. The vine can constrict only one creature at a time.
Entangling Vines. Animate existing roots and vines in a 15 ft. square on the ground within 30 ft. The area becomes Difficult Terrain. Creatures there when it begins make DC 13 Strength saves or become Restrained. A trapped creature can spend an action and succeed on a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check to free itself. The effect ends after 1 minute or earlier if the vine dies or uses this action again.
sections.Habitats: Chult's jungle. A subterranean form grows near hot springs or volcanic vents.
sections.Appearance: A thick, creeping vine with many shorter branches. Late in summer it bears bunches of bitter, grape-like fruit.

ruleNotes: Rules source: Tomb of Annihilation, p. 213.

name: Bard
otherStatistics: Chain Shirt. Dexterity saves +4, Wisdom +3. Acrobatics +4, Perception +5, Performance +6. Passive Perception 15. Any two languages.

sections.Traits: Song of Rest. The bard can sing through a short rest. A listener who is an ally and spends at least one Hit Die to heal at the end of the rest regains 1d6 additional HP. The bard can benefit too.
sections.Spellcasting:
Charisma, 4th-level caster, save DC 12 and +4 to spell attacks.
Cantrips · Friends, Mage Hand, Vicious Mockery.
1st (4 slots) · Charm Person, Healing Word, Heroism, Sleep, Thunderwave.
2nd (3 slots) · Invisibility, Shatter.
sections.Actions:
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack +4, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit for 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing.
sections.Bonus actions: Taunt (2/day). One creature within 30 ft. that can hear the bard makes a DC 12 Charisma save. Failure gives it Disadvantage on ability checks, attacks and saves until the start of the bard’s next turn.
sections.Habitats: Settlements, especially taverns. Bards also travel with adventurers or serve patrons.
sections.Appearance: A traveling performer in a chain shirt who carries a shortsword and a shortbow.

ruleNotes: Rules source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 211.

name: Demilich
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Constitution saves +6, Intelligence +11, Wisdom +9, Charisma +11. Resists bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from magic weapons. Immune to necrotic, poison and psychic, and to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks. Immune to Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone and Stunned. Truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 13. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Avoidance. If an effect would deal half damage on a successful save, it instead takes no damage on success and half on failure.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). It can turn a failed save into a success.
Turn Immunity. It is immune to effects that turn Undead.
Undead Nature. It does not need to breathe, eat, drink or sleep.
Enduring Existence. Unless its phylactery is destroyed, its skull reforms in 1d10 days. Feeding a soul to the phylactery can restore its lich form.
sections.Actions:
Howl (Recharge 5–6). Each creature within 30 ft. that hears it makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On failure it drops to 0 HP. On success it is Frightened until the end of its next turn.
Life Drain. Choose up to three creatures within 10 ft. that it can see. Each makes a DC 19 Constitution save or takes 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. The demilich regains HP equal to all damage dealt.
sections.Legendary actions:
It has three actions each round and regains them at the start of its turn. Use one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Flight (1 action). Fly up to half its fly speed.
Cloud of Dust (1 action). Each creature within 10 ft., including around corners, makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On failure it is Blinded until the end of the demilich’s next turn. On success it is immune to this effect through the same time.
Energy Drain (2 actions). Every creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Constitution save. Failure reduces its maximum HP by 10 (3d6), killing it if the maximum reaches zero. Greater Restoration or comparable magic restores the lost maximum.
Vile Curse (3 actions). Choose a creature it sees within 30 ft. It makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or suffers Disadvantage on attacks and saves. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the curse on a success.
sections.Lair actions:
In its lair it is CR 20 (24,500 XP). At initiative count 20, after ties, roll a d20. On an 11 or higher, choose one effect, skipping the effect used in the previous round.
Tremor. Creatures standing on the floor make DC 19 Dexterity saves or fall Prone.
Antimagic Field. Center it on a creature the demilich sees within 60 ft. It follows that creature until initiative count 20 next round.
No healing. Choose any number of creatures it sees within 30 ft. They cannot regain HP until initiative count 20 next round.
sections.Lair traits:
These effects may apply in any combination. A non-evil creature takes 16 (3d10) necrotic the first time it enters the tomb. Monsters there have Advantage on saves against Charmed, Frightened and turning effects.
Unauthorized creatures cannot use teleportation or planar travel to enter or leave, but may use that magic within the tomb. The effects fade over 10 days if the demilich is destroyed.
sections.Appearance: A lich’s disembodied skull that rises from the dust when disturbed.

ruleNotes: Rules source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 48–49 and official errata.
The stat block uses the errata’s 80 HP (32d4). The surrounding lore still describes maximum hit points per die, a mismatch with the corrected block.
appearance: A floating skull with gleaming gems set into bare bone.
reusedIn: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden
Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage

name: Fathomer
speed: 30 ft. · Serpent form adds swim 40 ft.
otherStatistics: AC 13 with Mage Armor. Arcana +2, Perception +4, Stealth +4. Passive Perception 14. Aquan, Common.

sections.Traits:
Olhydra’s Armor (human form only). Cast Mage Armor at will, without material components.
Serpent form. Breathe underwater and gain a swim speed of 40 ft. Resist fire and nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing. Immune to poison damage and Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Restrained, Prone and Unconscious. It can stop in hostile creatures’ spaces and move through any opening water can cross without squeezing.
sections.Spellcasting:
Human form only. Charisma, 5th-level caster, save DC 12 and +4 to spell attacks. Both 3rd-level slots return after a short or long rest.
Cantrips · Chill Touch, Eldritch Blast, Mage Hand.
1st–3rd (two 3rd-level slots) · Armor of Agathys, Expeditious Retreat, Hex, Invisibility, Vampiric Touch.
sections.Actions:
Shapechanger (2/day). Become a Medium serpent made of water or return to human form. Gear merges and is inaccessible in the serpent form. It reverts after four hours unless another use sustains it, and reverts if knocked Unconscious or killed.
Constrict (serpent only). Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning. A Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 12) and Restrained until freed. It cannot constrict a second target during that time.
Dagger (human only). Melee or ranged weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit for 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing.
sections.Habitats: Water cult strongholds such as Rivergard Keep.
sections.Appearance: A human cultist who can turn into a serpent made of water and slip through bars or under a door.

ruleNotes: Rules source: Princes of the Apocalypse, p. 207.

name: Iron Cobra
otherStatistics: Stealth +7. Immune to poison damage and bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not adamantine. Immune to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Understands one of its creator’s languages but does not speak.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. It saves against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing. A creature hit makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On failure, roll 1d3 for the poison effect.
1 · Poison Damage. Deal 13 (3d8) poison damage.
2 · Confusion. On its next turn the target spends its action on a weapon attack against a random creature it sees within 30 ft., using its held weapon or an Unarmed Strike. Move first if needed for range. If no creature is visible within 30 ft., the target Dashes toward the nearest creature.
3 · Paralysis. The target is Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.
sections.Appearance: A metal serpent shaped like a hooded cobra.

ruleNotes: Rules source: Mordenkainen’s Tome of Foes, p. 125.

name: Kuo-toa Monitor
otherStatistics: Natural armor and Unarmored Defense. Perception +6, Religion +5. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 16. Undercommon.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. It can breathe air and water.
Otherworldly Perception. It senses Invisible creatures and creatures on the Ethereal Plane within 30 ft. It can pinpoint them while they move.
Slippery. It has Advantage on checks and saves to escape grapples.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight it has Disadvantage on attacks and sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks.
Unarmored Defense. Its listed AC includes its Wisdom modifier.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Unarmed Strikes.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning plus 3 (1d6) lightning. The target loses its reactions until the end of the monitor’s next turn.
sections.Appearance: A bulging-eyed, fishlike humanoid trained to fight with its bare hands.

ruleNotes: Rules source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 198.

name: Refrum
otherStatistics: Unarmored. Medicine +7, Persuasion +3, Religion +5. Passive Perception 13. Any two languages.

sections.Spellcasting:
Wisdom, 5th-level caster, save DC 13 and +5 to spell attacks.
Cantrips · Light, Sacred Flame, Thaumaturgy.
1st (4 slots) · Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Sanctuary.
2nd (3 slots) · Lesser Restoration, Spiritual Weapon.
3rd (2 slots) · Dispel Magic, Speak with Dead.
sections.Actions: Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack +2, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 1 bludgeoning.
sections.Bonus actions: Divine Eminence. Spend a spell slot. Until the turn ends, each melee weapon hit deals an extra 10 (3d6) radiant damage. Add 1d6 for each slot level beyond first.
sections.Habitats: The Alchemists’ Quarter in the Styes, a waterfront district.
sections.Appearance: A slight, stooped inventor-priest in plain gray clothes who gestures animatedly.

ruleNotes: Rules source: Ghosts of Saltmarsh, p. 169, The Styes.
Both Saltmarsh names refer to the same NPC. The adventure replaces the generic Priest’s armor, weapon and Spirit Guardians. Unarmed Strike uses the core 2014 rule.

name: Sea Hag (Coven Variant)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Aquan, Common, Giant.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. She can breathe air and water.
Horrific Appearance. A humanoid starting its turn within 30 ft. that sees her true form makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. Failure leaves it Frightened for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each turn, with Disadvantage if the hag is in sight. Success or the effect ending grants 24 hours of immunity to this feature. If the humanoid is not Surprised and the reveal is not sudden, it may avert its eyes to skip the initial save. Its attacks against the hag have Disadvantage until its next turn.
sections.Coven Spellcasting:
When all three hags are within 30 ft. of one another, each can use this spell list as a 12th-level Intelligence caster. The coven shares the slots. This sea hag has save DC 13 and +5 to spell attacks.
1st (4 slots) · Identify, Ray of Sickness.
2nd (3 slots) · Hold Person, Locate Object.
3rd (3 slots) · Bestow Curse, Counterspell, Lightning Bolt.
4th (3 slots) · Phantasmal Killer, Polymorph.
5th (2 slots) · Contact Other Plane, Scrying.
6th (1 slot) · Eyebite.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing.
Death Glare. Target one Frightened creature within 30 ft. that she can see. If it sees her, it must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom save or drop to 0 HP.
Illusory Appearance. She disguises herself and her gear as an ugly humanoid-shaped creature of similar size. The disguise ends when she dies or dismisses it as a bonus action. Touch exposes inconsistencies. Visual scrutiny takes an action and a successful DC 16 Intelligence (Investigation) check.
sections.Coven item:
Hag Eye. Each hag can spend an action to look through the coven’s eye while on the same plane. It has AC 10, 1 HP and Darkvision 60 ft. Destroying it deals 3d10 psychic damage to each member and Blinds them for 24 hours.
Creating an eye takes all three hags one uninterrupted hour. A Blinded hag cannot contribute, and they can keep only one eye at a time.
sections.Habitats: Coasts and underwater, especially polluted lairs.
sections.Appearance: A gaunt sea hag with a hideous true face who can mask herself with an illusory disguise.

ruleNotes: Rules source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 176 and 179.
This is the standard 2014 coven profile. Consult the Saltmarsh encounter for coven members and any encounter-specific spell substitutions.

name: Swarm of Insects (Spiders)
classification: Medium Swarm of Tiny Beasts, unaligned
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Resists bludgeoning, piercing and slashing. Immune to Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained and Stunned. Blindsight 10 ft., passive Perception 8. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Swarm. It can share spaces with creatures and enter any opening that admits a Tiny spider. It cannot regain HP or gain temporary HP.
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces, even while upside down, without an ability check.
Web Sense. While touching a web, it knows where any other creature touching that web is.
Web Walker. Webbing does not hamper its movement.
sections.Actions: Bites. Melee weapon attack +3, reach 0 ft., one target sharing its space. Hit for 10 (4d4) piercing, or 5 (2d4) piercing when the swarm has 11 HP or fewer.
sections.Habitats: The general swarm is found in forests, swamps, hills, grasslands, deserts, settlements and the Underdark.
sections.Appearance: A moving mass of tiny spiders that can spread over walls and ceilings.

ruleNotes: Rules source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 338 and official errata.

name: Piercer
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Stealth +5. Blindsight 30 ft. and Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 8. No languages.

sections.Traits:
False Appearance. A motionless piercer on a ceiling looks like an ordinary stalactite.
Spider Climb. It can cross difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
sections.Actions: Drop. Melee weapon attack +3 against one creature directly below it. A hit deals 3 (1d6) piercing per 10 ft. dropped, to a maximum of 21 (6d6). On a miss, the piercer takes half the falling damage for that drop.

appearance: A pale cave mollusk encased in a pointed shell that resembles a hanging stalactite.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 252.
reusedIn: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden
Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage

name: Pixie
otherStatistics: Perception +4, Stealth +7. Passive Perception 14. Sylvan.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The pixie has Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions: Superior Invisibility. It turns itself and all worn or carried gear Invisible while it maintains Concentration.
sections.Spellcasting:
Innate spellcasting uses Charisma, save DC 12. Pixie dust is its sole component.
At will · Druidcraft.
1/day each · Confusion, Dancing Lights, Detect Evil and Good, Detect Thoughts, Dispel Magic, Entangle, Fly, Phantasmal Force, Polymorph and Sleep.

appearance: A tiny woodland faerie with bright, translucent wings and pointed ears.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 253.

name: Skitterling
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 11. No languages.

sections.Traits: Flyby. It provokes no opportunity attacks for flying out of an enemy's reach.
sections.Actions: Claws. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage. The target must pass a DC 10 Constitution save or be Blinded until the start of its next turn. Immunity to poison damage or Poisoned gives an automatic success.

appearance: A housecat-sized, six-legged rodent with broad bat wings and grasping claws.
ruleNotes: Public playtest rules. The final printing is a separate publication version.

name: Lightbender
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +7, Stealth +8. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 17. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Avoidance. When a successful save would halve damage, instead take none on success and half on failure.
Pounce. Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hit it with Claw that turn. It makes a DC 15 Strength save or falls Prone. The lightbender can make one Bite against that Prone target as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. One Bite and two Claws, or two Tail Whips.
Bite. Melee +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing.
Claw. Melee +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing.
Tail Whip. Melee +7, reach 15 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning and 7 (2d6) radiant.
Hypnotic Mane (1/day). Creatures within 15 ft. save Wisdom DC 14 or are Charmed for 1 minute. A creature Charmed this way is Incapacitated with speed 0. Damage to it, or someone shaking it as an action, ends the effect on it.
sections.Reactions: Afterimage. On a hit, the lightbender can make the attack miss and reappear in an open space it sees within 30 ft. This fails against senses that do not rely on sight or that see through illusions.

appearance: A lionlike predator with an iridescent mane and a pair of tails tipped with refractive crystals.
ruleNotes: Public playtest rules. The final printing is a separate publication version.

name: Overmind
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Int +8, Wis +6, Cha +7. Arcana +8, Deception +7, Insight +6, Intimidation +7, Perception +6. Immune to Charmed, Flanked, Frightened and Prone. Darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 16. Common, Deep Speech and Undercommon.

sections.Traits: Detached Eyes. Six eye objects hover nearby, each with AC 24 and 1 HP. The shield on an eye makes it immune to damage until it uses a power, then drops until the start of the overmind's next turn. Replace a destroyed eye at the end of the overmind's next turn.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee +4, reach 5 ft., 14 (4d6) piercing.
Eye Psionics. Choose three different powers. A single-target beam generally needs a visible target within 120 ft.
Charm Beam. Wisdom DC 16 or Charmed for an hour, ending if the overmind harms the target or an ally.
Compulsion Beam. Intelligence DC 16 or use the available reaction to move up to speed toward the closest visible ally and attack it with a weapon. Immunity to Charmed also stops this effect.
Toxic Vapors. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Creatures within 10 ft. of it make Constitution DC 16 or are Poisoned for 1 minute, save ends at end of turn.
Telekinetic Beam. Strength DC 16 or reposition the target up to 30 ft. and deal 7 (2d6) force. Alternatively move a visible object of up to 300 lb. within 120 ft. by up to 30 ft., provided nobody wears or carries it. It can also operate simple objects with the beam.
Lightning Bolt. A 5-ft.-wide, 60-ft. line deals 21 (6d6) lightning, Dexterity DC 16 halves.
Fire Beam. Dexterity DC 16 or take 36 (8d8) fire and catch fire for 1 minute. Take 9 (2d8) fire at each turn start, save ends at end of turn. Any creature can spend an action to put out the flames.
sections.Bonus Actions: The Great Eye (Recharge 6). End spells affecting the overmind or creatures in its 150-ft. cone.
sections.Reactions: Away with You! When hit by a melee attack from a creature within 5 ft., use Telekinetic Beam against it.
sections.Lair Actions:
Choose one at initiative 20, losing ties. The same action cannot be used two rounds in a row.
Slime. One creature of the overmind's choice within 120 ft. makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. On failure it is vulnerable to fire and lightning until either damage type hits it or initiative 20 of the next round.
Lift. Up to three selected creatures within 60 ft. make DC 15 Strength saves. On failure a creature's speed drops to 0 and it rises 20 ft. until initiative 20 of the next round, when it falls.
Gas. A 20-ft. sphere opens at a point within 60 ft. until initiative 20 of the next round. On first entry or starting a turn inside, a creature must pass a DC 15 Constitution save or be Poisoned until the start of its next turn.

appearance: A floating aberration with six detached eyes circling the huge central eye of its main body.
ruleNotes: Public playtest rules. The final printing is a separate publication version.

name: Xorannox
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Int +9, Wis +7, Cha +9. Arcana +9, Deception +9, Insight +7, Intimidation +9, Perception +7. Immune to Charmed, Flanked, Frightened and Prone. Darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 17. Common, Deep Speech and Undercommon.

sections.Traits: Painful Resistance. On a failed save, Xorannox can sacrifice one of eight floating eyes, randomly selected with a d8, to succeed instead. It regrows at the end of his next turn. The eyes remain shielded.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee +5, reach 5 ft., 14 (4d6) piercing.
Eye Psionics. Choose three different effects. Unless specified, the target must be visible and within 120 ft.
Charm Beam. Wisdom DC 17 or Charmed for 1 hour, ending if he harms the creature or one of its allies.
Compulsion Beam. Intelligence DC 17 or use an available reaction to move up to speed toward the closest visible ally and attack it with a weapon. Immunity to Charmed prevents it.
Memory Beam. Intelligence DC 17 or waste the highest remaining spell slot. If none remain, lose proficiency with one weapon held or carried for 1 minute, save ends at end of turn.
Toxic Vapors. At a visible point within 120 ft., creatures within 10 ft. make Constitution DC 17 or are Poisoned for 1 minute, save ends at end of turn.
Telekinetic Field. At a visible point within 120 ft., each creature of his choice within 10 ft. makes Strength DC 17 or is moved up to 30 ft. and takes 7 (2d6) force. Move an unattended object within the same area up to 30 ft. if it weighs at most 300 lb., or operate a simple object.
Lightning Bolt. A 5-ft.-wide, 60-ft. line deals 36 (8d8) lightning, Dexterity DC 17 halves.
Explosion. Creatures within 10 ft. of a visible point within 120 ft. take 36 (8d8) fire, Dexterity DC 17 halves.
Necrosis Beam. Constitution DC 17 or take 55 (10d10) necrotic and lose 7 (2d6) HP at each turn start. Reducing the target to 0 HP this way kills it. Ends if he dies or loses sight of the target. He cannot use it again while it persists.
sections.Bonus Actions: The Great Eye (Recharge 6). End spells affecting Xorannox or creatures in its 150-ft. cone.
sections.Reactions: Cower! On a hit against Xorannox, the attacker makes Wisdom DC 17 or takes 21 (6d6) psychic and becomes Frightened of him for 1 minute, save ends at end of turn.
sections.Villain Actions:
Each can be used once after an enemy turn, in any order, with at most one per round.
Disruption Beams. Three visible creatures within 120 ft. make Wisdom DC 17. On failure, for 1 minute, making more than one weapon attack on a turn or casting a non-cantrip spell deals 14 (4d6) psychic to that creature. Save ends at end of turn.
Disappearing Act. He is Invisible until the end of his next turn and teleports to an open space he sees within 120 ft.
Megabeam. In a 20-ft.-wide, 120-ft. line, each creature saves against two different random eye effects from the remaining eyes. Area effects only target creatures individually here.

appearance: A Tyract overmind with sweeping facial armor, a massive central eye and eight detached psionic eyes.
ruleNotes: Public playtest rules. The final printing is a separate publication version.

name: Athar Null
classification: Small or Medium Humanoid, any alignment
otherStatistics: Saves Dex +6, Wis +5. Skills Investigation +8, Perception +5, Stealth +6. Languages: Common plus two more languages. Passive Perception 15.

sections.Traits: Avoidance. If a successful save would normally halve damage, the null instead takes none on success and half on failure.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Force Dagger attacks.
Force Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing plus 13 (3d8) force. The dagger returns to the null immediately after it is thrown.
sections.Bonus Actions: Defier's Whim. Dash, Disengage, or Use an Object.
sections.Reactions: Nullify Spell (3/day). When it sees a creature casting, the null can interrupt it. A spell of 3rd level or lower automatically fails. For a spell of 4th level or higher, make an Intelligence check against DC 10 + spell level. The spell fails on a success.

appearance: A hooded Athar infiltrator in close-fitting street gear with concealed weapons.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Morte's Planar Parade, p. 53.

name: Bariaur Wanderer
otherStatistics: Saves Str +6, Dex +4. Skills Athletics +6, Perception +4, Stealth +4, Survival +6. Senses: darkvision 60 ft.. Languages: Celestial, Common. Passive Perception 14.

sections.Traits: Portal Sense. Detect any portal within 30 ft., even if inactive, and know where it leads. The wanderer also knows the distance and direction of the last portal it used while on the same plane as that portal.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Barbed Javelin or Shortbow attacks.
Barbed Javelin. Melee or ranged attack +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing. A creature hit loses 10 ft. of speed until the start of the wanderer's next turn.
Ram. Melee attack +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning. Moving straight toward the target for at least 20 ft. immediately before the hit adds 10 (3d6) bludgeoning and forces a DC 14 Strength save to avoid falling Prone.
Shortbow. Ranged attack +4, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing, plus 4 (1d8) piercing if the target is below maximum HP.
sections.Spellcasting:
Wisdom, no material components.
At will · Dancing Lights and Druidcraft.
1/day each · Goodberry, Pass without Trace, and Tongues.
sections.Bonus Actions: Mighty Leap. The wanderer jumps up to its walking speed.

appearance: A horned celestial with a humanoid upper body and four goat legs.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Morte's Planar Parade, p. 21.

name: Cranium Rat Squeaker
otherStatistics: Senses: darkvision 30 ft.. Languages: telepathy 30 ft. (emotions only). Passive Perception 10.

sections.Traits:
Shared Telepathy. A creature touching the rat may use its telepathy if the rat permits it. A borrower who knows a language can send both words and emotions.
Telepathic Shroud. The rat is immune to divination spells and effects that read its thoughts or sense its emotions.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Illumination. Light the exposed brain for dim light within 5 ft., or extinguish it.

appearance: A small rat with exposed brain tissue visible above its eyes.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Morte's Planar Parade, p. 22.

name: Dabus
otherStatistics: Saves Int +5, Wis +4. Skills Insight +4, Perception +6. Senses: darkvision 60 ft.. Languages: understands all languages but can't speak; communicates via Symbol Speech. Condition immunities: exhaustion. Passive Perception 16.

sections.Traits:
Physical Restraint. The dabus never makes melee attacks or opportunity attacks.
Symbol Speech. The dabus speaks by conjuring symbols and images that vanish after a few seconds. A creature seeing them can make a DC 10 Intelligence (Investigation) check to understand the message without spending an action.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Flying Brick attacks.
Flying Brick. Ranged spell attack +5, range 90 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning.
Grasping Ground (Recharge 6). Choose a visible 20-ft. square of ground within 60 ft. Chosen creatures inside make a DC 13 Dexterity save. On failure, deal 9 (2d8) bludgeoning and Grapple the target (escape DC 13). The target is Restrained while Grappled this way. The effect lasts up to 1 minute with Concentration.

appearance: A gray-skinned, curled-horn humanoid who floats and communicates with visible symbols.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Morte's Planar Parade, p. 23.

name: Lantern Archon
otherStatistics: Skills Perception +3. Senses: darkvision 120 ft.. Languages: all. Resists: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks. Damage immunities: lightning, radiant. Condition immunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, prone, restrained. Passive Perception 13.

sections.Traits:
Aura of Menace. While the archon is not Incapacitated, it chooses which creatures make a DC 11 Wisdom save when they start a turn within 20 ft. Failure Frightens the creature until the start of its next turn. Success grants that creature immunity to any archon's Aura of Menace for 24 hours.
Illumination. Bright light extends 30 ft., then dim light for 30 more.
Incorporeal Movement. It can pass through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain. Ending a turn inside an object deals 5 (1d10) force damage to the archon.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Radiant Strikes, with the option to replace one with Teleport.
Radiant Strike. Melee or ranged weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) radiant.
Teleport. The archon and its gear move to a visible unoccupied space within 120 ft.
sections.Spellcasting:
Charisma, no material components.
At will · Detect Evil and Good.
1/day · Aid.
sections.Bonus Actions: Shift Radiance. Reduce light to dim light within 5 ft. or return it to full intensity.

appearance: A floating orb of radiant light with no humanoid body.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Morte's Planar Parade, p. 17.

name: Razorvine Blight
otherStatistics: Skills Stealth +4. Senses: blindsight 60 ft. (can't see beyond this radius). Languages: understands Common but can't speak. Condition immunities: blinded, deafened. Passive Perception 10.

sections.Traits:
False Appearance. If motionless when combat starts, the blight has Advantage on Initiative. Before it is seen moving or acting, a creature needs a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to recognize it as animate.
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces or hang upside down on ceilings without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 10 ft., one target. Roll with Advantage if the target is below maximum HP. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing.
Life-Draining Vines (Recharge 6). Each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. Damage is 9 (2d8) slashing, halved on success. The blight heals 9 HP if at least one creature that fails is neither Construct nor Undead.

appearance: A creeping plant monster made of thorned vines and leaves with cutting edges.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Morte's Planar Parade, p. 42.

name: Sunfly
otherStatistics: Languages: understands Celestial but can't speak. Passive Perception 10.

sections.Actions:
Sting. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing. On an Outer Plane, the hit also injects a toxin.
Upper Plane. The target sheds bright light within 5 ft. until the end of its next turn.
Neutral Plane. A target maintaining Concentration makes the Constitution save caused by the hit with Disadvantage.
Lower Plane. Reduce the target's speed by 5 ft. until the end of its next turn.
sections.Bonus Actions: Illumination. Emit bright light within 5 ft. and dim light for 5 ft. more, or turn off the light.

appearance: A luminous flying insect with a pointed stinger.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Morte's Planar Parade, p. 47.

name: Swarm of Sunflies
classification: Medium swarm of Tiny Celestials, chaotic good
otherStatistics: Languages: understands Celestial but can't speak. Passive Perception 10.

sections.Traits: Swarm. It can share other creatures' spaces and fit through an opening large enough for a Tiny dragonfly. It cannot regain HP or gain temporary HP.
sections.Actions:
Stings. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 10 (3d4 + 3) piercing, or 5 (1d4 + 3) if the swarm has half its HP or less. On an Outer Plane the hit also injects a toxin.
Upper Plane. The target sheds bright light within 5 ft. until the end of its next turn and gains no benefit from Invisible in that time.
Neutral Plane. The target immediately loses any Concentration.
Lower Plane. Reduce the target's speed by 10 ft. until the end of its next turn.
Dazzling Lights (Recharge 6). Creatures within 15 ft. make a DC 10 Constitution save or are Stunned for 1 minute. Repeat the save at the end of each affected creature's turn to end it.
sections.Bonus Actions: Illumination. Emit bright light within 15 ft. and dim light for 15 ft. more, or turn off the light.

appearance: A cluster of shimmering winged insects with venomous stingers.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Morte's Planar Parade, p. 47.

name: Adult Time Dragon
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Dex +8, Con +12, Wis +9, Cha +11. Skills Arcana +12, History +18, Perception +15, Stealth +14. Senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft.. Languages: all. Passive Perception 25.

sections.Traits: Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed save into a success.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee weapon attack +13, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing plus 7 (2d6) force.
Time Breath (Recharge 5–6). A 60-ft. cone turns nonmagical unattended objects and vegetation to dust. Each creature in range makes a DC 20 Constitution save. On failure it takes 36 (8d8) force damage and is weakened. Attacks against a weakened creature have Advantage, and it is Poisoned. A creature that passes the initial save only takes half damage. A weakened target may repeat the save at each turn end. Its third successful repeat ends the effect.
sections.Reactions:
Up to three reactions each round, at most one each turn.
Reactive Rend. After using Legendary Resistance or being hit by an attack roll, make one Rend attack.
Slow Time. Just after a visible creature's turn ends, choose a visible creature within 60 ft. weakened by Time Breath. Its speed is fixed at 0 while it remains weakened.
Time Slip. Halve damage from an attack by a visible attacker, then optionally teleport with all gear to a visible unoccupied space within 30 ft.
sections.Lair Actions:
Act on initiative 20, losing ties. Choose one lair action, with no repeat on consecutive rounds.
Temporal Fling. One visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. On failure it takes 26 (4d12) psychic damage and disappears for one round, then returns to its space or the nearest available space.
Temporal Lag. Until initiative 20 next round, each creature within 60 ft. can move or take an action on its turn, but not both. It cannot take reactions or bonus actions during that time.
Timeline Divergence. Choose a space in the lair the dragon can fit inside. It exists in both locations until initiative 20 next round. It chooses which self moves or acts each time. An attack or effect covering both spaces affects the dragon once.
sections.Regional Effects:
Within 3 miles, one or both effects can apply.

appearance: A long silver-blue dragon with curling horns traced by branching rainbow veins.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Morte's Planar Parade, p. 50.
In its lair: CR 19 (22,000 XP).

name: Ancient Time Dragon
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Dex +10, Con +16, Wis +12, Cha +14. Skills Arcana +16, History +24, Perception +20, Stealth +18. Senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft.. Languages: all. Passive Perception 30.

sections.Traits:
Cycle of Rebirth. On death, the dragon's soul forms a steely egg that teleports to a random plane. The egg takes no damage and hatches in 1d100 years as a wyrmling retaining the dragon's former memories and knowledge.
Legendary Resistance (5/day). Turn a failed save into a success.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee weapon attack +17, reach 15 ft. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) slashing plus 10 (3d6) force.
Time Breath (Recharge 5–6). A 90-ft. cone turns nonmagical unattended objects and vegetation to dust. Each creature in range makes a DC 24 Constitution save. On failure it takes 52 (8d12) force damage and is weakened. Attacks against a weakened creature have Advantage, and it is Poisoned. Other creatures also resist all damage it deals. A creature that passes the initial save only takes half damage. A weakened target may repeat the save at each turn end. Its third successful repeat ends the effect.
Time Gate (1/day). Open a 20-ft.-diameter portal between the dragon's horns or at a visible unoccupied point within 30 ft. Choose an exact place on any plane, up to 8,000 years before or after the present. Each opening has a front and back. Enter either opening from the front to arrive at the nearest clear space on the other end. The gate lasts up to 24 hours with Concentration. A deity or planar ruler can block it in that being's presence or domain.
sections.Reactions:
Up to three reactions each round, at most one each turn.
Reactive Rend. After using Legendary Resistance or being hit by an attack roll, make one Rend attack.
Slow Time. Just after a visible creature's turn ends, choose a visible creature within 90 ft. weakened by Time Breath. Its speed is fixed at 0 while it remains weakened.
Time Slip. Halve damage from an attack by a visible attacker, then optionally teleport with all gear to a visible unoccupied space within 60 ft.
sections.Lair Actions:
Act on initiative 20, losing ties. Choose one lair action, with no repeat on consecutive rounds.
Temporal Fling. One visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. On failure it takes 26 (4d12) psychic damage and disappears for one round, then returns to its space or the nearest available space.
Temporal Lag. Until initiative 20 next round, each creature within 60 ft. can move or take an action on its turn, but not both. It cannot take reactions or bonus actions during that time.
Timeline Divergence. Choose a space in the lair the dragon can fit inside. It exists in both locations until initiative 20 next round. It chooses which self moves or acts each time. An attack or effect covering both spaces affects the dragon once.
sections.Regional Effects:

name: Eyestalk of Gzemnid
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Con +11, Wis +4. Senses: blindsight 30 ft., tremorsense 60 ft.. No languages. Passive Perception 9.

sections.Traits: Tunneler. Burrowing through solid rock costs twice as much movement, and leaves a tunnel 10 ft. wide.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Bite once and use Eradication Gaze when available.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +14, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing. A Large or smaller creature must pass a DC 19 Dexterity save or be swallowed. Inside, it is Blinded and Restrained and has Total Cover against attacks and effects from outside. At the start of each eyestalk turn it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage. When one creature inside deals at least 30 damage on a turn, the eyestalk must pass a DC 21 Constitution save at that turn's end or vomit all swallowed creatures out Prone within 10 ft. If the eyestalk dies, swallowed creatures are no longer Restrained by it and can spend 20 ft. of movement to exit Prone.
Eradication Gaze (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 150-ft. cone makes a DC 16 Dexterity save. Failure deals 55 (10d10) necrotic damage. A creature reduced to 0 HP by that damage turns into fine violet dust.

Eye of Fear. The target and up to four chosen creatures within 10 ft. of it make DC 16 Wisdom saves. On failure, the creature is Frightened for 1 minute. A repeat save at the end of each affected turn can end it.
Eye of Flame. DC 16 Dexterity save. Failure deals 44 (8d10) fire and ignites a creature or flammable object. Success halves damage and prevents ignition. A burning target takes 5 (1d10) fire at each of its turn starts until a creature uses an action to put it out.

sections.Traits: Iron Scent. Locates ferrous metal within 30 ft. by smell.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack +3, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing. It attaches to a target's metal armor or shield if present. It cannot attack while attached. At each of its turn starts, roll a d20. On 10+, the item permanently loses 1 AC. Destroy armor reduced to AC 10 or a shield reduced to +0. The khargra can detach for 5 ft. of movement, or a creature can detach it with an action.
Earth Phasing. Until the end of its next turn, it flies through nonmagical earth or stone without disturbing it. It can stop inside. If still inside when the effect ends, it takes 14 (4d6) force and moves to the nearest open space.
sections.Reactions: Opportunistic Hunger. When a visible creature within 5 ft. hits it with a metal weapon, make one Bite attack against that creature.

sections.Actions:

name: Drow Shadowblade (Summoner Variant)
otherStatistics: Studded leather armor. Saves Dex +9, Con +7, Wis +6. Skills Perception +6, Stealth +9. Senses: darkvision 120 ft.. Languages: Elvish, Undercommon. Passive Perception 16.

sections.Traits:
Fey Ancestry. Advantage on saves against being Charmed, and magic cannot put the drow to sleep.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the drow has Disadvantage on attack rolls and sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Shadow Sword attacks. After a hit within 10 ft. of a darkness cube created by the sword on an earlier turn, the drow can dismiss that cube to deal 21 (6d6) extra necrotic damage to the target. This extra damage can occur once per turn.
Shadow Sword. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing, 10 (3d6) necrotic, and 10 (3d6) poison. The drow can then fill an empty 5-ft. cube within 5 ft. of the target with magical Darkness for 1 minute.
Hand Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack +9, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing, plus a DC 13 Constitution save to avoid being Poisoned for 1 hour. Failure by 5 or more also makes the target Unconscious while Poisoned this way. Damage or another creature using an action to shake it ends the Unconscious condition.
Summon Shadow Demon (1/day). There is a 50% chance to summon one Shadow Demon in an open space within 60 ft. Failure deals 5 (1d10) psychic damage to the shadowblade. The demon is an ally and cannot summon other demons. It remains for 10 minutes or until it or the shadowblade dies or the shadowblade dismisses it as an action.
sections.Bonus Actions: Shadow Step. In dim light or Darkness, teleport up to 60 ft. to a visible empty space also in dim light or Darkness. Gain Advantage on the first melee attack made before the turn ends.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma, save DC 13, no material components.
At will · Dancing Lights.
1/day each · Darkness, Faerie Fire, Levitate (self only).
