The creature has disadvantage on attacks until it stops wielding the shield or spends an action to pull the pilum free. The veles carries six pila.
sections.Bonus Actions: Pivot. Move up to half the veles’s speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Kobold Venator
otherStatistics: Shield. Athletics +4, Perception +3, Stealth +3, Survival +3. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 13. Common and Draconic.

sections.Traits:
Not What I Seem. The venator starts combat posing as a novice warrior. Its first weapon attack against a creature that has yet to see it attack has advantage.
Shield? Shield! While wielding a shield, the kobold gains +1 AC if within 5 ft. of a shield-wielding ally with the same trait who is neither Incapacitated nor Prone.
sections.Actions:
Dolabra. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing.
Net. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 5/15-ft. range, one Large or smaller creature. A hit leaves it Restrained until freed. A creature can spend an action to attempt a DC 10 Strength check to free itself or another creature within reach. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) destroys it and releases the target unharmed. The venator carries one net.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Lost in the Crowd. Take the Hide action. The Stealth check has advantage if at least two allied kobolds are within 5 ft.
Then We Light the Net on Fire! Ignite the net restraining a creature within 5 ft. While restrained by the burning net, the creature takes 3 (1d6) fire at the start of each turn. After each instance of damage, roll a die. An odd result destroys the net and frees the creature. An attempt to free the creature with the Strength check puts out the fire whether the check succeeds or fails.

name: Lizardfolk Grunt
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Passive Perception 11. Common and Draconic.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The grunt breathes air and water.
sections.Actions:
Bite (group attack). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Deal 1 piercing damage per participant on a hit. Each participating grunt grapples the target (escape DC 10 + the number of grunts holding it). One successful escape frees the target from all of them. Until then the target is Restrained, and participating grunts cannot Bite another target.
Javelin (group attack). Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 30/120-ft. range, one target. Deal 1 piercing damage per participant on a hit.

name: Ogre Goon
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 10. Common and Giant.

sections.Actions: Fist (group attack). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Deal 2 bludgeoning damage per participant on a hit. If at least two goons took part, the target makes a Strength save (DC 10 + the number that joined). On a failure it falls Prone and can be moved up to 10 ft. horizontally.

name: Minotaur (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Athletics +6, Perception +3, Survival +3. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 13. Common.

sections.Traits:
Dizzying Gore. If the minotaur moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a Large or smaller creature and hits it with Goring Horns that turn, the creature must pass a DC 14 Constitution save or be Dazed until the start of the minotaur’s next turn.
Minotaur Senses. The minotaur always knows where north is and cannot get lost.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Maul attack and one Goring Horns attack.
Maul. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning. The minotaur can push a Large or smaller target 5 ft. away.
Goring Horns. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing.
sections.Reactions: Retaliatory Gore. When the minotaur takes damage from a creature it can see within 40 ft., it can move up to its speed. If it finishes within 5 ft. of the creature, it can attack that creature with Goring Horns.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): A Dazed creature chooses one option on its turn: movement, an action, or a bonus action. Becoming Dazed on its own turn ends that turn. Extra actions from features such as Haste or Action Surge are still available. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can remove the condition.

name: Minotaur Lackey
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 11. Common.

sections.Traits: Goring Run. If the lackey moves at least 20 ft. straight toward an enemy and finishes within 5 ft. of it, the enemy takes 1 piercing damage.
sections.Actions: Goring Horns (group attack). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Deal 3 piercing damage per participant on a hit. If at least two lackeys took part, the target makes a Strength save (DC 10 + the number that joined). On a failure, move the target 5 ft. horizontally per participant.

name: Otyugh (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Constitution save +7. Resists acid and poison damage. Immune to Poisoned and, while it has an eyestalk, Flanked. Darkvision 60 ft. in its usual form. Passive Perception 11. Otyugh.

sections.Traits:
Adjustable Appendages. The otyugh starts with seven appendages: one eyestalk, three legs, and three tentacles. Each eyestalk adds 60 ft. to its Darkvision. With at least one it is immune to Flanked. With zero it is Blinded and can be Flanked. Each leg adds 15 ft. to walking speed. Each tentacle provides one attack in Multiattack and one slot for a grapple from Tentacle Slam.
Limited Telepathy. The otyugh can send simple images or messages to a creature within 120 ft. that understands a language. This communication is one-way.
Rot Leech. At the start of its turn, each creature the otyugh has Grappled loses 5 (1d10) from its HP maximum for 1 hour, to a minimum of its current HP. The otyugh heals the amount actually lost.
Trash Traversal. Ignore difficult terrain. The otyugh has advantage on Stealth checks to hide in refuse.
Vile Stench. A creature starting its turn within 10 ft. must pass a DC 15 Constitution save or be Poisoned until its next turn starts.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Tentacle Slam for every tentacle the otyugh has.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 21 (4d8 + 3) piercing. On a failed DC 15 Constitution save, the target contracts otyuck. The disease halves the creature’s speed and prevents it from taking the Dash action.
Tentacle Slam. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning plus 3 (1d6) piercing. A Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 13) and Restrained until the grapple ends. The otyugh can hold one target per tentacle.
sections.Bonus Actions: Transform. Convert one appendage to an eyestalk, a leg, or a tentacle. Update its associated statistics.

name: Otyugh Dregsbelcher
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 11. Otyugh.

sections.Traits:
Trash Traversal. Ignore difficult terrain. The dregsbelcher has advantage on Stealth checks to hide in refuse.
Whetted Appetites. A friendly non-minion otyugh gets +1 to attack rolls for each dregsbelcher within 60 ft., up to +5.
sections.Actions: Regurgitate (group attack). Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 20/40-ft. range, one target. Deal 2 bludgeoning plus 2 acid damage per participant on a hit.

name: Orc Blitzer
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Common and Orc.

sections.Traits:
Gnashing Horde. When an enemy the blitzer sees starts its turn within 5 ft. of at least three blitzers, it takes 1 piercing damage per blitzer within 5 ft.
Relentless Minion. When the blitzer drops to 0 HP without being Incapacitated, it can deal 1 piercing damage to an enemy within 5 ft.
sections.Actions: Spear (group attack). Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 1 piercing damage per participant.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Five blitzers play with Brunsa and the human guards in the meeting area (O2). Dohma Raskovar can call ten more with Reinforcements.

name: Orc Bloodrunner
otherStatistics: Spiked shield. Save Dex +5. Acrobatics +5, Athletics +4. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 9. Speaks Common and Orc.

sections.Traits:
Relentless (1/turn). When the orc would drop to 0 HP without dying outright, it can attack an enemy before its HP changes if it is not Incapacitated. The attack takes no action. If it hits and drops the enemy to 0 HP, the orc drops to 1 HP instead.
Unimpeded. The bloodrunner can share a Prone creature’s space. The first time on its own turn that it enters such a creature’s space, that creature takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage. A creature that stands while sharing the bloodrunner’s space moves into the nearest open space of its choice.
sections.Actions:
Spiked Shield. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing. If the bloodrunner moved at least 10 ft. before hitting a Large or smaller creature, it can knock the target Prone or push it up to 10 ft. away.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing.
sections.Reactions: Juke. Gain advantage on a Dexterity save when making it, provided the bloodrunner is free of the Prone, Grappled and Restrained conditions.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: If the party rests while the lair is on alert, there is an 80 percent chance that two bloodrunners and two furies find them five minutes into the rest.

name: Orc Forcecaller
otherStatistics: Hide armor. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Common and Orc.

sections.Traits: Relentless Minion. When the forcecaller drops to 0 HP without being Incapacitated, it can deal 1 force damage to an enemy within 5 ft.
sections.Actions: Chainspoken (group attack). Melee or ranged spell attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit 1 force damage per participant. If at least two forcecallers joined, they can deal that much force damage to another creature within 10 ft. of the target.

name: Orc Fury
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Save Str +5. Athletics +5. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Common and Orc.

sections.Traits: Relentless (1/turn). When the orc would drop to 0 HP without dying outright, it can attack an enemy before its HP changes if it is not Incapacitated. The attack takes no action. If it hits and drops the enemy to 0 HP, the orc drops to 1 HP instead.
sections.Actions:
Haymaker Greataxe. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d12 + 3) slashing, or 12 (1d12 + 6) if the target is already Prone. A Medium or smaller creature hit must pass a DC 13 Strength save or fall Prone.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing.
sections.Bonus Actions: Healing Rally (1/day). Regain 5 HP.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Two furies help Nalan in the feed room (O6). They try to draw intruders into the ring of troughs and trigger the scyza trap.

name: Orc Garroter
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Save Dex +4. Athletics +4, Stealth +6. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Speaks Common and Orc.

sections.Traits: Relentless (1/turn). When the orc would drop to 0 HP without dying outright, it can attack an enemy before its HP changes if it is not Incapacitated. The attack takes no action. If it hits and drops the enemy to 0 HP, the orc drops to 1 HP instead.
sections.Actions:
Strangle. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning and Grapple the target (escape DC 12). Until the grapple ends, it cannot speak intelligibly or cast spells with verbal components. If the attack had advantage, the target makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On failure it falls Unconscious for 1 minute, repeating the save at the start of each of its turns. A success, taking damage, or another creature using an action to shake it awake ends the unconsciousness.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing, plus 7 (2d6) piercing if the attack had advantage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Cloak (1/day). The garroter becomes magically Invisible for 1 minute, along with anything it wears or carries. Its movements are silent while it is Invisible. The effect ends early if it hits a creature with an attack, casts a spell, or takes damage.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Yarl hides off the narrow hallway (O3). If the group finds her while the lair is on alert, she attacks. Otherwise she follows the group and waits for a fight or a chance to attack with other mercenaries.

name: Orc Godcaller
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Save Wis +3. Arcana +3, Insight +3, Performance +8. Immune to Charmed. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Speaks Common and Orc.

sections.Traits: Relentless (1/turn). When the orc would drop to 0 HP without dying outright, it can attack an enemy before its HP changes if it is not Incapacitated. The attack takes no action. If it hits and drops the enemy to 0 HP, the orc drops to 1 HP instead.
sections.Actions:
Power Chord (1st-level spell). Melee or ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature that can hear the godcaller. Hit 18 (4d6 + 4) thunder.
Cadenza. Choose another creature within 30 ft. If it hears the godcaller, it can spend its reaction to move up to its speed and make an attack.
Song of the Gods (2nd-level spell). The godcaller and each ally within 30 ft. that hears it gain advantage on attacks until the start of its next turn. Damage to the godcaller ends the effect early.
sections.Bonus Actions: Rallying Ostinato (1/day). The godcaller and up to three allies within 60 ft. that can hear it each regain 20 HP and ignore difficult terrain for 1 minute.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Hanging Tree, p. 42. The White Tower, p. 148.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Brunsa questions intruders in the Hanging Tree meeting area (O2). In the White Tower, Ornaz tries to warn Xorannox once the guards notice intruders and then flees.

name: Orc Rampart
otherStatistics: Chain mail and shield. Athletics +6, Perception +2. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Speaks Common and Orc.

sections.Traits: Relentless (1/turn). When the orc would drop to 0 HP without dying outright, it can attack an enemy before its HP changes if it is not Incapacitated. The attack takes no action. If it hits and drops the enemy to 0 HP, the orc drops to 1 HP instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Spear attacks. If both target the same creature, it has disadvantage when attacking anyone other than the rampart until the start of the rampart’s next turn.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing with a two-handed melee attack.
sections.Reactions: No! When an enemy within 5 ft. targets a different creature with an attack, the enemy must target the rampart instead.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: One rampart works as a bouncer in the tavern (O1). A second poses as a patron and can be picked out with a DC 13 Wisdom (Insight) check. Use the separate Slime Servant stat block for the amphibious Rampart in Ruins of Wrathrock.

name: Orc Terranova
otherStatistics: Breastplate. Athletics +4. Immune to Prone. Tremorsense 30 ft. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 9. Speaks Common and Orc.

sections.Traits:
Relentless (1/turn). When the orc would drop to 0 HP without dying outright, it can attack an enemy before its HP changes if it is not Incapacitated. The attack takes no action. If it hits and drops the enemy to 0 HP, the orc drops to 1 HP instead.
Tremorspeak. The terranova can sense what a willing creature within 30 ft. senses with tremorsense or Tremorspeak.
Unhindered. The terranova ignores difficult terrain.
sections.Actions:
Earth Pillar (1st-level spell). Melee or ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target touching the ground. Hit 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning and knock the target Prone.
Quake. Choose up to five creatures on the ground within 15 ft. Each falls Prone unless it succeeds on a DC 13 Strength save.
Sinkhole. Choose up to two creatures on the ground within 30 ft. Each becomes Restrained unless it succeeds on a DC 13 Strength save. A creature can use its action to free itself or a creature within reach, ending the effect on that creature.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Rush. Take the Dash action.
Unearth Mohlers (1/day). Bring 1d3 + 1 Mohlers up from the ground in unoccupied spaces within 30 ft. They are friendly to the terranova and act immediately after its turn on the same initiative count.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Nalan and two furies guard three mohlers in the feed room (O6). The mohlers join if the orcs attack. Once the orcs fall, the mohlers burrow away.

name: Hellhound (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Immune to fire damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13. Saves Dex +5, Con +6. Perception +3, Stealth +7, Survival +3. Understands Common and Infernal and cannot speak.

sections.Traits:
Hardened by Flame. When subjected to fire damage, the hound takes none and its AC becomes 18 until the end of its next turn.
Stealthy Hunter. The hound has advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track other creatures and Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide from creatures unaware of its presence.
sections.Actions:
Hellish Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing plus 4 (1d8) fire.
Hellfire Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. Take 14 (3d6 + 4) fire on failure or half on success. A creature other than a hellhound that fails the save catches fire for 1 minute and takes 7 (2d6) fire damage at the start of each turn while burning. A successful repeat save at the end of a turn ends the fire early. The target or a creature within reach of it can also spend an action to put out the fire. If it catches fire again on a later turn, reset the duration to 1 minute without stacking the damage.
sections.Reactions: Tug of War. When an enemy within 5 ft. hits the hound with a melee attack, it can make a Hellish Bite attack against that enemy. On a hit, the enemy is Grappled (escape DC 12). If a weapon made the triggering attack, that weapon cannot be used to attack until the grapple ends. The grapple ends if the hound uses Hellish Bite against someone else.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Shifting Library, p. 88. Molten Enclave, p. 119.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: One hellhound shares the fire giants' meal in the Molten Enclave dining hall (Z6). In the Shifting Library, opening the gate to the Seven Cities (K5) has a 50 percent chance of bringing four hellhounds through.

name: Hellhound Cur
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Immune to fire damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 9. Understands Common and Infernal and cannot speak.

sections.Traits: Crossfire. A creature starting its turn within 10 ft. of at least two curs takes 4 fire damage.
sections.Actions: Hellish Bite (group attack). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 3 fire damage per participant. If at least two curs joined and the target is other than a hellhound, it makes a Dexterity save against DC 10 + the number of participants. On failure it burns for 1 minute, taking fire damage equal to that participant count at the start of each turn while burning. A successful repeat save at the end of a turn ends the fire early. The target or a creature within reach of it can also spend an action to put out the fire. If it catches fire again on a later turn, reset the duration to 1 minute without stacking the damage.

name: Rotting Zombie
otherStatistics: Immune to poison damage, Exhaustion, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 8. Understands the languages it knew in life and cannot speak.

sections.Traits:
Overwhelm. An enemy that starts its turn within 5 ft. of at least three Rotting Zombies that can see it loses 5 ft. of speed for each Rotting Zombie within 5 ft. until the start of its next turn. If that brings the enemy’s walking speed to 0, it is Restrained for the same duration.
Rise Again. The first time nonradiant damage reduces the zombie to 0 HP, it returns to full HP if its body survives. It falls Prone and is Incapacitated until the start of its next turn.
sections.Actions: Slam (group attack). Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 1 bludgeoning damage.

name: Mummy Rotwrap
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Blindsight 60 ft., passive Perception 13. Speaks the languages it knew in life.

sections.Actions: Words of Ancient Doom (group attack). Melee or ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 30-ft. range, one creature. Hit 4 necrotic damage. With at least three rotwraps participating, the target cannot speak or use telepathy until the end of its next turn.

name: Ghoul Craver
otherStatistics: Immune to poison damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 9. Speaks the languages it knew in life.

sections.Traits: Ever So Hungry. An enemy within 5 ft. of at least three cravers cannot Disengage.
sections.Actions: Just a Taste (group attack). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 1 slashing damage. Before the start of the craver’s next turn, the next non-minion ghoul to attack that target adds the number of participating cravers to its attack roll.

name: Decrepit Skeleton
otherStatistics: Immune to poison damage, Exhaustion, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Understands the languages it knew in life and cannot speak.

sections.Traits: Bone Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical. Its bow fires bones taken from its own body. Those bones grow back each dusk.
sections.Actions:
Bone Bow (group attack). Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit 1 piercing damage. If the target is a creature and at least three skeletons took part, they can deal 2 piercing damage to another creature they can see within 5 ft. of the target.
Bone Knife (group attack). Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 1 slashing damage.

name: Crawling Claw (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Stealth +3. Immune to poison damage, Exhaustion, and Poisoned. Blindsight 30 ft. and blind beyond that radius. Passive Perception 9. Understands the languages it knew in life and cannot speak.

sections.Actions:
Claw (group attack). Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 1 piercing damage. If at least three claws took part, the target must pass a DC 10 Constitution save or contract gravefilth.
Gravefilth halves healing granted by spells, powers, and comparable supernatural effects. The infected creature can repeat the DC 10 Constitution save after each long rest and recovers on a success.

name: Wight (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Intimidation +5, Perception +3. Resists necrotic damage. Immune to poison damage, Exhaustion, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13. Speaks the languages it knew in life.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Longsword attack and one Vitality Theft attack, or make two Heavy Crossbow attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.
Heavy Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.
Vitality Theft. Melee spell attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one creature. Hit 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. The wight regains HP equal to half the damage dealt. Until the start of the wight’s next turn, the target has disadvantage on attacks against any other creature.
sections.Reactions: Decaying Guard. When an attack hits an ally the wight sees within 5 ft., choose the wight itself or a willing ally within 5 ft. of the original target. The attacker rerolls the attack against the chosen creature.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Three wights join Azon's ritual in the Occult Sanctum (V6) while ten shades watch. If the last shade falls before the ritual is disrupted with Dispel Magic or by defeating Azon and the wights, a devil magistrate appears.

name: Wight Siphoner
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Immune to poison damage and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Speaks the languages it knew in life.

sections.Actions: Grasping Resurrection (group attack). Melee spell attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 3 necrotic damage. With three or more siphoners participating, they can return one destroyed Undead minion to full HP if its remains are within 15 ft. of the target. With five participating, choose either a 30-ft. range for restoring one minion or restore two minions within 15 ft.

name: Wraith (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Resists acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, and thunder damage, plus bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks. Immune to poison and psychic damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, and Unconscious. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Speaks the languages it knew in life.

sections.Traits:
Agonizing Phasing. It can pass through creatures and objects as difficult terrain. Ending its turn inside an object costs it 5 (1d10) force damage. The first time on a turn it passes through a creature, that creature takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage.
Throes of Oblivion. When the wraith dies, each creature within 20 ft. makes a DC 14 Constitution save. It takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Actions:
Agonizing Touch. Melee spell attack, +6 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one creature. Hit 14 (4d6) psychic damage. DC 14 Wisdom save or become Dazed. Repeat the save at the end of each turn, ending Dazed on a success. Every failed repeat save halves the creature’s current HP maximum. The cumulative reduction lasts until a short or long rest. If a Humanoid dies within 1 minute of the hit, its spirit becomes a Specter under the wraith’s control in the nearest unoccupied space to the place of death.
Psychic Enervation. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, 60-ft. range, one creature. Hit 10 (3d6) psychic damage. DC 14 Wisdom save or fall Prone and become Frightened of the wraith for 1 minute. The target cannot stand while Frightened by this attack. It repeats the save at the end of each turn to end the fear.
sections.Reactions: Denied Vitality. When a creature the wraith sees within 30 ft. regains HP, it can force that creature to make a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, the amount healed is halved.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn, a Dazed creature can move, take an action, or take a bonus action. It chooses just one. Becoming Dazed on its turn ends that turn. Extra actions granted by effects such as Haste or Action Surge still apply. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration end the condition.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Shifting Library, p. 93. Eighth City Advocacy Services, p. 207. Shadowkeep, p. 223. Durixaviinox’s Rest, p. 235. Boughs of Eternity, p. 317.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Shifting Library, p. 83, area K3. The wraith on each bookstack level works with a specter and five shades. If the fight lasts more than two rounds, the librarians from the other level arrive at the start of round three.

name: Shade
otherStatistics: Immune to necrotic and poison damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, and Unconscious. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks the languages it knew in life.

sections.Traits:
Incorporeal Movement. It treats creatures and objects it passes through as difficult terrain. Ending its turn inside an object destroys it.
Terrifying. An enemy that starts its turn within 5 ft. of at least three shades makes a Wisdom save with DC 10 plus the number of shades within 5 ft. Failure leaves it Frightened of them until the start of its next turn. Success gives it 24 hours of immunity to Terrifying from every shade.
sections.Actions: Life Drain (group attack). Melee spell attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one creature. Hit 1 necrotic damage.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Each floor of the Shifting Library bookstacks (K3) has five shades that work with a specter and a wraith. In Shadowkeep, ten shades witness the occult ritual (V6). If the ritual is still active when the last shade falls, it summons a devil magistrate.

name: Blood-Starved Vampire
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 90 ft., passive Perception 12. Speaks the languages it knew in life.

sections.Traits: Radiant Weakening. It has disadvantage on saves against effects that deal radiant damage.
sections.Actions: Feeding Frenzy (group attack). Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 2 piercing and 3 necrotic damage. If two or more vampires took part, reduce the target’s HP maximum by the necrotic damage it took. The target dies if its maximum drops to 0. A long rest, Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, or a comparable supernatural effect ends the reduction.

name: Ancient Lightning Eel
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Str +9, Dex +6. Acrobatics +10, Athletics +9, Perception +9. Resists cold and thunder. Immune to lightning. Passive Perception 19. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The ancient eel breathes air and water. It can remain out of water for up to 24 hours.
Foudroyant Majesty (3/day). Turn a failed save into a success. Doing so prevents the ancient eel from using Multiattack on its next turn.
Slippery. The eel has advantage on checks and saves to avoid or escape the Grappled condition.
Stormsurge. Each other Lightning Eel within 30 ft. deals an extra 4 (1d8) lightning damage with weapon attacks and Electric Pulse.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and use Electric Pulse.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing plus 9 (2d8) lightning damage and grapple the target (escape DC 17). The grappled target is Restrained. The ancient eel cannot bite another target while that grapple lasts.
Electric Pulse. One creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 16 Constitution save, with disadvantage if it is touching the ancient eel. On a failure, it takes 27 (6d8) lightning damage and is Dazed until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and avoids Dazed.
sections.Bonus Actions: Coiling Storm. One creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. On a failure, the ancient eel grapples it (escape DC 17).
sections.Reactions: Heart of the Storm. When another Lightning Eel the ancient eel can see within 30 ft. drops to 0 HP, restore it to life with 10 HP. An eel can benefit from this reaction only once.
sections.Villain Actions:
Use each action once per encounter after an enemy’s turn. Take them in any order, with at most one per round.
Call to the Storm. Each other Lightning Eel within 30 ft. can use Electric Pulse as a reaction.
Electric Rush. Move up to the ancient eel’s speed, then make a Bite attack that deals an extra 18 (4d8) lightning damage on a hit. A creature that hits the ancient eel with a melee attack during this movement takes 9 (2d8) lightning damage.
Fulminous Wave. Use Electric Pulse against every enemy within 30 ft.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): A Dazed creature can do one of the following on its turn: move, take an action, or take a bonus action. If it becomes Dazed during its turn, the turn ends. Extra actions granted by effects such as Haste or Action Surge remain available. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration remove the condition. The GM can allow other remedies.

name: Lightning Eel
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Save Dex +4. Acrobatics +6, Perception +2. Immune to lightning. Passive Perception 12. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The eel breathes air and water and can remain out of water for up to 8 hours.
Slippery. The eel has advantage on checks and saves to avoid or escape the Grappled condition.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Electric Pulse. One creature within 20 ft. makes a DC 12 Constitution save, with disadvantage if it is touching the eel. On a failure, it takes 18 (4d8) lightning damage and is Dazed until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and avoids Dazed.

name: Bear (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +3, Survival +3. Passive Perception 13. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Exceptional Smell. Add +10 to Wisdom (Perception) checks that use smell. The bear can smell creatures through dirt, snow, or water.
Natural Camouflage. The bear has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in its native terrain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claw attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage. The bear grapples a Medium or smaller target it hits (escape DC 14) and cannot bite another target until the grapple ends.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage. A Medium or smaller target falls Prone.
Powerful Swipe (recharge 6). Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (1d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Push a Medium or smaller target up to 10 ft. and knock it Prone. If the target hits a solid surface, it takes an extra 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Optional Bear Features:
Adept Climber (black or spectacled bear). Gain a 25-ft. climb speed.
Arctic Traveler (polar bear). Gain advantage on saves to avoid Exhaustion. Tolerate temperatures down to −50°F and ignore difficult terrain from ice or snow.
Fearsome Growl (any bear, 1/day). As a bonus action, growl. Each creature within 15 ft. that hears it makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Frightened of the bear until the end of the bear’s next turn. On a success, it is immune to Fearsome Growl from all bears for 24 hours.
Clever Claws (sloth bear). Use claws in place of thieves’ tools to open locks, with +3 to the relevant Dexterity check.
Powerful Jaws (giant panda or sun bear). Bite deals an extra 4 (1d8) damage and deals maximum damage to Plants. A bear with this trait cannot use Multiattack.
Sprint (black, brown, polar, spectacled, or sun bear, recharges after a short or long rest). When the bear moves on its turn during combat, it can triple its speed until the turn ends.

name: Bird of Prey (Small)
otherStatistics: Athletics +4, Perception +5. Passive Perception 15. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Exceptional Vision. Add +10 to Wisdom (Perception) checks that use sight.
Flyby. Flying out of an enemy’s reach provokes no opportunity attack.
High-Speed Dive (recharges after a short or long rest). After descending at least 30 ft. on its turn, the bird can Dash as a bonus action. If it does, it has advantage on its next attack that turn.
sections.Actions:
Beak. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
Talons. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage. The bird grapples a Tiny creature it hits (escape DC 12). It instead attaches to a Small or larger creature it hits. While attached, the bird can attack only that creature and has advantage on Beak attacks against it. The creature or someone within reach of it can spend an action to roll DC 12 Strength (Athletics). The attached creature takes 2 (1d4) slashing damage whether the check succeeds or fails. A success detaches the bird. The bird can detach by spending 5 ft. of movement.
sections.Bonus Actions: Spot. Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.
sections.Optional Bird Features:
Crushing Grip (eagle or falcon). As an action, choose a creature the bird is grappling or attached to. The target makes a DC 13 Strength save against 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage, taking half on a success.
Aerial Pursuit (merlin, replaces High-Speed Dive, recharges after a short or long rest). When the bird starts its turn airborne, it can triple its flying speed for that turn. If it descends at least 30 ft., it has advantage on its next attack that turn.
Agile Flyer (kite, harrier, or hawk). While airborne, add +5 to Dexterity saves and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.
Decapitating Strike (eagle or owl). A critical hit against a Tiny target removes its head. The target dies if it needs that head to survive.
Glide (condor or golden eagle). The bird can finish a short rest while flying horizontally.
Night Hunter (owl or letter-winged kite). Gain darkvision 120 ft. and +5 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
Ocean Hunter (osprey). If the bird starts its turn above water, underwater combat imposes no disadvantage on its attacks until that turn ends.
Powerful Impact (falcon, raises CR from 1/2 to 1). Descending at least 20 ft. immediately before hitting with Talons or Rending Talons on that turn adds 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage.
Scavenger’s Resilience (vulture or caracara). Gain advantage on Constitution saves and resistance to poison damage.
Wind Hover (kestrel or osprey). The bird can hover.

name: Camel (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Saves Str +5, Con +6. Passive Perception 11. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Beast of Burden. Count as one size larger when calculating carrying capacity.
Desert Dweller. Ignore difficult terrain made of dirt or sand and tolerate temperatures up to 120°F.
Metabolic Reserves. The camel can go without water for 7 days and without food for 90 days.
Stubborn. The camel has advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed, Frightened, or Prone on itself.
sections.Actions: Kick. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage. The target makes a DC 13 Strength save or falls Prone.
sections.Bonus Actions: Bilious Spit (recharge 5–6). One visible creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, it is Poisoned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a success. If the initial save fails by 5 or more, the creature is also Blinded while Poisoned by this effect.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: At the Soulstone Sanctum (L8), Vairae's Glyph of Warding can cast True Polymorph with save DC 22 and turn its target into this camel.

name: Griffon (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Save Con +6. Perception +4. Passive Perception 14. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Steady. The griffon has advantage on checks and saves against being knocked Prone.
Swoop. On a turn when the griffon flies more than 20 ft. directly toward a target and then hits it with Claw, it grapples the target (escape DC 14). While that grapple lasts, the griffon has advantage on Beak attacks against that target and cannot make Claw attacks. Grappling a Medium or smaller creature does not reduce its speed.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Beak attack and optionally make one Claw attack, use Buffet, or use Piercing Cry.
Beak. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.
Buffet. Each creature in a 30-ft. cone that the griffon is not grappling makes a DC 14 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage, is pushed 5 ft. away, and falls Prone.
Piercing Cry. Each enemy within 60 ft. that hears the griffon makes a DC 12 Wisdom save or is Frightened of it for 1 minute. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that succeeds or for whom the effect ends gains immunity to all griffons’ Piercing Cry for 24 hours.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Cloud Fang Keep, area E2. Two griffons start in the roost. Two more return at the start of round two, or one if the party already defeated a griffon outside. The nest is difficult terrain for creatures other than griffons.

name: Skitterling
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 11. No languages.

sections.Traits: Flyby. Flying out of an enemy’s reach provokes no opportunity attack.
sections.Actions: Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1 slashing damage. The target makes a DC 10 Constitution save or is Blinded until the start of its next turn. Immunity to poison damage or the Poisoned condition makes the save an automatic success.

name: Air Spark
otherStatistics: Perception +5. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15. Speaks Auran and Common.

sections.Actions: Wind Sweep (group attack). Melee spell attack, +8 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 8 slashing per attacker. If at least two sparks participated and the target is a Large or smaller creature, the sparks can move it horizontally up to 5 ft. per participating spark.

name: Earth Spark
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Immune to poison damage and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Common and Terran.

sections.Traits: Trampling Rampage. An enemy touching the ground that starts its turn within 5 ft. of at least two earth sparks makes a Strength save. The DC is 12 plus the number of earth sparks within 5 ft. of the enemy. On a failure, the enemy falls Prone and cannot stand while at least two earth sparks are within 5 ft. of it.
sections.Actions:
Shatter Smash (group attack). Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 5 bludgeoning per attacker.
Snort Rocks (group attack). Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit 5 bludgeoning per attacker. A flying creature hit falls Prone on a failed Strength save (DC 12 plus the number of sparks in the attack).

name: Fire Spark
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Performance +6. Immune to fire damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Common and Ignan.

sections.Traits: Little Flames. The spark gives off bright light within 15 ft. and dim light for the next 15 ft. An enemy that starts its turn within 5 ft. of three or more fire sparks takes 6 fire damage.
sections.Actions: Ember Claw (group attack). Melee spell attack, +6 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 4 fire per attacker.

name: Water Spark
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13. Speaks Aquan and Common.

sections.Traits: Whirlpool Suction. An enemy that starts its turn within 5 ft. of at least three water sparks makes a Strength save (DC 14 plus the number of water sparks within 5 ft. of the enemy). Its speed drops to 0 on a failure. The printed trait gives no duration. Table ruling for this profile: the speed reduction ends at the end of that enemy’s turn.
sections.Actions: Whelming Wave (group attack). Melee or ranged spell attack, +11 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 30-ft. range, one target. Hit 10 bludgeoning per attacker. If at least two sparks participated, the target makes a Dexterity save (DC 14 plus the number of sparks in the attack). On a failure, it falls Prone and cannot stand until the end of the sparks’ next turn.

name: Essence of Mist
otherStatistics: Saving throws Dex +10, Cha +8. Deception +8, Sleight of Hand +10, Stealth +10. Resists psychic damage. Immune to Blinded, Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Prone, and Restrained. Blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 11. Speaks Aquan, Auran, and Common.

sections.Traits:
Flowing Form. The essence can enter and stop in an enemy’s space. It needs only a 1-inch-wide opening to pass without squeezing.
Gasping Aura. Any creature within 10 ft. that needs to breathe loses the ability to speak or take reactions while in range.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Breathless Rend attacks.
Breathless Rend. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing plus 22 (4d10) psychic.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Convocation of Breath (2/day). Choose the essence or another Elemental the essence sees within 30 ft. That Elemental chooses one effect below.
Hide in Breath. The Elemental targets a creature within 10 ft. other than a Construct, Elemental, Ooze, or Undead. On a failed DC 18 Constitution save, the Elemental enters the target’s body until the start of the Elemental’s next turn. Inside, the Elemental cannot take actions and has total cover from attacks and other effects outside the target.
Toxic Breath. The Elemental emits a 10-ft. aura for 1 minute or until moderate or stronger wind disperses it. The aura is lightly obscured. A creature that needs to breathe and starts its turn there is Poisoned until the end of its next turn on a failed DC 16 Constitution save.
Breathstealer’s Shimmer (1/day). The essence turns Invisible and takes the Hide action. The invisibility ends if it attacks or uses Convocation of Breath.

name: Essence of Storms
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Acrobatics +6, Perception +6. Resists lightning, poison, and thunder damage. Immune to Dazed, Grappled, Paralyzed, Poisoned, and Restrained. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 16. Speaks Auran and Common.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Wind Talons attacks. One can be replaced by Bluster or an available Lightning Squall.
Wind Talons. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing.
Bluster. Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 14 Strength save. The essence moves each creature that fails up to 10 ft. in any direction.
Lightning Squall (3/day). Choose a visible creature within 30 ft. It makes a DC 14 Constitution save. Failure deals 28 (8d6) lightning damage and leaves the creature Dazed for 1 minute, with a repeat save at the end of each of its turns to end the condition. Success deals half damage and avoids the condition.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Convocation of Air (1/day). Choose the essence or another Elemental the essence sees within 30 ft. That Elemental chooses one effect below.
Rising Whirlwind. Each creature the Elemental chooses within 30 ft. makes a DC 14 Strength save. Failure lifts it 10 ft. and leaves it Restrained for 1 minute. It rises another 10 ft. at the start of each turn while restrained and repeats the save at the end of each turn to end the condition. A different creature that can reach the target can use an action to pull it free and end the condition. The whirlwind ends if the Elemental dies or dismisses it without an action.
Vortex Terrain. For 1 minute, the area within 20 ft. of the Elemental counts as difficult terrain for enemies.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses just one of moving, taking an action, or taking a bonus action. If the creature becomes Dazed during its turn, the turn ends. It still receives any extra actions granted by effects such as Haste or Action Surge. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, or Greater Restoration can clear the condition.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Ash Queen’s Reliquary, area A3. An Elemental can activate the three champion statues as an action or bonus action once per 24 hours. They summon an essence of storms, an essence of tides and a force of earth. Each statue has AC 17, 27 HP and immunity to poison and psychic damage. Destroying a statue dismisses its elemental.

name: Essence of Tides
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Acrobatics +7, Medicine +6. Resists acid, fire, and poison damage. Immune to Grappled, Poisoned, and Restrained. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13. Speaks Aquan and Common.

sections.Traits: Water Glide. The essence gains a fly speed equal to its swim speed while within 5 ft. of a liquid or solid surface. Its flight does not provoke opportunity attacks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Water Wing attacks and one Lightning Tail Whip attack.
Water Wing. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning. A creature hit twice with Water Wing on the same turn becomes vulnerable to lightning damage until the end of the essence’s turn.
Lightning Tail Whip. Melee spell attack, +6 to hit, 15-ft. reach, one target. Hit 7 (2d6) lightning and push the target up to 10 ft. away.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Convocation of Water (1/day). Choose the essence or another Elemental the essence sees within 30 ft. That Elemental chooses one effect below.
Scalding Steam. Each creature within 15 ft. of the Elemental, except Elementals, makes a DC 15 Constitution save. Failure deals 18 (4d8) fire damage and leaves the creature Blinded until the end of its next turn. Success deals half damage and avoids the condition.
Waters of Vitality. The Elemental regains 25 HP and can remove one of these conditions from itself: Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Ash Queen’s Reliquary (p. 291, A3). An Elemental can activate the three memorial statues with an action or bonus action. One summons an essence of tides that fights intruders until destroyed. Destroying its statue dismisses it.

name: Crux of Fire
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throw Cha +6. Perception +4, Performance +6. Resists poison damage. Immune to fire damage, Invisible, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14. Speaks Common and Ignan.

sections.Traits: Ablaze. The crux gives off bright light within 20 ft. and dim light for the next 20 ft. It cannot benefit from being Invisible. A creature takes 7 (2d6) fire damage if it starts its turn grappling the crux or grappled by it.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Flame Tongue attacks or two Sulfurous Rake attacks.
Sulfurous Rake. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing. The target cannot take reactions this turn.
Flame Tongue. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, 100-ft. range, one target. Hit 13 (2d12) fire. A flammable object that nobody wears or carries catches fire.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Convocation of Fire (1/day). Choose the crux or another Elemental the crux sees within 30 ft. That Elemental chooses one effect below.
Flame Bloom. The Elemental chooses a visible point within 60 ft. A 10-ft.-radius sphere centered there burns for 1 minute. A creature takes 10 (3d6) fire damage when it first enters the sphere on a turn or starts its turn there.
Smoke Screen. Smoke fills a 10-ft. aura around the Elemental for 1 minute or until moderate or stronger wind disperses it. The area is heavily obscured for creatures other than fire elementals.
Flame Jet (1/day). The crux gains a 30-ft. fly speed until the end of its turn and can move up to its speed.

name: Crux of Frost
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Deception +10, Insight +9, Perception +6. Immune to cold and poison damage, Invisible, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 16. Speaks Aquan, Common, and languages gained from Frosted Reflection.

sections.Traits: Scintillating. The crux cannot benefit from being Invisible.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rimeglass Touch attacks and optionally use either Frosted Reflection or It Stares Back if available.
Rimeglass Touch. Melee or ranged spell attack, +7 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 60-ft. range, one target. Hit 17 (3d8 + 4) cold. Until the start of the crux’s next turn, the target loses the ability to see or hear creatures other than itself and the crux.
Frosted Reflection. Assume the illusory, frostbitten appearance of a particular Small or Medium creature seen within the last week. The crux gains the creature’s languages for the illusion’s duration. It ends when the crux takes thunder damage, uses the action again, or becomes Incapacitated.
It Stares Back (recharge 5–6). Target the creature portrayed by Frosted Reflection if it is within 60 ft. If it can see the crux, it makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. Failure leaves it Frightened of the crux for 1 minute or until the reflection ends. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns to end the fear. It takes an extra 11 (2d10) psychic damage every time it takes damage while Frightened this way. A successful save prevents the fear and grants immunity to It Stares Back from any crux for 24 hours.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Convocation of Ice (1/day). Choose the crux or another Elemental the crux sees within 30 ft. That Elemental chooses one effect below.
Frigid Sheen. For 1 minute, the Elemental can use a reaction when an attacker it can see within 30 ft. hits it. The attack has no effect on the Elemental. The attacker makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. On a failure, the attack’s damage and effects hit the attacker as if the Elemental made the attack. On a success, the attacker takes half the damage and suffers no other effects.
Frost Squall. Frost surrounds the Elemental for 1 minute. A creature other than an Elemental that starts its turn within 15 ft. has its speed capped at 15 ft. until the end of that turn. The first time it willingly moves before its next turn starts, it takes 10 (3d6) cold damage.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Durixaviinox’s Rest, p. 227, area W4. A DC 16 Wisdom (Perception) check spots the two cruxes in the water. They leap onto shore and attack when they notice intruders.

name: Oracle of Storms
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Dex +10, Cha +8. History +11, Nature +11, Perception +9, Performance +8. Immune to lightning, poison, and thunder damage and to Dazed, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, and Restrained. Blindsight 60 ft., passive Perception 19. Speaks Aquan, Auran, and Common.

sections.Traits: Turbulent Escalation. At the start of its turn outdoors, an oracle that is not Incapacitated can change the weather without an action. The change covers a 1-mile radius centered on the oracle and lasts 1 minute or until this trait is used again. A clear sky turns cloudy, cloudy skies bring rain or snow (oracle’s choice), and rain or snow intensifies to stormy weather.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Tempest Bolt twice. One use can be replaced by Cyclone Staff.
Cyclone Staff. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 23 (4d8 + 5) bludgeoning plus 22 (4d10) thunder. The oracle moves the target up to 10 ft. in any direction.
Tempest Bolt. Choose a visible creature within 90 ft., or within 300 ft. if it is outdoors in stormy weather. It makes a DC 18 Dexterity save with disadvantage if it is outdoors in stormy weather. Failure deals 31 (7d8) lightning damage. Success halves the damage.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Convocation of Storms (2/day). Choose the oracle or another Elemental the oracle sees within 30 ft. That Elemental chooses one effect below.
Lightning Within. The next time the Elemental hits with an attack within 1 minute, that attack deals 33 (6d10) extra lightning damage.
Thunder Burst. Choose four creatures the Elemental sees within 60 ft. A target that fails a DC 17 Constitution save takes 22 (4d10) thunder damage, is pushed up to 10 ft. away, and is Deafened until the end of its next turn.
sections.Utility Spells: Uses Wisdom (spell save DC 17). Three uses per day of each: Commune, Commune with Nature, Legend Lore, and Scrying. Use the spell descriptions for casting times.

name: Little Bear (Medium)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +3, Survival +3. Passive Perception 13. No languages.
description: A bear that picks up scents through snow, water, or soil and knocks foes down with a heavy swat.

sections.Traits:
Exceptional Smell. Add +10 to Wisdom (Perception) checks that use smell. Soil, snow, and water do not block the bear's sense of smell.
Natural Camouflage. The beast has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in its native terrain.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. Use the maximum damage against a Plant instead of rolling.
Swat. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing or bludgeoning damage, chosen by the bear. The target falls Prone if it fails a DC 13 Strength save.
sections.Optional Bear Features:
Adept Climber (black or spectacled bear). Gain a climb speed of 25 ft.
Arctic Traveler (polar bear). Gain advantage on saves against Exhaustion, tolerate temperatures as low as −50°F, and ignore difficult terrain from ice or snow.
Fearsome Growl (any bear, bonus action, 1/day). Each creature within 15 ft. that hears the bear makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Frightened of the bear until the end of the bear's next turn. On a success, it is immune to all bears' Fearsome Growl for 24 hours.
Clever Claws (sloth bear). Use claws in place of thieves' tools to open locks and add +3 to the Dexterity check.
Powerful Jaws (giant panda or sun bear). Bite deals an extra 4 (1d8) damage. Use maximum damage against Plants. This option prevents the bear from using Multiattack.
Sprint (black, brown, polar, spectacled, or sun bear, recharges after a short or long rest). When the bear moves on its turn in combat, it can triple its speed until the turn ends.

name: Little Wildcat (Small)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Acrobatics +4, Perception +6, Stealth +6. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 16. No languages.
description: A small feline ambusher that can drop from a tree without injury and pounce from cover.

sections.Traits:
Agile Landing. The cat takes no damage from falling 40 ft. or less unless it is Incapacitated.
Hunter's Pounce. A hit with advantage grapples a Small or smaller target (escape DC 12). The cat cannot attack another creature while holding the target this way.
Natural Camouflage. The beast has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in its native terrain.
Sprint (recharges after a short or long rest). When the cat moves on its turn in combat, it can triple its speed until the turn ends.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) piercing damage against a Grappled or Restrained target.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) slashing damage if the attack had advantage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Sneak. Take the Hide action.
sections.Optional Wildcat Features:
Adept Climber (clouded leopard, jaguar, leopard, lynx, or snow leopard). Gain a climb speed of 25 ft.
Agile Landing (any Medium wildcat). Ignore falls of 40 ft. or less unless Incapacitated.
Deadly Bite (lion, tiger, or jaguar). A Bite hit against a Prone target is a critical hit.
Desert Dweller (sand cat). Ignore difficult terrain from dirt or sand and tolerate temperatures up to 120°F. Fresh food meets the cat's need for water.
Mountain Dweller (lynx or snow leopard). Ignore difficult terrain from snow, ice, or steep slopes.
Superior Sprint (cheetah or sand cat, 2 uses per short or long rest). When the cat moves on its turn in combat, it can quadruple its speed until the turn ends. Replaces Sprint.
Pack Tactics (lion). The cat has advantage on attacks against a target within 5 ft. of at least one ally of the cat, as long as the ally is not Incapacitated.
Powerful Leap (caracal, cougar, lion, margay, serval, or snow leopard). Double all jump distances, with or without a running start. Use either Strength or Dexterity to determine the distance.
Swimmer (tiger, leopard, ocelot, or jaguar). Gain a swim speed of 30 ft.

name: Snowfox
otherStatistics: Perception +5, Stealth +5, Survival +3. Resists cold damage. Darkvision 120 ft., tremorsense 15 ft., passive Perception 15. No languages.
description: A winged fox from polar regions and high plateaus. Its white winter coat darkens as the weather warms.

sections.Traits:
Natural Camouflage. The snowfox has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in snowy terrain or cloudy skies.
Nimble Escape. The snowfox provokes no opportunity attacks when it leaves an enemy's reach.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 piercing damage, and the snowfox attaches to the target. While attached, it has advantage on Claw attacks against the target and cannot attack another creature. The target or a creature that can reach it can spend an action to detach the snowfox with a successful DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check. The snowfox can detach by spending 5 ft. of movement.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 slashing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Burrow. Burrow up to 5 ft. through snow.
Listen. Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.

name: Snowfox (Familiar Variant)
otherStatistics: Perception +5, Stealth +5, Survival +3. Resists cold damage. Darkvision 120 ft., tremorsense 15 ft., passive Perception 15. No languages.
description: A winged arctic fox that can share what it sees and hears with the creature it serves.

sections.Traits:
Natural Camouflage. The snowfox has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in snowy terrain or cloudy skies.
Nimble Escape. The snowfox provokes no opportunity attacks when it leaves an enemy's reach.
Familiar. The snowfox can form a telepathic bond with a willing creature it serves. Within 1 mile, the companion can share the snowfox's senses. While bonded, the fox may use the companion's proficiency bonus for ability checks. It gains temporary HP equal to that bonus at the end of a long rest. Either creature can end the bond at any time.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 piercing damage, and the snowfox attaches to the target. While attached, it has advantage on Claw attacks against the target and cannot attack another creature. The target or a creature that can reach it can spend an action to detach the snowfox with a successful DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check. The snowfox can detach by spending 5 ft. of movement.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 slashing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Burrow. Burrow up to 5 ft. through snow.
Listen. Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.

name: Wildcat (Large)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +6, Stealth +4. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 16. No languages.
description: A stalking cat that sprints from cover and sinks its teeth into prey it has pinned.

sections.Traits:
Hunter's Pounce. A hit with advantage grapples a Large or smaller target (escape DC 13). The cat cannot attack another creature while holding the target this way.

name: Swarm of Insects (Bullet Ants)
classification: Medium Swarm of Tiny Beasts, unaligned
otherStatistics: Resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Immune to Charmed, Dazed, Flanked, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, and Stunned. Blindsight 10 ft., passive Perception 9. No languages.
description: A mass of ants that burrows underfoot and stings as it closes in.

sections.Traits:
Multitudinous. The swarm has advantage on opportunity attacks and can make them when a creature leaves its reach even after taking Disengage.
Swarm. The swarm and other creatures can share occupied spaces. An opening that fits one Tiny insect fits the swarm. The swarm cannot regain HP or gain temporary HP.
sections.Actions:
Sting. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 2 (1d4) piercing plus 7 (2d6) poison damage. At half HP or less, the hit deals 1 piercing plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.
Distracting Buzz. The swarm can use this action while it has at least half its HP. Until the start of the swarm's next turn, creatures within 15 ft. that hear it have disadvantage on attacks against any other target.

ruleNotes: Uses the printed base swarm with the Burrower and Sting options listed for ants.

name: Swarm of Insects (MCDM)
classification: Medium Swarm of Tiny Beasts, unaligned
otherStatistics: Resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Immune to Charmed, Dazed, Flanked, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, and Stunned. Blindsight 10 ft., passive Perception 9. No languages.
description: A mass of insects that crowds the battlefield and distracts anyone close enough to hear it.

sections.Traits:
Multitudinous. The swarm has advantage on opportunity attacks and can make them when a creature leaves its reach even after taking Disengage.
Swarm. The swarm and other creatures can share occupied spaces. An opening that fits one Tiny insect fits the swarm. The swarm cannot regain HP or gain temporary HP.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit 10 (4d4) piercing damage, or 5 (2d4) piercing damage at half HP or less.
Distracting Buzz. The swarm can use this action while it has at least half its HP. Until the start of the swarm's next turn, creatures within 15 ft. that hear it have disadvantage on attacks against any other target.
sections.Optional Insect Swarm Features:
Deafening Song (cicadas, action, recharge 6). Each creature within 15 ft. makes a DC 12 Constitution save or is Deafened. A creature can repeat the save at each turn's end to end the effect.
Multiattack (locusts, action, +1 CR). Make two Bite attacks.
Burrower (ants, beetles, or termites). Gain a 5-ft. burrow speed.
Darkvision (beetles, mosquitoes, cockroaches, or other nocturnal insects). Gain darkvision 30 ft.
Disease Carrier (mosquitoes, dung beetles, or fleas). On an attack hit, the target makes a DC 12 Constitution save or is Poisoned. It repeats the save at each turn's end to end the effect.
Durable (cockroaches, +1 CR). Double the swarm's HP and set AC to 15. Constitution saves gain +5 and advantage.
Flyer (cicadas, locusts, wasps, or other flying insects). Gain a 30-ft. fly speed.
Sting (fire ants, bullet ants, or wasps). Replace Bite with the following attack. Sting. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 2 (1d4) piercing plus 7 (2d6) poison damage. At half HP or less, the hit deals 1 piercing plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

name: Arcane Amalgam
classification: Large swarm of Tiny Oozes, unaligned
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throw Con +7. Resists acid, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Immune to poison damage and to Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Flanked, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, and Stunned. Blindsight 120 ft., blind beyond that range, passive Perception 11. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Antimagic Lethargy. In an Antimagic Field its speed is halved and it cannot take reactions. When targeted by Dispel Magic, it must pass a Wisdom save against the caster’s spell save DC or lose its reactions for 1 minute.
Arcane Tracker. Coming within 30 ft. of a creature or object affected by magic lets it track that target unerringly for 24 hours.
Explosive Enhancement. Hitting the swarm with a mundane melee weapon charges the weapon for 1 minute, giving it a cumulative +1 bonus to damage rolls. At +3 the weapon explodes and is destroyed, dealing 10 (3d6) force damage to its wielder.
False Appearance. While motionless it passes for a puddle of muck.
Swarm. It can share space with a creature and fit through a 1-inch opening without squeezing. It cannot regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target. Hit 14 (4d6) acid damage, reduced to 7 (2d6) when the swarm is at half its hit points or below.
Wild Surge (recharge 5–6). Every creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 15 Dexterity save for half of 22 (4d10) damage. Roll a d6 separately for each creature to determine the damage type: 1 acid, 2 cold, 3 fire, 4 force, 5 necrotic, 6 poison.
sections.Reactions: Spell Reflection. On taking damage from a spell, make every creature within 10 ft. attempt a DC 15 Dexterity save. Failure deals 11 (2d10) damage of one type the triggering spell dealt to the swarm. The swarm picks the type if there were several.
sections.Flanked (MCDM): When using optional flanking rules, this immunity prevents enemies from flanking it from any positions.

name: Deep Dreamer
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throw Int +10. Deception +8, Insight +6, Persuasion +8. Immune to psychic damage and to Charmed, Frightened, and Prone. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 11. Speaks Deep Speech and Undercommon. Telepathy 120 ft.

sections.Traits: Psionic Shroud. Divination spells and effects that read its thoughts or sense its emotions cannot affect it.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Tendrils attacks and use Dream Spores if available.
Tendrils. Melee power attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing plus 22 (4d10) psychic damage. If the dreamer has Charmed the target, it heals for half the psychic damage dealt.
Dream Spores (5th-order power, recharge 5–6). Each creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 18 Intelligence save. On failure the dreamer Charms it for 1 minute. On its turn the creature must use its movement to approach within 10 ft. of the dreamer by the safest route. Whenever it takes damage, it can repeat the save and end the effect on itself on a success.
sections.Reactions: Rouse Dreamer. When a creature attacks the dreamer, the dreamer can redirect the attack to a creature it has Charmed that is within range of the attack.
sections.Psionic Powers (MCDM): Powers are supernatural and have no components. Antimagic Field, Counterspell, and Dispel Magic affect spells or magic and do not stop powers. A creature with a melee power attack can use it for an opportunity attack.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Coronal Hollow, p. 239, area B3. A creature exposed to the cove's ambient spores must pass a DC 17 Intelligence save or be Dazed while it remains in the cove. The two dreamers attack only if attacked. Killing both ends the ambient spore effects. Use the DC 18 Dream Spores action separately during combat.

name: Fossil Cryptic
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Str +7 and Con +7. Resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks. Immune to poison damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, and Prone. Blindsight 90 ft., passive Perception 11. Speaks Primordial.

sections.Traits: Churning Trunk. The cryptic can pass through a Prone creature’s space without provoking opportunity attacks from Prone creatures. The first time in a turn it crosses a Prone enemy’s space, that enemy takes 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks and use Stone Bone Storm.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Stone Bone Storm. Each creature in a 30-ft.-long, 5-ft.-wide line from the cryptic makes a DC 15 Strength save. Failure deals 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage and knocks it Prone. Success halves the damage and prevents the fall. Then the cryptic reforms in an unoccupied space within the line.
Shatterstone (recharge 6). Burrow up to half its speed. If within 5 ft. of the surface at the end of this movement, the cryptic can breach it. Each other creature within 20 ft. then makes a DC 15 Dexterity save for half of 36 (8d8) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Stoneshift. Choose one creature or object touching the ground within 30 ft. A failed DC 15 Dexterity save lets the cryptic move it horizontally up to 15 ft. Objects automatically fail.
sections.Mundane Attacks (MCDM): For these resistances, a mundane attack uses neither magic nor psionics.

name: Gibbering Mouther (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throw Con +5. Immune to Charmed, Frightened, and Prone. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks every language and understands none.

sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. Powers, spells, and other effects cannot change its form.
Primordial Influence. A Dazed enemy that starts its turn within 20 ft. makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On failure, the GM chooses a strange physical alteration that leaves the creature’s game statistics intact. The creature repeats the save after each long rest. On further failures, the GM worsens the alteration or adds another. A 4th-order or higher Cure Ailment, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect reverses the alterations. After failing three saves following the initial alteration, the creature becomes a gibbering mouther under the GM’s control. Only Wish can restore it after that.
Viscous Vicinity. The area within 20 ft. is difficult terrain for other creatures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Reality Rend attacks. One can be replaced by Pull.
Reality Rend. Melee power attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) psychic damage. The target must pass a DC 13 Wisdom save or become Dazed until the start of the mouther’s next turn.
Pull. Choose up to three visible creatures within 60 ft. Each that fails a DC 13 Strength save is pulled up to 30 ft. directly toward the mouther.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses just one of moving, taking an action, or taking a bonus action. If it becomes Dazed during that turn, the turn ends. It can still use extra actions granted by effects such as Haste or Action Surge. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, or Greater Restoration can clear the condition.
sections.Psionic Powers (MCDM): Powers are supernatural and have no components. Antimagic Field, Counterspell, and Dispel Magic affect spells or magic and do not stop powers. A creature with a melee power attack can use it for an opportunity attack.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Eyes of the Mountain (p. 252, N1). The four mouthers in the central pit obey Yserthrax. They attack intruders who descend at least 60 ft. into the pit, except Yserthrax and the voiceless talkers. They stay in the pit unless Yserthrax orders otherwise.

name: Lacuna
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Dex +5, Wis +8, and Cha +12. Arcana +9, Deception +12, Insight +8, and Persuasion +12. Immune to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, and Stunned. Truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 13. Speaks Abyssal, Common, and Infernal.

sections.Traits:
Avoidance. When an effect offers a save for half damage, a successful save prevents all damage and a failed save halves it.
False Appearance. A motionless lacuna passes for an ordinary statue.
Fiend Between. It has no walking speed and gains no benefit from speed bonuses.
Supernatural Resistance. It has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Grief-Eater attacks and use Infuse Sadness if available.
Grief-Eater. Melee or ranged spell attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20 ft., one creature. Hit 29 (4d10 + 7) psychic damage and reduce the target’s speed by 10 ft. until the end of its next turn.
Infuse Sadness (1/day). Every enemy the lacuna can see within 30 ft. makes a DC 20 Wisdom save. Failure makes attacks against that enemy have advantage for up to 1 minute. The enemy can end the effect by passing the save at the end of its turn.
sections.Bonus Actions: Slip Between. Teleport up to 60 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space.
sections.Reactions: Slip Away. If a creature within 60 ft. targets the lacuna with an attack, teleport up to 60 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space. If the teleport makes the lacuna an invalid target, the attacker must choose a new target or the attack misses.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Coronal Hollow, p. 241, area B7. Two lacunas pass as statues beside the entrance. They attack as soon as the party shows delight at the treasure.

name: Olothec
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Con +7, Int +9, Wis +6, and Cha +8. History +9, Insight +10, Intimidation +8, and Perception +10. Immune to Charmed, Flanked, Frightened, and Prone. Blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 20. Speaks Common, Deep Speech, and Undercommon. Telepathy 120 ft.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The olothec breathes air and water.
Immutable Form. Powers, spells, and other effects cannot change its form.
Supernatural Resistance. It has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make six Devolving Tentacle attacks and use Piscine Transformation.
Devolving Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage. The first time a creature is hit by this attack on a turn, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution save or be slimed. While slimed it subtracts 1d4 from each attack roll and ability check. After each of its turns, the penalty die steps up from d4 to d6, d8, d10, then d12. A successful repeat save at the end of its turn ends the effect, as do Cure Ailment and Lesser Restoration.
Piscine Transformation (3rd-order power). Choose a visible Humanoid within 60 ft. On a failed DC 17 Wisdom save, change one part of its body. A fish head prevents speech. Fins in place of legs limit walking speed to 10 ft. if it was higher and give a 30-ft. swim speed. A fish torso lets the target breathe only water and hold its breath for 1 hour. If it gains the torso out of water, it starts suffocating. A 4th-order or higher Cure Ailment or Greater Restoration ends a transformation. With all three changes at once, the target permanently becomes a fishlike hybrid. Only Wish or similar magic can restore it then.
sections.Bonus Actions: Jaunt (3rd-order power). Teleport 30 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space.
sections.Lair Actions:
In its lair, take one action from the list on initiative count 20 after any ties. Use a different option from the previous round.
Baleful Teleport. Choose up to two visible creatures within 60 ft. Each that fails a DC 15 Charisma save teleports up to 60 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space of the olothec’s choice.
Psychic Shock. Choose up to two creatures within 30 ft. slimed by Devolving Tentacle. Each takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage. The olothec heals for the total damage dealt.
Slime Eruption. Choose up to three creatures within 120 ft. On a failed DC 15 Constitution save, the target is Poisoned until the end of its next turn.
sections.Slime Servant Template: After 1 continuous minute slimed by Devolving Tentacle, the slime ends and the creature loses its memories and becomes an NPC loyal to the olothec. It keeps its statistics and gains amphibious breathing and a swim speed at least equal to its walking speed. It cannot be Charmed or Frightened. The olothec can use its senses and speak through it if it can speak. Only Wish restores its memories and original state.
sections.Psionic Powers (MCDM): Powers are supernatural and have no components. Antimagic Field, Counterspell, and Dispel Magic affect spells or magic and do not stop powers. A creature with a melee power attack can use it for an opportunity attack.
sections.Flanked (MCDM): When using optional flanking rules, this immunity prevents enemies from flanking it from any positions.

name: Voiceless Talker Graywarper
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 12. Speaks Deep Speech and Undercommon. Telepathy 120 ft.

sections.Traits: Psionic Nexus. A non-minion voiceless talker within 30 ft. can use telepathy or manifest a power as though in the graywarper’s space.
sections.Actions: Phase Chant (group attack). Melee or ranged power attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit 4 psychic damage per attacker. If three or more graywarpers took part and the target is a creature, the target makes a Charisma save with DC 11 + the number of attackers. On failure, it becomes translucent and immaterial until the end of its next turn and deals half damage with weapon attacks and unarmed strikes.
sections.Psionic Powers (MCDM): Powers are supernatural and have no components. Antimagic Field, Counterspell, and Dispel Magic affect spells or magic and do not stop powers. A creature with a melee power attack can use it for an opportunity attack.

name: Servok Builder
