otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Str +11 and Con +11. Athletics +11. Resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks. Immune to poison and psychic damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 9. Understands Dwarvish and cannot speak.

sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. Powers, spells, and other effects cannot change its form.
Siege Monster. It deals double damage to structures and objects.
Supernatural Resistance. It has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Wrecking Ball and Stone. It can also use Lay the Foundation if available.
Wrecking Ball. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 26 (3d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage. Every enemy within 5 ft. of the target must pass a DC 19 Dexterity save or take 13 (2d12) bludgeoning damage.
Stone. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit falls Prone.
Lay the Foundation (recharge 6). Cover a 20-ft. square of ground with wet concrete starting from a point within 5 ft. The area is difficult terrain for 1 hour as the concrete dries. A creature with Strength 20 or less that starts its turn there must pass a DC 19 Strength (Athletics) check or be Restrained until the start of its next turn.
sections.Mundane Attacks (MCDM): For these resistances, a mundane attack uses neither magic nor psionics.

name: Servok Miner
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Str +10 and Con +9. Athletics +10. Resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks. Immune to poison and psychic damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 9. Understands Dwarvish and cannot speak.

sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. Powers, spells, and other effects cannot change its form.
Supernatural Resistance. It has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.
Tunneler. It can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed, leaving a tunnel 5 ft. in diameter.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Drill Press and Pneumatic Pick.
Drill Press. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage. If touching the ground, the target falls Prone and the drill Restrains it. The target takes 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns while pinned. The miner cannot attack with Drill Press while pinning a target. The restraint ends if the miner moves, makes another Drill Press attack, or is destroyed. The target or a creature that can reach it can use an action to pull it free, dealing 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage to the target.
Pneumatic Pick. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage. Mundane armor worn by the target loses 1 AC permanently with each hit. Armor reduced to AC 10 is destroyed.
Unload Rocks (recharge 6). Every creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. On failure it takes 44 (8d10) bludgeoning damage and is Blinded until the end of its next turn. Success halves the damage and prevents Blinded.
sections.Bonus Actions: Break Ground (recharge 6). Open a fissure in a line from the miner that is 30 ft. long, 5 ft. wide, and 30 ft. deep. Each Medium or smaller creature in the line makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. On failure it falls in, takes 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage, and lands Prone. On success it is shunted 5 ft. to an unoccupied space. If none is available within 5 ft., it falls in anyway.
sections.Mundane Attacks (MCDM): For these resistances, a mundane attack uses neither magic nor psionics.

ruleNotes: The printed Drill Press prohibits another use while a target is pinned and also lists another use as a way to end the pin.

name: Servok War Engine
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Str +14 and Con +12. Athletics +14. Resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks. Immune to poison and psychic damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 9. Understands Dwarvish and cannot speak.

sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. Powers, spells, and other effects cannot change its form.
Siege Monster. It deals double damage to structures and objects.
Supernatural Resistance. It has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Blade Rake and Force Cannon.
Blade Rake. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 35 (4d12 + 9) slashing damage and pull the target up to 15 ft. toward the engine if it is Large or smaller.
Force Cannon. Ranged spell attack, +12 to hit, range 400 ft., one target. Hit 33 (6d10) force damage and Daze the target until the end of its next turn.
Burning Oil (recharge 6). Every creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 20 Dexterity save. On failure it takes 52 (15d6) fire damage and is coated in burning oil. The oil deals 10 (3d6) fire damage at the start of each of the coated creature’s turns. A creature can use an action to clear the oil from itself or a creature it can reach. Success halves the initial damage and prevents the oil from sticking.
sections.Bonus Actions: Destructive Rollout. Move up to the engine’s speed in a straight line. It destroys mundane walls under 10 ft. thick and any unattended Medium or smaller mundane object in its path. It treats spaces occupied by other creatures as difficult terrain during this movement. A creature whose space it enters must pass a DC 20 Dexterity save or take 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage and fall Prone.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses just one of moving, taking an action, or taking a bonus action. If it becomes Dazed during that turn, the turn ends. It can still use extra actions granted by effects such as Haste or Action Surge. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, or Greater Restoration can clear the condition.
sections.Mundane Attacks (MCDM): For these resistances, a mundane attack uses neither magic nor psionics.

name: Ashyra
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Con +8, Int +7, Wis +9. Arcana +7, History +7, Perception +9, Religion +7. Resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to necrotic and poison damage and to Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, and Poisoned. Blindsight 120 ft., passive Perception 19. Speaks Common and has telepathy 60 ft.

sections.Traits:
Atonement (3/day). Ashyra can turn a failed saving throw into a success. She then ends Ancient Curse on one enemy within 120 ft. or becomes Dazed until the end of her next turn.
Mummy Dust. When Ashyra takes piercing or slashing damage, every creature within 5 ft. takes 9 (2d8) poison damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Desiccating Slam and Soul Fire, then use Ancient Curse.
Desiccating Slam. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. Until the start of Ashyra's next turn, the target's speed is 0 and it cannot regain HP.
Soul Fire (3rd-level spell). Ranged spell attack, +9 to hit, 60-ft. range, one target. Hit 20 (3d10 + 4) radiant damage. A creature's HP maximum also drops by the damage taken until it finishes a long rest or receives Cure Ailment of 4th order or higher, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect. The creature dies if its HP maximum reaches 0.
Ancient Curse. One creature Ashyra sees within 120 ft. must pass a DC 17 Wisdom save or its attacks deal half damage. The curse lasts until she ends it or it is lifted by Cure Ailment, Remove Curse, or similar supernatural magic.
sections.Bonus Actions: Misty Step (2nd-level spell). Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space.
sections.Reactions: Weight of Ages. When a creature Ashyra sees within 60 ft. damages her, it must pass a DC 17 Strength save or become Restrained until the end of its next turn.
sections.Villain Actions:
Use each once per encounter, in any order, at the end of an enemy's turn. Use at most one per round.
1. Sands of the Ancients. The area within 15 ft. of Ashyra is heavily obscured until the end of her next turn. A creature that starts its turn there or first enters the area on a turn makes a DC 17 Constitution save, taking 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on a failure.
2. Dust to Dust. Attack each enemy within 60 ft. with Desiccating Slam, then reform in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. of Ashyra's starting position.
3. Last Rites. Each enemy within 30 ft. makes a DC 17 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and is sealed in stone. A success halves the damage and avoids the entombment. A trapped creature is Restrained, has total cover from outside attacks and effects, and takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage at the end of each of its turns. Destroy the stone to free the creature. The stone has AC 17 and 30 HP and is immune to poison and psychic damage.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses just one of moving, taking an action, or taking a bonus action. If the creature becomes Dazed during its turn, the turn ends. It still receives any extra actions granted by effects such as Haste or Action Surge. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, or Greater Restoration can clear the condition.
sections.Lair: Ashyra's underground tower holds books, scrolls, and arcane equipment. It guards a chamber where a hundred sorcerer-sovereigns lie buried. Seals close off the necropolis from the surface.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Tomb of the Keeper, p. 170, area M5. A DC 20 Charisma (Deception or Persuasion) check can convince Ashyra to bargain for an empyrean stag's heart. If she decides the party is useless to her, she attacks and fights until destroyed.

name: Lich (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Str +11, Con +10, Wis +10, Cha +12. Arcana +11, Athletics +11, Deception +12, History +11, Perception +10, Stealth +9. Resists necrotic damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to poison damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, and Stunned. Truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 20. Speaks Abyssal, Common, Draconic, and Infernal.

sections.Traits:
Rejuvenation. The destroyed lich takes refuge in its soulstone if it is intact. A creature that can see the occupied stone at the start of its turn must pass a DC 20 Charisma save or become Charmed by the stone until the end of its next turn. The Charmed creature tries its hardest to reach and touch the stone while avoiding obvious hazards. Any creature that touches the occupied stone makes a DC 20 Constitution save. On a failure, the toucher drops to 0 HP and the lich returns at full HP. On a success, the toucher loses half its current HP and the lich returns at half HP. Either way, the lich reforms in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the stone. The stone has AC 19, 50 HP, and immunity to every damage type except force and thunder.
Supernatural Resistance. The lich has advantage on saves against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.
Turn Immunity. Effects that turn Undead have no effect on the lich.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Glare of Undeath and make four attacks in any combination of Biting Acid, Disruptive Thunder, and Pain of Ages.
Biting Acid (3rd-level spell). Ranged spell attack, +12 to hit, 120-ft. range, one target. Hit 22 (5d8) acid damage. The target cannot regain HP until the start of the lich's next turn.
Disruptive Thunder (3rd-level spell). Melee or ranged spell attack, +12 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 60-ft. range, one target. Hit 22 (4d10) thunder damage. Move a Huge or smaller target up to 45 ft. horizontally.
Pain of Ages (3rd-level spell). Melee or ranged spell attack, +12 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 90-ft. range, one creature. Hit 21 (6d6) psychic damage. The first attack the target lands before the start of the lich's next turn deals half damage.
Glare of Undeath. One visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 20 Wisdom save. On failure it clutches itself and becomes Restrained for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. A creature it hears and understands can use an action to end the effect with a successful DC 20 Charisma (Persuasion) check.
Horrid Woe (2/day). One visible creature within 90 ft. makes a DC 20 Constitution save, taking 61 (7d8 + 30) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. A target reduced to 0 HP becomes stable and cannot heal. Its spirit appears as a wraith in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the body. It obeys the lich's spoken commands and acts immediately after the lich on the same turn. When the lich or wraith is destroyed, the spirit returns to the body and the target can regain HP.
Life Absorption (1/day, 9th-level spell, concentration). Each enemy within 120 ft. makes a DC 20 Constitution save. On a failure, for 1 minute the enemy takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The lich gains temporary HP equal to the total damage dealt.
sections.Bonus Actions: Necrotic Form (3rd-level spell). Become a shadow and move up to the lich's speed. In this form, the lich is immune to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and to Grappled and Restrained, and can pass through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. The form ends at the end of its turn.
sections.Reactions: Immortal Insight. When another visible creature rolls an attack, ability check, or saving throw, the lich can impose advantage or disadvantage.
sections.Utility Spells: Charisma, spell save DC 20. At will: Arcane Lock, Charm Person, Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Identify, Locate Object, Mage Hand. Three times per day each: Arcane Eye, Arcanist's Magic Aura, Contact Other Plane, Legend Lore, Scrying. Once per day each: Forbiddance, Geas, Hallow, Mirage Arcane, Symbol. Identify, Contact Other Plane, Legend Lore, Scrying, and the once-per-day spells use their listed casting times. The others take 1 action.
sections.Lair Actions:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one option. Do not repeat an option on consecutive rounds.
Soul Sip. Two visible enemies within 90 ft. each make a DC 20 Constitution save, taking 19 (3d12) necrotic damage on a failure.
Spirit Shell. Until the end of initiative count 20 on the next round, anyone who hits the lich with a melee attack must pass a DC 20 Wisdom save or be Dazed until the start of their next turn.
Unnatural Born Leader. One visible creature within 90 ft. makes a DC 20 Charisma save. On a failure, it uses its reaction, if available, to move up to its speed and make a weapon attack against a creature the lich chooses.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses just one of moving, taking an action, or taking a bonus action. If the creature becomes Dazed during its turn, the turn ends. It still receives any extra actions granted by effects such as Haste or Action Surge. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, or Greater Restoration can clear the condition.

name: Rot Angel
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Con +5, Cha +6. Perception +6. Resists necrotic and radiant damage. Immune to Charmed, Flanked, and Frightened. Blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 16. Understands Celestial without speaking it and has telepathy 120 ft.

sections.Traits: Flyby. Flying out of an enemy's reach does not provoke opportunity attacks.
sections.Actions: Decaying Touch. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 18 (4d8) necrotic damage, or 36 (8d8) against a corpse or Undead. A target also bears a mark for 24 hours. If it drops to 0 HP during that time, it immediately fails one death save. Multiple marks do not stack.
sections.Bonus Actions: Hypnotic Beam. One creature the angel sees within 60 ft. must pass a DC 14 Wisdom save or spend its reaction, if available, to move as far toward the angel as its speed allows without crossing clearly dangerous ground.
sections.Reactions: Radiant Puff. When an attack hits the angel, every creature within 10 ft. must pass a DC 14 Constitution save or be Blinded until the end of the angel's next turn.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Coronal Hollow, p. 237, area B2. The acidic swamp does not count as obvious danger for Hypnotic Beam. Four rot angels patrol it. If they fight, six empowered bog bodies surface at the start of round two.

name: Mycete
otherStatistics: Leather armor and shield. Saving throws Int +2, Wis +5. Insight +5, Nature +2, Perception +5, Survival +5. Resists fire damage and is immune to necrotic damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15. Speaks Common and Infernal.

sections.Traits: Necrotic Absorption. When Mycete would take necrotic damage, she regains that many HP instead.
sections.Actions:
Parasitic Spores. Melee or ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 30-ft. range, one target. Hit 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. Mycete heals 3 (1d6) HP if the target is a creature.
Fungal Growth. Pick a visible point within 60 ft. Solid surfaces in a 10-ft. square centered there become difficult terrain. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must pass a DC 13 Constitution save or be Poisoned for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Animate Husks (1/day). Three Rotting Zombies appear in unoccupied spaces Mycete can see within 30 ft. They go immediately after her on the same initiative count, obey her spoken commands, and perish if she dies.
sections.Bonus Actions: Spore Eruption. Destroy a Rotting Zombie under Mycete's control. Each enemy within 5 ft. of it makes a DC 13 Constitution save, taking 9 (2d8) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Utility Spells: Wisdom, spell save DC 13. At will: Druidcraft. Three times per day: Locate Animals or Plants. Once per day each: Fog Cloud, Pass Without Trace. Each takes 1 action.
sections.Villain Party Actions: Grave Order action 4, Fungal Paradise. Use once per encounter after an enemy's turn while Mycete is present and not Incapacitated. The Grave Order uses at most one villain party action per round. Mycete destroys any number of her visible Rotting Zombies within 30 ft. Each explodes in a 10-ft.-radius sphere. Every creature within one or more explosions makes one DC 13 Constitution save, taking 5 (2d4) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. The ground in each sphere gains the effects of Fungal Growth. If Mycete controls no Rotting Zombies within 30 ft., she uses Animate Husks instead without spending or needing a use.

name: Treant (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Nature +4, Survival +8. Tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 14. Speaks Common, Druidic, and Sylvan.

sections.Traits: False Appearance. An unmoving treant looks just like an ordinary tree.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Thorned Tendril attacks.
Thorned Tendril. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, 15-ft. reach, one target. Hit 19 (4d6 + 5) piercing damage and Grappled, escape DC 15. The target is Restrained and takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns while the grapple lasts.
Swinging Tendrils (recharge 6). Each creature already Grappled by the treant takes 26 (4d12) bludgeoning damage. The treant can move each of them to a visible unoccupied space within 15 ft. of itself. Each other creature within 15 ft. of the treant makes a DC 17 Dexterity save and takes 26 (4d12) bludgeoning damage for each creature the treant has Grappled, or half on a success.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Healing Growth (1/day). Each creature the treant chooses within 30 ft. regains 17 (3d8 + 4) HP.
Reel and Wrap. Pull one Grappled creature up to 10 ft. closer. It cannot speak until the grapple ends.
sections.Utility Spells: Wisdom, spell save DC 16. At will: Speak with Animals and Speak with Plants. Both take 1 action.

name: Treant Sapling (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Tremorsense 15 ft., passive Perception 13. Speaks Common, Druidic, and Sylvan.

sections.Traits:
False Appearance. A sapling that stays still passes for an ordinary tree.
Grove Strength. When a non-minion ally lands an attack, the target takes 2 extra slashing damage for each sapling within 5 ft. of it.
sections.Actions: Claws (group attack). Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 5 slashing damage.

name: Principle of Growth
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Str +10, Wis +8. Animal Handling +8, Nature +10, Survival +8. Immune to Charmed and Frightened. Darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 13. Speaks Common and Primordial.

sections.Traits: Regeneration. At the start of its turn, the principle heals 20 HP if it is not Incapacitated. After taking fire damage, it heals only 10 HP at the start of its next turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Hampering Roots attacks or two Vernal Lash attacks.
Hampering Roots. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 23 (4d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage and Grappled, escape DC 15. The target is Restrained while Grappled this way.
Vernal Lash. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, 60-ft. reach, one target. Hit 27 (4d10 + 5) slashing damage. Move the target up to 15 ft. horizontally.
Burst from the Earth (1/day). Grow three Large trees in visible unoccupied spaces within 60 ft. Each has AC 15, 40 HP, and immunity to psychic damage. An enemy that starts its turn within 15 ft. of one of the trees makes a DC 18 Dexterity save, taking 14 (4d6) slashing damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Convocation of Verdure (2/day). Choose the principle itself or an Elemental it can see within 30 ft. That Elemental chooses one effect.
Roots of the Mind. For 1 minute the Elemental can connect to each Large or larger plant object it sees within 90 ft. without using an action. It can perceive, attack, or take actions from any linked plant's space as if it were there.
Thorn Eruption. Each visible enemy within 30 ft. of the Elemental makes a DC 16 Dexterity save. On a failure it takes 27 (6d8) piercing damage and is Restrained until the end of its next turn. On a success it takes half damage and avoids the condition.

name: Dirt Mournling
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Str +12, Con +11, Cha +6. Athletics +12, Perception +7. Immune to cold, fire, and poison damage and to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, and Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 17. Understands its creator's languages and cannot speak.

sections.Traits:
Anguish Unleashed. When the mournling dies, each creature within 30 ft. that can hear it makes a DC 19 Wisdom save, taking 22 (4d10) psychic damage on a failure or half on a success.
Immutable Form. Spells, powers, and other effects cannot change the mournling's form.
Puddle of Mud. When the mournling leaves a space, the ground there is difficult terrain for its enemies for 10 minutes.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Slam and Mudslide. The mournling can also use Dust Storm if available.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage and Grappled, escape DC 20. The target is Restrained while Grappled this way.
Mudslide. Ranged weapon attack, +12 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A Huge or smaller creature hit by it is pulled up to 30 ft. toward the mournling, as is each Huge or smaller creature the mournling chooses within 5 ft. of that target.
Dust Storm (1/day). Each creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 19 Constitution save or becomes Blinded for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.
sections.Bonus Actions: Break and Reform. Teleport to a visible unoccupied space within 30 ft.
sections.Reactions: Stuck Fast. When a melee weapon attack hits the mournling, it can trap the striking weapon in mud and disarm the attacker. A creature within reach of the weapon can spend an action or bonus action to free it with a DC 19 Strength (Athletics) check. Natural weapons cannot trigger this reaction.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Boughs of Eternity, p. 303, area L1. The Dirt Mournling in Willow's Welcome is Large. It emerges when combat starts and fights until destroyed or ordered to stop by the dryads. Use the standard stat block's other values.

name: Flesh Mournling
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Str +7, Con +7. Athletics +7, Perception +4. Immune to Charmed, Frightened, and Exhaustion. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 14. Understands its creator's languages and cannot speak.

sections.Traits:
Horrid Sob. An enemy that hears the mournling and begins its turn within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Frightened of the mournling until the start of its next turn. On a success, it is immune to Horrid Sob from all flesh mournlings for 24 hours.
Immutable Form. Spells, powers, and other effects cannot change the mournling's form.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Creatures Frightened of the mournling also fall Prone.
Agonizing Wail (recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 30-ft. cone that can hear the mournling makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage and cannot see beyond 5 ft. until the end of its next turn. On a success it takes half damage and its sight is unaffected.

name: Thornblood
otherStatistics: Saving throws Con +9, Wis +9. Resists cold and lightning damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to poison and psychic damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Flanked, Frightened, Grappled, Poisoned, Prone, and Stunned. Blindsight 120 ft., passive Perception 13. Speaks Sylvan.

sections.Traits:
Corpse Retreat (1/day). When reduced to 0 HP, the thornblood drops to 1 HP instead and withdraws into the Medium Humanoid corpse it grew from. It becomes immune to all damage through the end of its next turn. It is Medium, both speeds become 60 ft., and it loses access to Throttle and Overgrowth until it finishes a long rest.
Overgrowth. The thornblood passes through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. It can share spaces with other creatures.
Supernatural Resistance. The thornblood has advantage on saves against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make four attacks in any combination of Vinerip and Throttle.
Vinerip. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, 30-ft. reach, one target. Hit 20 (4d6 + 6) bludgeoning plus 11 (2d10) piercing damage. Pull the target up to 30 ft. closer.
Throttle. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, 0-ft. reach, one target in the thornblood's space. Hit 20 (4d6 + 6) piercing damage and entangled. The entangled target is Restrained, moves with the thornblood, cannot see beyond its space, and takes 20 (4d6 + 6) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. The target or a creature within 5 ft. of it can use an action to take 20 (4d6 + 6) slashing damage and attempt a DC 20 Strength check, freeing the target on a success.
From Life, Lightning (2/day). Requires at least one entangled creature. Each entangled creature makes a DC 20 Constitution save, taking 55 (10d10) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Then each enemy within 60 ft. that is not entangled makes a DC 20 Dexterity save, taking 55 (10d10) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Bonus Actions: You're Mine. Move one creature entangled by the thornblood to a space it occupies that contains no other creature or object.
sections.Reactions: Hostile Roots. An enemy that ends its turn in the thornblood's space must pass a DC 17 Dexterity save or fall Prone.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Boughs of Eternity, p. 306, area L6. The thornblood bursts out of the vine-covered corpse and attacks when a living creature comes within 5 ft. of the bodies. A vampire awakens at the same time.

name: Halorin Yandres
otherStatistics: Breastplate and shield. Saving throws Str +5, Con +4. Skills Athletics +5, Intimidation +2, Perception +3. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 13. Common and Elvish.

sections.Traits:
Aura of Command. Halorin and any Undead within 30 ft. of him have advantage on saves against effects that turn Undead.
Pendant of Grave Regeneration. Halorin regains 5 HP at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Shield Slam attack and one Mace attack. A creature hit by both has disadvantage on attacks against anyone other than Halorin until the end of its next turn.
Mace. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Shield Slam. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. The target falls Prone on a failed DC 13 Strength save.
sections.Reactions: Unyielding Protection. When a willing ally within 5 ft. is hit by an attack, Halorin swaps spaces with the ally and takes the hit instead. Neither creature provokes opportunity attacks during the swap. Halorin must see both the ally and the attacker.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Grave Order. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy finishes its turn. It can use each action once per encounter, in any order. The creature performing the action must be present and able to act (not Incapacitated).
Action 2, Forward Assault. Each allied Undead minion within 30 ft. that can hear Halorin can move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Lestheris Soldrei
otherStatistics: AC 15 with Mage Armor. Saving throws Int +6, Wis +4. Skills Arcana +6, History +6, Investigation +6, Persuasion +3. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 12. Common and Elvish.

sections.Traits:
Charm Resistant. Lestheris has advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed.
Dark Calling. Other creatures within 30 ft. of Lestheris have disadvantage on death saving throws.
Tome of the Ethereal. Lestheris sees 120 ft. into the Ethereal Plane.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Grave Grasp attacks or two Necrotic Lance attacks.
Grave Grasp (cantrip). Melee spell attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The target cannot regain HP until the start of Lestheris’s next turn.
Necrotic Lance (1st-level spell). Ranged spell attack +6, range 120 ft., one target. Hit 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. Lestheris can destroy a Shade she controls within 30 ft. to deal an extra 4 (1d8) necrotic damage to the target.
Animate Spirits (2/day). Animate two Shades in unoccupied spaces she can see within 30 ft. They act immediately after her on the same initiative count and follow her verbal commands. They are destroyed if she dies.
sections.Reactions: Ethereal Step (3/day). When a creature Lestheris can see within 60 ft. targets her with an attack, spell, or power while she is outside the Ethereal Plane, she can teleport up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space she can see or enter the Ethereal Plane. If she enters that plane, she returns at the start of her next turn to the space she left. If that space is occupied, she chooses a nearest unoccupied space.
sections.Utility Spells: Intelligence, save DC 14. At will: Mage Hand, Message, Minor Illusion. 3/day each: Detect Magic, Mage Armor. 1/day each: Knock, Speak with Dead. Each takes 1 action.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Grave Order. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy finishes its turn. It can use each action once per encounter, in any order. The creature performing the action must be present and able to act (not Incapacitated).
Action 5, The Tide of Death. For each enemy Lestheris can see within 30 ft., animate one Shade in an unoccupied space she can see within 30 ft. They follow the turn order, command, and destruction rules under Animate Spirits.

name: Jedar Pike
otherStatistics: Half plate. Saving throws Wis +4, Cha +4. Skills Insight +4, Perception +4, Religion +2. Passive Perception 14. Celestial and Common.

sections.Traits: Exploit Opening (3/day). The creature can gain advantage on an attack roll it makes.
sections.Actions:
Warhammer. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) necrotic damage.
Nameless Reach (2/day, 1st-level spell). Ranged spell attack +4, range 120 ft., one target. Hit 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. The next attack against the target before the end of Jedar’s next turn has advantage.
Animate Bones (1/day). Animate three Decrepit Skeletons in unoccupied spaces Jedar can see within 30 ft. They act immediately after Jedar on the same initiative count, follow his verbal commands, and are destroyed if he dies.
sections.Bonus Actions: Bone Shield. Destroy a Decrepit Skeleton Jedar controls to grant 7 (2d6) temporary HP to a creature he can see within 60 ft.
sections.Utility Spells: Wisdom, save DC 12. At will: Light and Thaumaturgy, each using 1 action. 1/day: Augury, using its normal casting time.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Grave Order. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy finishes its turn. It can use each action once per encounter, in any order. The creature performing the action must be present and able to act (not Incapacitated).
Action 1, Bulwark of Bone. Animate four Decrepit Skeletons using the placement, turn order, command, and destruction rules under Animate Bones.

name: Harlo Honeygrin
speed: 25 ft., fly 60 ft. in Shadow Form
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Saving throws Int +9, Cha +9. Skills Acrobatics +8, Arcana +9, Deception +12, Insight +4, Intimidation +9, Performance +12, Persuasion +9, Stealth +8. Passive Perception 11. Common, Dwarvish, Elvish, Halfling, Thieves’ Cant, and telepathy 120 ft.

sections.Traits:
Amethyst Die (3/day). Add 1d6 to an ability check, save, or attack roll. Harlo then takes psychic damage equal to twice the die result. Works in Shadow Form.
Fear Resistant. Harlo has advantage on saves to avoid or end Frightened.
Mind Link. Harlo can communicate telepathically with other Amethyst Knife bosses anywhere on his plane.
Telepathic Shroud. Divination spells and effects that sense emotions or read thoughts cannot affect Harlo.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Mind Splinter attacks.
Mind Splinter (1st-order power). Melee or ranged power attack +9, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit 20 (4d6 + 6) psychic damage. Harlo becomes Invisible to the target until the start of his next turn.
Shadow Form (1/day, 4th-order power, concentration). For 10 minutes, Harlo and his equipment become an amorphous shadow. He flies at 60 ft. and resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks. He has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can hide without cover. He can move through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. He cannot pick up or wield anything except his Amethyst Die.
sections.Bonus Actions:
I’m Over Here. Choose an enemy within 60 ft. Harlo must be able to see the enemy, and the enemy must be unable to see him. On a failed DC 17 Wisdom save, the enemy makes a weapon attack against a creature Harlo chooses.
Sneaky. Take the Hide action.
sections.Reactions: Shared Condition. When Harlo becomes Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned, he can transfer the condition for its remaining duration to a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 ft. who does not already have the condition or is immune to it. Harlo loses the condition. He can use this reaction even while Incapacitated.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Amethyst Knife. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy finishes its turn. It can use each action once per encounter, in any order. The creature performing the action must be present and able to act (not Incapacitated).
Action 5, Epilogue. Each enemy within 60 ft. makes a DC 17 Intelligence save. On a failure, the enemy takes 28 (8d6) psychic damage and is Dazed until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and avoids Dazed.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On a turn while Dazed, a creature can move, take an action, or take a bonus action. It chooses one. If it becomes Dazed on its turn, its turn ends. It can still take extra actions granted by abilities such as Haste or Action Surge. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can remove Dazed.

name: Lady Avalla Deseo
otherStatistics: AC 16 with Mage Armor. Saving throws Con +4, Int +7, Wis +2. Skills Arcana +7, History +7, Investigation +7. Passive Perception 10. Common.

sections.Traits:
Exploit Opening (3/day). The creature can gain advantage on an attack roll it makes.
Supernatural Resistance. Avalla has advantage on saves against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.
sections.Actions:
Lightning Lash (cantrip). Melee or ranged spell attack +7, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. Hit 15 (3d6 + 5) lightning damage. Avalla can move the target up to 15 ft. horizontally.
Iron Terror (1/day, 4th-level spell). Each enemy in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, the target takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage and is Frightened of every member of the High Command for 1 minute. The target can repeat the save at the end of each turn, ending the condition on a success.
Iron Shackles (1/day, 3rd-level spell, concentration). Center a 15-ft. square of animated chains on a point on the ground Avalla can see within 60 ft. The chains last for 1 minute. A creature entering the area for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there must make a DC 15 Dexterity save or become Restrained. It can repeat the save at the start of each turn to end the condition. While Restrained by the chains, it takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage at the end of each of its turns.
Iron Ring (2/day). Teleport to the Cyst. From inside the Cyst, teleport to a place the creature has visited.
sections.Reactions:
Escape Ring. While outside the Cyst, when an ally Avalla can see within 60 ft. drops to 0 HP, expend a use of Iron Ring to teleport to the Cyst with each willing ally within 60 ft. who is not Incapacitated.
Spellcasting Feedback. When a creature Avalla sees within 60 ft. casts a spell, it chooses either to cast the spell and then take 3 (1d6) psychic damage per spell level or let the spell fail, spending the slot and wasting the action.
sections.Utility Spells: Intelligence, save DC 15. At will: Light, Mage Hand, Message. 3/day each: Detect Magic, Mage Armor. 1/day each: Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Sending. Each takes 1 action.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Black Iron Pact. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy finishes its turn. It can use each action once per encounter, in any order. The creature performing the action must be present and able to act (not Incapacitated).
Action 3, Promised Storm. Target one creature Avalla can see within 90 ft., plus up to two other creatures she chooses within 30 ft. of the first. Each target makes a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Lord Erasmus Deseo
otherStatistics: Plate. Saving throws Str +7, Con +5, Wis +2. Skills Athletics +7, History +4, Intimidation +3. Passive Perception 10. Common.

sections.Traits:
Exploit Opening (3/day). The creature can gain advantage on an attack roll it makes.
Master Tactician. Erasmus chooses his place in initiative after all other combatants roll.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatsword attacks. Erasmus can replace one attack with I’m Right Here.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage. A creature hit has disadvantage on attacks against targets other than Erasmus until the end of its next turn.
I’m Right Here. Choose a creature Erasmus can see within 5 ft. that can hear him. On a failed DC 15 Wisdom save, it must use its reaction to attack Erasmus if the reaction is available. If it attacks, one ally within 30 ft. of Erasmus who is not Incapacitated can make a weapon attack against it without spending an action.
Iron Ring (2/day). Teleport to the Cyst. From inside the Cyst, teleport to a place the creature has visited.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Mark. Mark a creature Erasmus can see within 60 ft. until the start of his next turn. The first time an ally of Erasmus damages it on each turn, it takes an extra 3 (1d6) damage.
Reposition. Erasmus and each ally within 60 ft. who can hear him can move up to 5 ft. without provoking opportunity attacks.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Black Iron Pact. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy finishes its turn. It can use each action once per encounter, in any order. The creature performing the action must be present and able to act (not Incapacitated).
Action 5, Playtime’s Over. One member of the High Command within 60 ft. who can hear Erasmus can use its villain party action, even if it already used that action in this encounter.

name: Vivienn Dirroze
otherStatistics: Plate. Saving throws Str +11, Con +8, Cha +10. Skills Acrobatics +3, Athletics +11, Deception +10, Intimidation +10. Resists acid and necrotic damage. Blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 11. Common and Draconic.

sections.Traits:
Exploit Opening (3/day). The creature can gain advantage on an attack roll it makes.
Reckless. At the start of her turn, Vivienn can gain advantage on all melee weapon attacks she makes that turn. If she does, attacks against her have advantage until the start of her next turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Godslayer Axe attacks.
Godslayer Axe. Melee weapon attack +11, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (1d12 + 8) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage. A Celestial takes an extra 18 (4d8) necrotic damage.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Draconic Rage (3/day). For 1 minute or until Incapacitated, Vivienn becomes Large, gains +2 to weapon damage rolls and advantage on Strength checks and saves, and resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
Ravenous Bite (Draconic Rage only). Melee weapon attack +11, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (1d12 + 8) piercing damage. On a failed DC 19 Constitution save, the target is Frightened of Vivienn for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the condition.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Hallowed Dark. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy finishes its turn. It can use each action once per encounter, in any order. The creature performing the action must be present and able to act (not Incapacitated).
Action 5, Wrath of the Godslayer. Each enemy within 30 ft. makes a DC 19 Dexterity save. On a failure, the enemy takes 34 (4d12 + 8) slashing damage and falls Prone.

name: Canon Athenodorus
otherStatistics: Plate. Saving throws Con +4, Wis +7, Cha +3. Skills Athletics +7, Deception +3, Insight +7, Religion +4. Passive Perception 15. Common.

sections.Traits: Exploit Opening (3/day). The creature can gain advantage on an attack roll it makes.
sections.Actions:
Star of Iron. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, subtract 1d4 from its attack rolls and saves until the end of its next turn.
Iron Ring (2/day). Teleport to the Cyst. From inside the Cyst, teleport to a place the creature has visited.
Unholy Fire (2/day, 3rd-level spell). Center a 15-ft.-radius, 30-ft.-high cylinder on a point Athenodorus can see within 90 ft. Each enemy in it makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 14 (4d6) fire damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage, and Athenodorus moves it up to 15 ft. horizontally. On a success, it takes half damage and stays in place.
sections.Bonus Actions: Blessing of Ajax (2/day). One creature Athenodorus can see within 30 ft. regains 14 (2d8 + 5) HP. He can also end one of these conditions on the target: Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned.
sections.Utility Spells: Wisdom, save DC 15. At will: Light and Mending, each using 1 action as printed. 1/day each: Divination using 1 action and Glyph of Warding using its normal casting time.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Black Iron Pact. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy finishes its turn. It can use each action once per encounter, in any order. The creature performing the action must be present and able to act (not Incapacitated).
Action 2, Curse of Iron. Each enemy Athenodorus can see within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, the enemy takes 14 (4d6) necrotic damage and is Blinded for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each turn to end the condition. On a success, it takes half damage and avoids Blinded.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On a turn while Dazed, a creature can move, take an action, or take a bonus action. It chooses one. If it becomes Dazed on its turn, its turn ends. It can still take extra actions granted by abilities such as Haste or Action Surge. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can remove Dazed.

name: Vali
otherStatistics: Leather armor. Saving throws Dex +7, Wis +7, Cha +2. Skills Acrobatics +7, Perception +9, Stealth +9. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 19. Common, Elvish, and Sylvan.

sections.Traits:
Cloak and Dagger. Vali remains hidden after missing with a weapon attack.
Deft-Footed. Vali leaves tracks or other traces only if he chooses to.
Elf Glamour (1/day). When a creature targets Vali with an attack, a spell, or a power, he can force it to make a DC 15 Wisdom save without spending an action. On a failure, it is Charmed by Vali until the end of his next turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Shortsword attacks, or make two Waning Moon attacks and use Waning Moon Fade if available.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage.
Waning Moon. Ranged weapon attack +7, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage. A creature that cannot see Vali takes an extra 7 (2d6) force damage.
Waning Moon Fade (1/day). Become Invisible for 1 minute and take the Hide action. The effect ends when Vali attacks, casts a spell, or manifests a power.
sections.Bonus Actions: Nimble Escape. Take the Disengage or Hide action.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Wilderkith. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy finishes its turn. It can use each action once per encounter, in any order. The creature performing the action must be present and able to act (not Incapacitated).
Action 5, Suppressing Volley. Vali makes a ranged attack against each enemy he can see within 150 ft. Each member of the Inner Circle can move up to its speed and take the Hide action without spending an action.

name: Cloak
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Saving throws Dex +7, Con +4, Cha +4. Skills Acrobatics +7, Deception +4, Insight +3, Perception +3, Stealth +9. Passive Perception 13. Common.

sections.Traits: Exploit Opening (3/day). The creature can gain advantage on an attack roll it makes.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Shortsword attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage. The target is Poisoned until the start of Cloak’s next turn.
Light Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack +7, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage. The attack deals an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage to a creature that has not moved since the end of Cloak’s last turn.
Iron Ring (2/day). Teleport to the Cyst. From inside the Cyst, teleport to a place the creature has visited.
sections.Bonus Actions: Cunning Action. Take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.
sections.Reactions: You Should’ve Been Watching Me. When a creature within 5 ft. hits an ally of Cloak with an attack, Cloak can make a Shortsword attack against the creature if she can see both the attacker and the ally.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Black Iron Pact. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy finishes its turn. It can use each action once per encounter, in any order. The creature performing the action must be present and able to act (not Incapacitated).
Action 4, Assassin’s Strike. Cloak moves up to her speed and makes a Shortsword attack against a creature in reach. It deals 33 (6d10) piercing damage on a hit or half on a miss. The attack does not inflict Poisoned.

ruleNotes: Light Crossbow lists 8 damage and a roll of 1d8 + 5. The listed average and roll disagree.

name: Time Raider Archon
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Resists psychic damage. Immune to Blinded and Charmed. Darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 11. Common and Kuran'zoi.

sections.Traits:
Minion. Damage from an attack or a failed save drops this minion to 0 HP. Damage from another source kills it only if that instance meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise it takes no damage.
Psychic Scar. Immune to effects that detect emotions, read thoughts, tell whether the raider is lying, or reveal its alignment or location.
sections.Actions:
Brutal Flail (group attack). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 bludgeoning damage per participant. If at least two archons joined, the target makes a Constitution save with a DC of 10 plus the number of participants. Failure leaves it Dazed until the end of its next turn.
Blaster (group attack). Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit 3 radiant damage per participant.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses only one: move, take an action, or take a bonus action. Becoming Dazed during its turn ends that turn. Extra actions from effects such as Haste or Action Surge remain available. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can end Dazed. The GM can allow other remedies.

name: Time Raider Armiger
otherStatistics: Breastplate. Saves Str +5, Con +4, Int +5. Arcana +5, Athletics +5, Intimidation +2, Perception +3. Resists psychic damage. Immune to Blinded and Charmed. Darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 13. Common and Kuran'zoi.

sections.Traits: Psychic Scar. Immune to effects that detect emotions, read thoughts, tell whether the raider is lying, or reveal its alignment or location.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Serrated Saber or Blaster for each.
Serrated Saber. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage. The target has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of the armiger's next turn.
Blaster. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) radiant damage.
Concussive Slam (1st-order power). Choose a creature the armiger can see within 30 ft. If it fails a DC 13 Strength save, it takes 7 (3d4) force damage and falls Prone.
sections.Reactions: Sickening Sympathy (2nd-order power). When another creature the armiger can see within 30 ft. is hit by an attack, the attacker makes a DC 13 Constitution save. Failure leaves the attacker Poisoned until the end of its next turn.
sections.Psionics (MCDM): Powers are supernatural and need no components. Antimagic Field, Counterspell, and Dispel Magic do not affect them. The creature can use a power as a bonus action and still use a power of 2nd order or higher as its action.

name: Time Raider Nemesis
otherStatistics: Saves Str +7, Con +5, Int +7. Arcana +7, Athletics +7, Intimidation +6, Perception +4, Stealth +6. Resists psychic damage. Immune to Blinded and Charmed. Darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 14. Common, Kuran'zoi, and telepathy 60 ft.

sections.Traits:
Precog Reflexes. Add the nemesis's Intelligence modifier (+4) to its initiative and AC. The AC above already includes it.
Psychic Scar. Immune to effects that detect emotions, read thoughts, tell whether the raider is lying, or reveal its alignment or location.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Golden Scythe attacks. One attack can be replaced with Kinetic Crush or Phase when available.
Golden Scythe. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage. If this reduces an astral body to 0 HP, the creature's soul returns to its material body and that body also drops to 0 HP. This includes creatures using Astral Projection.
Kinetic Crush (4th-order power). One visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 27 (6d8) force damage and its speed drops to 0 until the start of the nemesis's next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and keeps its speed.
Phase (1/day, 4th-order power, concentration). For up to 1 minute, the nemesis can move through creatures and objects as difficult terrain. If it ends a turn inside an object, it takes 5 (1d10) force damage. If Phase ends while it is inside an object, it chooses a nearest unoccupied space and appears there.
sections.Bonus Actions: Jaunt (3/day, 3rd-order power). Teleport up to 30 ft. into an unoccupied space the nemesis can see.
sections.Psionics (MCDM): Powers are supernatural and need no components. Antimagic Field, Counterspell, and Dispel Magic do not affect them. The creature can use a power as a bonus action and still use a power of 2nd order or higher as its action.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: The White Tower, p. 140, area X3. If Vor'pat trusts the party or sees it attack Xorannox, xe can join it using the time raider freebooter profile. If the party fails both the trust check and the bluff at the entrance, xe attacks using the nemesis profile.

name: Time Raider Vertex
otherStatistics: Psionic power armor. Saves Str +7, Con +6, Int +7. Athletics +10, Perception +9. Resists psychic damage. Immune to Blinded, Charmed, and Prone. Blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 19. Common, Kuran'zoi, and telepathy 120 ft.

sections.Traits: Psychic Scar. Immune to effects that detect emotions, read thoughts, tell whether the raider is lying, or reveal its alignment or location.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Psionic Slam attacks.
Psionic Slam. Melee power attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage. The next attack against the target before the start of the vertex's next turn has advantage.
Split Space (2/day). Choose a precise spot the vertex has seen on any plane. A portal 10 ft. across opens in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the vertex. Anyone who touches it immediately teleports to the unoccupied space closest to the destination. The portal ends when the vertex dies, opens another portal, spends an action to close it, or travels through it.
sections.Bonus Actions: Invigorated March (3rd-order power). Each time raider within 60 ft. of the vertex can spend its reaction to move up to half its speed.
sections.Reactions: Kinetic Defense Field. When another Medium or smaller creature within 120 ft. takes damage, the vertex can reduce the damage by 15 if it can see that creature.
sections.Psionics (MCDM): Powers are supernatural and need no components. Antimagic Field, Counterspell, and Dispel Magic do not affect them. The creature can use a power as a bonus action and still use a power of 2nd order or higher as its action. The vertex can use Psionic Slam when its foe provokes an opportunity attack.

name: Troll Limbjumble
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Blindsight 30 ft. and blind beyond that range, passive Perception 7. Understands Giant and cannot speak.

sections.Traits: Minion. Damage from an attack or a failed save drops this minion to 0 HP. Damage from another source kills it only if that instance meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise it takes no damage.
sections.Actions: Arm and a Leg (group attack). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 2 bludgeoning damage per participant. A Medium or smaller target falls Prone if at least three limbjumbles joined the attack.
sections.Encounter Options: To add limbjumbles to a troll encounter, have one form whenever a troll takes at least 10 slashing damage from a single attack or effect.

name: Troll Whelp
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Save Con +8. Athletics +7, Perception +2. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Giant.

sections.Traits:
Minion. Damage from an attack or a failed save drops this minion to 0 HP. Damage from another source kills it only if that instance meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise it takes no damage.
Relentless Hunger. The whelp stays conscious and can act normally when damage other than acid or fire brings it to 0 HP. It dies if it ends its turn at 0 HP, if acid or fire drops it to 0 HP, or if acid or fire damages it while at 0 HP.
Ripping Claws. Medium or smaller enemies treat spaces within reach of one or more whelps as difficult terrain. An enemy takes 2 slashing damage when it leaves the reach of one or more whelps that can see it.
sections.Actions: Bite (group attack). Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 piercing damage per participant. Every participating whelp heals to full HP if the target is neither a Construct, an Elemental, nor a Plant.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Shtriga Nonna’s Hut, p. 48. Four whelps sleep with Gorfus. Crossing or searching the room takes a DC 13 group Dexterity (Stealth) check. Opening the tent calls for an individual DC 17 Dexterity (Stealth) check.

name: Stirge (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Stealth +5. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. No languages.

sections.Traits: Tiny Target. If nonpsychic damage reduces the stirge to 0 HP while it is attached, its host takes half the damage dealt to the stirge.
sections.Actions:
Proboscis. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 3 piercing damage. The stirge may attach to the target and enter its space. While attached, it moves with the target and cannot use Proboscis. Any creature in reach of the stirge can use an action to detach it. It then enters a nearest unoccupied space of its choice. Becoming Grappled, Incapacitated, Prone, or Restrained also detaches it.
Drain Essence. The stirge's host loses 3 HP and makes a DC 12 Constitution save unless it is a Construct or an Undead. On a failure, it is Poisoned until the end of the stirge's next turn. If it was already Poisoned, it is also Dazed until then.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses only one: move, take an action, or take a bonus action. Becoming Dazed during its turn ends that turn. Extra actions from effects such as Haste or Action Surge remain available. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can end Dazed. The GM can allow other remedies.

name: Stirge Broodling
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 9. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Minion. Damage from an attack or a failed save drops this minion to 0 HP. Damage from another source kills it only if that instance meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise it takes no damage.
Tiny Target. If nonpsychic damage drops an attached broodling to 0 HP, its host takes 1 damage of the same type.
sections.Actions:
Proboscis (group attack). Melee or ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 1 piercing damage per participant. Each participating broodling may attach to the target and enter its space. An attached broodling moves with the target and cannot use Proboscis. The target or a creature that can reach it may spend an action or bonus action to detach every broodling on it. Each detached broodling chooses a nearest unoccupied space. Becoming Grappled, Incapacitated, Prone, or Restrained also detaches it.
Drain Essence. A host that is neither a Construct nor an Undead loses 1 HP.

ruleNotes: The printed Proboscis lists a 5-ft. reach and gives no separate ranged distance. Use the listed 5 ft. at the table.

name: Dragonet (Familiar Variant)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Arcana +4, Insight +3, Perception +3. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13. Speaks Draconic.

sections.Traits:
Arcane Acumen. Gain advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks to learn about visible supernatural effects and objects. The dragonet always knows when something senses its emotions or reads its thoughts, or when a divination spell targets or observes it.
True Words. Gain advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to detect lies spoken in Draconic.
Familiar. The dragonet can enter a telepathic bond with a willing companion. While the pair are within 1 mile, the companion can perceive what the dragonet perceives. When the dragonet uses Truesight, the companion shares that Truesight while touching the dragonet. Either creature can break the bond at any time.
sections.Actions:
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing.
Revealing Breath (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). Light coats every object in a 15-ft. cone for 1 minute. A creature in the cone is also outlined for 1 minute unless it succeeds on a DC 13 Dexterity save. Outlined targets shed dim light for 5 ft. and cannot benefit from being Invisible. Attacks against an outlined target have advantage if the attacker can see it. By looking at an outlined target that bears magic, the dragonet can identify the school, if any.
Truesight (Recharges after a Long Rest). Gain Truesight out to 60 ft. for 1 minute.

name: Manticore (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Perception +3, Stealth +5. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13. Understands one language and speaks through Mimicry.

sections.Traits:
Agile Predator. A creature the manticore hits on its own turn cannot make opportunity attacks against it for the rest of that turn.
Mimicry. Repeat heard speech in a language the manticore understands. A listener can identify the imitation with a DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claw attack, or two Tail Spike attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage. A creature Frightened of the manticore takes another 4 (1d8) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage. The manticore can move the target up to 5 ft. horizontally.
Tail Spike. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage. On a failed DC 13 Constitution save, the target is Poisoned until the end of its next turn.
sections.Bonus Actions: Trumpeting Howl (1/day). Each enemy within 120 ft. that hears the howl makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Frightened of the manticore for 1 minute and can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect. If the initial save fails by 5 or more, the creature is also Dazed while Frightened this way.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses only one: move, take an action, or take a bonus action. Becoming Dazed during its turn ends that turn. Extra actions from effects such as Haste or Action Surge remain available. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can end Dazed. The GM can allow other remedies.

name: Ashen Hoarder
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Immune to necrotic and poison damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Understands the languages of its creator but cannot speak.
description: Necromancers use this spiked construct to retrieve corpses for their work.

sections.Traits: Corpse Carrier. Start with 6 corpses or roll 1d6 + 3. Corpse Bomb and Create Zombies spend these corpses.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Arm attacks. If both hit the same creature, the hoarder can use Impale on that creature.
Arm. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, chosen by the hoarder.
Impale. One Large or smaller creature the hoarder sees within 10 ft. makes a DC 17 Strength save. On a failure, the creature takes 16 (3d10) piercing damage and becomes Restrained. At the start of each of its turns, it takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage. If this damage reduces it to 0 HP, it dies and joins the corpse supply. A creature can use an action and pass a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check to free itself or someone it can reach. Destroying the hoarder releases everyone it has impaled.
Corpse Bomb. Hurl and destroy one corpse up to 60 ft. away. Creatures in a 20-ft.-radius sphere centered on it make a DC 17 Constitution save. On a failure, they take 33 (6d10) necrotic damage and cannot regain HP until the start of the hoarder's next turn. On a success, they take half damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Create Zombies. Drop any number of carried corpses. Each becomes a zombie in an unoccupied space within 10 ft. and acts immediately after the hoarder.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses one of these options: move, take an action, or take a bonus action. If it becomes Dazed during its turn, its turn ends. Extra actions from effects such as Haste and Action Surge still apply. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect can end this condition.

ruleNotes: Impale prints “Larger or smaller,” which is interpreted here as Large or smaller.

name: Atæshia
otherStatistics: Saving throws Con +12, Wis +13. Arcana +13, Deception +13, History +13, Nature +13, Perception +13, Persuasion +13, Religion +13. Resists cold, necrotic, poison, psychic, and radiant damage. Immune to fire damage and to Charmed, Frightened, and Poisoned. Blindsight 120 ft., passive Perception 23. Speaks all languages.
description: The Queen of Ash moves as a cloud of ashes and can return through a death near where she fell.

sections.Traits:
Offer to Remembrance (3/day). After Atæshia fails a save, a willing creature within 60 ft. that sees her may die immediately to turn her failure into a success.
Reborn From War. At 0 HP she collapses into ash. For the next 100 years, if a Celestial, Elemental, or Humanoid of CR or level 5 or higher dies within 60 ft. of that spot, she returns there with 25 HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Pale Flame attacks. One can be replaced by Moment of Loss if available.
Pale Flame. Melee or ranged spell attack, +13 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 120-ft. range, one target. Hit 20 (4d6 + 6) radiant plus 14 (4d6) fire damage. A creature reduced to 0 HP by this attack dies and leaves no remains.
Moment of Loss (recharge 6). Turn one creature she sees within 60 ft. into ash. While ash, the target is immune to damage, provides no cover, and cannot take reactions. The target reforms at the start of its next turn and makes a DC 21 Constitution save. On a failure, its HP falls to 1. On a success, it takes 44 (8d10) necrotic damage, which cannot reduce it below 1 HP.
From Death, Life (1/day). Use Kindled Sacrifice with Atæshia as the sacrifice, even if that villain action is unavailable.
sections.Bonus Actions: Flickering Flame. Teleport into a visible unoccupied space within 60 ft. Creatures within 5 ft. of the point she left take 5 (1d10) fire damage on a failed DC 21 Dexterity save.
sections.Reactions: Convocation of Ash. When an attack hits another Elemental she sees within 60 ft., halve its damage. The Elemental can move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
sections.Villain Actions:
Each action is available once per encounter, after an enemy finishes a turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
1. Wave of Sorrow. Each enemy she sees within 120 ft. makes a DC 21 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Dazed for 1 minute and repeats the save at the end of its turns. On a success, it cannot take reactions until the end of its next turn.
2. Kindled Sacrifice. A willing creature within 60 ft. dies. Up to two other dead creatures within 60 ft. of that creature return to life. Each regains the HP the sacrificed creature had, capped at its own HP maximum.
3. Life's Finale. Each enemy within 60 ft. makes a DC 21 Charisma save. On a failure, it takes 55 (10d10) necrotic damage and cannot regain HP until the end of Atæshia's next turn. A success halves the damage. A creature reduced to 0 HP by this effect immediately fails one death save.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses one of these options: move, take an action, or take a bonus action. If it becomes Dazed during its turn, its turn ends. Extra actions from effects such as Haste and Action Surge still apply. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect can end this condition.

name: Goxomoc
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Dex +9, Int +15, Wis +17. Arcana +15, Athletics +19, History +15, Perception +17. Immune to fire, lightning, poison, and thunder, to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks, and to Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Flanked, Frightened, Poisoned, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Stunned. Truesight 300 ft., passive Perception 27. Understands all languages but cannot speak. Telepathy 150 ft.
description: The titan sleeps under an active volcano. If its flesh falls, the storm form Xogomoc rises.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. Breathes air and water.
Earthbinder. Enemies within 60 ft. cannot fly. Goxomoc moving within 60 ft. of a flying enemy causes it to fall.
Lightning Lord. At 0 HP, Goxomoc becomes Xogomoc. Conditions and other supernatural effects affecting him carry over.
Psionic Resistance (3/day). Turn his failed save into a success. He cannot use Energy Eyes or Shockwave until the end of his next turn.
Psionic Weapons. His weapon attacks are psionic.
Siege Monster. His damage against objects and structures is doubled.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use one Bite, two Claws, one Stomp, and Energy Eyes.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +19 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 36 (4d12 + 10) piercing damage and Grappled (escape DC 20). The grapple also Restrains the target and prevents Goxomoc from biting a different target. A creature reduced to 0 HP by the damage dies, and he consumes its remains.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +19 to hit, 15-ft. reach, one target. Hit 21 (2d10 + 10) slashing damage. Goxomoc moves the target up to 10 ft. horizontally.
Stomp. Melee weapon attack, +19 to hit, 15-ft. reach, one target he is not grappling. Hit 23 (2d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage and knocks Huge or smaller targets Prone.
Energy Eyes (3rd-order power). One creature he sees within 300 ft. makes a DC 25 Dexterity save. It takes 22 (4d10) fire or lightning damage, his choice, or half on a success.
Catastrophic Breath (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 90-ft. cone make DC 27 Dexterity saves. On a failure, each takes 71 (11d12) fire or lightning damage, his choice, and teleports to an unoccupied space he chooses in the cone. A success halves the damage and prevents the teleport.
sections.Bonus Actions: Shockwave (2nd-order power). Chosen creatures within 15 ft. make a DC 25 Strength save. On a failure, each takes 22 (4d10) force damage and is pushed up to 20 ft. directly away.
sections.Reactions: Volcanic Punishment. When damaged, Goxomoc teleports with creatures he is grappling into an unoccupied space he sees within 30 ft. Each creature within 10 ft. of the point he left makes a DC 27 Dexterity save, taking 22 (4d10) fire damage or half on a success.
sections.Villain Actions:
Each action is available once per encounter, after an enemy finishes a turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
1. Rumble. Unworn and uncarried mundane objects within 90 ft. take 55 (10d10) force damage. Creatures within 90 ft. fall Prone and make DC 27 Dexterity saves. Those who fail become embedded in the ground and Restrained. A creature can use an action to free itself or a creature it can reach with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.
2. Thunder. Teleport with creatures he is grappling to an unoccupied space he sees within 120 ft. Each creature within 30 ft. of either endpoint makes a DC 27 Constitution save, taking 22 (4d10) thunder damage or half on a success.
3. Eruption. Enemies within 120 ft. make DC 25 Wisdom saves. Failure deals 44 (8d10) psychic damage and makes them vulnerable to all damage from Goxomoc until the end of his next turn. A success halves the damage.
sections.Psionic Powers (MCDM): Psionic powers are supernatural effects and require no components. They are unaffected by effects that target only spells or magic, including Antimagic Field, Counterspell, and Dispel Magic.
sections.Flanked (MCDM): If using flanking rules, creatures cannot flank this creature.
sections.Mundane Attacks (MCDM): A mundane attack is one that uses neither magic nor psionics.

name: Xogomoc
otherStatistics: Saving throws Int +15, Wis +17. Arcana +15, History +15, Perception +17. Immune to lightning, poison, and thunder, to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks, and to Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Flanked, Frightened, Grappled, Poisoned, Paralyzed, Petrified, Restrained, and Stunned. Truesight 300 ft., passive Perception 27. Understands all languages but cannot speak. Telepathy 150 ft.
description: This living storm is the second form of Goxomoc. Defeating it returns the titan to his resting place.

sections.Traits:
Amorphous. Pass through a 1-inch opening without squeezing.
Discorporation. At 0 HP or death, end all conditions and other effects on him. He teleports to his resting place, returns to his Goxomoc form at full HP, and falls Unconscious.
Disruptive Resistance (3/day). Turn his failed save into a success. Lightning Aura shuts off until the end of his next turn.
Lightning Aura. A creature starting its turn within 60 ft. makes a DC 25 Dexterity save, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage or half on a success.
Power of the Storm. His lightning and thunder damage ignores resistance.
Siege Monster. He deals double damage to objects and structures.
Supernatural Resistance. He has advantage on saves against spells, powers, and other supernatural effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Lightning Strike attacks.
Lightning Strike. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +19 to hit, 15-ft. reach or 600-ft. range, one target. Hit 29 (3d12 + 10) lightning damage. A second target within 30 ft. of the first takes the same damage on a failed DC 27 Dexterity save.
Energy Flow. Move up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks. He can pass through creature spaces without treating them as difficult terrain. Each creature takes 22 (4d10) lightning damage the first time he crosses its space during this move.
Lightning Breath (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 90-ft. cone make DC 27 Dexterity saves. On a failure, take 71 (11d12) lightning damage and lose reactions until the end of their next turn. On a success, take half damage only.
sections.Bonus Actions: Gone in a Flash. Teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space he sees, bringing anyone inside him. Each creature within 10 ft. of the space he left makes a DC 25 Constitution save, taking 22 (4d10) thunder damage or half on a success.
sections.Reactions: Shock Cage. When a creature he sees within 30 ft. hits him with an attack, that creature takes 22 (4d10) lightning damage and is Restrained until the end of its next turn.
sections.Villain Actions:
Each action is available once per encounter, after an enemy finishes a turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
1. Thunderstruck. Creatures within 120 ft. that hear him make DC 25 Wisdom saves. Those who fail are Dazed for 1 minute and repeat the save at the end of their turns.
2. Into the Storm. Enemies he sees within 30 ft. make DC 25 Strength saves. On a success, they take 16 (3d10) lightning damage. On a failure, they are pulled inside him. There, they are Restrained, move with him, and have total cover from outside attacks and other effects. At the start of each of their turns they take 16 (3d10) lightning plus 16 (3d10) thunder damage. Each can escape into an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 ft. by using an action to pass a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. If he takes at least 60 damage in a single turn or falls to 0 HP, all trapped creatures are expelled to unoccupied spaces of their choice within 5 ft.
3. Behold True Power. Enemies within 120 ft. make DC 25 Strength saves. Failure deals 44 (8d10) lightning damage and moves them up to 60 ft. in any direction. A success halves the damage and keeps the target in place.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses one of these options: move, take an action, or take a bonus action. If it becomes Dazed during its turn, its turn ends. Extra actions from effects such as Haste and Action Surge still apply. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect can end this condition.
sections.Flanked (MCDM): If using flanking rules, creatures cannot flank this creature.
sections.Mundane Attacks (MCDM): A mundane attack is one that uses neither magic nor psionics.

name: High Mage Vairae
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Con +11, Int +14, Wis +13, Cha +13. Arcana +14, Athletics +10, Deception +13, History +14, Perception +13, Persuasion +13. Resists fire and cold and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to necrotic and poison damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, and Stunned. Truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 23. Speaks Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Elvish, Infernal, and Sylvan. Telepathy 120 ft.
description: The elven High Mage hides their lichdom. Their soulstone is a sphere of everlasting ice.

sections.Traits:
Draining Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed save into a success. Vairae then has disadvantage on spell attacks until the end of their next turn.
Rejuvenation (as the Lich). If destroyed with the soulstone intact, Vairae's soul enters it. A creature that can see the stone at the start of its turn makes a DC 20 Charisma save. On a failure, it is Charmed until the end of its next turn and must try to move toward and touch the stone, avoiding clear hazards. Touching the occupied stone forces a DC 20 Constitution save. On a failure, the creature drops to 0 HP and Vairae reforms at full HP. On a success, the creature loses half its HP and Vairae reforms at half HP. In either case Vairae appears in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the stone. The stone has AC 19, 50 HP, and immunity to every damage type except force and thunder.
Supernatural Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells, powers, and other supernatural effects.
Turn Immunity. Vairae is immune to effects that turn Undead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Glare of Undeath and make four attacks in any combination of Conflagration, Immortal Pain, and Magic Drain.
Conflagration (4th-level spell). Ranged spell attack, +14 to hit, 150-ft. range, one target. Hit 35 (10d6) fire damage. If the target takes both an action and a bonus action on its next turn, it takes 17 (5d6) more fire damage at the end of that turn.
Immortal Pain (4th-level spell). Melee or ranged spell attack, +14 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 90-ft. range, one creature. Hit 28 (8d6) psychic damage and afflicts the target with pain, halving the damage its attacks deal.
