After each attack it makes against an enemy, the target can end the effect with a successful DC 22 Constitution save. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect also ends the pain.
Magic Drain (4th-level spell). Melee or ranged spell attack, +14 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 60-ft. range, one creature. Hit 26 (4d12) necrotic damage. If the target is under the effects of spells Vairae did not cast, those effects end on a failed DC 22 Wisdom save.
Glare of Undeath. One creature Vairae sees within 60 ft. makes a DC 22 Wisdom save. On a failure, it clutches itself and is Restrained for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each turn. A creature the target can hear and understand can use an action to end the effect with a DC 22 Charisma (Persuasion) check.
Machinations of Bone (2/day). Choose a visible point within 150 ft. Every enemy within 30 ft. of that point makes a DC 22 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 54 (12d8) piercing damage, falls Prone, and cannot stand until it receives supernatural healing.
sections.Bonus Actions: Necrotic Form (3rd-level spell). Assume a shadow form and move up to their speed. Until the end of the turn, Vairae is immune to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and to Grappled and Restrained, and can pass through a 1-inch opening without squeezing.
sections.Reactions: Baleful Teleport (6th-level spell). When a visible creature within 120 ft. targets Vairae with an attack, the attacker makes a DC 22 Charisma save. On a failure, Vairae teleports the attacker up to 60 ft. into a visible unoccupied space. If Vairae is now an invalid target, the attacker must choose a new target or miss.
sections.Villain Actions:
Each action is available once per encounter, after an enemy finishes a turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
1. Cages of Wasting. Enemies within 60 ft. make DC 22 Dexterity saves. Failure deals 27 (5d10) necrotic damage and Restrains the target in a cage for up to 1 minute. A success halves the damage. A trapped target can repeat the save at the end of each turn or teleport out. Destroying Vairae also ends the restraint.
2. My Magic Alone. Creatures within 60 ft. make DC 22 Wisdom saves. A creature that fails cannot benefit from magic items or cast spells of 4th level or higher until the end of Vairae's next turn.
3. Necrostorm. Creatures within 60 ft. make DC 22 Dexterity saves, taking 78 (12d12) necrotic damage or half on a success. A Humanoid killed by this damage rises as a wraith at the start of Vairae's next turn, permanently following Vairae's verbal commands.
sections.Lair Actions:
On initiative 20, losing ties, use one effect. The same lair action cannot be used in consecutive rounds.
Soul Sip. Choose two visible enemies within 90 ft. Each takes 19 (3d12) necrotic damage on a failed DC 20 Constitution save.
Spirit Shell. Until the end of initiative count 20 of the next round, a creature hitting Vairae with a melee attack makes a DC 20 Wisdom save or is Dazed until the start of that creature's next turn.
Unnatural Born Leader. One visible creature within 90 ft. makes a DC 20 Charisma save. On a failure, it uses its reaction, if available, to move up to its speed and make a weapon attack against a creature Vairae chooses.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses one of these options: move, take an action, or take a bonus action. If it becomes Dazed during its turn, its turn ends. Extra actions from effects such as Haste and Action Surge still apply. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect can end this condition.
sections.Mundane Attacks (MCDM): A mundane attack is one that uses neither magic nor psionics.
sections.Printed source: Undead. Lair actions, p. 258. Stat block, p. 260.

ruleNotes: Machinations of Bone involves body horror. Spectral blades can describe the same effect at the table.

name: Kraken (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Con +16, Int +18, Wis +14. Arcana +18, History +18, Perception +14. Immune to cold, lightning, psychic, and thunder, to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks, and to Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Flanked, Frightened, Poisoned, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Stunned. Blindsight 120 ft., truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 24. Understands all languages but cannot speak. Telepathy 150 ft.
description: The Titan of the Mindstorm sleeps beneath the ocean east of Higara. It can hold and crush a ship with its mind.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. Breathes air and water.
Discorporation. At 0 HP or death, all conditions and other effects end. The Kraken teleports to its resting place, returns to life with full HP, and falls Unconscious.
Siege Monster. Deals double damage to objects and structures.
Slowed Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed save into a success. Each use reduces the Kraken's speed by a cumulative 10 ft. for 24 hours.
Supernatural Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells, powers, and other supernatural effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make four Tentacle attacks or use Mental Lance three times.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, 30-ft. reach, one target. Hit 19 (2d10 + 8) bludgeoning plus 11 (2d10) psychic damage and Grappled (escape DC 18). Each of its ten tentacles can grapple one target.
Mental Lance (3rd-order power). Ranged power attack, +18 to hit, 120-ft. range, one creature. Hit 22 (4d10) psychic damage and the target is Frightened of the Kraken until the start of the Kraken's next turn.
Psionic Storm. Restrain one vehicle the Kraken sees within 120 ft. The effect ends if its concentration breaks as for a spell or if the Kraken and the vehicle are more than 120 ft. apart. If three of the Kraken's turns end while the effect lasts, the vehicle drops to 0 HP and the effect ends.
Skull-Splitting Howl (1/day). Enemies within 120 ft. make DC 26 Constitution saves. On a failure, each takes 55 (10d10) psychic damage and cannot concentrate on powers or spells until the start of the Kraken's next turn. A success halves the damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Telekinetic Fling. Throw one creature the Kraken is grappling into an unoccupied space it sees within 60 ft. The creature lands Prone and takes 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Reactions: Psychic Reprisal. When an attack damages the Kraken, its enemies within 30 ft. of the attacker, including the attacker, make DC 26 Wisdom saves. Failure deals 22 (4d10) psychic damage, halved on a success.
sections.Villain Actions:
Each action is available once per encounter, after an enemy finishes a turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
1. Psionic Tentacles. Conjure tentacles that make a Tentacle attack against each enemy within 120 ft. The Kraken then uses Telekinetic Fling on each creature it is grappling.
2. Psionic Ink. Teleport up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space the Kraken sees. Each creature within 30 ft. of the space it left makes a DC 26 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature is covered in ink and takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage at the start of each turn until it uses an action to wipe the ink away.
3. The Ocean's Wrath. Creatures within 120 ft. make DC 26 Wisdom saves. Failure deals 65 (10d12) psychic damage and makes the creature Frightened of the Kraken for 1 minute, with a repeat save at the end of each turn. A success halves the damage and avoids the condition.
sections.Psionic Powers (MCDM): Psionic powers are supernatural effects and require no components. They are unaffected by effects that target only spells or magic, including Antimagic Field, Counterspell, and Dispel Magic.
sections.Flanked (MCDM): If using flanking rules, creatures cannot flank this creature.
sections.Mundane Attacks (MCDM): A mundane attack is one that uses neither magic nor psionics.

name: Qazyldrath
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Con +14, Wis +10, Cha +11. Arcana +9, History +9, Perception +10, Stealth +8. Immune to acid and necrotic damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, and Stunned. Blindsight 120 ft., truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 20. Speaks Common and Draconic.
description: The Silent Decay uses acid and living shadows and wants to blot out the sun.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. Breathes air and water.
Consume Shadow (3/day). Turn a failed save into a success. Dispel any magical darkness in the lair. Qazyldrath cannot use Enshroud or Thwart Healing until the end of their next turn.
Shadow Strength. Qazyldrath's acid and necrotic damage ignore resistance.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, 15-ft. reach, one target. Hit 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. Extinguish the target if it is a light source, or extinguish any light source the target holds or wears.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage. Qazyldrath can move the target up to 15 ft. horizontally.
Vacuous Breath (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 90-ft.-long, 20-ft.-wide line make DC 22 Dexterity saves, taking 24 (7d6) acid plus 24 (7d6) necrotic damage or half on a success. The area fills with magical darkness for 1 minute. Darkvision cannot see through it. Daylight or a light-producing spell of 5th level or higher can illuminate it.
sections.Bonus Actions: Enshroud. A creature Qazyldrath sees within 120 ft. makes a DC 19 Dexterity save. On a failure, it is Blinded and vulnerable to necrotic damage until the start of their next turn.
sections.Reactions: Thwart Healing. When a creature within 60 ft. regains HP, it regains half as much on a failed DC 19 Constitution save.
sections.Villain Actions:
Each action is available once per encounter, after an enemy finishes a turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
1. Burning Globs. Enemies they see within 90 ft. make DC 19 Dexterity saves. Each creature that fails takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each turn until a creature uses an action to remove the globule from itself or another creature it can reach.
2. Shadow Form. Gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing until the end of their next turn, then teleport up to 120 ft. into an unoccupied space they see.
3. Sinking Gloom. Create a 5-ft.-deep, 20-ft.-radius pool of acid on visible ground within 120 ft. It is difficult terrain and lasts 1 minute. An enemy starting a turn inside takes 24 (7d6) acid damage and must pass a DC 19 Strength save or become Restrained until the start of its next turn. An enemy starting its turn flying within 30 ft. of the pool makes a DC 19 Dexterity save. On a failure, it lands in the nearest open space of its choice in the pool, takes 24 (7d6) acid damage, and is Restrained until the start of its next turn.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Coronal Hollow has three separate lair actions: Acidic Gas, Consume Light, and Hungry Gloom. These can change the lighting and interact with Qazyldrath’s shadow mechanics.

name: Xaantikorijek
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Con +15, Wis +10, Cha +12. Arcana +21, History +21, Nature +21, Perception +10, Religion +21. Immune to lightning and thunder damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Stunned. Blindsight 120 ft., truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 20. Speaks all languages.
description: The Voice of the Ages is a storm dragon who has forgotten his own name and much of the lore he once knew.

sections.Traits:
Static Shield (3/day). Turn a failed save into a success. His sight, blindsight, and truesight are limited to 30 ft. until the start of his next turn.
Storm of the Gods. His lightning and thunder damage ignore resistance.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, 15-ft. reach, one target. Hit 20 (2d10 + 9) piercing plus 5 (1d10) lightning damage. He can move the target up to 20 ft. in any direction.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 16 (2d6 + 9) slashing plus 7 (2d6) thunder damage and knocks the target Prone.
Fulminating Breath (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 120-ft.-long, 30-ft.-wide line make DC 23 Dexterity saves. On a failure, they take 66 (12d10) lightning damage and have disadvantage on saves until the end of Xaantikorijek's next turn. A success halves the damage and avoids the disadvantage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Lightning Discharge. Make one Bite attack. On a hit, deal an extra 11 (2d10) lightning damage to that target and to one other enemy within 60 ft. of it.
sections.Reactions: Voice of Negation. When a visible creature within 60 ft. uses an action or bonus action to cast a spell, it makes a DC 23 save using its spellcasting ability. Failure deals 16 (3d10) thunder damage and prevents casting until the end of the creature's turn. It keeps its spell slot and action.
sections.Villain Actions:
Each action is available once per encounter, after an enemy finishes a turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
1. Voice of Reverence. Choose creatures within 60 ft. Each falls Prone on a failed DC 20 Wisdom save and takes 22 (4d10) thunder damage if it stands before the end of Xaantikorijek's next turn.
2. Fulguration. Until the end of his next turn, he turns into lightning. During this time he resists all damage, fits through 1-inch gaps without squeezing, can move through creatures' spaces, and provokes no opportunity attacks. The first time he enters a creature's space each turn, that creature takes 16 (3d10) lightning damage.
3. Voice of the Ages. Enemies within 60 ft. who hear him make DC 20 Wisdom saves. Failure deals 44 (8d10) psychic damage, knocks the target Prone, and prevents it from standing for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each turn. A success halves the damage and avoids the other effects.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: In the Glass Cavern, Xaantikorijek can use a lair action to read a creature’s memories. The wyrm and fire giants may deal peacefully with visitors they judge harmless.

name: Yserthrax
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Con +14, Wis +10, Cha +11. Arcana +13, Deception +11, Insight +17, Perception +17, Persuasion +11, Stealth +7. Immune to poison and psychic damage and to Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, and Stunned. Blindsight 120 ft., truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 27. Speaks Common, Deep Speech, and Draconic.
description: This dragon carries a corruption that can turn her victims into gibbering mouthers.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. Breathes air and water.
Corruption. Her poison damage ignores resistance and treats immunity as resistance. A creature other than a Construct or Undead that takes poison damage from her makes a DC 19 Constitution save. If it fails, it becomes corrupted and takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage at the start of each turn. It can repeat the save at the end of each turn. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, or a comparable supernatural effect also ends the corruption. If the victim dies while corrupted, its body becomes a gibbering mouther under her control.
Withering Resistance (3/day). Take 16 (3d10) necrotic damage to turn her failed save into a success.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, 15-ft. reach, one target. Hit 20 (2d10 + 9) piercing plus 11 (2d10) poison damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 16 (2d6 + 9) slashing damage. She can move the target up to 15 ft. horizontally.
Corrupting Breath (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 90-ft. cone make DC 22 Constitution saves. A creature that fails takes 56 (16d6) poison damage and is Poisoned until the end of its next turn. A success halves the damage and avoids the condition.
sections.Bonus Actions: Ulcerate. One creature she sees within 60 ft. that is corrupted by her trait is Dazed until the end of its next turn on a failed DC 19 Constitution save.
sections.Reactions: Eldritch Disruption. When a creature she sees within 60 ft. hits her with an attack or passes a save, it chooses to take 10 (3d6) psychic damage or reroll the attack or save and use the new result.
sections.Villain Actions:
Each action is available once per encounter, after an enemy finishes a turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
1. Summon Monoliths. Create three crystal columns centered on points she sees within 500 ft. Each is a 10-ft.-radius, 60-ft.-high cylinder with AC 19, 100 HP, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. They do not block Yserthrax's vision. Creatures other than Yserthrax are vulnerable to psychic damage within 10 ft. of a column. When one is destroyed, creatures within 30 ft. make DC 19 Wisdom saves, taking 21 (6d6) psychic damage or half on a success.
2. Spatial Alteration. Creatures within 60 ft. make DC 19 Charisma saves. Those who fail are teleported up to 120 ft. to unoccupied spaces she sees.
3. Elder Scream. Each enemy she sees within 120 ft. makes a DC 19 Wisdom save, taking 77 (14d10) psychic damage or half on a success.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses one of these options: move, take an action, or take a bonus action. If it becomes Dazed during its turn, its turn ends. Extra actions from effects such as Haste and Action Surge still apply. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect can end this condition.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Eyes of the Mountain, p. 262 (stat block), p. 254 (lair)
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Eyes of the Mountain adds lair effects including Eldritch Suppuration and Elder Whispers. Elder Whispers can affect creatures already corrupted by Yserthrax.

name: Zenith Aastrika
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Str +11, Dex +7, Con +10, Wis +10. Athletics +11, Perception +10, Persuasion +6. Immune to fire damage and to Charmed and Frightened. Passive Perception 20. Speaks Giant and Primordial.
description: Aastrika rose through the Sunlight Legion and leads fire giants into battle.

sections.Traits:
Battle Tranquility (3/day). Turn a failed save into a success. Aastrika cannot use Sweltering Heat until the end of her next turn.
Molten Flesh. The first time each turn a creature other than a fire giant touches her or hits her with a melee attack, it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Take the Disengage action and make up to three attacks in any combination of Unarmed Strike and Hurl Flame.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 21 (4d6 + 7) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the target is a creature, attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of Aastrika's next turn while it glows red.
Hurl Flame. Ranged spell attack, +10 to hit, 180-ft. range, one target. Hit 20 (4d6 + 6) fire damage.
Lava Pillar (recharge 5–6). Pick a point she sees on the ground within 120 ft. Each creature in a 20-ft.-radius, 60-ft.-high cylinder above it makes a DC 18 Dexterity save, taking 38 (11d6) fire damage or half on a success.
sections.Bonus Actions: Sweltering Heat. Creatures within 20 ft. that lack resistance and immunity to fire damage gain one level of Exhaustion on a failed DC 18 Constitution save.
sections.Reactions: Power of Flame. When another fire giant she sees within 60 ft. misses a weapon attack, the giant rolls the damage as if it hit. The target takes half the result as fire damage.
sections.Villain Actions:
Each action is available once per encounter, after an enemy finishes a turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
1. Forward! Aastrika and up to three creatures she sees can each move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks and make one melee attack.
2. The Manifold Self. Teleport to an unoccupied space she sees within 30 ft. Five fire giant troopers appear in open spaces within 30 ft. of her departure point. They act immediately, then use that same initiative count in subsequent rounds.
3. This. Ends. Now. Aastrika and each willing fire giant within 60 ft. release heat. A creature within 10 ft. of her or one of those giants makes a DC 18 Dexterity save, taking 55 (10d10) fire damage or half on a success.

name: Force of Blood
classification: Large Elemental (Earth, Fire, Water), any alignment
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Con +12, Wis +10, Cha +11. Intimidation +11, Medicine +10, Persuasion +11. Resists fire and necrotic damage. Immune to Charmed, Exhaustion, and Frightened. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 14. Speaks Common, Dwarvish, Elvish, Giant, and Primordial.
description: A blood sovereign can find living creatures through obscured sight and replenish its strength with each spear hit.

sections.Traits: Visceral Sight. See any creature within 120 ft. other than a Construct or an Undead. Effects that obscure sight do not block this sense.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Scarlet Longspear attacks. One can be replaced with Rend from Within.
Scarlet Longspear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage. The force of blood regains 5 HP if it hits a creature.
Rend from Within. Melee spell attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 26 (4d12) necrotic damage. The target spends one Hit Die without effect and cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn. Miss 13 (2d12) necrotic damage.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Convocation of Blood. Choose the force of blood or another visible Elemental within 30 ft. That Elemental chooses Boiling Blood or Essence Thief.
Boiling Blood. A creature within 5 ft. of the Elemental, other than a Construct or an Undead, makes a DC 19 Constitution save. On a failure it chooses between taking 27 (5d10) fire damage or attacking a creature the Elemental picks with a weapon whose damage die is at least 1d4. The attack deals an extra 11 (2d10) fire damage on a hit.
Essence Thief. Two creatures the Elemental sees within 30 ft. make DC 19 Constitution saves, taking 19 (3d12) necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success. The Elemental can then teleport to a visible unoccupied space within 5 ft. of either target.

name: Force of Earth
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Athletics +7, History +6. Immune to poison damage and to Petrified and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft., passive Perception 12. Speaks Common and Terran.
description: A guardian shaped like a stone ape. It can move through solid rock without leaving a tunnel.

sections.Traits: Earth Glide. Burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth or stone without disturbing it.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Earthbind Strike attacks.
Earthbind Strike. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. The target's speed becomes 0 until the start of the force of earth's next turn.
Shatter Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. Hit 23 (3d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Against an object or structure, deal 47 (6d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage instead.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Convocation of Earth (1/day). Choose the force of earth or another visible Elemental within 30 ft. That Elemental chooses Earthen Aura or Stone Armor.
Earthen Aura. Stones orbit in a 10-ft.-radius sphere around the Elemental for 1 minute or until it dies or becomes Incapacitated. A non-Elemental takes 5 slashing damage for every 5 ft. it moves into or within the area.
Stone Armor. Gain 20 temporary HP. While any of these temporary HP remain, the Elemental is immune to Dazed, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Stunned.

name: Force of Iron
otherStatistics: Natural armor, AC 22 in Shield Form. Save Str +9. Athletics +9, Perception +5. Resists fire damage. Immune to poison damage and to Exhaustion, Frightened, Petrified, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft., passive Perception 15. Speaks Common, Ignan, and Terran.
description: A four-armed metal centaur that reshapes its body for reach, defense, or fire.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Form Stance, then make either three Ferrous Greatblade attacks or three Iron Spike attacks.
Ferrous Greatblade. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. (20 ft. in Polearm Form), one target. Hit 19 (4d6 + 5) slashing damage.
Iron Spike. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.
Form Stance. Choose one form. Its benefit lasts until the start of the force of iron's next turn.
Polearm Form. Its melee reach changes from 5 ft. to 20 ft.
Reckless Form. The force of iron has advantage on its melee attack rolls. All attack rolls against it also have advantage.
Shield Form. Increase AC by 3.
Fire Form (1/day). Its attacks deal an extra 13 (2d12) fire damage on a hit.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Convocation of Iron (1/day). Choose the force of iron or another visible Elemental within 30 ft. That Elemental chooses Earth Reinforcements or Iron Skin.
Earth Reinforcements. Five earth sparks appear in free spaces within 20 ft. of the Elemental. They understand it, obey its spoken commands, and act immediately after it in initiative.
Iron Skin. The Elemental resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage for 1 minute, with concentration as if on a spell.

ruleNotes: The Flee, Mortals! Multiattack says Ferrous Blade. Use the Ferrous Greatblade attack listed in the same block.

name: Logger
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Str +9, Con +6, Wis +3. Athletics +9, Stealth +5. Resists cold and fire damage. Immune to lightning damage and to Blinded, Deafened, and Exhaustion. Blindsight 60 ft., blind beyond that radius. Passive Perception 10. Understands Sylvan and cannot speak.
description: A walking tangle of wood and vines that Anthracia, Princess of Venom, made from her own tree.

sections.Traits: Lightning Absorption. When Logger would take lightning damage, it instead regains HP equal to the damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks, or three while Nature's Fury lasts.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Entangling Vines. Each enemy within 30 ft. makes a DC 17 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 9 (1d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage, is Grappled (escape DC 17), and is pulled up to 30 ft. straight toward Logger.
sections.Bonus Actions: Nature's Fury (1/day). For 1 minute Logger has advantage on Strength checks and saves and makes an extra Slam attack when using Multiattack. If it ends a turn without dealing damage to another creature during that turn, the fury ends.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Wilderkith timing. The party can use each villain party action once per encounter, in any order, after an enemy finishes its turn. The party can take only one per round. Logger must be present and able to act.
Action 2, Distracting Tendrils. Each enemy within 30 ft. of Logger makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. On a failure it takes 22 (4d10) slashing damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn. On a success it takes half damage and keeps its normal attacks.

name: Multivok Bodyguard
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Str +8, Dex +3, Con +7. Athletics +8, Perception +7. Resists psychic damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks. Immune to poison damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 17. Speaks Dwarvish.
description: A construct the steel dwarves built with axe blades for arms and a crossbow mounted on its shoulders. It may still protect the grave or possessions of its original charge.

sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. Spells, powers, and other effects cannot change its form.
Supernatural Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells, powers, and other supernatural effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Axe Arm and Repeating Crossbow.
Axe Arm. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 18 (2d12 + 5) slashing damage. A target wielding a weapon must make a DC 16 Strength save. On a failure, it drops a weapon it is wielding, chosen by the bodyguard, which kicks it up to 15 ft. away.
Repeating Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit 16 (3d10) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Magnetic Pull. Each enemy within 30 ft. wearing metal armor or made of metal makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure the bodyguard pulls it up to 15 ft. closer.
sections.Reactions: Valiar Cloak. When an attack hits a visible Medium or smaller ally within 5 ft. of the bodyguard, it makes the attacker roll again with the bodyguard as the target.
sections.Mundane Attacks (MCDM): For these resistances, a mundane attack uses neither magic nor psionics.

name: Multivok Chief
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Str +10, Dex +5, Con +10. Athletics +10. Resists psychic damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks. Immune to poison damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 11. Speaks Dwarvish.
description: A steel-dwarf foreman that trains its red targeting beam on obstacles and enemies, then sends other constructs in.

sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. Spells, powers, and other effects cannot change its form.
Supernatural Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells, powers, and other supernatural effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Pneumatic Fist and Targeting Beam.
Pneumatic Fist. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. The chief can push a Medium or smaller target up to 10 ft. away.
Targeting Beam. Ranged spell attack, +10 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit 26 (4d12) force damage. A red beam marks the target until the end of the chief's next turn. Attack rolls against the marked target have advantage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Chief's Command. Choose an ally within 60 ft. that can hear the chief. Without spending an action, the ally can move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks or make one melee attack.
sections.Mundane Attacks (MCDM): For these resistances, a mundane attack uses neither magic nor psionics.

name: Sunlight Nexus
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Wis +7, Cha +9. Insight +7, Intimidation +9, Perception +7, Religion +6. Resists fire and radiant damage. Immune to poison damage and to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 17. Speaks Common and Primordial.
description: A winged silhouette of fractured light that heals its allies while exposing an enemy to their attacks.

sections.Traits: Corona. The nexus sheds bright sunlight within 120 ft. and dim light for another 120 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Solar Arc attacks. An available Heavenly Collapse or Rejuvenating Flare can replace one of them.
Solar Arc. Melee or ranged spell attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. Hit 18 (2d12 + 5) radiant damage.
Heavenly Collapse (2/day). Choose one visible enemy within 60 ft. Every ally of the nexus within 5 ft. of the enemy regains 20 HP. The enemy makes a DC 17 Constitution save. On a failure it loses all damage resistances and is Blinded for 1 minute, with another save to end both effects at the end of each turn.
Rejuvenating Flare (1/day). One visible ally within 30 ft. regains 27 (5d10) HP and ends any of the Charmed, Dazed, Frightened, and Poisoned conditions affecting it.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Convocation of Sunlight (2/day). Choose the nexus or another visible Elemental within 30 ft. That Elemental chooses Healing Radiance or Protective Light.
Healing Radiance. The Elemental regains 30 HP. Until the end of the nexus's next turn, non-Elementals within 10 ft. of it are Blinded.
Protective Light. Four motes orbit the Elemental for 1 minute. When its attack damages a creature, the Elemental can extinguish a mote to deal 14 (4d6) extra radiant damage to that creature (no action).

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Coronal Hollow, p. 248. Ash Queen's Reliquary, p. 301.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Coronal Hollow, p. 239, area B4. Spicule and Brume will talk to stall visitors but attack when the conversation ends. Ash Queen's Reliquary, p. 291, area A4. Nayrin guards the study alongside Meskrit. If the party rested in the tower, use their earlier interaction to guide this meeting.

name: Valochera
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Str +9, Dex +4. Stealth +4, Perception +4. Resists cold and fire damage. Immune to acid, lightning, and poison damage and to Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned. Blindsight 60 ft., blind beyond that radius. Passive Perception 14. No languages.
description: A giant sewer mushroom grabs prey with its roots and softens it with acid before taking a bite.

sections.Traits:
Acid Absorption. When the valochera would take acid damage, it instead regains HP equal to the damage.
Unbearable Stench. A creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the valochera must make a DC 16 Constitution save. On a failure it is Poisoned for 1 minute and can repeat the save at the end of each turn to end it.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Mycelium attacks.
Mycelium. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 15) and stays Restrained until the grapple ends.
Chow Time. One creature grappled by the valochera makes a DC 16 Dexterity save. It takes 22 (4d10) acid damage plus 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage on a failure or half of each on a success.
Poison Glob (recharge 5–6). Choose a visible point within 30 ft. Each creature in a 5-ft.-radius sphere centered there makes a DC 16 Constitution save, taking 33 (6d10) poison damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Yumgrub
otherStatistics: Darkvision 30 ft., passive Perception 8. No languages.
description: Cave traders prize these sweet tunnel moth larvae for the burst of strength they give anyone who eats one alive.

sections.Traits:
Death Wail. When the yumgrub dies, creatures within 15 ft. that hear it take 1 psychic damage. Other yumgrubs and anyone who ate one within the past minute are immune.
Spider Climb. Climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
Yum. A Small or larger creature can spend an action to eat a living yumgrub within 5 ft. The yumgrub dies. For 1 minute the eater doubles its speed and gains +4 to Strength and +2 to AC. When the minute ends, the eater gains two levels of Exhaustion.
sections.Actions: Bite (group attack). Melee weapon attack, −1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1 piercing damage per participant.

name: Koptourok
otherStatistics: Saves Dex +6, Con +6. Perception +4. Resists necrotic and poison damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks. Immune to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned. Blindsight 120 ft., passive Perception 14. Understands its languages from life and cannot speak.
description: An undead cave hunter that steals breath. Ghouls sometimes follow it to feed on the bodies it leaves behind.

sections.Traits:
Breathless Aura. Enemies within 30 ft. cannot speak. Enemies in this area that need to breathe also have disadvantage on Constitution saves.
Wings of Breath. With at least one enemy within 30 ft., the koptourok has a flying speed equal to its walking speed. It falls if it starts its turn in the air without a flying speed.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Choking Grasp attacks.
Choking Grasp. Melee spell attack, +6 to hit, reach 30 ft., one creature. Hit 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage. Pull the target to an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the koptourok and Grapple it (escape DC 14). It stays Restrained while grappled, and this grapple does not halve the koptourok's speed.
Last Gasp. Each creature the koptourok is grappling must make a DC 14 Constitution save, taking 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage on a failure or half as much on a success. The koptourok gains 5 temporary HP for each creature that failed.
sections.Reactions: Thunderous Deflation. When the koptourok drops to 30 HP or fewer, every creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 16 (3d10) thunder damage and is Deafened until the end of its next turn. On a success it takes half damage and avoids the condition. The koptourok then releases every creature it is grappling and flies up to its speed.
sections.Mundane Attacks (MCDM): For these resistances, a mundane attack uses neither magic nor psionics.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Tomb of the Keeper, p. 174. Shadowkeep, p. 218.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Tomb of the Keeper, p. 169, area M3. Four koptouroks hide on the pillars if combat hasn't drawn them to the workshop. A character who can see in the dark spots them with a DC 16 Wisdom (Perception) check. They attack when discovered or once at least half the party enters.

name: Argan Rael
otherStatistics: AC 18 with Mage Armor. Saving throws Con +4, Int +10, Wis +3. Arcana +10, History +10, Investigation +10, Perception +3. Resists fire and necrotic damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13. Speaks Common and Infernal.
description: Argan persuaded Prince Ellan to fund his hunt for immortality. He now lives in the Bracers of the Spellbreaker and prefers to take spellcasters as hosts.

sections.Printed source: p. 382. Soulbinder items and curse, pp. 380–381.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. Argan has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Pervasive Magic. His spell attacks bypass damage resistance.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Arcane Lance attacks.
Arcane Lance (cantrip). Melee or ranged spell attack +10, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft., one target. Hit 17 (5d6) force damage. Argan can move the target horizontally up to 15 ft.
Lightning Volley (3rd-level spell). Choose up to three visible creatures within 30 ft. Each makes a DC 18 Constitution save. Failure deals 21 (6d6) lightning damage and halves speed until the end of its next turn. Success halves damage and leaves speed alone.
Fireball (1/day, 7th-level spell). Pick a point within 90 ft. Chosen creatures in a 20-ft.-radius sphere make DC 18 Dexterity saves, taking 42 (12d6) fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Bonus Actions: Misty Step (2/day, 2nd-level spell). Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space.
sections.Utility Spells: Intelligence, spell save DC 18. All listed utility spells take one action. At will, Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Message, Prestidigitation. Twice per day each, Detect Magic, Mage Armor, Sending.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Soulbinders. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy's turn. Each action is available once per encounter, in any order. The member taking it must be present and able to act.
Action 4, Gravity Bomb. Center a 20-ft.-radius sphere on a visible point within 90 ft. Enemies inside make DC 18 Constitution saves. A failure deals 33 (6d10) force damage and reduces speed to 0 through the end of the target's next turn. Success halves the damage and preserves speed.
sections.Recoverable Magic Item:
Bracers of the Spellbreaker. Very rare. Spellcaster attunement required. The wearer has advantage on saves against spells and magical effects, and their spell attacks bypass damage resistance.
Cursed Sentience. The item uses its Soulbinder's alignment, mental ability scores, and languages. It hears and sees in darkness within 60 ft. and can speak to its wearer telepathically. Break attunement with Remove Curse or equivalent magic. After seven days attuned and every 24 hours after that, make a DC 18 Wisdom save. Each failure reduces Wisdom by 1 while attuned. On the third failure, the Soulbinder takes control and changes the wearer's body, statistics, and equipment to match its own. The wearer remains aware. Breaking attunement restores the body and control. The Soulbinder returns to the item when attunement ends or the body dies. After 1d6 + 12 months of possession, the victim's soul and body are destroyed. The full group ritual for permanently lifting the curse is on p. 382.

name: Kishina Darrowind
otherStatistics: Armor includes Pathfinder’s Boots. Saving throws Str +5, Dex +10, Wis +10. Acrobatics +10, Athletics +5, Insight +10, Perception +10. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 20. Speaks Common and Elvish.
description: Kishina once fought the invaders of her homeland. She guided the Soulbinders to the ruin that bound her to the Pathfinder’s Boots, and now wants to learn how the ritual worked.

sections.Printed source: p. 383. Villain party action, p. 382. Soulbinder items and curse, pp. 380–381.
sections.Traits:
Charm Resistant. Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed.
Light Landing. Falling deals no damage to Kishina.
Standing Leap. Long jump 45 ft. and high jump 15 ft., with or without a running start.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make four Unarmed Strikes or three Throwing Knife attacks.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack +10, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (1d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage. A critical hit instead deals 20 (3d8 + 7).
Throwing Knife. Ranged weapon attack +10, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d4 + 7) piercing damage.
Painful Sprint (recharge 6). Move up to speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Each enemy Kishina can see and passes within 5 ft. of makes a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failure it is Poisoned until the start of its next turn. If it fails by at least 5, it also falls Prone.
sections.Bonus Actions: Throw. A visible Large or smaller enemy within 5 ft. makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. On a failure, Kishina moves the target up to 15 ft. away and knocks it Prone.
sections.Reactions: Shield (3/day, 1st-level spell). When an attack or Magic Missile targets Kishina, she gains +5 AC including against that attack and takes no Magic Missile damage until the start of her next turn.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Soulbinders. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy's turn. Each action is available once per encounter, in any order. The member taking it must be present and able to act.
Action 3, Furious Dance. Each visible enemy within 15 ft. makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. Failure deals 22 (5d8) bludgeoning damage and knocks the target Prone. Success halves damage and avoids the fall.
sections.Recoverable Magic Item:
Pathfinder’s Boots. Very rare. Attunement required. The wearer gains +2 AC and +10 ft. walking speed. The boots hold 7 charges. Spend 1 to cast Feather Fall, Jump, or Shield. They regain 1d6 + 1 spent charges at dawn.
Cursed Sentience. The item uses its Soulbinder's alignment, mental ability scores, and languages. It hears and sees in darkness within 60 ft. and can speak to its wearer telepathically. Break attunement with Remove Curse or equivalent magic. After seven days attuned and every 24 hours after that, make a DC 18 Wisdom save. Each failure reduces Wisdom by 1 while attuned. On the third failure, the Soulbinder takes control and changes the wearer's body, statistics, and equipment to match its own. The wearer remains aware. Breaking attunement restores the body and control. The Soulbinder returns to the item when attunement ends or the body dies. After 1d6 + 12 months of possession, the victim's soul and body are destroyed. The full group ritual for permanently lifting the curse is on p. 382.

name: Prince Ellan Farra
otherStatistics: Breastplate and shield. Saving throws Dex +5, Wis +10, Cha +8. Deception +8, Insight +10, Persuasion +8, Religion +3. Immune to psychic damage and to Charmed and Frightened. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 17. Speaks Common and Elvish.
description: Passed over for the crown, Ellan traded his mortal life for the chance to outlast his family. Now bound to the Crown of Majesty, he expects his subjects to worship him.

sections.Printed source: p. 383. Villain party action, p. 382. Soulbinder items and curse, pp. 380–381.
sections.Traits:
Elf Glamour (1/day). When a creature targets Ellan with an attack, power, or spell, it makes a DC 18 Wisdom save or becomes Charmed by him through the end of his next turn. No action required.
Resolute Aura. While Ellan is conscious, he and any allies within 20 ft. who can see him are immune to Charmed and Frightened.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bladed Scepter attacks.
Bladed Scepter. Melee weapon attack +10, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (1d8 + 7) bludgeoning plus 10 (3d6) poison damage. The target makes a DC 18 Constitution save or is Poisoned for 1 minute. It can save again at the end of each turn.
Command (2nd-level spell). Speak a one-word order to up to two visible creatures within 60 ft. On a failed DC 18 Wisdom save, a target follows the order on its next turn. The spell has no effect on Undead, targets who understand neither Common nor Elvish, or those who would be directly harmed by obeying. It ends if the target cannot comply. Approach makes the target advance by the shortest route and end its turn when within 5 ft. Drop makes it release held objects and end its turn. Flee makes it spend its turn getting away as quickly as possible. Grovel makes it fall Prone and end its turn. Halt forbids movement and actions.
Unholy Flame (3rd-level spell). A visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. Failure deals 27 (6d8) fire damage and envelops the creature in flame. While enveloped it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage at the start of its turns and can save to end the effect at the end of each turn. Success on the initial save halves the damage and avoids the ongoing flames.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Soulbinders. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy's turn. Each action is available once per encounter, in any order. The member taking it must be present and able to act.
Action 1, Battle Cry. Enemies who hear Ellan within 60 ft. make DC 18 Wisdom saves. On a failure, they have disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls through the end of their next turns.
sections.Recoverable Magic Item:
Crown of Majesty. Very rare. Attunement required. The wearer resists psychic damage and is immune to Charmed and Frightened. The crown holds 3 charges. Spend an action and 1 charge to cast Command or Charm Person, DC 18. It regains 1d3 spent charges at dawn.
Cursed Sentience. The item uses its Soulbinder's alignment, mental ability scores, and languages. It hears and sees in darkness within 60 ft. and can speak to its wearer telepathically. Break attunement with Remove Curse or equivalent magic. After seven days attuned and every 24 hours after that, make a DC 18 Wisdom save. Each failure reduces Wisdom by 1 while attuned. On the third failure, the Soulbinder takes control and changes the wearer's body, statistics, and equipment to match its own. The wearer remains aware. Breaking attunement restores the body and control. The Soulbinder returns to the item when attunement ends or the body dies. After 1d6 + 12 months of possession, the victim's soul and body are destroyed. The full group ritual for permanently lifting the curse is on p. 382.

name: Radlee Thugram
otherStatistics: Plate. Saving throws Str +10, Con +5, Wis +6. Athletics +10, Intimidation +4, Perception +6, Survival +6. Truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 16. Speaks Common.
description: Radlee deserted after her commander used her unit as bait. As a Soulbinder, she protects her fellow mercenaries and has little patience for Ellan’s courtly demands.

sections.Printed source: p. 384. Villain party action, p. 382. Soulbinder items and curse, pp. 380–381.
sections.Traits:
Exploit Opening (3/day). Gain advantage on an attack roll.
Sure-Footed. Advantage on saves against forced movement or being knocked Prone.
Tactical Vigilance. Radlee has advantage on initiative checks. While she can act, she and allies within 30 ft. who see or hear her cannot be surprised.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Halberd attacks, three Longbow attacks, or one Halberd attack and use Backswipe.
Halberd. Melee weapon attack +10, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 12 (1d10 + 7) slashing damage.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack +6, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Backswipe. One creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 18 Strength save. On a failure it takes 16 (3d10) bludgeoning damage and falls Prone.
sections.Reactions: Protector. When a creature Radlee can see within 10 ft. attacks her ally, she can make a Halberd attack against the attacker.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Soulbinders. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy's turn. Each action is available once per encounter, in any order. The member taking it must be present and able to act.
Action 2, Strategic Positioning. Radlee and each ally within 60 ft. who sees or hears her can move up to half speed without provoking opportunity attacks and take the Hide action.
sections.Recoverable Magic Item:
Visionary’s Cloak. Very rare. Attunement required. The wearer has advantage on initiative checks and cannot be surprised. With the hood up, the wearer has truesight to 60 ft. and glowing eyes. Raising or lowering the hood takes an action.
Cursed Sentience. The item uses its Soulbinder's alignment, mental ability scores, and languages. It hears and sees in darkness within 60 ft. and can speak to its wearer telepathically. Break attunement with Remove Curse or equivalent magic. After seven days attuned and every 24 hours after that, make a DC 18 Wisdom save. Each failure reduces Wisdom by 1 while attuned. On the third failure, the Soulbinder takes control and changes the wearer's body, statistics, and equipment to match its own. The wearer remains aware. Breaking attunement restores the body and control. The Soulbinder returns to the item when attunement ends or the body dies. After 1d6 + 12 months of possession, the victim's soul and body are destroyed. The full group ritual for permanently lifting the curse is on p. 382.

name: Scarlet Shadow
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Saving throws Dex +10, Int +4, Wis +8. Acrobatics +10, Perception +8, Sleight of Hand +10, Stealth +13. Resists necrotic damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 18. Speaks Common and Draconic.
description: The lone survivor of an assassins’ guild took its name as his own. Bound to the Ring of Scarlet Shadows, he wants to become a god of death.

sections.Printed source: p. 384. Villain party action, p. 382. Soulbinder items and curse, pp. 380–381.
sections.Traits:
Assassinate. On Scarlet's first turn, his attacks have advantage against creatures that have yet to act. His first hit against a surprised creature is a critical hit.
Sneak Attack (1/turn). A weapon hit deals 14 (4d6) extra damage if he has advantage. It also qualifies when an ally who can act is within 5 ft. of the target and Scarlet lacks disadvantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Shadow Blade attacks or three bow attacks. Use the listed Longbow profile for the bow attacks.
Shadow Blade. Melee weapon attack +10, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (2d6 + 7) necrotic damage. A target hit by two or more Shadow Blade attacks in one turn makes a DC 18 Wisdom save or is Blinded through the end of its next turn.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack +10, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit 11 (1d8 + 7) piercing damage.
Razor Garrote. Melee weapon attack +10, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (1d8 + 7) slashing damage. A Medium or smaller creature is Grappled, escape DC 17. Until free, it is Restrained and takes 22 (5d8) slashing damage at the start of its turns. Scarlet can attack only that target during the grapple.
Umbral Breath (recharge 6). Creatures in a 30-ft. cone make DC 18 Dexterity saves. A failure deals 28 (8d6) necrotic damage and leaves the creature Frightened of Scarlet for 1 minute, with a repeat save at the end of each turn. Success halves damage and avoids Frightened.
sections.Bonus Actions: Cunning Action. Dash, Disengage, or Hide.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Soulbinders. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy's turn. Each action is available once per encounter, in any order. The member taking it must be present and able to act.
Action 5, Shadow Shift. Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space, then make one Shadow Blade or Razor Garrote attack with advantage. Any hit is critical.
sections.Recoverable Magic Item:
Ring of Scarlet Shadows. Very rare. Attunement required. The wearer gains darkvision to 60 ft. or adds 60 ft. to an existing range, and has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide. A bonus action extends or dismisses a shadow blade from the ring hand. It works as a shortsword dealing necrotic damage. While extended, it cannot be dropped and the hand cannot hold anything else.
Cursed Sentience. The item uses its Soulbinder's alignment, mental ability scores, and languages. It hears and sees in darkness within 60 ft. and can speak to its wearer telepathically. Break attunement with Remove Curse or equivalent magic. After seven days attuned and every 24 hours after that, make a DC 18 Wisdom save. Each failure reduces Wisdom by 1 while attuned. On the third failure, the Soulbinder takes control and changes the wearer's body, statistics, and equipment to match its own. The wearer remains aware. Breaking attunement restores the body and control. The Soulbinder returns to the item when attunement ends or the body dies. After 1d6 + 12 months of possession, the victim's soul and body are destroyed. The full group ritual for permanently lifting the curse is on p. 382.

ruleNotes: The printed Multiattack mentions a Shortbow, but the only bow statistics provided are for a Longbow. This summary uses that listed attack.

name: Jutkarr Flintfingers
otherStatistics: Breastplate. Saving throws Con +5, Int +9. History +9, Investigation +9, Perception +6, Religion +9. Resists poison and psychic damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 16. Speaks Common, Dwarvish, and thieves’ cant. Telepathy 120 ft.
description: Jutkarr likes locks and guarded vaults for the same reason he likes the broadsheet’s puzzles. He plans the Amethyst Knife’s operations and keeps its supplies in order.

sections.Traits:
Mind Link. The bosses of the Amethyst Knife can speak telepathically with one another across any distance on the same plane.
Poison Resistant. Advantage on saves to avoid or end Poisoned.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Deserved Transfer attacks.
Deserved Transfer (2nd-order power). Melee or ranged power attack +9, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature. Hit 13 (2d6 + 6) psychic damage. A creature Jutkarr can see within 30 ft. gains temporary HP equal to half the damage dealt.
Psionic Resilience (2/day, 4th-order power). Touch a willing creature and give it immunity to one chosen condition for 1 hour. Choose Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, or Stunned. Suppress that condition for the same duration if the target already has it.
sections.Reactions: Shared Condition. When the creature becomes Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned, it can transfer the condition and its remaining duration to a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 ft. who neither has the condition nor is immune to it. The condition ends for the original creature. This reaction works even while Incapacitated.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Amethyst Knife. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy's turn. Each action is available once per encounter, in any order. The member taking it must be present and able to act.
Action 3, I Planned For This. An Amethyst Knife boss within 60 ft. of Jutkarr can swap places by teleporting with another willing boss in the same area. A boss must see the one it swaps with. No action required.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): While Dazed, a creature can use only one of its movement, action, or bonus action on its turn. Gaining Dazed ends the turn if it happens during that turn. Extra actions such as Haste or Action Surge still work. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can end the condition.
sections.Psionic Powers (MCDM): Powers have no components and count as supernatural. Antimagic Field, Counterspell, and Dispel Magic do not stop powers. A creature may maintain several different powers at once, up to its proficiency bonus, but cannot concentrate on a spell or another effect at the same time. Failing a concentration save ends all active powers. If a foe provokes an opportunity attack, the creature can use a melee power attack as its reaction instead.

name: Llyvessa
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Saving throws Dex +9, Wis +6. Acrobatics +9, Nature +5, Perception +6, Stealth +9, Survival +6. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 16. Speaks Elvish. Telepathy 120 ft.
description: Llyvessa replaced a missing guide on the expedition that uncovered the Amethyst Knife’s crystal. Something she saw there still frightens her, though she keeps her reasons for staying with the group to herself.

sections.Traits:
Deadly Sharpshooter. Long range does not give Llyvessa disadvantage with a ranged weapon.
Elf Glamour (1/day). When a creature targets Llyvessa with an attack, power, or spell, it makes a DC 14 Wisdom save or is Charmed by her until the end of her next turn. No action required.
Mind Link. The bosses of the Amethyst Knife can speak telepathically with one another across any distance on the same plane.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks with Scimitar or Longbow. Alternatively, make one Longbow attack and use Psychic Shot if available.
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d6 + 6) slashing damage.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack +9, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage.
Psychic Shot (recharge 5–6). Make a Longbow attack that ignores cover and passes through mundane solid obstacles up to 5 ft. thick. It cannot pass through an object being worn or carried.
sections.Bonus Actions: Jaunt (1/day, 3rd-order power). Teleport Llyvessa or one willing creature within 5 ft. to a visible unoccupied space within 30 ft. of her.
sections.Reactions:
Control Projectiles (3/day, 2nd-order power). When a creature Llyvessa sees within 60 ft. makes a ranged weapon attack, she chooses whether that attack has advantage or disadvantage.
Shared Condition. When the creature becomes Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned, it can transfer the condition and its remaining duration to a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 ft. who neither has the condition nor is immune to it. The condition ends for the original creature. This reaction works even while Incapacitated.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Amethyst Knife. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy's turn. Each action is available once per encounter, in any order. The member taking it must be present and able to act.
Action 2, Leaves Fall on the Moon. Fire an arrow that creates a 150-ft. line, 5 ft. wide. Enemies in the line make DC 17 Wisdom saves, taking 21 (6d6) psychic damage on a failure or half on success.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): While Dazed, a creature can use only one of its movement, action, or bonus action on its turn. Gaining Dazed ends the turn if it happens during that turn. Extra actions such as Haste or Action Surge still work. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can end the condition.

A creature may maintain several different powers at once, up to its proficiency bonus, but cannot concentrate on a spell or another effect at the same time. Failing a concentration save ends all active powers. If a foe provokes an opportunity attack, the creature can use a melee power attack as its reaction instead.

name: Victory Graves
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Saving throws Dex +9, Int +5. Acrobatics +9, Athletics +6, Deception +4, Intimidation +4, Stealth +9. Passive Perception 11. Speaks Common and thieves’ cant. Telepathy 120 ft.
description: A veteran of backroom fighting pits, Vic likes to coax opponents into duels. She started as Harlo’s bodyguard and is now his second-in-command.

sections.Printed source: p. 377. Villain party action, p. 375. Mindrazor item, p. 374.
sections.Traits:
Exploit Opening (3/day). Gain advantage on an attack roll.
Mind Link. The bosses of the Amethyst Knife can speak telepathically with one another across any distance on the same plane.
Kinetic Buildup. Each melee weapon hit adds 5 ft. to her speed and grants one additional reaction until the start of her next turn. The bonuses stack.
Psionic Wound (3/day). When Mindrazor hits, she can force a DC 17 Intelligence save. On a failure, the target is vulnerable to psychic damage for 1 minute. Repeat the save at the end of each turn to end it. No action required.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Mindrazor attacks and one Cheap Shot.
Mindrazor. Melee weapon attack +10, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (1d8 + 7) piercing damage.
Cheap Shot. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d4 + 6) bludgeoning damage. The target makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. On a failure, Victory knocks it Prone or inflicts Blinded, Dazed, or Deafened until the end of its next turn.
sections.Reactions: Shared Condition. When the creature becomes Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned, it can transfer the condition and its remaining duration to a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 ft. who neither has the condition nor is immune to it. The condition ends for the original creature. This reaction works even while Incapacitated.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Amethyst Knife. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy's turn. Each action is available once per encounter, in any order. The member taking it must be present and able to act.
Action 4, Telepathic Tirade. Pick one visible creature within 30 ft. Until the end of its next turn, it rolls ability checks, attacks, and saves with disadvantage and takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage each time one fails.
sections.Recoverable Magic Item: Mindrazor. Very rare +1 rapier, attunement required. It holds 3 charges and refills at dawn. On a hit spend 1 charge to force a DC 17 Intelligence save. A failure gives the target vulnerability to psychic damage for 1 minute. The target can try the save again at the end of each turn.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): While Dazed, a creature can use only one of its movement, action, or bonus action on its turn. Gaining Dazed ends the turn if it happens during that turn. Extra actions such as Haste or Action Surge still work. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can end the condition.

name: Treyvan von Hirnschmann
otherStatistics: Plate. Saving throws Str +9, Con +7. Athletics +9, Religion +3. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Speaks Common and Elvish. Telepathy 120 ft.
description: After learning that his own father was plotting his death, Treyvan pledged his muscle and telekinesis to the Amethyst Knife. He wants to seize the dukedom that he was denied.

sections.Traits:
Charm Resistant. Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed.
Mind Link. The bosses of the Amethyst Knife can speak telepathically with one another across any distance on the same plane.
Telekinetic Bastion. Allies within 20 ft. gain +2 AC and +2 on Dexterity saves. Enemies treat that area as difficult terrain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Maul attacks. Treyvan can replace one with Telekinetic Throw or Choke if available.
Maul. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller target can be knocked Prone or pushed up to 10 ft. away, at Treyvan's choice.
Telekinetic Throw. Make a Maul attack with a range of 30 ft. The maul immediately returns after the attack.
Choke (2/day, 5th-order power, concentration). A visible Large or smaller creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. Failure leaves it Restrained for up to 1 minute. It takes 14 (4d6) force damage at the start of its turns and can repeat the save at the end of each turn. The power ends if it gains total cover from Treyvan or moves beyond 30 ft.
sections.Reactions: Shared Condition. When the creature becomes Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned, it can transfer the condition and its remaining duration to a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 ft. who neither has the condition nor is immune to it. The condition ends for the original creature. This reaction works even while Incapacitated.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Amethyst Knife. The party can use one villain party action per round, after an enemy's turn. Each action is available once per encounter, in any order. The member taking it must be present and able to act.
Action 1, Amethyst Formation. Treyvan can move each willing Amethyst Knife boss he sees within 60 ft. up to 30 ft. in any direction.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): While Dazed, a creature can use only one of its movement, action, or bonus action on its turn. Gaining Dazed ends the turn if it happens during that turn. Extra actions such as Haste or Action Surge still work. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can end the condition.
sections.Psionic Powers (MCDM): Powers have no components and count as supernatural. Antimagic Field, Counterspell, and Dispel Magic do not stop powers. A creature may maintain several different powers at once, up to its proficiency bonus, but cannot concentrate on a spell or another effect at the same time. Failing a concentration save ends all active powers. If a foe provokes an opportunity attack, the creature can use a melee power attack as its reaction instead.

name: Kiona the Dread Lord
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Int +9, Wis +6. Arcana +9, History +9, Perception +6. Resists acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to necrotic and poison damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, and Unconscious. Blindsight 60 ft., passive Perception 16. Speaks Common, Draconic, and Orc.
description: The Codex Mortis destroyed the archaeologist Kiona Duemois’s body. She built an army of spectral undead to search for the lost book.

sections.Traits:
Corrupting Phasing. Kiona can cross through creatures and objects. She takes 5 (1d10) force damage if she ends her turn inside an object. Each creature she passes through takes 9 (2d8) necrotic damage the first time she passes through it on a turn.
Incorporeal Empowerment. Incorporeal Undead ignore difficult terrain while within 120 ft. of Kiona.
Spiritual Sacrifice (3/day). After failing a save, Kiona can lose 15 HP and succeed instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Energy Siphon attacks.
Energy Siphon. Melee or ranged spell attack +9, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one creature. Hit 15 (3d6 + 5) necrotic damage. The target cannot regain HP until the start of Kiona's next turn. She gains temporary HP equal to half the damage dealt.
Rise from Death (1/day). Summon three shadows, two specters, or one wraith under Kiona's control. They appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 ft. and act immediately after her on the same initiative count.
sections.Bonus Actions: Path of Pain. An incorporeal Undead other than Kiona within 120 ft. who can see her can move up to its speed.
sections.Reactions: Death’s Breath. After hitting Kiona with an attack from within 5 ft., the attacker must make a DC 17 Constitution save or be Poisoned through the end of its next turn.
sections.Villain Actions:
Kiona can use one of these actions after an enemy's turn, up to once per round. Each is available once per encounter, in any order.
Action 1, Restrain Them! Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Each enemy in a 20-ft.-radius sphere centered there makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. Failure leaves it Restrained until the end of Kiona's next turn.
Action 2, Ruinous March. Kiona and each ally within 60 ft. can move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Action 3, Vitality Drain. Kiona and each ally within 60 ft. can make a melee attack without using an action. A creature hit gains one level of Exhaustion.
sections.Mundane Attacks (MCDM): Magical and psionic attacks deal supernatural damage and bypass the listed resistance to mundane attacks.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: In the Shifting Library, surviving ground-floor undead join immediately and survivors upstairs arrive at the start of round three. At 30 HP or fewer, Kiona asks for mercy and opens a portal. She fights to the death if the party takes her books.

name: Boog
description: Boog is the Abominations’ bruiser. A rhino horn makes their charge as dangerous as their fists.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Str +7, Con +5. Skills Athletics +7, Intimidation +2. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 10. Common.

sections.Traits:
Boog Rampage. When Boog sees another Abomination drop to 0 HP, Boog rampages for 1 minute. Their melee attacks deal 2 extra damage while it lasts.
Boog Charge. If Boog moves at least 10 ft. straight toward a Medium or smaller creature and hits it with Gore on the same turn, the horn Grapples it (escape DC 15). The creature is Restrained and takes 3 (1d6) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. Boog cannot Gore another target until the grapple ends.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage, or 12 (1d10 + 7) during the rampage.
Gore. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage, or 10 (1d6 + 7) during the rampage.
Boog’s Ball. Throw a magic ball with a 3-inch radius to a visible point within 60 ft. The ball’s radius at that point is 5 ft. if the throw was up to 30 ft., or 10 ft. for a longer throw. Each creature in that area makes a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage on a failure. The ball shrinks and teleports back to the throwing hand.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Abominations. Once per encounter for each party action, after an enemy finishes its turn. The party can use the actions in any order, one per round. The creature performing the action must be present and must not be Incapacitated.
Action 5, Boog Stomp. Each grounded enemy within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and falls Prone. On a success, it takes half damage and stays upright.

name: Ceemal
description: The camel-headed Abomination looks after the others at camp. In a fight, Ceemal heals allies and draws them back out of danger.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Con +4, Int +5, Wis +6. Skills Medicine +6, Nature +5, Perception +6, Stealth +8, Survival +6. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 16. Common.

sections.Traits: Octopodan Camouflage. Ceemal can try to Hide while lightly obscured by natural conditions such as foliage, mist, heavy rain, or snow.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Fillet Knife attacks or two Acid Spit attacks.
Fillet Knife. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, another Abomination within 5 ft. of it heals for half the damage dealt.
Acid Spit. Ranged weapon attack +6, range 20/40 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) acid damage. The target is Poisoned until the start of Ceemal’s next turn.
sections.Bonus Actions: To Me, Sweetie (3/day). Choose an ally within 30 ft. who can hear Ceemal. The ally can spend its reaction to move up to its speed toward Ceemal without provoking opportunity attacks.
sections.Reactions: Wail of Loss. When an enemy within 60 ft. reduces another Abomination Ceemal can see to 0 HP, the enemy makes a DC 14 Constitution save. It takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Abominations. Once per encounter for each party action, after an enemy finishes its turn. The party can use the actions in any order, one per round. The creature performing the action must be present and must not be Incapacitated.
Action 3, All You Can Meat. Ceemal throws a piece of meat to every Abomination they can see within 30 ft. Each target that is not Incapacitated can eat the meat without spending an action and regain 8 (1d10 + 3) HP.

name: Excess
description: A subterranean scout with spider legs, a viper’s head, and a scorpion tail. Excess hunts from walls and ceilings.
otherStatistics: Saves Dex +6, Con +5. Skills Acrobatics +6, Perception +4, Stealth +8. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 14. Common.

sections.Traits: Spider Climb. Traverse difficult surfaces, including ceilings upside down, without making an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Sting attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller creature is Grappled (escape DC 14) and takes 2 (1d4) poison damage at the start of each of Excess’s turns. Excess cannot bite anyone else before this grapple ends.
Sting. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage. On a failed DC 13 Constitution save, the target is Poisoned for 1 minute and can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the condition.
Swallow. Use Bite on a Medium or smaller creature grappled by Excess or from which Excess is hidden. On a hit, swallow the creature. It is no longer Grappled, but is Blinded and Restrained and has total cover from attacks and other effects outside Excess. At the start of each of Excess’s turns, it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage. Excess can hold one swallowed creature. If Excess dies, the creature is no longer Restrained and can spend 5 ft. of movement to leave the corpse, exiting Prone.
sections.Bonus Actions: Cunning Action. Dash, Disengage, or Hide.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Abominations. Once per encounter for each party action, after an enemy finishes its turn. The party can use the actions in any order, one per round. The creature performing the action must be present and must not be Incapacitated.
Action 2, Hypnotize. Each creature in a 15-ft. cone from Excess must make a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Charmed by Excess and its speed is 0 until the start of Excess’s next turn.

name: Klar
description: The Abominations’ lion-headed hunt leader lures travelers close and drags them off with mantis claws.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Str +6, Con +5. Skills Athletics +6, Deception +5, Persuasion +5, Survival +5. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 11. Common.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. Klar can breathe air and water.
Mimicry. Klar can imitate animal sounds. A listener can detect the imitation with a DC 13 Wisdom (Insight) check.
Standing Leap. Klar can long jump up to 40 ft. or high jump up to 15 ft., with or without a running start.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Mantis Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Mantis Claws. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage. A Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 14) and Restrained for the duration. Moving with such a target does not halve Klar’s speed. Klar can hold only one target this way.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Bellowing Roar (1/day). Each creature that can hear Klar within 30 ft. must make a DC 13 Wisdom save or be Frightened of Klar for 1 minute. A creature that takes damage while Frightened this way can repeat the save to end the effect.
Kangaroo Leap. Jump up to half Klar’s speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Abominations. Once per encounter for each party action, after an enemy finishes its turn. The party can use the actions in any order, one per round. The creature performing the action must be present and must not be Incapacitated.
Action 4, Come and Get It. Klar can move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks and make up to two Mantis Claws attacks. Each Abomination within 30 ft. who can hear Klar can then move up to its speed toward Klar without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Sair
description: An owl-headed scout with dragon wings. Sair uses psionics to drive prey toward the Abominations on the ground.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Dex +6, Int +6. Skills Acrobatics +6, Perception +2, Survival +2. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 12. Common. Telepathy 120 ft.

sections.Traits: Flyby. Flying out of an enemy’s reach does not provoke an opportunity attack.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.
Psionic Bolt (1st-order power). Ranged power attack +6, range 120 ft., one target. Hit 10 (3d6) psychic damage. A Large or smaller target is pushed 5 ft. away.
Mind Scream (1/day, 3rd-order power). Each enemy within 30 ft. makes a DC 14 Intelligence save. It takes 17 (5d6) psychic damage on a failure or half on a success. A creature reduced to 0 HP by this damage is automatically stable.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Abominations. Once per encounter for each party action, after an enemy finishes its turn. The party can use the actions in any order, one per round. The creature performing the action must be present and must not be Incapacitated.
Action 1, Aerial Transport. Move up to twice Sair’s speed. Before or during the move, pick up one willing Large Abomination or up to two willing Medium or smaller Abominations within 5 ft. Sair can release them at any point and must release them at the end. Any creature released at least 10 ft. above the ground lands Prone and takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage per 10 ft. fallen.
sections.Psionic Powers (MCDM): Powers are supernatural and have no components. Antimagic Field, Counterspell, and Dispel Magic do not affect powers.

ruleNotes: Sair can attack from 120 ft. away while airborne. Against a melee-heavy party, have Sair fly low enough for characters to respond.

name: Aronar Valkys
description: Aronar wields divine magic for the Hallowed Dark and can heal Athmia while restoring an ally.
otherStatistics: Plate and shield. Saves Dex +4, Con +5, Wis +11. Skills Insight +11, Perception +11. Resists acid and necrotic damage. Blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 21. Common, Draconic, and Elvish.

sections.Traits:
Charm Resistant. Aronar has advantage on saves against gaining or retaining the Charmed condition.
Delusions of Grandeur. If an effect lets Aronar save at the end of his turn, he can also repeat that save at the start. When he succeeds on a save against an effect, it ends on Aronar and on any ally with the same effect within 30 ft. of him.
Sun Eater’s Grace (3/day). If Aronar is within 30 ft. of Athmia Valkys when his spell heals another creature, Athmia regains the same number of HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Divine Mace attacks, or make one Divine Mace attack and one God Complex attack.
Divine Mace. Melee weapon attack +11, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (1d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The target is Blinded until the start of its next turn on a failed DC 19 Constitution save.
God Complex (3/day, 3rd-level spell). Ranged spell attack +11, range 120 ft., one target. Hit 28 (8d6) necrotic damage. The next attack roll against this target before the end of Aronar’s next turn has advantage.
