Heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields prevent this, but the creature can drop held items as part of the reaction.

name: Hedge Bard
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Dex +4, Cha +5. Acrobatics +4, Perception +5, Performance +7. Passive Perception 15. Speaks Birdfolk and Hedge. Can also speak with beasts of any size that take the form of spiders, insects, worms, or other bugs.
description: A traveling performer who can use a cutting remark to throw an opponent off balance.

sections.Spellcasting:
4th-level Charisma spellcaster. Spell save DC 13, +5 to hit.
Cantrips, at will. Gust Barrier, Prestidigitation, Vicious Mockery.
1st level, 4 slots. Charm Person, Healing Word, Hideous Laughter, Thunderwave.
2nd level, 3 slots. Invisibility, Shatter, Suggestion.
Gust Barrier. Cast as an action on self. Ranged attacks against the bard have disadvantage until the end of the bard’s next turn. A melee attacker that hits during that time makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, the bard pushes the attacker up to 10 ft. away and knocks it Prone.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one attack with Rapier and one with Dagger.
Rapier. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Curl Up. The hedge curls into a ball and its base AC becomes 19. While curled up it cannot move, attack, or cast spells with somatic components. A creature that misses it with a melee attack takes 2d4 piercing damage. If a creature hits the hedge, it falls Prone in its space at the end of the turn. The hedge can uncurl at any point during its own turn.
sections.Bonus Actions: Taunt (2/day). Choose a creature within 30 ft. If it can hear the bard, it makes a DC 13 Charisma save. On a failure, its ability checks, attacks and saves have disadvantage until the start of the bard’s next turn.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, pp. 198–199. Stat block p. 199. Gust Barrier p. 51.

ruleNotes: The rapier uses the printed 1d6 damage die.

name: Hedge Witch
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Arcana +4, Survival +4. Passive Perception 12. Speaks Abyssal, Birdfolk and Hedge. Can also speak with beasts of any size that take the form of spiders, insects, worms, or other bugs.
description: A hedge spellcaster who learned through a pact. Susan of the Swamp uses this block with chaotic good alignment.

sections.Traits:
Dark One’s Blessing. Gain 5 temporary HP after reducing a hostile creature to 0 HP.
Repelling Blast. An Eldritch Blast hit can push its target up to 10 ft. straight away from the witch.
sections.Spellcasting:
2nd-level Charisma spellcaster. Spell save DC 13, +5 to hit.
Cantrips, at will. Eldritch Blast, Minor Illusion.
1st level, 2 slots. Hellish Rebuke, Charm Person, Unseen Servant.
sections.Actions:
Staff. Melee weapon attack, +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage.
Fiendish Vigor. Cast False Life at will as a 1st-level spell.
Curl Up. The hedge curls into a ball and its base AC becomes 19. While curled up it cannot move, attack, or cast spells with somatic components. A creature that misses it with a melee attack takes 2d4 piercing damage. If a creature hits the hedge, it falls Prone in its space at the end of the turn. The hedge can uncurl at any point during its own turn.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, pp. 198–199. Stat block p. 199.

name: Jerbeen Swashbuckler
otherStatistics: Leather armor. Acrobatics +8, Athletics +5, Persuasion +6. Passive Perception 10. Speaks Birdfolk and Jerbeen.
description: A nimble duelist who can turn aside a hit and answer it in the same motion.

sections.Traits:
Standing Leap. Long jump up to 30 ft. or high jump up to 15 ft., with or without a running start.
Sharp Witted Defense. Include the swashbuckler’s Charisma modifier in AC while it wears light armor or no armor and carries no shield.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Dagger attack and two Rapier attacks.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.
Rapier. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Team Tactics. Take the Help action as a bonus action.
sections.Reactions: Riposte. When a melee attack would hit, reduce its damage by 4 (1d8) and deal the same amount of piercing damage to the attacker. The swashbuckler must see the attacker and wield a melee weapon.

ruleNotes: The hit-point expression is printed as 8d6 + 6 despite Constitution +1. Use the printed 34 HP.

name: Jerbeen Thief
otherStatistics: Leather armor. Acrobatics +4, Sleight of Hand +4. Passive Perception 12. Speaks Birdfolk and Jerbeen.
description: A nimble pickpocket who can steal from someone who leaves an opening in melee.

sections.Traits: Standing Leap. Long jump up to 30 ft. or high jump up to 15 ft., with or without a running start.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Dagger attacks.
Dagger. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Team Tactics. Take the Help action as a bonus action.
sections.Reactions: Opportunist. After a creature misses the thief with a melee attack, the thief can make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check against DC 10 plus that creature’s Dexterity modifier. On a success, the thief takes one item the GM chooses. It must be something the attacker is carrying without holding or wearing it.

name: Lesser Demon
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Resists cold, fire and lightning damage. Immune to poison damage and the Poisoned condition. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 9. Speaks Abyssal.
description: A failed summoning can bring this troublesome fiend in place of whatever the caster meant to call.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.
Foul Odor (1/day). Fill a 20-ft. sphere with poison gas for 1 minute. The gas reaches around corners and heavily obscures the area. A creature entirely inside at the start of its turn makes a DC 11 Constitution save. On a failure, it spends its action retching. Poison immunity prevents the effect. Wind of at least 10 mph clears the gas after 4 rounds. Wind of at least 20 mph clears it after 1 round.

ruleNotes: The Foul Odor entry gives a 20-ft. sphere without specifying radius or diameter.

name: Luma Cleric of Ardea
otherStatistics: Chain shirt. Medicine +7, Persuasion +4, Religion +2. Passive Perception 13. Speaks Birdfolk and one other language. Understands Auran without speaking it.
description: An itinerant healer who carries Ardea’s teachings from grove to grove.

sections.Traits: Fated. Once per long rest, reroll an attack roll, skill check, or saving throw.
sections.Spellcasting:
5th-level Wisdom spellcaster. Spell save DC 13, +5 to hit.
Cantrips, at will. Light, Sacred Flame, Thaumaturgy.
1st level, 4 slots. Bless, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt.
2nd level, 3 slots. Lesser Restoration, Spiritual Weapon.
3rd level, 2 slots. Dispel Magic, Beacon of Hope.
sections.Actions:
Staff. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) with two hands.
Ardea’s Vigor (1/day). The cleric and up to three allies within 30 ft. gain 5 (2d4) temporary HP. For 1 minute, each recipient gains 5 temporary HP at the start of each of its turns.
Songbird. Once per long rest, cast Charm Person using Charisma, save DC 12. This casting needs no somatic components.
sections.Bonus Actions: Wing Flap. Rise up to half the creature’s movement speed. This can extend a regular jump and is unavailable while gliding.
sections.Reactions: Glide. When falling at least 10 ft., use a reaction to fly in one direction up to the creature’s speed while descending. Land in an empty space and take no falling damage. Heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields prevent this, but the creature can drop held items as part of the reaction.

name: Luma Wizard
otherStatistics: AC 15 with Mage Armor. Saving throws Int +7, Wis +4. Arcana +7, History +7. Resists poison damage. Passive Perception 11. Speaks Auran, Birdfolk and three other languages.
description: An arcane scholar who can turn an incoming attack toward someone else.

sections.Traits:
Fated. Once per long rest, reroll an attack roll, skill check, or saving throw.
Resilience. The wizard makes saving throws against poison with advantage.
sections.Spellcasting:
10th-level Intelligence spellcaster. Spell save DC 15, +7 to hit.
Cantrips, at will. Chill Touch, Fire Bolt, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation, Ray of Frost.
1st level, 4 slots. Charm Person, Detect Magic, Mage Armor, Shield, Sleep, Thunderwave.
2nd level, 3 slots. Darkness, Hold Person, Ray of Enfeeblement.
3rd level, 3 slots. Counterspell, Fireball.
4th level, 3 slots. Banishment, Stellar Bodies.
5th level, 2 slots. Conjure Elemental, Mislead.
Stellar Bodies. Cast as an action. Two orbiting stars shed dim light to 10 ft. for up to 1 minute. A creature within 5 ft. that hits the wizard in melee makes a DC 15 Wisdom save, taking 1d8 radiant damage per remaining star on a failure. Once per round on the wizard’s turn, use an action to expend one star and make a ranged spell attack (+7 to hit) against an enemy within 120 ft. It deals 4d8 radiant damage on a hit. The target then makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is Blinded until the start of the wizard’s next turn. The spell ends when time runs out, the wizard falls Unconscious, or all stars are spent. Each two slot levels above 4th add one star and 5 ft. to the light radius.
sections.Actions: Staff. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Wing Flap. Rise up to half the creature’s movement speed. This can extend a regular jump and is unavailable while gliding.
sections.Reactions:
Glide. When falling at least 10 ft., use a reaction to fly in one direction up to the creature’s speed while descending. Land in an empty space and take no falling damage. Heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields prevent this, but the creature can drop held items as part of the reaction.
Charming (3/day). When a creature attacks the wizard, it makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure, it targets the next closest creature within range, choosing between ties. This has no effect if no other creature is in range.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, p. 201. Stellar Bodies p. 52.

name: Mountain Lion
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +4, Stealth +4. Passive Perception 14. No languages.
description: A rock-armored ambush hunter from the Crest Mountains. Its roar can bring down the rocks around its prey.

sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
Pounce. After moving at least 20 ft. toward a creature and hitting it with Claw on the same turn, the target makes a DC 13 Strength save or falls Prone.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.
Call Avalanche. Once per short or long rest, while in mountainous terrain, center a rockslide on a visible space within 60 ft. Each creature in its 15-ft. radius makes a DC 12 Dexterity save, taking 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Bonus Actions: Pounce Bite. The mountain lion can make a Bite attack against a Prone target.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, pp. 184–185. Stat block p. 185.

name: Mapach Bandit
otherStatistics: Leather armor. Resists poison damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Speaks Birdfolk and Mapach.
description: A bandit who uses darkness and climbable terrain to set up an ambush.

sections.Traits:
Resilience. The bandit rolls saves against being poisoned with advantage.
Skulker. In dim light or darkness, the bandit has advantage on Stealth checks.
sections.Actions:
Short Sword. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

ruleNotes: This printing gives the Short Sword slashing damage.

name: Mapach Brute
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Dex save +5, Cha save +4. Deception +4, Persuasion +4. Resists poison damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Speaks Birdfolk and Mapach.
description: A bandit enforcer who fights with a rapier and parrying dagger. Krall uses this profile.

sections.Traits:
Resilience. The brute rolls saves against being poisoned with advantage.
Skulker. In dim light or darkness, the brute has advantage on Stealth checks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rapier attacks and one Parrying Dagger attack.
Rapier. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Parrying Dagger. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Parry. Add 2 AC against a melee attack that would hit the brute. They must see the attacker and hold a melee weapon.

name: Mapach Tinkerer
otherStatistics: Resists poison damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Speaks Birdfolk and Mapach.
description: A practical inventor with a kit of gadgets that can disrupt a fight.

sections.Traits:
Resilience. The tinkerer rolls saves against being poisoned with advantage.
Skulker. In dim light or darkness, the tinkerer has advantage on Stealth checks.
sections.Actions:
Dagger. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Tinker's Toys. Choose a gadget or roll 1d4. Each gadget can be used once per day.
1. Cogwork Bird. Distract a creature within 30 ft. The next attack against it has advantage.
2. Flash-bangs. Choose a point within 10 ft. Each creature within 10 ft. of that point makes a DC 11 Con save. On a failure it is blinded until the start of the tinkerer's next turn.
3. Nettle Gun. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 10/20 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. Each creature within 5 ft. of the target makes a DC 11 Dex save or takes 5 (1d10) piercing damage.
4. Grease Balloon. Coat a 10-ft. square within 15 ft. in grease, making the area difficult terrain. Creatures in the square when it is coated, those that enter it, and those that end their turn there must pass a DC 11 Dex save or fall prone.

ruleNotes: The printed Grease Balloon entry leaves the duration of the grease unspecified.

name: Raptor Explorer
otherStatistics: Leather armor. History +2, Perception +6, Stealth +4, Survival +6. Passive Perception 16. Understands Auran and speaks Birdfolk.
description: A guide who ignores difficult natural ground and can use readied actions to turn a tight spot to their advantage.

sections.Traits:
Talons. The explorer has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces their talons can grip.
Patient. During a readied action taken as a reaction, the explorer has advantage on their first attack roll, skill check, or ability check.
Keen Hearing and Sight. The explorer has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use hearing or sight.
Sure Footing. The explorer ignores nonmagical difficult terrain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks or two Hand Crossbow attacks.
Talons. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Saber. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Hand Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Glide. After falling at least 10 ft., the explorer can spend a reaction to glide up to their speed in one direction while descending. They land in a free space at the end and take no fall damage. They need to be free of heavy objects, heavy weapons, and shields to glide. They can drop anything held as part of the same reaction.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, p. 204. Explorer background, p. 203.

name: Raptor Ranger
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Athletics +3, Stealth +7, Survival +5. Passive Perception 13. Speaks Birdfolk and Mapach. Understands Auran.
description: A wilderness archer who can scout through an arrow fired from a Red-Feather Bow.

sections.Traits:
Talons. The ranger has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces their talons can grip.
Aerial Defense. Attack rolls against the ranger have disadvantage while the ranger falls, glides, or jumps.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Red-Feather Bow attacks.
Red-Feather Bow. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Dagger. Weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
Talons. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Arrow Sight (3/day). When the ranger fires their Red-Feather Bow, see for 1 minute from the spot where that arrow lands. If it hits a creature, see through that creature's eyes instead.
Hunter (3/day). The ranger's next shortbow or longbow attack deals an extra 1d10 damage.
sections.Reactions: Glide. After falling at least 10 ft., the ranger can spend a reaction to glide up to their speed in one direction while descending. They land in a free space at the end and take no fall damage. They need to be free of heavy objects, heavy weapons, and shields to glide. They can drop anything held as part of the same reaction.
sections.Spellcasting: The ranger casts as a 3rd-level Wisdom spellcaster (save DC 13, +5 to spell attacks). 1st level (3 slots) Cure Wounds, Fog Cloud, Hunter's Mark, Protection from Evil and Good.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, p. 205. Ranger background, p. 203. Red-Feather Bow, Appendix D, p. 214.

ruleNotes: The printed Red-Feather Bow lists 6 average damage and a roll of 1d6 + 4. Those values differ. The Dagger lists a 20/60 ft. range alongside its melee label. Use the listed range when it is thrown.

name: Strig Knight
otherStatistics: Half plate and shield. Con save +5, Wis save +4. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Understands Auran and speaks Birdfolk.
description: A Perch Guard knight who can open a retreat route for an ally. Riffin the Ash-Knight uses this profile with lawful good alignment.

sections.Traits:
Talons. The knight has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces their talons can grip.
Maneuver (2/day). After the knight hits, an ally within 5 ft. of the target can use their reaction to move away from it at half speed without provoking an opportunity attack.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Short Sword attacks.
Short Sword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Talons. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
Wing Crest Shield (1/day). Use the shield to cast Gust of Wind (save DC 15).
sections.Bonus Actions: After hitting with Talons, the knight can grapple the target as a bonus action.
sections.Reactions: Glide. After falling at least 10 ft., the knight can spend a reaction to glide up to their speed in one direction while descending. They land in a free space at the end and take no fall damage. They need to be free of heavy objects, heavy weapons, and shields to glide. They can drop anything held as part of the same reaction.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, p. 205. Knight background, p. 204. Wing Crest Shield, Appendix D, p. 214.

ruleNotes: The printed Wisdom save is +4. The Talons entry allows a grapple but supplies no special escape DC, so use the normal grapple rules.

name: Strig Tracker
otherStatistics: Hide armor. Acrobatics +6, Perception +4, Survival +4. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15. Speaks Birdfolk and two other languages. Understands Auran.
description: A woodland tracker who can search for a hidden creature while keeping pressure on a fight.

sections.Traits:
Talons. The tracker has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces their talons can grip.
Patterned Feathers. The tracker has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in a forest.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one melee Longsword and one melee Handaxe attack, or two ranged Handaxe attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) when held in two hands.
Handaxe. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Talons. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Reya's Keen Eye. Make a Wisdom (Perception) check to find hidden creatures.
sections.Reactions: Glide. After falling at least 10 ft., the tracker can spend a reaction to glide up to their speed in one direction while descending. They land in a free space at the end and take no fall damage. They need to be free of heavy objects, heavy weapons, and shields to glide. They can drop anything held as part of the same reaction.
sections.Spellcasting:
The tracker casts as a 3rd-level Wisdom spellcaster (save DC 12, +4 to spell attacks). 1st level (3 slots) Elevated Sight, Hunter's Mark, Longstrider, Speak with Animals.
Elevated Sight takes one action and lasts up to 1 minute with concentration. A moving, invisible sensor gives the caster a 360-degree view from up to 120 ft. above them. They can change its height as a bonus action and switch to their own sight during their turn. Their own eyes are blind while they view through the sensor.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, p. 206. Elevated Sight, p. 49.

ruleNotes: The printed passive Perception is 15 even though its Perception skill is listed as +4.

name: Vulpin Captain
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Acrobatics +4, Perception +4. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14. Speaks Birdfolk and Vulpin.
description: A bandit officer who coordinates raids and is capable of running a camp. Fray Merridan uses this profile.

sections.Traits: Evasive. Add the captain's Intelligence modifier to Dexterity saves.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Short Sword. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Parry (1/round). Add 2 AC against a melee attack that would hit the captain. They must see the attacker and hold a melee weapon.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, pp. 208–209. Captain background, p. 207.

name: Vulpin Noble
otherStatistics: Breastplate. Deception +5, History +4, Insight +3, Persuasion +5. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Speaks Birdfolk and Vulpin.
description: A courtier who can throw an opponent off balance with a timely insult.

sections.Traits: Evasive. Add the noble's Intelligence modifier to Dexterity saves.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.
Rapier. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Disparaging Remark. When someone the noble sees attacks an ally, impose disadvantage on that attack roll if the attacker can hear and understand the noble.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, p. 209. Noble background, p. 208.

name: Vulpin Priest of Kren
otherStatistics: Chain shirt. Medicine +7, Persuasion +3, Religion +5. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13. Speaks Birdfolk, Celestial, and Vulpin.
description: A priest of the fox Amaranthine who can turn a spell slot into venomous melee strikes. Shyla Denn uses this profile.

sections.Traits: Evasive. Add the priest's Intelligence modifier to Dexterity saves.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Mace. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Divine Eminence. Spend a spell slot. Until the end of the turn, the priest's melee weapon hits deal an extra 10 (3d6) poison damage. Add 1d6 more damage for each slot level above 1st.
sections.Spellcasting:
The priest casts as a 5th-level Wisdom spellcaster (save DC 13, +5 to spell attacks).
Cantrips at will. Light, Sacred Flame, Thaumaturgy.
1st level (4 slots). Cure Wounds, Disguise Self, Guiding Bolt.
2nd level (3 slots). Lesser Restoration, Mirror Image, Spiritual Weapon.
3rd level (2 slots). Blink, Spirit Guardians.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, p. 209. Shyla Denn, p. 208.

name: Amalgamation
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Str +17, Dex +7, Con +14, Int +13, Wis +11. Arcana +13, Deception +12, Insight +11, Perception +11. Immune to psychic damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons. Immune to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, and Stunned. Truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 21. All languages and telepathy 1 mile.
description: An aberration that forms around a planar rupture and draws other creatures through.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Malignancy. It cannot be teleported or taken to another plane against its will.
Immutable Form. Effects that would alter its form fail.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
sections.Innate Spellcasting: Charisma, save DC 20, no components. At will, Detect Thoughts and Dispel Magic.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Contaminating Presence and make three Tentacle attacks. Any of those attacks can be replaced with Fling.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +17, reach 5 ft., one target, 23 (3d8 + 10) piercing. A Large or smaller target already Grappled by the amalgamation is Swallowed, ending that grapple. Inside, it is Blinded and Restrained, has total cover from outside, takes 42 (12d6) acid damage, and gains one level of Contamination at the start of the amalgamation's turns. If the amalgamation takes 50 or more damage in a single turn from a creature inside it, it makes a DC 25 Constitution save at the end of that turn. On a failure all swallowed creatures fall Prone within 10 ft. If it dies, they cease to be Restrained and can spend 15 ft. of movement to exit Prone.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack +17, reach 50 ft., one target, 20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning. Grapple the target (escape DC 18). It is Restrained while grappled. Each of twelve tentacles can hold one target.
Fling. Throw one Large or smaller held object or grappled creature up to 60 ft. A thrown creature lands Prone. Against a solid surface, it takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning per 10 ft. thrown. A creature the target is thrown at must pass a DC 18 Dexterity save or take the same damage and fall Prone.
Mind-breaking Whispers. One creature within 120 ft. must pass a DC 20 Intelligence save or take 35 (10d6) psychic damage and become insane until it finishes a long rest. It cannot take actions, understand speech, or read, and can only speak gibberish. Greater Restoration ends the effect.
Contaminating Presence. Each humanoid within 120 ft. must pass a DC 20 Constitution save or take 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and gain one level of Contamination.
sections.Legendary Actions:
Three legendary actions per round. Use one option after another creature's turn and recover spent actions at the start of this creature's turn.
Tentacle Attack or Fling. Use either option.
Mind-breaking Whispers (2 actions). Use Mind-breaking Whispers.
Piper at the Gate (3 actions). Summon up to five gibbering mouthers into empty spaces within 30 ft. They obey the amalgamation, act immediately after it on the same initiative count, and remain until destroyed. It can have at most ten mouthers summoned by this action.

name: Crimson Countess
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Con +5, Wis +5. Acrobatics +11, Deception +7, Perception +8. Immune to lightning and thunder. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 16. Abyssal.
description: A harpy matriarch who fights in flight with an electrified javelin.

sections.Traits: Keen Sight. Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use sight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. She can use Frightful Screech, then make two Talons attacks or one Javelin attack.
Talons. Melee weapon attack +8, reach 5 ft., one target, 11 (1d10 + 5) slashing.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack +8, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target, 9 (1d6 + 5) piercing plus 14 (4d6) lightning.
Frightful Screech. Chosen creatures within 120 ft. that are not Deafened must pass a DC 15 Wisdom save or become Frightened for 1 minute. While affected, a creature must Dash and flee by the safest route on each turn if possible. It repeats the save whenever it ends a turn out of her line of sight. A successful save or the end of the effect grants immunity to her screech for 24 hours.
Thunder Blast (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 15-ft. cube make a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 14 (4d6) thunder damage, getting pushed 10 ft., and falling Prone on failure. On success they only take half damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Aerial Acrobat. Dash, Disengage, or Dodge.

name: Executioner
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Str +15, Con +13, Wis +6. Immune to poison and psychic damage and to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons that are not adamantine. Immune to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 10. Understands Common without speaking.
description: An execution construct that patrols Slaughterstone Square and hurls a returning blade.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Immutable Form. Effects that would alter its form fail.
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
Rejuvenation. After destruction, it returns at full HP after 24 hours unless someone casts Disintegrate on the remains.
sections.Actions:
Guillotine Blade. Melee or ranged weapon attack +15, reach 10 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target, 30 (6d6 + 9) slashing plus 14 (4d6) necrotic. On a failed DC 21 Constitution save, reduce the target's maximum HP by the necrotic damage taken until it finishes a long rest. A target whose maximum HP becomes 0 dies. The blade returns immediately after a ranged attack.
Necrotic Vents (recharge 5–6). Each creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 21 Constitution save, taking 45 (10d8) necrotic damage on failure or half on success. A creature that fails by 5 or more gains one level of Contamination.
sections.Legendary Actions:
Three legendary actions per round. Use one option after another creature's turn and recover spent actions at the start of this creature's turn.
Lumber Forward (2 actions). Move up to half speed.
Attack (2 actions). Make a melee or ranged Guillotine Blade attack.
Summon Shadows (3 actions). Up to six visible humanoid corpses within 60 ft. that died violently each produce a shadow in their space or the nearest empty one. They obey the Executioner and act after it on the same initiative count. They disappear after 1 minute or if the Executioner is destroyed, and can be destroyed earlier.

ruleNotes: The stat block lists CR 20 without an XP figure. The profile uses the standard 25,000 XP value.

name: Gravekeeper
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Con +10, Wis +8, Cha +10. Perception +13. Truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 23. Understands all languages without speaking.
description: A floating mass of former cryptkeepers carrying lanterns whose beams have different effects.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Dazzling Illumination. Sheds bright light for 60 ft. and imposes disadvantage on attacks against it. A hit disrupts the trait until the end of its next turn. It is also disrupted while it is Incapacitated or its speed is 0.
sections.Actions:
Slam. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 10 ft., one target, 14 (4d8 + 4) bludgeoning plus 10 (3d6) necrotic.
Lantern Blast. Every creature within 120 ft. without total cover rolls a d6 for the ray that strikes it. The save DC is 18. Failure deals 35 (10d6) damage of the listed type and applies that ray's effect. Table ruling. Success halves the damage and prevents the other effects for every ray.
sections.Lantern Blast Rays:
1. Dispelling Blast. Intelligence save, psychic damage. End all spells and magical effects on the target and break its spell concentration.
2. Forceful Blast. Strength save, force damage. Push 20 ft. away and knock Prone.
3. Blinding Blast. Constitution save, radiant damage. Blinded for 1 minute. Repeat the save on each of the target's turns to end it.
4. Contamining Blast. Constitution save, necrotic damage and one level of Contamination.
5. Igniting Blast. Dexterity save, fire damage. The target also takes 35 (10d6) fire damage at the start of its turns until someone spends an action to douse it.
6. Freezing Blast. Constitution save, cold damage. No reactions until the end of the target's next turn. On that turn it can only do one of these: move, take an action, or take a bonus action.
sections.Legendary Actions:
Three legendary actions per round. Use one option after another creature's turn and recover spent actions at the start of this creature's turn.
Slam. Make one Slam attack.
Glide. Move up to speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Lantern Blast (3 actions). Use Lantern Blast.
sections.Lair Actions:
At initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one effect. Each must be used before an effect repeats, and the same effect cannot occur in consecutive rounds.
Sludge Spout. A 10-ft.-radius, 30-ft.-high cylinder erupts. Creatures inside make a DC 18 Constitution save. Failure deals 42 (12d6) necrotic damage and one level of Contamination. Success halves the damage.
Grasping Walls. Walls within 120 ft. grow arms. Chosen creatures starting a turn within 10 ft. of one make a DC 15 Dexterity save or become Grappled. Escape with a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.
Lantern. A torch or lantern in the room emits a Lantern Blast.

ruleNotes: Slam preserves the printed average of 14 alongside the printed formula 4d8 + 4. For rolled damage, use the formula.
The successful save instruction follows ray 6 in the printing. This profile applies it to all six rays.

name: Lord of the Feast
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Con +9, Dex +9, Wis +9, Cha +6. Athletics +9, Perception +14, Stealth +14, Survival +9. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 24. Abyssal.
description: A garmyr hunter who uses specialized arrows to snare, drag, or contaminate prey.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Regeneration. Regain 20 HP at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 HP.
Close-Quarters Hunter. Hostile creatures within 5 ft. do not give his ranged attacks disadvantage.
Predatory Senses. Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks. He pinpoints Invisible creatures within 120 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make a Bite and two Claws attacks, or one attack with each of the three arrow types.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 5 ft., one target, 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing plus 18 (4d8) necrotic. DC 17 Constitution save or one level of Contamination.
Claws. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 10 ft., one target, 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing.
Contaminating Arrow. Ranged weapon attack +9, range 150/600 ft., one target, 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing plus 18 (4d8) necrotic. DC 17 Constitution save or one level of Contamination.
Ensnaring Arrow. Ranged weapon attack +9, range 150/600 ft., one target, 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing. A Large or smaller target must pass a DC 17 Dexterity save or become Restrained for 1 minute. It can spend an action to repeat the save and escape.
Harpoon Arrow. Ranged weapon attack +9, range 150/600 ft., one target, 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing. A Huge or smaller creature must pass a DC 17 Strength save or be pulled up to 20 ft. directly toward him.
sections.Legendary Actions:
Three legendary actions per round. Use one option after another creature's turn and recover spent actions at the start of this creature's turn.
Dash. Move up to speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Arrow (2 actions). Make an arrow attack of his choice.
Call of the Hunt (3 actions). His howl can be heard around Drakkenheim. Garmyr within 60 ft. that can see and hear him can use a reaction to move up to half speed and make one melee or ranged attack with advantage.

name: Pale Man
otherStatistics: AC 15 with Mage Armor. Saves Int +10, Con +8, Wis +7. Arcana +10, Perception +7, History +10. Immune to necrotic and poison. Resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons. Immune to Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, and Restrained. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15. Common and five other languages.
description: A wizard held together by swarming insects, able to reform if the swarm escapes.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Insect Body. It can share spaces with creatures and pass through openings large enough for a Tiny insect.
Crawling Flesh. At 0 HP, it breaks into a swarm of insects in its space. If that swarm survives, it returns to the cocoon and reforms after 1d6 days.
sections.Spellcasting:
16th-level wizard. Intelligence, save DC 18, +10 to hit.
At will: Chill Touch, Mage Hand, Mending, Prestidigitation, Shocking Grasp.
1st level (4 slots): Delerium Orb, Mage Armor, Magic Missile, Shield.
2nd level (3 slots): Hold Person, Invisibility, Warp Bolt.
3rd level (3 slots): Counterspell, Lightning Bolt, Purge Contamination.
4th level (3 slots): Delerium Blast, Forced Evolution.
5th level (3 slots): Conjure the Deep Haze, Siphon Contamination.
6th level (1 slot): Chain Lightning.
7th level (1 slot): Octarine Spray.
8th level (1 slot): Antimagic Field.
sections.Setting Spells:
Delerium Orb. Action, 120 ft. One visible creature makes a save using an ability chosen by the caster. Choose cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, psychic, or radiant damage. Deal 6d6 on failure or half on success, plus 2d6 per slot level above 1st.
Warp Bolt. Action, 60 ft., concentrate up to 1 minute. Automatically hit a contaminated target, or make a ranged spell attack against an uncontaminated one. A hit deals 6d6 necrotic and one level of Contamination. On later turns, use an action for a new bolt. Each slot level above 2nd permits one more target.
Delerium Blast. Action, 150 ft. Creatures in a 20-ft.-radius sphere make an Intelligence save. Failure deals 10d6 psychic damage and Incapacitates until the end of the target's next turn. Success halves damage and prevents Incapacitated. Add 2d6 per slot level above 4th.
Conjure the Deep Haze. Action, 120 ft., concentrate up to 10 minutes. A 20-ft.-radius sphere spreads around corners and is heavily obscured until it ends or strong wind clears it. First entry on a turn or starting a turn there forces a Constitution save. Failure deals 8d6 necrotic and one level of Contamination. Success halves damage without Contamination. Holding breath does not help.
Octarine Spray. Action, 60-ft. cone. Each creature makes a Constitution save. Roll a d8 for each creature. On rolls of 1–5, deal 20d6 psychic, necrotic, force, radiant, or thunder damage respectively, half on success. On a failed save, 6 compels the target to spend its movement approaching the nearest visible creature and use its action to attack a random creature in reach, with a Wisdom save at each turn's end to stop. A 7 causes a level of Contamination at each turn's start, with a Constitution save at each turn's end to stop. An 8 adds two rolls and can repeat.
Each spell above consumes a 100 gp delerium fragment and gives its caster one level of Contamination.
Purge Contamination. One hour, touch. Consume 100 gp of alchemical fluids or holy water to clear a humanoid's Contamination and mutations. It gains one Exhaustion level per level removed.
Forced Evolution. Eight hours, touch. Consume a 250 gp alchemical mixture to replace one mutation with one selected by the GM or rolled randomly.
Siphon Contamination. One hour, touch. Consume 500 gp of alchemical fluids and a 5,000 gp delerium geode. A second willing humanoid takes all Contamination removed from a first willing humanoid, whose mutations are also removed. A transformed former humanoid can instead return to their original form if the second willing humanoid has at least their transformed CR in levels or CR. The recipient then undergoes Monstrous Transformation. Preventing the transfer makes the spell fail.
sections.Actions:
Contaminating Touch. Melee spell attack +8, reach 10 ft., one target, 10 (3d6) necrotic. DC 16 Constitution save or one level of Contamination.
Infest the Flesh (recharge 6). Each creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 16 Dexterity save. Failure deals 22 (5d8) necrotic and Restrains the creature. It takes 22 (5d8) necrotic at the start of each of the Pale Man's turns. It repeats the save at the end of its own turns to end the effect.
sections.Legendary Actions:
Three legendary actions per round. Use one option after another creature's turn and recover spent actions at the start of this creature's turn.
Cantrip. Cast a cantrip.
Slither (2 actions). Move up to speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Contaminate (3 actions). Each target Restrained by Infest the Flesh makes a DC 16 Constitution save or gains one level of Contamination.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, pp. 212–213. Setting spells, Appendix D, pp. 227–229.

ruleNotes: Contaminating Touch and Infest the Flesh use their printed attack bonus and save DC. These differ from the general Spellcasting numbers.
The stat block lists Siphon Contamination among the 5th-level slots, but Appendix D defines it as a 6th-level spell. Table ruling. Use the Appendix D level when casting it.

name: Rat Prince
otherStatistics: Leather armor. Acrobatics +6, Athletics +3, Perception +6, Stealth +8. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15. Common.
description: An armored ratling raider who carries delerium-laced bolts.

sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use smell.
Pack Tactics. Advantage against a target if a non-Incapacitated ally is within 5 ft. of it.
Contaminated Ammunition. Carries 2d6 contaminated projectiles. A hit with one adds 1d6 damage and forces a DC 10 Constitution save. Failure adds one level of Contamination.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Shortsword attacks and one Contaminated Bite attack.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target, 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing.
Contaminated Bite. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target, 4 (1d4 + 4) piercing plus 10 (3d6) necrotic. DC 11 Constitution save or one level of Contamination.
Hand Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack +6, range 30/120 ft., one target, 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing.
sections.Bonus Actions: Cunning Action. Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

ruleNotes: The printed Contaminated Bite lists 4 piercing damage and a roll of 1d4 + 4. Use the formula when rolling.

name: Eldrick Runeweaver
otherStatistics: Robe of the Archmage and Staff of Power. Saves Str +1, Dex +2, Con +10, Int +13, Wis +11, Cha +4. Arcana +16, History +16, Perception +16, Persuasion +14. Resists damage from spells. Truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 26. All languages.
description: An Amethyst Academy archwizard equipped with a Staff of Power and rare consumables.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Special Equipment: Robe of the Archmage, Staff of Power, Ring of Spell Storing, and 2d6 very rare spell scrolls and potions. The block gives no fixed contents for the ring or the consumables.
sections.Spellcasting:
20th-level wizard. Intelligence, save DC 19, +11 to hit.
At will: Shield and Invisibility, plus Fire Bolt, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation, and Ray of Frost.
1st level (4 slots): Mage Armor, Magic Missile, Thunderwave.
2nd level (3 slots): Detect Thoughts, Levitate, Shatter.
3rd level (3 slots): Counterspell, Dispel Magic, Lightning Bolt.
4th level (3 slots): Banishment, Dimension Door, Ice Storm.
5th level (3 slots): Arcane Hand, Scrying, Wall of Force.
6th level (2 slots): Chain Lightning, Globe of Invulnerability.
7th level (2 slots): Forcecage, Teleport.
8th level (1 slot): Maze.
9th level (1 slot): Prismatic Wall.
sections.Actions: Staff of Power. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one creature, 10 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning.
sections.Legendary Actions:
Three legendary actions per round. Use one option after another creature's turn and recover spent actions at the start of this creature's turn.
Cantrip. Cast a cantrip.
Teleport. Teleport 60 ft. to a visible empty space.
Cast a Spell (3 actions). Cast a spell by spending a slot.

ruleNotes: The printed Staff of Power attack lists 10 damage and a roll of 1d6 + 1. Use the formula when rolling.

name: Knight-Captain Theodore Marshal
otherStatistics: Plate and shield. Saves Wis +7, Cha +9. Athletics +9, Animal Handling +7, Persuasion +9, Insight +7. Immune to Charmed and Frightened. Passive Perception 12. Common and Celestial.
description: A knight of the Silver Order who fights with a Holy Avenger longsword.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Divine Strikes. His weapon attacks are magical and add 4d8 radiant damage, included below.
sections.Spellcasting:
20th-level paladin. Charisma, save DC 17, +9 to hit.
1st level (4 slots): Bless, Command, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt.
2nd level (3 slots): Aid, Branding Smite, Lesser Restoration.
3rd level (3 slots): Beacon of Hope, Dispel Magic.
4th level (3 slots): Banishment, Death Ward.
5th level (2 slots): Flame Strike, Hallow.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks.
Holy Avenger. Melee weapon attack +13, reach 5 ft., one target, 10 (1d8 + 8) bludgeoning plus 18 (4d8) radiant.
sections.Legendary Actions:
Three legendary actions per round. Use one option after another creature's turn and recover spent actions at the start of this creature's turn.
Attack. Make one weapon attack.
Holy Bolt (2 actions). Cast Guiding Bolt without spending a slot.

ruleNotes: The Holy Avenger entry prints bludgeoning damage and an average of 10 for 1d8 + 8. Use the formula when rolling.

name: Queen of Thieves
otherStatistics: Canny Defense and Mage Armor. Saves Dex +10, Int +10. Acrobatics +10, Arcana +10, Deception +14, Insight +8, Perception +8, Persuasion +9, Sleight of Hand +10, Stealth +15. Immune to Charmed. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 18. Common, Dwarvish, Elvish, and Undercommon.
description: The Queen's Men leader combines illusions, precise attacks, and memory magic.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Canny Defense. Add Intelligence to AC with light or no armor and no shield.
Sneak Attack (1/turn). Add 18 (5d6) to a weapon hit if she has advantage, or if the target has a non-Incapacitated ally of the Queen within 5 ft. and she has no disadvantage.
Memory Thief. Creatures do not notice when she reads their thoughts or charms them. When one of her spells that Charms a creature ends, she can force a DC 18 Intelligence save. Failure erases up to 8 hours of the time the creature spent Charmed by her. Heal or similar magic restores these memories.
sections.Special Equipment: Amulet of Proof Against Detection and Location, Spymaster's Signet, and +3 rapier. The attuned signet casts Disguise Self at will. As an action, the wearer can turn Invisible for 1 minute along with worn and carried items. A bonus action ends this invisibility early. The invisibility use returns at dawn.
sections.Innate Spellcasting: Intelligence, no components. At will: Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Suggestion.
sections.Spellcasting:
20th-level wizard. Intelligence, save DC 18, +10 to hit.
At will: Chill Touch, Mage Hand, Message, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation.
1st level (4 slots): Feather Fall, Mage Armor, Shield, Sleep.
2nd level (3 slots): Mirror Image, Misty Step, See Invisibility.
3rd level (3 slots): Gaseous Form, Hypnotic Pattern, Major Image.
4th level (3 slots): Dimension Door, Greater Invisibility, Polymorph.
5th level (3 slots): Dominate Person, Scrying, Seeming.
6th level (2 slots): Eyebite, Mass Suggestion.
7th level (2 slots): Forcecage, Project Image.
8th level (1 slot): Feeblemind.
9th level (1 slot): Foresight.
sections.Actions:
+3 Rapier. Melee weapon attack +13, reach 5 ft., one target, 13 (1d8 + 8) piercing.
Dagger. Ranged weapon attack +10, range 20/60 ft., one target, 7 (1d4 + 7) piercing.
sections.Reactions: Misdirection. When she would take damage, become Invisible and teleport 60 ft. to a visible empty space, leaving a double in her previous space for 1 minute. Invisibility ends if she attacks, casts a spell, or after 1 minute.
sections.Legendary Actions:
Three legendary actions per round. Use one option after another creature's turn and recover spent actions at the start of this creature's turn.
Attack. Make one melee or ranged attack.
Move. Move up to speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, p. 217. Spymaster's Signet, Appendix D, p. 233.

ruleNotes: The printed Dagger lists 7 damage and a roll of 1d4 + 7. The +3 Rapier lists 13 damage and a roll of 1d8 + 8. Use the formulas when rolling.

name: Lucretia Mathias
otherStatistics: Unarmored defense. Saving throws Wis +11 and Cha +9. Insight +16, Perception +16, Persuasion +14, Religion +14. Immune to Charmed and Frightened. Truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 26. Speaks all languages.
description: The leader of the Followers of the Falling Fire teaches that a sanctified delerium shard can offer salvation.

sections.Traits:
Prescient. While conscious, Lucretia cannot be surprised.
Unarmored Defense. Without armor or a shield, add her Wisdom modifier to AC.
Undeniable Faith. Lucretia automatically passes Constitution saves to maintain Concentration. Resolve each spell she casts as though she used a 9th-level slot.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Lucretia can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Divine Grace. A creature targeting Lucretia with an attack or harmful spell must first make a DC 20 Wisdom save. On a failure, it chooses another target or loses the attack or spell. Area effects bypass this protection. If Lucretia attacks, casts a spell affecting an enemy, or damages another creature, Divine Grace stops until the start of her next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
20th-level cleric spellcasting. Wisdom, DC 20, +12 to hit.
Cantrips at will. Chill Touch, Guidance, Light, Sacred Flame, Thaumaturgy.
1st level, 4 slots. Bless, Command, Guiding Bolt, Healing Word.
2nd level, 3 slots. Aid, Hold Person, Lesser Restoration, Spiritual Weapon.
3rd level, 3 slots. Dispel Magic, Sending, Speak with Dead, Spirit Guardians.
4th level, 3 slots. Banishment, Death Ward, Divination.
5th level, 3 slots. Commune, Flame Strike, Greater Restoration, Scrying.
6th level, 2 slots. Heal, Word of Recall.
7th level, 2 slots. Divine Word, Resurrection.
8th level, 1 slot. Holy Aura.
9th level, 1 slot. Gate, Sacrament of the Falling Fire.
sections.Actions:
Pacifying Touch. Melee spell attack, +12 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one creature. Hit 10 (3d6) psychic damage. If this damage drops the target to 0 HP, it is stable. The target makes a DC 20 Wisdom save or is Incapacitated for 1 minute. Any damage ends this condition early.
Divine Intervention (1/week). Ask the Sacred Flame for aid. The GM chooses the result. A cleric or domain spell is an appropriate model.
sections.Legendary Actions:
Lucretia has three legendary actions and regains them at the start of her turn. Use one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn.
Cantrip (1 action). Cast a cantrip.
Pacifying Touch (2 actions). Use Pacifying Touch.
Cast a Spell (3 actions). Cast a spell using a slot.
sections.Sacrament of the Falling Fire: A one-hour ritual in the Deep Haze with a 30-ft. range. Each of up to 12 willing, faithful Humanoids drives a 100 gp delerium fragment into their chest, becoming sanctified. Each participant is then attacked by a hostile Shadow, or a Wraith if the GM judges the participant’s anger, fear, or hatred warrants one. While keeping the faith, a sanctified creature has advantage on saves against Charmed and Frightened, resistance to necrotic and radiant damage, and immunity to contamination. On death its soul enters the fragment and it cannot be raised while the soul remains there.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, pp. 216–217. Sacrament, Appendix D, p. 229.

ruleNotes: Use the printed Wisdom saving throw of +11. The printed spell attack bonus is +12.

name: Lord Commander Elias Drexel
otherStatistics: Wears a +3 breastplate. Saving throws Str +9, Dex +7, Wis +8. Athletics +8, Perception +13, Stealth +12, Survival +8. Blindsight 10 ft., passive Perception 23. Speaks Common.
description: The Hooded Lanterns’ commander leads from the front and uses his badge to keep nearby allies fighting.

sections.Traits:
Survivor. At the start of his turn, Drexel regains 10 HP if he has at least 1 HP and no more than half his maximum.
Brute. His melee weapon hits deal one extra weapon die, already included below.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Drexel can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
20th-level ranger spellcasting. Wisdom, DC 16, +8 to hit.
1st level, 4 slots. Cure Wounds, Fog Cloud, Hunter’s Mark.
2nd level, 3 slots. Pass without Trace, Protection from Poison, Spike Growth.
3rd level, 3 slots. Conjure Animals, Nondetection.
4th level, 3 slots. Freedom of Movement, Stoneskin.
5th level, 2 slots. Tree Stride, using buildings instead of trees.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Leadership, then make four Longsword attacks or four Longbow attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, 150/600-ft. range, one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Leadership (short or long rest). For 1 minute, when a nonhostile creature Drexel sees within 120 ft. makes an attack roll or saving throw, he can issue a command or warning. If it hears and understands him, it adds 1d4 to the roll. One Leadership die can benefit a roll. The effect ends if Drexel is Incapacitated.
Lord Commander’s Badge (recharges at dawn). Give a command audible within 300 ft. Choose up to 12 visible allies who hear it. They each gain 20 temporary HP and have advantage on attack rolls and saves while those temporary HP remain.
sections.Reactions: Parry. Add 5 to Drexel’s AC against one melee attack that would hit. He must see the attacker and wield a melee weapon.
sections.Legendary Actions:
Drexel has three legendary actions and regains them at the start of his turn. Use one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn.
Attack (1 action). Make one weapon attack.
Command (1 action). Choose one visible ally who sees and hears Drexel. The ally can use its reaction to make one weapon attack with advantage, dealing an extra 10 (3d6) damage on a hit.
sections.Equipment: +3 longsword, +3 breastplate, and Lord Commander’s Badge.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, pp. 214–215. Lord Commander’s Badge, Appendix D, p. 233.

ruleNotes: Use the printed fixed total of 255 HP. The printed dice expression of 30d8 + 150 averages 285 HP. The printed Longbow entry lists 7 damage with a roll of 1d8 + 2.

name: Protean Abomination
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Immune to Charmed, Frightened, and Prone. Blindsight 60 ft., passive Perception 10. No languages.
description: This shapeless mutant drags prey into its body and can climb across a ceiling.

sections.Traits:
Absorption. When the abomination kills a creature other than a Construct or Undead, it absorbs the corpse and regains 20 HP.
Amorphous. Move through openings as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Spider Climb. Climb difficult surfaces and ceilings without a check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks. If both hit the same Large or smaller target, it is Grappled (escape DC 15) and the abomination uses Engulf on it.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 19 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Engulf. Engulf one Large or smaller creature the abomination is grappling. Until the grapple ends, the target is Blinded, Restrained, and unable to breathe, and moves with the abomination. At the start of each of the abomination’s turns, the target makes a DC 15 Constitution save or takes 19 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. Only one creature can be engulfed at a time.

ruleNotes: The printed fixed damage for Slam and Engulf is 19. The same entries list a roll of 3d8 + 5.

name: Animated Delerium Sludge
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Resists acid and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons. Immune to necrotic and poison damage and to Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, and Unconscious. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Deep Speech.
description: A pool of corrupted sludge can rush across water and swallow creatures that enter its space.

sections.Traits: Sludge Form. Enter and stop in a hostile creature’s space. Pass through an opening as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
sections.Actions:
Contaminated Touch. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target makes a DC 15 Constitution save or gains 1 contamination level.
Engulf. Each creature in the sludge’s space makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure, a Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 14) and Restrained until the grapple ends. On a success, push the target out of the sludge’s space. The sludge can hold either one Large target or up to two targets of Medium size or smaller. At the start of each of the sludge’s turns, each grappled target takes 28 (8d6) necrotic damage and makes a DC 15 Constitution save or gains 1 contamination level. A creature within 5 ft. can use an action to pull out a creature or object with a successful DC 14 Strength check.

name: Living Deep Haze
otherStatistics: Resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons. Immune to necrotic and poison damage and to Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, and Unconscious. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Deep Speech.
description: A mobile bank of Haze tracks creatures through the ruins and contaminates anyone it envelops.

sections.Traits:
Fog Form. Enter and stop in a hostile creature’s space. Pass through an opening as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Deep Haze. A creature entering the Haze’s space or starting its turn there makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and gains 1 contamination level.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

name: Entropic Flame
otherStatistics: Resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons. Immune to fire and poison damage and to Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, and Unconscious. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Deep Speech.
description: This fire elemental hurls flame between short teleports and sets creatures alight by passing through them.

sections.Traits:
Fire Form. Pass through an opening as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. A creature that touches the flame or hits it in melee from within 5 ft. takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. The flame can enter and stop in a hostile creature’s space. The first time it enters a creature’s space on a turn, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and ignites. The burning creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns until someone uses an action to extinguish it.
Illumination. Shed bright light out to 30 ft. and dim light for 30 ft. more.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Hurl Flame attacks. Before or after each attack, the flame can teleport up to 10 ft. to a space it sees, even if occupied.
Hurl Flame. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, 120-ft. range, one target. Hit 10 (3d6) fire damage.
Touch. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) fire damage. A creature or flammable object ignites and takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns until a creature uses an action to extinguish it.

name: Walking Delerium Geode
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Vulnerable to radiant and thunder. Resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons. Immune to necrotic and poison damage and to Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, and Unconscious. Darkvision and tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Deep Speech.
description: A walking mass of delerium crystals can travel through earth. It bursts when destroyed by most damage types.

sections.Traits:
Death Burst. If damage drops the geode to 0 HP, its crystals explode unless the damage was force, radiant, or thunder. Each creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 42 (12d6) necrotic damage and gains 1 contamination level. The explosion also triggers a random effect from the Arcane Anomalies d20 table in Appendix D, p. 225.
Earth Glide. The geode burrows through unworked, nonmagical earth and stone without disturbing it.
sections.Actions: Shard Slam. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. The target then makes a DC 15 Constitution save or takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and gains 1 contamination level.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, p. 205. Arcane Anomalies, Appendix D, p. 225.

name: Hypnotic Eldritch Blossom
otherStatistics: Immune to Blinded, Deafened, and Frightened. Blindsight 30 ft., blind beyond this range. Passive Perception 6. No languages.
description: A flower that passes for harmless until its pollen draws nearby creatures in.

sections.Traits: False Appearance. While motionless the blossom looks like an ordinary flower.
sections.Actions:
Contaminated Nectar. One visible creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 10 Constitution save or gains 1 contamination level.
Hypnotic Pollen (short or long rest). Each creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 10 Wisdom save or is Charmed for 1 minute. While Charmed this way, it is Incapacitated and must spend all its movement getting as close as possible to the blossom on its turns. The effect ends if the target takes damage or another creature uses an action to shake it awake.
sections.Reactions: Spell Reflection. If the blossom saves against a non-area spell targeting only it, or a spell attack misses it, choose another visible creature within 30 ft., including the caster. Redirect the spell to that creature. The new target makes its own save if required, or the attack is rerolled against it.

name: Warlock of the Rat God
otherStatistics: AC 15 with Mage Armor. Deception +4, Stealth +4. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Common.
description: A ratling pact caster that hides between spells and calls giant rats to its aid.

sections.Traits: Keen Smell. Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
sections.Bonus Actions: Skulker. Take the Hide action.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma, DC 12, +4 to hit. No material components.
At will. Eldritch Blast (two beams), Mage Armor (self only), Minor Illusion, Thaumaturgy.
1/day each. Augury, Burning Hands, Conjure Animals (giant rats only), Faerie Fire, Invisibility, Misty Step.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Ratling
otherStatistics: Stealth +6. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Common.
description: A scavenging tunnel-dweller that attacks in packs and slips away into cover.

sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
Pack Tactics. Gain advantage on an attack against a creature if an ally is within 5 ft. of it and the ally is not Incapacitated.
sections.Bonus Actions: Skulker. Take the Hide action.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Sling. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, 30/120-ft. range, one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

name: Aquatic Dreg
otherStatistics: Blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Common.
description: A gilled dreg armed with a spear, found in sewers and flooded caverns.

sections.Base stat block: Delerium Dreg, Appendix A, p. 199. This profile includes the printed Aquatic mutation.
sections.Traits:
Misty Camouflage. The dreg has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in mist or fog that obscures the area.
Amphibious. The dreg breathes air and water and can swim 30 ft.
Blindsight. The dreg gains blindsight out to 30 ft.
sections.Actions: Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 20/60-ft. range, one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. Wielding the spear in two hands for a melee attack deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

ruleNotes: The variant description mentions shields. The listed mutations leave the base AC of 11 in place.

name: Bloated Delerium Dreg
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Common.
description: A swollen dreg that attacks with a spray of acid. Its body bursts when it dies.

sections.Base stat block: Delerium Dreg, Appendix A, p. 199. This profile includes the printed Bloated mutation.
sections.Traits:
Misty Camouflage. The dreg has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in mist or fog that obscures the area.
Death Burst. When the dreg dies, each creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 11 Constitution save. A creature takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. A failure by at least 5 also adds one level of contamination.
sections.Actions:
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 20/60-ft. range, one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. Wielding the spear in two hands for a melee attack deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Bile Spray (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. A creature takes 7 (2d6) acid damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. A failure by at least 5 also adds one level of contamination.

name: Chitinous Dreg
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Common.
description: Hard plates cover the dreg and raise its Armor Class.

sections.Base stat block: Delerium Dreg, Appendix A, p. 199. This profile includes the printed Chitinous mutation.
sections.Traits:
Misty Camouflage. The dreg has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in mist or fog that obscures the area.
Armored Shell. The dreg has AC 18.
sections.Actions: Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 20/60-ft. range, one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. Wielding the spear in two hands for a melee attack deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Cyclopean Dreg
otherStatistics: Immune to psychic damage and the Frightened condition. Truesight 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Common.
description: A keen-sighted dreg whose shriek can frighten creatures nearby.

sections.Base stat block: Delerium Dreg, Appendix A, p. 199. This profile includes the printed Cyclopean mutation.
sections.Traits:
Misty Camouflage. The dreg has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in mist or fog that obscures the area.
Spectral Vision. The dreg gains truesight out to 60 ft. and has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
Mad Certainty. The dreg is immune to psychic damage and the Frightened condition.
sections.Actions:
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 20/60-ft. range, one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. Wielding the spear in two hands for a melee attack deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Psychic Shriek (Recharge 6). Each creature within 20 ft. makes a DC 10 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage and is Frightened for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.

name: Delerium Dreg
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Common.
description: A former inhabitant of Drakkenheim warped by contamination. It can hide more easily in the city's mist.

sections.Traits: Misty Camouflage. The dreg has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in mist or fog that obscures the area.
sections.Actions: Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 20/60-ft. range, one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. Wielding the spear in two hands for a melee attack deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Displaced Dreg
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Common.
description: A dreg that is hard to strike and can attack as it teleports.

sections.Base stat block: Delerium Dreg, Appendix A, p. 199. This profile includes the printed Displaced mutation.
sections.Traits:

sections.Base stat block: Purple Worm, SRD 5.1. Remove Multiattack and Tail Stinger. Keep Bite and add Breach and Contaminated Gullet.
sections.Traits:
Tunneler. Burrow through solid rock at half burrow speed, leaving a 10-ft.-diameter tunnel.
Contaminated Gullet. Each time a swallowed creature takes acid damage inside the wurm, it also gains one contamination level.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. A Large or smaller target must pass a DC 19 Dexterity save or be swallowed. A swallowed creature is Blinded and Restrained, has total cover against effects outside the wurm, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the wurm's turns. If a creature inside deals at least 30 damage to the wurm in one turn, the wurm makes a DC 21 Constitution save at that turn's end. On a failure it expels all swallowed creatures, which land Prone within 10 ft. A creature inside a dead wurm is no longer Restrained and can spend 20 ft. of movement to leave the corpse and land Prone.
Breach. The wurm uses its full movement and can enter the spaces of Large or smaller creatures. Whenever it enters a creature's space, that creature makes a DC 19 Strength save. On success, the creature can choose to be moved to the side of the wurm's space. On failure, or if it succeeds and declines that movement, it takes 35 (10d6) bludgeoning damage, is pushed 10 ft., and falls Prone. After finishing this movement, the wurm can make one Bite attack against a Prone target as a bonus action.

sections.Sacrament of the Falling Fire: A one-hour rite in the Deep Haze, range 30 ft. Up to twelve willing, faithful Humanoids each use a 100 gp delerium fragment and become sanctified. Each confronts a hostile Shadow or, if the GM judges that the participant harbors substantial anger, fear or hatred, a Wraith. While faithful, they have advantage on saves against Charmed or Frightened, resist necrotic and radiant damage, and are immune to contamination. If they die, their soul enters the fragment and cannot be raised while it remains there.

sections.Setting spell: Purge Contamination (3rd level). Cast for 1 hour and touch one contaminated humanoid. Consume 100 gp of alchemical fluids or holy water. Remove every contamination level and mutation, then give the target one level of Exhaustion for each level removed.
sections.Actions:
Staff of the Woodlands. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) when wielded in two hands.

sections.Staff of the Woodlands:

One action, using Eoghan’s spell save DC. Animal Friendship (1), Awaken (5), Barkskin (2), Locate Animals or Plants (2), Speak with Animals (1), Speak with Plants (3), or Wall of Thorns (6). Pass without Trace costs no charge.
Tree Form costs one charge and one action while planting the staff in fertile ground. It grows into a 60-ft. tree with a 5-ft.-diameter trunk and a 20-ft. branch radius. Touch the tree and speak its command word as an action to return it to staff form.

His Resurrection ritual requires a living humanoid sacrifice whose level or CR equals or exceeds the deceased’s, a diamond or delerium substitute, and a personal offering. If he uses delerium in place of the diamond, the revived creature gains a random Drakkenheim Madness.

otherStatistics: Natural armor. Deception +5, Insight +4, Perception +4, Stealth +5. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14. Common.

sections.Traits:
Radiant Gaze. When a creature that can see Lenore’s eyes starts its turn within 30 ft. of her, she can force a DC 14 Constitution save if she is not Incapacitated and can see it. Failure deals 22 (4d10) radiant damage and adds one contamination level. Success halves the damage.
Avert Eyes. Unless Surprised, a creature can look away at the start of its turn to avoid the save. It cannot see Lenore until its next turn starts, when it can avert its gaze again. If it looks at her early, it immediately saves against the gaze.
Own Reflection. If Lenore sees herself in a polished surface within 30 ft. while in bright light, she is Blinded and Incapacitated for 1d6 hours.
sections.Actions: Tentacle Hair. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing and 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. The target makes a DC 14 Constitution save and gains one contamination level on failure.

ruleNotes: The encounter replaces the Medusa’s actions. Tentacle Hair is its only printed replacement.

otherStatistics: Natural armor. Dexterity +7, Constitution +15, Wisdom +10, Charisma +12 saves. Insight +10, Perception +17, Stealth +7. Immune to lightning. description: The ancient bronze guardian of Castle Drakken treats its mutated occupants as residents and humanoid visitors as intruders.

sections.Printed source: Castle Drakken, pp. 181, 183. Tower Dragon traits, Appendix A, p. 198. Seals and Crown, Appendix D, p. 233.
sections.Base stat block: Ancient Bronze Dragon, SRD 5.1 (2014 fifth-edition rules). Add the Tower Dragon’s guardian traits from Appendix A. The palace encounter adds the trigger distance, patrol limits, and response to a Seal of Drakkenheim. Use the ancient dragon’s CR 22.
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. Breathes air and water.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed save into a success.
Constructed Nature. Needs no food, air, drink, or sleep.
False Appearance. While still, he resembles an inanimate bronze statue.
Faultless Tracker. A creature that triggers his activation becomes his quarry. He knows where and how far away it is until it leaves Drakkenheim or he is destroyed.
Immutable Form. Spells and effects cannot change his form.
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. His weapon attacks are magical.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. May use Frightful Presence, then makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 20 (2d10 + 9) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 16 (2d6 + 9) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit 18 (2d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage.
Frightful Presence. Chosen creatures within 120 ft. who know he is there make a DC 20 Wisdom save or are Frightened for 1 minute. Repeat at the end of each turn. Once a creature succeeds or the effect ends, it is immune to this presence for 24 hours.
Breath Weapons (recharge 5–6). Choose Lightning Breath or Repulsion Breath.
Lightning Breath. Creatures in a 120-ft. line, 10 ft. wide, make a DC 23 Dexterity save against 88 (16d10) lightning damage, halved on success.
Repulsion Breath. Creatures in a 30-ft. cone make a DC 23 Strength save or are pushed 60 ft. away.
sections.Legendary Actions:
Three legendary actions. Recover all at the start of his turn and use one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Detect. Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.
Tail Attack. Make one Tail attack.
Wing Attack (costs 2). Creatures within 15 ft. make a DC 24 Dexterity save or take 16 (2d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage and fall Prone. He can then fly up to half his flying speed.
sections.Encounter notes: He attacks intruders who approach within 150 ft. of the palace. He cannot follow them inside and stops pursuit at the castle grounds. He ignores creatures attuned to a Seal of Drakkenheim unless they attack him or cast a spell on him, in which case he ignores that protection for 24 hours. An action presenting a seal within 30 ft. can rebuke him if he can see or hear the presenter and loses a contested Charisma check. He cannot move or take actions or reactions for 1 minute or until he takes damage. If he wins the check, he is immune to that creature’s rebuke for 24 hours. He obeys the wearer of the Crown of Westemär. Wish alone restores his sanity.
