description: A ghost whose wail overwhelms nearby minds and whose possession can leave lasting mutations.

sections.Base stat block: Ghost, SRD 5.1 (2014 fifth-edition rules). Replace Horrifying Visage with Psychic Wail and add Mutate Host. The inherited Possession remains available.
sections.Traits:
Ethereal Sight. Can see 60 ft. into the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane or the reverse.
Incorporeal Movement. The witch passes through objects and creatures as difficult terrain. Ending its turn inside an object deals 5 (1d10) force damage to the witch.
sections.Actions:
Withering Touch. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.
Etherealness. Move between the Material Plane and the Border Ethereal. The witch remains visible from the other plane but cannot affect anything there or be affected by it.
Psychic Wail (recharge 5–6). Each creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 13 Intelligence save. Failure deals 10 (3d6) psychic damage and makes the target Incapacitated until the end of the witch’s next turn.
Possession (recharge 6). One visible humanoid within 5 ft. makes a DC 13 Charisma save. On failure the witch vanishes and controls the target’s body. The target stays aware, is Incapacitated, and cannot control its body. The witch keeps its own alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and Charmed and Frightened immunities. It otherwise uses the target’s statistics without its knowledge, proficiencies, or class features. Only effects that turn Undead can target it during possession. The effect also ends if the body falls to 0 HP, the witch ends it as a bonus action, or it is turned or expelled by a spell such as Dispel Evil and Good. On ending, the witch appears in a vacant space within 5 ft. A humanoid that succeeds or is freed is immune to this witch’s Possession for 24 hours.
sections.Bonus Actions: Mutate Host. While possessing a creature, force it to make a DC 13 Charisma save. On failure it gains one contamination level and automatically acquires a random mutation in place of the normal mutation check.

Creatures in the square when cast make a Strength save or become Restrained until it ends. A creature can spend an action on a Strength check against the spell’s DC to break free.

Cry of the Forest (Recharge 6). Each creature that hears the cry within 30 ft. makes a DC 16 Charisma save. Failure deals 35 (10d6) psychic damage and Frightens for 1 minute. sections.Bonus Actions: Toss. Choose one Medium or smaller creature within 5 ft. It makes a DC 16 Strength save. Failure throws it up to 20 ft. away in a random direction and knocks it Prone.

otherStatistics: Perception 13, Stealth 16. Immune to poison damage and the Poisoned condition. Keensense 10 ft. No languages.
description: This venomous snake hunts by scent and can curl up and roll after fleeing prey. It also raids coaching inns for ale.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str -3, Dex +4, Con +1, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -3
sections.Traits:
Heightened Smell. Perception 18 when relying on scent.
Plant Camouflage. Stealth 21 where vegetation provides ample concealment.
Standing Leap. Long jump up to 15 ft. and high jump up to 5 ft., with or without a run-up.
sections.Actions: Leaping Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing plus 2 (1d4) poison damage. The attack has advantage if the snake moved at least 10 ft. first.
sections.Bonus Actions: Hoop Dash. The snake grips its tail and takes the Dash action. The next attack it makes before the start of its next turn has disadvantage.

ruleNotes: Keensense lets the creature perceive its surroundings without relying on sight.

name: Vallowex
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 14, Stealth 16. Resists poison damage and the Poisoned and Prone conditions. Immune to Blinded and Exhaustion. Keensense 60 ft., its maximum sensing range. No languages.
description: A pond-dwelling predator uses supernatural thirst to draw creatures to the water. It can also leave eggs close to where they drink.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +8, Dex +0, Con +7, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -3
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. It breathes air and water.
Aura of Thirst. At the start of the vallowex’s turn, creatures within 30 ft. make a DC 15 Constitution save. On failure, each has disadvantage on its next attack roll or ability check before the vallowex’s next turn starts. Each minute in the aura adds one level of Exhaustion. A creature can remove a level by spending an action to drink a pint of water. Creatures immune to Exhaustion ignore the aura.
Infested Water. After every seven days it spends in an enclosed body of water up to 100 ft. in radius, it deposits eggs. They remain viable for 24 hours. A DC 15 Intelligence (Nature) check to inspect the water spots them. A Beast or Humanoid who drinks the water makes a DC 15 Constitution save or contracts a disease. Only one tadpole can mature per host. After each long rest, the host repeats the save. On failure, reduce its Strength score by 1d4. The reduction lasts until a long rest after the disease is cured. If Strength reaches 0, the host dies and a vallowex emerges. Three successful saves or a magical cure destroy the tadpole.
Underwater Camouflage. Its Stealth is 21 underwater.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Spiked Tongue and two Tail attacks. Swallow can replace Spiked Tongue.
Spiked Tongue. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing. The target is Grappled, escape DC 15, and Restrained for the duration. The vallowex cannot use Spiked Tongue on someone else while the Grapple holds.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning.
Swallow. Use Spiked Tongue on a Medium or smaller creature it is Grappling. On a hit, the creature is swallowed and the Grapple ends. It is Blinded and Restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects originating outside the vallowex, and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the vallowex’s turns. Only one creature can be swallowed. If that creature deals at least 15 damage to the vallowex during one turn, the vallowex makes a DC 15 Constitution save at the end of that turn. On failure it regurgitates the target, which lands Prone within 5 ft. If the vallowex dies, the swallowed creature is no longer Restrained and can exit Prone by spending 10 ft. of movement.

ruleNotes: Keensense lets the creature perceive its surroundings without relying on sight.

name: Vila
otherStatistics: Perception 15, Stealth 18. Resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks and the Charmed and Unconscious conditions. No special senses in the statistics line. Languages Common, Sylvan.
description: A woodland guardian who drives intruders away with poison-tipped weapons, songs, and allies called from the forest.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +1, Dex +5, Con +1, Int +0, Wis +2, Cha +6
sections.Traits:
Fey Resilience. It resists Charmed and Unconscious.
Forest’s Defender. Nonmagical vegetation, including thorns and spines, does not slow or damage it. It has advantage on initiative in forested terrain.
Forest Sight. It sees clearly through light obscurity and treats dim light as bright.
Heightened Hearing and Sight. Perception 20 when using hearing or sight.
Poisoned Weapons. Each weapon hit deals an extra 3d6 poison damage, already listed below.
Speak with Beasts. It can speak with Beasts as if they shared a language.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Shortsword or Shortbow.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.
Denizens of the Wilds (1/day). Call 1d4 wolves, one brown bear, or one flinderbeast. They arrive in 1d4 rounds, act as allies, and obey spoken commands. They stay for up to one hour, until the vila dies, or until it dismisses them as a bonus action.
sections.Bonus Actions: Song of the Forest. Choose up to two visible creatures within 30 ft. Each target that hears the song makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On failure, Ancient Lullaby makes the target Unconscious for 1 minute, ending if it takes damage or if another creature spends an action waking it. Fascinating Melody makes it Stunned until the end of its next turn. Luckless Tune imposes disadvantage on attacks and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

name: Vodyanoi
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 15, Stealth 17. Vulnerable to lightning damage. Resists cold damage and the Charmed and Unconscious conditions. Immune to poison damage and the Poisoned condition. Darkvision 60 ft. Languages Common, Primordial, Sylvan.
description: A shapechanging fey who poses as a stranded traveler or a sage to get close to visitors at the water’s edge.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +2, Dex +4, Con +6, Int +1, Wis +6, Cha +2
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. It breathes air and water.
Fey Resilience. It resists Charmed and Unconscious.
Shared Breath. Chosen friendly creatures within 30 ft. can breathe air and water.
Water Mastery. It has advantage against targets touching the same body of water as it. If both the target and the vodyanoi are on dry land, the vodyanoi has disadvantage on the attack.
Water Walker. It can treat the surface of water like solid ground. The trait otherwise works as Water Walk.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Claws or Water Bolt. When both Water Bolts hit one creature, it must pass a DC 15 Strength save or be pushed up to 10 ft. away and knocked Prone.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing plus 9 (2d8) poison damage. A Humanoid form without claws deals bludgeoning instead of slashing.
Water Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.
Crashing Wave (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 30-ft. cone make a DC 15 Strength save. On failure they take 13 (3d8) bludgeoning plus 10 (3d6) cold and are knocked Prone on land or pushed up to 10 ft. away if submerged. Success halves damage and prevents both riders.
sections.Bonus Actions: Change Shape. It becomes a Small or Medium Humanoid or returns to its Fey form. Its size can change, with the remaining statistics intact. Its equipment changes with it. Death restores its true form.

name: Wood Ward
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 13, Stealth 10. Vulnerable to fire damage and the Prone condition. Construct Resilience makes it immune to poison and psychic damage, Exhaustion, Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft. Understands its creator’s languages and cannot speak.
description: A wooden figure that stays still until its village is threatened. A ritual binds it to the community it guards.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +2, Dex +0, Con +3, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -5
sections.Traits:
Construct Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Construct Resilience. See the listed damage and condition immunities.
Immutable Form. Effects that would change its form fail.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Horror Gaze. Choose one visible creature within 30 ft. It makes a DC 13 Charisma save or becomes Frightened until the end of its next turn.

name: Wraith Bear
otherStatistics: Perception 17, Stealth 13. Vulnerable to radiant damage. Resists acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage, plus bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks. Immune to necrotic damage and Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, and Restrained. Undead Resilience adds immunity to poison damage, Exhaustion, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft. Knows the languages it knew in life.
description: A corrupted ancestral spirit in bear form. It drains nearby plants to heal and can sense the direction of a living relative.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +4, Dex +3, Con +4, Int +0, Wis +3, Cha +2
sections.Traits:
Detect Relatives. It knows the direction of its nearest living relative on the same plane.
Draining Regeneration. At the start of its turn, it regains 10 HP if it has at least 1 HP and living plants are within 5 ft. Healing kills all plant life within 5 ft. It cannot heal by this trait while in one of those spaces.
Incorporeal Movement. It treats creatures and objects as difficult terrain it can move through. Ending a turn inside an object deals it 5 (1d10) force damage.
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Undead Resilience. See the additional immunities.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Draining Claw attacks. If both hit the same target and it is neither Construct nor Undead, reduce its maximum HP by the total necrotic damage from both hits. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest and kills it if its maximum reaches 0.
Draining Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Baleful Roar. Choose up to two visible creatures within 30 ft. Each target that hears the roar makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. Failure makes the target Incapacitated until the end of its next turn. If the bear is below 79 HP, a target that saves is instead Frightened until the end of its next turn.

ruleNotes: Use the printed below-79-HP cutoff for Baleful Roar.

name: Alligator
description: A river predator that seizes prey from the water’s edge.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 10. Stealth 12. Resistant to Grappled. No special senses or languages.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +2 · DEX +0 · CON +1 · INT -4 · WIS +0 · CHA -5
sections.Traits: Hold Breath. It can hold its breath for 15 minutes.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. The target is Grappled (escape DC 12) and Restrained while held. The alligator cannot bite another target until this grapple ends.
sections.Bonus Actions: High Walk. Take the Dash action. This bonus action is unavailable while swimming.

name: Alligator Turtle
description: An irritable turtle with a long neck and a beak that can reach farther than its shell suggests.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 11. Stealth 13. Resistant to Prone. No special senses or languages.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +2 · DEX +1 · CON +1 · INT -4 · WIS +1 · CHA -2
sections.Traits:
False Appearance. While motionless underwater with its mouth open, it looks like a rock with a worm protruding from it.
Hold Breath. It can hold its breath for 1 hour.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage. The target is Grappled (escape DC 12). The turtle cannot bite a different target while the grapple lasts.
sections.Reactions: Spiky Shell. When a visible creature within 5 ft. hits it with an attack, the turtle reduces the damage by 5 (2d4). The attacker takes 2 (1d4) piercing damage.

name: Baboon, Howler
description: A territorial primate that calls its troop to defend the woods and hills.
otherStatistics: Perception 13. Stealth 12. Resistant to Deafened. No special senses or languages.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +2 · DEX +2 · CON +2 · INT -2 · WIS +1 · CHA -2
sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The baboon has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if a non-Incapacitated ally is within 5 ft. of that creature.
sections.Actions:
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Challenging Howl. One visible creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 12 Charisma save. On a failure the baboon chooses one effect. The target has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of the baboon’s next turn, or its next attack before that time must target the baboon.

name: Bat, Strossen
description: A black, blood-drinking bat with a pale stripe across its eyes.
otherStatistics: Perception 12. Stealth 15. Vulnerable to Deafened. Resistant to Blinded. Keensense 60 ft. No languages.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR -2 · DEX +3 · CON +0 · INT -5 · WIS +0 · CHA -4
sections.Traits:
Echolocation. Being Deafened disables its keensense.
Heightened Hearing. Perception 17 for hearing.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the bat attaches. While attached it cannot attack and moves with the target without spending movement. At the start of each of the bat’s turns, the target loses 5 (1d4 + 3) HP from blood loss. The bat can detach by spending 5 ft. of movement on its turn. It detaches after draining 15 HP or if the target dies. Any creature, including the target, can use its action to pull the bat off.
sections.Bonus Actions: Haunting Screech. One creature within 10 ft. that can hear the screech must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom save or become Frightened until the end of its next turn.

name: Beetle, Giant Bombardier
description: A forest-floor herbivore that sprays boiling liquid when cornered.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 10. Stealth 12. Vulnerable to Frightened. Resistant to fire damage. Keensense 30 ft. No languages.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +0 · DEX +2 · CON +2 · INT -4 · WIS +0 · CHA -4
sections.Traits: Forest Camouflage. Stealth 17 in forests.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Spray (Recharge 5–6). One visible creature within 15 ft. makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. It takes 5 (2d4) fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Reactions: Defensive Spray (7 HP or fewer). When the beetle takes damage, its Spray recharges and it can use it immediately.

name: Bull
description: A territorial animal that charges challengers head-on.
otherStatistics: Perception 9. Stealth 11. No special senses or languages.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +3 · DEX +1 · CON +3 · INT -4 · WIS -1 · CHA -2
sections.Traits: Charge. After moving at least 20 ft. straight toward a target, a Gore hit against that target on the same turn deals 3 (1d6) extra piercing damage. A creature hit this way makes a DC 13 Strength save or falls Prone.
sections.Actions:
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

name: Forest Falcon
description: A raptor that hunts under the canopy, diving from a perch or pursuing prey on foot.
otherStatistics: Perception 14. Stealth 13. Vulnerable to Blinded. No special senses or languages.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR -2 · DEX +3 · CON +1 · INT -4 · WIS +2 · CHA -3
sections.Traits:
Falcon Dive. After diving at least 20 ft. straight toward a target while flying, the falcon has advantage on its next Beak attack against that target before the turn ends. A hit deals 2 (1d4) extra piercing damage.
Heightened Sight. Perception 19 for sight.
sections.Actions: Beak. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Grove Bear
description: A quick, blond-snouted bear that wrestles rivals to the ground.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 13. Stealth 11. Resistant to Grappled. No special senses or languages.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +3 · DEX +1 · CON +2 · INT -4 · WIS +1 · CHA -2
sections.Traits:
Grappler. The bear has advantage on attack rolls against creatures it is grappling.
Heightened Smell. Perception 18 for smell.
sections.Actions: Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage. The target is Grappled (escape DC 13). The bear cannot use Claws on another target until this grapple ends.
sections.Bonus Actions: Pin. A creature Grappled by the bear makes a DC 13 Strength save or becomes Restrained until the grapple ends.

name: Leech, Giant
description: An amphibious blood feeder that tracks vibrations through dark water.
otherStatistics: Perception 10. Stealth 15. Tremorsense 30 ft. No languages.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR -2 · DEX +3 · CON +0 · INT -5 · WIS +0 · CHA -4
sections.Traits: Amphibious. It breathes air and water.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, and the leech attaches. While attached it cannot attack and moves with the target without spending movement. At the start of each of its turns, the target loses 5 (1d4 + 3) HP from blood loss. The leech can detach by spending 5 ft. of movement on its turn. It detaches after draining 10 HP or if the target dies. Any creature, including the target, can use its action to remove the leech.

name: Lizard, Giant Frilled
description: A territorial climber that flares its neck frill when it rushes an intruder.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 14. Stealth 14. Resistant to poison damage and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft. No languages.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +2 · DEX +4 · CON +2 · INT -4 · WIS +1 · CHA +0
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (4d4) poison damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit must make a DC 15 Strength save or fall Prone.
sections.Bonus Actions: Intimidating Dash. Move up to 20 ft. toward a visible creature within 60 ft. without provoking opportunity attacks. If this brings the lizard within 30 ft. of the target, it must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma save or be Frightened until the start of the lizard’s next turn. It has disadvantage on the save if the move brings the lizard within 5 ft.
sections.Reactions: Detach Tail (63 HP or fewer, recharges after a short or long rest). On taking damage, detach the tail to reduce the damage by 9 (2d8) and immediately move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. It cannot make Tail attacks again until the reaction recharges.

name: Margreve Hound
description: A stout hunting dog whose bark helps caravans ward off fey.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 13. Stealth 13. Resistant to Charmed and Frightened. No special senses or languages.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +2 · DEX +1 · CON +1 · INT -4 · WIS +1 · CHA -2
sections.Traits:
Fearsome Mien. A Fey attacking the hound makes a DC 12 Wisdom save or has disadvantage on the attack roll.
Heightened Hearing and Smell. Perception 18 when using smell.
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. The target is Grappled (escape DC 12), and the hound cannot bite another target while holding it.
sections.Bonus Actions: Warning Bark. Choose a visible creature within 30 ft. It makes a DC 12 Wisdom save or cannot move closer to the hound until the start of the hound’s next turn. Fey have disadvantage on the save.

ruleNotes: The printed Heightened Hearing and Smell trait gives a higher Perception value for smell only.

name: Margreve Stag
description: A swift deer native to the Margreve that bolts or leaps clear of danger.
otherStatistics: Perception 10. Stealth 12. Vulnerable to Frightened. Resistant to Exhaustion. No special senses. Understands Sylvan but cannot speak.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +2 · DEX +2 · CON +1 · INT -3 · WIS +0 · CHA -1
sections.Traits:
Charge. After moving at least 20 ft. straight toward a target, a Ram hit against it on the same turn deals 2 (1d4) extra damage. A creature hit this way makes a DC 12 Strength save or falls Prone.
Heightened Hearing. Perception 15 for hearing.
Standing Leap. The stag can long jump up to 20 ft. or high jump up to 10 ft., with or without a running start.
sections.Actions:
Ram. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Kick. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Skittish. Take the Dash or Disengage action.
sections.Reactions: Will of the Margreve. After failing a save, the stag can reroll it and must use the new result.

name: Mongoose, Giant
description: A woodland predator that dodges sudden strikes with quick rolls.
otherStatistics: Perception 12. Stealth 15. Resistant to poison damage and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft. No languages.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +0 · DEX +3 · CON +2 · INT -4 · WIS +2 · CHA -2
sections.Traits: Heightened Hearing and Smell. Perception 17 for hearing or smell.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Evasive Roll. Add 2 to AC against one attack that would hit, provided the mongoose can see the attacker.

name: Owl, Great Gray
description: A quiet owl that stays motionless on low perches as creatures pass by.
otherStatistics: Perception 14. Stealth 16. Darkvision 120 ft. No languages.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR -3 · DEX +4 · CON +0 · INT -4 · WIS +2 · CHA -2
sections.Traits:
Flyby. Flying out of an enemy’s reach does not provoke opportunity attacks.
Heightened Hearing and Sight. Perception 19 for hearing or sight.
Quiet Wings. Stealth 21 while flying.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Talon attacks.
Talon. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Intense Gaze. One visible creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure the owl has advantage on its next attack roll against that creature before the start of the owl’s next turn.

name: Alseid
description: A deer-bodied guardian that patrols deep woods and slips between patches of moonlight.
otherStatistics: Perception 15. Stealth 15. Resistant to Charmed. Speaks Common, Elvish, and Sylvan.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +1 · DEX +3 · CON +1 · INT -1 · WIS +3 · CHA -1
sections.Traits:
Forest Sight. Lightly obscured areas do not impede its sight, and dim light looks like bright light.
Heightened Sight. Perception 20 when using sight.
Monstrosity Resilience. Resistant to Exhaustion and Frightened.
Woodfriend. In forest terrain, leave no tracks and know true north. Nonmagical plants never slow its movement, and thorns, spines, and similar plant hazards deal it no damage as it passes.
sections.Actions:
Moon Spear. Weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) radiant damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Moon Step. The alseid and its gear magically teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. Both spaces must be in bright or dim light.

name: Child of the Briar, Greater
description: A thorny ambusher that pins larger prey and anchors the briar pack’s spellcasting.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 12. Stealth 17. Vulnerable to fire. Resistant to piercing and poison damage and to Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks Briarclick, Common, and Sylvan.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +1 · DEX +3 · CON +1 · INT +1 · WIS +0 · CHA +2
sections.Traits:
Fey Blessing. Advantage on saves against being Charmed. Magic cannot put it to sleep.
Plant Resilience. Resistant to Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Unconscious.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Claw or Spitdart Tongue. If both Claws hit one Large or smaller creature, it is Grappled, escape DC 13. At the start of each of its turns while held, it takes 2 (1d4) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) poison damage. The child can hold one creature at a time.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage.
Spitdart Tongue. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Entangle (Recharge 6). While within 10 ft. of another child of the briar, cast Entangle at DC 13. Each friendly child of the briar within 30 ft. can spend a reaction to join. Each ally who joins adds 1 to the DC and 5 ft. to the side of the area, up to DC 17 and a 40-ft. square. The area must include a participant. Participants ignore this casting and cannot start another Entangle until it ends.
sections.Reactions: Thorn Burst. When a visible creature within 10 ft. hits the child with a melee attack, the attacker makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 5 (2d4) poison damage.
sections.Spellcasting: Entangle. Choose a 20-ft. square within 90 ft. It becomes difficult terrain for up to 1 minute with concentration. Creatures there when the spell is cast make a Strength save or become Restrained until the spell ends. A creature can spend an action to make a Strength check against the spell DC, freeing itself on a success.

name: Child of the Briar, Swarm of
description: A knot of little thorn-creatures that pours through gaps and makes standing inside it painful.
otherStatistics: Perception 12. Stealth 17. Vulnerable to fire. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks Briarclick, Common, and Sylvan.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR -2 · DEX +3 · CON +0 · INT +1 · WIS +0 · CHA +2
sections.Traits:
Fey Blessing. Advantage on saves against being Charmed. Magic cannot put it to sleep.
Plant Resilience. Resistant to Exhaustion, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Unconscious.
Swarm. The swarm shares spaces with other creatures and fits through any opening a Tiny Plant can pass through. It cannot regain HP or gain temporary HP.
Swarm Resilience. Resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Immune to Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, and Stunned.
Thorny Swarm. A creature that starts its turn in the swarm’s space makes a DC 13 Dexterity save or takes 2 (1d4) piercing damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claws attacks or use Hail of Thorns twice.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm’s space. Hit 15 (6d4) piercing damage, or 7 (3d4) while the swarm has half its HP or fewer.
Hail of Thorns. One visible creature within 20 ft. makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. Failure deals 15 (6d4) piercing damage, or 7 (3d4) while the swarm has half its HP or fewer. A success halves the damage.

name: Child of the Briar, Vampiric
description: A blood-drinking briar hunter that homes in on wounds and clings to ceilings.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 13. Stealth 20. Vulnerable to fire. Resistant to necrotic damage. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks Briarclick, Common, and Sylvan.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +2 · DEX +7 · CON +1 · INT +1 · WIS +0 · CHA +3
sections.Traits:

description: This web hunter grows stronger under a quarter or half moon and binds prey after landing both claws.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 11. Stealth 17. Vulnerable to fire. Immune to poison damage and to Poisoned and Restrained. Darkvision 60 ft., keensense 10 ft. Speaks Deep Speech and Sylvan.

Shadow Stealth. In dim light or darkness, take the Hide action.

It repeats the save whenever damaged and at the end of each day, ending the effect on a success. If the full duration elapses with the target still Charmed, it dies and its body becomes a cocoon. A new fleshcrawler hatches an hour later.

Ventriloquistic Step. Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space.

Taking at least 5 acid or fire damage also destroys the maggots. After the creature saves or the maggots are destroyed, it is immune to this trait for 1 hour.
Pack Tactics. Has advantage on an attack if an ally within 5 ft. of the target is not Incapacitated.

Success halves the damage and avoids the condition. Unattended objects and structures take double damage with no save or damage threshold.
sections.Bonus Actions: Rotten Shake (Recharge 5–6). Each creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 13 Dexterity save or suffers Maggoty Hide.

Entrap. Move up to half speed and make one Constrict attack.
Toxic Blood Spray (costs 2 actions; 241 HP or fewer). Each creature within 20 ft. of Fafnir makes a DC 17 Constitution save. Failure deals 10 (4d4) poison damage and makes the creature Poisoned through the end of its next turn.
Inflame Greed (costs 2 actions). Cast Compel Avarice (Wisdom, DC 13) with verbal and somatic components, without material components or concentration. Choose a visible object and target one creature within 30 ft. On a failed save it tries to steal the object, fights its holder if theft fails, or flees the others to guard it once acquired. The effect lasts up to 1 minute. A creature immune to Charmed automatically succeeds.
sections.Lair Actions:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, use one option. Fafnir cannot repeat the same option in consecutive rounds.
Distracting Gleam. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Each creature within 20 ft. of the point makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. A failure bars reactions and bonus actions for up to 1 minute, until Fafnir uses this option again, or until he dies. Affected creatures repeat the save at the end of each turn to end it.
Grasping Tentacles. Target up to three creatures Fafnir can see within 120 ft. Each makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or becomes Restrained by tentacles. Any creature, including a target, can spend an action and pass a DC 15 Strength check to free a target.
Treasure Whirlwind. A visible point within 120 ft. becomes the center of a 15-ft.-diameter whirlwind. Each creature entering it for the first time on a turn or starting a turn there makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. It lasts 1 minute, until Fafnir uses this option again, or until he dies.
sections.Regional Effects:
The region can have any of these effects. They fade 1d10 days after Fafnir leaves or dies.
Avariciousness. Within 1 mile, creatures guard their things, covet others’ belongings, and have disadvantage on saves against effects that compel theft or taking an object.
Familial Strife. Within 5 miles, creatures become hostile toward relatives. Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, or Persuasion) checks to get someone to harm a relative have advantage.
Increased Mishaps. Within 1 mile, checks and saves to avoid injury while climbing, jumping pits, or otherwise risking an accident have disadvantage.

name: Hafgufa
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 12, Stealth 14 (19 underwater). Resistant to Exhaustion and Frightened. Darkvision 60 ft. No languages.
description: A tentacled sea predator that can seize several creatures at once and swallow them alive. Its stomach can hold relics from earlier prey.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +6, Dex +0, Con +9, Int +0, Wis +2, Cha +1
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. Breathes air and water.
Monstrosity Resilience. Resistant to Exhaustion and Frightened.
Seagoing Lurker. Stealth is 19 underwater.
Siege Monster. Double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make four Tentacle attacks. One can be replaced with Bite.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 28 (4d10 + 6) piercing damage. The attack has advantage against a creature Grappled by one of its tentacles.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A Huge or smaller creature is Grappled (escape DC 18), and the hafgufa can pull it up to 25 ft. straight toward itself. It can hold four creatures at once.
Reeking Mist (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 40-ft. cube centered on the hafgufa makes a DC 17 Constitution save or becomes Incapacitated for 10 minutes. Repeat the save at the end of each turn to end the effect.
sections.Bonus Actions: Swallow. A Large or smaller creature that the hafgufa is Grappling within 5 ft. makes a DC 18 Strength save. On a failure it is swallowed and the Grapple ends. A swallowed creature is Blinded and Restrained, has total cover against outside attacks and effects, and takes 28 (8d6) acid damage at the start of each of the hafgufa’s turns. Capacity six. If a creature inside deals at least 40 damage in a single turn, the hafgufa makes a DC 19 Constitution save at the end of that turn. On a failure it expels everyone inside, each falling Prone within 10 ft. When the hafgufa dies, the restraint ends and a swallowed creature can spend 20 ft. of movement to exit Prone.
sections.Encounter Context: Optional stomach find (1d6): 1, a very rare magic item from a past hero. 2, a lost ruler’s crown worth 2,000 gp. 3, an old message in a sealed bottle. 4, a treasure map etched on lead. 5, a rune-marked iron key for a giant’s lock. 6, a pirate captain’s cursed bones in a strongbox.

name: Hafgufa Spawn
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 10, Stealth 14 (19 underwater). Resistant to Exhaustion and Frightened. Darkvision 60 ft. No languages.
description: A juvenile hafgufa that snares prey with tentacles and can disable nearby creatures with a foul mist.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +5, Dex +2, Con +5, Int -2, Wis +0, Cha -2
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. Breathes air and water.
Monstrosity Resilience. Resistant to Exhaustion and Frightened.
Seagoing Lurker. Stealth is 19 underwater.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Tentacle attacks. One can be replaced with Bite.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. The attack has advantage against a creature Grappled by one of the spawn’s tentacles.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature is Grappled (escape DC 15), and the spawn can pull it up to 10 ft. straight toward itself. It can hold four creatures at once.
Reeking Mist (1/day). Each creature in a 20-ft. cube centered on the spawn makes a DC 13 Constitution save or becomes Incapacitated for 10 minutes. Repeat the save at the end of each turn to end the effect.

name: Hamingja
otherStatistics: Perception 15, Stealth 14. Resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, and radiant damage. Immune to poison damage and to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft. Languages Common and Celestial. Telepathy 60 ft.
description: This luminous, foxlike spirit brings luck to someone it sees as kind or destined for heroism. It generally stays unseen and takes animal or humanoid forms when it shows itself.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str -2, Dex +4, Con +0, Int +1, Wis +3, Cha +4
sections.Traits:
Celestial Resilience. Resistant to radiant damage.
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Radiant Touch attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Radiant Touch. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (2d4 + 2) radiant damage.
Spellcasting. Charisma, save DC 12, no material components. At will: Invisibility (self only), Light, Purify Food and Drink. 1/day each: Cure Wounds, Zone of Truth.
sections.Bonus Actions: Change Shape. Take the form of a Medium or smaller Beast or Humanoid, or return to Celestial form. Only size changes, except that a wingless form loses the flying speed. Equipment keeps its shape. Death returns the spirit to its true form.
sections.Reactions: Shot of Luck (3/day). When a bonded creature fails an attack roll, ability check, or save, add 1d6 to that roll. The new result may succeed.
sections.Encounter Context: The spirit stays with its host until either dies or the host becomes evil. In rare cases it serves a family or clan across generations.

name: Lindwurm, Sea
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 14, Stealth 19. Vulnerable to lightning damage and immune to cold damage. Darkvision 60 ft. Language Draconic.
description: A seal-like dragon with spiny scales and a venomous bite. It can scatter nearby creatures with its flippers and slip back into the water.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +8, Dex +3, Con +6, Int -2, Wis +4, Cha -1
sections.Traits: Amphibious. Breathes air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 14 Constitution save or is Restrained by the toxin. If still Restrained, the target repeats the save at the end of its next turn. Success ends the effect and failure makes the target Paralyzed for 1 hour.
Flipper Slap (recharge 5–6). All creatures in a 10-ft.-radius sphere around the lindwurm make a DC 16 Dexterity save. Failure deals 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and makes the creature Stunned until the end of its next turn. Success halves the damage and avoids Stunned.
sections.Bonus Actions: Deep Dive. Move up to half speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Malrgotr
otherStatistics: Perception 11, Stealth 10. Resistant to cold, fire, and lightning damage. Immune to Frightened and Stunned. Darkvision 60 ft. No languages.
description: A boar with metal bristles and golden tusks. It lives in forests and peatlands and attacks walls and farm buildings when it encounters them.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +4, Dex +0, Con +3, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -2
sections.Traits: Bristles. A creature within 5 ft. that hits the malrgotr with a melee attack takes 4 (1d8) piercing damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Gore and one Hooves attack.
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing plus 3 (1d6) radiant damage.
Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Glorious Flare (recharge 5–6). Each creature within 15 ft. makes a DC 13 Constitution save. Failure deals 7 (2d6) radiant damage and makes the creature Blinded through the end of its next turn.
sections.Encounter Context: The corpse yields 50 lb. of iron and 20 lb. of gold.

name: Skogsra
otherStatistics: Perception 16, Stealth 14. Darkvision 60 ft. Languages Common and Sylvan.
description: A forest predator poses as a lost traveler. Beneath the disguise is a hollow, bark-covered body from which it lashes out with vines and venomous claws.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +4, Dex +4, Con +2, Int +2, Wis +6, Cha +7
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Claw attacks. One Claw can be replaced with Grasping Vines or Spellcasting.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Grasping Vines. One visible Medium or smaller creature within 15 ft. makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure it is pulled up to 10 ft. toward the skogsra and is Grappled (escape DC 15).
Spellcasting. Charisma, save DC 15. At will: Charm, Shocking Grasp. 1/day each: Call Lightning, Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Ice Storm, Wind Wall.
sections.Bonus Actions: Hollow Trap. Pull a creature the skogsra is Grappling into its hollow body, ending the Grapple. The creature is Blinded and Restrained and has total cover against outside attacks and effects. At the start of each of the trapped creature’s turns, it takes 7 (2d6) slashing plus 7 (2d6) poison damage. A Humanoid reduced to 0 HP by this damage is stable and Paralyzed for 12 hours or until it regains HP. Capacity one. If the creature inside deals at least 15 damage in a single turn, the skogsra makes a DC 13 Constitution save at the end of that turn. On a failure it expels the creature Prone within 5 ft. If the skogsra dies, the restraint and paralysis from the trap end, and the creature can spend 5 ft. of movement to exit Prone.

name: Sleipnirspringr
otherStatistics: Perception 11, Stealth 13. No special senses or languages.
description: An eight-legged horse descended from Wotan’s mount. It is headstrong and chooses its own rider, often someone it encounters performing a great deed or causing trouble.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +3, Dex +3, Con +3, Int -2, Wis -1, Cha +2
sections.Traits: Preternatural Balance. Automatically succeeds on saves against falling Prone and cannot be pushed or pulled by nonmagical means.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Hoof attacks.
Hoof. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Trickster Spawn. Take the Dash, Disengage, or Dodge action.

name: Boreas's Chosen
otherStatistics: Perception 12, Stealth 12. Immune to cold damage. Languages Common, Giant.
description: Boreas's chosen fight with frost-laced spears and can breathe a gust cold enough to freeze their enemies in place.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +4, Int -1, Wis +2, Cha +0
sections.Traits: Ice Walk. Cross and climb ice without a check. Snow and ice do not slow the chosen.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Spear attacks.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold.
Breath of the North Wind (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 15-ft. cone make a DC 14 Constitution save. On failure, they take 28 (8d6) cold damage and lose 10 ft. of speed until the end of their next turn. A creature that fails by 5 or more is instead Petrified in ice until the end of its next turn. On success, it takes half damage and retains its full speed.
sections.Reactions: Freezing Blood. When an attack hits the chosen, every creature within 5 ft. takes 4 (1d8) cold damage.

name: Frost-Afflicted
otherStatistics: Perception 13, Stealth 12. Immune to cold damage and Petrified. Languages Common, Giant.
description: Ice covers this fighter and pricks foes who press in too close.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +1, Dex +2, Con +4, Int +1, Wis +3, Cha +0
sections.Traits:
Burning Ice. The frost-afflicted's cold damage bypasses cold resistance. Cold immunity still applies.
Iced Skin. A creature that hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft. takes 4 (1d8) piercing damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Frigid Punch and Frost Bolt.
Frigid Punch. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) cold.
Frost Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +4 to hit, range 60 ft. Hit 13 (2d10 + 2) cold damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Frigid Flare (recharge 5–6). Each creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On failure, it takes 4 (1d8) cold damage and loses 10 ft. of speed until the end of the frost-afflicted’s next turn.

name: Huskarl
otherStatistics: Perception 14, Stealth 11. Language Common.
description: This armored retainer fights close enough to take a blow meant for an ally.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +4, Dex +1, Con +5, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha +1
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Battle Axe and Javelin.
Battle Axe. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Interpose. When an ally within 5 ft. takes damage, the huskarl can take that damage in the ally’s place.

name: Runewright
otherStatistics: Perception 17, Stealth 12. Resists cold, fire, and lightning damage. Immune to necrotic and poison damage and to Blinded, Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, and Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft. Languages Common and two others.
description: A dead wizard preserves its mastery of runes by carving them into its skin and hunting for new magic.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +1, Int +9, Wis +1, Cha +8
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rune Blast attacks. Runic Gaze can replace one attack.
Rune Blast. Melee or ranged spell attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit 21 (3d10 + 5) damage. Choose cold, fire, lightning, or radiant according to the rune used.
Runic Gaze. One creature the runewright sees within 60 ft. makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. Failure deals 14 (2d8 + 5) psychic damage and imposes either Charmed or Frightened, chosen by the runewright, until the start of its next turn. Success halves the damage and avoids the condition.
sections.Spellcasting:
Uses Intelligence, save DC 17, and requires no material components.
At will: Detect Magic, Disguise Self.
2/day each: Counterspell, Dispel Magic, Silence.
1/day each: Dimension Door, Elemental Shield, Freedom of Movement.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Arcane Sense. Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. Identify one spell affecting it or one magic item it carries, if any.
Misty Step. Cast the Misty Step spell.
sections.Reactions: Sun Rune. When an attack roll hits the runewright, it can force its attacker to make a DC 17 Constitution save. Failure makes the attacker Blinded until the end of its next turn.

name: Skein Witch
otherStatistics: Perception 23, Stealth 11. Resists radiant damage. Immune to fire, lightning, and psychic damage. Truesight 60 ft. Language Celestial. Telepathy 120 ft.
description: A celestial weaver of fate can bind two allies together so that each suffers the harm dealt to the other.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str -2, Dex +1, Con +2, Int +7, Wis +13, Cha +5
sections.Traits:
Fate's Resistance (3/day). After failing a save, choose to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Inexorable Thread attacks.
Inexorable Thread. Melee or ranged spell attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. Hit 27 (5d8 + 5) radiant damage. On a hit, the witch can teleport with its gear up to 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space.
Destiny Distortion Wave (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 60-ft. cone make a DC 17 Wisdom save. Failure deals 55 force damage and gives disadvantage on checks, attacks, and saves for 1 minute. Repeat the save at the end of each turn to end the disadvantage. Success halves the damage and avoids the disadvantage.
Bind Fates (1/day). One visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On failure, bind it to one ally of that target, chosen by the witch. Damage and conditions that would affect either bound creature affect its partner instead. A creature can have only one partner. Greater Restoration, Heal, Remove Curse, or comparable magic ends the bond.
sections.Bonus Actions: Cutting the Thread. Choose a visible creature at 0 HP within 30 ft. It loses its stability if stable and immediately rolls a death save.
sections.Reactions: Parry Spell. When the witch beats a save DC by 5 or more against a spell of 4th level or lower that targets only it, the spell rebounds on the caster. Use the original caster’s circle, save DC, attack bonus, and spellcasting ability.
sections.Encounter Notes: Fear of Cards. Bringing a Deck of Many Things near the witch causes it to wail and disintegrate.

name: Vaettir, Buried Lord
otherStatistics: Perception 13, Stealth 12. Resists cold damage. Immune to necrotic and poison damage and to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., truesight 30 ft. Languages known in life.
description: An undead ruler watches over its plunder and commands the warriors buried with it.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +5, Dex +2, Con +5, Int +0, Wis +1, Cha +5
sections.Traits:
Aura of Authority. Allies within 10 ft. have advantage on attacks and saves while the buried lord is free of the Incapacitated condition.
Grave Goods Sense. Pinpoint anyone wearing or carrying its belongings or grave goods within 60 ft. and sense the direction of those objects within 1 mile.
Rejuvenation. After destruction, return at full HP in a new body 24 hours later, in a random unoccupied space within 100 ft. of the spot where it fell. Putting it to rest, usually by returning its remains to its burial mound, prevents this.
Sunlight Sensitivity. Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while in sunlight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Longsword attacks or two Longbow attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft. Hit 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Corpse Breath (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 15-ft. cone make a DC 13 Constitution save. On failure, a creature is Poisoned for 1 minute and can repeat the save at the end of each turn to end it.
Disorienting Gaze. One creature the buried lord sees within 30 ft. makes a DC 13 Charisma save. On failure, it is Incapacitated and travels in a random direction whenever it moves. Repeat the save at the end of each turn to end the effect. A success grants immunity to this buried lord’s gaze for 24 hours.
sections.Spellcasting:
Uses Charisma, save DC 13, and requires no material components.
2/day: Bane.
1/day each: Enlarge/Reduce, Gaseous Form.
sections.Bonus Actions: Mark Quarry (2/day). Mark one visible creature within 30 ft. until the start of the buried lord’s next turn. Its weapon hits against that creature deal an extra 1d6 of the weapon’s damage type.
sections.Reactions: Parry. Add 2 AC against one melee attack that would hit. The buried lord must see its attacker and wield a melee weapon or hold a shield.

name: Vaettir, Drowned Raider
otherStatistics: Perception 13, Stealth 10. Resists cold and fire damage. Immune to necrotic and poison damage and to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft. Languages known in life.
description: A waterlogged warrior hunts for grave goods carried out to sea when its burial place flooded.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +4, Dex +0, Con +2, Int -1, Wis +1, Cha -1
sections.Traits:
Grave Goods Sense. Pinpoint anyone wearing or carrying its belongings or grave goods within 60 ft. and sense the direction of those objects within 1 mile.
Rejuvenation. After destruction, return at full HP in a new body 24 hours later, in a random unoccupied space within 100 ft. of the spot where it fell. Putting it to rest, usually by returning its remains to its burial mound, prevents this.
Sunlight Sensitivity. Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while in sunlight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Battleaxe and Javelin.
Battleaxe. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Water Purge. Creatures in a 20-ft. by 5-ft. line make a DC 12 Dexterity save. Failure deals 7 (2d6) necrotic damage and makes a target Poisoned until the end of its next turn. Success halves the damage and avoids the condition.

name: Vedaja
otherStatistics: Perception 13, Stealth 15. Immune to poison and psychic damage and to Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft. Understands its creator's language and one other but cannot speak.
description: This statuette of wood or horn can shape its hands into blunt fists or piercing points.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str -1, Dex +3, Con +2, Int +0, Wis +1, Cha +3
sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. Its form cannot be altered.
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Hand attacks.
Hand. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning or piercing damage, chosen by the vedaja.
Terrifying Glare. One creature the vedaja sees within 30 ft. makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. Failure makes it Frightened until the end of the vedaja’s next turn. It is also Paralyzed for as long as it remains Frightened by the glare.

name: Drake, Nidhogg-Blooded
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 14, Stealth 12. Immune to poison damage and the Poisoned condition. Darkvision 60 ft., keensense 20 ft. Languages Common, Northern Tongue, and Draconic.
description: These wolf-sized drakes pick up Nidhogg’s corruption near his prison beneath Yggdrasil. Their narrow legs support jaws lined with rows of tiny teeth.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +6, Int +1, Wis +0, Cha +2
sections.Traits: Ancient Imprisonment. The drake has disadvantage on saves against effects that would Grapple, Restrain, or otherwise trap it.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing and 5 (1d10) poison damage. The target is Poisoned until the drake’s next turn starts.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Venom Spit (recharge 4–6). Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit 35 (6d10 + 2) poison damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Earth Wyrm. Move up to the drake’s burrow speed.

name: Giant, Jotun
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 15, Stealth 16. Immune to cold and to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Darkvision 120 ft. Languages Common and Giant.
description: Jotun claim the oldest mountain and glacier halls in the North. The giants keep secrets from before the present age and plot against the gods who displaced them.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +14, Dex -1, Con +13, Int +4, Wis +12, Cha +9
sections.Traits:
Giant Attributes. Resistant to Stunned and vulnerable to Prone. It has advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end Stunned, and disadvantage on checks and saves to avoid or end Prone.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed save into a success.
Magic Resistance. The jotun has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Material Bound. Effects cannot force the jotun off the Material Plane against its will. It has disadvantage on saves against effects that would return it there from another plane.
Too Big to Notice. Stealth becomes 21 while the jotun holds still in nonmagical natural terrain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Greatclub or Rock in any combination. One can be replaced with Icy Sweep or a casting of Fear.
Greatclub. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 25 (4d8 + 7) bludgeoning and 36 (8d8) cold damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +14 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning and 36 (8d8) cold damage.
Icy Sweep (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 20-ft. radius centered on the jotun makes a DC 21 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 54 (12d8) cold damage, is pushed up to 15 ft. away, and falls Prone. On a success, it takes half damage and stays in place on its feet.
Spellcasting. Wisdom (spell save DC 20), no material components. At will: Bestow Curse, Earthquake, Fear, Gust of Wind, and Speak with Animals.
sections.Reactions: Rock Catching. When a ranged weapon attack hits the jotun, it can catch the weapon or ammunition to reduce the attack’s damage by 38 (1d20 + 28). If this brings the damage to zero, it can throw what it caught at a creature within 60 ft., using the original attack roll and damage.
sections.Legendary Actions:
The jotun has three legendary actions. It can use one option at the end of another creature’s turn and regains spent actions at the start of its turn.
Hurl. Make one Rock attack.
Smash. Make one Greatclub attack.
Titanic Power. Use Spellcasting or an available Icy Sweep.

name: Giant, Lightning
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 14, Stealth 17. Immune to lightning and thunder damage. Darkvision 60 ft. Languages Auran, Common, and Giant.
description: Lightning giants rear huge goats and keep dire wolves in stormy mountain country. A giant can draw the electricity that plays over its skin into a glowing staff.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +6, Dex +7, Con +5, Int +2, Wis +4, Cha +2
sections.Traits:
Electrifying Flesh. A creature that hits the giant with a melee weapon makes a DC 16 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 3 (1d6) lightning damage, or 5 (1d10) if the weapon is conductive metal.
Giant Attributes. Resistant to Stunned and vulnerable to Prone. It has advantage on checks and saves to avoid or end Stunned, and disadvantage on checks and saves to avoid or end Prone.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Lightning Staff or Static Fling attacks in any combination.
Lightning Staff. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning and 9 (2d8) lightning damage.
Static Fling. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit 22 (4d8 + 4) lightning damage. The giant can push the target up to 15 ft.
Static Discharge (recharge 6 or Absorb Lightning). Each creature in a 20-ft.-radius sphere centered on the giant makes a DC 15 Constitution save. Failure deals 21 (6d6) lightning damage and leaves the creature Stunned until the end of its next turn. Success halves the damage and avoids Stunned.
sections.Bonus Actions: The giant can suppress Electrifying Flesh.
sections.Reactions: Absorb Lightning. When a creature the giant can see within 60 ft. deals lightning damage to another creature, the giant can absorb that damage into its staff. The original target takes none of that lightning damage, and Static Discharge recharges.

name: Giant, Thrudgelmir
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 22, Stealth 10. Cold damage resistance. Immune to Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, and Unconscious. Darkvision 120 ft. Languages Common and Giant.
description: A thrudgelmir hunts alone across the far north. Six heads let it stay on watch constantly, while runes tattooed across its skin feed elemental power into its iron mauls.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +10, Dex +0, Con +10, Int +2, Wis +7, Cha +4
sections.Traits:
Ever Vigilant. At least two of the giant’s heads are always awake. Perception 22.
Giant Attributes. The trait lists resistance to Stunned and vulnerability to Prone. The stat line grants immunity to Stunned. It has disadvantage on checks and saves to avoid or end Prone.
Magic Resistance. The giant has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Runic Tattoos. Treat the tattoos as a 5th-circle spell for Dispel Magic. A successful dispel suppresses the tattoos for 1 minute, removing Magic Resistance and Elemental Hammer’s extra elemental damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Elemental Hammer attacks.
Elemental Hammer. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 24 (4d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (2d12) extra damage. Roll 1d6 for the extra type: 1 acid, 2 cold, 3 fire, 4 lightning, 5 poison, 6 thunder.
Faces of Evil (recharge 5–6). Every creature within 30 ft. that can see the giant makes a DC 16 Charisma save. On a failure, roll 1d6 for the effect. Ongoing effects last through the end of the giant’s next turn.
1. Sad. Disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saves.
2. Angry. The creature treats its allies as foes and the giant as an ally. It attacks its nearest perceived foe on its turn.
3. Happy. Charmed.
4. Sleepy. Unconscious.
5. Pained. 14 (4d6) psychic damage.
6. Scared. Frightened.

name: Giant, Thursir
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 14, Stealth 10. Darkvision 60 ft. Languages Common, Dwarven, and Giant.
description: Thursir smiths work in workshops under frozen mountains. Their craft draws customers from other giants, and wrestling and feasting fill the hours away from the forge.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +4, Dex +0, Con +5, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha +0
sections.Traits: Cast Iron Stomach. A thursir has advantage on saves to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.
sections.Actions:
Thurs Rune Warhammer. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning and 11 (2d10) lightning damage. The target loses its reactions until the start of the giant’s next turn.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 26 (4d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Gnoll, Tundra
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 13, Stealth 14. Immune to cold damage. Darkvision 60 ft. Language Gnoll.
description: White-furred tundra gnolls wait in snowbanks for prey. They form small hunting bands across tundra, pine barrens, and snowy hills.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +2, Dex +2, Con +1, Int -2, Wis +3, Cha -2
sections.Traits: Arctic Camouflage. Stealth becomes 19 in snow or ice.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bone Axe attacks or two Bone Bow attacks.
Bone Axe. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage.
Bone Bow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.
Freezing Glare. Choose one creature the gnoll can see within 20 ft. It must pass a DC 12 Wisdom save or its speed becomes 0 through the end of its next turn.
sections.Bonus Actions: Rampage (2/day). When the gnoll damages a creature at half its hit points or fewer, the gnoll can move up to half speed and make a Bone Axe attack.

name: Jorumungkyn
otherStatistics: Perception 12, Stealth 9. Resistant to bludgeoning damage. Immune to cold, poison, and psychic damage and to Charmed and Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft. Understands Draconic and cannot speak.
description: This spiny sea dragon rises from frigid trenches to pull ships under. It sheds a poisonous film onto the surface of the water. Aboleths sometimes try to make servants of them.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +7, Dex -1, Con +9, Int -3, Wis +2, Cha -1
sections.Traits: Poisonous Secretions. A creature that starts its turn within 10 ft. of the dragon, or within 30 ft. in water, takes 3 (1d6) poison damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make a Bite attack and a Tail attack, then use Constrict.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 15 ft. Hit 25 (4d8 + 7) piercing and 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 15 ft. Hit 21 (4d6 + 7) bludgeoning and 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Constrict. Target one visible Huge or smaller creature within 15 ft. It makes a DC 19 Strength save. Failure deals 21 (4d6 + 7) bludgeoning and 7 (2d6) poison damage, and leaves the target Grappled (escape DC 19) and Restrained until the grapple ends.
sections.Bonus Actions: Glare of the Deep (2/day). Choose one creature the dragon can see within 60 ft. On a failed DC 14 Intelligence save, the creature takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage and is Charmed for 1 minute. While Charmed, it is Incapacitated, and on its turn moves by the most direct route to within 5 ft. of the dragon if farther away. It repeats the save before entering damaging terrain or when damaged by another source. Success ends the effect and grants immunity to this dragon’s Glare for 24 hours.

name: Ogre, Great
otherStatistics: Perception 11, Stealth 9. Darkvision 60 ft. Languages Common and Giant.
description: Angrboda and Bergelmir tried to outdo each other by making a stronger ogre. The result was big enough to swing trees and anchors and still liked to smash whatever caught its eye.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +5, Dex -1, Con +3, Int -2, Wis -1, Cha -1
sections.Traits: Massive Frame. The great ogre has advantage on Strength saves and Strength (Athletics) checks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatclub attacks or throw two Javelins.
Greatclub. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit 19 (4d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 50/200 ft. Hit 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.
Hideous Belch (recharge 6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and is Poisoned for 1 minute. Success halves the damage and avoids Poisoned. An affected creature repeats the save at the end of each turn, ending the condition on a success.
sections.Reactions: Tense Muscles (recharge 6). When an attack hits the ogre and deals bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, the ogre can halve the attack’s damage.

name: Sea Serpent
otherStatistics: Perception 13, Stealth 15. No special senses or languages.
description: The fins along a sea serpent’s back show above the surface like a row of sails. Wild ones hunt in open water. Hatchlings can imprint on a keeper and grow into ship guards or mounts.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +6, Dex +3, Con +3, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -3
sections.Traits: Constrictor. After hitting with Bite, the serpent can use Constrict as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage.
Constrict. Choose a visible Huge or smaller creature within 10 ft. It makes a DC 14 Strength save. Failure deals 10 (4d4) bludgeoning damage and leaves the target Grappled (escape DC 16).

name: Moose
otherStatistics: Perception 13, Stealth 10. No special senses or languages.
description: A short-tempered forest browser with broad antlers. Northlanders call it an elg.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +4, Dex +0, Con +2, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -3
sections.Traits: Forest Walker. Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in forest terrain.
sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Against a Large or smaller creature, a straight approach of at least 10 ft. immediately before the hit adds 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage and knocks the target Prone.
sections.Reactions: Fury. After taking at least 5 damage, gain advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

name: Reindeer
otherStatistics: Perception 13, Stealth 13. No special senses or languages.
description: Wild herds cross the coldest reaches of the Northlands. Domestic reindeer pull sleds and provide meat and milk.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +2, Dex +3, Con +2, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -3
sections.Traits:
Agile. Moving out of an enemy's reach provokes no opportunity attack.
Snowstrider. The reindeer ignores difficult terrain from snow and ice.
sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 7 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Burst of Speed (3/day). Double its speed until the start of its next turn.

name: Selkie
speed: 30 ft., swim 30 ft. (seal form 20 ft., swim 50 ft.)
otherStatistics: AC 14 in seal form. Perception 14, Stealth 14. Resists cold. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks Aquan, Common, and Sylvan.
description: A coastal fey who becomes a seal with the help of a skin bound to them alone. A selkie whose skin is stolen may enlist other selkies to recover it.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +2, Dex +2, Con +2, Int +0, Wis +2, Cha +3
sections.Traits:
Fey Resilience. Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed or Unconscious.
Hold Breath. It can hold its breath for 30 minutes.
Speak with Pinnipeds. It can talk with seals, sea lions, and walruses as though they spoke the same language.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. In seal form, make one Bite and two Tail attacks. In Fey form, make three Spear attacks.
Bite (seal form only). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Spear (Fey form only). Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Tail (seal form only). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Change Shape. Magically switch between a Medium seal and its true Fey form. Statistics other than AC, size, and speed carry over, and equipped or carried gear changes with it. A selkie in Fey form must be wearing or carrying its own bound sealskin to use this action. Death restores its Fey form.
Charming Escape. Dash or Disengage. If it Disengages this way, each creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or becomes Charmed until the end of the selkie's next turn.

name: Skeljaskra
otherStatistics: Perception 11, Stealth 8. Immune to Exhaustion. Darkvision 60 ft. No languages.
description: A pale, plated scavenger that can eat a small house. Stones and scraps of metal turn up in its droppings.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +5, Dex -2, Con +6, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -2
sections.Traits: Siege Monster. Deal double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks chosen from Rend, Burning Spit, and Tail in any combination.
Rend. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.
Burning Spit. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 30 ft. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) poison damage, and the target is Blinded and Poisoned until the start of the skeljaskra's next turn.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage and push the target 5 ft.
sections.Reactions: Armored Ball. After taking at least 10 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage from one source, roll up until the start of its next turn. While rolled up, it resists those three damage types and is Incapacitated.

name: Skeljaskra, Dread
otherStatistics: Perception 11, Stealth 8. Immune to Exhaustion. Darkvision 60 ft. No languages.
description: Rare skeljaskras grow for years while sleeping in places steeped in magic. A full-grown one can flatten a settlement.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +6, Dex -2, Con +9, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -2
sections.Traits: Siege Monster. Deal double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks chosen from Rend, Burning Spit, and Spiked Tail in any combination.
Rend. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit 33 (6d8 + 6) slashing damage.
Burning Spit. Ranged weapon attack, +10 to hit, range 90 ft. Hit 20 (4d6 + 6) poison plus 10 (3d6) fire damage, and the target is Blinded and Poisoned until the start of the skeljaskra's next turn.
Spiked Tail. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 15 ft. Hit 33 (5d10 + 6) piercing damage and push the target 20 ft.
Crushing Roll (Recharge 5–6). If it begins its turn in Armored Ball form, it can roll along a line 15 ft. wide and up to 60 ft. long. Each creature in that line must pass a DC 16 Dexterity save or take 32 (5d12) bludgeoning damage and fall Prone.
sections.Reactions: Armored Ball. After taking at least 30 damage, it can roll up until the start of its next turn. While rolled up, it is immune to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and is Incapacitated.

name: Troll, Fjord
otherStatistics: Perception 15, Stealth 12. Resists cold and poison. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks Giant.
description: Webbed hands let this troll paddle its own fishing canoe. Its hooked claws carry a paralytic toxin.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +4, Int -1, Wis -1, Cha -2
sections.Traits:
Hold Breath. It can hold its breath for 30 minutes.
Regeneration. Recover 15 HP at the start of each turn. Acid or fire damage suppresses recovery on the next turn. It dies only if it starts a turn with 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Gouge attacks.
Gouge. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing plus 7 (2d6) poison damage. A creature must pass a DC 15 Constitution save or become Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.
Water Stream. Each creature in a line 30 ft. long and 5 ft. wide makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. Failure deals 22 (4d10) cold damage and pushes a Huge or smaller target up to 10 ft. away. Success halves the damage and prevents the push.
sections.Bonus Actions: Aquatic Charge. Swim up to half its swim speed.

name: Troll, Gilitrutt
otherStatistics: Perception 13, Stealth 12. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks Giant.
description: A small troll that can take the shape of a giant hound. It hunts beside other trolls and guards them with fierce loyalty.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +5, Int -2, Wis +1, Cha -2
sections.Traits: Regeneration. Recover 10 HP at the start of each turn. Acid or fire damage suppresses recovery on the next turn. It dies only if it starts a turn with 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks in hound form or three Claw attacks in troll form.
Bite (hound form only). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. A Large or smaller creature also falls Prone.
Claw (troll form only). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Shape-Shift. Become a Large hound with a speed of 40 ft. or return to troll form. The troll keeps its other statistics except for its form-specific attacks. Its worn and carried gear does not transform.

name: Troll, Glacial
otherStatistics: Perception 16, Stealth 11. Vulnerable to fire. Immune to cold. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks Giant.
description: Blue ice plates grow over its back and claws. It feeds on prey frozen in glacial ice, and frost giants sometimes hire it as a guard.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +5, Dex +1, Con +5, Int -2, Wis +0, Cha -2
sections.Traits:
Frigid Aura. Nonmagical fire within 15 ft. goes out. When an ongoing magical flame overlaps the aura, its caster must pass a DC 16 Constitution save or the spell ends. Success protects that casting against further saves from the aura.
Icy Carapace. A creature within 5 ft. takes 4 (1d8) cold damage when it hits the troll with a melee attack.
Regeneration. Recover 15 HP at the start of each turn. Acid or fire damage suppresses recovery on the next turn. It dies only if it starts a turn with 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Ice Rend attacks. Replace one with Hoary Breath if available.
Ice Rend. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing plus 4 (1d8) cold damage.
Hoary Breath (Recharge 5–6). Choose one target within 5 ft. On a failed DC 16 Dexterity save, the target takes 14 (3d6) cold damage as printed and is Restrained by ice for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a DC 16 Strength save to break free and end the condition.

name: Troll, Wind
otherStatistics: Perception 14, Stealth 14. Resists cold. Immune to lightning, thunder, Deafened, and Exhaustion. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks Giant and Primordial (Auran).
description: A blue-haired trickster that takes to the air to dance in hard storms. Northlanders connect the first wind trolls with Thor and Loki.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +2, Dex +4, Con +7, Int +0, Wis +1, Cha +3
sections.Traits:
Regeneration. Recover 15 HP at the start of each turn. Acid or fire damage suppresses recovery on the next turn. It dies only if it starts a turn with 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
Storm Absorption. When subjected to lightning or thunder damage, recover HP equal to that damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Rend, Storm Strike, or any combination.
Rend. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.
Storm Strike. Ranged spell attack, +7 to hit, range 60 ft. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) lightning plus 4 (1d8) thunder damage, and a Medium or smaller creature falls Prone.
Windstorm (Recharge 5–6). Each creature within the 20-ft. radius makes a DC 15 Strength save. Failure deals 9 (2d8) bludgeoning plus 9 (2d8) thunder damage and pushes the target up to 10 ft. away from the troll. Success halves the damage and prevents the push.
