Spellcasting. Charisma, spell save DC 14. No material components. At will: Fog Cloud. 2/day: Gust of Wind. 1/day: Wind Wall.
sections.Bonus Actions: Flying Charge. Fly up to half its fly speed.

name: Trollkin Raider
otherStatistics: Perception 11, Stealth 11. No special senses. Speaks Common.
description: A longship raider or hired reaver who trades between bow and spear as the fight closes.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +4, Dex +0, Con +3, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -2
sections.Traits: Regeneration. Recover 5 HP at the start of each turn. Acid or fire damage suppresses recovery on the next turn. It dies only if it starts a turn with 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks with Spear or Longbow in any combination.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft. Hit 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Aim. Gain advantage on its next ranged attack roll this turn.

name: Trollkin, Berserker
otherStatistics: Perception 14, Stealth 12. Immune to Charmed and Frightened. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks Common and Giant.
description: Trollkin rites give this front-line fighter a reserve of fury that shows when it is badly wounded.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +7, Int +0, Wis +1, Cha +0
sections.Traits:
Bloodied Frenzy. At or below half its maximum HP, it has advantage on attack rolls and saves.
Regeneration. Recover 5 HP at the start of each turn. Acid or fire damage suppresses recovery on the next turn. It dies only if it starts a turn with 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make four attacks with Freezing Bryntroll or Freezing Handaxe in any combination.
Freezing Bryntroll. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing plus 4 (1d8) cold damage. Once per round after a hit, make another attack roll with the bryntroll against a second creature within 5 ft. of the first and within reach. That hit deals 13 (2d12) slashing damage.
Freezing Handaxe. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing plus 4 (1d8) cold damage.

name: Jarl
otherStatistics: Perception 14, Stealth 12. Immune to Charmed and Frightened. Languages Common and three others.
description: A jarl lends courage to nearby allies and slips away from dangerous blows when wounded.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +6, Int +1, Wis +2, Cha +3
sections.Traits:
Aura of Command. The jarl and allies within 10 ft. cannot be Charmed or Frightened while the jarl lacks the Incapacitated condition.
Mental Fortitude. Effects cannot read the jarl’s thoughts or sense its emotions. It has advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to gauge sincerity or intent.
Resilient Leader (recharges after a short or long rest). Reroll a failed save and use the new result.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Longsword and Longbow.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) force.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft. Hit 7 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) force.
sections.Bonus Actions: Loyal Heroism. Choose up to two visible allies within 30 ft. Each has advantage on the next attack roll or save it makes before the jarl’s next turn starts.
sections.Reactions: Evade. When hit at half maximum HP or below, add 3 to AC against the attack. If the attack misses, move up to half speed away from the attacker without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Merchant
otherStatistics: Perception 13, Stealth 13.
description: A trader can charm the person across the counter and call on nearby help when a deal turns violent.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +0, Dex +3, Con +1, Int +2, Wis +3, Cha +3
sections.Traits: Trader’s Eye. Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks to spot poor-quality or counterfeit wares and on Wisdom (Insight) checks to tell when someone is trying to sell such wares to the trader.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Shortsword and Quip.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Quip. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 60 ft. Hit 13 (3d6 + 3) psychic damage.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Best Bargain. One visible creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 13 Charisma save. On failure, it is Charmed until the merchant’s next turn starts.
Dismiss Allies. Dismiss the allies summoned by Call for Aid.
sections.Reactions: Call for Aid (1/day). When hit in a populated area, choose 1d4 Bandits or 1d4 Guards. They arrive at initiative count 20 of the following round and defend the merchant as allies. They stay for 1 hour, until the merchant dies, or until dismissed.

name: Merchant Captain
otherStatistics: Perception 14, Stealth 13. Languages Common and three others.
description: A merchant captain reads a bad deal quickly and uses practiced banter to unsettle opponents.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +0, Dex +3, Con +4, Int +3, Wis +4, Cha +7
sections.Traits: Trader’s Eye. Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks to spot poor-quality or counterfeit wares and on Wisdom (Insight) checks to tell when someone is trying to sell such wares to the trader.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make four attacks in any combination of Shortsword and Quip.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Quip. Ranged spell attack, +7 to hit, range 60 ft. Hit 14 (3d6 + 4) psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Uses Charisma, save DC 15.
At will: Comprehend Languages, Mage Hand, Mending.
3/day each: Calm Emotions, Enthrall, Heroism.
1/day each: Confusion, Freedom of Movement.
sections.Bonus Actions: Fast Talk. A visible creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Charisma save. On failure, its next attack roll or save before the captain’s next turn starts has disadvantage.
sections.Reactions: Banter (4/day). When a creature within 30 ft. fails an attack roll, ability check, or save, it can reroll and must keep the new result.

name: Northern Hunter
otherStatistics: Perception 12, Stealth 13. Resists cold damage. Immune to Frightened. Languages Common and two others.
description: The Northern Hunter tracks prey through the snow and slows it with poisoned arrows.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +5, Dex +3, Con +5, Int +2, Wis +7, Cha +0
sections.Traits: Arctic Tracker. Advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track through forest, cold grassland, and glacial terrain. Snow and ice do not cost extra movement as difficult terrain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make four attacks in any combination of Longbow and Spear. For each, the hunter may replace the weapon’s usual damage type with force.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft. Hit 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison. Reduce the target’s speed by 10 ft. until the hunter’s next turn starts. This reduction does not stack.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. The printing lists no ranged distance. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage. The target has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the hunter’s next turn starts.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Slayer (3/day). The hunter’s next attack bypasses damage resistances and immunities.
Swift Hunter. Move up to full speed toward an enemy the hunter can see.
sections.Reactions: No Escape. When a visible creature within 40 ft. moves into a space more than 10 ft. away, the hunter throws a bola or similar object. The creature falls Prone on a failed DC 16 Strength save.

name: Shaman
otherStatistics: Perception 15, Stealth 11. Languages Common and one other.
description: A shaman poisons foes with curses and gives companions a burst of ferocity.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +2, Dex +1, Con +2, Int +0, Wis +3, Cha +1
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Ritual Staff and Cursed Bolt.
Ritual Staff. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) poison.
Cursed Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 60 ft. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) necrotic damage. The target is Poisoned until its next turn ends.
sections.Spellcasting:
Uses Wisdom, save DC 15.
At will: Druidcraft, Guidance, Mending.
2/day each: Cure Wounds, Entangle, Fog Cloud.
1/day each: Flaming Sphere, Plant Growth.
sections.Bonus Actions: Inspire Ferocity (recharge 4–6). Choose up to three visible creatures. Each gains 10 temporary HP and has advantage on attack rolls and saves until the shaman’s next turn ends.
sections.Reactions: Minor Elemental Absorption (3/day). Gain resistance against one instance of incoming acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage.

name: Shield-Maiden
otherStatistics: Perception 13, Stealth 12. Languages Common and one other.
description: The shield-maiden fights beside allies, deflecting a blow and striking back if it misses.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +4, Int +0, Wis +1, Cha +1
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Longsword and Javelin. Shield Bash can replace one attack.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.
Javelin. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Shield Bash. Choose one visible creature within 5 ft. It makes a DC 12 Strength save. On failure, it takes 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller target falls Prone.
sections.Bonus Actions: Call to Arms (recharge 6). Choose up to three creatures within 30 ft. that can hear the shield-maiden. They gain advantage on attack rolls until her next turn starts.
sections.Reactions: Interpose Shield. When a creature within 5 ft. is hit by a melee attack, it can add 2 to its AC against that attack. If the attack misses, the shield-maiden can make one weapon attack against the attacker.

name: Skald
otherStatistics: Perception 14, Stealth 13. Languages Common and one other.
description: A skald uses stories and spells to steady an ally in a fight.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +0, Dex +3, Con +2, Int +2, Wis +1, Cha +7
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make either two Shortsword attacks or two Shortbow attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Uses Charisma, save DC 15. No material components required.
At will: Message, Prestidigitation.
2/day each: Heroism, Hideous Laughter.
1/day: Enthrall.
sections.Bonus Actions: Heroic Oration (recharge 5–6). Choose one creature within 30 ft. that can hear the skald. It has advantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the skald’s next turn starts.

name: Viking
otherStatistics: Perception 11, Stealth 11. Language Common.
description: A viking is most dangerous when another raider closes in on the same foe.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +4, Int -1, Wis +1, Cha +0
sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The viking has advantage on an attack against a target if an ally within 5 ft. of it is not Incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Battleaxe and Shortbow. The text names Longbow, but prints only a Shortbow attack.
Battleaxe. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft. Hit 5 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

name: Wandering Druid
otherStatistics: Perception 17, Stealth 13. Languages Common and one other.
description: This traveling druid can turn into a beast and bring down enemies with radiant claws.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +1, Dex +3, Con +2, Int +4, Wis +7, Cha +1
sections.Traits: Primal Strike. After hitting on its own turn, the druid can add 1d8 cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage to the hit. It chooses the type on the hit and can do this once per turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks or cast a spell.
Fang and Claw (beast form only). Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 17 (4d6 + 3) radiant damage and the target falls Prone.
Hand Axe (humanoid form only). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 8 (2d6 + 1) slashing damage.
Short Bow (humanoid form only). Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Verdant Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +7 to hit, range 90 ft. Hit 14 (3d6 + 4) radiant damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Humanoid form only. Uses Wisdom, save DC 15.
At will: Barkskin (included in AC), Detect Magic, Guidance, Message, Speak with Animals.
2/day each: Call Lightning, Cure Wounds.
1/day each: Blight, Revivify.
sections.Bonus Actions: Wild Shape. Shift into a beast or back to humanoid form. Statistics stay the same except for rules marked by form. When the druid becomes a beast, it gains 18 temporary HP and its worn and carried equipment merges into its body.

name: War Chaplain
otherStatistics: Perception 14, Stealth 10. Languages Common and two others.
description: A battlefield priest patches up a nearby ally and calls for another blow against a foe already under attack.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +2, Dex +0, Con +2, Int +0, Wis +4, Cha +2
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Longsword and Radiant Bolt.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) radiant.
Radiant Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +4 to hit, range 90 ft. Hit 13 (2d10 + 2) radiant damage.
War God’s Healing (recharge 5–6). One ally within 30 ft. regains 10 (3d6) HP.
sections.Bonus Actions: Divine Orders. Choose an ally within 30 ft. It can spend its reaction to attack a creature the chaplain attacked this round.

name: Warlord
otherStatistics: Perception 15, Stealth 12. Languages Common and one other.
description: The warlord directs attacks at a distance and counters anyone who gets close enough to strike.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +4, Dex +2, Con +6, Int +0, Wis +2, Cha +3
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Battleaxe and Longbow.
Battleaxe. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft. Hit 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Command. Choose an ally within 60 ft. that can see and hear the warlord. It can immediately spend its reaction to make one melee or ranged weapon attack against a target of the warlord’s choice.
Intimidate. A visible creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On failure, its attack rolls have disadvantage until the warlord’s next turn starts.
sections.Reactions: Reflexive Strike. When an attack roll hits the warlord, it can make one Battleaxe attack against the attacker. If the counterattack hits, the attacker falls Prone unless it passes a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check.

name: Warpriest
otherStatistics: Perception 17, Stealth 10. Immune to Frightened. Languages Common and two others.
description: A warpriest can call on divine power to make an ally’s strike hit harder.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +3, Dex +0, Con +6, Int +0, Wis +7, Cha +1
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Blessed Warhammer and Divine Flame.
Blessed Warhammer. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant or necrotic damage, chosen by the warpriest.
Divine Flame. Ranged spell attack, +7 to hit, range 120 ft. Hit 18 (4d6 + 4) radiant or necrotic damage, chosen by the warpriest.
sections.Spellcasting:
Uses Wisdom, save DC 15. No spell components required.
At will: Guidance, Light, Spare the Dying, Thaumaturgy.
2/day each: Command, Cure Wounds, Hold, Spiritual Weapon.
1/day each: Guardian of Faith, Protection from Energy.
sections.Bonus Actions: Divine Aid (3/day). Cast Bless, Dispel Magic, Healing Word, or Restoration.
sections.Reactions: War Blessing. When a visible creature within 30 ft. hits with a melee weapon attack, the warpriest can add 9 (2d8) radiant or necrotic damage to the hit. The warpriest chooses the type.

name: Witch
otherStatistics: Perception 16, Stealth 13. Languages Common and three others.
description: This witch can turn a successful roll sour or bind an attacker in sudden vines.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +0, Dex +3, Con +2, Int +4, Wis +2, Cha +8
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Dagger and Eldritch Burst.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 10 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison.
Eldritch Burst. Melee or ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit 18 (4d6 + 4) force damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Uses Charisma, save DC 16. No spell components required.
At will: Bane, Barkskin (included in AC), Druidcraft, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion.
2/day each: Charm Person, Hex, Invisibility.
1/day each: Blight, Polymorph.
sections.Bonus Actions: Misty Step. Cast Misty Step.
sections.Reactions:
Retributive Vines. When a visible attacker deals at least 5 damage to the witch, vines make the attacker Restrained until the start of its next turn.
Reflexive Hex. When a visible creature within 60 ft. succeeds on an ability check, attack roll, or save, it must roll 1d6 and subtract the result from the triggering roll.

name: Witch, Apprentice
otherStatistics: Perception 13, Stealth 12. Languages Common and two others.
description: The apprentice combines poisoned steel with force magic and has one short teleport to escape a close fight.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +0, Dex +2, Con +2, Int +2, Wis +1, Cha +3
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Dagger and Eldritch Burst.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison.
Eldritch Burst. Melee or ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) force damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Uses Charisma, save DC 13. No spell components required.
At will: Barkskin (included in AC), Druidcraft, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion.
2/day each: Bane, Hex.
sections.Bonus Actions: Misty Step (1/day). Cast Misty Step.
sections.Reactions: Reflexive Hex. When a visible creature within 60 ft. makes an ability check, attack roll, or save, it must roll 1d4 and subtract the result from the triggering roll.

name: Avatar of Nidhogg
description: Nidhogg sends this wingless dragon of roots and clay in his place when a favored cultist needs his aid.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 23. Stealth 18. Immune to necrotic damage. Darkvision 120 ft. Keensense 60 ft. Speaks Common, Draconic, and Void Speech.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +13 · DEX +2 · CON +11 · INT +5 · WIS +13 · CHA +10
sections.Traits:
Aura of Hopelessness. A hostile creature that begins its turn within 15 ft. makes a DC 19 Wisdom save. On a failure, until its next turn starts, it rolls attacks with disadvantage and gains half as many HP from healing effects. The avatar can exempt any creature without spending an action.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The avatar can turn its failed save into a success.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Bite attacks, substituting a Tail attack for any of them.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 16 (2d8 + 7) piercing and 18 (4d8) necrotic damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit 14 (2d6 + 7) bludgeoning and 18 (4d8) necrotic damage. A Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 19) and stays Restrained until the grapple ends. The avatar can hold up to four Medium or smaller creatures or two Large creatures.
Decaying Breath (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 30-ft. cone make a DC 19 Constitution save, taking 54 (12d8) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Plant creatures and magical plants make this save with disadvantage. Use the maximum damage roll against them. Ordinary nonmagical plants in the cone die.
sections.Legendary Actions:
The avatar has three legendary actions per round. It chooses one option at the end of another creature’s turn and refreshes its pool at the start of its own.
Detect. Pinpoint every creature and trap within 30 ft. automatically.
Move. Move up to half speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Void Wave (2 actions). Each creature within 15 ft. makes a DC 19 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and falls Prone. Void taint imposes disadvantage on the save. If a tainted creature fails, it takes another 4 (1d8) necrotic damage per level of void taint. The avatar heals HP equal to that extra damage, then the creature loses all levels of void taint.
sections.Encounter reference: Void taint measures exposure to the Void. Use the target’s current levels for Void Wave. See Chapter 7 for the optional taint rules.

name: Bone Knight
description: The disgraced soldier’s soul is bound into a carved bone head mounted on a suit of plate.
otherStatistics: Plate armor. Perception 13. Stealth 8 in plate or 13 without it. Immune to necrotic and poison damage, exhaustion, Frightened, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks the languages it knew in life.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +3 · DEX +1 · CON +2 · INT +0 · WIS +1 · CHA +2
sections.Traits:
Disgraced Rejuvenation. If destroyed before it is redeemed, the knight revives at full HP in 1d4 days within 10 ft. of where it fell.
Necrotic Weapons. Add 2d6 necrotic damage to any weapon hit. The listed attacks already include it.
Undead Nature. The knight needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Undead Resilience. The knight ignores poison damage, exhaustion, and the Poisoned condition.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Longsword or Bone Spur.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) with two hands, plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage either way.
Bone Spur. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing and 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. A Large or smaller target must make a DC 13 Constitution save or move at half speed through the end of its next turn.
sections.Bonus Actions: Guard. Friendly creatures within 5 ft. of the knight gain +2 AC while it holds this stance. The stance ends when its next turn starts, it dies, or it becomes Incapacitated.

name: Dymaxion
description: A living chariot that scoops allies off the battlefield and breathes holy fire.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 17. Stealth 14. Resistant to poison, psychic, radiant, and nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, plus Grappled, Poisoned, Prone, and Restrained. Immune to exhaustion. Keensense 30 ft. Darkvision 120 ft. Speaks Common and Celestial.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +6 · DEX +4 · CON +2 · INT +1 · WIS +7 · CHA +6
sections.Traits:
Celestial Resilience. Resists radiant damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
Immortal Nature. The dymaxion needs no food, drink, or sleep.
Immutable Form. Spells and effects cannot change the dymaxion’s form.
Living Chariot. Its 10-ft.-square carriage holds up to four Medium creatures or one Large creature. Riders have half cover from attacks and effects originating outside the dymaxion’s space, and advantage on checks and saves against forced movement. They can see out, act on their own initiative, share its space, and travel with it. A creature within 5 ft. can board an available spot by spending 5 ft. of movement. A rider can spend 5 ft. of movement to step into a free space within 5 ft. of the dymaxion. A rider exits automatically if forced movement takes it out of the dymaxion’s occupied spaces.
Magic Resistance. The dymaxion rolls saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks count as magical.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Spiked Wheel or Spit Holy Fire.
Spiked Wheel. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage.
Spit Holy Fire. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) fire and 7 (2d6) radiant damage.
Holy Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 30-ft. cone make a DC 15 Dexterity save. A failed save deals 17 (5d6) fire and 17 (5d6) radiant damage. A success halves both.
sections.Bonus Actions: Rallying Rush. Move up to 30 ft. in a straight line through the spaces of creatures no larger than Large. The first entry into each eligible enemy’s space forces a DC 15 Strength save. A failure pushes it up to 5 ft. away from the dymaxion. The first entry into each eligible ally’s space lets that ally spend its reaction to board if there is room. Opportunity attacks against the dymaxion during this move have disadvantage.

name: Forge Servitor
description: A repair automaton from the Cold Forge that wields a saw and a pneumatic nail gun.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 15. Stealth 11. Immune to poison and psychic damage, exhaustion, Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, and Prone. Darkvision 60 ft. Understands Dwarvish and has no speech.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +3 · DEX +1 · CON +1 · INT -2 · WIS +1 · CHA -2
sections.Traits:
Construct Nature. The servitor needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Construct Resilience. The servitor ignores poison and psychic damage, exhaustion, and the Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned conditions.
Mechanic. The servitor and each ally within 5 ft. of it have advantage on ability checks using tools.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Saw or Pneumatic Nail. Repair can replace one attack.
Saw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.
Pneumatic Nail. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Repair. Another Construct or an object within 5 ft. regains 5 (2d4) HP, up to half its maximum HP.
sections.Bonus Actions: Spark Spray (19 HP or fewer). Creatures within 10 ft. make a DC 13 Dexterity save or take 7 (2d6) lightning damage.

name: Frost Knight
description: A warrior who froze before completing its mission. Burning every piece of its remains can put it to rest.
otherStatistics: Plate armor. Perception 14. Stealth 7 in plate or 12 without it. Resistant to cold and necrotic damage. Immune to poison damage, exhaustion, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks the languages it knew in life.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +7 · DEX +2 · CON +4 · INT +0 · WIS +1 · CHA +3
sections.Traits:
Disgraced Rejuvenation. If destroyed before it is redeemed, the knight revives at full HP in 1d4 days within 10 ft. of where it fell.
Undead Nature. The knight needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Undead Resilience. The knight ignores poison damage, exhaustion, and the Poisoned condition.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Warhammer attacks or two Ice Splinter attacks.
Warhammer. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing and 10 (3d6) cold damage.
Ice Splinter. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage. The target and any creature within 5 ft. of it then make a DC 15 Dexterity save. A failure deals 10 (3d6) cold damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Cold Stare. A visible creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, ice leaves it Restrained until the knight’s next turn starts or the target takes fire damage.

name: Giant of the Falling Mountain
description: A giant scholar of the Ancients who rides a bound skimmer and fights with recovered force weapons.
otherStatistics: Scale mail. Perception 13. Stealth 12. Resistant to Stunned. Vulnerable to Prone. No special senses. Speaks Common, Giant, and Qoradan.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +7 · DEX +2 · CON +7 · INT +4 · WIS +0 · CHA -1
sections.Traits:
Air Skimmer. A magic disk bound to the giant provides its fly speed. Treat the disk as part of its body. Individual targeting or separation requires the giant’s permission. The disk becomes ordinary metal on the giant’s death.
Flyby. Flying out of an enemy’s reach provokes no opportunity attacks.
Giant Attributes. The giant resists Stunned and is vulnerable to Prone.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Morningstar attacks or three Force Bolt attacks. A creature hit by both Morningstar attacks or by two Force Bolts can be pushed up to 10 ft. away from the giant.
Morningstar. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing and 5 (1d10) force damage.
Force Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d10 + 4) force damage.
Energy Lance (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 60-ft.-long, 10-ft.-wide line make a DC 15 Dexterity save against 27 (5d10) force damage, taking half on a success.
sections.Bonus Actions: Air Skimmer. While separated from the bound disk, the giant can call it back by magic.
sections.Reactions: Arcane Fumes. After a creature moves into a space within 5 ft. of the giant or attacks it while within 5 ft., the skimmer can vent gas. Creatures within 5 ft. make a DC 15 Constitution save or are Poisoned through the end of their next turn.

name: Qoradan Tomb Guardian
description: An orichalcum wheel with blades that races through the Ancients’ ruins to drive off intruders.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 16. Stealth 13. Resistant to acid, fire, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Immune to poison and psychic damage, exhaustion, Blinded, Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned. Keensense 120 ft. Understands the languages of the Ancients and Machine Speech and has no speech.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +7 · DEX +3 · CON +4 · INT -3 · WIS +6 · CHA -3
sections.Traits:
Construct Nature. The guardian needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Construct Resilience. The guardian ignores poison and psychic damage, exhaustion, and the Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned conditions.
Wheelie Maneuverable. Moving out of an enemy’s reach provokes no opportunity attacks. The guardian can fit through spaces large enough for a Small or Medium creature without squeezing.
Overdrive (46 HP or fewer). Once it hits this threshold, the guardian gains advantage on melee weapon attacks and its attackers gain advantage against it. This lasts until it has more than 51 HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make four Whirling Blade attacks or two Flame Jet attacks.
Whirling Blade. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage.
Flame Jet. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 21 (4d8 + 3) fire damage.
Acid Spray (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 30-ft. cone make a DC 15 Dexterity save against 31 (7d8) acid damage, taking half on a success.
sections.Bonus Actions: Freewheeler. Take the Dash action.
sections.Reactions: Stunning Jolt. When a visible creature within 5 ft. hits the guardian with a melee attack, force it to make a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure the attacker is Stunned through the end of its next turn. Each time it takes damage while Stunned this way, it can repeat the save and end the effect on a success.

name: Sphinx, Tunnel
description: A prophetic guardian of Labyrinth ruins and archives. It honors those who answer its riddles.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 18. Stealth 12. Resistant to exhaustion. Immune to psychic damage, Charmed, and Frightened. Truesight 120 ft. Speaks Common, Qoradan, and Sphinx. Telepathy 120 ft.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +8 · DEX +2 · CON +3 · INT +8 · WIS +8 · CHA +4
sections.Traits:
Inscrutable. Effects that sense emotion or read thoughts fail against the sphinx, as do divination spells it chooses to refuse. Wisdom (Insight) checks about its intent or honesty have disadvantage.
Magical Claws. A Claw attack counts as magical and deals an extra 2d8 force damage on a hit, already included below.
Monstrosity Resilience. The sphinx resists exhaustion and has Frightened immunity under its listed defenses.
Truth Speaker. The sphinx must speak truthfully to anyone who solves one of its riddles or passes one of its tests.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Ram and two Claw attacks, or three Arcane Bolt attacks. Spellcasting can replace one of these attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing and 9 (2d8) force damage.
Ram. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning and 9 (2d8) force damage.
Arcane Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit 21 (5d6 + 4) force damage.
Spellcasting. Wisdom, save DC 16, no components. At will: detect magic, mage hand, minor illusion. 3/day each: dispel magic, divination (as an action), suggestion, tongues. 1/day each: banishment, geas (as an action).
sections.Bonus Actions: Dire Warning. One creature within 60 ft. that can hear the sphinx makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure, the target is Frightened for 1 minute and has speed 0 while Frightened this way. A failure by 5 or more also leaves it Paralyzed for the same duration. It repeats the save at the end of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Legendary Actions:
The sphinx has three legendary actions per round. It chooses one option at the end of another creature’s turn and refreshes its pool at the start of its own.
Teleport. Move magically up to 120 ft. to a visible unoccupied space, taking worn and carried equipment along.
Cast a Spell (2 actions). Use Spellcasting.
Lacerating Swipe (2 actions). Creatures in a 15-ft. cone make a DC 16 Dexterity save. A failure deals 7 (2d6) slashing damage and opens a bleeding wound. The wound costs the target 3 (1d6) HP at the start of each of its turns. Magical healing closes it, as does an action with a successful DC 16 Wisdom (Medicine) check by any creature.

name: Ahu-Nixta
otherStatistics: Clockwork armor. Perception 13, Stealth 12. Resistant to psychic damage, Exhaustion, Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, and Stunned. Immune to Prone. Darkvision 60 ft. Languages Deep Speech and Void Speech.
description: A shapeless aberration travels between stars inside clockwork armor. Its quiet prayers fall into unison when others of its kind gather.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +2, Int +6, Wis +1, Cha +0
sections.Traits:
Aberrant Resilience. Resistance to Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, and Stunned. Advantage on saves against spells or effects that change its form.
Clockwork Armor. At 18 HP or fewer, its armor breaks and ejects it into the same space. Outside the armor its AC falls by 2, Str becomes +0, each speed drops by 15 ft., and Psychic Burst is its only attack option. Its flesh can form eyes, mouths, and appendages that manipulate objects and have no combat use. Opening or closing an armor port to handle objects outside takes no action. It can enter or exit the armor as a bonus action.
Telekinetic Manipulation. As part of an action, manipulate or move an unworn, uncarried object weighing up to 150 lb. within 30 ft. Move it up to 30 ft. This otherwise follows Telekinesis with Intelligence and an indefinite duration.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three melee attacks or three Psychic Burst attacks.
Whirring Blades. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.
Pronged Scepter. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Bashing Rod. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Psychic Burst. Melee or ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) psychic damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Frightening Murmurs. One creature the ahu-nixta can see within 30 ft. makes a DC 14 Charisma save. On failure it is Frightened until the end of its next turn.

name: Celebrun
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Perception 16, Stealth 17. Resistant to radiant damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Immune to Blinded. Darkvision 60 ft. Languages Celestial and Common. Telepathy 60 ft.
description: Owl-eyed celestial bounty hunters judge whether the punishment a petitioner seeks fits the injury. A celebrun that takes a contract pursues its quarry with immortal patience.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +3, Dex +7, Con +2, Int +1, Wis +6, Cha +3
sections.Traits:
Celestial Resilience. Resistance to radiant damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
Flyby. Flying out of an enemy’s reach provokes no opportunity attack.
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks count as magical.
Seekers Sign. On hitting a creature with Talons or Golden Helm, the celebrun can mark it. It knows the target’s exact location whenever they share a plane. The mark ends when either dies or it marks a different creature.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatsword and one Talons attack, or two Golden Helm attacks.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Talons. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 14 Dexterity save or be Blinded until the end of its next turn.
Golden Helm. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.
Whirling Wheel (recharge 5–6). Every creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. Failure deals 14 (4d6) slashing plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage. Success halves both.
sections.Bonus Actions: Horn of Heaven. Choose a visible non-Celestial creature within 60 ft. that hears the horn. On a failed DC 14 Charisma save, golden light outlines it for 1 minute, negating the benefits of Invisible and granting advantage to attacks against it. Repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.

name: Mucosette
otherStatistics: Perception 12, Stealth 15. Resistant to cold, fire, lightning, thunder, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Immune to acid, necrotic, and poison damage, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, and Unconscious. Darkvision 60 ft. Understands languages it knew in life and cannot speak.
description: Arcane corruption can strand a poltergeist away from the Ethereal Plane. Its old memories fade as it takes on a dripping waxlike form and a taste for pranks.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str -3, Dex +5, Con +0, Int -1, Wis +2, Cha -1
sections.Traits:
Ethereal Sight. See 60 ft. into the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane and vice versa.
Incorporeal Movement. Move through creatures and objects as difficult terrain. Ending a turn inside an object deals 5 (1d10) force damage to the mucosette.
Undead Nature. Needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Undead Resilience. Immune to poison damage, Exhaustion, and Poisoned.
sections.Actions:
Corrosive Slam. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.
Slime Rocket. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d8 + 3) acid damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 13 Dexterity save or be Restrained until the end of its next turn.
sections.Bonus Actions: Slime Trail. Move up to 20 ft. in a straight line, passing through creatures’ spaces without provoking opportunity attacks. Each space along the line stays slimy until the start of the mucosette’s next turn. A creature moving through one of those spaces or starting its turn there falls Prone unless it passes a DC 13 Dexterity save.
sections.Reactions: Gooey Weapon. When a visible creature within 10 ft. hits it with a melee weapon attack, coat the weapon with slime. After damage, the attacker drops its weapon unless it passes a DC 13 Dexterity save.

name: Portal Eater
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 17, Stealth 13. Resistant to force damage, Exhaustion, Frightened, and Prone. Darkvision 60 ft. Language Abyssal.
description: This six-legged predator nests where magic is plentiful. Void cultists lure one to a new gateway to attack travelers, knowing its feeding can destabilize the crossing.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +4, Dex +0, Con +3, Int -3, Wis +7, Cha -2
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Monstrosity Resilience. Resistance to Exhaustion and Frightened.
Sense Magic. Detect and locate magic within 120 ft. A visible creature or object bearing detectable magic appears outlined by a faint aura.
Shimmering Sail. The sail shimmers within 120 ft. of a magic source. A creature starting its turn within 30 ft. that can see the sail makes a DC 15 Charisma save. On failure it is mesmerized until the start of its next turn. While mesmerized, its speed is halved and it has disadvantage on attack rolls and sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks. Unless Surprised, a creature can avert its eyes at the start of its turn to avoid the save. It cannot see the portal eater until the start of its next turn. Looking at it before then triggers the save immediately.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Gore and two Claw attacks, or three Force Bolt attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 17 (3d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Force Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 17 (3d8 + 4) force damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Consume Magic (recharge 4–6). Choose a visible spellcaster or magic item within 30 ft. Exclude sentient items and artifacts. A spellcaster loses a slot of the highest circle it can cast unless it passes a DC 15 Charisma save. An item loses 2 (1d4) charges or cannot be activated until it recharges or 24 hours pass, whichever comes first. After draining a target, the portal eater gains 5 temporary HP per circle of the slot or per charge lost, with a minimum of 5 temporary HP.

name: Satakree
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 12, Stealth 10. Resistant to necrotic damage and to Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, and Unconscious. Darkvision 60 ft. Language Void Speech.
description: A chitin-plated shock trooper bred by the satarre. Each brood obeys the officer it imprinted on at hatching and may lash out indiscriminately if that officer dies.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +6, Dex +0, Con +3, Int -3, Wis +2, Cha -1
sections.Traits:
Void Strength. Resistance to Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, and Unconscious.
Void Weapons. Its weapon attacks count as magical and deal an additional 1d6 necrotic damage, already included below.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw or Necrotic Bolt attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.
Greataxe. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.
Necrotic Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 9 (2d6 + 2) necrotic damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Feral Strike (27 HP or fewer). Move up to half speed and make one Claw attack against a visible creature within reach.
sections.Reactions: Force Armor. While conscious, gain +2 AC against a melee attack that would otherwise hit.

name: Tollinvardo
otherStatistics: Ring Shield. Perception 13, Stealth 14. Vulnerable to radiant, slashing, and thunder damage. Resistant to bludgeoning and necrotic damage, Charmed, and Unconscious. Darkvision 60 ft. Languages Common and Void Speech. Telepathy 60 ft.
description: The Void hollows out this fey until little remains but ribbonlike skin. A metal ring bound to the creature shields it and conducts the energy inside it.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +3, Dex +2, Con +3, Int +1, Wis +3, Cha +4
sections.Traits:
Fey Resilience. Resistance to Charmed and Unconscious.
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Ring Shield. The bound ring works as a standard shield. If dropped or taken, it teleports back at the start of the tollinvardo’s next turn. When the tollinvardo dies, the ring is destroyed in a burst of sparks. Each creature within 10 ft. of the ring must pass a DC 14 Dexterity save or be Blinded until the end of its next turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Ring Shield, then make two Voidstaff attacks.
Voidstaff. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.
Ring Shield. Throw the ring at up to two visible creatures within 60 ft. before it vanishes and returns. Each makes a DC 14 Dexterity save, taking 7 (2d6) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Glimpse Between. One visible creature within 10 ft. must pass a DC 14 Wisdom save or be Frightened until the end of its next turn.
Restrictive Shroud. One visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 14 Strength save. Failure halves its speed and imposes disadvantage on attack rolls and Strength and Dexterity checks and saves for 1 minute. Repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect. The tollinvardo can bind only one creature at a time.
sections.Reactions: Unravel. When a source the tollinvardo can see damages it, it can unravel into strands to halve the damage.

name: Trail Snail
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 11, Stealth 10. Resistant to Exhaustion and Frightened. Immune to force damage. Keensense 60 ft. No languages.
description: An opalescent snail chews through barriers and leaves false paths in the Labyrinth. Skilled handlers sometimes train one as a mount for passing through magical wards.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +3, Dex +0, Con +3, Int -3, Wis +1, Cha -1
sections.Traits:
Dispelling Slime. When the snail deals force damage to a creature under a magical effect, there is a 25% chance to end that effect as Dispel Magic without an ability check. Standing on or chewing a magic item other than an artifact for 1 minute gives a 10% chance of suppressing the item’s magic for 24 hours, disabling activation. A sentient item keeps its awareness and normal means of communication.
Monstrosity Resilience. Resistance to Exhaustion and Frightened.
Rainbow Ward. A creature within 30 ft. that relies on sight has disadvantage on attack rolls against the snail.
Path Maker. At the end of its turn, the snail can deal 9 (2d8) force damage to an object or structure sharing its space, ignoring any damage threshold. Magical barriers such as Wall of Force count as difficult terrain for it. It suffers no other penalties from moving through or starting its turn in a magical barrier’s space.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam or Force Spit attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning plus 4 (1d8) force damage.
Force Spit. Ranged weapon attack, +2 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 9 (2d8) force damage.
sections.Reactions: Energy Absorption. When the snail takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, it can halve it and deal force damage equal to the resulting amount to each creature it chooses within 5 ft.

name: Ripper
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 17, Stealth 13. Resistant to necrotic damage and to Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, and Stunned. Darkvision 60 ft. Languages Common and Void Speech.
description: A Void predator opens unstable rifts with its oversized claws. It looks for vulnerable worlds and may open a rift for someone whose aims it shares.

sections.Ability modifiers: Str +8, Dex +3, Con +5, Int +3, Wis +7, Cha +2
sections.Traits: Aberrant Resilience. Resistance to Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, and Stunned. Advantage on saves against spells or effects that change its form.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Void Claw or four Void Bolt attacks. Replace two attacks with Black Gate if it is available. After two Void Claw hits on the same creature, it has disadvantage on its next save against this ripper’s Black Gate within 1 minute.
Void Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. A Medium or smaller creature is Grappled (escape DC 16). Each of the two claws can hold one target.
Void Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.
Black Gate (recharge 6). Open a rift in an unoccupied visible space within 120 ft. It lasts 1 minute or until the ripper dies or spends an action closing it. Any other creature starting its turn within 20 ft. must pass a DC 16 Strength save or be drawn into a Void demiplane. A banished creature can spend its action to make a DC 16 Intelligence save. On success it reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the gate.
sections.Bonus Actions: Reality Skip. The ripper teleports itself or one visible creature within 30 ft., along with worn or carried equipment, up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space the ripper can see. An unwilling target can avoid this with a DC 16 Wisdom save.

name: Angel, Archangel, Kel Belleth
description: Kel Belleth turned her exile into a base for the Void. She recruits disaffected celestials and aids cults from her demiplane, Sun Hollow.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 20, Stealth 14. Immune to necrotic damage. Truesight 120 ft. Speaks all languages and has telepathy 120 ft. CR 16 in Sun Hollow.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +7 · DEX +4 · CON +11 · INT +4 · WIS +10 · CHA +10
sections.Traits:
Angelic Resilience. Resist radiant damage and damage from nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing attacks. Immune to Exhaustion, Charmed, and Frightened.
Angelic Senses. Pinpoint Aberrations, Celestials, Fiends, and Undead within 30 ft. Recognize consecration or desecration on any place or object the angel can sense.
Divine Awareness. Kel Belleth recognizes any lie she hears.
Divine Protection. Aberrations, Celestials, Fiends, and Undead roll attacks against her with disadvantage.
Immortal Nature. The angel needs no food, drink, or sleep.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). She can choose to succeed when she fails a save.
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Void Weapons. Her weapon attacks are magical and add 4d8 necrotic damage on a hit, as included below.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatsword attacks or four Void Bolt attacks. One attack in either set can be replaced with Chain.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 28 (6d6 + 7) slashing plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage.
Chain. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage. Grapple the target (escape DC 18) and Restrain it until the grapple ends. Each of her three chains can hold one target.
Void Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +10 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 23 (4d8 + 5) necrotic damage.
Soul Siphon (Recharge 6). Choose up to three creatures she can see within 10 ft. Each makes a DC 18 Constitution save, with disadvantage if Restrained by her Chain. A failure deals 49 (11d8) necrotic damage and gives one level of void taint, or one level of Exhaustion if substituting. A success halves the damage and avoids the added level. Kel Belleth regains HP equal to half the total necrotic damage dealt.
sections.Reactions: Blasphemous Word. When an attacker she can see hits her, Kel Belleth can speak a word of Void Speech. An attacker that hears her takes 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. She must be able to speak.
sections.Legendary Actions:
Kel Belleth has three legendary actions and recovers them at the start of her turn. Use at most one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Teleport. Move magically up to 90 ft. to an unoccupied space she can see, bringing anything she is wearing or carrying.
Dark Litany (2 actions). Choose up to two creatures she can see within 60 ft. Each that hears her makes a DC 18 Wisdom save, with disadvantage if it has void taint or the substituted Exhaustion. Every saving target falls Prone. A failed save also Incapacitates it until the end of its next turn.
Ravenous Heart (2 actions). Use Soul Siphon if ready.
sections.Lair Actions:
On initiative count 20, after tied turns, choose one effect. The same effect cannot be used in consecutive rounds.
Clawing Shadows. Until the next count 20, each hostile creature that starts its turn in dim light or darkness within 120 ft. of Kel Belleth makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. Failure deals 7 (2d6) necrotic damage and halves its speed until the start of its next turn.
Vile Chorus. Pick a point she can see within 120 ft. Each hostile creature within 30 ft. of that point makes a DC 18 Constitution save. Failure deals 7 (2d6) psychic damage and makes it vulnerable to necrotic damage until the next count 20.
Weeping Stone. All solid surfaces within 300 ft. of Kel Belleth become difficult terrain until the next count 20.
sections.Regional Effects:
Gnawing Emptiness. Food and drink consumed in Sun Hollow turn to ash and do not count against starvation or dehydration.
Heavenly Hostility. Celestials other than Kel Belleth and void angels make a DC 18 Charisma save each hour spent in Sun Hollow. Failure adds one level of Exhaustion, bypassing the immunity granted by Angelic Resilience.
Oppressive Gray. Effects that create sunlight give bright light instead. Effects that ordinarily create bright light give dim light.
These effects fade 1d10 days after Kel Belleth dies.
sections.Encounter reference: See Chapter 7, pp. 227–229 for the optional void taint rules. Soul Siphon specifies Exhaustion as the fallback.

name: Angel, Destroying
description: Kel Belleth’s soldiers arrive on ragged wings with corroded armor and warhammers.
otherStatistics: Breastplate. Perception 14, Stealth 11. Resists necrotic damage. Darkvision 120 ft. Speaks all languages and has telepathy 120 ft.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +3 · DEX +1 · CON +3 · INT +1 · WIS +4 · CHA +4
sections.Traits:
Angelic Resilience. Resist radiant damage and damage from nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing attacks. Immune to Exhaustion, Charmed, and Frightened.
Angelic Senses. Pinpoint Aberrations, Celestials, Fiends, and Undead within 30 ft. Recognize consecration or desecration on any place or object the angel can sense.
Immortal Nature. The angel needs no food, drink, or sleep.
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Void Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical and add 2d8 necrotic damage on a hit, as included below.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Warhammer attacks.
Warhammer. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) when used with two hands, plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage either way.
Ruinous Burst (Recharge 5–6). Each creature within 20 ft. other than angels makes a DC 14 Constitution save. Creatures made from inorganic matter roll with disadvantage. Failure deals 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and knocks the creature Prone. Success halves the damage and prevents the fall. Structures and unattended nonmagical objects take double damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Dazing Bolt. Pick a creature the angel can see within 30 ft. On a failed DC 14 Constitution save, its next attack roll before the start of the angel’s next turn has disadvantage.
sections.Reactions: Word of Decay. When a visible creature hits the angel in melee, the angel can speak a word of Void Speech. If the attacker wields a nonmagical weapon, it makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, the weapon decays after the hit and attacks with it have disadvantage until a creature spends a short rest repairing it. The angel must be able to speak.

name: Angel, Void
description: An exiled celestial that seeks out ambitious mortals and tempts them with forbidden magic.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 17, Stealth 14. Resists necrotic damage. Darkvision 120 ft. Speaks all languages and has telepathy 120 ft.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +4 · DEX +2 · CON +4 · INT +2 · WIS +7 · CHA +7
sections.Traits:
Angelic Resilience. Resist radiant damage and damage from nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing attacks. Immune to Exhaustion, Charmed, and Frightened.
Angelic Senses. Pinpoint Aberrations, Celestials, Fiends, and Undead within 30 ft. Recognize consecration or desecration on any place or object the angel can sense.
Immortal Nature. The angel needs no food, drink, or sleep.
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Void Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical and add 4d8 necrotic damage on a hit, as included below.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatsword attacks. One may be replaced with Chain.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage.
Chain. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage. Grapple the target (escape DC 15) and Restrain it until the grapple ends. Each of its two chains can hold one target.
Soul Siphon (Recharge 6). Choose up to two creatures the angel can see within 10 ft. Each makes a DC 15 Constitution save, with disadvantage if Restrained by its Chain. A failure deals 31 (7d8) necrotic damage and gives one level of void taint, or one level of Exhaustion if substituting. A success halves the damage and avoids the added level. The angel regains HP equal to half the total necrotic damage dealt.
sections.Bonus Actions: Change Shape. Magically become a Large or smaller Beast or Humanoid of CR 8 or lower, or return to true form. Gear may transform or be carried by the new form. Death restores the true form. The angel keeps its HP, HD, speech, proficiencies, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, Angelic Resilience, Angelic Senses, Immortal Nature, and Change Shape. Otherwise take the new form’s statistics and capabilities except class features and legendary actions.
sections.Reactions: Blasphemous Word. When an attacker the angel can see hits it, the angel can speak a word of Void Speech. An attacker that hears it takes 4 (1d8) necrotic damage. The angel must be able to speak.
sections.Encounter reference: See Chapter 7, pp. 227–229 for the optional void taint rules. Soul Siphon specifies Exhaustion as the fallback.

name: Chol, Pyrol
description: Chol armies hire pyrols as incendiary artillery. The fiends take payment in magic items that produce light or fire.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 14, Stealth 16. Resists cold, lightning, poison, and damage from nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing attacks. Resists Grappled, Poisoned, and Restrained. Immune to acid and fire damage and Charmed. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks Abyssal, Common, and Infernal. Telepathy 60 ft.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +3 · DEX +6 · CON +3 · INT +1 · WIS +1 · CHA +6
sections.Traits:
Acidic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical and add 2d8 acid damage on a hit, as included below.
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Stifling Heat. A non-Fiend that starts its turn within 10 ft. makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and deals half damage with Strength-based weapon attacks until its next turn starts. Failing by at least 5 also adds one level of Exhaustion. A creature can gain Exhaustion from this pyrol’s heat only once per 24 hours.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Claw or Clinging Flame.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 17 (4d6 + 3) slashing plus 9 (2d8) acid damage.
Clinging Flame. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. Hit 21 (4d8 + 3) fire damage. A creature or flammable object catches fire and takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns until a creature uses an action to put out the fire.
Fiery Acid Burst (Recharge 5–6). Each creature within 20 ft. makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. Failure deals 13 (3d8) acid and 13 (3d8) fire damage. Success halves each. A creature that fails by at least 5 takes another 4 (1d8) acid and 4 (1d8) fire damage at the start of its next turn.
sections.Bonus Actions: Burning Dash. Move up to half speed. The spaces crossed hold puddles of flaming acid until the start of the pyrol’s next turn. The first creature to enter a given puddle takes 2 (1d4) fire damage and extinguishes that puddle.

name: Demon, Realm Singer
description: The demon steals voices and warps songs into weapons. A singer robbed of their voice gives it the power to shriek in Void Speech.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 18, Stealth 15. Vulnerable to Charmed, Deafened, and Unconscious. Resists thunder damage. Truesight 120 ft. Speaks Abyssal and Void Speech. Telepathy 120 ft.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +7 · DEX +1 · CON +3 · INT +1 · WIS +8 · CHA +4
sections.Traits:
Demonic Resilience. Resist cold, fire, and lightning damage. Immune to poison damage and Poisoned.
Demon Song. While it has a stolen voice, the singer can sing in Void Speech. A hostile creature that starts its turn within 15 ft. and hears the song makes a DC 16 Charisma save or is Incapacitated until its next turn starts.
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Beak or Discordant Blast.
Beak. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d10 + 3) piercing plus 9 (2d8) thunder damage.
Discordant Blast. Ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit 17 (3d8 + 4) thunder plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
Shrieking Song (Recharge 5–6). Requires a stolen voice. Creatures in a 60-ft. cone make a DC 16 Constitution save. Failure deals 18 (4d8) thunder and 21 (6d6) psychic damage. Success halves each.
sections.Bonus Actions: Steal Voice. Choose a speaking creature the singer can see within 30 ft. On a failed DC 16 Charisma save, it loses speech and cannot cast spells with verbal components for 1 minute. Repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Holding a stolen voice enables Demon Song and Shrieking Song.
sections.Reactions: Interrupting Theft. When a creature the singer can see within 30 ft. casts a spell with a verbal component, use Steal Voice against it immediately. If it loses its voice, the spell is interrupted.

name: Demon, Widross
description: A tiny demon that hides in animal form and carries messages in other people’s voices.
otherStatistics: Perception 13, Stealth 12. Darkvision 120 ft. Speaks Abyssal, Common, and Void Speech.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR −2 · DEX +2 · CON +1 · INT +0 · WIS +1 · CHA +3
sections.Traits:
Demonic Resilience. Resist cold, fire, and lightning damage. Immune to poison damage and Poisoned.
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Mimicry. Imitate simple sounds it has heard. A listener identifies the imitation with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (Insight) check.
Mimic Message. Store and repeat up to 1 minute or 25 words of speech, whichever comes first, in the voices it heard and in any language. Storing a new message erases the old one.
sections.Actions:
Bite (true form only). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. A creature also makes a DC 13 Constitution save, taking 7 poison damage on a failure or half on a success. The printed alternative is 3d6 poison damage.
Slam (Beast form only). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage matching the new form’s main attack.
sections.Bonus Actions: Change Shape. Magically become a Tiny CR 0 Beast or return to true Fiend form. Statistics stay the same except speed, and gear transforms. Death restores true form.
sections.Encounter reference: Optional Familiar (p. 255). A willing companion forms a magical telepathic bond with the widross. The companion can share its senses within 1 mile and benefits from its Magic Resistance within 10 ft. The widross can break the bond at any time.
sections.Table notes: Bite prints both 7 and 3d6 for poison damage even though the dice average is 10.5. Use the listed fixed 7 when using fixed damage, or roll the listed dice.

name: Giant, Void
description: A giant channeling the power of the Void can turn an enemy’s spell into fuel for its own.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 12, Stealth 10. Resists necrotic damage. No special senses. Speaks Common, Draconic, and Giant.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +5 · DEX +0 · CON +4 · INT +8 · WIS +2 · CHA +6
sections.Traits:
Giant Attributes. Resistant to Stunned and vulnerable to Prone.
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks or three Void Bolt attacks. Replace up to one attack with Spellcasting.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 23 (4d8 + 5) bludgeoning plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.
Void Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 25 (6d6 + 4) necrotic damage.
Spellcasting. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (save DC 16). At will: Command, Dancing Lights, Minor Illusion, Thaumaturgy. 3/day each: Bane, Comprehend Languages, Maddening Whispers. 2/day each: Bestow Curse, Dispel Magic, Ray of Enfeeblement. 1/day: Glimpse of the Void.
sections.Bonus Actions: Void Infusion. Infuse the next spell the giant casts before the end of its next turn. One chosen creature that the spell hits or that fails its save is Stunned until the end of that creature’s next turn.
sections.Reactions: Magic Absorption. When the giant succeeds on a save against a hostile creature’s spell, it may ignore that spell’s effects on itself. If it uses Void Infusion on its next turn, that spell can Stun up to four affected creatures rather than one.
sections.Encounter reference:
Maddening Whispers (p. 189). Choose a creature that can hear the giant within 30 ft. A failed DC 16 Charisma save leaves it Incapacitated with speed 0 for up to 1 minute. The spell ends if the target takes damage or the giant fails to spend a bonus action continuing the whispers within 30 ft. on a subsequent turn.
Glimpse of the Void (p. 187). Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Each creature in a 30-ft. cube centered there makes a DC 16 Intelligence save. On a failure, for up to 1 minute with Concentration its only actions are unintelligible cries. At the start of each affected turn, it has a 50 percent chance to move up to half speed in a random direction.

name: Devil, Gear
description: An infernal salvage worker with a body full of gears. Gear devils strip metal for prison and factory machinery and prize magical alloys.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 14. Stealth 11. Vulnerable to acid damage. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks Common and Infernal.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +3 · DEX +1 · CON +3 · INT +0 · WIS +2 · CHA +2
sections.Traits:
Devil’s Sight. Magical darkness does not impair its darkvision.
Devilish Resilience. Resists cold damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Immune to fire damage, poison damage, and the Poisoned condition.
Magic Resistance. Has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make four Claw attacks. The devil can trade two of those attacks for one Tail Stab.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.
Tail Stab. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. A Prone creature hit this way becomes Restrained. The restraint ends if the devil dies, makes another Tail Stab, uses Tail Whip, or moves more than 15 ft. away. Any creature, including the target, can spend an action and pass a DC 13 Strength check to free the target.
sections.Bonus Actions: Tail Whip. One creature the devil can see within 15 ft. falls Prone on a failed DC 13 Strength save.
sections.Reactions: Gear Screech. When a creature the devil can see within 15 ft. attacks it, the devil can make its gears screech. The attacker rolls with disadvantage if it can hear the screech.

name: Devil, Lantern
description: A failed bid for promotion leaves this devil with a green lantern fused into its chest. Lantern devils lead lesser fiends through caverns and on night raids.
otherStatistics: Perception 12. Stealth 15. Resists Blinded. Darkvision 120 ft. Speaks Common and Infernal.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +0 · DEX +3 · CON +1 · INT −1 · WIS +2 · CHA +3
sections.Traits:
Chest Lantern. Its magic lantern stays lit while the devil lives and crumbles to dust when it dies. It sheds bright light out to a radius of 5 to 30 ft. and dim light for the same distance beyond that.
Devil’s Sight. Magical darkness does not impair its darkvision.
Devilish Resilience. Resists cold damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Immune to fire damage, poison damage, and the Poisoned condition.
Magic Resistance. Has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Onyx Club or Lantern Bolt attacks. If two Lantern Bolts hit the same creature, it makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure it is Blinded until the end of its next turn.
Onyx Club. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and 2 (1d4) piercing damage. A creature marked by the devil loses 20 ft. of speed until the end of its next turn.
Lantern Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) fire damage and 4 (1d8) radiant damage. For 1 minute after taking this damage, the target gains no benefit from being Invisible.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Adjust Lantern. Choose a new radius for the Chest Lantern.
Stoke the Heart (Recharge 5–6). Gain 5 (2d4) temporary HP. This automatically recharges if the devil starts its turn with 17 HP or fewer.

ruleNotes: Onyx Club imposes a speed penalty on marked targets. The printed block leaves the source of the mark undefined. Apply the penalty only when the table has established a mark.

name: Devil, Maze Imp
description: A winged infernal scout that tracks fugitives and finds hidden portals. Maze imps prefer to escape a fight and return with reinforcements.
otherStatistics: Perception 14. Stealth 15. Truesight 60 ft. Darkvision 120 ft. Speaks Common and Infernal.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR −2 · DEX +3 · CON +1 · INT +1 · WIS +4 · CHA +2
sections.Traits:
Devilish Resilience. Resists cold damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Immune to fire damage, poison damage, and the Poisoned condition.
Labyrinth Tracker. At the end of a long rest, the imp can name a creature it knows or has seen as its quarry. While both are in the Labyrinth, the imp knows the direction and distance to the quarry. If the quarry leaves through a portal, the imp knows the direction and distance to that portal.
Magic Resistance. Has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Claws attack and one Sting attack.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.
Sting. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. The target also makes a DC 13 Constitution save, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failure or half on a success.
Invisibility. The imp and its worn or carried gear magically turn Invisible. This ends when the imp attacks or loses concentration, as if concentrating on a spell.
sections.Bonus Actions: Escape to Report. Take the Dash or Disengage action.
sections.Reactions: Brimstone Poof (Recharge 4–6). When a creature the imp can see hits it with a melee attack, it can teleport up to 30 ft. to an empty space it can see. Creatures within 5 ft. of the space it left become Poisoned until the ends of their next turns on failed DC 13 Constitution saves.

name: Devil, Risolan
description: A goat-headed devil that thrives in mortal courts. Risolans broker trade and alliances for the Hells and resort to mental magic when diplomacy fails.
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Perception 17. Stealth 14. Resists psychic damage. Darkvision 120 ft. Speaks Common, Druidic (Elder Speech), and Infernal. Telepathy 120 ft.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +1 · DEX +4 · CON +4 · INT +2 · WIS +7 · CHA +8
sections.Traits:
Devil’s Sight. Magical darkness does not impair its darkvision.
Devilish Resilience. Resists cold damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Immune to fire damage, poison damage, and the Poisoned condition.
Infernal Diplomacy. Before targeting the risolan with an attack or harmful spell, a creature must pass a DC 16 Charisma save. On a failure, it must pick another target or lose the attack or spell. When the risolan attacks or casts a spell that affects a creature, that creature and its allies ignore this trait for the next 24 hours.
Magic Resistance. Has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Silver Tongue. Has advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) and Wisdom (Insight) checks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Scepter or Psychic Bolt attacks. The risolan can replace one attack with Spellcasting.
Scepter. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and 13 (3d8) psychic damage.
Psychic Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit 22 (4d8 + 4) psychic damage.
Mind Snare (Recharge 5–6). Every creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 16 Intelligence save. A failure deals 27 (6d8) psychic damage and inflicts an infernal wound until the start of the risolan’s next turn. A success halves the damage and avoids the wound. A creature with the wound subtracts a separate 1d6 from each attack roll, ability check, and save.
Spellcasting. Charisma, spell save DC 16. Three times per day each: detect thoughts, hold, suggestion. Once per day each: confusion, greater invisibility.
sections.Bonus Actions: Change Shape. Magically take the shape of a Medium or smaller Humanoid or return to its true Fiend form. Its statistics stay the same apart from size. Its worn and carried gear changes with it. It reverts on death.

name: Dragonborn
description: A halberd-bearing dragonborn who channels the element of a dragon ancestor. Dragonborn may guard their communities or act as emissaries for true dragons.
otherStatistics: Chain shirt. Perception 11. Stealth 10. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks Common and Draconic.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +3 · DEX +0 · CON +1 · INT +0 · WIS +1 · CHA +2
sections.Traits: Draconic Ancestry. Choose an ancestor and use its damage type for both resistance and Breath Weapon. Black or copper gives acid, silver or white gives cold, brass, gold, or red gives fire, blue or bronze gives lightning, green gives poison, void gives necrotic, and yellow gives radiant.
sections.Actions:
Halberd. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage.
Breath Weapon (Recharge 5–6). Choose a 15-ft. cone or a 30-ft. line 5 ft. wide. Each creature in the area makes a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking 7 (2d6) damage of the ancestry type on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Bonus Actions: Tail Lash. A visible creature within 5 ft. falls Prone on a failed DC 13 Strength save.

name: Dragonborn, Radiant Dragonborn Lightcaller
description: A scepter-bearing servant of Solanna with a yellow dragon ancestor. Its body can shine with sunlight.
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Perception 16. Stealth 13. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks Common and Draconic.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR −1 · DEX +3 · CON +0 · INT +0 · WIS +4 · CHA +2
sections.Traits:
Draconic Ancestry. Its yellow dragon ancestor gives it resistance to radiant damage.
Radiant Weapons. Its weapon hits deal an extra 3d6 radiant damage, already included in Scepter.
Solanna’s Radiance. While conscious, it sheds bright sunlight within 15 ft. and dim light another 15 ft. At the start of its turn it chooses whether to emit or suppress that light.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Scepter attacks or three Radiant Bolt attacks. One attack can be replaced with Spellcasting.
Scepter. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and 10 (3d6) radiant damage.
Radiant Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) radiant damage.
Breath Weapon (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. line 5 ft. wide makes a DC 14 Dexterity save, taking 21 (6d6) radiant damage on a failure or half on a success.
Spellcasting. Wisdom, spell save DC 14. At will: continual flame, guidance, spare the dying. Twice per day each: color spray, cure wounds, heroism. Once per day each: blindness/deafness, daylight.
sections.Bonus Actions: Tail Lash. A visible creature within 5 ft. falls Prone on a failed DC 14 Strength save.
sections.Reactions: Solanna’s Flare. When a visible creature within 30 ft. attacks the lightcaller, the lightcaller can impose disadvantage on the attack roll with a flash. The lightcaller must be shedding light itself or within 10 ft. of a light source.

name: Hag, Astral
description: This hag snares astral travelers with threads and silver needles, then feeds on the terror she creates in her captives.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception 15. Stealth 18. Resists psychic damage and Frightened. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks Common and Primordial.

sections.Ability modifiers: STR +3 · DEX +8 · CON +3 · INT +3 · WIS +2 · CHA +8
sections.Traits:
Fey Resilience. Resists Charmed and Unconscious.
Magic Resistance. Has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks or three Soul Needle attacks. One attack can be replaced with Spellcasting. A creature hit by two attacks becomes Frightened until the end of its next turn.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage and 10 (3d6) psychic damage.
Soul Needle. Ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage and 10 (3d6) psychic damage.
Astral Binding (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 16 Dexterity save. A failure deals 20 (8d4) piercing damage and 14 (4d6) psychic damage and Restrains the creature for 1 minute. A success halves the damage and avoids the restraint. A Restrained creature can end the effect early by passing a DC 16 Charisma save at the end of its turn.
Spellcasting. Charisma, spell save DC 16. No material components. At will: message, minor illusion, prestidigitation. Three times per day each: charm, hallucinatory terrain (as an action), mirror image. Once per day each: hypnotic pattern, major image.
sections.Bonus Actions: Soul Stitch. Choose one visible creature within 15 ft. On a failed DC 16 Wisdom save, its soul is bound to the hag for 1 minute.
