name: Mechanical Golem
otherStatistics: Initiative +0. AC −1 size, +12 natural. Touch AC 9, flat-footed AC 21. Base attack +10, grapple +15. Printed space 5 ft., reach 10 ft. Fort +4, Ref +4, Will +4.
description: Steam hisses from a metal frame whose sparking arm ends in a keen blade.

sections.Actions:
Built-in weapon. Use the listed keen greatsword at +17 melee (2d6 + 7), with a second +12 attack on a full attack. Other built-in weapons vary and the blade is always keen.
Lightning Burst (Ex). Once per 1d4 rounds, creatures within 20 ft. take 3d6 electricity damage, Reflex DC 17 for half.
Shocking Strike (Ex). On a critical hit, add 3d6 electricity damage and require a DC 17 Fortitude save to avoid being stunned for 2d4 rounds. A melee attack against the golem that would otherwise score a critical hit also exposes the attacker to the 3d6 electricity damage.
sections.Traits:
Construct traits and damage reduction 10/magic.
Magic Immunity (Ex). Immune to spells, spell-like abilities, and supernatural effects except for the listed vulnerabilities. Rust effects such as rusting grasp work normally. Targeted dispel magic against DC 14 shuts it down for a number of rounds equal to the dispel check result minus 10. A result at least 10 over the DC destroys it. Detect magic reveals the suppressed aura building back up.
sections.Dread golem commands: The creator can give orders within 60 ft. while the golem can see and hear them. The golem follows the last command and defends itself if attacked. Some grow independent of their creators.
sections.Skills and feats: Climb +14, Listen +7, Spot +7. Cleave, Combat Reflexes, Power Attack.
sections.Encounter details: Any land or underground. Solitary, usually chaotic evil. No treasure. Advances to 15–22 HD (Large) or 23–35 HD (Huge).

ruleNotes: Both printed attack lines show +17/+12. For a single attack, use +17. The printed space is 5 ft. even though its size is Large.
The retaliation clause specifies damage to the attacker and does not repeat the stun.

name: Ceramic Figurine
otherStatistics: Initiative +2. AC +2 size, +2 Dex, +1 natural. Touch AC 14, flat-footed AC 13. Base attack +1, grapple −8. Space 2½ ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +1, Ref +3, Will +1.
description: A bright pottery animal hides two flasks in its hollow body. An assassin can send one after a named victim.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. One claw +2 melee (1d2 − 1), only on the master’s orders, or fluid spray +5 ranged touch.
Fluid Spray (Ex). Load up to two flasks of liquid such as alchemist’s fire, holy water, acid, or poison. Spray one flask at one creature within 10 ft. without splash damage. When a physical attack destroys it, any remaining liquid bursts at its location as a splash weapon.
sections.Traits:
Construct traits, damage reduction 5/—, and immunity to fire, cold, and electricity. The stat block lists vulnerability to bludgeoning but gives no multiplier.
Vulnerability to Sonic Effects (Ex). A damaging sonic effect destroys the figurine unless it makes a Fortitude save, DC 10 + spell level + caster’s Intelligence modifier. It still takes the effect’s damage on a success.
sections.Figurine loyalty: Once a month the figurine and its master roll opposed Will saves. If the figurine wins, it breaks free, becomes evil, and seeks to kill its master. It understands its creator’s language and detailed commands but cannot speak.
sections.Encounter details: Hide +10. Any land in Sri Raji. Solitary, always neutral before breaking free, with no treasure. Advances to 5–8 HD (Small) or 9–12 HD (Medium).

name: Undead Treant
otherStatistics: Initiative −2. Printed AC components −2 size, −1 Dex, +13 natural. Touch AC 7, flat-footed AC 21. Base attack +4, grapple +21. Space 10 ft., reach 15 ft. Fort +0, Ref +1, Will +4.
description: The leafless ruler of a corrupt grove pins travelers under its branches to feed through its roots.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Slam +21 melee (1d6 + 9). Full attack. Two slams +2 melee (1d6 + 9 each) as printed. A full attack deals double damage to an object or structure.
Trample (Ex). 2d12 + 5 damage, Reflex DC 23 for half.
Blood Drain (Ex). On its next turn after pinning a living foe, 1d3 roots attach. Each root drains 1 Constitution each round it maintains the grapple. It cannot move while feeding and takes a full-round action to become mobile again. Break the pin normally or sever every attached root. Each root has AC 15 and 4 HP independent of the treant. Use Ravenloft vampire feeding rules from chapter 5 of the Ravenloft Player’s Handbook for its feeding needs.
Spells. It casts as a 6th-level druid and chooses no spells that employ fire.
sections.Traits: Undead traits, damage reduction 10/slashing, and fire vulnerability. It has lost the living treant’s ability to animate trees.
sections.Skills and feats: Hide −10, Intimidate +8, one Knowledge skill +8, Listen +9, Sense Motive +9, Spot +9, Survival +9. Hide has a +16 racial bonus in dead or dying forest. Feats: Cleave, Improved Sunder, Iron Will, Power Attack.
sections.Encounter details: Any forest. Solitary or with 4–7 dread treants. Always neutral evil. Standard treasure. Advances to 9–17 HD (Huge) or 18–22 HD (Gargantuan).

ruleNotes: The printed full attack is +2 while its single slam is +21. For a consistent table ruling, use +21 for both slams.
The printed AC components do not add to AC 20, and Dexterity 6 gives a −2 modifier rather than the printed −1 in those components. Use the listed total, touch, and flat-footed values.

name: Tenebris
otherStatistics: Initiative +3. AC +3 Dex, +2 deflection. Touch AC 15, flat-footed AC 12. Printed base attack +8, grapple +8. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +6, Ref +6, Will +6.
description: A second shadow follows its host by day. At night the outsider uses the sleeping host’s body to act on grudges that the host mistakes for dreams.

sections.Actions:
Attack and full attack. Use the host’s attacks.
Malevolent Possession (Su). Once a night, enter a sleeping creature on the Material Plane unless it passes a DC 20 Will save. Use magic jar at caster level 10 without a receptacle. It takes over the body and controls dreams as a 10th-level sorcerer using dream. A success grants immunity to its possession that night.
Wisdom Drain (Su). Once per night the possessed creature takes 1d4 Wisdom drain unless it passes a DC 29 Will save.
Spell-like abilities. Twice per day each: bane, charm person, command, confusion, crushing despair, mind fog, and undetectable alignment. Caster level 10, save DC 15 + spell level. Detect thoughts is listed separately without a specified frequency.
sections.Traits: Incorporeal. It is dormant during the day and uses the host’s skills while in control at night. A DC 20 Spot check reveals the extra shadow. Otherwise, detection requires telepathic contact. Dispel evil or an ethereal opponent can drive it out of its host.
sections.Skills and feats: Bluff +12, Concentration +8, Diplomacy +12, Gather Information +12, Hide +20, Intimidate +10, Knowledge (the planes) +12, Listen +12, Sense Motive +12, Spot +12. Alertness, Blind-Fight, Combat Reflexes.
sections.Encounter details: Any land or underground. Solitary, always neutral evil, no treasure. Advances to 9–12 HD (Medium). Printed level adjustment +7.

ruleNotes: The special attacks line says “Will drain.” The detailed ability drains Wisdom and uses a Will save.

name: Radiant Spirit
otherStatistics: Initiative +6. AC +2 Dex, +3 deflection. Touch AC 15, flat-footed AC 13. Printed base attack +6, grapple +6. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +3, Ref +7, Will +13.
description: The ghost of a cleric or paladin keeps vigil over the spot where its quest failed. Its light can blind a traveler before they see the figure inside.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Slam +6 melee (1d6). Full attack. Two slams +6 melee (1d6 each).
Blinding Pulse (Su). Once per minute, use a gaze attack. A failed DC 18 Fortitude save deals 1d10 damage and permanently blinds as the blindness spell at caster level 10. The victim’s corneas bear skull-shaped scars that add 1 to Outcast Rating when visible.
Frightful Moan (Su). As a standard action, force living creatures within 30 ft. to make a DC 18 Fear save. Evil creatures take a −5 morale penalty. A success grants immunity to this spirit’s moan for one day.
Sunbeam (Su). Three times per day, use sunbeam at caster level 10.
sections.Traits:
Incorporeal and undead traits, +4 turn resistance.
Radiant Aura (Su). The spirit sheds light as bright as daylight. Its continuous 30-ft. gaze blinds for 1d4 rounds on a failed DC 18 Fortitude save. It cannot suppress the aura.
Rejuvenation (Su). If destroyed, it reforms in 2d4 days. Completing its unfinished quest lays it to rest permanently.
sections.Skills and feats: Diplomacy +18, Knowledge (religion) +20, Listen +17, Search +20, Sense Motive +18, Spot +17. Alertness, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Toughness.
sections.Encounter details: Any land or underground, within 1 mile of the site of its death. Solitary, always lawful evil, no treasure. Advances to 11–20 HD (Medium). Speaks languages it knew in life. It may let sympathetic travelers pass and refuses to speak to evil creatures.

ruleNotes: Blinding Pulse gives no separate range. Use the standard 30-ft. gaze range.
The text both says it immediately attacks disrespectful intruders and describes its intended victims as evil. Its continuous gaze cannot be suppressed.

name: Aquatic Remnant
description: The spirit of a laborer buried in water lingers above the site where its body was discarded.
otherStatistics: Any aquatic environment. Solitary, gang of 2–5, or swarm of 6–11. Usually chaotic neutral. No treasure. Advancement 4–8 HD (Medium). No level adjustment. Knows its languages from life and needs magic to communicate.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +2. AC +2 Dex, +2 deflection, +1 natural. Touch 14, flat-footed 13. Base attack +1, printed grapple +1. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +1, Ref +3, Will +4.
sections.Skills and feats: Hide +10, Listen +12, Search +5, Sense Motive +4, Spot +8. Blind-Fight.
sections.Traits: Undead traits and incorporeal subtype. The remnant stays in the body of water that holds its remains. Burial of those remains on consecrated ground puts it to rest.
sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Incorporeal touch +3 melee for 1d4 Dexterity drain. A living target reduced to Dexterity 0 by this attack cannot move because of hypothermia and drowns unless helped.
Gift of Breath (Sp, 1/day). Breathe into one living creature’s mouth to grant water breathing while contact continues.
Manifestation (Su). The remnant normally cannot interact with the Material Plane. When it manifests, it becomes visible and can use its touch attack while remaining incorporeal. Creatures on either the Ethereal or Material Plane can attack it while it is manifested.

ruleNotes: The printed block includes natural armor and a grapple modifier despite the incorporeal subtype. Use the printed AC and apply the normal incorporeal restriction on grappling.

name: Sea Spawn Master
description: A mucus-coated sea spawn waits offshore while its minions infiltrate fishing villages and bring it prey.
otherStatistics: Any aquatic environment. Solitary. Usually lawful evil. Standard treasure, usually in its underwater lair. Advancement 11–16 HD (Large). No level adjustment or spoken language.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +5. AC −1 size, +1 Dex, +6 natural. Touch 10, flat-footed 15. Base attack +7, grapple +11. Space 5 ft. and reach 10 ft. as printed. Fort +6, Ref +4, Will +9.
sections.Skills and feats: Escape Artist +4, Listen +7, Move Silently +10, Search +9, Spot +9, Survival +9. Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Multiattack.
sections.Traits:
The master drowns in air as a human does underwater.
Slime (Ex). Its coating works like oil of slipperiness. It also has a printed +10 racial bonus on Escape Artist checks against webs, nets, and similar restraints.
Telepathy (Su). It stays in telepathic contact with its own minions and aquatic allies. If a minion or host is threatened, the master can call on the others nearby.
sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +11 melee for 1d6 + 4. The attack line omits damage. The full-attack line supplies it.
Full attack. Two claws +11 melee (1d6 + 4 each) and bite +9 melee (2d6 + 2 plus disease).
Disease (Ex). A bitten target makes a DC 18 Fortitude save. On failure, the wound becomes infected immediately. HP lost to infected wounds cannot heal naturally before remove disease or equivalent magic.
Aquatic Allies (Su, 2/day). As summon nature’s ally IV at caster level 10th, limited to aquatic creatures. Summoned creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds.
sections.Tactics: A master targeting a coastal community releases 3d6 minions near shore each night until they have taken it over. Roughly one in ten reaches shore. During the day, the master coordinates its minions from a trance in its lair. It sends allies to fight for it and tries to get back into water if forced out.

ruleNotes: The printed space is 5 ft. despite the Large classification. The single-target claw uses damage from the full-attack line.

name: Red Widow
speed: 30 ft. (6 squares), climb 20 ft. in spider form
description: A red-haired stranger lures prey into a webbed hideout, then drops the disguise and reveals a red-and-black spider.
otherStatistics: Any temperate or cold land. Solitary or pair. Usually neutral evil. Standard treasure. Advancement 7–9 HD (Medium) or 10–12 HD (Large). No level adjustment. Speaks its homeland’s domain languages.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +6 in either form. Base attack +4, grapple +6. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +7, Ref +7, Will +6 in both forms.
sections.Humanoid form: AC 12 (+2 Dex), touch 12, flat-footed 10. Speed 30 ft. Attack or full attack is one unarmed strike +6 melee (1d3 + 2).
sections.Spider form: AC 18 (+2 Dex, +6 natural), touch 12, flat-footed 16. Speed 30 ft., climb 20 ft. Attack or full attack is one bite +6 melee (1d4 + 2 plus poison). The widow’s special attacks are limited to this form.
sections.Skills and feats: Bluff +14, Climb +10, Diplomacy +12, Listen +3, Sense Motive +10 in either form. Humanoid Jump +4 and Spot +3. Spider Hide +6, Jump +10, Move Silently +6, and Spot +11. The listed skill totals include racial bonuses to Bluff, Diplomacy, and Sense Motive and, in spider form, to Jump and Spot. The widow also gains a +8 competence bonus to Hide and Move Silently around its webs. Alertness, Improved Initiative (bonus), Skill Focus (Bluff).
sections.Traits:
Darkvision 60 ft.
Alternate Form (Su). As a standard action, assume its one specific humanoid form as if using polymorph. Gear stays as it is. Death restores spider form. A widow can switch forms while maintaining a pin.
sections.Actions:
Use the attack listed for the current form.
Poison (Ex). On a bite hit, Fortitude DC 15. Initial damage 1d6 Strength, secondary damage 2d6 Strength.
Fluid Drain (Ex). In spider form, pin a living creature using a successful grapple check to drain 1d4 Constitution per round the pin holds. Each Constitution point consumed sustains the widow for a day.
Web (Ex). Use the 3.5 Medium monstrous spider rules. Throw a web up to eight times per day as a net-like ranged touch attack (10-ft. range increment, 50-ft. maximum) against a target up to Large. A trapped creature can spend a standard action to attempt DC 12 Escape Artist or DC 16 Strength. A Medium web has 6 HP. A widow that wins an opposed Strength check against a webbed victim can pull it 10 ft. closer as a standard action.
Infest (Ex). A widow can implant 2d4 eggs in a paralyzed mate once a year and wrap the target in webbing. Remove the eggs before they hatch in 1d6 days. After hatching each young deals 1 HP of damage to the host per day. Immature young use monstrous spider statistics until they mature at one year.

ruleNotes: The habitat and combat prose describe paralysis during infestation, but the Poison entry specifies Strength damage and supplies no separate paralysis rules.

name: Reaver
description: A fishlike raider uses its blade-edged scales to cut creatures it gets hold of. In groups, reavers strike boats or houses after dark.
otherStatistics: Temperate or warm aquatic environments, notably the Sea of Sorrows. Solitary or school of 10–15. Always chaotic evil. Standard treasure. Advances by character class, level adjustment +3. Communicates with hisses and ultrasonic calls.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +0. AC +6 natural. Touch 10, flat-footed 16. Base attack +4, grapple +8. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +2, Ref +4, Will +6.
sections.Skills and feats: Hide +6, Listen +5, Move Silently +4, Profession (hunter) +4, Spot +5, Survival +4. Add a +4 racial bonus to each of those underwater. Cleave and Power Attack.
sections.Traits: Amphibious (Ex). It breathes air and water. After 1 hour per point of Constitution out of water, apply the drowning rules.
sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +8 melee (1d6 + 4).
Full attack. Two claws +8 melee (1d6 + 4 each) and bite +3 melee (1d4 + 2).
Improved Grab (Ex). A single claw hit can start a grapple against a target up to Small. Both claws must hit the same target to grab an opponent up to Medium.
Cutting Scales (Ex). A creature grappling the reaver takes 1d6 slashing damage automatically, regardless of which creature began the grapple.

name: Ravenkin
description: An oversized black bird with a taste for bright trinkets. A ravenkin shares magic with ordinary ravens and may trade information with someone it trusts.
otherStatistics: Any temperate land. Solitary, murder of 5–20, or community of 100–200 plus 10% noncombatants and 200–300 ravens. Always good, usually neutral good. Standard treasure. Advances by character class, level adjustment +2. Speaks Ravenkin and usually at least one domain language.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +8. AC +1 size and +4 Dex. Touch 15, flat-footed 11. Base attack +2, grapple +1 as printed. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +1, Ref +7, Will +5.
sections.Skills and feats: Appraise +12, Concentration +7, Gather Information +10, Knowledge (arcana) +12, Listen +10, Sense Motive +10, Spot +12. +8 racial bonus on Appraise, Gather Information, Survival, and Spot. Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Flyby Attack, Still Spell, and Weapon Finesse. All listed except Flyby Attack are bonus feats.
sections.Traits: Ravenlink (Su). Can share spells with an ordinary raven within 5 ft. At 3 HD or more, can deliver touch spells through an ordinary raven within 60 ft. At 13 HD or more, it can touch an ordinary raven once per day to scry through it as a spellcaster would through a familiar.
sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Bite +7 melee (1d3 − 1), threat range 19–20.
Eye Peck (Ex). A confirmed critical hit with the bite removes one eye. A target left with only one eye takes a −2 competence penalty to Dexterity-modified rolls. A creature that loses all eyes is blinded. Only regenerate or heal can reverse this blindness.
Spells. Casts as a 1st-level sorcerer. Choose the spells when preparing the encounter, since the printing does not give a spells-known list. It uses Still Spell to cast while flying.

ruleNotes: The printed grapple modifier is +1, although base attack +2, Strength 9 and Small size ordinarily total −3. The encounter retains the printed number.

name: Witchbane Leech
speed: 1 ft. (1/5 square), climb 1/2 ft., swim 2 ft.
description: A purple leech slips under clothing and interferes with a host’s magic. Its anesthetic coating makes a bite easy to miss.
otherStatistics: Any marsh. No listed organization. Always neutral. No treasure, advancement or level adjustment.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative −2. AC 16, listed as +8 size and −2 Dex. Touch 8 and flat-footed 16 as printed. Base attack +0, grapple −16. Space 1/2 ft., reach 0 ft. Fort −2, Ref −2, Will −4.
sections.Skills and feats: Hide +14. No feats listed.
sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Bite +0 melee, attaching on a hit without dealing damage. Roll 1d10 bite attacks against each suitable host for each hour in an infested area. A host has to be alive and have a circulatory system. The leeches favor creatures with magical abilities.
Magical Interference (Su). Add 5 percentage points of spell failure per attached leech. This can also cause divine spells and supernatural or spell-like abilities to fail even if they normally have no spell failure chance. An infested host cannot regain expended spells or uses of limited-use supernatural or spell-like abilities.
Removal. DC 11 Heal check, or DC 13 Dexterity check with hands or a suitable appendage. The Dexterity DC increases to 23 without one.

ruleNotes: The printed regular and touch AC do not agree with the listed size and Dexterity modifiers. Both values are retained.

name: Shadow Asp
description: A cobra made of shadow wards tombs in Har’Akir. It strikes anyone alive who enters its assigned chamber.
otherStatistics: Any land or underground in the Amber Wastes. Brood of 5–30. Always neutral. No treasure. Advancement 1–2 HD (Small) or 3–4 HD (Medium). No level adjustment.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +8. AC +2 size, +4 Dex as printed, +1 natural. Touch 16, flat-footed 13. Base attack +0, grapple −11. Space 2-1/2 ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +2, Ref +7, Will +1.
sections.Skills and feats: Balance +13, Climb +13, Hide +24, Listen +6, Spot +6. Weapon Finesse. Gets skills as an animal. Gains +4 racial Listen and Spot and +8 racial Balance and Hide. It can use Dexterity for Climb.
sections.Traits:
DR 5/slashing or magic. Darkvision 60 ft. and low-light vision.
Silent (Ex). Its movement never makes a sound.
Vulnerability to Light (Su). Light, continual light, or daylight kills an asp instantly if the spell targets the asp. No saving throw.
sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Bite +3 melee (1d2 − 3 plus poison, minimum 1 point of bite damage under the standard damage rule).
Shadow Poison (Su). Fortitude DC 15 after a bite. Initial damage 1 Strength, secondary damage 2d6 Strength. The victim’s skin darkens while affected. At Strength 0, the victim dies and makes a second DC 15 Fortitude save. On success the body fades into shadow. On failure the victim becomes a shadow bound to the asp’s warded area, otherwise free-willed.
sections.Summoning: Summon monster III can summon a shadow asp. A lost Akiri spell could summon 5d6 and bind them to a tomb permanently.

ruleNotes: The printing gives Dexterity 20 alongside +4 Dex to AC. The attack and defense numbers use the printed values.

name: Dread Nightmare
otherStatistics: Initiative +7. AC components −2 size, +3 Dex, +13 natural. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 21. Base attack +8, grapple +13. Space 10 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +9, Ref +5, Will +3.
description: A black stallion whose hooves and breath flame in battle. A herd hunts in formation and may circle a victim before closing.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Hoof +13 melee (1d8 + 5).
Full attack. Two hooves +13 melee (1d8 + 5 each) and bite +8 melee (1d8 + 2).
Flaming Hooves (Su). A hoof hit ignites combustible material.
Frightful Presence (Ex). Stomp and belch smoke. Affected creatures make a DC 15 Fear save or become frightened for 5d6 rounds.
Smoke (Su). In battle, snort a 15-ft. cone. A creature caught in it makes a DC 16 Fortitude save or takes a −3 morale penalty on attack and damage rolls until 1d6 minutes after leaving. The nightmare has concealment against creatures 5 ft. away and total concealment against creatures 10 ft. away. It sees through its smoke and can suppress it as a free action.
Trample (Ex). As the 3.5 trample action, Reflex DC 19 half. See the table note for damage.
sections.Traits: Darkvision 60 ft. Etherealness (Su) works as the spell at caster level 20, with indefinite duration. It often retreats to the Near Ethereal during daylight.
sections.Skills and feats: Intimidate +12, Listen +12, Move Silently +12, Search +10, Sense Motive +12, Spot +12, Survival +13. Alertness, Combat Reflexes, Improved Initiative.
sections.Encounter details: Any land and underground, especially Nova Vaasa. Solitary, pair, or herd of 6–10. Always lawful evil. No treasure. Advancement 9–10 HD (Large), 11–18 HD (Huge). Level adjustment +4 as a cohort.

ruleNotes: The printing omits the trample damage and the area for Frightful Presence. For play, use 1d8 + 7 for trample from the hoof die and 1½ times Strength, and use the smoke cone for Frightful Presence. Use the listed smoke penalty and concealment.

name: Grim Reaper
otherStatistics: Initiative +2. AC components +2 Dex and +8 deflection. Base attack +5, grapple +7 as printed. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +6, Will +6.
description: A robed spirit comes to collect a dying creature’s soul. It fights only if someone interferes.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. +2 scythe at +9 melee. Use the blade for 2d4 + 5 nonlethal damage and Destruction, or the pole for 1d6 + 5 nonlethal damage and Feign Death.
Destruction (Su). A living creature hit by the blade makes a DC 16 Fortitude save or dies. Only true resurrection or miracle restores a victim slain this way.
Feign Death (Su). The pole forces a DC 16 Will save. Failure leaves the target in a deathlike trance for 5 minutes. Magic can discern life.
Gaze of Fear (Su). As a standard action, target a foe with a DC 16 Fear save. Looking at the reaper by itself does not trigger the effect.
sections.Traits: DR 5/bludgeoning. Immune to cold, mind-affecting effects, and necromantic effects. Electricity and fire resistance 10. Incorporeal and Mists subtype traits. Only the dying and creatures that see ethereal or invisible beings can see it. Attacking does not end invisibility. Speak with dead can allow communication.
sections.Running the encounter: When a character in Ravenloft is dying, use a 5% appearance chance and add 5 percentage points for each prior brush with death. Reaching −8 HP or dying and returning counts. It alternates scythe and gaze from round to round when opposed. Death ward protects its intended target. Any healing magic used on that target makes the reaper leave. If the reaper is slain, the target stabilizes and regains 10% of maximum HP.
sections.Skills and feats: Hide +12, Knowledge (the afterlife) +17, Listen +13, Search +13, Sense Motive +12, Spot +14, Spellcraft +11. Weapon Focus (scythe), Weapon Specialization (scythe).
sections.Encounter details: Any environment. Solitary. Always neutral. No treasure. Advancement 5–10 HD (Medium).

ruleNotes: The printing lists a grapple modifier alongside the incorporeal subtype and does not list touch or flat-footed AC. Apply the normal subtype rules. The printed AC components give touch 20 and flat-footed 18.

name: Jack Frost
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 as printed. AC components +1 size and +4 Dex in humanoid form. Touch AC 15, flat-footed AC 11. Base attack +1, grapple +1. Space and reach 5 ft. each in humanoid form, or 10-ft. space and 0-ft. reach in alternate forms. Fort +1, Ref +7, Will +5.
description: Spiteful cold spirits travel in flurries, weakening prey with vapor or mesmerizing snow before closing in humanoid form.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Touch +2 melee for 1d6 cold, or bite +2 melee for 1d3 damage and Frostbite.
Frostbite (Su). A bitten creature makes a DC 15 Fortitude save or takes 1d6 additional nonlethal damage and is fatigued until that damage is removed. This is a cold effect.
Freezing Vapor (Su). In vapor form, pass through an enemy’s space as a move action. A creature passed through takes 3d6 cold, Reflex DC 14 half. A foe can take this damage from only one jack frost per round. Creatures killed by it freeze solid.
Sparkling Snow (Su). In snow form, use a 30-ft. gaze that works as hypnotic pattern, Will DC 14.
sections.Traits: Cold subtype. Alternate Form (Su). As a standard action, become vapor or sparkling snow indefinitely. Either form works as gaseous form with the printed space and reach, perfect flight 60 ft., and no running.
sections.Skills and feats: Bluff +6, Escape Artist +8, Hide +12, Listen +7, Move Silently +8, Spot +7. Dodge.
sections.Encounter details: Mountains and cold lands. Flurry of 10–30. Usually neutral evil. Standard treasure. Advancement 4–6 HD (Small).

ruleNotes: Initiative is +2 in the printed table despite Dexterity 18. Retain the printed modifier.

name: Marikith Queen
otherStatistics: Initiative +1. AC components −2 size, +1 Dex, +10 natural. Touch AC 9, flat-footed AC 18. Base attack +7, grapple +15. Space 10 ft., reach 10 ft. Fort +8, Ref +4, Will +9.
description: This spiderlike queen breeds the hunters of Timor. She stays inside the hive and directs her brood against intruders.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +15 melee (2d4 + 8).
Full attack. Four claws +15 melee (2d4 + 8 each), plus either bite +10 melee (2d8 + 4 and poison) or sting +10 melee (1d8 + 4 and poison).
Improved Grab (Ex). After at least two claws hit a Medium or smaller target, attempt to start a grapple as a free action without provoking an attack of opportunity.
Poison (Ex). Bite and sting both require DC 20 Fortitude saves. For the bite, use 2d6 initial Constitution damage and 1d6 secondary Constitution damage. The sting has no initial damage and causes one week of secondary paralysis. An affected humanoid becomes a marikith hunter during that week. Neutralizing the poison before the change finishes reverses the transformation.
sections.Traits: DR 5/piercing. Darkvision 120 ft. Immune to fear, horror, and madness. Hive Mind (Su) lets her communicate telepathically with any of her brood within 5 miles. Light Sensitivity (Ex) imposes a −1 attack penalty in candlelight or starlight, −2 in torchlight, and −4 in bright sunlight or daylight. The block also lists Voice Mimicry.
sections.Skills and feats: Balance +9, Hide +5, Listen +10, Move Silently +7, Search +3, Spot +8. Improved Grab, Multiattack.
sections.Encounter details: Underground in Timor. A queen is escorted by 4–48 hunters. Always neutral evil. Double standard treasure. Advancement 11–16 HD (Huge).

ruleNotes: The bite description repeats “secondary damage” with two different values. For play, use 2d6 initial and the explicitly repeated 1d6 secondary. The queen has Voice Mimicry in her stat line, but only the hunter entry gives a procedure. As a table default, use opposed Bluff with a +8 racial bonus against Listen, as for the hunters.
The queen’s printed stat line gives a 10-ft. space and +15 grapple. The full-attack line omits bite poison, which is specified in the combat description on p. 150.

name: Dread Troll
otherStatistics: Initiative +4. AC components −1 size, +4 Dex, +6 natural. Touch AC 13, flat-footed AC 15. Base attack +6, grapple +16. Space 5 ft., reach 10 ft. Fort +11, Ref +6, Will +5.
description: A dread troll stalks solitary travelers and bargains for a second victim in exchange for releasing the first.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +12 melee (1d6 + 6).
Full attack. Two claws +12 melee (1d6 + 6 each) and bite +7 melee (1d6 + 3).
Rend (Ex). If both claws hit one target, deal another 2d6 + 9 damage automatically.
sections.Traits: Darkvision 90 ft. Scent. Regeneration 5 (Ex). Fire and acid deal normal damage. Lost parts grow back in 3d6 minutes. Holding a severed part to the stump reattaches it immediately. Alter Form (Su) changes its height to anywhere from 7 to 12 ft. Flexible limbs let it hide in tight spaces.
sections.Skills and feats: Escape Artist +6, Hide +4, Intimidate +6, Listen +4, Move Silently +6, Spot +4. Alertness, Iron Will, Power Attack.
sections.Encounter details: Any land. Solitary. Always lawful evil. Standard treasure. Advancement by character class.

name: Vorlog
otherStatistics: Initiative +6. AC components +2 Dex, +3 natural, +4 chain shirt. Touch AC 12, flat-footed AC 17. Base attack +6, grapple +10. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +7, Ref +4, Will +3.
description: A vampire’s chosen companion survives an interrupted Dark Kiss. The vorlog charms a replacement and drains their Wisdom to keep them devoted.

sections.Actions:
Attack and full attack as printed. Unarmed strike +10/+5 melee (1d3 + 4 nonlethal and Wisdom Drain), short sword +10/+5 melee (1d6 + 4, 19–20/×2), or masterwork mighty longbow +9 ranged (1d8 + 4, 19–20/×2).
Animal Rage (Su). At will, animals within 50 ft. make a DC 14 Will save or rage as the spell at caster level 12 and attack the nearest creature, even the vorlog.
Charm Person (Sp). At will at caster level 6, Will DC 12.
Wisdom Drain (Su). The unarmed hit deals 1d3 Wisdom damage to a living target. At Wisdom below 3 it becomes a lost one under the vorlog’s control. The vorlog keeps its surrogate at or below half their normal Wisdom.
sections.Traits: DR 5/silver and magic. Immune to mind-affecting effects, poison, sleep, and paralysis. Fast Healing (Ex) restores 1 HP per hour while at 1 HP or more, or 1 HP per round if the surrogate is physically present. At 0 HP or less it becomes a puddle of tears, moves at speed 20 ft., can climb walls and pass through tiny cracks, and must reach a dark haven in 1d4 hours or evaporate. After resting 8 hours it resumes humanoid form. Direct sunlight deals 1d6 damage each round. It will not approach a good deity’s holy symbol presented with conviction. It needs food and Wisdom and dies after three months without a surrogate.
sections.Skills and feats: Climb +16, Craft (bowmaking) +4, Diplomacy +3, Listen +4, Move Silently +13, Ride +4, Spot +4. Alertness, Blind-Fight, Dodge, Improved Critical (short sword), Improved Initiative, Improved Unarmed Strike, Point Blank Shot, Power Attack.
sections.Encounter details: Any land and underground. Solitary. Usually chaotic, always evil. Standard treasure. Gear includes 50 +1 arrows and a ring of climbing. It retains its former languages. A charmed victim who drinks the vorlog’s blood for three consecutive nights becomes its surrogate.
sections.Template for another encounter: Apply to a humanoid or monstrous humanoid. Keep type, size, speed, attacks, damage, saves, and existing special abilities. Increase Hit Dice one die size to a maximum of d12. Add +3 natural armor, +4 Str, +2 Dex, +2 Cha, and a +8 racial bonus to Move Silently. Add Alertness and Improved Unarmed Strike if missing. Add the vorlog attacks, traits and weaknesses above. Animal Rage Will DC is 10 + half the vorlog’s HD + Cha modifier. Charm Person Will DC is 11 + Cha modifier. CR is base +1, level adjustment base +8, and advancement by class.

ruleNotes: The sample prints iterative melee bonuses in both Attack and Full Attack and gives the longbow a 19–20/×2 critical. Listed values follow the printing. The sample’s level adjustment is +15.

name: Wolfwere
otherStatistics: Initiative +5. AC components +1 Dex and +6 natural. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 16. Base attack +3, grapple +5. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +6, Ref +5, Will +5. Statistics are for the hybrid form.
description: A wolfwere masquerades as a traveler or minstrel. Its song slows victims before it takes hybrid form and attacks.

sections.Actions:
Attack and full attack as printed. Bite +5 melee (1d6 + 3) and longsword +3 melee (1d8 + 1), or composite shortbow +4 ranged (1d6).
Song of Weariness (Su). Creatures within 90 ft. make a DC 14 Will save or are slowed for 1d4 + 4 rounds as slow at caster level 6. Success gives one day of protection from the same wolfwere’s song. The song is sonic and mind-affecting.
sections.Traits: DR 10/cold iron, darkvision 60 ft., SR 13. Alternate Form (Su). As a standard action, assume dire wolf or Small or Medium humanoid form indefinitely as polymorph. It retains supernatural abilities in humanoid form. It speaks Sylvan and the local domain language.
sections.Skills and feats: Bluff +6, Diplomacy +6, Disguise +6, Hide +5, Listen +5, Move Silently +5, Perform (string instruments) +6, Spot +5. Combat Reflexes, Combat Expertise, Improved Initiative, Multiattack.
sections.Encounter details: Any land and underground. Solitary, pair, or troupe of 2–5 wolfweres and 2d8 wolves. Always chaotic evil. Standard treasure. Advancement by class. Level adjustment +4.
sections.Greater wolfwere:
CR 7. Large Animal (Augmented Animal, Shapechanger). 60 HP and 8d8 + 10 as printed. Initiative +4, speed 50 ft., AC 18 (−1 size, +9 natural), touch 9, flat-footed 18. Space 5 ft., reach 10 ft. Fort +9, Ref +6, Will +8. Str 23, Dex 10, Con 17, Int 16, Wis 14, Cha 16. The printed table omits base attack and grapple. For play, +6/+16 derives from 8 animal HD, size, and Strength.
Attack and full attack as printed. Bite +11 melee (1d8 + 6) and two claws +9 melee (1d6 + 3), or composite shortbow +5 ranged (1d6). In wolf-man form the prose instead pairs the bite with a melee weapon and gives the weapon the claws’ stated +3 attack bonus.
Song of Weariness. Will DC 17 within 90 ft. or slowed 1d6 + 4 rounds at caster level 8. Success gives immunity to the same singer for one day. Lupine Allies (Su). Once per day as a standard action, howl to call 4d6 wolves or 2d6 dire wolves. They arrive in 2d6 rounds, serve for up to 1 hour, and gain a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls.
Alternate Form as above. DR 10/cold iron, darkvision 60 ft., SR 21, regeneration 10. Fire and acid deal normal damage. Lost limbs do not regrow.
Bluff +7, Diplomacy +7, Disguise +6, Handle Animal +6, Hide −2, Intimidate +7, Listen +7, Move Silently +3, Perform (wind instruments) +7, Spot +7. Alertness, Combat Expertise, Improved Initiative, Multiattack, Power Attack. Temperate forest. Solitary, pair, gang of 3–5, or troupe with one greater wolfwere, 2d4 wolfweres, 1d6 dire wolves, and 3d6 wolves. Always neutral evil. Standard treasure, advancement by class, level adjustment +11.

ruleNotes: The greater wolfwere’s listed 60 HP and 8d8 + 10 are retained even though its listed Constitution would usually modify the dice differently. Its written weapon routine is separate from the printed bite-and-claw routine.

name: Blood Elemental
classification: Medium Elemental (Water, Mists). Medium size tier shown in header.
description: A red mass lashes with its tentacles and leaves a twisting trail that dries in patterns. If it breaks free, it stalks its conjurer and destroys things along the way.

sections.Medium size tier:
Medium elemental (Water, Mists). CR 3. 30 HP (4d8 + 12). Initiative +1. Speed 20 ft..
AC 19, touch 11, flat-footed 18. Base attack +3, grapple +6. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft.
Attack Slam +6 melee (1d8 + 4 plus Blood Drain). Full attack Slam +6 melee (1d8 + 4 plus Blood Drain).
Fort +7, Ref +2, Will +1. Str 16, Dex 12, Con 17, Int 5, Wis 11, Cha 11. Listen +7, Spot +7.
Feats include Power Attack. Advancement 5–7 HD, Medium.
sections.Actions:
Slam. Make one melee slam, or use the full-attack count in the chosen tier. Blood Drain applies to every successful slam against a living creature.
Blood Drain (Ex). After a slam hits a living creature, the elemental attempts to drain its blood as a free action. Fortitude DC equals its HD plus its Constitution modifier. Failure deals 1d4 Constitution damage. The elemental gains 1 HP for each point of Constitution damage actually dealt.
Drench (Ex). Touch extinguishes an exposed nonmagical flame at least one size category smaller than the elemental. Touching magical fire can dispel it as dispel magic at caster level equal to the elemental’s HD.
Engulf (Ex). The elemental can engulf a foe at least one size smaller in a round when it makes no slams. The target can make an attack of opportunity and forgo the save, or decline the attack and attempt a DC 16 Reflex save. An engulfed creature is subject to the 3.5 drowning rules. When an attack hits the elemental, split the damage evenly between it and the engulfed target on a 50% roll if the elemental is one size larger, or 10% if it is two sizes larger. With a gap of three or more categories, only the elemental takes damage.
sections.Traits: Darkvision 60 ft. Immune to poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning, critical hits, and flanking. Does not eat, sleep, or breathe. It cannot be raised or resurrected, though limited wish, wish, miracle, or true resurrection can restore it. Drawn from blood or from water taken from drowned lungs. Exceptionally evil blood can increase its HD. It cannot enter or cross a large body of water. Forced contact with a body of water at least as large as itself deals 1d10 damage each round until it escapes.
sections.Other size tiers: Small, Large, Huge, Greater, and Elder are listed below. Each uses the same actions and traits with its own statistics.
sections.Small tier:
Small elemental (Water, Mists). CR 1. 11 HP (2d8 + 2). Initiative +0. Speed 20 ft..
AC 17, touch 11, flat-footed 17. Base attack +1, grapple −1. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft.
Attack Slam +4 melee (1d6 + 3 plus Blood Drain). Full attack Slam +4 melee (1d6 + 3 plus Blood Drain).
Fort +4, Ref +0, Will +0. Str 14, Dex 10, Con 13, Int 5, Wis 11, Cha 11. Listen +5, Spot +5.
Feats include Power Attack. Advancement 3 HD, Small.
sections.Large tier:

sections.Dread golem commands: The creator can give commands from within 60 ft. if the golem can see and hear them. It follows the last command and responds to attacks against it. Some dread golems act independently.
sections.Skills and feats: Climb +13, Hide +6, Jump +13, Listen +5. Improved Initiative, Power Attack.
sections.Encounter details: Any land or underground. Solitary, always neutral, no treasure. Advances to 11–15 HD (Medium) or 16–25 HD (Large).

ruleNotes: The printed +8 melee slam is lower than its base attack plus Strength. Use the printed attack line. The pounce rules do not give an exact division of extra falling damage.

name: Glass Golem
otherStatistics: Initiative +3. AC +2 Dex, +7 natural. Base attack +5, grapple +9. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +2, Ref +1, Will +2.
description: A stained-glass knight can wait inside a window until a trespasser walks past.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Sword +9 melee for 2d10 + 4.
Prismatic Burst (Su). Once every 1d4 rounds, affect every creature within 30 ft. as prismatic spray, caster level 7th and save DC 13 where applicable.
sections.Traits:
Damage reduction 10/magic. Fast healing 2 in direct sunlight or within the radius of daylight or a similar spell. For bludgeoning weapons, double damage that gets past its damage reduction.
Magic Immunity (Ex). Immune to spells, spell-like abilities and supernatural effects, with named exceptions. After shatter hits the golem, every subsequent physical hit for rounds equal to the spell's caster level forces a Fortitude save at DC 5 + damage dealt. Failure destroys it. Mending restores full HP. A targeted dispel magic at DC 14 disables it for a number of rounds equal to the caster's dispel check result minus 10. A result at least 10 above the DC destroys it. Detect magic reveals its aura returning while it is disabled.
Construct traits. Immune to mind-affecting effects, poison, disease and similar effects. Critical hits, nonlethal damage, ability damage, energy drain and death from massive damage do not affect it, subject to the exceptions below.
sections.Dread golem commands: The creator can give commands from within 60 ft. if the golem can see and hear them. It follows the last command and responds to attacks against it. Some dread golems act independently.
sections.Skills and feats: Climb +10, Listen +7, Spot +7. Improved Initiative.
sections.Encounter details: Any land or underground. Solitary, always neutral, no treasure. Advances to 8–12 HD (Medium) or 13–18 HD (Large).

ruleNotes: The source omits touch and flat-footed AC. From its printed modifiers, use touch AC 12 and flat-footed AC 17. Initiative is printed as +3 despite the listed Dexterity and Improved Initiative.

name: Mist Golem
otherStatistics: Initiative +8. AC −1 size, +2 Dex, +9 natural. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 18. Base attack +13, grapple +21. Space 10 ft., reach 10 ft. Fort +11, Ref +8, Will +11.
description: A construct forms out of the Mists, wearing the face of the person whose attempt to create it went wrong.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Slam +21 melee for 3d6 + 8. Full attack makes two slams at the same bonus and damage.
Infuse Essence (Su). A critical hit that kills the target turns it into a mist horror. Finding and capturing that creature is required before restoring the victim to life. A target that survives becomes ethereal and unable to act for 10 rounds. Damage directed at the golem goes to that victim instead. Direct physical attacks against the victim require a magic weapon. If the victim dies during the effect, it becomes a mist horror.
Mist Door (Su). The golem spends the round doing nothing else, and attacks against it gain +2. It retreats into the Mists the following round, leaving thick fog that clears after an hour.
Mournful Howl (Su). Anyone within 50 ft. must make a DC 15 Will save or flee in terror. The howl is audible up to a mile away.
Ram (Ex). Its blows against structures work like a battering ram.
Spellshroud (Sp). The mist extends 15 ft. beyond the golem and produces one of ten spells per use, each usable once per day. When surprised, it releases a random unused effect. Use each spell's usual save type with a −4 penalty to its DC. Roll 1d10 if needed: 1 cloudkill, 2 confusion, 3 blindness, 4 hold person, 5 Tasha's hideous laughter, 6 Otto's irresistible dance, 7 stinking cloud, 8 silence, 9 vampiric touch, 10 slow.
sections.Traits:
Damage reduction 10/magic. Mists subtype. The Demiplane of Dread is its home plane. In foggy conditions its targets take −2 initiative.
Magic Immunity (Ex). Immune to spells, spell-like abilities and supernatural effects. Damage-dealing spells heal 1 HP per 2 damage they would normally deal if the golem is injured. Dispel magic has no effect.
Construct traits. Immune to mind-affecting effects, poison, disease and similar effects. Critical hits, nonlethal damage, ability damage, energy drain and death from massive damage do not affect it, subject to the exceptions below.
sections.Dread golem commands: The creator can give commands from within 60 ft. if the golem can see and hear them. It follows the last command and responds to attacks against it. Some dread golems act independently.
sections.Specific Focus (Ex): At creation, its focus was exposed to moonlight within 50 ft. of both golem and creator. The object weighs at most 5 lb. and is worth at least 10,000 gp. A holder can command five tasks. The golem cannot harm the holder while they carry the item. It follows instructions literally and increasingly twists their intent. After the fifth task, the focus vanishes and appears elsewhere in Ravenloft. The golem then hunts its former holder.
sections.Skills and feats: Climb +11, Hide +6, Jump +12, Listen +4, Move Silently +6, Spot +4, Survival +4. Alertness, Blind-Fight, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Power Attack.
sections.Encounter details: Any terrain in the Mists. Solitary, always chaotic evil, no treasure. Advances to 19–23 HD (Huge) or 24–30 HD (Gargantuan).

ruleNotes: The prose gives no duration for the howl’s flight and no caster level or base save DC for Spellshroud. The header labels +13/+21 as Base Attack. Use the second value as grapple, following the adjacent stat blocks.

name: Snow Golem
otherStatistics: Initiative +3. AC −1 size, +3 Dex, +7 natural. Touch AC 12, flat-footed AC 16. Base attack +9, grapple +13. Space 10 ft., reach 10 ft. Fort +8, Ref +4, Will +8.
description: What looks like a white marble sentinel is packed snow shaped into plate armor.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Slam +13 melee for 2d12 + 4. Full attack makes two slams using the same bonus and damage. It sometimes grapples.
Conduction (Ex). If an electrical attack hits it, the golem takes no damage and passes the damage to a creature touching it. Without contact it stores that electrical damage and releases it into the next creature to touch it.
Cone of cold (Sp). Use once every 5 rounds at caster level 10th.
sections.Traits:
Damage reduction 10/magic. Immune to cold and water-based attacks. The stat block lists regeneration and vulnerability to fire and steam.
Magic Immunity (Ex). Immune to spells, spell-like abilities and supernatural effects, except that fire-based spells damage it and create a steam cloud reaching 20 ft. beyond it. Creatures in the steam make a DC 15 save or take half the damage the golem took.
Construct traits. Immune to mind-affecting effects, poison, disease and similar effects. Critical hits, nonlethal damage, ability damage, energy drain and death from massive damage do not affect it, subject to the exceptions below.
sections.Dread golem commands: The creator can give commands from within 60 ft. if the golem can see and hear them. It follows the last command and responds to attacks against it. Some dread golems act independently.
sections.Skills and feats: Climb +9, Hide +9, Jump +8, Listen +5, Move Silently +9, Spot +4, Survival +5. Alertness, Blind-Fight, Power Attack.
sections.Encounter details: Arctic lands and mountains of Todstein. Solitary, always chaotic evil, no treasure. Advances to 13–20 HD (Huge) or 20–26 HD (Gargantuan).

ruleNotes: The printed damage-reduction line repeats a digit across a line break. Read it as 10/magic. The steam save does not specify a type. Reflex is a table default. Regeneration is listed without a rate, and the cone of cold gives a caster level without a save DC.

name: Wax Golem
otherStatistics: Initiative +6. AC +2 Dex, +6 natural. Touch AC 12, flat-footed AC 16. Base attack +6, grapple +10. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +6, Ref +4, Will +4.
description: A wax duplicate knows its living counterpart’s languages and hunts them for the memories it needs to take their place.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Slam +10 melee for 2d6 + 4 plus the listed energy drain. Full attack makes two such slams or uses a weapon at +10 melee for weapon damage +4.
Memory Drain (Su). A hit on its living counterpart calls for a DC 15 Will save. On failure, the victim takes one negative level in place of physical damage, and the golem gains the memories and abilities of the victim’s newest remaining level. If the victim escapes while partly drained, they make a DC 16 Madness save each week until the golem is destroyed. A completely drained victim is comatose and alive. If the drained counterpart later dies, the golem melts.
sections.Traits:
Damage reduction 10/magic. Immune to cold and electrical attacks. The stat block lists regeneration and vulnerability to fire.
Magic Immunity (Ex). The golem has the usual dread golem immunities. Magical fire melts its features, revealing the disguise.
Construct traits. Immune to mind-affecting effects, poison, disease and similar effects. Critical hits, nonlethal damage, ability damage, energy drain and death from massive damage do not affect it, subject to the exceptions below.
sections.Dread golem commands: The creator can give commands from within 60 ft. if the golem can see and hear them. It follows the last command and responds to attacks against it. Some dread golems act independently.
sections.Skills and feats: Climb +7, Hide +6, Jump +7, Listen +4, Move Silently +5, Spot +3, Survival +3, Swim +7. Improved Initiative, Power Attack.
sections.Encounter details: Any terrain. Solitary, always chaotic evil, no treasure. Advances to 9–12 HD (Large) or 13–16 HD (Huge).

ruleNotes: The save line prints “Wis +4” after Fortitude and Reflex. Read it as Will +4. The source gives no spell list or regeneration rate. Its only described energy-drain procedure is Memory Drain against the living counterpart.

name: Powrie
otherStatistics: Initiative +5. AC 17 (+2 size, +5 Dex), touch 17, flat-footed 12. Base attack +2, grapple −8. Space 2½ ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +2, Ref +2, Will +5.
description: This wasp-winged redcap stalks targets with illusions, needle daggers, and a grin that opens impossibly wide.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Bite +0 melee (1d4−2 plus poison) or powrie dagger +5 ranged (1d3−2).
Evil Grin (Su). A creature that looks at the grinning powrie makes a DC 16 Will save or suffers the fear spell.
Poison (Ex). The bite delivers injury poison. On a failed DC 15 Fortitude save, the victim is blinded as with blindness/deafness. There is no secondary damage.
Shriek (Sp). Creatures in a 30-ft. radius make a DC 15 Fortitude save or become deafened.
Alternate Form (Su). As a standard action at will, become a wasp or another stinging insect. Spend at most 3 hours in that form per 24 hours.
sections.Traits: DR 5/magic and platinum. Immune to steel. Electricity resistance 10. Darkvision 120 ft. and low-light vision. Use the rogue rules for Evasion, Uncanny Dodge, Trapfinding, and Sneak Attack. Direct sunlight deals 1d4 damage each round without a save.
sections.Spellcasting: Casts Illusion spells as a 5th-level sorcerer. The book does not list spells known. For a quick encounter, select spells such as ghost sound, disguise self, silent image, invisibility, and mirror image. Spell save DC 11 + spell level.
sections.Skills and feats: Disable Device +8, Hide +13, Move Silently +13, Open Lock +13, Search +8, Sleight of Hand +13. Dodge, Skill Focus (Hide). −10 racial penalty to Diplomacy. Speaks Sylvan.
sections.Encounter details: Any land in the Shadow Rift. A lone powrie prefers surprise. Larger groups may attack directly. Solitary, a unit, or a hive of up to 400. No coins, 50% goods and 50% items. Always chaotic evil.

ruleNotes: The printed saves include Reflex +2 despite Dexterity 20. The stat block uses the printed save.
The book gives no Sneak Attack dice or Shriek duration. For play, use +3d6 Sneak Attack as a 5th-level rogue and let Shriek deafen for 1 round. These are table defaults.
The organization line prints ‘unit (46)’ without a separator. Use 4–6 for a small unit as a table default.

name: Shee
otherStatistics: Initiative +7. AC 16 (+3 Dex, +3 luck), touch 16, flat-footed 13. Base attack +3, grapple +3. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +2, Ref +2, Will +5.
description: A soft-spoken patron of the arts who negotiates first and reaches for enchanted ammunition if cornered.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Shortbow +8 ranged (1d6) or light crossbow +8 ranged (1d8).
Cursed Arrows (Su). The shee's arrows and bolts inflict doom as the spell unless the target succeeds on a DC 14 Will save.
Charming Kiss (Sp). A kiss works as charm person. A DC 15 Will save negates it.
Alternate Form (Su). As a standard action at will, take a nonpredatory, nonscavenging bird form for up to 8 hours total per 24 hours.
sections.Traits: DR 5/lead. Immune to stone. Darkvision 120 ft. and low-light vision. The +3 luck bonus to AC is already included. Reroll one failed save per day. Direct sunlight deals 2d4 damage each round without a save.
sections.Spellcasting: A performing shee casts as a 5th-level bard. The book gives no spell list. For a quick encounter, grease, glitterdust, and suggestion are options. Spell save DC 13 + spell level.
sections.Skills and feats: Knowledge (Shadow Rift) +14, Knowledge (fey) +14, Perform (wind instruments) +17, Ride +9, Spot +12, Spellcraft +8, Use Magic Device +9. Improved Initiative and Skill Focus in each listed Knowledge skill. Speaks Sylvan and usually at least three local languages.
sections.Encounter details: Any land in the Shadow Rift. Solitary or clique of 3–5. Standard treasure. Usually neutral.

ruleNotes: The combat prose names a longbow, but the attack line supplies shortbow statistics. Use the printed shortbow attack.
The source does not define the extent of ‘immunity to stone.’ For play, treat that as immunity to attacks made with stone. The printed Reflex save is +2.

name: Sith
otherStatistics: Initiative +2. AC 15 (+2 Dex, +3 luck), touch 15, flat-footed 13. Base attack +3, grapple +3. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +2, Ref +2, Will +5.
description: A gaunt Unseelie spellcaster who prefers to travel as a shadow and reappears with a rapier in hand.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Rapier +6 melee (1d6).
Full attack. Three rapier strikes +6 melee (1d6 each) with Blinding Speed. A sith cannot use Blinding Speed if wielding a heavy weapon.
Fear Aura (Su). At will, opponents within 30 ft. make a DC 14 Will save or are stunned for 1 round. A successful save grants immunity to this sith's aura for 1 day.
Shadow Form (Su). As a standard action, assume the appearance of a nonmagical shadow. In this form the sith can move and perceive its surroundings, but cannot attack.
sections.Traits: DR 5/silver. Immune to fire. Darkvision 120 ft. and low-light vision. The +3 luck bonus to AC is already included. Reroll one failed save per day. Direct sunlight deals 3 damage each round without a save. Shade reduces this to 1 damage per round.
sections.Spellcasting: Casts Necromancy spells as a 6th-level wizard. No prepared spell list is given. For a quick encounter, ray of enfeeblement, blindness/deafness, and vampiric touch are options. Spell save DC 13 + spell level.
sections.Skills and feats: Craft (alchemy) +10, Decipher Script +10, Gather Information +10, Hide +12, Knowledge (arcana) +10, Listen +15, Move Silently +9, Ride +8, Spellcraft +10, Spot +10, Use Magic Device +10. Scribe Scroll, Silent Spell, Still Spell. Speaks Sylvan and at least four local languages.
sections.Encounter details: Any land in the Shadow Rift. Solitary or bevy of 3–5. Standard treasure. Always lawful evil.

ruleNotes: The source describes Blinding Speed as three full attacks and gives a three-strike full-attack line. Use that line as the total rather than multiplying it again.
The source says ‘damage resistance 5/silver.’ This profile treats that notation as damage reduction, consistent with the other shadow fey.

name: Teg
otherStatistics: Initiative +6. AC 15 (+2 Dex, +3 luck), touch 15, flat-footed 12. Base attack +1, grapple +3. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +1, Ref +1, Will +3.
description: This fox-faced hunter prefers to drive intruders into a snare and resorts to claws and teeth when cornered.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +3 melee (1d4+2) or bite −1 melee (1d4+2).
Full attack. Two claws +3 melee (1d4+2 each) and bite −1 melee (1d4+2).
Howl of Confusion (Su). Creatures within 50 ft. make a DC 12 Will save or suffer confusion at caster level 8.
Alternate Form (Su). As a standard action at will, become a fox for up to 8 hours total per day.
sections.Traits: DR 5/gold. Immune to cold. Darkvision 120 ft. and low-light vision. The +3 luck bonus to AC is already included. Reroll one failed save per day. Direct sunlight deals 2 damage each round without a save. Shade reduces this to 1 damage every 2 rounds.
sections.Spellcasting: Casts Animal domain spells as a 2nd-level druid. For play, calm animals is the 1st-level option. The print gives no spell allotment.
sections.Skills and feats: Handle Animal +9, Hide +8, Move Silently +8, Sense Motive +9, Spot +9, Survival +9. Skill Focus (Survival). Speaks Sylvan and can converse with animals normally found in temperate forests or grasslands.
sections.Encounter details: Temperate forests, hills, or plains of the Shadow Rift. Solitary. Standard treasure. Usually neutral evil.

name: Ennui
otherStatistics: Initiative +6. AC 15 (+2 Dex, +3 natural), touch 12, flat-footed 13. Base attack +8, grapple +11. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +8, Ref +8, Will +9.
description: A winged jailer of the Veil of Sleep watches its prey unseen before attacking with four claws.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +11 melee (1d4+3). Full attack. Four claws +11 melee (1d4+3 each).
Lullaby (Su). As a standard action, opponents within 20 ft. must make a DC 14 Will save. Failure fatigues them for 1d4 rounds or as long as the dream spawn keeps speaking within 20 ft. of them. Maintaining the lullaby is a free action. This is a sonic, mind-affecting compulsion.
Memory Drain (Su, 1/day). A successful touch attack deals 1d4 Intelligence damage. Until the victim recovers all of those points, the dream spawn can use Alternate Form to impersonate any creature from the victim's memory.
Alternate Form (Su). Use polymorph on itself as a standard action at caster level 8. The form can last indefinitely. Returning to its own shape is a free action.
Invisibility (Sp). As a standard action, become invisible as the spell at caster level 8. It can stay invisible indefinitely until the effect ends, such as by attacking.
sections.Traits: DR 15/magic. Darkvision 60 ft. It does not need to eat, drink, or breathe. Detect Thoughts (Su). In an inhabited dreamscape, it knows a creature's surface thoughts as though it had studied them for three rounds with detect thoughts, caster level 8, Will DC 15. Fear Eater (Ex). Immune to Fear, Horror, and Madness. A spell targeting it that would normally cause one of those effects heals 1 HP per spell level. When one of its actions makes a dreamer fail a Fear, Horror, or Madness save, it heals 2 HP for a minor outcome, 4 HP for a moderate outcome, or 8 HP for a major outcome.
sections.Dream defeat: A dreamer killed by this dream spawn takes a DC 17 Ravenloft Madness save on waking (Will). For consequences and recovery, use the Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, chapter 3. A spawn that wins often returns to terrorize that dreamer again.
sections.Skills and feats: Bluff +13, Disguise +15, Hide +10, Intimidate +12, Listen +10, Move Silently +10, Sense Motive +12, Spot +10. Alertness (bonus), Flyby Attack, Improved Initiative, Skill Focus (Disguise). Speaks Oneiros and the languages of its current prey.
sections.Encounter details: Any land or underground (dreams). Solitary. No treasure by default. Always lawful evil. Advances at 9–16 HD (Medium) or 17–24 HD (Large). An ennui sometimes carries a dreamslayer weapon. While dreaming, add +3 to that weapon's existing enhancement bonus, to a maximum of +5. Outside of dreams, use the weapon's normal enhancement bonus.

name: Gray Morph
otherStatistics: Initiative +0. AC 14 (+1 size, +3 natural), touch 11, flat-footed 14. Base attack +3, grapple +0. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +3, Will +4.
description: An ash-colored dream creature impersonates animals and bystanders. It flees if its disguise fails.

Attack. Claw +5 melee (1d3+1). Full attack. Two claws +5 melee (1d3+1 each).
