Immune to Fear, Horror, and Madness. A spell targeting it that would normally cause one of those effects heals 1 HP per spell level. When one of its actions makes a dreamer fail a Fear, Horror, or Madness save, it heals 2 HP for a minor outcome, 4 HP for a moderate outcome, or 8 HP for a major outcome.
sections.Dream defeat: A dreamer killed by this dream spawn takes a DC 12 Ravenloft Madness save on waking (Will). For consequences and recovery, use the Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, chapter 3. A spawn that wins often returns to terrorize that dreamer again.
sections.Skills and feats: Bluff +2, Disguise +4, Hide +6, Listen +3, Move Silently +2, Sense Motive +3, Spot +3. Skill Focus (Disguise). Speaks Oneiros and the languages of its current prey.
sections.Encounter details: Any land or underground (dreams). Solitary, pair, gang of 3–6, or pack of 9–20. No treasure. Always lawful neutral. Advances at 4–6 HD (Medium) or 7–9 HD (Large). If forced to fight, it resumes its natural form and claws its attacker.

name: Shadow Morph
otherStatistics: Initiative +5. AC 16 (+1 Dex, +5 natural), touch 11, flat-footed 15. Base attack +5, grapple +7. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +6, Ref +5, Will +6.
description: This featureless dream creature takes the shape of a dreamer’s old enemy or a lost loved one.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +7 melee (1d4+2). Full attack. Two claws +7 melee (1d4+2 each).
Lullaby (Su). As a standard action, opponents within 20 ft. must make a DC 14 Will save. Failure fatigues them for 1d4 rounds or as long as the dream spawn keeps speaking within 20 ft. of them. Maintaining the lullaby is a free action. This is a sonic, mind-affecting compulsion.
Memory Drain (Su, 1/day). A successful touch attack deals 1d4 Intelligence damage. Until the victim recovers all of those points, the dream spawn can use Alternate Form to impersonate any creature from the victim's memory.
Alternate Form (Su). Use polymorph on itself as a standard action at caster level 8. The form can last indefinitely. Returning to its own shape is a free action.
Nightmare Howl (Su). As a standard action, opponents within 60 ft. make a DC 14 Will save. Failure paralyzes the creature with fear for 1d4 rounds and heals the shadow morph for 1d4 HP per failed save. Anyone exposed is immune to that morph's howl for 1 day. All dream spawn are immune. This is a sonic, mind-affecting fear effect.
sections.Traits: DR 10/magic. Darkvision 60 ft. It does not need to eat, drink, or breathe. Detect Thoughts (Su). In an inhabited dreamscape, it knows a creature's surface thoughts as though it had studied them for three rounds with detect thoughts, caster level 5, Will DC 14. Fear Eater (Ex). Immune to Fear, Horror, and Madness. A spell targeting it that would normally cause one of those effects heals 1 HP per spell level. When one of its actions makes a dreamer fail a Fear, Horror, or Madness save, it heals 2 HP for a minor outcome, 4 HP for a moderate outcome, or 8 HP for a major outcome.
sections.Dream defeat: A dreamer killed by this dream spawn takes a DC 14 Ravenloft Madness save on waking (Will). For consequences and recovery, use the Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, chapter 3. A spawn that wins often returns to terrorize that dreamer again.
sections.Skills and feats: Bluff +10, Disguise +10, Hide +4, Intimidate +5, Listen +5, Move Silently +4, Sense Motive +8, Spot +5. Improved Initiative, Skill Focus (Disguise). Speaks Oneiros and the languages of its current prey.
sections.Encounter details: Any land or underground (dreams). Solitary, pair, or pack of 3–6. No treasure. Always lawful evil. Advances at 6–10 HD (Medium) or 11–15 HD (Large). It uses familiar forms to lure dreamers close before it attacks.

name: Carcass Hound
otherStatistics: Initiative +1. AC 13 (+1 Dex, +2 natural), touch 12, flat-footed 11. Base attack +0. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +0, Ref +1, Will +2. Listen +5, Spot +5. No feats. Any land. Solitary or pack (2–5). No treasure. Always neutral.
description: This decaying watchdog follows simple orders and leaves pieces of itself behind on patrol.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Bite +1 melee (1d6+1 plus nerve rot).
Nerve rot (Ex). A bite exposes the target to disease. Fortitude DC 13. Incubation takes 1d3 hours. Damage is 1d3 Intelligence and 1d3 Constitution.
sections.Traits and tactics: Undead traits. Carcass hounds often guard a site in packs. They keep attacking the nearest enemy until destroyed.

ruleNotes: The stat block prints touch AC 12 and flat-footed AC 11 despite the listed AC components. The disease text calls its DC Constitution-based, but the hound has no Constitution. Use the printed values. The Base Attack/Grapple row gives only base attack. If you need a grapple modifier, use +1 from standard 3.5 rules.

name: Dread Mastiff
otherStatistics: Initiative +2. AC 16 (+2 Dex, +4 natural), touch 14, flat-footed 12. Base attack +1. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +5, Ref +5, Will +1. Listen +5, Spot +5, Swim +5, Survival +1. Toughness. Any land. Solitary or pack (2–5). No treasure. Always neutral.
description: A broad-jowled dog bred to guard property and hunt large game. A trained mastiff can bring down an intruder with its bite.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Bite +3 melee (1d6+3).
Trip (Ex), trained attack dogs only. A successful bite allows a free trip attempt without a touch attack or an attack of opportunity. If the trip fails, the opponent cannot trip the mastiff in return.
sections.Traits and tactics: Scent. It gains a +4 racial bonus on Survival checks to track by scent.

ruleNotes: The print calls this form Mastiff under Hounds, Dread. It lists touch AC 14 and flat-footed AC 12 despite the AC components. The Base Attack/Grapple row gives only base attack. If you need a grapple modifier, use +3 from standard 3.5 rules. Trip follows the wolf rule cited in the entry.

name: Phantom Hound
otherStatistics: Initiative +2. AC 16 (+2 Dex, +4 natural), touch 14, flat-footed 12. Base attack +0. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +5, Ref +5, Will +1. Listen +5, Spot +5. No feats. Any land. Solitary or pack (2–5). No treasure. Always neutral. Advances at 3–4 HD (Medium).
description: A dead watchdog still patrols its former master’s property. It leaves the grounds to recover stolen goods.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Bite +3 melee (1d6+3 plus poison).
Bay (Su). As a standard action, howl. Every creature within earshot makes a DC 10 Ravenloft Fear save (Will) or is panicked for 2d4 rounds. When the whole pack howls together, use DC 13 and 4d4 rounds.
Poison (Ex). A bite hit requires a DC 16 Fortitude save. Initial damage is 1d3 Strength. There is no secondary damage.
sections.Traits and tactics: Undead traits. Immune to nonmagical weapons. A phantom hound chases a thief until it recovers the property or is destroyed. The strongest hound leads a pack, which attacks together.

ruleNotes: The print gives touch AC 14 and flat-footed AC 12 despite the listed AC components. It calls the poison DC Constitution-based even though the hound has no Constitution. Use the printed values. The Base Attack/Grapple row gives only base attack. If you need a grapple modifier, use +2 from standard 3.5 rules.

name: Head Hunter
otherStatistics: Initiative +2. AC 14 (+2 size, +2 Dex). Base attack +1, grapple −7. Space and reach 2½ ft. Fort +0, Ref +2, Will +3. Bluff +5, Disguise +6, Hide +11, Listen +7, Move Silently +9, Spot +2. Weapon Finesse. Any land or underground. Solitary. No treasure. Always neutral evil.
description: A spiderlike head can puppet a corpse or call for help from behind a web of nearly invisible blades.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Bite +4 melee (1d6−2 plus poison), or slam +0 melee (1d3) in a host body.
Poison (Ex). The bite carries poison. Up to 3/day the head hunter can also spit contact venom at a target within 15 ft. with a ranged touch attack. Fortitude DC 13, initial and secondary damage 2d4 Constitution.
Razor Web (Ex). Spinning takes full-round actions, at a rate of one 5-ft. cube per minute and at most two cubes per day. Spot DC 20 notices a web. Each web square a creature crosses attacks at +10 melee for 2d6 damage. On a critical hit, roll 1d10. On 1–9 a random limb is severed, adding nonlethal damage equal to the normal damage and bleeding as from a wounding weapon. On 10 it cuts off the target’s head as a vorpal weapon would. Each web square has AC 8 and 10 HP.
sections.Host body (Ex): It can spend one minute implanting itself in a corpse killed in its web and feed on it for ten days. It can puppet a Small to Large corpse. The printed Medium host has 1d10 HD (5 HP), AC 12, Str 10, Dex 10, Ref +0, Hide +2, Move Silently +4, and 5-ft. space and reach. Hits damage the host unless an attacker specifically targets the head. When the host is destroyed, the head hunter falls as if dead. Left unattended it crawls out and seeks another corpse. Entering a new host restores its own HP.
sections.Traits and tactics: Immune to poison and webbing. It climbs any webs freely, including its own razor web. It and its web take double fire damage, and fire damage spreads to every square in the web. Tremorsense 60 ft. detects anything touching the ground or its webs. It is effectively blinded to targets beyond 20 ft. that evade tremorsense. Seeing it without a host or on a quadruped calls for a DC 13 Ravenloft Horror save (Will). Speaks Elven, Drow, and several domain languages. Racial +5 on Bluff, Disguise, Hide, Listen, and Move Silently.

ruleNotes: The printed host AC is 12 with a listed +2 Dex component, though the host’s bracketed Dexterity is 10. Use the listed total. The text gives the web’s critical result as 1–10 without naming the die, so use 1d10. The spit has no printed attack bonus. Use +5 ranged touch for the unhosted form from its listed base attack, Dexterity, and size.

name: Kizoku
otherStatistics: Initiative +7. AC 17 (+3 Dex, +2 natural, +2 leather armor). Base attack +7, grapple +11. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +10, Will +11. Bluff +10, Diplomacy +11, Disguise +8, Gather Information +10, Listen +6, Move Silently +8, Perform (sing) +13, Ride +7, Sense Motive +10, Spot +6. Bonus feats Alertness, Dodge, and Exotic Weapon Proficiency (katana). Improved Initiative, Improved Unarmed Strike, Iron Will. Land (Rokushima Táiyoo). Solitary. Double standard treasure, 50% art objects. Always lawful evil. Advances at 11–20 HD (Medium), subject to Willow Heart.
description: A well-dressed predator marked by a crescent-shaped mole. Its grove of weeping willows holds the people it has transformed.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Unarmed strike +11 melee (1d3+4 lethal or nonlethal), katana +11 melee (1d10+4, threat 19–20), or mighty longbow +10 ranged (1d8+3, ×3 critical).
Full attack. One unarmed strike +11, katana +11/+6, or longbow +10/+5. Use the attack damage above.
sections.Supernatural abilities:
Euphoria (Su). After at least a week of courtship and a successful Bluff (seduction) check, the woman makes a DC 20 Will save. Failure charms her as charm person (caster level 10th). She gains a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls and ability and skill checks near the kizoku, or takes a −2 morale penalty on those rolls when it is absent. This ends when the kizoku is destroyed or break enchantment dispels it.
Willow Heart (Su). After at least a month courting a euphoric woman and leading her to commit major betrayal or murder, the kizoku can offer a draining kiss. A failed DC 20 Will save lets it drain her life and turn her into a weeping willow as polymorph any object (caster level 10th). Ravenloft Innocents are immune to this death effect. While the kizoku lives, reversing the transformation leaves an inert body unless miracle, wish, or true resurrection restores the victim. After its death she can be restored normally, except that a victim whose tree provided the killing weapon still requires one of those three spells. The kizoku learns the languages spoken by those it drains and advances one Hit Die per four levels drained through this power.
sections.Spell-like abilities: Caster level 10th, save DC 15 + spell level. At will: fly. 1/day each: alter self, calm emotions, charm person, color spray, command, confusion, crushing despair, daze, detect scrying, dimension door, disguise self, displacement, enthrall, gaseous form, hold person, hypnotism, invisibility, mind fog, mislead, rage, slow, and suggestion.
sections.Defenses and weakness: DR 10/magic, low-light vision, regeneration 1, spell resistance 13. Its regeneration converts damage from ordinary attacks to nonlethal damage. Someone who truly loved a victim can identify her willow with a DC 20 Wisdom check. A weapon made from that willow’s heartwood deals lethal damage when used by that person. If they land the killing blow, the kizoku dies permanently and the stolen souls return to their owners. The kizoku normally tries to escape with its spells when threatened.

ruleNotes: The book gives no touch or flat-footed AC totals. Standard 3.5 defaults from the listed components are touch 13 and flat-footed 14 without applying Dodge. The full-attack line lists one unarmed strike despite the weapon attacks having iterative bonuses.

name: Tentacle Rat
otherStatistics: Initiative +3. AC 14 (+1 size, +3 Dex), touch 14, flat-footed 11. Base attack +0, grapple +4. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +2, Ref +5, Will +3. Balance +6, Climb +10, Hide +8, Move Silently +5. Dodge, Weapon Finesse. Underground (Markovia). Group of 10–30. No treasure. Always neutral evil.
description: A bipedal rat with spined tentacles instead of forelimbs. Groups use their tentacles to immobilize prey.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Tentacle +4 melee (1d3 plus paralysis).
Full attack. Two tentacles +4 melee (1d3 plus paralysis each) and bite −1 melee (1d4).
Paralysis (Ex). Each tentacle hit requires a DC 12 Fortitude save or the target is paralyzed for 1d6+2 minutes.
sections.Traits and tactics: Darkvision 60 ft. and scent. It usually attacks only if threatened, cornered, or hunting in a pack.

ruleNotes: The grappling line explicitly gives +4 despite the creature’s Small size and Str 10. The print uses swarm as an organization label, with an individual Small aberration stat block.

name: Goblyn
otherStatistics: Initiative +3. AC 15 (+3 Dex, +2 natural), touch 13, flat-footed 12. Base attack +3, grapple +5. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +3, Ref +7, Will +4. Climb +10, Hide +8, Listen +3, Move Silently +10, Spot +3. Endurance, Multiattack. Any land or underground. Solitary, gang (2–5), or pack (7–12). No treasure. Always neutral evil. Advances at 5–6 HD (Medium).
description: Magic reshaped this humanoid into a tireless guard. It shares its creator’s orders telepathically with other goblyns.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +5 melee (1d4+2).
Full attack. Two claws +5 melee (1d4+2 each) and bite +3 melee (1d6+2).
Improved Grab (Ex). If both claws hit a Huge or smaller creature, attempt to start a grapple as a free action without provoking an attack of opportunity.
Feasting (Ex). Starting on the round after taking hold, the goblyn can bite the held creature. A successful feasting bite grants a +4 circumstance bonus on opposed grapple checks to keep its hold that round. For each 10 HP lost to its feasting bites, the victim makes a DC 12 Fortitude save. Failure adds 1 to the victim’s Ravenloft Outcast Rating from facial scarring. Regenerate removes the scarring penalties.
Startle (Ex). The first time a foe encounters a goblyn in combat, it makes a DC 13 Ravenloft Fear save (Will) or is stunned for one round.
sections.Traits and tactics: Darkvision 90 ft., immunity to sleep and mind-affecting effects, spell resistance 10. Controlled (Su). Each goblyn has a telepathic bond with its creator and with every other goblyn controlled by the same creator. They coordinate ambushes and initiate combat only when ordered.

name: Bloodrose
description: A patch of white roses lashes at passersby. Its petals turn red as its roots feed.
otherStatistics: Any temperate land. Patch of 3–10, one bush per 5-ft. square. Always neutral. Standard treasure.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +0. AC includes +1 size, touch 11, flat-footed 11. Base attack and grapple +0. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +2, Ref +0, Will +2.
sections.Traits:
Plant traits and DR 10/bludgeoning or magic. Tremorsense locates creatures and objects touching the ground within 30 ft.
Camouflage (Ex). Spot, Survival, or Knowledge (plants or herbs) DC 20 to notice it before it attacks.
Vulnerability to Salt (Ex). A gallon of salt water deals 1d10 damage. After it hits a salt-coated target, the bush recognizes the salt and leaves that target alone.
sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. One thorny lash +0 melee (1d3) per bush.
Entangle (Ex). As a free action, the bush entangles foes in every square it can reach, as entangle at caster level 3rd. Reflex DC 12 resists.

name: Fearweed
description: This milkweed look-alike feeds when its hallucination-inducing pollen turns travelers against one another.
otherStatistics: Any land. Patch of 11–20. Always neutral. Standard treasure.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +0. AC includes +2 size, touch and flat-footed 12. Base attack and grapple +0. Space 2½ ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +5, Ref +0, Will −1.
sections.Traits: Plant traits. Tremorsense locates creatures and objects touching the ground within 60 ft. Camouflage (Ex). Spot, Survival, or Knowledge (plants or herbs) DC 20 to identify the plant before it attacks.
sections.Actions:
No ordinary attack.
Fear Pollen (Su, 1/day). Movement within 20 ft. triggers a 20-ft.-radius cloud centered on the plant. It lasts 1d3 minutes. Each round in the cloud, make a DC 13 Fortitude save or suffer paranoia and threatening hallucinations for 1d4 minutes. If an affected victim dies or falls unconscious, each of that victim's companions can make another Fortitude save. Success restores control, with a −2 penalty on attacks, checks, and saves for the remaining duration. Immunity to poison or mind-affecting effects prevents this effect. Neutralize poison ends it.

ruleNotes: The second Fortitude save has no separate DC in print. Use the initial DC 13 for that save.

name: Lashweed
description: This black-stemmed hunter uses a low drumming sound to find prey and draw other lashweeds into the fight.
otherStatistics: Temperate and warm plains, forests, hills, and marshes. Patch of 5–20, usually spaced 20–30 ft. apart. Usually neutral. Standard treasure. Advancement 5–8 HD (Huge).

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +1. AC components −1 size, +1 Dex, and +4 natural. Touch 10, flat-footed 14. Base attack +3, grapple +11. Space 5 ft., reach 10 ft. Fort +7, Ref +2, Will +3.
sections.Traits: Plant traits. Tremorsense 20 ft., or 60 ft. while thrumming. Woodland Stride (Ex). Ordinary overgrowth, thorns, and briars do not impede or injure it. Magically altered growth still affects it.
sections.Skills: Hide −3, Move Silently +1. Add +10 racial to Hide in overgrowth and apply −10 racial to Move Silently while thrumming.
sections.Actions:
Attack. Whip +7 melee (1d4 + 4). Full attack. Four whips +7, each for 1d4 + 4.
Entangle (Sp, 3/day). As entangle at caster level 3rd. Reflex DC 13 avoids entanglement.
Spray Poison (Ex). Once every 3 hours, a 10-ft. cone delivers contact poison, Fort DC 15. Both its initial and secondary effects blind for 1d4 days.

ruleNotes: The AC 13, flat-footed AC 14, and 5-ft. space are printed as shown, despite the listed AC modifiers and Large size.

name: Quickwood
description: An oak with a face in its bark can spy through the surrounding grove. It drags prey toward its trunk with roots that reach far beyond its branches.
otherStatistics: Any forest. Solitary or pair. Usually neutral. Standard treasure. Speaks Sylvan and may know other languages. Advancement 9–16 HD (Huge), 17–21 HD (Gargantuan).

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative −2. AC components −2 size, −2 Dex, and +13 natural. Touch 6, flat-footed 21. Base attack +6, grapple +17. Space 10 ft., reach 5 ft. or up to 90 ft. with roots. Fort +11, Ref +0, Will +4.
sections.Traits:
Plant traits, DR 10/bludgeoning or slashing, electricity resistance 20, and fire resistance 20. Camouflage (Ex). Spot, Survival, or Knowledge (plants or herbs) DC 16 to identify it before it attacks. The stat line lists blindsight 120 ft. The dedicated trait gives 60 ft. for sensing corporeal objects and creatures, in addition to normal sight.
A distressed quickwood can drum loudly enough to be heard a mile or farther.
sections.Skills: Hide −8, Intimidate +10, Listen +12, Sense Motive +11, Spot +12, Survival +12. Add +18 racial to Hide in a forest.
sections.Actions:
Attack. Slam +17 melee (1d6 + 11). Full attack. Eight slams +17, each for 1d6 + 11. It can attack with one root per HD. Roots extend 30 ft. each round, to a maximum of 90 ft. Each root is Medium, AC 15, with 8 HP tracked separately. It withdraws every root when half are severed.
Improved Grab and Constrict (Ex). A root slam hit allows a grapple. A successful grapple check deals 1d6 + 11 constriction damage to a Medium or smaller foe. Pull grappled foes 30 ft. per round toward the trunk. It can bite an adjacent grappled target once each round at +10 melee (1d4 + 5).
Animate Trees (Sp, at will). Control up to four normal oaks within 180 ft. Each spends a full round uprooting itself, then moves at speed 10 ft. and fights as a 3.5 treant. A tree stops moving if the quickwood is incapacitated or leaves range. As a standard action it can scry through oaks out to 1 mile. Otherwise use liveoak at caster level 12th.
Channel Fear (Su). As a free action when directly targeted by a spell, the quickwood can force all creatures within 45 ft. to make a DC 15 Ravenloft Fear save or become panicked. The spell is lost if its caster fails this save. It resolves normally if the caster succeeds or is outside the radius.

ruleNotes: The printed blindsight distances conflict. Use the dedicated trait's 60-ft. range for corporeal detection. Printed hit points and grapple bonus are retained.

name: Moor Man
description: A marsh hunter lies under the mud until dark. The first glimpse of one is often the tattoo that helps it spring the ambush.
otherStatistics: Temperate marsh. Gang of 4–9, hunting party of 5–12, or tribe of 10–30 with a 4th-level shaman and 4th–6th-level leader. Usually chaotic evil. Standard treasure.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +5. AC includes +1 Dex and +2 natural, touch 11, flat-footed 12. Base attack +4, grapple +6. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +6, Ref +2, Will +2.
sections.Traits: Darkvision 150 ft. Light Blindness (Ex). Bright sunlight or daylight blinds it. Abrupt exposure to bright light also triggers a DC 14 Ravenloft Fear save.
sections.Skills and feats: Hide +4, Listen +2, Move Silently +3, Spot +4. Dodge and Improved Initiative.
sections.Actions: Attack or full attack. Short sword +6 melee (1d6 + 2) or shortbow +1 ranged (1d6, critical ×3).
sections.Tattoos (Su):
Wear one magical tattoo at a time, effective for one day before reapplication.
Axe and sword. Frenzy grants one extra attack each round and temporary HP equal to current HP. These disappear when combat ends. If it took more damage than its ordinary HP, it is mortally wounded and only realizes it at the end of the fight.
Bedazzlement. A creature within 30 ft. that sees the design makes a DC 12 Will save or is affected by hypnotic pattern at caster level 6th. Moor men are immune.
Death mask. Ignore the first successful attack against it each round.
Flower. Reroll one die roll per round.
Shield. +2 luck to AC and all saves.
Veil of darkness. Ignore bright-light effects, including Light Blindness.
sections.Fear save: Use Will against DC 14 with applicable modifiers. Failure by 1–5 leaves the target shaken, 6–10 frightened, and 11 or more panicked. The fear lasts 5d6 rounds. Failure by 16 or more also calls for a Horror save at DC 9. A new failed Fear save escalates an existing fear effect one step. See Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, pp. 77–79.

ruleNotes: The source prints the shortbow at +1 in both attack lines. Use the printed bonus.

name: Paka
description: A paka passes for human and can use a nearby cat as its eyes and ears. Its true form has slit pupils, whiskers, and a long tail.
otherStatistics: Temperate forests and hills. Solitary, pair, or pride of 4–12. Always chaotic evil. Double standard treasure. Speaks Aumes and often local domain languages.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +5. AC includes +5 Dex and +1 natural, touch 15, flat-footed 11. Base attack +3, grapple +2. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +3, Ref +10, Will +3.
sections.Traits: Scent and SR 14. Canine Antipathy (Su). Apply a −5 racial penalty to Charisma-based skill checks involving canines, including werewolves and wolfweres, in any form.
sections.Skills and feats: Balance +14, Bluff +7, Climb +10, Jump +8, Listen +6, Move Silently +14, Tumble +6. This includes +4 racial on Balance and Move Silently. Use Dex for Climb. Dodge, Lightning Reflexes, Mobility, and bonus Weapon Finesse.
sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw or rapier +7 melee (1d6 − 1). Full attack. Two claws +7 melee or one rapier +7 melee (1d6 − 1). See the note for full-attack claw damage.
Feline Allies (Su). As a standard action, bond telepathically with a feline animal within 50 ft. As a free action, perceive through it and direct its actions. The bond breaks beyond 50 ft.
Lick Wounds (Ex). Heal 1 HP as a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity. The daily pool is 2 HP per HD, split among recipients.
Pounce (Ex). A charge allows a full attack.

ruleNotes: The full-attack claw damage reads 1d6 − 6, while the single claw and rapier do 1d6 − 1. Use 1d6 − 1 for both claws as a table ruling. The stat line lists Feline Empathy without a separate procedure. Use Feline Allies for its defined feline interaction.

name: Quevari
description: A village may offer weary travelers a bed for the night. The three nights of the full moon bring a change most Quevari forget afterward.
otherStatistics: Any land. Solitary, pair, family of 2–5, or village of 20–40 plus as many noncombatants and a 3rd-level adept. Usually lawful good outside the bloodmoon and always lawful evil during it. Standard treasure. Speaks Quevari and usually one or two additional languages.

sections.Combat statistics: Pacifistic form. Initiative +4, touch and flat-footed AC 10. Base attack and grapple +0. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +1, Ref +2, Will +0.
sections.Skills and feats: Climb +14, Hide +10, Listen +8, Move Silently +10. Improved Initiative. During the bloodmoon also use Blind-Fight and Weapon Finesse with familiar melee weapons.
sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack in pacifistic form. Unarmed strike +0 melee (1d3 nonlethal) before the −2 morale penalty that applies to all attack rolls in this form. The Quevari fights only to defend itself.
Attack or full attack during the bloodmoon. Sickle +2 melee (1d6) or sling +5 ranged (1d4).
sections.Bloodmoon (Ex): On the three nights of the full moon, set Dex to 16 and Ref to +5. Use the bracketed printed AC 15, touch 13, flat-footed 12. Witnesses to the change may require a DC 15 Ravenloft Horror save. Unfamiliar melee weapons such as polearms and warhammers do not benefit from Weapon Finesse.
sections.Horror save: Use Will against DC 15 with applicable modifiers. Failure by 1–5 gives a minor Horror effect, 6–10 a moderate one, and 11 or more a major one. Roll 1d4 on the corresponding Horror table. Failure by 16 or more also calls for an immediate DC 10 Madness save. See Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, pp. 77–83.

ruleNotes: The Bloodmoon prose says natural armor increases by +3. The printed bracketed stat line shows +2 natural armor. This profile uses the bracketed total and derived printed ACs.

name: Subdweller
description: Packs of clawed tunnel dwellers charge intruders on sight. Bright light is the easiest way to interrupt an ambush.
otherStatistics: Any underground. Gang of 4–10. Usually chaotic evil. Standard treasure. Advancement 3–4 HD (Medium).

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +2. AC includes +2 Dex, touch 12, flat-footed 10. Base attack +1, grapple +3. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +4, Ref +2, Will −1.
sections.Traits: Darkvision 60 ft. Sensitivity to Light (Ex). Bright sunlight or daylight blinds it.
sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +3 melee (1d3 + 2). Full attack. Two claws +3, each dealing 1d3 + 2.
Rage (Ex). Immediately on first contact with opponents, gain +2 Str, +2 Con, and −2 AC. The frenzy lasts a number of rounds equal to the improved Con modifier, 3 rounds in this profile. Then the ability scores and AC return to normal.

name: Bussengeist
otherStatistics: Printed 2nd-level human commoner example. Initiative +2. AC 12 (+2 Dex), touch 12, flat-footed 10. Base attack +1, grapple +1. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +0, Ref +2, Will +0. Hide +10, Listen +10, Profession +7, Search +8, Spot +11. Lightning Reflexes, Skill Focus (Profession). No treasure. Any land or underground. Solitary. Any alignment.
description: This wandering geist appears where a tragedy like the one it helped cause is about to occur. Its mourning begins 1d6 days before disaster.

sections.Actions:
No physical attack.
Aura of Despair (Sp). Creatures within 120 ft. make a DC 10 Will save. On a failure they take a −2 morale penalty to saves, attack rolls, ability checks, skill checks, and weapon damage rolls until they leave the aura. A success grants immunity to this geist’s aura for 24 hours.
Mind Games (Su). As a free action, project an image of itself to living creatures within 30 ft. Use major image as a phantasm. A DC 10 Will save prevents perception of the image. The sight may also call for a Horror save if its death was particularly gruesome.
sections.Traits: Undead and incorporeal traits. It remains in the Near Ethereal and cannot manifest. On the Material Plane it is intangible and normally invisible. It ignores damage from corporeal sources. If destroyed, it returns until its unfinished business is resolved.

ruleNotes: The book prints one common Geist stat block. This encounter uses its numbers with the Bussengeist’s listed powers and omits the bound geist’s +4 turn resistance. The two DCs come from the printed geist formula.

name: Poltergeist
otherStatistics: Printed 2nd-level human commoner example. Initiative +2. AC 12 (+2 Dex), touch 12, flat-footed 10. Base attack +1, grapple +1. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +0, Ref +2, Will +0. Hide +10, Listen +10, Profession +7, Search +8, Spot +11. Lightning Reflexes, Skill Focus (Profession). No treasure. Any land or underground. Solitary. Any alignment.
description: This bound geist haunts the site of a violent death and hurls furnishings to drive the living away.

sections.Actions:
No physical attack.
Telekinesis (Su). Once per round as a free action, use telekinesis as a sorcerer of level equal to its HD or 12, whichever is higher. It can only move objects at or below its Charisma score in weight. For this example, use caster level 12 and a 9-lb. limit per object.
sections.Traits: Undead and incorporeal traits. It remains in the Near Ethereal and cannot manifest. On the Material Plane it is intangible and normally invisible. It ignores damage from corporeal sources. If destroyed, it returns until its unfinished business is resolved. It cannot leave its haunting grounds. It has +4 turn resistance and cowers if turned.

ruleNotes: The book prints one common Geist stat block. This encounter uses its numbers with Poltergeist Telekinesis. The printed weight cap has no unit. Use pounds at the table.

name: Pyroskeleton
otherStatistics: Initiative +5. AC 16 (−1 size, +1 Dex, +6 natural), touch 10, flat-footed 15. Base attack +2, grapple +6. Space 5 ft., reach 10 ft. Fort +1, Ref +2, Will +4. Alertness, Improved Initiative. Any land or underground. Any organization. No treasure. Always neutral. Advancement 6–15 HD (Huge), 16–25 HD (Gargantuan).
description: A towering skeleton burns from within with blue fire. Its flames can shrink to a candle-sized flicker when it has stood idle for 48 hours.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +6 melee (1d6+4).
Full attack. Two claws +5 melee (1d6+4 each) or huge scythe +7 melee (2d6+6).
Fireball (Su), 1/hour. Cast an 8d6 fireball, Reflex DC 14 half.
Keen Edge (Su). Its flame applies keen edge to slashing weapons it holds. A nonmagical weapon it holds slowly becomes a huge bone scythe over a few months. This power leaves the claw attacks unchanged.
sections.Traits: Undead traits. Immune to fire. DR 5/bludgeoning. Cold damage bypasses its DR. On a failed save against a cold-based effect, it takes half damage. It follows simple orders and cannot coordinate flanking.

ruleNotes: The printed 5-ft. space and +6 single claw versus +5 full-attack claws are retained. The cold rule specifies damage on a failed save only.

name: Strahd Skeleton
otherStatistics: Initiative +6. AC 13 (−1 size, +1 Dex, +3 natural), touch 10, flat-footed 12. Base attack +2, grapple +3. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +3, Ref +2, Will +4. Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative. Any land (Barovia). Any organization. No treasure. Always neutral. Advancement 5–10 HD (Huge), as printed.
description: Strahd’s skeletal infantry rise again after they fall. They can see invisible creatures before those creatures get close enough to strike.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +3 melee (1d4+1) or use a weapon and its corresponding combat stats.
Full attack. Two claws +3 melee (1d4+1 each) or its printed weapon alternative.
sections.Traits:
Undead traits, cold immunity, DR 5/bludgeoning, spell resistance 15, +4 turn resistance.
Relentless (Ex). At 0 HP or below, it falls helpless and starts regaining 1 HP per round. It resumes attacking at full HP. Destroy it by turning strong enough to destroy it, disintegrate, or a coup de grace while it lies helpless. For this skeleton, a coup de grace bypasses undead immunity to critical hits. Severed limbs creep back and reattach.
Vigilant (Su). Continuous see invisibility, out to 60 ft.

ruleNotes: The printed AC breakdown uses a −1 size modifier despite the Medium size and gives +1 Dex with Dex 14. The printed speed lists both 30 ft. and 5 squares. Use 30 ft. and the listed ACs at the table.

name: Strahd’s Skeletal Steed
otherStatistics: Initiative +6. AC 13 (−1 size, +1 Dex, +3 natural), touch 10, flat-footed 12. Base attack +2, grapple +6. Space 10 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +3, Ref +2, Will +4. Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative. Any land (Barovia). Solitary or units of four. No treasure. Always neutral. Advancement 5–10 HD (Huge).
description: The remains of a heavy warhorse stand motionless until Strahd sends them to fetch someone. Their gait sounds like bones cracking.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Hoof +6 melee (1d6+4) and bite +0 melee (1d4+2), as printed.
Full attack. Two hooves +6 melee (1d6+4 each) and bite +0 melee (1d4+2).
Breath Weapon (Su), every other round. Affect one adjacent square with stinking cloud, Reflex DC 12 negates. The steed can use its breath weapon while biting.
sections.Traits: Undead traits, cold immunity, DR 5/bludgeoning, +4 turn resistance, and scent.

ruleNotes: The single Attack line lists the hoof and bite together. The breath uses the printed Reflex save instead of the spell’s usual Fortitude save. The source gives no caster level for the breath.

name: Strahd Zombie
otherStatistics: Initiative −1. AC 11 (−1 Dex, +2 natural), touch 9, flat-footed 11. Base attack +1, grapple +2. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +2, Ref −1, Will +3. Great Fortitude, Toughness. Any terrain (Barovia). Gangs of 2–5, squads of 6–10, or mobs of 11–20. No treasure. Always neutral.
description: These former Barovian guards still march in formation when their master calls. They follow simple orders without speaking.

sections.Actions: Attack or full attack. Slam +2 melee (1d6+1). It can take only one move or attack action each round. It may move and attack as a charge if it has a clear path and starts within its speed.
sections.Traits:
Undead traits, darkvision 60 ft., spell resistance 15, +4 turn resistance.
Relentless (Ex). At 0 HP or below, it falls helpless and starts regaining 1 HP per round. It resumes attacking at full HP. Destroy it by turning strong enough to destroy it, disintegrate, or a coup de grace while it lies helpless.
Vigilant (Su). Continuous see invisibility, out to 60 ft.

ruleNotes: The format lists AC 11 both normally and flat-footed despite the negative Dexterity modifier. The listed totals are retained. The printed Strahd Zombie column does not grant damage reduction.

name: Spirit Waif
otherStatistics: Initiative +0. AC 13 (+1 size, +1 Dex, +1 deflection), touch 13, flat-footed 12. Base attack +0, grapple −4. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +0, Ref +3, Will +3. Hide +10, Listen +6, Sense Motive +7, Spot +6. Lightning Reflexes. Any land or underground. Solitary. No treasure. Usually neutral good.
description: The ghost of a murdered child tries to bring kindly travelers to its bones, unaware that a dangerous creature may now lair there.

sections.Actions:
No attack. If attacked, it flees through a wall or floor and refuses further help to the attacker.
Sympathy (Su). It uses Sense Motive to find a kind or virtuous living creature, then reveals itself and tries to lead it to its remains. Any creature that sees the waif makes a DC 11 Will save or follows it as if affected by charm person from a 1st-level sorcerer.
sections.Traits:
Undead and incorporeal traits.
Rejuvenation (Su). If destroyed, it reforms in 2d4 days. Give its bones a traditional burial to lay it to rest.

ruleNotes: Use initiative +0, as printed, even though the printed Dexterity and AC breakdown suggest +1.

name: Undead Cloaker
otherStatistics: Initiative +7. AC 21 (printed breakdown −1 size, +3 Dex, +7 natural), touch 12, flat-footed 16. Base attack +2. Space 10 ft., reach 10 ft. (5 ft. with bite). Fort unlisted, Ref +5, Will +7. Hide +12, Listen +11, Spot +11. Alertness, Improved Initiative. Underground. Solitary. Standard treasure. Always chaotic evil. Advancement 6–8 HD (Large), 9–16 HD (Huge).
description: This ragged, foul-smelling cloaker rides a living host until it can drain another victim. It keeps a dead host as a puppet.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Tail slap +8 melee (1d6+5).
Full attack. Tail slap +8 melee (1d6+5) and bite +3 melee (1d4+2). It can use its tail on other creatures while engulfing.
Attach (Su). After engulfing a human-shaped creature at least one size smaller, it attempts to bite. A hit attaches the cloaker, which can allow the host to move freely after it stops struggling. It loses its bite while attached. Death ward protects a creature against attachment and removes an attached cloaker. The cloaker also detaches if it is destroyed or successfully turned.
Forcible removal. Use the Attach procedure: another character makes a DC 15 Strength check to tear the cloaker free. On success the host gains 1d4 negative levels. The cloaker survives and follows its hostless rules.
Energy Drain (Su). When the host touches a living creature, that creature gains 1 negative level. Use a touch attack if the target resists. If the host touches no living creature over 24 hours, the cloaker instead gives the host 1 negative level. Fortitude DC 14 removes each negative level at the normal recovery check.
Create Spawn (Su). A humanoid killed by the drain rises in 24 hours as a zombie without its living abilities. Zombies remain controlled until the cloaker dies. It stays attached to a dead host and controls that host once it rises.
sections.Traits: Undead traits and DR 10/magic. Without a host it loses 1 HD each week until destroyed. Once it attaches, it regains 1 HD for each day it feeds.

ruleNotes: The printed AC breakdown adds to 19, but the total is 21. Use the printed total, touch, and flat-footed values. The stat block omits grapple and Fortitude. If needed, the standard 3.5 statistics yield grapple +11 and Fortitude +1 against effects that apply to undead. The combat paragraph requires DC 17 and says removal kills the cloaker. The detailed Attach ability instead specifies DC 15 and provides rules for a hostless cloaker. Use the Attach procedure as a table ruling.

name: Alecto
description: The Fury called the Implacable uses divine magic to drive penitents back to their old ways.
otherStatistics: Any land or underground. Triune with her sisters. Always lawful evil. No treasure or level adjustment. Advances as a cleric.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +3. AC +3 Dex, +2 natural. Touch 13, flat-footed 12. Base attack +10, grapple +11. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +8, Ref +9, Will +10.
sections.Skills and feats: Bluff +12, Diplomacy +12, Gather Information +12, Intimidate +15, Knowledge (Ravenloft) +12, Listen +14, Search +15, Sense Motive +15, Spot +12. Alertness, Exotic Weapon Proficiency, Flyby Attack, Multiattack.
sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +11 melee for 1d4 + 1, or +3 scourge of foolishness +16 ranged for 1d4 + 4 and Wisdom damage.
Full attack. Two claws +11 melee for 1d4 + 1 each, or the same scourge strike.
Scourge of foolishness. A strike deals 1d3 Wisdom damage unless the target succeeds on a DC 13 Will save.
See Fury shared rules for Rake and Breath Weapon.
sections.Spellcasting: Casts as a 10th-level cleric. Save DC 13 + spell level. Domains: Death, Destruction, Evil, Fire, Knowledge, Trickery and War. Preferred spells: burning hands, cause light wounds, charm person, clairaudience, death knell, dispel good, dispel magic, divination, divine power and protection from good. The book leaves her preparations open.

ruleNotes: The stat block calls the scourge’s effect Wisdom drain and gives a ranged attack, while the combat text calls the effect Wisdom damage and the shared rules treat scourges as whips. Use the printed attack bonus and the specific Wisdom-damage procedure. The attack line calls it scourge of fools. The listed Dexterity score also differs from the Dexterity bonus printed in AC.

name: Megaera
description: The Fury called the Disputatious brings arcane magic to the trio’s hunt.
otherStatistics: Any land or underground. Triune with her sisters. Always lawful evil. No treasure or level adjustment. Advances as a sorcerer.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +3. AC +3 Dex, +2 natural. Touch 13, flat-footed 12. Printed base attack +3 and grapple +3. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +8, Ref +9, Will +9.
sections.Skills and feats: Bluff +18, Concentration +15, Diplomacy +19, Gather Information +17, Intimidate +15, Knowledge (arcana) +16, Listen +15, Move Silently +12, Spellcraft +15, Spot +15. Alertness, Exotic Weapon Proficiency, Flyby Attack, Multiattack.
sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +10 melee for 1d4, or +3 scourge of idiocy +11 melee for 1d4 + 3 and Intelligence damage.
Full attack. Two claws +10 melee for 1d4 each, or the same scourge strike.
Scourge of idiocy. A strike deals 1d3 Intelligence damage unless the target succeeds on a DC 15 Will save.
See Fury shared rules for Rake and Breath Weapon.
sections.Spellcasting:
Casts as a 10th-level sorcerer. Save DC 12 + spell level. Printed spells per day by level 0–5: 6/7/7/6/5/3.
0: daze, dancing lights, detect magic, detect poison, disrupt undead, flare, light, ray of frost, resistance.
1st: cause fear, chill touch, color spray, hold portal, magic missile.
2nd: darkness, flaming sphere, protection from arrows, web.
3rd: dispel magic, lightning bolt, stinking cloud.
4th: lesser globe of invulnerability. The book also lists polymorph any object here.
5th: cone of cold.

ruleNotes: The book spells her name Megarea. The single Attack line appears to print 1d4 + 5 scourge damage, while the Full Attack line gives 1d4 + 3. Use 1d4 + 3 in both. Her weapon line calls its effect Intelligence drain, while the combat prose gives Intelligence damage. Use the latter. The listed +3 base attack and +3 grapple are preserved despite her 10 outsider HD.

The book lists polymorph any object as a 4th-level spell, but in 3.5 it is an 8th-level sorcerer spell. Omit it unless the table deliberately adopts the printed exception. The school restriction in the prose also conflicts with the printed spells known.

name: Tisiphone
description: The Fury called the Avenger closes in with claws and a scourge that saps strength.
otherStatistics: Any land or underground. Triune with her sisters. Always lawful evil. No treasure or level adjustment. Advances as a fighter. The text describes her as having the combat prowess of a 10th-level fighter.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +7. AC +3 Dex, +2 natural. Touch 13, flat-footed 12. Base attack +10, printed grapple +1. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +8, Ref +5, Will +4.
sections.Skills and feats: Bluff +13, Diplomacy +12, Gather Information +13, Intimidate +14, Listen +13, Sense Motive +13, Spot +13. Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Exotic Weapon Proficiency, Flyby Attack.
sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +13 melee for 1d4 + 3, bite +11 melee for 1d4 + 3, or +3 scourge of weakness +16 ranged for 1d4 + 8 and Strength damage.
Full attack as printed. Two claws +13 melee for 1d4 + 3 each, one bite +11 melee for 1d4 + 3, or one scourge strike. The prose allows a mixed round. For a mixed full attack, substitute one scourge strike for one claw.
Scourge of weakness. A strike deals 1d3 Strength damage unless the target succeeds on a DC 15 Fortitude save.
See Fury shared rules for Rake and Breath Weapon.

ruleNotes: The full-attack line presents the attack modes as alternatives, but the prose allows her to use her scourge and claws in the same round without specifying a routine. The mixed full attack is a table ruling. The stat line calls the scourge rider Strength drain. The combat prose supplies Strength damage and the save. The printed grapple +1 and Hit Dice formula are retained.

name: Sea Spawn Minion
speed: 10 ft. (2 squares), climb 5 ft., swim 10 ft.
description: A six-inch slug slips ashore and takes over a host so its master can feed on the coastal village.
otherStatistics: Any aquatic environment. Brood of 3–18. Always lawful evil. No treasure, advancement or level adjustment.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +9. AC +4 size, +5 Dex. Touch 19, flat-footed 14. Base attack +0, grapple −17. Space 1 ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +1, Ref +5, Will +2.
sections.Skills and feats: Hide +23, Move Silently +11. Improved Initiative.
sections.Traits:
Amphibious (Ex). Outside both water and a suitable host it survives 1 hour per point of Constitution (12 hours for this stat block), then uses the drowning rules.
Telepathy (Su). The master that spawned it has a telepathic link to the minion. If the minion or its host is threatened, the master can call other minions or hosts in the area to help.
sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Bite +0 melee for 1 damage (printed 1d3 − 5, minimum 1) and poison. A DC 11 Fortitude save prevents paralysis for 2d6 minutes. No secondary damage.
Control Host (Ex). As a full-round action, enter a paralyzed victim’s skull. The host makes a DC 16 Will save each round until it fails or the minion is removed. On failure, the minion takes control. The host retains memories, statistics and abilities except divinely granted powers. While implanted, apply a −4 competence penalty to Charisma-based skill checks and 1 Intelligence drain per day. At Intelligence 0, the host dies.
Removal. Cure disease or restoration expels the minion, dealing 3d6 damage to the host as it emerges. Greater restoration destroys it without harming the host.
sections.Running the encounter: A master releases 3d6 minions nightly near shore during an invasion. About one in ten reaches land. Minions climb walls and ceilings and drop onto victims. A typical host is a 1st-level human commoner whose personality becomes detached and distant.

name: Marikith Hunter
description: A rubbery black hunter slips through drains and barred openings. Packs lure prey with copies of their voices.
otherStatistics: Any underground environment in Timor. Pairs, packs of 2–8 or swarms of 2–20. Always lawful evil. No treasure or level adjustment. Advancement 4–5 HD (Medium).

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +8. AC +4 Dex, +3 natural. Touch 14, flat-footed 13. Base attack +2, printed grapple +3. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +2, Ref +5, Will +5.
sections.Skills and feats: Escape Artist +16, Hide +12, Listen +6, Move Silently +12, Spot +4. Improved Initiative. Racial bonuses: +8 Escape Artist, +4 Hide and Move Silently.
sections.Traits:
Darkvision 120 ft. Takes half damage from bludgeoning weapons and is immune to fear, horror and madness. Hunters are under the influence of their queen.
Light Sensitivity (Ex). Attack rolls take −1 in candlelight or starlight, −2 in torchlight, and −4 in bright sunlight or within a daylight spell.
sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +5 melee for 1d4 + 3.
Full attack. Two claws +5 melee for 1d4 + 3 each and bite +0 melee for 2d4 + 3.
Compression (Ex). While moving, pass through a gap at least 1 ft. across as a free action. A gap 7–11 inches across takes a move action. A gap 3–6 inches across takes a full-round action. Smaller gaps are impassable.
Voice Mimicry (Ex). The hunter has no true language but can imitate voices and sounds. Resolve deception with its Bluff check at a +8 racial bonus opposed by the listener’s Listen check.
sections.Running the encounter: Hunters torment prey before striking. Outside the hive they hunt in small packs. In the hive the first wave has two or three hunters, and each later wave grows until the intruders are outnumbered at least ten to one.

ruleNotes: The single-attack line omits claw damage, so use the matching claw damage in Full Attack. The printed grapple modifier is +3 even though the printed base attack and Strength yield +5 under the usual calculation.

name: Razorback
otherStatistics: Initiative +3. AC components +1 size, +3 Dex, +5 natural. Touch 14, flat-footed 16. Base attack +1, grapple −2. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +6, Will +1.
description: This low-slung plains hunter runs beneath its prey and cuts it with the raised spines along its back.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Rake +3 melee for 1d8 + 1 and wounding.
Full attack. Use the same rake, or make two claws at −2 melee for 1d4 each and a bite at −2 melee for 1d6 + 1.
Rake on a charge. Target a creature from Medium through Huge (long). Add the usual +2 charge bonus to the printed attack. The razorback can pass through the target’s square without provoking from that movement and can continue up to a total of double its speed.
Wounding (Ex). Each spine wound deals 1 HP of bleeding damage per round. Bleeding from multiple wounds stacks. A DC 15 Heal check or any healing magic stops it. Creatures immune to critical hits are immune to this bleeding.
sections.Traits: Scent. Packs usually each choose a target, but they may charge one large foe in succession and follow it while it bleeds.
sections.Skills: Hide +8, Listen +5, Move Silently +7, Spot +5. Racial bonuses are +4 to Hide and Move Silently. The Hide racial bonus increases to +8 in tall grass or heavy undergrowth.
sections.Encounter details: Temperate or warm plains. Solitary, pair, or pack of 2–8. Always neutral. No treasure. Advancement 3–5 HD Small, then 6–8 HD Medium.

name: Chiang Shi
otherStatistics: Fledgling sample, 5th-level human monk. Initiative +8. AC components +4 Dex, +3 Wis, +1 monk, +6 natural, +1 armor. Touch 18, flat-footed 17. Base attack +5, grapple +10. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +10, Will +7.
description: This fledgling was a human monk. It can levitate toward a target, paralyze them with a look, or vanish before approaching.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +10 melee for 1d4 + 5 and energy drain, +1 kama +13 melee for 1d6 + 6, or masterwork sling +8 ranged for 1d4.
Full attack. Two of the listed claws, one listed kama attack, or one listed sling attack.
Mesmerism (Su). Standard action against one target within 30 ft. who meets its eyes. Will DC 17 or hold monster at caster level 12.
Energy Drain (Su). Claw hits bestow one negative level on a living target.
Blood Drain (Ex). Pin a living creature in a grapple. Each round the pin is maintained, drain 1d4 Constitution and gain 5 temporary HP.
Spell-like abilities. At will, insect plague and passwall at caster level 12. DC 17 if a save applies.
Children of the Night (Su). Once per day as a standard action, call 4d8 cats or 2d6 panthers using leopard statistics. They arrive after 2d6 rounds and serve for up to 1 hour.
sections.Traits:
DR 10/bamboo and magic. Cold and electricity resistance 10. Turn resistance +4. Undead traits. The sample retains evasion, slow fall, stunning attack, and unarmed strike from monk. At 5th monk level, slow fall reduces the effective distance by 20 ft. when a wall is within reach.
Corrosion (Su). A nonmagical weapon that hits must make a DC 14 Fortitude save or take 2d8 acid damage, ignoring hardness.
Invisibility (Su). At will as a standard action, become invisible indefinitely until it makes a direct attack.
Weightless Step (Su). Levitate at will as a free action at caster level 12. The fledgling can also move horizontally up to 10 ft. in this state.
Alternate Form (Su). Assume tiger form as a standard action. It remains in that form until it changes again or until sunrise. Apply the ordinary vampire form rules to its native attacks and the tiger’s extraordinary attacks.
sections.Spawn: A humanoid or monstrous humanoid killed by energy drain rises as vampire spawn 1d4 days after burial. One reduced to Constitution 0 by blood drain returns as spawn if it had 4 or fewer HD or as a chiang-shi if it had 5 or more. A creator controls its spawn until it dies.
sections.Repelling and slaying:
It avoids smoke made by burning rosemary and myrrh and cannot touch a creature wearing a rosemary and ivy garland. It cannot cross running water on its own. It can be carried over in a coffin or on a conveyance. It rests by day in a coffin lined with native soil. Scattering rosemary and myrrh on that soil bars it permanently from that coffin.
Direct sunlight leaves it with a single move or attack action. It is destroyed in the next round if it cannot escape the light. Immersion in running water takes away one-third of its HP each round and destroys it at the end of round 3. A vampire strain whose base creature has a swim speed retains it and escapes the immersion weakness.
At 1 HP or more it heals 5 HP per round. At 0 HP or less it turns invisible and intangible and flees without attacking. It is destroyed if it misses the 2-hour deadline to reach its coffin. After 1 hour there it reaches 1 HP and resumes healing.
A bamboo shaft through the heart kills it while the shaft remains in place. For permanent destruction, bless a rosemary blossom, put it in the vampire’s mouth, then sew its lips and eyes shut with a silver needle and golden thread.
sections.Skills and feats: Balance +12, Bluff +10, Concentration +10, Diplomacy +10, Hide +12, Jump +13, Listen +13, Move Silently +12, Search +9, Sense Motive +11, Spot +13, Tumble +12. Alertness, Combat Reflexes, Deflect Arrows, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Weapon Focus with kama.
sections.Encounter details: Any environment, especially Rokushima Táiyoo. Solitary, pair, or gang of 2–5. An organized group can contain 1–2 full vampires and 2–5 vampire spawn. Speaks languages known in life. Always evil. Double standard treasure. The printed monk has a +1 kama, bracers of armor +1, and two potions of cat’s grace.
sections.Template and age: Apply the strain to a humanoid or monstrous humanoid using the 3.5 vampire template as the base. Keep its size, base attack, saves, skill points, d12 HD and applicable original powers. Constitution is absent. These age entries give the changes to Str, Dex, Int, Wis, Cha, speed and natural AC. Speed also specifies maximum horizontal movement while levitating. Damage reduction in every tier requires bamboo and magic to bypass. Apply one age row only. The sample above already incorporates its age. For unlisted save DCs use 10 + half HD, rounded down, + Cha modifier. The two spell-like abilities use 15 + Cha modifier instead. Claw damage follows the size table if the base creature has no claw attack. Where the printed example differs, use its own attack line.
sections.Age modifiers:
Fledgling. Abilities +6/+4/+2/+2/+4. Speed +10 ft., DR 10, fast healing 5, turn resistance +4, natural AC +6, CR +2.
Mature. Abilities +8/+4/+2/+4/+4. Speed +10 ft., DR 15, fast healing 5, turn resistance +4, natural AC +6, CR +2.
Old. Abilities +8/+6/+4/+4/+6. Speed +10 ft., DR 15, fast healing 6, turn resistance +5, natural AC +7, CR +3.
Ancient. Abilities +10/+6/+4/+6/+6. Speed +20 ft., DR 20, fast healing 6, turn resistance +6, natural AC +7, CR +3.
Eminent. Abilities +10/+8/+6/+6/+8. Speed +20 ft., DR 20, fast healing 8, turn resistance +7, natural AC +8, CR +4.
Patriarch. Abilities +12/+10/+8/+8/+10. Speed +30 ft., DR 25, fast healing 10, turn resistance +8, natural AC +8, CR +5.

ruleNotes: Use the printed monk’s flat-footed AC 17 and base attack +5. They differ from values derived from its AC components and standard monk progression. Its Mesmerism DC 17 is explicit and differs from the template’s general save formula. The sample’s claw die is 1d4 even though the strain table gives 1d6 as the default for Medium creatures.

name: Vrykolaka
otherStatistics: Fledgling sample, 5th-level human warrior. Initiative +9. AC components +5 Dex, +5 natural, +1 deflection. Touch 16, flat-footed 16. Base attack +5, grapple +11. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +8, Will +4.
description: This fledgling was a human warrior. It puts victims into a fever sleep and can flee as a swarm.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +11 melee for 1d4 + 6 and filth fever.
Full attack. Two of the listed claws.
Fever Sleep (Su). Standard action against one target within 30 ft. who meets its eyes. Will DC 12 or sleep as the spell at caster level 12 without a Hit Dice limit. Feeding does not awaken the target.
Blood Drain (Ex). Pin a living creature in a grapple. Each round the pin is maintained, drain 1d4 Constitution and gain 5 temporary HP. A victim must also save against filth fever.
Filth fever (Ex). Any living victim damaged by a claw or blood drain makes a DC 12 Fortitude save. Incubation is 1d3 days. The disease deals 1d3 Dexterity and 1d3 Constitution damage.
Children of the Night (Su). Once per day as a standard action, call 6d10 HD of monstrous vermin. They arrive after 2d6 rounds and serve for up to 1 hour.
sections.Traits:
DR 5/iron and magic in the sample’s stat line. Cold and electricity resistance 10, turn resistance +3, spider climb, and undead traits.
Disease (Ex). The strain carries one permanent disease. It also picks up injury- or contact-transmitted diseases when it feeds on an infected victim. Add its Cha modifier to the disease DC. Each secondary disease’s DC falls by 1 each day after acquisition. At DC 0 it loses that disease. A DC 15 Heal check identifies diseases it carries.
Alternate Form (Su). As a standard action, use polymorph at caster level 12 to change into a dire rat, a rat swarm, or a swarm of Fine vermin until changing again or until sunrise. A swarm has as many 1-HP members as the vampire has total HP. Each member killed costs the vampire 1 HP. The swarm members still carry its diseases.
sections.Spawn: A humanoid or monstrous humanoid killed by its disease rises as vampire spawn 1d4 days after burial. A victim drained to Constitution 0 returns as spawn if it had 4 or fewer HD or as a vrykolaka if it had 5 or more. A creator controls its spawn until it dies.
sections.Repelling and slaying:
Garlic, anise, a continuous line of aniseed, and a strongly brandished holy symbol keep it away. It cannot enter an immaculate room or cross running water unaided. Still or stagnant water does not trouble it.
Direct sunlight leaves it with a single move or attack action. It is destroyed in the next round if it cannot escape the light. Immersion in running water takes away one-third of its HP each round and destroys it at the end of round 3. A vampire strain whose base creature has a swim speed retains it and escapes the immersion weakness.
At 1 HP or more it heals 5 HP per round. At 0 HP or less it flees as a swarm. At least half the swarm must get to its coffin within 2 hours or it is destroyed. After 1 hour there it reaches 1 HP and resumes healing.
An iron spike through its skull kills it while the spike remains. Burn the body completely to keep it from returning. A casting of remove disease forces a Fortitude save or bestows two negative levels. While it sleeps in its coffin or is incapacitated it automatically fails this save. It is destroyed permanently at negative levels equal to or greater than its HD. When destroyed, it dissolves into vapors like stinking cloud at caster level 12.
sections.Skills and feats: Bluff +8, Handle Animal +4, Hide +13, Intimidate +6, Jump +12, Listen +13, Move Silently +13, Search +6, Sense Motive +11, Spot +13. Alertness, Blind-Fight, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Run.
sections.Encounter details: Any environment in Ravenloft. Solitary, pair, or gang of 2–5. An organized group can contain 1–2 full vampires and 2–5 vampire spawn. Speaks languages known in life. Always evil. Standard treasure. The printed warrior wears a ring of protection +1.
sections.Template and age: Apply the strain to a humanoid or monstrous humanoid using the 3.5 vampire template as the base. Keep its size, base attack, saves, skill points, d12 HD and applicable original powers. Constitution is absent. These age entries give the changes to Str, Dex, Int, Wis, Cha, speed, natural AC and Outcast Rating (OR) against non-vrykolakas. Intelligence has a minimum of 3. Every age tier requires cold iron and magic to bypass damage reduction. Apply one age row only. The sample already incorporates its age. For unlisted save DCs use 10 + half HD, rounded down, + Cha modifier. Filth fever uses 12 + Cha modifier instead. Claw damage follows the size table if the base creature has no claw attack. Where the printed example differs, use its own attack line.
sections.Age modifiers:
Fledgling. Abilities +6/+8/−6/+4/+2. Speed +0 ft., DR 5, fast healing 5, turn resistance +3, natural AC +5, OR +2, CR +1.
Mature. Abilities +6/+10/−4/+4/+2. Speed +0 ft., DR 10, fast healing 5, turn resistance +3, natural AC +5, OR +2, CR +1.
Old. Abilities +8/+10/−4/+6/+4. Speed +10 ft., DR 10, fast healing 6, turn resistance +4, natural AC +6, OR +3, CR +2.
Ancient. Abilities +8/+12/−2/+6/+4. Speed +10 ft., DR 15, fast healing 6, turn resistance +5, natural AC +6, OR +4, CR +2.
Eminent. Abilities +10/+12/−2/+8/+6. Speed +20 ft., DR 15, fast healing 8, turn resistance +6, natural AC +7, OR +5, CR +3.
Patriarch. Abilities +12/+14/+0/+10/+8. Speed +30 ft., DR 20, fast healing 10, turn resistance +7, natural AC +7, OR +6, CR +4.

ruleNotes: The sample says DR 5/iron and magic. The age table specifies cold iron and magic. The sample’s claw die is 1d4 even though the strain table gives 1d6 as the default for Medium creatures. For template use, the p. 204 spawn paragraph says “vampire” before referring to the new vrykolaka.

name: Arak
description: The shadow fey of the Shadow Rift belong to the Seelie and Unseelie Courts. Their forms can change over decades to reflect their temperaments.

sections.Running the encounter: Choose a breed before assigning statistics. Powrie use poison and ambushes, shee ensnare mortals with enchantments, sith wield dark magic and stealth, and teg hunt and work with animals. Use the selected profile for its attacks, spells, and alternate forms.
sections.Sunlight: Each of the four printed breeds takes damage from direct sunlight without a saving throw. Use the damage and shade rules on the selected profile. The amount varies by breed.

name: Dread Cloaker
description: Cloak-shaped parasites attach to a host and feed through it. Each kind uses its host in a different way.

sections.Running the encounter: Choose the shadow, resplendent, or undead profile and use its Attach and feeding rules.
sections.Members:
Shadow Cloaker
Resplendent Cloaker
Undead Cloaker

name: Dread Elemental
description: Ravenloft produces corrupted elementals of blood, grave earth, mist, and pyre fire. Each has six printed size tiers.

sections.Running the encounter: Choose the kind of elemental and its size tier, then use that profile. All four use elemental traits and the Mists subtype. They understand speech but never speak. Free-willed dread elementals resent their conjurers and look for a chance to turn on them.

name: Dread Golem
description: The maker shapes a body, but the dark desires behind the work bring the construct to life. Some dread golems develop wills of their own.

sections.Running the encounter: Choose the material and use its member profile. The creator can give orders from within 60 ft. if the golem can both see and hear the creator. It keeps following the last order until replaced and defends itself when attacked. A free-willed golem can turn on its maker or leave.
sections.Construct defenses: Dread golems are immune to mind-affecting effects, poison, disease, and similar effects. They ignore critical hits, nonlethal damage, ability damage, energy drain, and death from massive damage. Their magic immunity blocks spells except where the chosen golem's profile lists an exception.

name: Dread Hound
description: This heading groups Ravenloft's living mastiff with two kinds of undead hound.

sections.Running the encounter: Use a dread mastiff as a living guard dog. A trained attack dog can trip as a wolf does and a mastiff gets +4 on Survival checks to track by scent. A phantom hound normally guards its former master's property, but it will pursue a thief to recover stolen property. Phantom hounds that bay together use the pack version of Bay. Carcass hounds follow simple orders and attack the nearest foe until destroyed. Use the selected profile for its numbers and bite effects.
sections.Members:
Dread Mastiff
Phantom Hound
Carcass Hound

name: Dread Plant
description: Ravenloft's hostile flora includes rooted ambushers, mobile predators, and plants that use their victims as lures.

sections.Running the encounter: Choose the plant that fits the location. The family introduction calls for plant traits. Use the selected profile for its actual creature type, especially the Undead Treant, and for its way of detecting or trapping prey.
sections.Dread treants: The living dread treant sidebar retains the standard 3.5 treant statistics and abilities. The corruption of Ravenloft turns these treants evil and gives them a taste for humanoid flesh. Use the Undead Treant profile where the encounter calls for the separate, blood-draining creature.

name: Dream Spawn
description: These shapeshifters feed on fear in the Veil of Sleep and use a dreamer's memories to decide what shape to take.

sections.Running the encounter: A gray morph plays a minor part in the nightmare and flees when challenged. A shadow morph directs the dream and uses its howl to paralyze foes. An ennui stalks vivid nightmares and can turn invisible. Use the chosen form's profile. If a dream spawn kills a dreamer in the dreamscape, the dreamer makes a Madness save on waking. The DC is 10 + half the spawn's Hit Dice + its Wisdom modifier.
sections.Shared actions: Alternate Form works as polymorph on itself at caster level 8 and takes a standard action. It lasts indefinitely, and the spawn can return to its own form as a free action. In its dreamscape, it reads surface thoughts as if it had studied each creature for three rounds with detect thoughts. Caster level equals its Hit Dice and the save DC is Wisdom-based. Once per day, Memory Drain inflicts 1d4 Intelligence damage with a touch. Until the victim recovers all the lost Intelligence, the spawn can mimic creatures from their memories.
sections.Lullaby and Fear Eater: Lullaby is a standard action. Foes within 20 ft. make a DC 14 Will save or become fatigued for 1d4 rounds, or for as long as the spawn stays within 20 ft. and maintains its chant as a free action. This is a sonic, mind-affecting compulsion. Dream spawn are immune to fear, horror, and madness. A spell that would cause one of these effects heals the spawn 1 HP per spell level. If the spawn makes a dreamer fail one of these saves, it heals 2 HP for a minor effect, 4 HP for a moderate effect, or 8 HP for a major effect.

name: Figurine
description: Rajian artisans animate small statues as guards, assassins, and distractions. The material determines how each construct fights.

sections.Running the encounter: Choose a figurine by its material. A Ceramic Figurine sprays stored liquids. A Crystal Figurine uses patterned lights and reflects light spells. An Ivory Figurine grows to elephant size. An Obsidian Figurine gets underfoot and sprays sharp fragments when hit. A Porcelain Figurine uses enervation rays and grows to tiger size.
sections.Control: Once a month, the figurine and its master make opposed Will saves. A win frees the figurine, changes its moral alignment to evil, and sends it after its former master. Figurines understand their creator's language and cannot speak.
sections.Members:
Ceramic Figurine
Crystal Figurine
Ivory Figurine
Obsidian Figurine
Porcelain Figurine

name: Furies
description: Alecto, Megaera, and Tisiphone hunt penitents in Ravenloft. They tempt their target back into wrongdoing before resorting to murder.

sections.Running the encounter: The sisters appear together and may approach in the guise of elderly human women. They lure a penitent with promises of divination and make three attempts to corrupt them again. If all three attempts fail, the sisters try to kill the penitent in public. In combat, use the individual scourges and spellcasting of Alecto, Megaera, and Tisiphone alongside the shared rules below.

name: Marikith
description: The marikith hunters of Timor live in dark tunnels around a queen. They frighten their prey before closing in.

sections.Running the encounter: Use small packs outside the hive. In the hive, send two or three hunters first and increase the size of each wave until the hunters outnumber their opponents at least ten to one. The queen remains inside and issues telepathic orders to her brood within 5 miles. Her printed encounter lists an escort of 4–48 hunters.
sections.Light sensitivity: All marikith take −1 on attack rolls in candlelight or starlight, −2 in torchlight, and −4 in bright sunlight or within daylight.
sections.Hunter tactics: Hunters squeeze through gaps and use mimicry to isolate their prey. To fool a listener, a hunter opposes the listener's Listen check with Bluff and gains a +8 racial bonus on the roll. The queen's bulk prevents her from using the hunters' Compression ability.
sections.Transformation: The book presents a failed powers check in Timor as a rumored route to transformation, taking 1d6 hours. The queen's sting provides a separate confirmed encounter mechanic. A humanoid paralyzed by the sting changes into a hunter within a week. Neutralizing the poison before completion reverses the change.

name: Sea Spawn
description: A sea spawn master uses parasitic minions to infiltrate coastal communities and draw prey into the water.

sections.Running the encounter: A master releases 3d6 minions near the shore each night until it controls the village. Roughly one in ten reaches shore. A minion paralyzes a host, burrows into its skull, and takes control. Use the Sea Spawn Minion entry for implantation, removal, and daily effects.
sections.Coordinated response: The master stays in shallow coastal water and maintains a telepathic link with its brood. If a minion or its host is threatened, it can call on nearby controlled hosts and minions. Use the Sea Spawn Master entry for the submerged confrontation and aquatic allies.
sections.Signs and escalation: The minions favor children and infirm people. They abduct others and deliver them to the master. Once the village is under control, the minions drive their own hosts into the sea to feed the master. The occasional survivor matures into a new master after a year.
sections.Members:
Sea Spawn Minion
Sea Spawn Master

name: Crystal Figurine
otherStatistics: Initiative +3. Touch AC 17, flat-footed AC 15. Base attack +0, grapple −13. Space 1 ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +0, Ref +2, Will +0.
description: A gemstone arthropod patrols as a guard or distraction. Its cut surfaces flash when it turns a spell back on the caster.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Rake +3 melee for 1d2 − 1 damage. Bite or sting can replace the rake if the carving calls for it. The figurine uses these physical attacks on its master's orders.
Spell-like abilities (1/day each). Color spray, hypnotic pattern, and rainbow pattern as an 8th-level sorcerer. Save DC is 5 + spell level.
sections.Traits:
Construct traits and damage reduction 5/—. Takes half damage from edged weapons. A light-related spell cast on the figurine, such as color spray or sunbeam, rebounds on the caster.
Sonic vulnerability (Ex). A damaging sonic spell destroys the figurine unless it succeeds on a Fortitude save at DC 10 + spell level + the caster's Intelligence bonus. It still takes damage on a success.
sections.Control: Once a month, the figurine and its master make opposed Will saves. A win frees the figurine, changes its moral alignment to evil, and sends it after its former master. Figurines understand their creator's language and cannot speak.

name: Ivory Figurine
otherStatistics: Initiative +3. Touch AC 17, flat-footed AC 17. Base attack +1, grapple −11. Space 1 ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +1, Ref +4, Will +1.
description: A small ivory elephant guards an entrance. It can grow to full size or drive intruders away with a blast of sound.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Gore +1 melee for 1d2 damage.
Enlarge (Su, 3/day). Become a Huge, 11-foot-tall construct for 1 minute. Use 55 HP, Fort +3, Ref +3 and Will +3. Use the elephant attacks below.
Trumpet (Su, 3/day). In either form, produce a 30-ft. cone as shout at caster level 8. It deals 5d6 sonic damage and deafens for 2d6 rounds. Fortitude DC 10 while small or DC 15 while enlarged halves damage and prevents deafness. Exposed brittle or crystalline things take 8d6 instead. Use the spell's normal saves for creatures and held objects. Silence blocks the cone.
sections.Traits: Construct traits and damage reduction 5/—. Immune to cold and electricity. Follows direct, simple orders.
sections.Control: Once a month, the figurine and its master make opposed Will saves. A win frees the figurine, changes its moral alignment to evil, and sends it after its former master. Figurines understand their creator's language and cannot speak.
sections.Encounter details: Any land in Sri Raji. Solitary. Always neutral while controlled. No treasure. Advancement 3–4 HD (Tiny), 5–8 HD (Small).
sections.Enlarged attacks: Use the revised 3.5 SRD elephant attack routines. Gore +16 melee for 2d8 + 15. Full attack can instead be one slam +16 melee for 2d6 + 10 and two stamps +11 melee for 2d6 + 5 each. Trample (Ex) deals 2d8 + 15, Reflex DC 25 half. The elephant's space is 15 ft. and reach 10 ft. Keep the figurine's construct traits and printed HP and saves.

name: Obsidian Figurine
otherStatistics: Initiative +3. Touch AC 17, flat-footed AC 14. Base attack +1, grapple −12. Space 1 ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +1, Ref +3, Will +1.
description: A rough black statuette gets close to a target's feet. A blow against it can spray fragments into the eyes of anyone sharing its square.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Claw +0 melee for 1d2 − 1 damage. If its limbs carry poison, apply the rules for a poisoned weapon.
Spikes (Ex). Some figurines are carved with up to six spikes. When it attacks from underfoot, ignore the target's shield, armor and deflection bonuses to AC. A critical hit breaks off one spike and causes a caltrop wound. Use the revised 3.5 SRD caltrop wound. It deals 1 damage, halves speed for up to 24 hours, and stops running or charging immediately. A DC 15 Heal check or at least 1 point of magical healing ends the speed penalty. Broken spikes are spent permanently.
sections.Traits:
Construct traits and damage reduction 5/—. Follows simple orders.
Shards (Ex). When a physical attack damages the figurine, each creature sharing its square makes a DC 10 Reflex save. Failure deals 1 damage and causes permanent blindness. Remove blindness cures it.
sections.Control: Once a month, the figurine and its master make opposed Will saves. A win frees the figurine, changes its moral alignment to evil, and sends it after its former master. Figurines understand their creator's language and cannot speak.
sections.Encounter details: Any land in Sri Raji. Solitary. Always neutral while controlled. No treasure. Advancement 5–8 HD (Small), 9–12 HD (Medium).

name: Porcelain Figurine
otherStatistics: Initiative +2. Touch AC 16, flat-footed AC 17. Base attack +1, grapple −12. Space 1 ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +2, Ref +4, Will +2.

The printed Fortitude save removes a negative level. The text gives no special timing for the removal save.
description: A painted porcelain tiger guards valuables. On command it fires an enervation ray or grows large enough to fight with claws and teeth.

Attack or full attack. Claw +1 melee for 1d2 − 1 damage or the enervation ray.
Enervation Ray (Su, 3/day). Attack at +7 ranged touch as enervation at caster level 8. A living creature hit gains one negative level. Use the printed DC 6 Fortitude save to remove that negative level.
Enlarge (Su, at will). Grow to a 9-ft.-long Large tiger with AC 14 and Strength 23. Use two claws +9 melee for 1d8 + 6 each and one bite +4 melee for 2d6 + 3.
