sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma, spell save DC 17. It casts without material components.
At will. Alter Self, Clairvoyance, Darkness, Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Dispel Magic, Invisibility (self only), Suggestion.
3/day each. Dimension Door, Fear, Wall of Fire.
1/day each. Fire Storm and Mass Suggestion.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. It can use Hypnotic Gaze and makes three melee attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing with two hands.
Hypnotic Gaze. Choose one visible creature within 30 ft. If it can see the ultroloth, it makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. Failure leaves it Charmed and Stunned until the end of the ultroloth’s next turn. A successful save grants it immunity to this ultroloth’s gaze for 24 hours.
Teleport. It and its worn or carried equipment magically move up to 60 ft. to a visible unoccupied space.
Summon Yugoloth (1/day). It has a 50 percent chance to magically call 1d6 Mezzoloths, 1d4 Nycaloths, or one Ultroloth. Choose among the listed groups before rolling. Each creature appears in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. of the summoner. They are allies of the summoner. The summoned creatures can't summon other yugoloths. Each stays for up to 1 minute and disappears sooner if it dies, the summoner dies, or the summoner dismisses it using a bonus action.

name: Barlgura (summoner variant)
description: An ape-shaped demon that hunts dangerous prey in packs and hangs trophies around its territory.

sections.Traits:
Reckless. At the start of its turn it may gain advantage on melee weapon attacks for that turn. Attack rolls against it then have advantage until its next turn starts.
Running Leap. With a running start it can long jump up to 40 ft. and high jump up to 20 ft.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Wisdom, save DC 13. These spells require no material components.
2/day each. Disguise Self, Invisibility (self only).
1/day each. Entangle, Phantasmal Force.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Fist attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Summon Demon (1/day). It has a 30 percent chance to magically call one Barlgura. Each creature appears in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. of the summoner. They are allies of the summoner. The summoned creatures can't summon other demons. Each stays for up to 1 minute and disappears sooner if it dies, the summoner dies, or the summoner dismisses it using an action.

ruleNotes: The 2015 errata raised its walking and climbing speeds from 30 ft. to 40 ft. each.

name: Chasme (summoner variant)
description: A fly-shaped demon that hunts down deserters. Its drone can leave prey unconscious before it lands.

sections.Traits:
Drone. Each nondemon starting its turn within 30 ft. makes a DC 12 Constitution save or falls Unconscious for 10 minutes. A creature unable to hear the drone succeeds automatically. Damage ends this effect, as does another creature using an action to splash the target with holy water. A creature that saves or recovers is immune to the drone for 24 hours.
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Proboscis. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 16 (4d6 + 2) piercing and 24 (7d6) necrotic damage. Reduce the target’s maximum HP by the necrotic damage it took. It dies if this reduces its maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until it finishes a long rest or receives a spell such as Greater Restoration.
Summon Demon (1/day). It has a 30 percent chance to magically call one Chasme. Each creature appears in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. of the summoner. They are allies of the summoner. The summoned creatures can't summon other demons. Each stays for up to 1 minute and disappears sooner if it dies, the summoner dies, or the summoner dismisses it using an action.

name: Mezzoloth (summoner variant)
description: The foot soldier of yugoloth armies, armed with a trident and protected by a thick chitinous shell.

name: Yochlol (Summoner Variant)
description: A handmaiden of Lolth that can approach as a drow or giant spider. Its true form is a column of yellow slime with one eye.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action it can become a female drow, a giant spider, or return to its demon form. It keeps the same statistics and its gear keeps its shape. It returns to its true form on death.
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
Web Walker. Webbing doesn’t restrict its movement.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma, save DC 14. These spells require no material components.
At will. Detect Thoughts, Web.
1/day. Dominate Person.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks.
Slam (Bite in spider form). Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or 10 ft. in demon form, one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or piercing in spider form, plus 21 (6d6) poison damage.
Mist Form. It and its gear become toxic mist until it returns to its true form. It reverts on death. In mist form it is Incapacitated and cannot speak. It can hover, fly 30 ft., and pass through any gap that isn’t airtight. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saves and is immune to nonmagical damage. It can enter and stop in a creature’s space. Each time that creature starts its turn sharing the space, it makes a DC 14 Constitution save or is Poisoned until its next turn starts. It remains Incapacitated while Poisoned in this way.
Summon Demon (1/day). It has a 50 percent chance to magically call one Yochlol. Each creature appears in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. of the summoner. They are allies of the summoner. The summoned creatures can't summon other demons. Each stays for up to 1 minute and disappears sooner if it dies, the summoner dies, or the summoner dismisses it using an action.

ruleNotes: The printed Mist Form action lets it return to its true form, and the mist is Incapacitated. The entry does not specify how it reverts while it cannot take actions.

Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Sting. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing plus 17 (5d6) poison damage. The target makes a DC 14 Constitution save or becomes Poisoned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each turn and ends the condition on a success.

name: Night Hag (Coven Variant)
description: An exiled Feywild hag who sends nightmares to corrupt mortals and collect their souls. This hag belongs to a three-member coven.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The hag has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). No material components.
At will: Detect Magic, Magic Missile.
2/day each: Plane Shift (self only), Ray of Enfeeblement, Sleep.
sections.Actions:
Claws (hag form only). Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Change Shape. The hag magically becomes a Small or Medium female humanoid or resumes her true form. Her statistics stay the same and her equipment keeps its original form. She returns to her true form when she dies.
Etherealness. While carrying a Heartstone, the hag can magically cross between the Material and Ethereal Planes.
Nightmare Haunting (1/day). From the Ethereal Plane, the hag magically touches a sleeping humanoid on the Material Plane. Protection from Evil and Good or Magic Circle blocks the touch. The target suffers visions while contact continues. If the visions last at least 1 hour, the target gains no benefit from that rest and its maximum HP decreases by 5 (1d10). Greater Restoration or similar magic ends the reduction. If its maximum HP reaches 0 this way, the target dies, and if it was evil, its soul is caught in the hag’s Soul Bag.
sections.Night hag items:
Heartstone. Carrying this very rare stone lets the hag use Etherealness. Its touch also cures any disease. The hag takes 30 days to make one.
Soul Bag. This very rare item holds one evil soul at a time. Only the hag who made it can use it to catch a soul with Nightmare Haunting. Making one takes 7 days and a humanoid sacrifice.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 176, 178–179. The coven sidebar is on p. 176. The official errata corrects innate spellcasting, Claws, and resistance wording.
sections.Variant rules: Night Hag (Coven) is the other library label for this printed coven profile.
sections.Shared spellcasting:
A coven has three hags of any type. All three can use these wizard spells while they are within 30 ft. of one another. Track one pool of spell slots for the whole coven. Each hag casts as a 12th-level spellcaster using Intelligence. This hag uses spell save DC 15 and +7 to hit with spell attacks for this list.
1st level (4 slots): Identify, Ray of Sickness.
2nd level (3 slots): Hold Person, Locate Object.
3rd level (3 slots): Bestow Curse, Counterspell, Lightning Bolt.
4th level (3 slots): Phantasmal Killer, Polymorph.
5th level (2 slots): Contact Other Plane, Scrying.
6th level (1 slot): Eyebite.
sections.Hag Eye: A coven can have one Hag Eye. A coven member on the same plane can spend an action to see through it. The eye has AC 10, 1 HP, and darkvision 60 ft. If it is destroyed, each coven member takes 3d10 psychic damage and becomes Blinded for 24 hours. All three hags must perform a 1-hour ritual to make a new eye. They cannot do so while Blinded, and an action outside the ritual makes them start over.

The target suffers visions while contact continues. If the visions last at least 1 hour, the target gains no benefit from that rest and its maximum HP decreases by 5 (1d10). sections.Traits:

name: Gray Slaad (control gem variant)
description: A gray slaad can pass for a humanoid and use illusion, flight, and planar travel to choose its fights.

sections.Senses: Blindsight and darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 17.
sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action, the slaad can take the form of a Small or Medium humanoid or return to its true form. Only its size changes in its statistics. Its equipment keeps its own form. It returns to its true form on death.
Magic Resistance. The slaad has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. The slaad’s weapon attacks count as magical.
Regeneration. At the start of its turn, the slaad regains 10 HP if it has at least 1 HP.
Control Gem. The slaad has a magical gem in its brain. It must obey the creature that possesses the gem and is immune to being Charmed for as long as the gem controls it. Destroying the gem ends this means of control.
Spell extraction. If the slaad fails a save against Imprisonment, the caster can have the spell move the gem to their open hand instead of imprisoning the slaad. Wish can retrieve the gem if cast in the slaad's presence with that wording. Greater Restoration cast on the slaad destroys the gem without injuring it.
Surgical extraction. A creature proficient in Wisdom (Medicine) can remove the gem while the slaad is Incapacitated. Each attempt takes 1 minute of uninterrupted work and a DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check. A failure deals 22 (4d10) psychic damage to the slaad.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma, spell save DC 14. No material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Invisibility (self only), Mage Hand, Major Image.
2/day each. Fear, Fly, Fireball, Tongues.
1/day. Plane Shift (self only).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw or Greatsword attacks.
Bite (slaad form only). Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Claw (slaad form only). Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

name: Troll (variant)
description: A troll whose severed limbs fend for themselves until it regrows them.

sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. The troll has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
Regeneration. The troll regains 10 HP at the start of its turn. If it takes acid or fire damage, it cannot regenerate at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn at 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 291, including the Loathsome Limbs sidebar and Perception errata.
sections.Loathsome Limbs:
If the troll takes 15 or more slashing damage at once, roll a d20. On 1–10, no part comes off. On 11–14, sever one remaining leg. On 15–18, sever one remaining arm. On 19–20, decapitate it. A decapitated troll dies only if it cannot regenerate. When it dies, its detached head dies too.
Detached parts. Each has AC 13, 10 HP and the troll’s Regeneration. Each acts on the troll’s initiative with its own movement and action. If the troll completes a short or long rest without reattaching the part, it grows a replacement and the detached part dies.
Leg. A detached leg has speed 5 ft. and cannot attack. The troll’s speed halves after losing one leg. With both legs gone, it falls Prone and can crawl if it has arms. With just one arm it crawls at half speed. With no arms or legs its speed is 0 and speed bonuses do not apply.
Arm. A detached arm has speed 5 ft. and makes one Claw attack on its turn. It has disadvantage unless the troll can see both the arm and the target. Each lost arm removes one Claw from the troll’s Multiattack.
Head. The detached head cannot move, retains Keen Smell, and can Bite only a target in its space. The body loses Bite and is Blinded unless its head can see the body.

name: Adult Blue Dracolich
description: An adult blue dragon whose spirit animates its own bones through a phylactery gem.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed and Poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. Roll saving throws against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, drink or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. The dracolich may use Frightful Presence, then makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing plus 5 (1d10) lightning damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
Frightful Presence. The dracolich chooses creatures within 120 ft. that are aware of it. Each makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. On a failure, the creature is Frightened for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that succeeds or whose fear ends is immune to this dracolich's Frightful Presence for 24 hours.
Lightning Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 90-ft. line 5 ft. wide makes a DC 20 Dexterity save. Failure deals 66 (12d10) lightning damage. Success halves it.
sections.Legendary actions:
The dracolich has 3 legendary actions. It uses one option at a time, at the end of another creature's turn, and regains spent actions at the start of its own turn. It can't use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must wait until after its first turn.
Detect (1 action). Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make a Tail attack.
Wing Attack (2 actions). Each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 21 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 14 (2d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage and falls Prone. The dracolich can then fly up to half its flying speed.
sections.Phylactery: When the body is destroyed, the spirit returns to its gem if the gem and body are on the same plane. If the gem then touches another dragon's corpse, the spirit can animate that body and return as a dracolich. If the gem is on another plane when the body is destroyed, the spirit passes into the afterlife.
sections.Lair options: The printed example has no listed lair actions. The template lets the DM keep, remove, or replace the base dragon's lair actions.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 83–84. The official errata corrects saves, skills, passive Perception and weapon attack bonuses.

name: Adult Red Dracolich
description: An adult red dragon restored to its own skeleton by the spirit bound to its phylactery gem.

sections.Template: Apply the printed dracolich template to the Adult Red Dragon. Change its type to undead and add the listed resistances, immunities and Magic Resistance. The book gives no separate red dracolich stat block or CR or XP adjustment. This profile carries over the base dragon's CR 17 and 18,000 XP.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed and Poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. Roll saving throws against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, drink or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. The dracolich may first use Frightful Presence. It then makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.
Frightful Presence. Choose any creatures within 120 ft. that are aware of the dracolich. Each makes a DC 19 Wisdom save or is Frightened for 1 minute. A target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that saves or whose fear ends is immune to this dracolich's Frightful Presence for 24 hours.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 60-ft. cone make a DC 21 Dexterity save. Failure deals 63 (18d6) fire damage. Success halves it.
sections.Legendary actions:
The dracolich has 3 legendary actions and spends them one option at a time at the end of another creature's turn. It regains them at the start of its turn. It can't use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or before its first turn if surprised.
Detect (1 action). Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make a Tail attack.
Wing Attack (2 actions). Each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 22 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and falls Prone. The dracolich can then fly up to half its flying speed.
sections.Phylactery: When the body is destroyed, the spirit returns to its gem if the gem and body are on the same plane. If the gem then touches another dragon's corpse, the spirit can animate that body and return as a dracolich. If the gem is on another plane when the body is destroyed, the spirit passes into the afterlife.
sections.Lair actions:
If the DM retains the adult red dragon's lair actions, use these options. The template also allows the DM to remove them or substitute new ones.
On initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one option that was not used the previous round. The creature can't use a lair action while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or before its first turn if surprised.
Magma Geyser. Choose a ground point the dracolich can see within 120 ft. Magma erupts in a 5-ft.-radius, 20-ft.-high column. Each creature in it makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. Failure deals 21 (6d6) fire damage. Success halves it.
Tremor. Each other creature on the ground within 60 ft. of the dracolich makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or falls Prone.
Volcanic Gas. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. A 20-ft.-radius sphere of gas spreads around corners and is lightly obscured. It lasts until initiative count 20 of the next round. Each creature starting its turn inside makes a DC 13 Constitution save or is Poisoned until the end of its turn. A creature poisoned this way is also Incapacitated.
sections.Regional effects: If using the original lair's regional effects, small earthquakes are common within 6 miles of the lair. Water sources within 1 mile are unnaturally warm and sulfurous. Rocky fissures within 1 mile form portals to the Elemental Plane of Fire and admit creatures from that plane. These effects fade over 1d10 days after the dracolich is destroyed.
sections.Variant spellcasting: Under the optional dragon spellcasting rule, choose five spells of 5th level or lower. The dracolich can cast each once per day without material components. Its Charisma spell save DC is 19 and its spell attack bonus is +11. The book leaves the spell choices to the DM.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 83 for the template, pp. 98–99 for the adult red dragon and lair, and p. 86 for optional dragon spellcasting.

name: Demilich (Trap Soul)
description: Acererak and other demiliches of his tradition set soul gems into their skulls to feed their phylacteries.

sections.Traits:
Avoidance. If a saving throw would normally halve damage on a success, the demilich takes none on a success and half on a failure.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Turn Immunity. Immune to effects that turn Undead.
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, drink or sleep. Use the printed 80 HP.
Enduring Existence. An intact phylactery restores the destroyed skull in 1d10 days. A demilich that still has the will to feed a soul to its phylactery can return to lich form by doing so.
sections.Actions:
Howl (Recharge 5–6). Every creature within 30 ft. that can hear the howl makes a DC 15 Constitution save. Failure drops it to 0 HP. Success leaves it Frightened until the end of its next turn.
Life Drain. Choose up to three visible creatures within 10 ft. Each makes a DC 19 Constitution save or takes 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. The demilich heals HP equal to the total damage dealt.
Trap Soul. Choose one visible creature within 30 ft. It makes a DC 19 Charisma save. On a failure, magic traps its soul in one of the demilich's gems and its body and carried equipment disappear. On a success, it takes 24 (7d6) necrotic damage, which still traps its soul if it brings the creature to 0 HP. The demilich devours an imprisoned soul after 24 hours. At 0 HP the demilich crumbles to powder and leaves its gems behind. Crushing a gem frees any soul still inside. Its body reforms in the nearest unoccupied space in the same state it was in when trapped.
sections.Legendary actions:
Three legendary actions. Spend one option at the end of another creature’s turn. Regain spent actions at the start of this creature’s turn. It cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or before its first turn if surprised.
Flight (1 action). Fly up to half its flying speed.
Cloud of Dust (1 action). Each creature within 10 ft., even around a corner, makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is Blinded until the end of the demilich’s next turn. On a success that creature is immune to this effect until the end of the demilich’s next turn.
Energy Drain (2 actions). Every creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, reduce maximum HP by 10 (3d6). A target dies if its maximum falls to 0. Greater Restoration or similar magic can restore the lost maximum.
Vile Curse (3 actions). One visible creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On failure it is magically cursed and has disadvantage on attack rolls and saves. It repeats the save at the end of each turn and ends the curse on success.
sections.Lair actions:
In its lair, the demilich is CR 23 (50,000 XP). Act on initiative count 20, losing ties. No lair action while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or before the first turn if surprised. Roll a d20. On 11 or higher, choose an effect. Never repeat the same effect on consecutive rounds.
Tremor. Each creature on the tomb floor makes a DC 19 Dexterity save or falls Prone.
Antimagic. Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. Antimagic Field fills its space and moves with it until initiative count 20 next round.
Seal Healing. Choose any number of visible creatures within 30 ft. They cannot regain HP until initiative count 20 next round.
sections.Lair traits:
Use any of these optional tomb traits. A non-evil creature takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage the first time it enters. Monsters in the tomb have advantage on saves against Charmed, Frightened and turning. A ward prevents unauthorized creatures from using teleportation or planar travel to enter or leave, but allows such movement entirely within the tomb.
After the demilich is destroyed, these effects fade over 10 days.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 48–49. Use the Acererak and His Disciples sidebar and the corrected Hit Dice.
sections.Variant: This is the Acererak and His Disciples variant. The library also lists it as Demilich (Variant).
sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from magic weapons.
sections.Damage immunities: Necrotic, poison and psychic. Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone and Stunned.

ruleNotes: The lair introduction mentions extra uses for legendary actions, but this printing does not specify a different action budget. The stat block gives three each round.
The Undead Nature prose says to maximize the Hit Dice. The official errata gives 80 HP with 32d4, which matches the average. Use the listed 80 HP for this profile.

sections.Lair traits:

Wall of Ice (Recharge 6). Magically form an opaque ice barrier on a solid surface the devil can see within 60 ft. The ice is 1 ft. thick. The devil chooses a wall up to 30 ft. long and 10 ft. high or a hemispherical dome up to 20 ft. across.

name: Green Hag
description: A swamp or woodland hag who uses false cries for help to lure travelers into danger.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. She can breathe air and water.
Mimicry. She can imitate animal sounds and humanoid voices. A listener identifies the imitation with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma (spell save DC 12). She needs no material components.
At will: Dancing Lights, Minor Illusion, Vicious Mockery.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Illusory Appearance. The hag disguises herself and everything she wears or carries as a creature of her general size and humanoid shape. She can end the effect with a bonus action, and it ends if she dies. Touch can reveal discrepancies between the illusion and her body. A creature can also spend an action inspecting the disguise and identify it with a successful DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check.
Invisible Passage. She becomes Invisible, as does everything she wears or carries. The effect ends when she attacks, casts a spell, or loses Concentration as if concentrating on a spell. During the effect she leaves no physical evidence of her passage. Only magic can track her.

2nd level (3 slots): Hold Person, Locate Object.
3rd level (3 slots): Bestow Curse, Counterspell, Lightning Bolt.

name: Vampire Spawn
description: A vampire’s victim raised as a hungry undead servant. The spawn gains its freedom if its creator dies.

sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Regeneration. At the start of its turn, it regains 10 HP if it has at least 1 HP and is outside sunlight and running water. Radiant damage or damage from holy water stops regeneration at the start of its next turn.
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
Undead Nature. It needs no air.
sections.Vampire weaknesses:
Forbiddance. An occupant must invite the spawn before it enters a residence.
Harmed by Running Water. Ending its turn in running water deals 20 acid damage to it.
Stake to the Heart. A wooden piercing weapon driven into its heart while it is Incapacitated at its resting place destroys it.
Sunlight Hypersensitivity. Starting its turn in sunlight deals 20 radiant damage to it. Sunlight imposes disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. It makes two attacks, with at most one Bite.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage. On a hit, it may Grapple the target in place of dealing damage. Escape DC 13.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature that is willing, Grappled by this spawn, Incapacitated, or Restrained. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. Reduce the target’s maximum HP and heal the spawn by the necrotic damage taken. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a Long Rest. The target dies if its maximum HP reaches 0.
sections.Creation and control: The vampire that created the spawn controls it. If that vampire willingly lets the spawn drink its blood, the spawn becomes a true Vampire and is free of that control. The spawn also becomes free-willed if its creator dies.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 295, 298 (stat block p. 298). The official errata changes the resistance wording.

name: Vampire Spellcaster
description: A vampire who prepares wizard spells and rests by day in a coffin, crypt, or grave.

sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. Outside sunlight and running water, the vampire can use an action to become a Tiny bat, a Medium cloud of mist, or its true form. As a bat, it cannot speak, has a walking speed of 5 ft. and flying speed of 30 ft., and otherwise retains its stats apart from size. Worn gear transforms with it, and carried gear does not. Death returns it to true form. As mist, it cannot use actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It weighs nothing, flies 20 ft. with hover, can stop in hostile creatures' spaces, fits anywhere air can pass without squeezing, and cannot pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saves in mist form and is immune to nonmagical damage other than sunlight damage.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). It can turn a failed save into a success.
Misty Escape. At 0 HP outside its resting place, it becomes mist instead of falling Unconscious. It is destroyed if sunlight or running water prevents the change. At 0 HP in mist form, it cannot revert voluntarily and must reach its resting place in 2 hours or be destroyed. When it arrives, it reverts and is Paralyzed until it has at least 1 HP. An hour spent there at 0 HP restores 1 HP.
Regeneration. It regains 20 HP at the start of each turn if it has at least 1 HP and is outside sunlight and running water. Radiant damage or damage from holy water stops regeneration at the start of its next turn.
Spider Climb. It climbs difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
Undead Nature. It needs no air. A vampire without a formal burial rests beneath a foot of soil at the place where it became undead.
sections.Vampire weaknesses:
Forbiddance. An occupant must invite the vampire before it enters a residence.
Harmed by Running Water. Ending a turn in running water deals 20 acid damage to it.
Stake to the Heart. If a wooden piercing weapon pierces its heart while it is Incapacitated at its resting place, it is Paralyzed until the weapon is removed.
Sunlight Hypersensitivity. Starting its turn in sunlight deals 20 radiant damage to it. It has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks in sunlight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack (vampire form only). It makes two attacks, with at most one Bite.
Unarmed Strike (vampire form only). Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. It can instead Grapple the target on a hit (escape DC 18).
Bite (bat or vampire form only). Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature that is willing, Grappled by this vampire, Incapacitated, or Restrained. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. Reduce the target's maximum HP and heal the vampire by the necrotic damage taken. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a Long Rest, and the target dies if its maximum HP becomes 0. A humanoid killed this way and buried in the ground rises the next night as a Vampire Spawn under its control.
Charm. Choose one humanoid the vampire sees within 30 ft. If the target sees it, the target makes a DC 17 Wisdom save against magic. Failure leaves the target Charmed, treating the vampire as a trusted friend to protect and heed. The target interprets the vampire's actions and requests as favorably as it can and is willing to be bitten. It retains control of its own actions. Each harmful act by the vampire or its allies lets the target repeat the save, ending the effect on success. The charm ends after 24 hours, if the vampire is destroyed, if the two are on different planes, or if the vampire uses a Bonus Action to end it.
Children of the Night (1/day). If the sun is down, it magically calls 2d4 Swarms of Bats or Swarms of Rats. Outdoors it can call 3d6 Wolves instead. The creatures arrive after 1d4 rounds, ally with the vampire, and obey its spoken orders. They stay for 1 hour or until the vampire dies or dismisses them with a Bonus Action.
sections.Legendary actions:
Three legendary actions per round, spent one option at a time after another creature's turn. It regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it can use them only after its first turn.
Move. It moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Unarmed Strike. It makes one Unarmed Strike.
Bite (2 actions). It makes one Bite attack.
sections.Regional effects: Bats, rats, and wolves grow more numerous around its lair. Within 500 ft., plants wither and grow twisted and thorny, shadows stretch and sometimes move on their own, and fog clings to the ground and occasionally takes strange shapes. The effects end 2d6 days after the vampire is destroyed.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 295–298 (base stat block p. 297, variant p. 298). The official errata corrects the spell save DC and spell attack bonus.
sections.Spellcasting:
9th-level wizard spellcaster. Intelligence (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will): Mage Hand, Prestidigitation, Ray of Frost.
1st level (4 slots): Comprehend Languages, Fog Cloud, Sleep.
2nd level (3 slots): Detect Thoughts, Gust of Wind, Mirror Image.
3rd level (3 slots): Animate Dead, Bestow Curse, Nondetection.
4th level (3 slots): Blight, Greater Invisibility.
5th level (1 slot): Dominate Person.
sections.Resting places: During the day the vampire must rest in its coffin, crypt, or grave. It can move its resting place, or establish additional ones, by transporting its coffin or a substantial amount of its grave dirt.

name: Dao
description: A dao is a genie from the Elemental Plane of Earth. It reshapes rock into winding halls and bargains for treasure. When it flies, swirling sand takes the place of its legs.

sections.Traits:
Earth Glide. The dao can burrow through unworked nonmagical earth and stone without disturbing either.
Elemental Demise. When the dao dies, its body becomes crystalline powder. Its worn and carried equipment remains.
Sure-Footed. The dao rolls Strength and Dexterity saves against being knocked Prone with advantage.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
The dao uses Charisma, with save DC 14 and +6 to hit with spell attacks. Its spells require no material components.
At will. Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic, Stone Shape.

1/day each. Conjure Elemental (Earth Elemental only), Gaseous Form, Invisibility, Phantasmal Killer, Plane Shift, Wall of Stone.

name: Djinni
description: A djinni is a genie from the Elemental Plane of Air. Djinn keep floating palaces, prize music and wine, and may trade a brief service for a fine gift. In flight, a djinni rides a column of wind.

sections.Traits: Elemental Demise. When the djinni dies, its body dissolves into a warm breeze. Its worn and carried equipment remains.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
The djinni uses Charisma, with save DC 17 and +9 to hit with spell attacks. Its spells require no material components.
At will. Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic, Thunderwave.
3/day each. Create Food and Water (may create wine in place of water), Tongues, Wind Walk.

A creature can use its action to free a creature held by the wind, including itself, with a DC 18 Strength check. On a success, the captive stops being Restrained and moves to the nearest space outside the wind.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold and lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, and lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Stench. A creature that starts its turn within 10 ft. makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, it is Poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a success, it is immune to this hezrou's Stench for 24 hours.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.
Summon Demon (1/day). Choose 2d6 Dretches or one Hezrou, then attempt a magical summoning with a 30 percent chance of success. Each demon arrives in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. of the summoner and fights as its ally. It can't summon further demons. It stays for up to 1 minute and disappears earlier if it dies, the summoner dies, or the summoner uses an action to dismiss it.

name: Nalfeshnee
description: A winged demon with features of an ape and a boar. It flies over the front line to strike vulnerable targets.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, and lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Horror Nimbus if available, then make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 32 (5d10 + 5) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage.
Horror Nimbus (Recharge 5–6). It magically emits multicolored light. Each creature within 15 ft. that can see the light makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Frightened for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Once it saves or the effect ends for it, it is immune to this nalfeshnee's Horror Nimbus for 24 hours.
Teleport. It and everything it wears or carries magically move up to 120 ft. to a visible unoccupied space.

name: Barbed Devil
description: An alert infernal guard covered in spikes, quick to punish a grapple or set a fleeing foe ablaze.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Barbed Hide. At the start of the devil's turn, each creature grappling it takes 5 (1d10) piercing damage.
Devil's Sight. The devil sees through magical darkness with its darkvision.
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks and one Tail attack, or use Hurl Flame twice.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Hurl Flame. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit 10 (3d6) fire damage. A hit also ignites a flammable object that nobody is wearing or carrying.
sections.Infernal return: A devil killed outside the Nine Hells disappears in sulfurous smoke or dissolves into ichor and re-forms immediately at full strength on its home layer. Death within the Nine Hells is permanent.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 67 and 70. Damage resistance wording follows the official errata.

Any creature can spend an action and pass a DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check to close the wound. Magical healing received by the target also closes it.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.

Apply the chosen form's speeds and keep the imp's other statistics. Its equipment stays as it was. Death restores its true form.
Devil's Sight. The devil sees through magical darkness with its darkvision.
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
sections.Actions:
Sting (Bite in Beast Form). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 11 Constitution save, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Quasit
description: A petty Abyssal spy that slips into an animal guise or vanishes before striking.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, and lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. It can use an action to change into a bat (walk 10 ft., fly 40 ft.), centipede (walk and climb 40 ft.), toad (walk and swim 40 ft.), or its true form. Only the listed speeds change. Its gear keeps its original form, and the quasit returns to its true form when it dies.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Claws (Bite in beast form). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. On a failed DC 10 Constitution save, the target also takes 5 (2d4) poison damage and becomes Poisoned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each turn, ending the condition on a success.
Scare (1/day). Choose one creature within 20 ft. It makes a DC 10 Wisdom save or becomes Frightened for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each turn, with disadvantage if it can see the quasit, ending the effect on a success.
Invisibility. The quasit and its worn or carried gear become magically Invisible. The effect ends if the quasit attacks, uses Scare, or loses Concentration as if concentrating on a spell.
sections.Abyssal return: A demon killed outside the Abyss dissolves and reforms there immediately. Killing it in the Abyss destroys it permanently unless it has protected its essence with a demonic amulet.

Charge. If it moves at least 15 ft. straight toward a target and hits that target with Gore on the same turn, the hit deals another 38 (7d10) piercing damage. A creature hit this way also makes a DC 21 Strength save. On a failure, the goristro pushes it up to 20 ft. away and knocks it Prone.
Labyrinthine Recall. It remembers every route it has traveled.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Siege Monster. It deals double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:

sections.Abyssal return: A demon killed outside the Abyss dissolves and reforms there immediately. Killing it in the Abyss destroys it permanently unless it has protected its essence with a demonic amulet.

name: Dust Mephit
description: An elemental of earth and air drawn to tombs by its fascination with death.

sections.Traits:
Death Burst. When the mephit dies, dust bursts out in a 5-ft. radius around it. Each creature in that radius makes a DC 10 Constitution save. On a failure it is Blinded for 1 minute. It may repeat the save on each of its turns and ends the blindness on a success.
Elemental Nature. The mephit can go without food, drink, and sleep.
sections.Innate spellcasting: Charisma. Once per day, the mephit can cast Sleep without material components.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
Blinding Breath (Recharge 6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone of dust makes a DC 10 Dexterity save. On a failure it is Blinded for 1 minute. The affected creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns and end the blindness on a success.

Elemental Nature. The mephit can go without food, drink, and sleep.

name: Duodrone
description: A blocky modron that supervises monodrones and can work on two tasks at once.

sections.Traits:
Axiomatic Mind. Compulsion can't make the duodrone disobey its instructions or act against its nature.
Disintegration. When it dies, its body turns to dust. Anything it carried remains.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Fist attacks or two Javelin attacks.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

name: Duodrone (Rogue)
classification: Medium construct, any alignment except lawful neutral
description: A duodrone that breaks with Primus. Other modrons hunt it down.

sections.Traits: Disintegration. When it dies, its body turns to dust. Anything it carried remains.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Fist attacks or two Javelin attacks.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

sections.Variant: The Rogue Modron option removes Axiomatic Mind and allows any alignment except lawful neutral. All other duodrone statistics still apply.

name: Pseudodragon
description: A small red-brown dragon that nests in hollow trees and caves. It avoids strangers and defends itself with a venomous tail.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13.
sections.Languages: Understands Common and Draconic. It can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Keen Senses. It has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use sight, hearing, or smell.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Limited Telepathy. It can magically send simple thoughts, feelings, or images to a creature within 100 ft. that understands a language.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Sting. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 11 Constitution save or is Poisoned for 1 hour. On a failure by 5 or more, it also falls Unconscious for the same duration. Damage or another creature using an action to shake it awake ends the Unconscious condition early.

name: Pseudodragon (familiar variant)
description: A pseudodragon willing to form a familiar bond with a companion.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13.
sections.Languages: Understands Common and Draconic. It can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Keen Senses. It has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use sight, hearing, or smell.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Limited Telepathy. It can magically send simple thoughts, feelings, or images to a creature within 100 ft. that understands a language.
Familiar. The pseudodragon forms a magical telepathic bond with a willing creature. The companion can share the pseudodragon's senses while they are within 1 mile of each other and gains the benefit of Magic Resistance while within 10 ft. The pseudodragon may end its service and the bond at any time.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

On a failure by 5 or more, it also falls Unconscious for the same duration. Damage or another creature using an action to shake it awake ends the Unconscious condition early.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 254, including the Pseudodragon Familiar sidebar.

name: Satyr
description: A horned woodland fey with goat hooves that seeks out music and festivals.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Ram. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (2d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Satyr (Variant)
description: A satyr carrying magical panpipes. In a group, usually only one satyr has a set.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Ram. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (2d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Panpipes. Choose one melody. Each creature that can hear the pipes within 60 ft. must make a DC 13 Wisdom save. Other satyrs and creatures immune to the Charmed condition are exempt. Affected creatures can retry the save at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success. After a successful save or the effect ending, that creature is immune to this set of panpipes for 24 hours.
Charming Melody. On a failed save, the creature is Charmed by the satyr for 1 minute. The effect ends immediately if the satyr or one of its companions harms the creature.
Frightening Strain. On a failed save, the creature is Frightened for 1 minute.
Gentle Lullaby. On a failed save, the creature falls asleep and becomes Unconscious for 1 minute. Taking damage or someone using an action to shake it awake ends the effect.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 267, including the Satyr Pipes sidebar.

sections.Spellcasting:
5th-level cleric spellcaster using Wisdom. Spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks. Its spells need only verbal components.
Cantrips at will. Mending, Sacred Flame, Thaumaturgy.

3rd level (2 slots). Bestow Curse.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

name: Assassin
classification: Medium humanoid (any race), any non-good alignment
description: A hired killer who uses surprise and poison. A ruler or guild might keep one on retainer.

sections.Languages: Thieves' Cant and any two languages.
sections.Traits:
Assassinate. On its first turn, the assassin has advantage on attacks against creatures that haven't acted yet. A hit against a surprised creature is a critical hit.
Evasion. When a Dexterity save would reduce damage to half, the assassin takes no damage on a success and half on a failure.
Sneak Attack (once per turn). A weapon hit deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage if the roll had advantage. It also qualifies if the target is within 5 ft. of one of the assassin's allies who is not incapacitated and the roll had no disadvantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Shortsword attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failure or half on a success.
Light Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 343. Saves, skills, passive Perception, Sneak Attack damage, and attack bonuses follow the official errata.

name: Bandit
classification: Medium humanoid (any race), any non-lawful alignment
description: A gang member or pirate. Some crews raid for profit. Others take to the road after famine or persecution.

sections.Actions:
