11th-level cleric. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability, with save DC 16 and +8 to hit. Only verbal components are needed.
Cantrips, at will. Mending, Sacred Flame, Thaumaturgy.
1st level, 4 slots. Command, Cure Wounds, Shield of Faith.
2nd level, 3 slots. Calm Emotions, Hold Person.
3rd level, 3 slots. Bestow Curse, Clairvoyance.
4th level, 3 slots. Banishment, Freedom of Movement.
5th level, 2 slots. Flame Strike, Geas.
6th level, 1 slot. True Seeing.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 45 (10d8) poison damage on a failure or half damage on a success.
Spit Poison. Ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, range 15/30 ft., one creature. On a hit, the target makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 45 (10d8) poison damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

name: Spirit Naga
description: A cave-dwelling serpent works on new spells and uses enchantment to draw prey within reach.

sections.Traits:
Rejuvenation. After dying, the naga returns to life with full HP in 1d6 days. Only Wish can stop this trait.
Immortal Nature. Nagas need no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Spellcasting:
10th-level wizard. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability, with save DC 14 and +6 to hit. Only verbal components are needed.
Cantrips, at will. Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Ray of Frost.
1st level, 4 slots. Charm Person, Detect Magic, Sleep.
2nd level, 3 slots. Detect Thoughts, Hold Person.
3rd level, 3 slots. Lightning Bolt, Water Breathing.
4th level, 3 slots. Blight, Dimension Door.
5th level, 2 slots. Dominate Person.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 13 Constitution save, taking 31 (7d8) poison damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

name: Couatl
description: A winged serpent keeps an ancient charge in secret and may appear in another shape to guide those it protects.

sections.Damage immunities: Psychic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
Shielded Mind. The couatl is immune to scrying and to effects that sense its emotions, read its thoughts, or find its location.
Truth Tellers. A couatl can omit details, but cannot lie.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma is the spellcasting ability, with save DC 14. Spells require only verbal components.
At will. Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts.
3/day each. Bless, Create Food and Water, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration, Protection from Poison, Sanctuary, Shield.
1/day each. Dream, Greater Restoration, Scrying.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage. The target must pass a DC 13 Constitution save or be Poisoned for 24 hours. It becomes Unconscious while the poison lasts. Another creature can use an action to shake it awake.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and Grapple the target, escape DC 15. The target is Restrained during the grapple, and the couatl cannot constrict another target until this grapple ends.
Change Shape. Magically take the form of a Beast or Humanoid whose CR is no higher than the couatl's, or return to its true form. It reverts to its true form on death. It chooses whether the new form absorbs its equipment or wears or carries it. It keeps its statistics and speech except for AC, movement modes, Strength, Dexterity, and its other actions, which come from the new form. It also gains statistics and capabilities it lacks, excluding class features, legendary actions, lair actions, and regional effects. If the form has a bite attack, the couatl can use its own Bite while in that form.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 43. Immunity wording and the limits on gaining a legendary form's abilities follow the official errata.

name: Dragon Turtle
description: This ocean dragon hoards treasure from wrecks and may bargain with sailors for safe passage.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. It breathes both air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks. It can replace the two Claw attacks with one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 26 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 26 (3d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 20 Strength save or be pushed up to 10 ft. away and fall Prone.
Steam Breath (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 60-ft. cone make a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failure they take 52 (15d6) fire damage. On a success they take half damage. Being underwater gives no resistance against this damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 119. Saving throws and weapon attack bonuses follow the official errata.

name: Hydra
description: A many-headed swamp predator grows new heads when its wounds escape burning.

sections.Traits:
Hold Breath. It can hold its breath for 1 hour.
Multiple Heads. It starts with five heads. While it has more than one, it has advantage on saves against being Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, or knocked Unconscious. Whenever it takes at least 25 total damage in one turn, one head dies. It dies if it loses all its heads. At the end of its turn, it grows two heads for each one lost since its last turn, unless it took fire damage in that interval. It regains 10 HP per head regrown this way.
Reactive Heads. Beyond its first head, each head grants one extra reaction that it can use only for opportunity attacks.
Wakeful. At least one head remains awake when the hydra sleeps.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack for each head the hydra currently has.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

name: Purple Worm
description: An enormous tunneler follows vibrations and can swallow prey whole.

sections.Traits: Tunneler. The worm can bore through solid rock at half its burrow speed, leaving a tunnel 10 ft. wide.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tail Stinger attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. A Large or smaller creature hit must pass a DC 19 Dexterity save or the worm swallows it. Inside, the creature is Blinded and Restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects from outside, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns. If a creature inside deals at least 30 damage to the worm in one turn, the worm must pass a DC 21 Constitution save at that turn's end or regurgitate every swallowed creature. They fall Prone within 10 ft. of the worm. If the worm dies, swallowed creatures cease to be Restrained by it and can spend 20 ft. of movement to escape the corpse, emerging Prone.
Tail Stinger. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit 19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 19 Constitution save, taking 42 (12d6) poison damage on a failure or half damage on a success.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 255. Bite and Tail Stinger attack bonuses follow the official errata.

name: Cambion
description: A winged descendant of a fiend and a humanoid. It can command charmed victims and attack from the air.

sections.Armor: Scale mail. The listed AC includes Fiendish Blessing.
sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning, and poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Fiendish Blessing. Add its Charisma bonus to AC.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma is its spellcasting ability (save DC 14). It casts these spells without material components.
3/day each. Alter Self, Command, Detect Magic.
1/day. Plane Shift (self only).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks or use Fire Ray twice.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage for a two-handed melee hit. Add 3 (1d6) fire damage to either.
Fire Ray. Ranged spell attack, +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit 10 (3d6) fire damage.
Fiendish Charm. Choose one visible humanoid within 30 ft. It makes a DC 14 Wisdom save or is magically Charmed for 1 day. While Charmed it obeys the cambion's spoken commands. Harm from any creature or a suicidal order from the cambion lets it repeat the save and end the charm on a success. A successful save or the charm ending grants 24 hours of immunity to that cambion's Fiendish Charm.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 36. Resistance wording follows the official errata.

name: Chain Devil
description: A jailer of the Nine Hells that binds victims with its own chains and animates loose chains nearby.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks that use no silvered weapon.
sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. Magical darkness leaves the devil's darkvision unchanged.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Chain attacks.
Chain. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. If the devil isn't already grappling a creature, a creature hit is Grappled (escape DC 14). While held it is Restrained and takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage at the start of each of its turns.
Animate Chains (recharges after a short or long rest). Magically animate up to four visible chains within 60 ft. that nobody is wearing or carrying. Each chain grows barbs and becomes an object with AC 20, 20 HP, piercing resistance, and psychic and thunder immunity. When the devil uses Multiattack on its turn, each animated chain can make one additional Chain attack. Each chain can hold one creature in its own grapple and cannot attack while it holds that creature. A chain becomes inanimate at 0 HP or if the devil becomes Incapacitated or dies.
sections.Reactions: Unnerving Mask. When a creature the devil sees starts its turn within 30 ft., the devil can appear to be one of its departed loved ones or bitter enemies. If the creature sees the devil, it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom save or be Frightened until the end of that turn.
sections.Infernal return: If it dies outside the Nine Hells, its body vanishes in smoke or dissolves into ichor. It returns immediately to its home layer at full strength. Death in the Nine Hells destroys the chain devil permanently.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 67–68 and 72. Resistance wording follows the official errata.

name: Hell Hound
description: A fire-breathing fiend that hunts in packs and may guard a devil or fire giant.

sections.Traits:
Keen Hearing and Smell. It has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use hearing or smell.
Pack Tactics. It has advantage on an attack against a creature if at least one of the hound's allies within 5 ft. of the target is free of the Incapacitated condition.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. It takes 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.After death: The hound's internal fire consumes its body in smoke and embers, leaving scorched tufts of fur.

name: Lemure
description: A malformed devil born from a mortal soul condemned to the Nine Hells.

sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. Magical darkness leaves the devil's darkvision unchanged.
Hellish Rejuvenation. A lemure slain in the Nine Hells returns after 1d10 days with full HP. It stays dead if a good-aligned creature under Bless slew it, or if its remains are sprinkled with Holy Water before it returns.
sections.Actions: Fist. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Infernal return: If it dies outside the Nine Hells, its body vanishes in smoke or dissolves into ichor. It returns immediately to its home layer at full strength.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 67–69 and 76. The stat block's Hellish Rejuvenation trait gives the specific conditions for death in the Nine Hells.

name: Magmin
description: A fire spirit in a crust of black magma. It looks for things to burn whenever its summoner lets it roam.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Death Burst. At its death, each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 11 Dexterity save and takes 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failure or half on a success. Flammable objects in the area ignite if nobody is wearing or carrying them.
sections.Bonus actions: Ignited Illumination. The magmin can set itself alight or put out its flames. While lit it sheds bright light for 10 ft. and dim light for another 10 ft.
sections.Actions: Touch. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (2d6) fire damage. The strike ignites a creature or flammable object it hits. The burning target takes 3 (1d6) fire damage at the end of each of its turns until a creature takes an action to douse it.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 212. The official errata applies the ongoing Touch damage to the target and updates resistance wording.

name: Nightmare
description: A black, flame-wreathed steed that carries wicked riders between the Material and Ethereal Planes.

sections.Languages: Understands Abyssal, Common, and Infernal and cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Confer Fire Resistance. The nightmare can make any creature riding it resistant to fire damage.
Illumination. It sheds bright light for 10 ft. and dim light for another 10 ft.
sections.Actions:
Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.
Ethereal Stride. The nightmare magically crosses between the Material and Ethereal Planes. It can take up to three willing creatures within 5 ft. along.

name: Planetar
description: An angel sent to act directly on behalf of a deity. It can bring rain, summon a plague, or fight with a radiant greatsword.

sections.Damage resistances: Radiant. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Angelic Weapons. Its weapon attacks count as magical and deal an extra 5d8 radiant damage on a hit. The Greatsword entry includes that extra damage.
Divine Awareness. It recognizes a lie when it hears one.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Immortal Nature. It needs no food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma is its spellcasting ability (save DC 20). It casts these spells without material components.
At will. Detect Evil and Good, Invisibility (self only).
3/day each. Blade Barrier, Dispel Evil and Good, Flame Strike, Raise Dead.
1/day each. Commune, Control Weather, Insect Plague.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage plus 22 (5d8) radiant damage.
Healing Touch (4/day). Touch another creature. It magically regains 30 (6d8 + 3) HP and loses any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 15 and 17. Resistance wording follows the official errata.

name: Solar
description: One of the most powerful angels. Its greatsword can fly and fight on command. A shot from its longbow can kill outright.

sections.Damage resistances: Radiant. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Angelic Weapons. Its weapon attacks count as magical and deal an extra 6d8 radiant damage on a hit. The attack entries include that extra damage.
Divine Awareness. It recognizes a lie when it hears one.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Immortal Nature. It needs no food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma is its spellcasting ability (save DC 25). It casts these spells without material components.
At will. Detect Evil and Good, Invisibility (self only).
3/day each. Blade Barrier, Dispel Evil and Good, Resurrection.
1/day each. Commune, Control Weather.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatsword attacks.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 22 (4d6 + 8) slashing damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage.
Slaying Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +13 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage. A creature hit with 100 HP or fewer makes a DC 15 Constitution save or dies.
Flying Sword. Release the greatsword into an unoccupied space within 5 ft., where it hovers by magic. The sword falls if the solar dies. Effects that target the hovering sword treat the solar as holding it.
Healing Touch (4/day). Touch another creature. It magically regains 40 (8d8 + 4) HP and loses any curse, disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.
sections.Bonus actions: Command Flying Sword. While the solar sees its hovering sword, it can mentally order it to fly up to 50 ft. and either make one attack or return to the solar's hands.
sections.Legendary actions:
The solar has 3 legendary actions. It can take one option at the end of another creature's turn. It regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using them. Assuming the solar's form does not grant these actions.
Teleport. Magically teleport up to 120 ft. to a visible unoccupied space, taking worn and carried gear.
Searing Burst (2 actions). Each creature the solar chooses within 10 ft. makes a DC 23 Dexterity save against its divine magic. On a failure take 14 (4d6) fire damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage. On a success take half.
Blinding Gaze (3 actions). Choose a visible creature within 30 ft. that can see the solar. It makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is Blinded until magic, such as Lesser Restoration, removes the blindness.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 15 and 18. The official errata corrects the Slaying Longbow range and updates resistance and legendary action timing.

name: Behir
description: A many-legged hunter that clings to steep cavern walls. It swallows smaller prey and drives dragons away from its territory.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Constrict attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage. If the behir has no creature constricted, this also grapples the target (escape DC 16). The target remains Restrained until that grapple ends.
Lightning Breath (Recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 20-ft. line 5 ft. wide makes a DC 16 Dexterity save. A failure deals 66 (12d10) lightning damage and a success halves it.
Swallow. Make one Bite attack against a Medium or smaller target the behir is grappling. A hit also swallows the target and ends the grapple. Inside, the target is Blinded and Restrained, has total cover from outside attacks and effects, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the behir's turns. The behir can hold only one swallowed creature at a time.
If that creature deals at least 30 damage to the behir in a single turn, the behir makes a DC 14 Constitution save at the end of that turn. On a failure it spits the creature out, and the creature falls Prone within 10 ft. If the behir dies, it stops restraining its captive. The captive can spend 15 ft. of movement to leave the corpse, exiting Prone.

name: Bulette
description: An armored land shark that tracks footsteps through soil and bursts out beneath its prey.

sections.Traits: Standing Leap. It can long jump up to 30 ft. and high jump up to 15 ft. without a running start.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 30 (4d12 + 4) piercing damage.
Deadly Leap. After jumping at least 15 ft. during its movement, the bulette can use this action to land on its feet in an occupied space. Every other creature in that space makes a DC 16 Strength or Dexterity save, its choice. On a failure it falls Prone and takes 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage. On a success it takes half damage and is pushed 5 ft. out of the bulette's space into an unoccupied space of its choice. If no such space is available, it falls Prone in the bulette's space.

name: Dryad
description: A woodland fey bound to a living tree. She watches travelers from the grove and defends it alongside other forest creatures.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. She has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Speak with Beasts and Plants. She can communicate with beasts and plants as though they shared a language.
Tree Stride. Once on her turn, she can spend 10 ft. of movement to magically enter a living tree within reach and emerge from another living tree within 60 ft. of the first. Both trees must be Large or bigger. She appears in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the second tree.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma, save DC 14. These spells need no material components.
At will. Druidcraft.
3/day each. Entangle, Goodberry.
1/day each. Barkskin, Pass without Trace, Shillelagh.
sections.Actions:
Club. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage. With Shillelagh the attack is +6 to hit and deals 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Fey Charm. Choose a humanoid or beast she can see within 30 ft. If it can see her, it makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is magically Charmed and treats her as a trusted friend worth protecting, interpreting her actions and requests as favorably as possible. It still decides what to do.
The target can save again whenever she or an ally harms it. Any successful save ends the effect and makes the target immune to her Fey Charm for 24 hours. The charm otherwise lasts up to 24 hours, ending early if she dies, is on a different plane from the target, or dismisses it as a bonus action. She can maintain the charm on one humanoid and up to three beasts at once.

name: Hippogriff
description: A winged, eagle-fronted creature with a horse's hindquarters. A hippogriff raised in captivity can become a loyal mount.

sections.Traits: Keen Sight. It has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Beak and one Claws attack.
Beak. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

name: Pegasus
description: A shy, intelligent winged horse from Arborea. A pegasus may choose a good-aligned rider and form a lifelong bond.

sections.Languages: Understands Celestial, Common, Elvish, and Sylvan. It cannot speak.
sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Xorn
description: A three-armed earth elemental that eats coins and gems. A hungry xorn may bargain for treasure and offer news of places it has passed underground.

sections.Damage resistances: Piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine.
sections.Traits:
Earth Glide. It can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing it.
Stone Camouflage. It has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain.
Treasure Sense. By scent it pinpoints precious metals and stones, including coins and gems, within 60 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Claw attacks and one Bite.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 304. Resistance wording follows the official errata.

name: Remorhaz
description: An arctic burrower with a furnace-hot body. It cools itself while lying in wait so it can stay hidden under ice and snow.

sections.Traits: Heated Body. A creature takes 10 (3d6) fire damage if it touches the remorhaz or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 ft. of it.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 40 (6d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage. A creature hit is Grappled (escape DC 17) and Restrained until the grapple ends. During that grapple the remorhaz cannot bite another target.
Swallow. Make one Bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature the remorhaz is grappling. On a hit it takes the Bite damage, is swallowed, and is no longer grappled. Inside, it is Blinded and Restrained, has total cover from attacks and effects outside, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the remorhaz's turns.
If a creature inside deals at least 30 damage to the remorhaz in a single turn, the remorhaz makes a DC 15 Constitution save at the end of that turn. On a failure it spits out every swallowed creature. They fall Prone within 10 ft. If the remorhaz dies, it stops restraining its captives. Each can spend 15 ft. of movement to leave the corpse, exiting Prone.

name: Roper
description: It looks like a cave formation until its eye opens and its sticky tendrils reach for passing prey.

sections.Traits:
False Appearance. While motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal cave formation.
Grasping Tendrils. It can have up to six tendrils at once. Each has AC 20, 10 HP, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. Destroying one leaves the roper unharmed, and it can grow a replacement on its next turn. A creature can also use an action to break a tendril with a successful DC 15 Strength check.
Spider Climb. It climbs difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make four Tendril attacks, use Reel, then make one Bite attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Tendril. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 50 ft., one creature. A hit grapples the creature (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the creature is Restrained, has disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saves, and occupies that tendril so the roper cannot use it on another target.
Reel. Pull each creature the roper has grappled up to 25 ft. straight toward it.

name: Awakened Shrub
description: Magic gives this ordinary shrub a mind and the ability to move.

sections.Traits: False Appearance. It looks exactly like an ordinary shrub while it stays motionless.
sections.Actions: Rake. Melee weapon attack, +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1 (1d4 − 1) slashing damage.

name: Awakened Tree
description: An ordinary tree made sentient and mobile by magic. It can strike a target with its branches.

sections.Traits: False Appearance. It looks exactly like an ordinary tree while it stays motionless.
sections.Actions: Slam. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Black Pudding
description: This dark, caustic ooze can crawl along a ceiling and ruin ordinary armor and weapons.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone.
sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft. It is Blind beyond that radius.
sections.Traits:
Amorphous. It can pass through openings as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Corrosive Form. A creature takes 4 (1d8) acid damage if it touches the pudding or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft. A nonmagical metal or wooden weapon that hits takes a permanent, cumulative −1 penalty to damage rolls after dealing damage. Destroy the weapon once the total penalty reaches −5. Nonmagical metal or wooden ammunition that hits is destroyed after dealing damage. The pudding can eat through nonmagical wood or metal 2 inches thick in 1 round.
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
Ooze Nature. It does not need sleep.
sections.Actions: Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) acid damage. Nonmagical armor the target wears takes a permanent, cumulative −1 penalty to the AC the armor provides. Destroy it if the penalty reduces that AC to 10.
sections.Reactions: Split. When subjected to lightning or slashing damage while Medium or larger and at 10 HP or more, the ooze can split into two oozes. Each is one size smaller and has half the original’s current HP, rounded down.

name: Ochre Jelly
description: A yellow-brown ooze that follows prey at a distance and digests flesh without corroding ordinary gear.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone.
sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft. It is Blind beyond that radius.
sections.Traits:
Amorphous. It can pass through openings as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
Ooze Nature. It does not need sleep.
sections.Actions: Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage.
sections.Reactions: Split. When subjected to lightning or slashing damage while Medium or larger and at 10 HP or more, the ooze can split into two oozes. Each is one size smaller and has half the original’s current HP, rounded down.

name: Shrieker
description: A stationary mushroom that sounds an alarm when a creature or bright light comes near.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 30 ft. It is Blind beyond that radius.
sections.Traits: False Appearance. It looks exactly like ordinary fungus while it stays motionless.
sections.Actions: The stat block lists no actions. Use Shriek as a reaction.
sections.Reactions: Shriek. While any creature or bright light is within 30 ft., the shrieker can react by emitting a shriek audible within 300 ft. It keeps shrieking as long as the disturbance is within range, then for 1d4 of its own turns after the disturbance leaves.

name: Twig Blight
description: Dry branches twist into limbs when this blight uproots itself. It often waits near camps or watering holes.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft. It is Blind beyond that radius.
sections.Traits: False Appearance. It looks exactly like a dead shrub while it stays motionless.
sections.Actions: Claws. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

name: Violet Fungus
description: A slow purple mushroom that lashes out with stalks capable of rotting flesh.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 30 ft. It is Blind beyond that radius.
sections.Traits: False Appearance. It looks exactly like ordinary fungus while it stays motionless.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Roll 1d4 and make that many Rotting Touch attacks.
Rotting Touch. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.
sections.After the encounter: A creature the fungus kills decomposes quickly. A new violet fungus sprouts from the corpse and reaches full size in 2d6 days.

name: Blink Dog
description: A watchful fey hound that blinks out of sight and reappears close enough to bite. It attacks displacer beasts on sight.

sections.Languages: Blink Dog. It understands Sylvan but cannot speak it.
sections.Traits: Keen Hearing and Smell. The dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use hearing or smell.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.
Teleport (Recharge 4–6). The dog magically teleports up to 40 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. Its worn and carried equipment goes with it. It can make one Bite attack either before or after teleporting.

name: Cloaker
description: A cave predator with a raylike body and a lashing tail. When it folds its fins, it resembles a dark leather cloak.

sections.Traits:
Damage Transfer. While attached, the cloaker takes half of any damage dealt to it, rounded down. The creature it is attached to takes the rest.
False Appearance. If it stays still and keeps its underside hidden, it looks exactly like a dark leather cloak.
Light Sensitivity. In bright light, the cloaker has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. The cloaker attaches to a Large or smaller target. When it attaches this way, it latches onto the target's head if it had advantage on the roll, leaving that creature Blinded and unable to breathe until detached. While attached, it can Bite only that creature, and the attack has advantage. The cloaker can spend 5 ft. of movement to detach. Any creature, including the target, can detach it with an action and a successful DC 16 Strength check.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.
Moan. Each creature other than an aberration within 60 ft. that hears the moan makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failure it is Frightened until the end of the cloaker's next turn. On a success it is immune to the moan for 24 hours.
Phantasms (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). Outside bright light, the cloaker magically creates three illusory doubles that copy its motions and change positions with it. If it enters bright light, all doubles vanish. When a creature targets the cloaker with an attack or harmful spell while any double remains, randomly determine whether it targets the cloaker or one of the remaining doubles. Creatures that cannot see or rely on other senses ignore this effect. A double uses the cloaker's AC and saves. It vanishes if an attack hits it or if it fails a save against a damaging effect.

name: Darkmantle
description: A cave hunter that clings to rock formations and drops over its prey before cloaking the area in darkness.

sections.Traits:
Echolocation. The darkmantle loses the use of its blindsight while Deafened.
False Appearance. A motionless darkmantle passes for a cave formation such as a stalactite or stalagmite.
sections.Actions:
Crush. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the darkmantle attaches. If the target is Medium or smaller and the darkmantle had advantage, it engulfs the target's head. That creature is Blinded and cannot breathe while its head is engulfed. While attached, the darkmantle moves with the target. Its speed becomes 0, speed bonuses have no effect, and it can attack only the target, with advantage. A creature can take an action and succeed on a DC 13 Strength check to remove it. The darkmantle can detach on its turn by spending 5 ft. of movement.
Darkness Aura (1/Day). Magical darkness spreads around corners in a 15-ft. radius from the darkmantle and moves with it. The darkness lasts up to 10 minutes while the darkmantle maintains Concentration as if on a spell. Darkvision cannot see through it, and natural light cannot illuminate it. If it overlaps light created by a spell of 2nd level or lower, that spell is dispelled.

name: Death Dog
description: A two-headed hound that prowls deserts, plains, and the Underdark. Its bite leaves a lingering disease.

sections.Traits: Two-Headed. The dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and saves against being Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, or knocked Unconscious.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 12 Constitution save against disease or become Poisoned until cured. The diseased creature repeats the save every 24 hours. Each failure reduces its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10) until the disease is cured. It dies if this reduction brings its maximum to 0.

name: Gibbering Mouther
description: A crawling mass of chattering mouths and staring eyes. It softens the ground around it as it closes on prey.

sections.Traits:
Aberrant Ground. Ground within 10 ft. of the mouther is difficult terrain. Any creature that starts its turn in that area must pass a DC 10 Strength save or have speed 0 until the start of its next turn.
Gibbering. The mouther babbles while it can see a creature and is not Incapacitated. A creature that starts its turn within 20 ft. and hears the sound must pass a DC 10 Wisdom save. On a failure it loses reactions until the start of its next turn and rolls 1d8 for its behavior this turn.
1–4. Do nothing.
5–6. Use all movement in a randomly determined direction and take no action or bonus action.
7–8. Make one melee attack against a randomly determined creature within reach. If no such attack is possible, do nothing.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bites attack and use Blinding Spittle if available.
Bites. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 17 (5d6) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller target must pass a DC 10 Strength save or fall Prone. If the damage kills it, the mouther absorbs it.
Blinding Spittle (Recharge 5–6). Choose a point the mouther can see within 15 ft. The spittle bursts in a flash on impact there. Each creature within 5 ft. of the flash must pass a DC 13 Dexterity save or be Blinded until the end of the mouther's next turn.

name: Phase Spider
description: A spider that hunts from the Ethereal Plane. It can appear beside prey, strike, and slip out of reach.

sections.Traits:
Spider Climb. The spider climbs difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
Web Walker. Webbing does not impede the spider's movement.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 11 Constitution save. Take 18 (4d8) poison damage on a failure or half on a success. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 HP, it is Stable but Poisoned for 1 hour even if it regains HP. It is Paralyzed while Poisoned this way.
sections.Bonus actions: Ethereal Jaunt. The spider magically shifts from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane or back again.

name: Sprite
description: A tiny winged fey that guards hidden woodland homes. It judges visitors by what it senses when it touches them.

sections.Actions:
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1 slashing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 40/160 ft., one target. Hit 1 piercing damage. The target must pass a DC 10 Constitution save or be Poisoned for 1 minute. On a save result of 5 or lower, the Poisoned target also falls Unconscious for that duration. It wakes early if it takes damage or another creature uses an action to shake it awake.
Heart Sight. The sprite touches a creature and magically learns its current emotions. If the creature fails a DC 10 Charisma save, the sprite also learns its alignment. Celestials, fiends, and undead automatically fail.
Invisibility. The sprite turns magically Invisible along with all equipment it wears or carries. The effect ends when it attacks, casts a spell, or loses Concentration as if on a spell.

name: Cockatrice
description: This skittish, bat-winged bird rushes perceived threats. A bite can turn its victim to stone.

sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage and requires a DC 11 Constitution save against magical petrification. On a failure the target begins to turn to stone and becomes Restrained. It repeats the save at the end of its next turn. A success ends the effect. On a second failure, it is Petrified for 24 hours.

name: Flameskull
description: The floating skull of a dead wizard. It obeys its creator’s orders literally and can reform after it is destroyed.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, and Prone.
sections.Traits:
Illumination. It sheds either dim light out to 15 ft., or bright light out to 15 ft. with dim light for the next 15 ft. Switching between the two takes an action.
Magic Resistance. It makes saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Rejuvenation. One hour after its destruction, it reforms at full HP. Sprinkling Holy Water on the remains or casting Dispel Magic or Remove Curse on them prevents its return. If it reforms but can no longer carry out its orders, it acts independently.
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Spellcasting:
5th-level wizard, Intelligence spellcasting, save DC 13 and +5 to hit with spell attacks. It casts without somatic or material components.
Cantrip, at will. Mage Hand.
1st level, 3 slots. Magic Missile, Shield.
2nd level, 2 slots. Blur, Flaming Sphere.
3rd level, 1 slot. Fireball.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Fire Ray twice.
Fire Ray. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit 10 (3d6) fire damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 134. The official errata adds hover and immunity to Prone.

name: Gorgon
description: An iron-plated bull that tramples prey and breathes green vapor that turns creatures to stone.

sections.Traits: Trampling Charge. If it moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hits that creature with Gore on the same turn, the target must pass a DC 16 Strength save or fall Prone. If the target is Prone, the gorgon can follow up with one Hooves attack against it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 18 (2d12 + 5) piercing damage.
Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Petrifying Breath (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 30-ft. cone make a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure a creature begins turning to stone and becomes Restrained. It repeats the save at the end of its next turn. A success ends the effect. A second failure leaves it Petrified until Greater Restoration or other magic frees it.

name: Homunculus
description: A tiny construct made from clay, ash, mandrake root, and blood. It can scout and share what it senses with its creator.

sections.Languages: Understands its creator’s languages. It cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Telepathic Bond. As long as it and its creator are on the same plane, they can talk telepathically and the homunculus can magically share what it senses over any distance.
Shared Mind. It knows what its creator knows, including the languages the creator speaks and reads.
Creation. A creator can have only one homunculus. Attempts to make another while the first lives fail. The homunculus dies when its creator dies.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 1 piercing damage and requires a DC 10 Constitution save. On a failure, the target is Poisoned for 1 minute. On a failure by 5 or more, the poison instead lasts 5 (1d10) minutes and the target is Unconscious while affected by it.

name: Manticore
description: A winged lion with a humanoid face and a tail full of spikes. It often attacks from the air before closing in.

sections.Traits: Tail Spike Regrowth. The manticore starts with 24 tail spikes. Expended spikes return when it finishes a long rest.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks, or three Tail Spike attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Tail Spike. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 100/200 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Spectator
description: Beholder kin with four eyestalks, summoned as a guard. A spectator usually speaks telepathically and can turn hostile spells on nearby creatures.

sections.Languages: Deep Speech and Undercommon. Telepathy 120 ft.
sections.Summoning and service: A summoning ritual consumes four beholder eyestalks. The spectator guards an item or location chosen by its summoner for 101 years. It grants access only to the summoner unless instructed otherwise. If its guarded item is stolen or destroyed before that time runs out, the spectator vanishes. Once its term is up, it is free to leave.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 2 (1d6 − 1) piercing damage.
Eye Rays. Use up to two different magical rays, targeting one or two creatures the spectator can see within 90 ft. Each ray is limited to one use per turn.
Confusion Ray. On a failed DC 13 Wisdom save, the target loses its reactions until the end of its next turn. On that turn it cannot move, and it spends its action making a melee or ranged attack against a randomly selected creature within reach or range. If unable to attack, it does nothing that turn.
Paralyzing Ray. On a failed DC 13 Constitution save, the target is Paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the paralysis on a success.
Fear Ray. On a failed DC 13 Wisdom save, the target is Frightened for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns to end the fear. It has disadvantage on the repeat save if it can see the spectator.
Wounding Ray. The target makes a DC 13 Constitution save. It takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage on a failure, or half on a success.
Create Food and Water. Conjure enough food and water for the spectator to live on for 24 hours.
sections.Reactions: Spell Reflection. When it succeeds on a save against a spell or a spell attack misses it, the spectator can redirect the spell to another creature it can see within 30 ft., including the caster. The new target takes the spectator’s place as the target and rolls its own save if the spell calls for one. If the spell was an attack, reroll the attack against the new target.

name: Worg
description: A cunning, speaking predator sometimes ridden by goblins or hobgoblins. A mistreated mount may turn on its rider.

sections.Traits: Keen Hearing and Smell. It makes Wisdom (Perception) checks based on hearing or smell with advantage.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. A creature hit by the bite must pass a DC 13 Strength save or fall Prone.

name: Werebear
speed: 30 ft. in humanoid form. 40 ft., climb 30 ft. in bear or hybrid form.
description: A reclusive guardian that takes bear form to defend its territory. It favors claws or an axe over a bite that could spread its curse.

sections.Armor: AC 10 in humanoid form. AC 11 from natural armor in bear and hybrid forms.
sections.Damage immunities: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.
sections.Languages: Common. It cannot speak in bear form.
sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action, polymorph into a Large bear, a Large bear-humanoid hybrid, or its true humanoid form. Size and armor class change with the form. Worn and carried equipment stays as it was. Death returns it to its humanoid form.
Keen Smell. It has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on smell.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. In humanoid form, make two Greataxe attacks. In bear form, make two Claw attacks. In hybrid form, choose either pair.
Bite (bear or hybrid only). Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. A humanoid target that is not already a lycanthrope makes a DC 14 Constitution save or contracts werebear lycanthropy.
Claw (bear or hybrid only). Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Greataxe (humanoid or hybrid only). Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage.
sections.Player lycanthropy:
A character keeps its own statistics except for the changes listed here. It gains the printed nonhumanoid speeds, damage immunities, traits, and actions that require no equipment, plus proficiency with the lycanthrope's natural attacks. Use the listed natural weapon damage. The character cannot speak in animal form.
Only a humanoid that is not already a lycanthrope saves against the curse when hit by a curse-bearing attack. The Constitution save DC is 8 + the attacking lycanthrope's proficiency bonus + its Constitution modifier. A character who resists the curse keeps their usual alignment and personality in humanoid form. The full moon forces them into animal or hybrid form until it wanes. A character who embraces the curse acquires the lycanthrope's alignment and can eventually learn to shift at will. The DM can take control of the character until the curse is removed. Remove Curse can end an acquired curse. A natural-born lycanthrope needs Wish.
Raise Strength to 19 if lower. Bear and hybrid forms gain +1 AC from natural armor. Use Strength for natural weapon attack and damage rolls.
sections.Nonhuman lycanthropes: The printed blocks assume a human. For a lycanthrope of another ancestry, the DM can retain one or more traits from its humanoid form, such as Fey Ancestry for an elf.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 206–207 and 208. The player sidebar erratum clarifies curse eligibility. The profiles apply that limit to the curse-bearing attacks. Immunity wording follows the global errata.

name: Wereboar
speed: 30 ft. in humanoid or hybrid form. 40 ft. in boar form.
description: A territorial brawler that charges with its tusks in boar or hybrid form and fights with a heavy maul when it has hands.

sections.Armor: AC 10 in humanoid form. AC 11 from natural armor in boar and hybrid forms.
sections.Damage immunities: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.
sections.Languages: Common. It cannot speak in boar form.
sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action, polymorph into a boar, a boar-humanoid hybrid, or its true humanoid form. Use the listed armor class and movement for the chosen form. Worn and carried equipment stays as it was. Death returns it to its humanoid form.
Charge (boar or hybrid only). Move at least 15 ft. straight toward a target and hit it with Tusks on the same turn to deal an extra 7 (2d6) slashing damage. A creature hit this way makes a DC 13 Strength save or falls Prone.
Relentless (recharges after a short or long rest). If damage of 14 or less would drop it to 0 HP, it drops to 1 HP instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack (humanoid or hybrid only). Make two attacks, with at most one Tusks attack.
Maul (humanoid or hybrid only). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Tusks (boar or hybrid only). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. A humanoid target that is not already a lycanthrope makes a DC 12 Constitution save or contracts wereboar lycanthropy.

Raise Strength to 17 if lower. Boar and hybrid forms gain +1 AC from natural armor. Use Strength for Tusks attack and damage rolls. The Charge save DC is 8 + the character’s proficiency bonus + its Strength modifier.

name: Wererat
description: An ambusher that uses blades or crossbows in crowded streets and slips through sewers in giant rat form.

sections.Damage immunities: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.
sections.Senses: Darkvision 60 ft. in rat form only. Passive Perception 12.
sections.Languages: Common. It cannot speak in rat form.
sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action, polymorph into a giant rat, a rat-humanoid hybrid, or its true humanoid form. Use the chosen form’s size. Worn and carried equipment stays as it was. Death returns it to its humanoid form.
Keen Smell. It has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on smell.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack (humanoid or hybrid only). Make two attacks, with at most one Bite.
Bite (rat or hybrid only). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. A humanoid target that is not already a lycanthrope makes a DC 11 Constitution save or contracts wererat lycanthropy.
Shortsword (humanoid or hybrid only). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Hand Crossbow (humanoid or hybrid only). Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Weretiger
speed: 30 ft. in humanoid or hybrid form. 40 ft. in tiger form.
description: A solitary hunter that prefers the scimitar or longbow in humanoid form and can pounce in tiger or hybrid form.

sections.Damage immunities: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.
sections.Languages: Common. It cannot speak in tiger form.
sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action, polymorph into a tiger, a tiger-humanoid hybrid, or its true humanoid form. Use the chosen form’s size and listed speed. Worn and carried equipment stays as it was. Death returns it to its humanoid form.
Keen Hearing and Smell. It has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on hearing or smell.
Pounce (tiger or hybrid only). Move at least 15 ft. straight toward a creature and hit it with Claw on the same turn. The target makes a DC 14 Strength save or falls Prone. If it is Prone, the weretiger can Bite it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack (humanoid or hybrid only). In humanoid form, make two Scimitar or two Longbow attacks. In hybrid form, choose either of those pairs or two Claw attacks.

Claw (tiger or hybrid only). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

Longbow (humanoid or hybrid only). Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Werewolf
speed: 30 ft. in humanoid or hybrid form. 40 ft. in wolf form.
description: A pack hunter with acute hearing and smell. It uses a spear in human form and savages prey with its claws and bite in hybrid form.

sections.Armor: AC 11 in humanoid form. AC 12 from natural armor in wolf and hybrid forms.
sections.Damage immunities: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.
sections.Languages: Common. It cannot speak in wolf form.
sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action, polymorph into a wolf, a wolf-humanoid hybrid, or its true humanoid form. Use the listed armor class and movement for the chosen form. Worn and carried equipment stays as it was. Death returns it to its humanoid form.
Keen Hearing and Smell. It has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on hearing or smell.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack (humanoid or hybrid only). Make two Spear attacks in humanoid form. Make one Bite and one Claws attack in hybrid form.
Bite (wolf or hybrid only). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage. A humanoid target that is not already a lycanthrope makes a DC 12 Constitution save or contracts werewolf lycanthropy.
Claws (hybrid only). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.
Spear (humanoid only). Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) if used with two hands for a melee attack.
sections.Player lycanthropy:
A character keeps its own statistics except for the changes listed here. It gains the printed nonhumanoid speeds, damage immunities, traits, and actions that require no equipment, plus proficiency with the lycanthrope's natural attacks. Use the listed natural weapon damage. The character cannot speak in animal form.
Only a humanoid that is not already a lycanthrope saves against the curse when hit by a curse-bearing attack. The Constitution save DC is 8 + the attacking lycanthrope's proficiency bonus + its Constitution modifier. A character who resists the curse keeps their usual alignment and personality in humanoid form. The full moon forces them into animal or hybrid form until it wanes. A character who embraces the curse acquires the lycanthrope's alignment and can eventually learn to shift at will. The DM can take control of the character until the curse is removed. Remove Curse can end an acquired curse. A natural-born lycanthrope needs Wish.
Raise Strength to 15 if lower. Wolf and hybrid forms gain +1 AC from natural armor. Use Strength for natural weapon attack and damage rolls.
sections.Nonhuman lycanthropes: The printed blocks assume a human. For a lycanthrope of another ancestry, the DM can retain one or more traits from its humanoid form, such as Fey Ancestry for an elf.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 206–207 and 211. The player sidebar erratum clarifies curse eligibility. The profiles apply that limit to the curse-bearing attacks. Immunity wording follows the global errata. The Werewolf Multiattack also follows the errata.

name: Troll (Loathsome Limb; Severed Arm)
description: A detached troll arm that crawls and lashes out under its parent’s direction.

sections.Severing and reattachment:
When the troll takes 15 or more slashing damage from a single instance, roll a d20. On 1–10 no part is severed. On 11–14 it loses a leg if any remain. On 15–18 it loses an arm if any remain. On 19–20 it is decapitated. It survives the decapitation if it can regenerate. If the troll dies after decapitation, its severed head also dies.
A detached part acts on the troll’s initiative with its own movement and action. If the troll finishes a short or long rest before reattaching the part, a replacement grows and the old part dies. The sidebar gives no reattachment action or timing.
sections.Traits: Regeneration. The part regains 10 HP at the start of its turn. Acid or fire damage prevents that healing at the start of its next turn. Applying the troll’s Regeneration to the part, it dies when it begins its turn at 0 HP and cannot regenerate.
sections.Actions: Claw. Make one Claw attack on the arm’s turn using the parent Troll’s attack. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. The attack has disadvantage unless the troll can see both the arm and its target.
sections.Effects on the troll: Each lost arm removes one Claw attack from the troll’s Multiattack. Losing its head removes Bite, and the body is Blinded unless the head can see it. With one leg missing, halve the troll’s speed. With both legs missing, it falls Prone and can crawl if it has one or both arms. Halve its speed if it has only one arm to crawl with. With no arms or legs left, its speed is 0 and speed bonuses cannot increase it.
sections.Parent encounter: Use this procedure only with the Troll (variant). The sidebar gives each part its own AC, HP, movement and any listed attack. It gives no separate size, ability scores, challenge rating or XP. The DM decides how to resolve checks or saves the sidebar leaves unspecified.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 291, Loathsome Limbs sidebar and the Troll’s Regeneration.

name: Bandit Crime Lord
description: The boss of a bandit crew fights with a scimitar, a pair of pistols, and poisoned ammunition.

sections.Traits: Evasion. If a Dexterity save normally halves an effect's damage, take none on a success and half on a failure. Evasion is unavailable while Incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination with Scimitar and Pistol.
Scimitar. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit for 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.
Pistol. Ranged attack, +9 to hit, range 30/90 ft. Hit for 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Deadly Aim. Gain Advantage on the next attack roll this turn. A hit with that attack deals 28 (8d6) extra poison damage.

name: Bandit Deceiver
description: A bandit uses illusions to set up poisoned dagger strikes or escape pursuit.

sections.Armor: The listed AC includes Mage Armor.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Dagger attacks.
Dagger. Melee or ranged attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit for 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.
Blinding Flash (recharge 4–6). Pick a point you can see within 120 ft. Each creature in a 10-ft.-radius Sphere around that point makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, take 13 (3d6 + 3) radiant damage and become Blinded until the start of the bandit's next turn. On a success, take half damage only.
Spellcasting. Cast one of the spells listed below as an action.
sections.Spellcasting:
Intelligence, spell save DC 14.
At will. Disguise Self, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion.
1/day each. Hold Person (4th-level version), Mage Armor (included in AC), Major Image.

name: Berserker Commander
description: A frontline commander keeps allies moving even after the fight turns against them.

sections.Traits: Bloodied Frenzy. While Bloodied, gain Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination with Greataxe and Javelin.
Greataxe. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit for 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage. Deal 10 (3d6) thunder damage to either that target or another creature within 5 ft. of it.
Javelin. Melee or ranged attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit for 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing damage and reduce the target's Speed by 5 ft. until the start of the berserker's next turn.
sections.Bonus actions: Frenzied Rush. Each ally within 30 ft. can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed. The berserker can also move up to half its Speed. This movement provokes no Opportunity Attacks.

name: Pirate Admiral
description: A pirate leader presses the attack with a poisoned blade and keeps nearby companions in the fight.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination with Scimitar and Pistol.
Scimitar. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit for 16 (3d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage. Choose Awestruck to leave the target Charmed or Poison to leave it Poisoned. Either condition lasts until the start of the pirate's next turn.
Pistol. Ranged attack, +10 to hit, range 30/90 ft. Hit for 28 (4d10 + 6) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Rally (1/day). Pick up to three other creatures you can see within 30 ft. The targets gain Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of the pirate's next turn.
sections.Reactions: Defensive Stance. When a melee attack roll hits the pirate while it is holding a weapon, add 4 to its AC against melee attack rolls until the start of its next turn. Apply the bonus to the triggering attack as well. The extra AC can turn a hit into a miss.

name: Questing Knight
description: A wandering knight uses radiant attacks and an aura that steadies nearby companions.

sections.Traits: Aura of Bravery. Choose which creatures in the knight's 30-ft. Emanation to protect. Those creatures gain immunity to Charmed and Frightened while inside the aura.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination with Greatsword and Longbow.
Greatsword. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit for 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 22 (5d8) radiant damage.
Longbow. Ranged attack, +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft. Hit for 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 22 (5d8) radiant damage.
Spellcasting. Cast one of the spells listed below as an action.
sections.Spellcasting:
Charisma, spell save DC 16.
1/day each. Daylight, Dispel Evil and Good, Greater Restoration, Phantom Steed.

name: Scout Captain
description: A field leader picks out firing positions and strikes hardest when the target is exposed.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination with Shortsword and Longbow.
Shortsword. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit for 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. Add 10 (3d6) piercing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.
Longbow. Ranged attack, +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft. Hit for 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. Add 10 (3d6) piercing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.
sections.Bonus actions: Aim. Gain Advantage on the next attack roll this turn.
sections.Reactions: Uncanny Dodge. When an attack roll hits the scout, halve the damage it takes from that attack and round down.

name: Spy Master
description: An experienced infiltrator uses poisoned weapons and a smoke bomb to break contact.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination with Rapier and Hand Crossbow.
Rapier. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit for 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Hand Crossbow. Ranged attack, +9 to hit, range 30/120 ft. Hit for 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.
Smoke Bomb (1/day). Throw a bomb at a point you can see within 30 ft. Each creature in a 20-ft.-radius Sphere around that point makes a DC 16 Constitution save. On a failure, take 28 (8d6) poison damage and become Blinded until the end of the spy's next turn. On a success, take half damage only.
sections.Bonus actions: Cunning Action. Use Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

name: Animated Broom
description: An enchanted broom can dart through the air to defend the place it usually sweeps.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned.
sections.Traits: Flyby. Flying out of an enemy's reach does not provoke an Opportunity Attack.
sections.Actions: Slam. Melee attack roll, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

name: Mage Apprentice
description: A novice spellcaster with a few practiced spells, whether learned from a mentor or discovered alone.

sections.Actions:
Arcane Burst. Melee or ranged attack roll, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. On a hit, deal 14 (2d10 + 3) force damage.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell as an action. Use Intelligence, with spell save DC 13 and +5 to hit on spell attacks.
At will. Mage Hand and Prestidigitation.
1/day each. Disguise Self, Ice Knife, Mage Armor (included in AC), and Thunderwave.

name: Noble Prodigy
description: A noble whose inherited magic may be the best-kept secret in the family.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Beguiling Strike attacks.
Beguiling Strike. Melee or ranged attack roll, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. On a hit, deal 18 (4d6 + 4) psychic damage and leave the target Charmed until the start of the noble's next turn.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell as an action without Material components. Use Charisma, with spell save DC 16.
At will. Mage Armor (included in AC), Mage Hand, and Minor Illusion.
1/day each. Befuddlement, Detect Thoughts, Fly, Scrying, and Shatter cast at level 7.
sections.Reactions: Shield (2/day). Cast Shield in response to its usual trigger, using Charisma as in Spellcasting.

name: Performer
description: A local entertainer, traveling storyteller, or musician earning a name for themselves.

sections.Actions: Shortsword. Melee attack roll, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Uncanny Dodge. When an attack roll hits the performer, halve the damage the performer takes from that attack. Round down.

name: Performer Legend
description: A celebrated artist whose signature act can make an audience fear or adore them.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Bejeweled Baton attacks.
Bejeweled Baton. Melee attack roll, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 10 (2d4 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage.
Majestic Song. Center a 20-ft.-radius Sphere on a point within 120 ft. Every creature in it makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failed save, take 22 (4d8 + 4) psychic damage and become Charmed or Frightened, as the performer chooses, until the end of the performer's next turn. On a successful save, take half damage and suffer no condition.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell as an action without Material components. Use Charisma, with spell save DC 17.
At will. Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, and Prestidigitation.
1/day each. Major Image and Project Image.
sections.Reactions: Warding Charm. When a creature hits the performer with an attack roll, that creature makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failed save, the attack misses and the attacker is Charmed until the end of the performer's next turn.

name: Performer Maestro
description: A headliner whose performance can charm a room or stop a fight.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rapier attacks.
Rapier. Melee attack roll, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
Beguiling Song. Center a 20-ft.-radius Sphere on a point within 120 ft. Every creature in it makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failed save, take 20 (3d10 + 4) psychic damage and become Charmed until the end of the performer's next turn. On a successful save, take half damage and suffer no condition.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell as an action without Material components. Use Charisma, with spell save DC 15.
At will. Minor Illusion and Prestidigitation.
1/day. Tasha's Hideous Laughter cast at level 3.

name: Goblin Hexer
description: A goblin spellcaster who puts on an archmage's airs and uses magic to disrupt enemies.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Hex Stick attacks. Replace either attack with one use of Spellcasting if desired.
Hex Stick. Melee or ranged attack roll, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. On a hit, deal 12 (2d8 + 3) psychic damage.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell as an action, or in place of one attack during Multiattack. Use Intelligence, with spell save DC 13.
At will. Minor Illusion.
1/day each. Blindness/Deafness, Faerie Fire, and Grease.
sections.Reactions: Jinx. When a creature the goblin can see hits it with an attack roll, the attacker makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failed save, the attack misses.

name: Aarakocra Aeromancer
description: This birdfolk spellcaster draws on the endless storms of the Elemental Plane of Air to command wind and lightning.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Wind Staff attacks. The aarakocra can also use Spellcasting to cast Gust of Wind.
Wind Staff. Melee or ranged attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) lightning damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one of these spells as an action. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability, with save DC 13. These spells need no material components.
At will. Elementalism, Gust of Wind, Mage Hand, Message.
1/day. Lightning Bolt.
sections.Reactions: Feather Fall (1/day). Cast Feather Fall when its trigger occurs, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.
sections.Habitat: Mountains and the Elemental Plane of Air.

name: Aarakocra Skirmisher
description: The skirmisher fights in the clouds and dives at enemies on the ground.

sections.Actions:
Talons. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage. If the aarakocra moved at least 30 ft. straight toward the target immediately before hitting, the damage is 9 (3d4 + 2) instead.
Wind Javelin. Melee or ranged attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) thunder damage. After any ranged attack with it, the javelin immediately returns to the aarakocra's hand by magic.
sections.Habitat: Mountains and the Elemental Plane of Air.

name: Bullywug Bog Sage
description: This fey marsh keeper calls on swamp magic to sicken enemies and speak with plants.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The bullywug breathes air and water.
Speak with Frogs and Toads. The bullywug can express simple ideas to frogs and toads by speaking Bullywug.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bog Staff attacks. Replace either or both attacks with a use of Spellcasting to cast Ray of Sickness.
Bog Staff. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one of these spells as an action. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability, with save DC 13 and +5 to hit with spell attacks.
At will. Dancing Lights, Druidcraft, Ray of Sickness.
1/day each. Speak with Plants, Vitriolic Sphere.
sections.Bonus actions: Leap. The bullywug spends 10 ft. of movement to jump up to 30 ft.

name: Bullywug Warrior
description: These fey amphibians ambush intruders in swamps, often alongside trained Giant Frogs.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The bullywug breathes air and water.
Speak with Frogs and Toads. The bullywug can express simple ideas to frogs and toads by speaking Bullywug.
sections.Actions: Insectile Rapier. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) poison damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Leap. The bullywug spends 10 ft. of movement to jump up to 30 ft.

name: Centaur Warden
description: A fey guardian of forests, grasslands, and places of primal power.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Forest Staff or Sun Ray for each.
Forest Staff. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.
Sun Ray. Ranged attack, +7 to hit, range 90 ft. A hit deals 14 (3d6 + 4) radiant damage and leaves the target Blinded until the start of the centaur's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting: As an action, cast Druidcraft or Speak with Animals at will. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability, with save DC 15.
sections.Bonus actions: Entangling Trail (recharge 5–6). Move up to the centaur's speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature within 5 ft. of the centaur at any point during this move makes one DC 15 Strength save. On a failed save, the creature takes 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and is Restrained until the end of its next turn.

name: Azer Pyromancer
description: A living bronze smith who conjures elemental fire to heat magical forges and fend off attackers.

sections.Traits:
Fire Aura. At the end of each of the azer's turns, the azer chooses which creatures in its 5-ft. Emanation take 11 (2d10) fire damage. The aura deals no damage while the azer is Incapacitated.
Illumination. The azer sheds Bright Light for 10 ft. and Dim Light for another 10 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Flame Burst attacks.
Flame Burst. Melee or ranged attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) fire damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one of these spells as an action. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability, with save DC 15. These spells need no material components.
At will. Elementalism, Mage Hand.
1/day. Fireball.
sections.Reactions: Hellish Rebuke (2/day). Cast Hellish Rebuke when its trigger occurs, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability and save DC 15.
sections.Habitat: Mountains and the Elemental Plane of Fire.

name: Githzerai Psion
description: This psion guides a githzerai sanctuary and may lead a strike against a mind flayer colony.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Psychic Warp attacks.
Psychic Warp. Melee or ranged attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. A hit deals 26 (4d10 + 4) psychic damage. For a Large or smaller creature, the githzerai chooses whether the hit leaves the target Charmed until the start of the githzerai's next turn or knocks it Prone.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one of these spells as an action. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability, with save DC 16. These spells need no components.
At will. Mage Hand. The hand is Invisible.
1/day each. Plane Shift, See Invisibility.
sections.Reactions: Psionic Defense. Cast Feather Fall or Shield when that spell's trigger occurs. Use Intelligence as the spellcasting ability and omit all components.

name: Aboleth
description: This amphibious aberration gathers servants in sunken ruins and preserves memories of long-dead worlds.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. Breathes air and water.
Eldritch Restoration. When destroyed, the aboleth returns in a new body at full HP after 5d10 days. It reappears in the Far Realm or another location chosen by the DM.
Legendary Resistance (3/day, 4/day in its lair). It can turn a failed save into a success.
Mucus Cloud. While the aboleth is underwater, each creature within a 5-ft. Emanation from it makes a DC 14 Constitution save at the end of the aboleth’s turn. Failure curses the creature. Its skin becomes slimy, it can breathe air and water, and it can regain HP only underwater. Outside a body of water it takes 6 (1d12) acid damage at the end of every 10 minutes unless its skin is moistened before that interval is up.
Probing Telepathy. When a creature the aboleth can see talks to it telepathically, it learns that creature’s greatest desires.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Tentacle attacks, then use Consume Memories or Dominate Mind if available.
Tentacle. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 15 ft. Hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. One of the four tentacles also Grapples a target that is Large or smaller (escape DC 14).
Consume Memories. One creature within 30 ft. that the aboleth has Charmed or Grappled makes a DC 16 Intelligence save. Failure deals 10 (3d6) psychic damage and success halves it. The aboleth learns the memories of a Humanoid reduced to 0 HP by this action.
Dominate Mind (2/day). One visible creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. Failure leaves it Charmed until the aboleth dies, the two are on different planes, or the creature succeeds on a repeat save. While Charmed it acts as the aboleth’s ally, obeys its control within 60 ft., and can communicate telepathically with it at any distance. It repeats the save whenever it takes damage and after every 24 hours it spends at least 1 mile away.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 uses (4 in its lair). Spend one use immediately after another creature’s turn. Recover all uses at the start of this creature’s turn. It cannot use these actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Lash. Make one Tentacle attack.
Psychic Drain. If the aboleth has a creature Charmed or Grappled, use Consume Memories and regain 5 (1d10) HP.
sections.Regional effects:
Foul Water. Water sources within 1 mile of the lair are befouled. Anyone other than the aboleth or its allies who drinks this water must make a DC 15 Constitution save or become Poisoned for 1 hour.
Psionic Projection. In its lair the aboleth can cast Project Image without components. It uses Intelligence (save DC 16), the spell reaches 1 mile, and its telepathy can originate in the image’s space.
Both effects end immediately if the aboleth dies or its lair moves.
sections.In its lair: 7,200 XP. The traits and Legendary actions sections give the increased resource limits.

name: Beholder
description: A floating eye tyrant carves tunnels with its rays and collects the adventurers it petrifies.

sections.Traits: Legendary Resistance (3/day, 4/day in its lair). It can turn a failed save into a success.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Eye Rays three times.
Bite. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit deals 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage.
