At will. Animal Friendship, Charm Monster, and Druidcraft. Charm Monster lasts up to 24 hours and ends early if the dryad casts it again.
1/day each. Entangle and Pass without Trace.
sections.Bonus actions: Tree Stride. From within 5 ft. of a Large or larger tree, teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of another Large or larger tree that is within 60 ft. of the first.

name: Green Hag
description: A hag who uses imitations, illusions, and invisibility to draw prey into reach.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. Breathe air and water.
Mimicry. Imitate animal sounds or humanoid voices. A listener can recognize an imitation with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.
sections.Coven Magic:
While within 30 ft. of two or more hag allies, the hag can cast any of these spells at its usual casting time. Use Intelligence and save DC 11. The spells require no Material components. After casting a spell this way, the hag must finish a Long Rest to cast that same spell through Coven Magic again.
Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, and Unseen Servant.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee attack roll, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft.. On a hit, deal 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one listed spell as an action. Use Wisdom, spell save DC 12, and +4 to hit with spell attacks. The spells require no Material components.
At will. Dancing Lights, Disguise Self (24 hours), Invisibility (self only), Minor Illusion, and Ray of Sickness (3rd-level version).
The hag leaves no tracks while Invisible from this casting of Invisibility.

name: Night Hag
description: A fiend who can cross to the Ethereal Plane and trap the souls of creatures killed by her nightmares.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
Soul Bag. The hag must carry or hold this bag to use Nightmare Haunting. The bag has AC 15, 20 HP, and Resistance to all damage. At 0 HP it crumbles to dust and frees every soul inside. The hag can make another bag after 7 days.
sections.Coven Magic:
While within 30 ft. of two or more hag allies, the hag can cast any of these spells at its usual casting time. Use Intelligence and save DC 14. The spells require no Material components. After casting a spell this way, the hag must finish a Long Rest to cast that same spell through Coven Magic again.
Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, and Unseen Servant.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee attack roll, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft.. On a hit, deal 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Nightmare Haunting (1/day). While carrying or holding the soul bag on the Ethereal Plane, cast Dream using the Spellcasting ability. Only the hag can be the messenger. The target must be a creature the hag can see on the Material Plane. The use is spent and the spell fails if the target is protected by Protection from Evil and Good or is inside Magic Circle. Any Dream damage reduces the target's HP maximum by the damage it took. If Dream kills the target, its soul enters the soul bag and it can't return from the dead until its soul is released.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one listed spell as an action. Use Intelligence and spell save DC 14. The spells require no Material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Etherealness, and Magic Missile (4th-level version).
2/day each. Phantasmal Killer and Plane Shift (self only).
sections.Bonus actions: Shape-Shift. Become a Small or Medium Humanoid or return to true form. Only size changes among game statistics. Worn and carried equipment keeps its form.

name: Sea Hag
description: A coastal hag whose exposed true form can frighten victims and set up a lethal glare.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. Breathe air and water.
Vile Appearance. A Beast or Humanoid that starts its turn within 30 ft. and can see the true form makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Frightened until the start of its next turn. On a success, it is immune to this hag's Vile Appearance for 24 hours.
sections.Coven Magic:
While within 30 ft. of two or more hag allies, the hag can cast any of these spells at its usual casting time. Use Intelligence and save DC 11. The spells require no Material components. After casting a spell this way, the hag must finish a Long Rest to cast that same spell through Coven Magic again.
Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, and Unseen Servant.
sections.Actions:
Claw. Melee attack roll, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft.. On a hit, deal 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Death Glare (recharge 5–6). Pick one visible Frightened creature within 30 ft. It makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. On a failure, a target with 20 HP or fewer drops to 0 HP. A target with more than 20 HP instead takes 13 (3d8) psychic damage.
Illusory Appearance. Cast Disguise Self using Constitution and spell save DC 13. The spell lasts 24 hours.

name: Medusa
description: A snake-haired hunter whose gaze can petrify creatures in front of it, including itself if it catches its own reflection.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks and one Snake Hair attack, or make three Poison Ray attacks.
Claw. Melee attack roll, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft.. On a hit, deal 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Snake Hair. Melee attack roll, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft.. On a hit, deal 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.
Poison Ray. Ranged attack roll, +5 to hit, range 150 ft.. On a hit, deal 11 (2d8 + 2) poison damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Petrifying Gaze (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 13 Constitution save. The medusa also saves if it sees its reflection in the cone. On a first failure, the target is Restrained. If it is still Restrained at the end of its next turn, it repeats the save. Success ends the effect. A second failure replaces Restrained with Petrified.

name: Nothic
description: A one-eyed stalker that digs into minds and withers flesh with its gaze.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. The nothic makes two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.
Rotting Gaze. Choose one creature the nothic can see within 120 ft. The target makes a DC 13 Constitution save, taking 17 (5d6) Necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Bonus actions: Weird Insight (recharge 6). Choose one creature the nothic can see within 120 ft. On a failed DC 14 Wisdom save, the nothic magically learns one fact or secret about the target.

name: Grell
description: A floating ambusher that carries prey away in its paralyzing tentacles.

sections.Traits: Abduct. Moving a creature the grell is grappling costs it no extra movement.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. The grell makes one Beak attack and one Paralyzing Tentacles attack.
Beak. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 11 (2d8 + 2) Piercing damage.
Paralyzing Tentacles. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 7 (1d10 + 2) Piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, two of the grell's ten tentacles Grapple it (escape DC 12). The target also makes a DC 11 Constitution save. On a failure, it is Poisoned and remains Paralyzed while that poison lasts. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. The save succeeds automatically after 1 minute.

name: Chuul
description: An amphibious guardian that can sense magic and hold prey in either of its pincers.

sections.Languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The chuul can breathe both air and water.
Sense Magic. The chuul senses magic within 120 ft. as with Detect Magic. The sense itself is nonmagical.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. The chuul makes two Pincer attacks and uses Paralyzing Tentacles.
Pincer. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 9 (1d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, one of the chuul's two pincers Grapples it (escape DC 14).
Paralyzing Tentacles. Choose one creature Grappled by the chuul. The target makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, it is Poisoned and remains Paralyzed while that poison lasts. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. The save succeeds automatically after 1 minute.

name: Cloaker
description: A winged Underdark predator that clings to its quarry and shares any damage it takes with that victim.

sections.Traits: Light Sensitivity. The cloaker has Disadvantage on attack rolls in Bright Light.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. The cloaker makes one Attach attack and two Tail attacks.
Attach. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage. The cloaker latches onto a Large or smaller creature it hits. Until detached, that creature is Blinded and the cloaker cannot use Attach against another target. Whenever the cloaker takes damage while attached, halve the damage and round down. The cloaker and the attached creature each take that amount. The cloaker can spend 5 ft. of movement to detach. The attached creature or a creature within 5 ft. of it can take an action to detach the cloaker with a successful DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check.
Tail. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions:
Moan. Each creature in a 60-ft. Emanation from the cloaker makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. A creature that fails is Frightened until the end of the cloaker's next turn. A creature that succeeds is immune to this cloaker's Moan for 24 hours.
Phantasms (recharges after a Short or Long Rest). The cloaker casts Mirror Image using Wisdom and no spell components. The spell ends early if the cloaker starts or ends its turn in Bright Light.

name: Gibbering Mouther
description: A crawling mass of eyes and mouths that turns nearby ground treacherous and disrupts its victims with incessant babble.

sections.Traits:
Aberrant Ground. Ground in a 10-ft. Emanation from the mouther is Difficult Terrain.
Gibbering. The mouther babbles whenever it is free of the Incapacitated condition. Each creature starting its turn within 20 ft. while it babbles makes a DC 10 Wisdom save. On a failure, roll 1d8 to determine that creature's behavior for the current turn.
1–4. It does nothing.
5–6. It takes no action or Bonus Action and spends all its movement moving in a random direction.
7–8. It makes a melee attack against a randomly chosen creature within reach. If it cannot make this attack, it does nothing.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 7 (2d6) Piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it falls Prone. A target reduced to 0 HP by this attack dies. The mouther absorbs the body and leaves the equipment behind.
Blinding Spittle (recharge 5–6). Choose a point within 30 ft. Each creature in a 10-ft.-radius Sphere centered there makes a DC 10 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 7 (2d6) Radiant damage and is Blinded until the end of the mouther's next turn.

name: Flumph
description: A hovering Underdark aberration that can hear nearby telepathy and fend off threats with foul-smelling spray.

sections.Languages: understands Undercommon but can't speak. telepathy 60 ft.
sections.Traits:
Advanced Telepathy. The flumph perceives the content of telepathic communication within 60 ft.
Prone Deficiency. When the flumph becomes Prone, roll a die. An odd result leaves it Incapacitated. At the end of each of its turns, it makes a DC 10 Dexterity save to end that Incapacitated condition.
Telepathic Shroud. Its thoughts are unreadable by any means. Magic cannot find its location or observe it from afar.
sections.Actions:
Tentacle. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 4 (1d4 + 2) Acid damage.
Stench Spray (1/day). Choose one creature the flumph can see within 15 ft. The target makes a DC 10 Dexterity save. On a failure, a foul liquid coats the target, causing a stench for 1d4 hours and leaving it Poisoned while the stench lasts. Other creatures are Poisoned while in a 5-ft. Emanation from the coated target. The target can end the stench early by bathing during a Short or Long Rest.

name: Spectator
description: A floating beholderkin that guards its charge with four magical eye rays.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. The spectator uses Eye Rays twice.
Bite. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.
Eye Rays. Choose a target the spectator can see within 90 ft. and roll 1d4 for a magical ray. Reroll any ray the spectator has already used this turn.
1. Confusion Ray. DC 12 Wisdom save. On a failure, the target takes 5 (2d4) Psychic damage and cannot take Reactions until the end of its next turn. On that turn it cannot move and must use its action to make a melee or ranged attack against a random creature within range. It does nothing if it cannot attack.
2. Paralyzing Ray. DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, the target is Paralyzed. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. The save succeeds automatically after 1 minute.
3. Fear Ray. DC 12 Wisdom save. On a failure, the target takes 5 (2d4) Psychic damage and is Frightened until the end of its next turn.
4. Wounding Ray. DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, deal 16 (3d10) Necrotic damage. A success halves the damage.
sections.Reactions: Spell Reflection. After the spectator succeeds on a save against a spell or a spell attack roll misses it, choose one creature the spectator can see within 120 ft. The chosen creature makes a DC 12 Dexterity save, taking 10 (3d6) Force damage on a failure.

name: Mummy
classification: Small or Medium undead, lawful evil
description: Burial rites tether the spirits of priests, nobles, and champions to their remains. They rise when their tombs are disturbed or when called to fulfill an old duty.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rotting Fist attacks and use Dreadful Glare.
Rotting Fist. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. A creature hit is cursed. While cursed, it cannot regain HP or restore its HP maximum by finishing a Long Rest. Its HP maximum drops by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours. A creature reduced to 0 HP by the attack dies and crumbles to dust. Remove Curse or comparable magic ends the curse.
Dreadful Glare. Choose a creature the mummy can see within 60 ft. The target makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. On failure, it is Frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn. Success makes it immune to this mummy's Dreadful Glare for 24 hours.

name: Mummy Lord
classification: Small or Medium undead (cleric), lawful evil
description: A mummy lord trades its heart for immortality and hides the organ away from its body. From an old palace or temple, it raises servants and pursues plans that can span centuries.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). After failing a saving throw, the mummy lord can make it a success.
Magic Resistance. It has Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Undead Restoration. If destroyed while its heart is intact, it forms a new body with full HP after 24 hours. The body appears in an unoccupied space in its lair. The heart is a Tiny object with AC 17, 10 HP, and immunity to every damage type except fire.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack, and use Dreadful Glare.
Rotting Fist. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. A creature hit is cursed. While cursed, it cannot regain HP and gains no benefit from a Long Rest. Its HP maximum drops by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours. A creature reduced to 0 HP by the attack dies and crumbles to dust. Remove Curse or comparable magic ends the curse.
Channel Negative Energy. Ranged attack, +9 to hit, range 60 ft. Hit 25 (6d6 + 4) necrotic damage.
Dreadful Glare. Choose a creature the mummy lord can see within 60 ft. The target makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On failure, it takes 25 (6d6 + 4) psychic damage and is Paralyzed until the end of the mummy lord's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, the mummy lord casts one listed spell without Material components. Wisdom is its spellcasting ability (save DC 17, spell attack +9).
At will. Dispel Magic, Thaumaturgy.
1/day each. Animate Dead, Harm, Insect Plague (level 7).
sections.Reactions: Whirlwind of Sand. When hit by an attack roll, the mummy lord gains +2 AC against that attack, which can turn the hit into a miss. It teleports up to 60 ft. to a visible unoccupied space. Creatures it chooses and can see within 5 ft. of its destination are Blinded until the end of its next turn.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 uses (4 in its lair). Spend one use immediately after another creature's turn. Recover all uses at the start of the mummy lord's turn. It cannot use these actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Glare. Use Dreadful Glare. The mummy lord can use Glare again at the start of its next turn or later.
Necrotic Strike. Make one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack.
Dread Command. Cast Command at level 2 with Wisdom as in Spellcasting (DC 17). The mummy lord can use Dread Command again at the start of its next turn or later.
sections.In its lair: 15,000 XP, 4 uses of Legendary Resistance per day, and 4 Legendary Action uses.
sections.Regional effects:
Cursed Fate. When a creature other than the mummy lord or its allies casts a Divination spell within 1 mile of the lair, it makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On failure, the spell has no effect and the action, Bonus Action, or Reaction used to cast it is spent. The caster keeps the resources it would have spent on the spell.
Soul Drain. Creatures within 1 mile of the lair have Disadvantage on Death Saving Throws.
Both effects stop immediately if the mummy lord is destroyed or relocates its lair. They resume when it forms a new body through Undead Restoration.

name: Flameskull
description: The skull of a dead spellcaster flies under its own power and burns with magic. It might watch a necromancer's stronghold or chase an ambition its former self never fulfilled.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, prone.
sections.Traits:
Illumination. It emits Bright Light for 15 ft. and Dim Light for another 15 ft.
Magic Resistance. It has Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Undead Restoration. A destroyed flameskull recovers all its HP after 1 hour. Sprinkling Holy Water on the remains or casting Dispel Evil and Good on them prevents the return.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Fire Ray attacks.
Fire Ray. Melee or ranged attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit 13 (3d6 + 3) fire damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, the flameskull casts one listed spell without Somatic or Material components. Intelligence is its spellcasting ability (save DC 13).
At will. Mage Hand.
1/day. Fireball.
2/day. Magic Missile (level 2).

name: Ghast
description: A ghast is a foul-smelling corpse that hungers for flesh and the vices it knew in life. Ghasts often lead ghoul packs into crypts to raid the graves.

sections.Traits: Stench. Each creature that starts its turn in a 5-ft. Emanation from the ghast makes a DC 10 Constitution save. On failure, it is Poisoned until the start of its next turn. On success, it is immune to this ghast's Stench for 24 hours.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.
Claw. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. A creature other than an Undead makes a DC 10 Constitution save after the hit. On failure, it is Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

name: Ghoul
description: Ghouls scavenge graves and hunt in packs through catacombs and ruins. Their claws paralyze prey before they feed.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.
Claw. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage. A creature other than an Undead or an elf makes a DC 10 Constitution save after the hit. On failure, it is Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

name: Shadow
description: A shadow haunts a place it knew in life or a site touched by the Shadowfell. It feeds on the living, and its victims can rise as new shadows.

sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Amorphous. It moves through gaps as narrow as 1 inch at its usual movement cost.
Sunlight Weakness. While in sunlight, it has Disadvantage on all D20 Tests.
sections.Actions: Draining Swipe. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) necrotic damage and reduce the target's Strength score by 1d4. If this drops that score to 0, the target dies. A Humanoid slain by the attack rises as a Shadow after 1d4 hours.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. Take the Hide action while in Dim Light or Darkness.

ruleNotes: Draining Swipe leaves the duration of the Strength reduction unspecified.

name: Specter
description: A specter is an angry spirit drawn to places soaked in grief or cruelty. It drains the vigor of the living for a brief taste of the warmth it has lost.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, piercing, slashing, thunder.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious.
sections.Languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Incorporeal Movement. It can pass through creatures and objects at the cost of Difficult Terrain movement. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
Sunlight Sensitivity. Sunlight gives the specter Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
sections.Actions: Life Drain. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. A creature hit loses an equal amount from its HP maximum.

name: Ankheg
description: A burrowing insectoid predator bursts out of its tunnel to seize prey in its mandibles or spray acid at creatures nearby.

sections.Traits: Tunneler. The ankheg can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed, leaving a tunnel 10 ft. in diameter.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. The ankheg has Advantage if it already has the target Grappled. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage. A Large or smaller creature hit by the bite is Grappled, escape DC 13.
Acid Spray (recharge 6). Each creature in a line 30 ft. long and 5 ft. wide makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. It takes 14 (4d6) acid damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Basilisk
description: This many-legged reptile can turn creatures to stone with its gaze. A reflection can subject the basilisk to its own magic.

sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Petrifying Gaze (recharge 4–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 12 Constitution save. The basilisk also saves if it sees its own reflection in the cone. An initial failure makes the creature Restrained. If the creature is still Restrained at the end of its next turn, it repeats the save. Success ends the effect. On a second failure, Petrified replaces Restrained.

name: Cockatrice
description: A cockatrice is a small, winged creature with a rooster-like head. Its bite can leave a creature petrified for a day.

sections.Actions: Petrifying Bite. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage. A creature hit by the bite also makes a DC 11 Constitution save. Failure makes it Restrained. If it is still Restrained at the end of its next turn, it repeats the save. Success ends the effect. On a second failure, it becomes Petrified for 24 hours and is no longer Restrained.

name: Chimera
description: A chimera combines a lion, a goat, and a dragon in one body. Its three heads can attack together while its wings carry it above the battlefield.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Ram, one Bite, and one Claw attack. The chimera can use Fire Breath in place of Claw if the breath is available.
Bite. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing damage if the chimera had Advantage on the attack.
Claw. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.
Ram. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 10 (1d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit by the attack also falls Prone.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. It takes 31 (7d8) fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Gorgon
description: A gorgon resembles a metal-plated bull. Its charge can knock foes down, and its breath can turn them to stone.

sections.Actions:
Gore. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 18 (2d12 + 5) piercing damage. A Large or smaller creature hit by the attack falls Prone if the gorgon moved at least 20 ft. straight toward it immediately before the hit.
Petrifying Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 15 Constitution save. An initial failure makes the creature Restrained. If it is still Restrained at the end of its next turn, it repeats the save. Success ends the effect. On a second failure, Petrified replaces Restrained.
sections.Bonus actions: Trample. Choose one Prone creature within 5 ft. It makes a DC 16 Dexterity save and takes 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Hydra
description: A hydra fights with all of its heads at once. Cutting down a head gives it a chance to grow two, and fire can interrupt that regrowth.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, Unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Hold Breath. The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.
Multiple Heads. The hydra starts with five heads. Each time it takes at least 25 damage on a single turn, one head dies. The hydra dies when it loses its last head. At the end of each of its turns, if it has a living head and has taken no fire damage since its last turn, it grows two heads for each head that died since its last turn. Growing new heads restores 20 HP.
Reactive Heads. Each head after the first grants one additional Reaction that the hydra can use only to make an Opportunity Attack.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack per living head.
Bite. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

name: Wyvern
description: A wyvern hunts from the air and strikes with its jaws and venomous tail.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Sting attack.
Bite. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Sting. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 24 (7d6) poison damage. The target is Poisoned until the start of the wyvern's next turn.

name: Animated Armor
description: A suit of armor comes to life, often in a sentry post where it can pass for a decoration until it moves.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

name: Iron Golem
description: This metal guardian can stand watch for generations. Its magical core turns fire into a source of healing and lets it burn or poison intruders.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Languages: Understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Fire Absorption. Exposure to fire damage restores HP equal to the fire damage dealt.
Immutable Form. The golem cannot change shape.
Magic Resistance. The golem rolls saves against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Bladed Arm and Fiery Bolt.
Bladed Arm. Melee attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 20 (3d8 + 7) slashing damage and 10 (3d6) fire damage.
Fiery Bolt. Ranged attack, +10 to hit, range 120 ft. On a hit, deal 36 (8d8) fire damage.
Poison Breath (recharge 6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 18 Constitution save against 55 (10d10) poison damage. A success halves the damage.
sections.Orders (1d4):
1. Block a door no one has opened until a prophecy comes true.
2. Vent poison whenever possible unless someone uses the password.
3. Keep still like a statue until the community truly needs help.
4. Stand guard over the place where a potent magic item lies.

name: Clay Golem
description: A sculpted guardian made from earth tied to the place it protects. It can keep its watch long after its creator dies.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Acid Absorption. Replace acid damage with healing equal to the amount of that damage.
Berserk. At the start of each of the golem's turns, if it is Bloodied, roll 1d6. On a 6, it goes berserk. On its turns in that state, it attacks the nearest creature it can see. If it cannot move close enough to attack a creature, it attacks an object. The state ends when it is destroyed or stops being Bloodied.
Immutable Form. The golem cannot change shape.
Magic Resistance. The golem rolls saves against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks. Make three if the golem used Hasten this turn.
Slam. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage and 6 (1d12) acid damage. Reduce the target's HP maximum by the acid damage it took.
sections.Bonus actions: Hasten (recharge 5–6). The golem takes both the Dash and Disengage actions.
sections.Orders (1d4):
1. Stop anyone entering with a weapon drawn.
2. Protect the creator's family or community when a threat is in sight.
3. Bar Fiends from crossing a bridge.
4. Remove visitors from the creator's workshop.

name: Flesh Golem
description: A maker animates a body assembled from several others. Fragments of the former lives sometimes surface in its behavior.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Aversion to Fire. Taking fire damage gives the golem Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks through the end of its next turn.
Berserk. At the start of each of the golem's turns, if it is Bloodied, roll 1d6. On a 6, it goes berserk. On its turns in that state, it attacks the nearest creature it can see. If it cannot move close enough to attack a creature, it attacks an object. The state ends when it is destroyed or stops being Bloodied. Its creator can use an action within 60 ft. to try a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check, provided the golem can hear them. A success stops the frenzy through the start of the golem's next turn, when it rolls again if still Bloodied.
Immutable Form. The golem cannot change shape.
Lightning Absorption. Exposure to lightning damage restores HP equal to the lightning damage dealt.
Magic Resistance. The golem rolls saves against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and 4 (1d8) lightning damage.
sections.Appearance (1d6):
1. Humanlike and animal parts stitched together.
2. Heavy clothing and makeup hide the seams.
3. Gaps in the body's assembly lie exposed.
4. Body parts serve unusual purposes, such as hands covering the torso.
5. Fine stitching frames nearly flawless features.
6. Visible bellows or other machinery move the body.

name: Stone Golem
description: These animated statues often guard tombs, sanctuaries, and monuments well after their makers are gone.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Languages: Understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. The golem cannot change shape.
Magic Resistance. The golem rolls saves against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Slam and Force Bolt.
Slam. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and 9 (2d8) force damage.
Force Bolt. Ranged attack, +9 to hit, range 120 ft. On a hit, deal 22 (4d10) force damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Slow (recharge 5–6). Cast Slow with no spell components. Use Constitution as its spellcasting ability, with a save DC of 17.
sections.Orders (1d6):
1. Admit only visitors in ceremonial clothing.
2. Cast Slow on anyone who touches the city's prized relic, then help capture them.
3. Break a particular dam or bridge when ordered by the holder of the ruler's medallion.
4. Obey whoever returns a lost crest to its chest, then shut down for a year.
5. Show the secret passage to anyone who repeats the ruler's final words.
6. Hunt the kind of monster that killed the hero the golem depicts.

name: Helmed Horror
description: A suit of animated armor with a soldier's judgment. It follows its maker's commands and can withstand spells its maker chose in advance.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned.
sections.Languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The horror rolls saves against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
Spell Immunity. Its creator chooses three spells to which it is immune. Heat Metal, Lightning Bolt, and Magic Missile are common choices.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Arcane Sword attacks.
Arcane Sword. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage and 5 (1d10) force damage.
sections.Directives (1d6):
1. Fly its master's palanquin to its destination.
2. Keep a treasure safe by fitting it into the armor.
3. Wear a missing or dead hero's gear and impersonate them.
4. Work as a servant or laborer.
5. Join a legion made from the armor of earlier defenders.
6. Stand guard among suits of mundane armor.

name: Shield Guardian
description: A magical bodyguard follows whoever wears its command amulet. It can shield that wearer from harm and hold a spell for later use.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Languages: Understands commands given in any language but can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Bound. While the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane, the wearer can call it telepathically to the amulet. On that plane, the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. Whenever the wearer takes damage within 60 ft. of the guardian, transfer half that damage to the guardian, rounding up.
Regeneration. It begins each of its turns by regaining 10 HP if it has at least 1 HP.
Spell Storing. A spellcaster wearing the amulet can cast a spell of level 4 or lower on the guardian from within 5 ft. The spell takes no immediate effect and replaces any spell already stored. The guardian can later cast it with the original caster's parameters and spellcasting ability, without components. Casting uses up the stored spell.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Fist attacks.
Fist. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and 7 (2d6) force damage.
sections.Reactions: Protection. When an attack roll hits the amulet's wearer within 5 ft. of the guardian, give the wearer +5 AC until the start of the guardian's next turn. The bonus applies to the triggering attack and can cause it to miss.

name: Dao
description: An earth genie that glides through unworked stone and bargains for gems, metalwork, or fossils.

sections.Traits:
Earth Glide. The dao can burrow through unworked, nonmagical earth and stone without disturbing it.
Elemental Restoration. If the genie dies outside the Elemental Plane of Earth, its body dissolves into dirt. It returns at full HP in a new body somewhere on that plane after 1d4 days.
Magic Resistance. Roll saving throws against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
Wishes. Roll a 30 percent chance that this genie knows Wish. It can cast the spell solely on behalf of a non-genie who expresses a wish it understands. Casting this way causes the genie no stress from the spell. After three castings, it must wait 365 days before casting Wish again.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Earthen Maul attacks or two Earth Burst attacks.
Earthen Maul. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 20 (4d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and knocks a Large or smaller creature Prone.
Earth Burst. Ranged attack, +10 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. Hit or miss, a blast erupts from the target's space. The target and each other creature in the 10-ft. Emanation centered there make a DC 16 Dexterity save. A failed save deals 10 (3d6) thunder damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Spellcasting. As an action, cast one listed spell with Charisma and no Material components. Spell save DC 16.
At will. Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic, Stone Shape.
1/day each. Gaseous Form, Invisibility, Move Earth, Passwall, Plane Shift, Tongues, Wall of Stone.

name: Djinni
description: An air genie that roams stormy coasts and cloud palaces. It may trade stories for lore from other worlds.

sections.Traits:
Elemental Restoration. If the genie dies outside the Elemental Plane of Air, its body dissolves into mist. It returns at full HP in a new body somewhere on that plane after 1d4 days.
Magic Resistance. Roll saving throws against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
Wishes. Roll a 30 percent chance that this genie knows Wish. It can cast the spell solely on behalf of a non-genie who expresses a wish it understands. Casting this way causes the genie no stress from the spell. After three castings, it must wait 365 days before casting Wish again.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using any mix of Storm Blade and Storm Bolt.
Storm Blade. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) lightning damage.
Storm Bolt. Ranged attack, +9 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 13 (3d8) thunder damage and knocks a Large or smaller creature Prone.
Create Whirlwind. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. The whirlwind fills a 20-ft.-radius, 60-ft.-high Cylinder at that point and lasts until the djinni's Concentration ends. At the start of each of its turns, the djinni can move the whirlwind up to 20 ft. When a creature enters the whirlwind or the whirlwind enters its space, it makes a DC 17 Strength save, at most once per turn. The djinni is unaffected. On a failure, the target is Restrained while in the whirlwind and moves with it. While Restrained this way, it takes 21 (6d6) thunder damage at the start of each of its turns and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. Success ends the effect on that creature.
sections.Spellcasting:
Spellcasting. As an action, cast one listed spell with Charisma and no Material components. Spell save DC 17.
At will. Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic.
2/day each. Create Food and Water (can make wine instead of water), Tongues, Wind Walk.
1/day each. Creation, Gaseous Form, Invisibility, Major Image, Plane Shift.

name: Efreeti

sections.Lair resources: The encounter is worth 50,000 XP in the lair. The dragon has 5 daily Legendary Resistance uses and 4 legendary action uses there.
sections.Regional effects:
Beast Spies. Within 1 mile of the lair, Tiny Beasts can magically understand Draconic and communicate telepathically with the dragon.
Poisonous Thicket. Ordinary plants poison the air within 1 mile of the lair. A creature other than the dragon or one of its allies that finishes a Long Rest in the area makes a DC 15 Constitution save or becomes Poisoned for 1 hour.
Both effects end immediately when the dragon dies or moves its lair.

name: Ancient Red Dragon
description: This dragon rules a lair surrounded by extreme heat and drifting ash.

sections.Traits: Legendary Resistance (4/day, or 5/day in its lair). When it fails a save, it can spend a use to succeed instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. The dragon can replace one with level 3 Scorching Ray through Spellcasting.
Rend. Melee attack, +17 to hit, reach 15 ft. Hit 19 (2d8 + 10) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 90-ft. cone makes a DC 24 Dexterity save. Failure deals 91 (26d6) Fire damage. Success halves the damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Casting one of these spells takes an action. Charisma is the spellcasting ability (save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks). The spells require no Material components.
At will. Command (level 2), Detect Magic, Scorching Ray (level 3).
1/day each. Fireball (level 6), Scrying.
sections.Legendary actions:
It has 3 uses, or 4 in its lair. It can spend one use on one option immediately after another creature’s turn. It regains spent uses at the start of its turn. It cannot take legendary actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Commanding Presence. Cast level 2 Command through Spellcasting. The dragon cannot choose this option again until the start of its next turn.
Fiery Rays. Cast level 3 Scorching Ray through Spellcasting. The dragon cannot choose this option again until the start of its next turn.
Pounce. Move up to half its Speed and make one Rend attack.
sections.Lair resources: The encounter is worth 75,000 XP in the lair. The dragon has 5 daily Legendary Resistance uses and 4 legendary action uses there.
sections.Regional effects:
Burning Heat. The area within 1 mile of the lair is subject to Extreme Heat. A burning creature or object takes 1d4 extra Fire damage at the start of each of its turns.
Smoldering Haze. Ash leaves the area within 1 mile of the lair Lightly Obscured. A creature other than the dragon or one of its allies that finishes a Long Rest there must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or become Poisoned for 1 hour.
Both effects end immediately when the dragon dies or moves its lair.

name: Ancient White Dragon
speed: 40 ft., burrow 40 ft., fly 80 ft., swim 40 ft.
description: This arctic dragon crosses ice effortlessly. Chilly fog and dangerously cold water surround its lair.

sections.Traits:
Ice Walk. It can cross and climb icy surfaces without an ability check. Difficult Terrain made of ice or snow costs it no extra movement.
Legendary Resistance (4/day, or 5/day in its lair). When it fails a save, it can spend a use to succeed instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +14 to hit, reach 15 ft. Hit 17 (2d8 + 8) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage.
Cold Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 90-ft. cone makes a DC 22 Constitution save. Failure deals 63 (14d8) Cold damage. Success halves the damage.
sections.Legendary actions:
It has 3 uses, or 4 in its lair. It can spend one use on one option immediately after another creature’s turn. It regains spent uses at the start of its turn. It cannot take legendary actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Freezing Burst. Center a 30-ft.-radius sphere on a visible point within 120 ft. Each creature inside makes a DC 20 Constitution save. On failure, it takes 14 (4d6) Cold damage and its Speed is 0 until the end of the affected creature's next turn. The dragon must wait until the start of its next turn to choose this option again, regardless of the save result.
Frightful Presence. Cast Fear without Material components, using Charisma (save DC 18). The dragon cannot choose this option again until the start of its next turn.
Pounce. Move up to half its Speed and make one Rend attack.
sections.Lair resources: The encounter is worth 33,000 XP in the lair. The dragon has 5 daily Legendary Resistance uses and 4 legendary action uses there.
sections.Regional effects:
Frigid Cold. The area within 1 mile of the lair is subject to Extreme Cold. Water there counts as Frigid Water. Use the Dungeon Master's Guide hazard rules for both.
Glacial Gloom. Chilly fog leaves the area within 1 mile of the lair Lightly Obscured. A creature other than the dragon or one of its allies that finishes a Long Rest there must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or have its Speed reduced by 10 ft. for 1 hour.
Both effects end immediately when the dragon dies or moves its lair.

name: Carrion Crawler
description: A segmented scavenger that clings to ceilings above carrion. It uses the tentacles around its jaws to paralyze prey.

sections.Traits: Spider Climb. The crawler needs no ability check to cross difficult climbing surfaces or move along ceilings.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Paralyzing Tentacles once and make one Bite attack.
Bite. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.
Paralyzing Tentacles. Choose one visible creature within 10 ft. It makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, the creature is Poisoned and remains Paralyzed while this Poisoned condition lasts. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. The save automatically succeeds after 1 minute.

name: Displacer Beast
description: A six-legged feline stalker with a barbed tentacle at each shoulder. Its projected image makes enemies strike at the wrong spot.

sections.Traits:
Avoidance. If an effect normally deals half damage on a successful save, the beast takes no damage on a success and half on a failure. The trait is inactive while the beast is Incapacitated.
Displacement. Its projected image gives attacks against it Disadvantage. The trait is inactive while the beast is Incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Rend and one Tentacle attack.
Rend. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage. A Large or smaller creature hit by Rend falls Prone.
Tentacle. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

name: Hook Horror
description: A beaked Underdark predator with hooked forelimbs. It uses echoes to navigate caves and crosses ceilings in search of food.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Hook attacks.
Hook. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, move it 5 ft. straight toward or away from the hook horror.

name: Grick
description: A solitary hunter whose four tentacles seize prey and draw it close to a hard beak.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Beak and one Tentacles attack.
Beak. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Tentacles. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit by the attack is Grappled by all four tentacles, escape DC 12.

name: Phase Spider
description: A horse-sized Ethereal Plane spider that watches the Material Plane for prey and shifts across to attack.

sections.Traits:
Ethereal Sight. It sees up to 60 ft. into the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane and up to 60 ft. into the Material Plane from the Ethereal Plane.
Spider Climb. It can cross difficult climbing surfaces and move along ceilings without an ability check.
Web Walker. Webs impose no movement restrictions on the spider. It knows the location of any other creature touching the same web.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage. If the Bite damage drops the target to 0 HP, the target becomes Stable and is Poisoned for 1 hour. It is also Paralyzed while this Poisoned condition lasts.
sections.Bonus actions: Ethereal Jaunt. Teleport to the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane or to the Material Plane from the Ethereal Plane.
sections.Habitats: Desert, Forest, Grassland, Hill, Planar (Ethereal Plane), Underdark, Urban.

name: Roper
description: A subterranean hunter that looks like a rock formation. It uses long tentacles to reel creatures into biting range.

sections.Traits: Spider Climb. The roper climbs difficult surfaces and traverses ceilings without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Tentacle attacks, use Reel, and make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Tentacle. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 60 ft. On a hit, one of its six tentacles Grapples the target, escape DC 14. The target is Poisoned until the grapple ends. Each tentacle has AC 20, 10 HP, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. Damage to a tentacle does not harm the roper. Destroying a tentacle frees its captive. The tentacle regrows at the start of the roper's next turn.
Reel. Pull each creature the roper has Grappled up to 30 ft. straight toward it.
sections.Roper hazards:
Roll 1d8 or choose a hazard for its ambush.
1. A route that trips a trap.
2. A cavern full of smoke or gas.
3. A dead magic or wild magic zone.
4. A creature's lair, where the prey may draw the occupant out.
5. A nest of vermin.
6. Brown mold or green slime.
7. A pool of magma or boiling water.
8. Razorvine or another dangerous plant.

name: Darkmantle
description: This ceiling hunter resembles a stalactite until it drops and spreads its webbed tentacles over its prey.

sections.Actions:
Crush. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and attach to the target. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the darkmantle had Advantage on the attack roll, it covers the target. The covered creature is Blinded and suffocates until the darkmantle detaches. While attached, the darkmantle can attack only the target and has Advantage on its attacks. Its Speed becomes 0, and bonuses cannot increase it. It moves with the target. A creature can take an action to detach the darkmantle from itself with a successful DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check. The darkmantle can spend 5 ft. of movement on its own turn to detach.
Darkness Aura (1/day). Magical Darkness fills a 15-ft. Emanation centered on the darkmantle. The aura lasts for as long as it maintains Concentration, up to 10 minutes. Darkvision cannot see through the darkness, and no light can illuminate the area.
sections.Suffocation hazard: A creature suffocating under the darkmantle gains 1 level of Exhaustion at the end of each of its turns. Once it can breathe again, remove the levels it gained from suffocation.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), p. 90. Suffocation follows the 2024 rules glossary.

name: Cloud Giant
description: Cloud giants watch the lands below from mountain citadels and palaces that drift through the sky. Some record what they see, while others meddle in the affairs of smaller folk.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Thunderous Mace and Thundercloud in any combination. The giant can replace one attack with casting Fog Cloud through Spellcasting.
Thunderous Mace. Melee attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) thunder damage.
Thundercloud. Ranged attack, +12 to hit, range 240 ft. On a hit, deal 18 (3d6 + 8) thunder damage and give the target the Incapacitated condition until the end of the target's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma with a save DC of 15 and no Material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Fog Cloud, Light.
1/day each. Control Weather, Gaseous Form, Telekinesis.
sections.Bonus actions: Misty Step. Cast Misty Step using Charisma, the ability used for Spellcasting.

name: Fire Giant
description: Fire giants build fortress-forges near molten rock. Some arm armies for conquest, while others trade their metalwork and teach Giant forging techniques.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Flame Sword and Hammer Throw in any combination.
Flame Sword. Melee attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 21 (4d6 + 7) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.
Hammer Throw. Ranged attack, +11 to hit, range 60/240 ft. On a hit, deal 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) fire damage. Push the target up to 15 ft. straight away from the giant. The target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

name: Frost Giant
description: Frost giants hunt and build strongholds in tundras and glacial mountains. Some raid for supplies, while others trade protection for goods from nearby Fey or fire giants.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Frost Axe and Great Bow in any combination.
Frost Axe. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 19 (2d12 + 6) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.
Great Bow. Ranged attack, +9 to hit, range 150/600 ft. On a hit, deal 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage and reduce the target's Speed by 10 ft. until the end of the target's next turn.
sections.Bonus actions: War Cry (recharge 5–6). The giant chooses itself or one creature that can see or hear it. That creature gains 16 (2d10 + 5) Temporary Hit Points and has Advantage on attack rolls until the start of the giant's next turn.

name: Hill Giant
description: Hill giants make weapons and tools from timber, stone, and hides. They guard the valleys that feed them, though an entertaining visitor might be invited to share a meal.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Tree Club and Trash Lob in any combination.
Tree Club. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit by the club falls Prone.
Trash Lob. Ranged attack, +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft. On a hit, deal 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage and give the target the Poisoned condition until the end of the target's next turn.

name: Stone Giant
description: Stone giants blend into the rock of their caverns and canyons. They seldom intervene in their neighbors' affairs, but they defend their homes and places of ancient wonder.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Stone Club and Boulder in any combination.
Stone Club. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 15 ft. On a hit, deal 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Boulder. Ranged attack, +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft. On a hit, deal 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit by the boulder falls Prone.
sections.Reactions: Deflect Missile (recharge 5–6). When a ranged attack roll hits the giant and deals bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, reduce the damage the giant takes from that attack by 11 (1d10 + 6). If this reduces the damage to 0, the giant can choose one creature it sees within 60 ft. That creature makes a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 11 (1d10 + 6) force damage on a failure.

name: Storm Giant
description: Storm giants watch for omens from palaces below the sea or castles in the clouds. When they intervene, they can bring storms down on their foes.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The giant breathes air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Storm Sword and Thunderbolt in any combination.
Storm Sword. Melee attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 23 (4d6 + 9) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage.
Thunderbolt. Ranged attack, +14 to hit, range 500 ft. On a hit, deal 22 (2d12 + 9) lightning damage. The target is Blinded and Deafened until the start of the giant's next turn.
Lightning Storm (recharge 5–6). Pick a point the giant sees within 500 ft. Each creature in a Cylinder originating there, 10 ft. in radius and 40 ft. high, makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. It takes 55 (10d10) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Wisdom with a save DC of 18 and no Material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Light.
1/day. Control Weather.

name: Fomorian
description: Fomorians retreated to the Underdark after their invasion of the Feywild ended in a curse. They turn that curse on others with Warping Hex.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Stone Club attacks. The fomorian can replace one attack with Warping Hex if it is available.
Stone Club. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 15 ft. On a hit, deal 24 (4d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Warping Hex (recharge 4–6). Choose one creature the fomorian sees within 120 ft. The target makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage and gains one level of Exhaustion. On a success, it takes half the damage.
sections.Fomorian Warping (1d4):
Choose or roll for a cosmetic effect of Warping Hex.
1. Bright blemishes travel across the skin.
2. The target sweats in shifting colors.
3. Tufts of hair move on their own.
4. Veins swell and twitch under the skin.

name: Barbed Devil
description: The spines of this devil bite into creatures that grapple it or get caught in its claws.

sections.Senses: Darkvision 120 ft. Magical Darkness does not block this vision.
sections.Traits:
Barbed Hide. At the start of its turn, the devil deals 5 (1d10) Piercing damage to each creature it is grappling or that is grappling it.
Diabolical Restoration. If this devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body vanishes in sulfurous smoke. It returns immediately in a new body at full HP somewhere in the Nine Hells.
Magic Resistance. The fiend has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Claws attack and one Tail attack, or use Hurl Flame twice.
Claws. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage. A Large or smaller creature hit is Grappled by both claws (escape DC 13).
Tail. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 14 (2d10 + 3) Slashing damage.
Hurl Flame. Ranged attack, +5 to hit, range 150 ft. On a hit, deal 17 (5d6) Fire damage. A flammable target object starts Burning if nobody is wearing or carrying it.

name: Bearded Devil
description: This devil's spiny beard prevents healing, and its glaive leaves a wound that has to be stanched or healed by a spell.

sections.Senses: Darkvision 120 ft. Magical Darkness does not block this vision.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The fiend has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Beard attack and one Infernal Glaive attack.
Beard. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage. The target is Poisoned until the start of the devil's next turn and cannot regain HP while this poison lasts.
Infernal Glaive. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage. A creature hit that has no infernal wound makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure it suffers an infernal wound and loses 5 (1d10) HP at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, when a spell restores any HP to the target, or when the target or a creature within 5 ft. of it takes an action and succeeds on a DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check to stanch the wound.

name: Chain Devil
description: A chain devil holds opponents in its chains and conjures another to drag distant targets closer.

sections.Senses: Darkvision 120 ft. Magical Darkness does not block this vision.
sections.Traits:
Diabolical Restoration. If this devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body vanishes in sulfurous smoke. It returns immediately in a new body at full HP somewhere in the Nine Hells.
Magic Resistance. The fiend has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Chain attacks and use Conjure Infernal Chain.
Chain. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage. A Large or smaller creature hit is Grappled by one of the devil's two chains (escape DC 14) and Restrained until the grapple ends.
Conjure Infernal Chain. One visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 9 (2d4 + 4) Fire damage and is Restrained until the end of the devil's next turn, when the chain vanishes. If the target is Large or smaller, the devil moves it up to 30 ft. straight toward itself. On a success, the chain vanishes without effects.
sections.Reactions: Unnerving Gaze. When a creature the devil can see starts its turn within 30 ft. and can see the devil, the devil can force that creature to make a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, the creature is Frightened until the end of its turn. On a success, it is immune to this devil's Unnerving Gaze for 24 hours.

name: Arcanaloth
description: A fox-headed yugoloth mage uses a magic tome to imprison creatures.

sections.Traits:
Fiendish Restoration. If this yugoloth dies outside Gehenna, its body dissolves into ichor. It returns immediately in a new body at full HP in Gehenna.
Magic Resistance. The fiend has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Soul Tome. Holding or carrying this book allows the arcanaloth to use Banishing Claw. The tome has AC 17 and 35 HP, and is immune to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage. It recovers all HP at the end of every turn, and crumbles to dust at 0 HP or when the arcanaloth dies. If destroyed, the arcanaloth can make a replacement when it finishes a Short or Long Rest.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Fiendish Burst attacks. The arcanaloth can replace one attack with Banishing Claw.
Fiendish Burst. Melee or ranged attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. On a hit, deal 31 (4d12 + 5) Necrotic damage.
Banishing Claw (requires Soul Tome). Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 10 (2d4 + 5) Slashing plus 19 (3d12) Psychic damage. A creature hit makes a DC 17 Charisma save. On a failure, the tome traps the target in a demiplane and it is Incapacitated there. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. A success frees it into its former space or the nearest unoccupied space if that spot is occupied. If it fails three saves while inside the demiplane, escape requires reducing the tome to 0 HP.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells without Material components. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (save DC 17).
At will. Alter Self, Detect Magic, Identify, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation.
1/day each. Contact Other Plane, Detect Thoughts, Dimension Door, Mind Blank.
sections.Bonus actions: Teleport. Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space.
sections.Reactions: Counterspell. Cast Counterspell when the spell's trigger occurs, using Intelligence as in Spellcasting (save DC 17).

name: Mezzoloth
description: This four-clawed yugoloth pins foes and throws a trident that returns to its grasp.

sections.Traits:
Fiendish Restoration. If this yugoloth dies outside Gehenna, its body dissolves into ichor. It returns immediately in a new body at full HP in Gehenna.
Magic Resistance. The fiend has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Claws, Mercurial Trident, or one of each.
Claws. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage. A Large or smaller creature hit is Grappled by two of the mezzoloth's four claws (escape DC 14) and Restrained until the grapple ends.
Mercurial Trident. Melee or ranged attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. On a hit, deal 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing plus 10 (3d6) Force damage. The trident returns magically to the mezzoloth's claw immediately after a ranged attack.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells without Material components. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability (save DC 13).
1/day each. Cloudkill, Darkness, Dispel Magic.
sections.Bonus actions: Teleport (recharge 5–6). Teleport up to 60 ft. to a visible unoccupied space. The mezzoloth can bring one creature it is grappling and place it in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the destination.

name: Nycaloth
description: A winged yugoloth that turns Invisible when it teleports and carries an axe that returns after each throw.

sections.Traits:
Fiendish Restoration. If this yugoloth dies outside Gehenna, its body dissolves into ichor. It returns immediately in a new body at full HP in Gehenna.
Magic Resistance. The fiend has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Mercurial Axe attacks.
Mercurial Axe. Melee or ranged attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 30/90 ft. On a hit, deal 18 (2d12 + 5) Slashing plus 10 (3d6) Force damage. The axe returns magically to the nycaloth's hand immediately after a ranged attack.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadowy Teleport. The nycaloth becomes Invisible for 1 minute and teleports up to 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space. The Invisible condition ends immediately after it deals damage.

name: Ultroloth
description: An ultroloth can stun a group with its gaze and use its whip to move targets around the battlefield.

sections.Traits:
Fiendish Restoration. If this yugoloth dies outside Gehenna, its body dissolves into ichor. It returns immediately in a new body at full HP in Gehenna.
Magic Resistance. The fiend has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Hypnotic Gaze and make two Mercurial Whip attacks.
Mercurial Whip. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 15 ft. On a hit, deal 25 (6d6 + 4) Force damage. The ultroloth can teleport the target up to 10 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. The destination cannot be in the air.
Hypnotic Gaze. Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure, take 10 (3d6) Psychic damage and become Stunned until the start of the ultroloth's next turn. On a success, the creature is immune to this ultroloth's Hypnotic Gaze for 24 hours.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells without Material components. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (save DC 17).
At will. Alter Self, Clairvoyance, Detect Magic.
1/day each. Dimension Door, Fireball (level 5), Wall of Fire.
sections.Bonus actions: Fiendish Guile (recharge 4–6). Cast Dispel Magic, Invisibility (self only), Misty Step, or Suggestion. None requires Material components. Use Intelligence as in Spellcasting (save DC 17).

name: Barlgura
description: A hulking, ape-like demon that hunts intruders and batters them to the ground.

sections.Traits: Demonic Restoration. If the barlgura dies away from the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor. A new body forms immediately in the Abyss, where it revives at full HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Tormenting Bite attack and two Thrash attacks.
Tormenting Bite. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage and 13 (2d12) Psychic damage.
Thrash. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it falls Prone.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Wisdom, save DC 13. The spells need no material components.
2/day each. Disguise Self and Invisibility (self only).
1/day each. Entangle and Phantasmal Killer (level 6).
sections.Bonus actions: Leap. Spend 10 ft. of movement to jump up to 40 ft.

name: Chasme
description: A horse-sized fly demon whose drone puts victims to sleep so it can feed.

sections.Traits:
Demonic Restoration. If the chasme dies away from the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor. A new body forms immediately in the Abyss, where it revives at full HP.
Magic Resistance. The chasme has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Spider Climb. The chasme can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
sections.Actions: Proboscis. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 16 (4d6 + 2) Piercing damage and 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, reduce its maximum HP by the Necrotic damage it took.
sections.Bonus actions: Drone. Every creature in a 30-ft. Emanation from the chasme makes a DC 12 Constitution save. Demons succeed automatically. On a failure, the target becomes Unconscious and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. It succeeds automatically after 10 minutes, if it takes damage, or if a creature within 5 ft. of it uses an action to empty a flask of Holy Water on it. A success ends the effect and grants immunity to this chasme's Drone for 24 hours.

name: Manes
description: A small Abyssal demon that claws at anyone it thinks too weak to fight back.

sections.Actions: Claw. Melee attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (2d4) Slashing damage.

name: Shadow Demon
description: An incorporeal remnant of a demon that could not re-form after its destruction.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Piercing, Slashing, Thunder.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained.
sections.Traits:
Demonic Restoration. If the shadow demon dies away from the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor. A new body forms immediately in the Abyss, where it revives at full HP.
Incorporeal Movement. The demon treats creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain it can move through. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
Light Sensitivity. Bright Light gives the demon Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
sections.Actions: Umbral Claw. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 16 (3d8 + 3) Psychic damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. Take the Hide action while in Dim Light or Darkness.

name: Yochlol
description: A one-eyed mass of shifting tentacles that often passes for a cultist or spider.

sections.Traits:
Demonic Restoration. If the yochlol dies away from the Abyss, its body dissolves. A new body forms immediately in the Abyss, where it revives at full HP.
Magic Resistance. The yochlol has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Spider Climb. The yochlol can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
Web Walker. Webs impose no movement restrictions on the yochlol.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Caustic Lash attacks. The yochlol can also cast Web or Dominate Person using Spellcasting if that spell is available.
Caustic Lash. Melee or ranged attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. A hit deals 25 (6d6 + 4) Acid damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Charisma, save DC 15. The spells need no material components.
At will. Detect Thoughts, Gaseous Form (self only), and Web.
1/day. Dominate Person.
sections.Bonus actions: Shape-Shift. Take the form of a Medium Humanoid or a Medium spider, or return to true form. The yochlol keeps its game statistics in each form. Worn and carried equipment stays as it was.
sections.Reactions: Toxic Escape. When an attack roll hits the yochlol, halve the attack's damage to it, rounding down. The yochlol also teleports to a visible unoccupied space within 30 ft. Every creature within 5 ft. of the destination makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, the target is Poisoned through the end of its next turn and is Incapacitated while Poisoned this way.

name: Spined Devil
description: A flying infernal spy that needles foes with fiery spines from beyond their reach.

sections.Senses: Darkvision 120 ft. Magical Darkness does not block this vision.
sections.Traits:
Flyby. The spined devil provokes no Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.
Magic Resistance. The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Infernal Fork and Tail Spine.
Infernal Fork. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage and 3 (1d6) Fire damage.
Tail Spine. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 20/80 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage and 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

name: Lemure
description: A misshapen devil that obeys stronger fiends and attacks weaker creatures with poisonous slime.

sections.Senses: Darkvision 120 ft. Magical Darkness does not block this vision.
sections.Traits: Hellish Restoration. A lemure that dies in the Nine Hells revives at full HP in 1d10 days. It stays dead if a creature under the effects of Bless killed it or if someone sprinkles its remains with Holy Water.
sections.Actions: Vile Slime. Melee attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

name: Gnoll Fang of Yeenoghu
description: A demonic gnoll singles out wounded prey, then closes in with a venomous bite and a long-reaching bone flail.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Bone Flail attacks.
Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage. The target is Poisoned until the start of the gnoll's next turn.
Bone Flail. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Rampage (2/day). Immediately after damaging a creature that was already Bloodied, the gnoll moves up to half its Speed and makes one Bite attack.

name: Gnoll Pack Lord
description: A pack leader fights with weapons made of bone and calls on nearby gnolls to strike out of turn.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Bone Whip and Bone Javelin. Use Incite Rampage if it is available.

Bone Javelin. Ranged attack, +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.
Incite Rampage (recharge 5–6). Choose another visible creature within 60 ft. that has the Rampage bonus action. That creature can use its Reaction to make one melee attack.
sections.Bonus actions: Rampage (2/day). Immediately after damaging a creature that was already Bloodied, the gnoll moves up to half its Speed and makes one Bone Whip attack.

name: Goblin Boss
description: A quick-footed goblin leader attacks from an opening and puts an ally in the way of a dangerous blow.

Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Scimitar and Shortbow.
Scimitar. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Slashing damage if the roll had Advantage.
Shortbow. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the roll had Advantage.
sections.Bonus actions: Nimble Escape. Take the Disengage or Hide action.

sections.Habitats: Forest, Grassland, Hill, Acheron, Feywild, Underdark.

Longbow. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) Poison damage.
sections.Habitats: Desert, Forest, Grassland, Hill, Mountain, Acheron, Underdark.

name: Hobgoblin Warlord
description: A heavily armored commander rallies troops across the battlefield and uses heavy javelins to slow anyone trying to escape.

sections.Habitats: Desert, Forest, Grassland, Hill, Mountain, Acheron, Underdark.

name: Kuo-toa

sections.Traits:

sections.Actions:

Sticky Net (1/day). Choose a visible Large or smaller creature within 15 ft. It makes a DC 10 Dexterity save. On a failure, it is Restrained until the net is destroyed. The net has AC 10 and 5 HP, with Immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage. A creature can take an action and succeed on a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check to free itself or another creature in a net within 5 ft. This destroys the net.
sections.Reactions: Sticky Shield. When a creature misses the kuo-toa with a melee attack roll using a weapon, that creature makes a DC 11 Strength save. On a failure, its weapon sticks to the kuo-toa's shield and becomes unusable. If the attacker keeps hold of the weapon, it is Grappled while the weapon is stuck (escape DC 11). The attacker can take an action and succeed on a DC 11 Strength (Athletics) check to free the weapon.

Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 90-ft. line 5 ft. wide makes a DC 21 Dexterity save. Failure deals 58 (13d8) Fire damage. Success halves the damage.
Sleep Breath. Each creature in a 90-ft. cone makes a DC 21 Constitution save. On failure, the creature is Incapacitated until the end of its next turn and repeats the save then. On a second failure, it falls Unconscious for 10 minutes. Damage wakes it, as does an action taken by a creature within 5 ft.
sections.Spellcasting:
Casting one of these spells takes an action. The dragon uses Charisma (save DC 20), and the spells require no Material components.
Scorching Ray uses a +12 spell attack bonus, calculated from Charisma and proficiency.
At will. Detect Magic, Minor Illusion, Scorching Ray at level 3, Shapechange, Speak with Animals.
1/day each. Control Weather, Detect Thoughts.
Shapechange only allows Beast or Humanoid forms. It grants no Temporary Hit Points and requires neither Concentration nor Temporary Hit Points to maintain.
sections.Legendary actions:
The dragon has 3 uses, or 4 in its lair. It can spend one use on one option immediately after another creature’s turn. Spent uses return at the start of the dragon’s turn. It cannot use these actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Blazing Light. Cast Scorching Ray at level 3 through Spellcasting.
Pounce. Move up to half its Speed and make one Rend attack.
Scorching Sands. A visible creature within 120 ft. makes a DC 20 Dexterity save. On failure, it takes 36 (8d8) Fire damage and its Speed is halved until the end of that creature’s next turn. The dragon can use this option again starting on its next turn.
sections.Lair resources: The encounter is worth 33,000 XP in the lair. The dragon has 5 daily Legendary Resistance uses and 4 legendary action uses there.
sections.Regional effects:
Mirages. From its lair the dragon can cast Major Image without Material components, using its Spellcasting ability. The range is 1 mile, and the effect can appear in places the dragon cannot see.
Refreshing Water. A creature that drinks water from within 1 mile of the lair gains 2d4 Temporary Hit Points. The dragon immediately knows the drinker is present.
Both effects end immediately if the dragon dies or moves its lair.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), p. 56. Includes the regional effects.

1/day each. Detect Thoughts, Control Water, Scrying, Water Breathing.

name: Ancient Copper Dragon

Slowing Breath. Each creature in a 90-ft. cone makes a DC 22 Constitution save. On failure, its Speed is halved, it cannot take Reactions, and it must choose between an action and a Bonus Action on its turn. These effects last until the end of the creature’s next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
Casting one of these spells takes an action. The dragon uses Charisma (save DC 21), and the spells require no Material components.

1/day each. Greater Restoration, Major Image, Project Image.
Shapechange only allows Beast or Humanoid forms. It grants no Temporary Hit Points and requires neither Concentration nor Temporary Hit Points to maintain.
