Giggling Magic. A visible creature within 120 ft. makes a DC 21 Charisma save. On failure, it takes 31 (9d6) Psychic damage and subtracts 1d8 from each ability check and attack roll it makes until the end of the creature’s next turn. Roll that d8 for each check or attack. The dragon can use this option again starting on its next turn.
Mind Jolt. Cast Mind Spike at level 5 through Spellcasting. The dragon can use this option again starting on its next turn.
Pounce. Move up to half its Speed and make one Rend attack.

sections.Traits:
Blood Frenzy. The sahuagin has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature below its hit point maximum.
Limited Amphibiousness. The sahuagin breathes air and water and must submerge at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating outside water.
Shark Telepathy. The sahuagin can use special telepathy to magically control sharks within 120 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Trident attacks.
Trident. Melee or ranged attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Fiendish Blood. When the sahuagin takes piercing or slashing damage, each creature it chooses in a 5-ft. Emanation from it makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, the creature takes 10 (3d6) acid damage and is cursed until it finishes a Short or Long Rest. While cursed, the creature cannot benefit from being Invisible, its Speed decreases by 10 ft., and every Fiend within 120 ft. of the creature can sense its location even through obstacles.

name: Merrow
description: An ogre-like aquatic hunter uses a harpoon to pull prey toward its jaws. Merrow ambush travelers in coastal waters and raid nearby settlements.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The merrow breathes both air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Bite, Claw, and Harpoon.
Bite. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage and leaves the target Poisoned until the end of the merrow's next turn.
Claw. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.
Harpoon. Melee or ranged attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. The merrow pulls a Large or smaller creature hit by the harpoon up to 15 ft. straight toward itself.

name: Werebear
classification: Small or Medium monstrosity (lycanthrope), neutral good
speed: 30 ft. (40 ft. in bear form), climb 30 ft. (bear form only)
description: Werebears take the shape of bears native to their region. Some help druids and Fey protect the wilderness.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Handaxe or Rend in any combination. The werebear can replace one with Bite. Follow the form restrictions for each attack.
Bite (bear or hybrid form only). Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 17 (2d12 + 4) Piercing damage. A Humanoid hit by this attack makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, it is cursed. If a cursed target drops to 0 HP, it becomes a Werebear with 10 HP under the DM's control instead. On a success, the target is immune to this werebear's curse for 24 hours.
Handaxe (Humanoid or hybrid form only). Melee or ranged attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 14 (3d6 + 4) Slashing damage.
Rend (bear or hybrid form only). Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Shape-Shift. Take the shape of a Large bear-humanoid hybrid or a Large bear, or return to its true Humanoid form. Game statistics are shared across forms except for the listed differences. Worn and carried gear keeps its original form.

name: Wereboar
classification: Small or Medium monstrosity (lycanthrope), neutral evil
description: Some wereboars change involuntarily when they give in to greed.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Javelin or Tusk in any combination. The wereboar can replace one with Gore. Follow the form restrictions for each attack.
Gore (boar or hybrid form only). Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage. A Humanoid hit by this attack makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, it is cursed. If a cursed target drops to 0 HP, it becomes a Wereboar with 10 HP under the DM's control instead. On a success, the target is immune to this wereboar's curse for 24 hours.
Javelin (Humanoid or hybrid form only). Melee or ranged attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. A hit deals 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage.
Tusk (boar or hybrid form only). Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the wereboar moved at least 20 ft. straight toward a Medium or smaller creature immediately before hitting it, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) Piercing damage and falls Prone.
sections.Bonus actions: Shape-Shift. Take the shape of a Medium boar-humanoid hybrid or a Small boar, or return to its true Humanoid form. Game statistics are shared across forms except for the listed differences. Worn and carried gear keeps its original form.

name: Wererat
classification: Small or Medium monstrosity (lycanthrope), lawful evil
description: Wererats often form gangs or thieves' guilds. Darkness or a new moon can force some of them to change form.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Scratch or Hand Crossbow in any combination. The wererat can replace one with Bite. Follow the form restrictions for each attack.
Bite (rat or hybrid form only). Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage. A Humanoid hit by this attack makes a DC 11 Constitution save. On a failure, it is cursed. If a cursed target drops to 0 HP, it becomes a Wererat with 10 HP under the DM's control instead. On a success, the target is immune to this wererat's curse for 24 hours.
Scratch. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.
Hand Crossbow (Humanoid or hybrid form only). Ranged attack, +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Shape-Shift. Take the shape of a Medium rat-humanoid hybrid or a Small rat, or return to its true Humanoid form. Game statistics are shared across forms except for the listed differences. Worn and carried gear keeps its original form.

name: Weretiger
description: Some weretigers treat changing form as a family honor. They use that power to defend something of historical importance.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Scratch or Longbow in any combination. The weretiger can replace one with Bite. Follow the form restrictions for each attack.
Bite (tiger or hybrid form only). Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage. A Humanoid hit by this attack makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, it is cursed. If a cursed target drops to 0 HP, it becomes a Weretiger with 10 HP under the DM's control instead. On a success, the target is immune to this weretiger's curse for 24 hours.
Scratch. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.
Longbow (Humanoid or hybrid form only). Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d8 + 2) Piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions:
Prowl (tiger or hybrid form only). Move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. At the end of this movement, the weretiger can take the Hide action.
Shape-Shift. Take the shape of a Large tiger-humanoid hybrid or a Large tiger, or return to its true Humanoid form. Game statistics are shared across forms except for the listed differences. Worn and carried gear keeps its original form.
sections.Weretiger wards:
Roll 1d4 or choose what it protects.
1. A storied weapon or royal emblem.
2. A site where foretold heroes must prove themselves.
3. A rare magical plant or animal.
4. A sacred spring with magical water.

name: Werewolf
classification: Small or Medium monstrosity (lycanthrope), chaotic evil
description: Werewolves can change shape by choice, though many are forced to transform under a full moon.

sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The werewolf has Advantage on an attack roll if at least one ally without the Incapacitated condition is within 5 ft. of the target.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Scratch or Longbow in any combination. The werewolf can replace one with Bite. Follow the form restrictions for each attack.
Bite (wolf or hybrid form only). Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage. A Humanoid hit by this attack makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, it is cursed. If a cursed target drops to 0 HP, it becomes a Werewolf with 10 HP under the DM's control instead. On a success, the target is immune to this werewolf's curse for 24 hours.
Scratch. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.
Longbow (Humanoid or hybrid form only). Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d8 + 2) Piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Shape-Shift. Take the shape of a Large wolf-humanoid hybrid or a Medium wolf, or return to its true Humanoid form. Game statistics are shared across forms except for the listed differences. Worn and carried gear keeps its original form.

name: Jackalwere
description: A jackal is the fiend's natural form. It uses a human disguise and a sleep-inducing gaze to trick or rob travelers.

sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The jackalwere has Advantage on an attack roll if at least one ally without the Incapacitated condition is within 5 ft. of the target.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend or Slam attacks, following each attack's form restriction.
Rend (jackal or hybrid form only). Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.
Slam (human or hybrid form only). Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.
Sleep Gaze (recharge 5–6). Choose one visible creature within 30 ft. It makes a DC 10 Wisdom save. Constructs and Undead succeed automatically. On a failure, the target is Unconscious for up to 10 minutes. Taking damage wakes it, as does a creature within 5 ft. spending an action to wake it. Success gives immunity to this jackalwere's Sleep Gaze for 24 hours.
sections.Bonus actions: Shape-Shift. Take the shape of a Medium human or a Medium jackal-humanoid hybrid, or return to its true Small jackal form. Game statistics are shared across forms except for the listed differences. Worn and carried gear keeps its original form.
sections.Jackalwere tricks:
Roll 1d4 or choose a trick.
1. Lead travelers into the wilds and leave them stranded.
2. Sketch a shortcut through a monster lair.
3. Put travelers to sleep and steal their mounts or supplies.
4. Promise treasure where sunlight glints off sand or water.

name: Doppelganger
description: A doppelganger reads minds to impersonate people and uncover secrets. It can also take a disturbing appearance to scare away a threat.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks and use Unsettling Visage if it is available.
Slam. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. The attack roll has Advantage in the first round of combat.
Unsettling Visage (recharge 6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Emanation from the doppelganger that can see it makes a DC 12 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Frightened and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. Success ends the effect on that creature. After 1 minute, the save succeeds automatically.
Read Thoughts. Cast Detect Thoughts using Charisma, with spell save DC 12 and no components.
sections.Bonus actions: Shape-Shift. Become a Medium or Small Humanoid, or return to its true form. Only its size can change among its game statistics. Worn and carried gear keeps its original form.
sections.Doppelganger deceptions:
Roll 1d6 or choose an agenda.
1. Sow chaos in the temple of the deity that took away its true form.
2. Hide evidence of a widespread conspiracy.
3. Pose as a local bogeyman and rule by fear.
4. Usurp a noble to live in luxury.
5. Spy on wizards for a way to finish the magic that created it.
6. Infiltrate a position of power ahead of an invasion.

name: Black Pudding
description: An ink-black ooze that dissolves wood, metal, and whatever else stands in its way.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Prone, Restrained.
sections.Traits:
Amorphous. It can fit through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without spending extra movement.
Corrosive Form. A creature that hits the pudding with a melee attack roll takes 4 (1d8) Acid damage. Destroy nonmagical ammunition immediately after it hits and deals damage to the ooze. When a nonmagical weapon touches the ooze and deals damage to it, the weapon immediately gains a cumulative −1 penalty to its attack rolls. At −5, the weapon is destroyed. Mending removes the penalty from a surviving weapon. The pudding eats through 2 ft. of nonmagical wood or metal in 1 minute.
Spider Climb. It climbs difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
sections.Actions: Dissolving Pseudopod. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 17 (4d6 + 3) Acid damage. Nonmagical armor worn by the target takes a −1 penalty to the AC it provides. If this lowers the armor's AC to 10, the armor is destroyed. Mending removes the penalty from surviving armor.
sections.Reactions: Split. A Medium or Large pudding with at least 10 HP can react when it becomes Bloodied or is subjected to Lightning or Slashing damage. Replace it with two of the same kind, each one size smaller. They act on the original's initiative and each receives half its current HP, rounded down.

name: Gray Ooze
description: A slab-gray ooze that creeps along walls and corrodes armor with a touch.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Prone, Restrained.
sections.Traits:
Amorphous. It can fit through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without spending extra movement.
Corrosive Form. Destroy nonmagical ammunition immediately after it hits and deals damage to the ooze. When a nonmagical weapon touches the ooze and deals damage to it, the weapon immediately gains a cumulative −1 penalty to its attack rolls. At −5, the weapon is destroyed. Mending removes the penalty from a surviving weapon. The ooze eats through 2 inches of nonmagical wood or metal in 1 round.
sections.Actions: Pseudopod. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 10 (2d8 + 1) Acid damage. Nonmagical armor worn by the target takes a −1 penalty to the AC it provides. If this lowers the armor's AC to 10, the armor is destroyed. Mending removes the penalty from surviving armor.

name: Ochre Jelly
description: A yellow-brown jelly that scales cave ceilings and divides when cut.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Prone, Restrained.
sections.Traits:
Amorphous. It can fit through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without spending extra movement.
Spider Climb. It climbs difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
sections.Actions: Pseudopod. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 12 (3d6 + 2) Acid damage.
sections.Reactions: Split. A Medium or Large jelly with at least 10 HP can react when it becomes Bloodied or is subjected to Lightning or Slashing damage. Replace it with two of the same kind, each one size smaller. They act on the original's initiative and each receives half its current HP, rounded down.

name: Psychic Gray Ooze
description: This gray ooze can assault a creature's thoughts and retaliate when that creature's magic overcomes it.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Prone, Restrained.
sections.Traits: Amorphous. It can fit through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without spending extra movement.
sections.Actions:
Pseudopod. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 11 (3d6 + 1) Acid damage. The target has Disadvantage on Intelligence saves until the end of the ooze's next turn.
Psychic Crush. Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. It makes a DC 10 Intelligence save, taking 13 (3d8) Psychic damage on a failure.
sections.Reactions: Mind Corrosion. When the ooze fails a save against a creature's spell or other magical effect, that creature takes 3 (1d6) Psychic damage.

name: Water Weird
description: A water elemental tethered to a particular body of water. It surges out to seize creatures within reach.

sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Invisible in Water. The weird is Invisible while completely submerged.
Water Bound. It dies if it leaves the water it is bound to or that water is destroyed.
sections.Actions: Surge. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 13 (3d6 + 3) Cold damage. A Medium or smaller creature is also Grappled (escape DC 13) and Restrained until that grapple ends.

name: Galeb Duhr
speed: 15 ft. (30 ft. when rolling, 60 ft. rolling downhill)
description: A boulder-shaped elemental that rolls downhill and calls nearby rocks to life.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Actions:
Avalanche Slam. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 12 (2d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the galeb duhr moved at least 20 ft. straight toward it immediately before hitting, deal an extra 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage and knock it Prone.
Animate Boulders (1/day). Magically animate one or two visible boulders within 60 ft. Each uses the Galeb Duhr stat block with Intelligence and Charisma 1 and without Animate Boulders. It obeys the galeb duhr and takes its turn immediately after it on the same initiative count. It stays animated for 1 minute or until either it or the galeb duhr dies.

name: Xorn
description: A burrowing earth elemental that can pinpoint nearby gems and precious metals.

sections.Traits:
Earth Glide. The xorn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material.
Treasure Sense. It pinpoints precious metals and stones within 60 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and three Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 17 (4d6 + 3) Piercing damage.
Claw. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Charge. Move up to the xorn's Speed or Burrow Speed straight toward an enemy it can sense.

name: Behir
description: A twelve-legged cave hunter that races up walls and blasts escaping prey with lightning. Legends credit storm giants with creating behirs to hunt dragons and raid their nests.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and use Constrict.
Bite. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 19 (2d12 + 6) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) lightning damage.
Constrict. A visible Large or smaller creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 18 Strength save. On a failure it takes 28 (5d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and becomes Grappled, escape DC 16. It is Restrained until the grapple ends.
Lightning Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a line 90 ft. long and 5 ft. wide makes a DC 16 Dexterity save. It takes 66 (12d10) lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Bonus actions:
Swallow. One Large or smaller creature Grappled by the behir makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. On a failure the behir swallows the creature and the grapple ends. The behir can hold one swallowed creature at a time.
Inside the behir. The creature is Blinded and Restrained and has Total Cover against attacks and effects from outside. It takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the behir's turns.
Regurgitation. If the swallowed creature deals at least 30 damage to the behir on one turn, the behir makes a DC 14 Constitution save at that turn's end. On a failure the behir spits the creature out, and it falls Prone within 10 ft. If the behir dies, the creature is no longer Restrained and can spend 15 ft. of movement to leave the corpse, ending up Prone.

name: Bulette
description: This heavily armored land shark tracks movement from underground. It bursts through the surface to snatch prey and can overrun whole herds.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 17 (2d12 + 4) piercing damage.
Deadly Leap. Spend 5 ft. of movement to leap to a space within 15 ft. containing at least one Large or smaller creature. Every creature in that space makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. Failure deals 19 (3d12) bludgeoning damage and knocks the creature Prone. Success halves the damage and pushes it 5 ft. directly away from the bulette.
sections.Bonus actions: Leap. Spend 10 ft. of movement to jump up to 30 ft.

name: Abominable Yeti
description: An abominable yeti claims whole stretches of frozen mountain country and may follow trespassers for days. It hurls ice from afar and closes to strike with its claws or breathe killing cold.

sections.Traits: Fear of Fire. After taking fire damage, the yeti has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks through the end of its next turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Claw and Ice Throw. The yeti can also use Chilling Gaze.
Claw. Melee attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.
Ice Throw. Ranged attack, +11 to hit, range 60/240 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d4 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.
Chilling Gaze. A visible creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 18 Constitution save. It takes 21 (6d6) cold damage on a failure and is Paralyzed until the start of the yeti's next turn unless it is immune to cold damage. On a success it becomes immune to this abominable yeti's Chilling Gaze for 1 hour.
Cold Breath (recharge 6). Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 18 Constitution save. It takes 45 (10d8) cold damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Yeti
description: A pale, horned hunter that blends into the snow and waits near mountain routes used by herders and travelers. It can freeze prey with a look or hurl conjured ice.

sections.Traits: Fear of Fire. After taking fire damage, the yeti has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks through the end of its next turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Claw and Ice Throw. The yeti can also use Chilling Gaze.
Claw. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.
Ice Throw. Ranged attack, +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) cold damage.
Chilling Gaze. A visible creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 13 Constitution save. It takes 5 (2d4) cold damage on a failure and is Paralyzed until the start of the yeti's next turn unless it is immune to cold damage. Success grants 1 hour of immunity to every ordinary yeti's Chilling Gaze. Abominable yetis can still affect the creature.

name: Remorhaz
description: A full-grown remorhaz ambushes prey from tunnels under snow and ice. Its centipede-like body radiates heat, and its bite holds prey in place long enough for it to swallow.

sections.Traits: Heat Aura. At the end of each of the remorhaz's turns, every creature in a 5-ft. Emanation from it takes 16 (3d10) fire damage.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage. A Large or smaller creature hit by the bite is Grappled, escape DC 17, and is Restrained until the grapple ends.
sections.Bonus actions:
Swallow. One Large or smaller creature Grappled by the remorhaz makes a DC 19 Strength save. On a failure the remorhaz swallows the creature and the grapple ends. The remorhaz can hold up to two swallowed creatures.
Inside the remorhaz. Each swallowed creature is Blinded and Restrained and has Total Cover against attacks and effects from outside. At the start of each of the remorhaz's turns it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.
Regurgitation. If a creature inside deals at least 30 damage to the remorhaz on one turn, the remorhaz makes a DC 15 Constitution save at that turn's end. On a failure it spits out all swallowed creatures, and each falls Prone within 5 ft. If the remorhaz dies, swallowed creatures are no longer Restrained and each can spend 15 ft. of movement to leave the corpse, ending up Prone.

name: Young Remorhaz
description: A young remorhaz burrows through snow and ice, then chases down prey and sears it with its bite and the heat radiating from its body.

sections.Traits: Heat Aura. At the end of each of the young remorhaz's turns, every creature in a 5-ft. Emanation from it takes 11 (2d10) fire damage.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) fire damage.

name: Purple Worm
description: A gigantic burrower that chews through earth and rock in search of food. It swallows smaller creatures whole and can leave entire settlements wrecked in its wake.

sections.Traits: Tunneler. The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed. It leaves a tunnel 10 ft. across.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Tail Stinger attack.
Bite. Melee attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. A Large or smaller creature hit by the bite is Grappled, escape DC 19, and is Restrained until the grapple ends.
Tail Stinger. Melee attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 16 (2d6 + 9) piercing damage plus 35 (10d6) poison damage.
sections.Bonus actions:
Swallow. One Large or smaller creature Grappled by the worm makes a DC 19 Strength save. On a failure the worm swallows the creature and the grapple ends. The worm can hold up to three swallowed creatures.
Inside the worm. Each swallowed creature is Blinded and Restrained and has Total Cover against attacks and effects from outside. At the start of each of the worm's turns it takes 17 (5d6) acid damage.
Regurgitation. If a creature inside deals at least 30 damage to the worm on one turn, the worm makes a DC 21 Constitution save at that turn's end. On a failure it spits out all swallowed creatures, and each falls Prone within 5 ft. If the worm dies, swallowed creatures are no longer Restrained and each can spend 20 ft. of movement to leave the corpse, ending up Prone.

name: Beholder Zombie
description: A reanimated beholder still floats and fires magical rays. Spellcasting beholders sometimes raise these corpses from rivals they have defeated.

sections.Languages: Understands Deep Speech and Undercommon but cannot speak.
sections.Traits: Undead Fortitude. When damage drops the zombie to 0 HP, it makes a Constitution save with a DC equal to 5 plus the damage taken. Skip the save for Radiant damage or damage from a Critical Hit. On a success, it drops to 1 HP instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Eye Rays twice.
Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 16 (4d6 + 2) Piercing damage.
Eye Rays. Choose a visible target within 120 ft. and roll 1d4 for the ray. Reroll any ray already used this turn.
1. Paralyzing Ray. DC 14 Constitution save. Failure leaves the target Paralyzed. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect and succeeds automatically after 1 minute.
2. Fear Ray. DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure, the target takes 13 (3d8) Psychic damage and is Frightened until the end of its next turn.
3. Enervation Ray. DC 14 Constitution save. Failure inflicts 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage and leaves the target Poisoned until the end of its next turn. It can't regain HP while Poisoned this way. Success halves the damage and avoids the condition.
4. Disintegration Ray. DC 14 Dexterity save. Failure inflicts 27 (5d10) Force damage and turns a 10-ft. Cube of a targeted nonmagical object or magical force creation to dust. Success halves the damage. A creature reduced to 0 HP by the ray disintegrates on either result.

name: Bone Naga
description: Rituals can raise a dead naga as a skeletal guard. It keeps some of its living magic, but undeath leaves gaps in its memory. A few pursue the goals they had in life.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks. The naga can use Serpentine Gaze in place of either or both attacks.
Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit inflicts 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.
Serpentine Gaze. A visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On failure, it takes 13 (3d6 + 3) Psychic damage and is Charmed until the start of the naga's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell below using Intelligence (save DC 13). No Material components are needed.
At will. Mage Hand, Thaumaturgy.
1/day each. Command, Detect Thoughts, Lightning Bolt.

name: Crawling Claw
description: An animated severed hand stalks the living. Some single out particular victims, and a rare few act while the rest of their former body still lives.

sections.Actions: Slam. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 2 Necrotic damage.

name: Minotaur Skeleton
description: This hulking skeleton can come from a minotaur or be assembled from several creatures. It bowls prey over with its horns.

sections.Actions:
Gore. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the skeleton moved at least 20 ft. directly toward it immediately before hitting, add 9 (2d8) Piercing damage and knock it Prone.
Slam. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

name: Revenant
description: A revenant reanimates its former body to hunt its killer. If the body is destroyed, it can claim another corpse on the same plane.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Stunned.
sections.Traits:
Regeneration. The revenant restores 10 HP at the start of each of its turns. Fire or Radiant damage stops that healing at the start of its next turn. Its body is destroyed only if it starts its turn at 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
Undead Restoration. The revenant returns 24 hours after it dies unless someone casts Dispel Evil and Good on its corpse. It animates a different Humanoid corpse elsewhere on the same plane. Its appearance changes, and it returns at full HP using this stat block.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Vengeful Glare and make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) Necrotic damage.
Vengeful Glare. A visible creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On failure, it is Frightened. A target cursed by Vow of Revenge is also Paralyzed while this effect lasts. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect. After 1 minute the save succeeds automatically.
sections.Bonus actions: Vow of Revenge (1/day). Curse a visible creature within 30 ft. The revenant knows its distance and direction, even across planes. This curse ends when the revenant uses Vow of Revenge on a different creature.

name: Warhorse Skeleton
description: An undead steed still bears scraps of its old barding. It may carry the remains of its former rider.

sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the skeleton moved at least 20 ft. directly toward it immediately before hitting, the target falls Prone.

name: Zombie
description: An animated humanoid corpse often guards a site or serves the magic-user who raised it.

sections.Languages: Understands Common plus one other language but cannot speak.
sections.Traits: Undead Fortitude. When damage drops the zombie to 0 HP, it makes a Constitution save with a DC equal to 5 plus the damage taken. Skip the save for Radiant damage or damage from a Critical Hit. On a success, it drops to 1 HP instead.
sections.Actions: Slam. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) Bludgeoning damage.

name: Couatl
description: A feathered serpent watches over mortals and may approach them in the guise of a beast or a person.

sections.Traits: Shielded Mind. Nothing can read the couatl's thoughts. Other creatures need its permission to communicate with it telepathically.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 11 (1d12 + 5) piercing damage. The target is Poisoned until the end of the couatl's next turn.
Constrict. Choose one visible creature of Medium size or smaller within 5 ft. It makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, is Grappled (escape DC 13), and remains Restrained until that grapple ends.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Wisdom (save DC 15), without components.
At will. Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Shapechange. Shapechange allows Beast or Humanoid forms only and grants no Temporary Hit Points. Maintaining the spell requires neither Concentration nor Temporary Hit Points.
1/day each. Create Food and Water, Dream, Greater Restoration, Scrying, Sleep.
sections.Bonus actions: Divine Aid (2/day total). Cast Bless, Lesser Restoration, or Sanctuary without components, using Wisdom as in Spellcasting.

name: Guardian Naga
description: This serpent-bodied sentinel turns its magic and venom against those who threaten the places it guards.

sections.Traits: Celestial Restoration. Unless someone casts Dispel Evil and Good on its remains, it revives with full HP 1d6 days after death.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks. The naga can substitute Poisonous Spittle for either or both.
Bite. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 17 (2d12 + 4) piercing damage plus 22 (4d10) poison damage.
Poisonous Spittle. One visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 16 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 31 (7d8) poison damage and is Blinded until the start of the naga's next turn. On a success, it takes half damage only.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Wisdom (save DC 16), without Somatic or Material components.
At will. Thaumaturgy.
1/day each. Clairvoyance, Cure Wounds (level 6), Flame Strike (level 6), Geas, True Seeing.

name: Spirit Naga
description: A fiendish serpent hurls necrotic rays and returns from death unless stopped by a Wish spell.

sections.Traits: Fiendish Restoration. It revives with full HP 1d6 days after death. Only Wish can prevent this return.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Bite and Necrotic Ray.
Bite. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.
Necrotic Ray. Ranged attack, +6 to hit, range 60 ft. On a hit, deal 21 (6d6) necrotic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Intelligence (save DC 14), without Somatic or Material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Water Breathing.
2/day each. Detect Thoughts, Dimension Door, Hold Person (level 3), Lightning Bolt (level 4).

name: Unicorn
description: A unicorn defends the creatures and woods within its realm. Healing magic is stronger near its lair.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The unicorn can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. It has Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Hooves attack and one Radiant Horn attack.
Hooves. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Radiant Horn. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 9 (1d10 + 4) radiant damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Charisma (save DC 14), without components.
At will. Detect Evil and Good, Druidcraft.
1/day each. Calm Emotions, Dispel Evil and Good, Entangle, Pass without Trace, Word of Recall.
sections.Bonus actions: Unicorn's Blessing (3/day total). Touch another creature with the horn and cast Cure Wounds or Lesser Restoration on that creature, using Charisma as in Spellcasting.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 uses. Spend one use on one option immediately after another creature's turn. Restore spent uses at the start of the unicorn's turn. The unicorn cannot use these options while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Charging Horn. Move up to half the unicorn's Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and make one Radiant Horn attack.
Shimmering Shield. Choose the unicorn itself or one other visible creature within 60 ft. The target gains 10 (3d6) Temporary Hit Points, and its AC increases by 2 until the end of the unicorn's next turn. The unicorn cannot use this option again until the start of its next turn.
sections.Regional effects:
Obscuring Foliage. Within 1 mile of the lair, the unicorn and its allies have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
Positive Energy. A creature within 1 mile of the lair regains the maximum possible HP whenever a spell heals it. Curses are suppressed within the same radius. Both effects end immediately if the unicorn dies or moves its lair.

name: Rakshasa
description: A disguised fiend infiltrates circles of power. Some physical detail of its true form survives even a magical disguise.

sections.Damage vulnerabilities: Piercing damage from weapons wielded by creatures affected by Bless.
sections.Traits:
Greater Magic Resistance. The rakshasa automatically succeeds on saves against spells and other magical effects, and spell attacks automatically miss it. Without its permission, spells cannot observe it remotely or detect its thoughts, creature type, or alignment.
Fiendish Restoration. If it dies outside the Nine Hells, its body becomes ichor and it immediately revives at full HP in a new body somewhere in the Nine Hells.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Cursed Touch attacks.
Cursed Touch. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 19 (3d12) necrotic damage. A creature hit is cursed and gains no benefit from finishing a Short Rest or Long Rest while the curse lasts.
Baleful Command (recharge 5–6). Each enemy in a 30-ft. Emanation from the rakshasa makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. On a failure, the enemy takes 28 (8d6) psychic damage and is Frightened and Incapacitated until the start of the rakshasa's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Charisma (save DC 18), without Material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion.
1/day each. Fly, Invisibility, Major Image, Plane Shift.

name: Satyr
description: A nimble Fey can drive enemies back with its hooves or lash out with a cutting remark.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The satyr has Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Hooves. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. The satyr can push a Medium or smaller creature hit up to 10 ft. directly away.
Mockery. One visible creature within 90 ft. makes a DC 12 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 5 (1d6 + 2) psychic damage.

name: Incubus
description: An incubus feeds on dreams and can return to a victim night after night. It may take the form of a succubus when it wants a different approach.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, poison, and psychic damage.
sections.Traits: Succubus Form. When the incubus finishes a Long Rest, it can shape-shift into a Succubus and use that stat block. Its worn and carried equipment stays the same.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Restless Touch attacks.
Restless Touch. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 15 (3d6 + 5) psychic damage and curse the target. The curse lasts 24 hours or until the incubus dies. Until it ends, the target gains no benefit from finishing Short Rests.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Charisma (save DC 15), without Material components.
At will. Disguise Self, Etherealness.
1/day each. Dream, Hypnotic Pattern.
sections.Bonus actions: Nightmare (recharge 6). One visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, if the creature has 20 HP or fewer it becomes Unconscious for up to 1 hour. Damage or a creature within 5 ft. spending an action to wake it ends the effect early. A target with more than 20 HP instead takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage on a failed save.

name: Bandit
description: A roadside outlaw armed with a scimitar and a light crossbow.

sections.Actions:
Scimitar. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.
Light Crossbow. Ranged attack, +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

name: Bandit Captain
description: A gang leader who fights with a scimitar and pistol and can turn aside a close strike.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Scimitar or Pistol for each.
Scimitar. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Pistol. Ranged attack, +5 to hit, range 30/90 ft. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Parry. When a melee attack hits the captain while it is holding a weapon, it adds 2 to its AC against that attack. This can turn the hit into a miss.

name: Berserker
description: A greataxe fighter whose attacks grow more reliable after taking a serious wound.

sections.Traits: Bloodied Frenzy. While Bloodied, the berserker has Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.
sections.Actions: Greataxe. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (1d12 + 3) slashing damage.

name: Cultist
description: A devotee who fights with a ritual sickle that leaves a trace of necrotic harm.

sections.Actions: Ritual Sickle. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage plus 1 necrotic damage.

name: Druid
description: A guardian of the wild who strikes with a living staff and sends radiant wisps after distant foes.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Vine Staff or Verdant Wisp for each.
Vine Staff. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) poison damage.
Verdant Wisp. Ranged attack, +5 to hit, range 90 ft. A hit deals 10 (3d6) radiant damage.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell as an action, using Wisdom with a spell save DC of 13.
At will. Druidcraft, Speak with Animals.
2/day each. Entangle, Thunderwave.
1/day each. Animal Messenger, Longstrider, Moonbeam.

name: Gladiator
description: An arena fighter who throws or thrusts with a spear and uses a shield to knock opponents down.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Spear attacks. The gladiator can replace one with Shield Bash.
Spear. Melee or ranged attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Shield Bash. Choose one visible creature within 5 ft. It makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure it takes 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage and falls Prone if it is Medium or smaller.
sections.Reactions: Parry. When a melee attack hits the gladiator while it is holding a weapon, it adds 3 to its AC against that attack. This can turn the hit into a miss.

name: Priest
description: A member of the clergy who strikes with radiant power and uses cleric magic to aid allies.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Mace or Radiant Flame for each.
Mace. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) radiant damage.
Radiant Flame. Ranged attack, +5 to hit, range 60 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d10) radiant damage.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell as an action using Wisdom.
At will. Light, Thaumaturgy.
1/day. Spirit Guardians.
sections.Bonus actions: Divine Aid (3/day total). Cast Bless, Dispel Magic, Healing Word, or Lesser Restoration using Wisdom. The four spells draw from the same pool of three uses.
sections.Spell save DC: Use DC 13 for spells that call for a save. The source names Wisdom but gives no DC. This value uses the priest's Wisdom modifier of +3 and proficiency bonus of +2.

name: Dragon Turtle
description: Dragon turtles patrol stretches of sea, claim passing cargo and guard submerged hoards. Some guide sailors or trade stories for a share of the treasure.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The dragon breathes both air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Bite attacks. The dragon can substitute one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee attack, +13 to hit, reach 15 ft. A hit deals 23 (3d10 + 7) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Being underwater grants no Resistance to this Fire damage.
Tail. Melee attack, +13 to hit, reach 15 ft. A hit deals 18 (2d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage and knocks a Huge or smaller creature Prone.
Steam Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. Cone makes a DC 19 Constitution save. It takes 56 (16d6) Fire damage on a failure or half on a success. Being underwater grants no Resistance to this Fire damage.

name: Young Brass Dragon
description: Young brass dragons roam for years between visits to their lairs. Some carry news between metallic dragons.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. The dragon can substitute one use of Sleep Breath for two attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) Slashing damage.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 40-ft. Line 5 ft. wide makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. It takes 38 (11d6) Fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
Sleep Breath. Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure it is Incapacitated until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. A second failure leaves it Unconscious for 1 minute. Damage wakes it, and a creature within 5 ft. can also wake it by taking an action.

name: Young Bronze Dragon
description: A young bronze dragon often takes up a local cause, such as protecting a port from raiders. It seeks friends who bring skills it lacks.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The dragon breathes both air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. The dragon can substitute one use of Repulsion Breath for one attack.
Rend. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 16 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage.
Lightning Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. Line 5 ft. wide makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. It takes 49 (9d10) Lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
Repulsion Breath. Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure it is pushed up to 40 ft. directly away from the dragon and falls Prone.

name: Young Copper Dragon
description: Young copper dragons make close friends and move quickly from one artistic pursuit to the next.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. The dragon can substitute one use of Slowing Breath for one attack.
Rend. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) Slashing damage.
Acid Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 40-ft. Line 5 ft. wide makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. It takes 40 (9d8) Acid damage on a failure or half on a success.
Slowing Breath. Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure its Speed is halved and it cannot take Reactions. On its turn it can take an action or a Bonus Action, with a limit of one of the two. The effect lasts until the end of that creature's next turn.

name: Young Gold Dragon
description: Young gold dragons confront evils they have seen firsthand and often prefer direct action.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The dragon breathes both air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. The dragon can substitute one use of Weakening Breath for one attack.
Rend. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 17 (2d10 + 6) Slashing damage.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. It takes 55 (10d10) Fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
Weakening Breath. Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone that is free of this breath's effects makes a DC 17 Strength save. On a failure it has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and subtracts 3 (1d6) from its damage rolls. It saves again at the end of each of its turns. A success ends the effect, and it succeeds automatically after 1 minute.

name: Young Red Dragon
description: Young red dragons raid for treasure and seize land where they can demand obedience.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. It takes 56 (16d6) Fire damage on a failure or half on a success.

name: Young Silver Dragon
description: Young silver dragons seek out heroes and older metallic dragons. They often carry messages or speak for those allies.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. The dragon can substitute one use of Paralyzing Breath for one attack.
Rend. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d8 + 6) Slashing damage.
Cold Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 17 Constitution save. It takes 49 (11d8) Cold damage on a failure or half on a success.
Paralyzing Breath. Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 17 Constitution save. On a failure it is Incapacitated until the end of its next turn, when it saves again. A second failure leaves it Paralyzed. A Paralyzed target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. A success ends the effect, and it succeeds automatically after 1 minute.

name: Young White Dragon
speed: 40 ft., burrow 20 ft., fly 80 ft., swim 40 ft.
description: Young white dragons defend their hunting grounds. Nearby communities may leave food and treasure to keep them from hunting closer to home.

sections.Traits: Ice Walk. The dragon can cross or climb ice without an ability check. Ice and snow that count as Difficult Terrain cost it no extra movement.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage.
Cold Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 15 Constitution save. It takes 40 (9d8) Cold damage on a failure or half on a success.

name: Black Dragon Wyrmling
description: A swamp-dwelling wyrmling that hunts from the water and exhales a narrow jet of acid.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The wyrmling breathes both air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Acid damage.
Acid Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Line 5 ft. wide makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 22 (5d8) Acid damage. On a success, it takes half that damage.

name: Blue Dragon Wyrmling
description: An electric-blue wyrmling at home in desert and coastal burrows.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Lightning damage.
Lightning Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. Line 5 ft. wide makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 21 (6d6) Lightning damage. On a success, it takes half that damage.

name: Green Dragon Wyrmling
description: A forest wyrmling that can breathe underwater and fill a clearing with poison.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The wyrmling breathes both air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.
Poison Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 11 Constitution save. On a failure, the creature takes 21 (6d6) Poison damage. On a success, it takes half that damage.

name: Red Dragon Wyrmling
description: A fire-breathing wyrmling that climbs the hills and mountains where it lives.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 24 (7d6) Fire damage. On a success, it takes half that damage.

name: White Dragon Wyrmling
speed: 30 ft., burrow 15 ft., fly 60 ft., swim 30 ft.
description: An arctic wyrmling that moves across ice and hunts with a blast of cold.

sections.Traits: Ice Walk. The wyrmling crosses and climbs icy surfaces without an ability check. Ice and snow never cost it extra movement as Difficult Terrain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage.
Cold Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, the creature takes 22 (5d8) Cold damage. On a success, it takes half that damage.

name: Brass Dragon Wyrmling
description: A desert wyrmling that burrows into the sand and breathes either fire or sleep gas.

sections.Actions:
Rend. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 20-ft. Line 5 ft. wide makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 14 (4d6) Fire damage. On a success, it takes half that damage.
Sleep Breath. Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 11 Constitution save. On a failure, it is Incapacitated until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. A second failure leaves it Unconscious for 1 minute. Taking damage ends the effect, as does a creature within 5 ft. taking an action to wake it.

name: Bronze Dragon Wyrmling
description: An amphibious coastal wyrmling with lightning breath and a blast that knocks creatures back.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The wyrmling breathes both air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.
Lightning Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 40-ft. Line 5 ft. wide makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 16 (3d10) Lightning damage. On a success, it takes half that damage.
Repulsion Breath. Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 12 Strength save. On a failure, it is pushed up to 30 ft. straight away from the dragon and knocked Prone.

name: Copper Dragon Wyrmling
description: A hill-dwelling wyrmling that climbs as readily as it walks and can slow pursuers with its breath.

sections.Actions:
Rend. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage.
Acid Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 20-ft. Line 5 ft. wide makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 18 (4d8) Acid damage. On a success, it takes half that damage.
Slowing Breath. Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 11 Constitution save. On a failure, its Speed is halved, it loses access to Reactions, and it can take at most one action or Bonus Action on its turn. These restrictions end at the end of its next turn.

name: Gold Dragon Wyrmling
description: An amphibious wyrmling that lives in forests or grasslands. Its two breaths burn or weaken foes.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The wyrmling breathes both air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 22 (4d10) Fire damage. On a success, it takes half that damage.
Weakening Breath. Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone that is unaffected by this breath makes a DC 13 Strength save. On a failure, it has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and subtracts 2 (1d4) from its damage rolls. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. After 1 minute the save succeeds automatically.

name: Silver Dragon Wyrmling
description: A wyrmling found in mountains and cities whose breath can chill or paralyze.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) Piercing damage.
Cold Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, the creature takes 18 (4d8) Cold damage. On a success, it takes half that damage.
Paralyzing Breath. Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, it is Incapacitated until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. A second failure leaves it Paralyzed. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. After 1 minute the save succeeds automatically.

name: Blue Slaad
description: Blue slaadi fight beside red slaadi. Their claw blades carry a curse called chaos phage, and they instinctively avoid killing creatures already bearing a slaad curse.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The creature makes saving throws with Advantage against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. The slaad regains 10 HP at the start of each of its turns while it has at least 1 HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Mutating Claw attacks.
Mutating Claw. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage. A Humanoid hit by the claw makes a DC 15 Constitution save if it carries no slaad curse. On a failure it contracts chaos phage. While cursed, it can't regain HP and loses 10 (3d6) from its HP maximum every 24 hours. A Long Rest doesn't restore the lost maximum.
If the curse reduces the target's HP maximum to 0, the curse ends and the target immediately becomes a Red Slaad. It becomes a Green Slaad instead if it can cast spells of level 3 or higher. The transformation replaces death. Only Wish can undo the transformation.
sections.Slaad control gems:
A slaad born from the Spawning Stone carries a magical control gem in its head. Once another creature claims the gem, the slaad is Charmed and obeys the bearer. It stops being Charmed if the bearer or the bearer's allies harm it, if someone returns the gem to the slaad, or if Greater Restoration destroys the gem when cast on the slaad.
Wish can retrieve the gem. If the slaad fails its save against Imprisonment, the caster gets the gem and the slaad stays free. Removing the gem from an Incapacitated slaad takes 1 minute and a successful DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check. Failure deals 22 (4d10) Piercing damage to the slaad.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), p. 285. The Slaad Control Gems sidebar supplies the control gem rules.

name: Death Slaad
description: Slaad lords infuse gray slaadi with chaotic power to create death slaadi. Death slaadi often direct groups of slaadi that are acting toward a shared goal.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The creature makes saving throws with Advantage against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. The slaad regains 10 HP at the start of each of its turns while it has at least 1 HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Chaos Blade attacks.
Chaos Blade. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 11 (1d12 + 5) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. Roll a d4 to determine the condition affecting the target until the start of the slaad's next turn. On 1 it is Charmed, on 2 Frightened, on 3 Poisoned, and on 4 Incapacitated.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the listed spells using Charisma (save DC 16) without Material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Invisibility (self only), Mage Hand, Major Image.
1/day each. Blight (level 8), Cloudkill (level 6), Fly, Plane Shift, Tongues.
sections.Bonus actions: Shape-Shift. Become a Small or Medium Humanoid or return to the slaad's true form. Its size is the only statistic that can change. Worn and carried equipment keeps its usual form.

sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), p. 287. The Slaad Control Gems sidebar supplies the control gem rules.

name: Gray Slaad
description: The Spawning Stone or a slaad lord can turn a green slaad into a gray one. Gray slaadi search the planes for Humanoid settlements near portals.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The creature makes saving throws with Advantage against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. The slaad regains 10 HP at the start of each of its turns while it has at least 1 HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Chaos Claw attacks.
Chaos Claw. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage. Roll a d4 to determine the condition affecting the target until the start of the slaad's next turn. On 1 it is Charmed, on 2 Frightened, on 3 Poisoned, and on 4 Incapacitated.
sections.Spellcasting:

At will. Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Invisibility (self only), Mage Hand, Major Image.
1/day each. Cloudkill, Fly, Plane Shift (self only), Tongues.

name: Green Slaad
description: Green slaadi can arise when a red or blue slaad curses a host capable of casting spells of level 3 or higher. Green slaadi often direct their kin toward portals that gray slaadi scout.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The creature makes saving throws with Advantage against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. The slaad regains 10 HP at the start of each of its turns while it has at least 1 HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Chaos Staff attacks.
Chaos Staff. Melee or ranged attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) Force damage. Roll a d4 to determine the condition affecting the target until the start of the slaad's next turn. On 1 it is Charmed, on 2 Frightened, on 3 Poisoned, and on 4 Incapacitated.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the listed spells using Charisma (save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks) without Material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Mage Hand.
1/day each. Fireball, Invisibility (self only).
sections.Bonus actions: Shape-Shift. Become a Small or Medium Humanoid or return to the slaad's true form. Its size is the only statistic that can change. Worn and carried equipment keeps its usual form.

name: Red Slaad
description: Red slaadi gather in Limbo to wrestle and reshape islands of drifting matter. When one meets a stranger, its mood can turn from play to hunger in moments.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The creature makes saving throws with Advantage against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. The slaad regains 10 HP at the start of each of its turns while it has at least 1 HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Injecting Claw attacks.
Injecting Claw. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage. A Humanoid hit by the claw makes a DC 14 Constitution save if it carries no slaad curse. On a failure it becomes cursed without realizing it, and the claw leaves an egg inside it. Ending the curse destroys the egg.
The egg develops over 2d4 × 10 days. During the last 24 hours the target feels ill, its Speed is halved, and it makes D20 Tests with Disadvantage. When that time ends, a Slaad Tadpole hatches and chews its way out, killing the host.
sections.Slaad control gems:

It stops being Charmed if the bearer or the bearer's allies harm it, if someone returns the gem to the slaad, or if Greater Restoration destroys the gem when cast on the slaad.
Wish can retrieve the gem. If the slaad fails its save against Imprisonment, the caster gets the gem and the slaad stays free. Removing the gem from an Incapacitated slaad takes 1 minute and a successful DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check. Failure deals 22 (4d10) Piercing damage to the slaad.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), p. 285. The Slaad Control Gems sidebar supplies the control gem rules.

name: Slaad Tadpole
description: These ravenous newborn slaadi hatch from eggs implanted by red slaadi. They also appear in Limbo and other realms of chaos.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The creature makes saving throws with Advantage against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.
sections.Growth: Under most conditions, a tadpole becomes a Blue Slaad within 2d12 hours of hatching. It becomes a Green Slaad instead if its host could cast spells of level 3 or higher.
sections.Slaad control gems:
A slaad born from the Spawning Stone carries a magical control gem in its head. Once another creature claims the gem, the slaad is Charmed and obeys the bearer. It stops being Charmed if the bearer or the bearer's allies harm it, if someone returns the gem to the slaad, or if Greater Restoration destroys the gem when cast on the slaad.
Wish can retrieve the gem. If the slaad fails its save against Imprisonment, the caster gets the gem and the slaad stays free. Removing the gem from an Incapacitated slaad takes 1 minute and a successful DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check. Failure deals 22 (4d10) Piercing damage to the slaad.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), p. 284. The Slaad Control Gems sidebar supplies the control gem rules. The Slaad Tadpole description supplies its growth timing.

name: Goristro
description: This enormous, minotaur-like demon serves Baphomet and prowls the Endless Maze. Goristros turn their strength against anything that rivals them in size, including giants and fortifications.

sections.Traits:
Demonic Restoration. If the goristro dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor. It immediately regains a body and returns at full HP somewhere in the Abyss.
Magic Resistance. The creature makes saving throws with Advantage against spells and other magical effects.
Siege Monster. The goristro deals twice its normal damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Brutal Gore attack and two Slam attacks.
Brutal Gore. Melee attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 40 (6d10 + 7) Piercing damage. A Huge or smaller creature hit by this attack is knocked Prone and pushed up to 20 ft. directly away from the goristro.
Slam. Melee attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 29 (4d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Charge. Move up to half the goristro's Speed in a straight line toward a visible enemy.

name: Dust Mephit
description: A winged elemental of air and fine earth that haunts forgotten places and treats death as a joke.

sections.Traits: Death Burst. When the mephit dies, each creature in its 5-ft. Emanation makes a DC 10 Dexterity save. It takes 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Actions:
Claw. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. It deals 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage on a hit.
Blinding Breath (recharge 6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 10 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature is Blinded until the end of the mephit's next turn.
Sleep (1/day). Cast Sleep using Charisma (save DC 10), without spell components.

name: Ice Mephit
description: A winged elemental of frost and cold air. It freezes whatever it can and slips ice into travelers' clothes.

sections.Traits: Death Burst. When the mephit dies, each creature in its 5-ft. Emanation makes a DC 10 Constitution save. It takes 5 (2d4) Cold damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Actions:
Claw. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. It deals 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage on a hit.
Frost Breath (recharge 6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 10 Constitution save. It takes 7 (3d4) Cold damage on a failure or half on a success.
Fog Cloud (1/day). Cast Fog Cloud using Charisma, without spell components.

name: Magma Mephit
description: A winged creature of molten rock that enjoys melting things and attacks magmins on sight.

sections.Traits: Death Burst. When the mephit dies, each creature in its 5-ft. Emanation makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. It takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Actions:
Claw. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. It deals 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage on a hit.
Fire Breath (recharge 6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. It takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage on a failure or half on a success.

name: Mud Mephit
description: A winged elemental of earth and water that smears mud over belongings and ruins unattended food.

sections.Traits: Death Burst. When the mephit dies, each creature in its 5-ft. Emanation makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, that creature is Restrained until the end of its own next turn.
sections.Actions:
Slam. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. It deals 4 (1d6 + 1) Bludgeoning damage on a hit.
Mud Breath (recharge 6). Choose one creature the mephit can see within 15 ft. That creature makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, it is Restrained until the end of the mephit's next turn.

name: Smoke Mephit
description: A winged figure of cinders and hot air that takes pleasure in misleading people and mocking them afterward.

sections.Traits: Death Burst. When the mephit dies, each creature in its 5-ft. Emanation makes a DC 11 Constitution save. On a failure, that creature is Poisoned until the end of its own next turn.
sections.Actions:
Claw. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. It deals 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage on a hit.
Cinder Breath (recharge 6). Choose one creature the mephit can see within 15 ft. That creature makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, it is Blinded until the end of the mephit's next turn.

name: Steam Mephit
description: A winged creature of heated vapor that promises rewards for favors and rarely pays up.

sections.Traits:
Blurred Form. Attack rolls against the mephit have Disadvantage unless it is Incapacitated.
Death Burst. When the mephit dies, each creature in its 5-ft. Emanation makes a DC 10 Dexterity save. It takes 5 (2d4) Fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Actions:
Claw. Melee attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. It deals 2 (1d4) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Fire damage on a hit.
Steam Breath (recharge 6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 10 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 5 (2d4) Fire damage and loses 10 ft. of Speed until the end of the mephit's next turn. A success halves the damage and leaves Speed unchanged. Being underwater grants no Resistance to this Fire damage.

name: Magmin
description: A little creature of flame and volcanic rock that treats anything flammable as kindling.

sections.Traits: Death Burst. When the magmin dies, each creature in its 10-ft. Emanation makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. It takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Actions: Touch. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. It deals 7 (2d4 + 2) Fire damage on a hit. A creature or an unworn, uncarried flammable object hit this way starts Burning.
sections.Bonus actions: Ignited Illumination. Kindle or extinguish its own flames. While ablaze, it sheds Bright Light in a 10-ft. radius and Dim Light for another 10 ft.
sections.Burning hazard: A burning creature or object takes 1d4 Fire damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can use its action to drop Prone and roll to extinguish its own flames. Dousing, submerging, or smothering the fire also puts it out.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), p. 200. Burning follows Player's Handbook (2024), p. 362.

name: Githyanki Knight
description: Githyanki knights defend Astral Plane territory against intruders. Their sacred silver swords can sever the cords of creatures traveling by Astral Projection.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Silver Sword attacks. The knight can replace one attack with Telekinesis through Spellcasting, if available.
Silver Sword. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) Psychic damage. On a critical hit against a target in an astral body, the knight can sever the cord tethering that body to the target's material body in place of the damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Intelligence (spell save DC 13), with no components.
At will. Mage Hand (the hand is Invisible).
2/day each. Nondetection (self only) and Tongues.
1/day each. Plane Shift and Telekinesis.
sections.Bonus actions: Misty Step (2/day). Cast Misty Step using Intelligence, with no components.

name: Githyanki Warrior
description: Githyanki warriors fight with blades that channel psionic force. Many serve Vlaakith in campaigns against mind flayers, githzerai, and other enemies.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Psi Blade attacks.
Psi Blade. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Intelligence, with no components.
At will. Mage Hand (the hand is Invisible).
2/day. Nondetection (self only).
sections.Bonus actions: Misty Step (2/day). Cast Misty Step using Intelligence, with no components.

name: Githzerai Monk
description: Githzerai monks practice physical discipline alongside psionics. Some leave their sanctuaries to test that training in harsher parts of the multiverse.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Psi Strike attacks.
Psi Strike. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Wisdom, with no components.
At will. Mage Hand (the hand is Invisible).
1/day. See Invisibility.
sections.Bonus actions: Psi-Powered Leap (2/day). Cast Jump using Wisdom, with no components.
sections.Reactions: Psionic Defense (2/day total). When the trigger for Feather Fall or Shield occurs, cast that spell using Wisdom, with no components. Both spells use the same two daily uses.

name: Githzerai Zerth
description: Zerths carry on Zerthimon's teachings. They hone their psionics in githzerai sanctuaries and can travel among the planes.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Psi Strike attacks.
Psi Strike. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) Psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Wisdom (spell save DC 14), with no components.
At will. Mage Hand (the hand is Invisible).
1/day each. Phantasmal Killer (level 6), Plane Shift, and See Invisibility.
sections.Bonus actions: Psi-Powered Leap (2/day). Cast Jump using Wisdom, with no components.
sections.Reactions: Psionic Defense (2/day total). When the trigger for Feather Fall or Shield occurs, cast that spell using Wisdom, with no components. Both spells use the same two daily uses.

name: Drider
description: Driders combine the features of spiders and humanoids, often drow transformed by Lolth. Their climbing and web magic let them hunt from cavern ceilings or dense forest canopies.

sections.Traits:
Spider Climb. Climb difficult surfaces or ceilings without an ability check.
Sunlight Sensitivity. While in sunlight, the drider has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
Web Walker. Webs do not restrict the drider's movement. It knows where every other creature touching the same web is.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Foreleg or Poison Burst in any combination.
Foreleg. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.
Poison Burst. Ranged attack, +6 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 13 (3d6 + 3) Poison damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Magic of the Spider Queen (Recharge 5–6). Cast Darkness, Faerie Fire, or Web using Wisdom (spell save DC 14), with no Material components.

name: Kenku
description: A curse left these birdfolk flightless and able to speak only by imitating sounds. Kenku use mimicry to signal allies or lure foes toward an ambush.

sections.Traits: Mimicry. The kenku can imitate sounds it has heard, including voices. A listener can recognize an imitation with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.
sections.Actions: Shadow Blade. Melee or ranged attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) Necrotic damage. The blade returns magically to the kenku's hand immediately after a ranged attack.
sections.Bonus actions: Eldritch Lantern (Recharge 4–6). Cast Faerie Fire using Intelligence (spell save DC 10).

name: Winged Kobold
description: Kobolds call their winged kin urds and often take the wings as a sign of draconic favor. An urd can spit elemental energy while staying out of melee reach.

sections.Traits:
Pack Tactics. The kobold has Advantage when attacking a creature if an ally within 5 ft. of that target isn't Incapacitated.
Sunlight Sensitivity. While in sunlight, the kobold has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
sections.Actions:
Dragon-Tooth Blade. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.
Chromatic Spittle. Ranged attack, +5 to hit, range 30 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) damage. The kobold chooses Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison.
sections.Habitats: Arctic, Coastal, Desert, Forest, Hill, Mountain, Swamp, Underdark, Urban.

name: Awakened Shrub
description: A small plant made sentient by magic. It can look like a flowering bush or a walking piece of topiary.

sections.Actions: Rake. Melee attack, +1 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 1 Slashing damage.

name: Awakened Tree
description: A living tree that can walk and speak. Some stand motionless for long stretches, while others patrol places steeped in natural magic.

sections.Actions: Slam. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

name: Myconid Adult
description: An Underdark fungus folk defender that keeps intruders away from its colony.

sections.Traits: Sun Sickness. In sunlight, the myconid has Disadvantage on D20 Tests. It dies if it spends more than 1 hour in sunlight.
sections.Actions:
Slam. Melee attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 4 (1d8) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.
Pacifying Spores (1/day). One visible creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 11 Constitution save. On failure, it is Stunned. It can end the effect by succeeding on a repeat save at the end of any of its turns. After 1 minute, the save succeeds automatically.
Rapport Spores. Release spores in a 30-ft. Emanation from the myconid. Creatures in the area with Intelligence 2 or higher gain telepathy out to 30 ft. for 1 hour. Constructs, Elementals, and Undead gain nothing from the spores.

name: Myconid Sovereign
description: A tall myconid whose layered growths set it apart from the adults it leads. It tends the colony and its fungal blooms.

sections.Traits: Sun Sickness. In sunlight, the myconid has Disadvantage on D20 Tests. It dies if it spends more than 1 hour in sunlight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Slam attack and use Pacifying Spores.
Slam. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 6 (2d4 + 1) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Poison damage.
Animating Spores (3/day). Release spores on a Small or Medium corpse within 5 ft. It must have belonged to a creature other than a Construct or Undead.
