After 24 hours, it rises as a Myconid Spore Servant. The animation lasts 1d4 + 1 weeks or ends when the servant is destroyed. These spores can animate that corpse only once.
Pacifying Spores. One visible creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On failure, it is Stunned. It can end the effect by succeeding on a repeat save at the end of any of its turns. After 1 minute, the save succeeds automatically.
Rapport Spores. Release spores in a 30-ft. Emanation from the myconid. Creatures in the area with Intelligence 2 or higher gain telepathy out to 30 ft. for 1 hour. Constructs, Elementals, and Undead gain nothing from the spores.

name: Myconid Sprout
description: A small myconid that tends the colony and watches for trespassers.

sections.Traits: Sun Sickness. In sunlight, the myconid has Disadvantage on D20 Tests. It dies if it spends more than 1 hour in sunlight.
sections.Actions:
Slam. Melee attack, +1 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 1 (1d4 - 1) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.
Rapport Spores. Release spores in a 30-ft. Emanation from the myconid. Creatures in the area with Intelligence 2 or higher gain telepathy out to 30 ft. for 1 hour. Constructs, Elementals, and Undead gain nothing from the spores.

name: Twig Blight
description: A tangle of moving twigs that hides near deadwood and ambushes travelers in groups.

sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. It has Advantage on attacks against a creature while at least one of its allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally is not Incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Claw. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

name: Vine Blight
description: A humanoid silhouette wrapped in vines. It can tangle foes in sudden plant growth and may repeat the words of its victims.

sections.Actions:
Constricting Vine. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 6 (1d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit is Grappled (escape DC 12). While the grapple lasts, the target takes 4 (1d8) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns and the blight cannot use Constricting Vine.
Entangling Plants (recharge 5–6). Cast Entangle using Constitution (spell save DC 12).

name: Needle Blight
description: A gaunt walking plant that lashes out with thorn-covered claws or flings volleys of needles.

sections.Actions:
Claw. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 6 (2d4 + 1) Slashing damage.
Needles. Ranged attack, +3 to hit, range 30/60 ft. On a hit, deal 6 (2d4 + 1) Piercing damage.

name: Violet Fungus
description: A slow-moving fungus whose lashing tendrils rot flesh on contact.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rotting Touch attacks.
Rotting Touch. Melee attack, +2 to hit, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.

name: Peryton
description: A winged predator with a fanged stag's head dives on travelers. Its shadow has a humanoid outline.

sections.Languages: Understands Common and Elvish. It cannot speak.
sections.Traits: Flyby. Flying out of an enemy's reach provokes no Opportunity Attack from that enemy.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Gore attack and one Talons attack.
Gore. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. Deal an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage if the peryton moved at least 30 ft. straight toward the target immediately before the hit.
Talons. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage. A Humanoid reduced to 0 HP by this attack dies as the peryton takes its heart.
sections.Peryton superstitions:
Roll 1d4 or choose what the peryton expects after collecting enough hearts.
1. The hearts will grant a wicked wish.
2. The peryton will regain its former shape.
3. Each heart will hatch a peryton.
4. The collection will open a portal into the Lower Planes.

name: Lamia
description: A lion-bodied fiend searches desert ruins for magic and uses illusions and dangerous bargains to recruit servants.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks. The lamia can use Corrupting Touch in place of one Claw attack.
Claw. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
Corrupting Touch. One creature the lamia can see within 5 ft. makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failure, the target takes 13 (3d8) psychic damage and is cursed for 1 hour. It is Charmed and Poisoned while the curse lasts.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Charisma (save DC 13) without Material components.
At will. Disguise Self (the disguise can be a Large or Medium biped) and Minor Illusion.
1/day each. Geas, Major Image, and Scrying.
sections.Bonus actions: Leap. Spend 10 ft. of movement to jump up to 30 ft.
sections.Lamia pacts:
Roll 1d6 or choose a demand.
1. Bring back a possession of a noble or ruler.
2. Survey and map a ruin or dungeon.
3. Help the lamia through the gates of a nearby settlement.
4. Leave a peculiar idol at a chosen site or home.
5. Lift a magic item's curse and bring the item back.
6. Kill a monster and bring back a specific organ.

name: Harpy
description: A winged scavenger with a humanlike face uses a magical song to draw prey into danger.

sections.Actions:
Claw. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage.
Luring Song. The harpy starts a magical song that continues while it maintains Concentration. At the start of the song, each Humanoid and Giant in a 300-ft. Emanation from the harpy makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. A creature that fails is Charmed until the song ends or it succeeds on a repeat save. While Charmed by the song, the creature is Incapacitated and ignores other harpies' Luring Songs. If it is more than 5 ft. away on its turn, it follows the most direct route toward the harpy, trying to get within 5 ft. It does not avoid Opportunity Attacks for this movement. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, before entering damaging terrain, and whenever a source other than the harpy damages it. A successful save grants immunity to this harpy's song for 24 hours.

name: Succubus
description: A shape-shifting fiend gains leverage by impersonating people its targets trust and drains the life of those it charms.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, poison, and psychic damage.
sections.Languages: Abyssal, Common, and Infernal. Telepathy 60 ft.
sections.Traits: Incubus Form. After finishing a Long Rest, the succubus can take Incubus form and switch to the Incubus stat block.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Fiendish Touch attack and use either Charm or Draining Kiss.
Fiendish Touch. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 16 (2d10 + 5) psychic damage.
Charm. Cast Dominate Person at level 8 without components, using Charisma (save DC 15).
Draining Kiss. One creature within 5 ft. that the succubus has Charmed makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 13 (3d8) psychic damage, or half that on a success. The damage dealt also reduces the target's maximum HP by the same amount.
sections.Bonus actions: Shape-Shift. The succubus can look like a Medium or Small Humanoid or take its true form again. Only its true form has a Fly Speed. Other statistics stay the same, and gear keeps its shape.
sections.Succubus temptations:
Roll 1d6 or choose a tactic.
1. Impersonate a loved one the target has lost.
2. Charm someone the target trusts.
3. Separate the target from family or friends.
4. Arrange a piece of unexpected good fortune.
5. Pass as an eager subordinate who flatters the target.
6. Pose as someone the target wants to protect.

name: Pixie
description: A tiny winged explorer uses dust and illusions to slip away from trouble.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The pixie has Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions: Faerie Dust. Melee or ranged attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. On a hit, deal 1 radiant damage. The pixie chooses whether the target becomes Charmed or Poisoned until the start of the pixie's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Charisma (save DC 12) without Material components.
At will. Dancing Lights, Druidcraft, and Invisibility (self only).
1/day each. Detect Thoughts, Fly, and Sleep.

name: Manticore
description: A winged hunter with a lionlike body and a barbed tail. It ambushes travelers from the air, but a better meal can persuade it to bargain.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks. Choose Rend or Tail Spike for each attack.
Rend. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.
Tail Spike. Ranged attack, +5 to hit, range 100/200 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Habitats: Arctic, coasts, grasslands, hills, and mountains.

name: Pseudodragon
description: A cat-sized dragon that stashes shiny objects in little lairs among trees or rocks. It may befriend a spellcaster, especially one who brings treats.

sections.Languages: understands Common and Draconic but can't speak.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The pseudodragon rolls saving throws against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Sting. One visible creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 5 (2d4) poison damage and becomes Poisoned for 1 hour. While Poisoned this way it is also Unconscious. That Unconscious condition ends early if the creature takes damage or someone within 5 ft. of it uses an action to wake it.
sections.Habitats: Coasts, deserts, forests, hills, mountains, and urban areas.

name: Sprite
description: A winged, foot-tall defender of enchanted forests. Sprites welcome friendly visitors and ambush those who threaten their home.

sections.Actions:
Needle Sword. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.
Enchanting Bow. Ranged attack, +6 to hit, range 40/160 ft. On a hit, the target takes 1 piercing damage and is Charmed until the sprite starts its next turn.
Heart Sight. One creature the sprite can see within 5 ft. makes a DC 10 Charisma save. Celestials, Fiends, and Undead fail automatically. On failure the sprite learns the target's emotions and alignment.
Invisibility. The sprite casts Invisibility on itself using Charisma. The spell requires no components.

name: Troll
description: A predator that drags smaller creatures back to its lair. Its wounds close quickly, and limbs that come off can keep fighting.

sections.Traits:
Loathsome Limbs (4/day). Check at the end of any turn. If the troll is Bloodied and took at least 15 slashing damage during that turn, one of its limbs falls into its space as a Troll Limb. The limb takes its turn immediately after the troll. Each missing limb gives the troll one level of Exhaustion. The next time it regains hit points, it regrows the missing limbs.
Regeneration. The troll heals 15 HP when it starts a turn. Acid or fire damage shuts off this healing on its next turn. The troll can die only if it begins a turn at 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Charge. Move up to half the troll's speed straight toward an enemy it can see.
sections.Habitats: Arctic, forests, hills, mountains, swamps, and the Underdark.

name: Umber Hulk
description: An armored burrower that tracks movement through stone. It digs beside traveled passages and punches through the wall to ambush prey.

sections.Traits: Tunneler. The umber hulk burrows through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a tunnel 10 ft. across.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions:
Confusing Gaze (recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. A creature that fails loses its reactions until the umber hulk starts its next turn and rolls 1d8 to determine what it does on its own next turn.
1–4. Do nothing.
5–6. Take neither an action nor a bonus action. Spend all movement going in a random direction.
7–8. Make a melee attack against a creature chosen at random from those within reach. Do nothing if no such attack is possible.

name: Blink Dog
description: A Feywild hound that vanishes and reappears as it runs. Blink dogs may join centaurs and pixies on hunts that cross into other worlds.

sections.Languages: Blink Dog. It understands Elvish and Sylvan and can't speak either.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Teleport (recharge 4–6). The dog teleports up to 40 ft. to a vacant space it can see.

name: Death Dog
description: A two-headed desert hound that targets weakened prey. It may retreat after a bite and stalk the victim until the infection takes hold.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, and Unconscious.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. A creature hit must make a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure it is Poisoned. While Poisoned in this way, finishing a Long Rest does not restore its hit point maximum to normal. It repeats the save every 24 hours, ending the effect on a success. Each failed repeat save reduces its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10).

name: Griffon
description: A hunter with the body of a big cat and the head and wings of a raptor. The familiar eagle-and-lion form is one of several breeds.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage. On a hit, a Medium or smaller creature is also Grappled by both front claws, escape DC 14.

name: Hippogriff
description: Part horse and part bird of prey, a hippogriff hunts as it migrates. Some carry riders who offer food or aid.

sections.Traits: Flyby. An enemy cannot make an Opportunity Attack when the hippogriff leaves that enemy's reach by flying.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

name: Pegasus
description: An intelligent winged horse often found in secluded pastures or on floating islands. Some serve deities of the Feywild or Upper Planes.

sections.Languages: Understands Celestial, Common, Elvish, and Sylvan. It can't speak.
sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) radiant damage.

name: Roc
description: A giant bird of prey that can lift an elephant or a wagon and carry it back to a distant nest.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Beak attacks. The roc can replace one of them with Talons.
Beak. Melee attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 28 (3d12 + 9) piercing damage.
Talons. Melee attack, +13 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 23 (4d6 + 9) slashing damage. On a hit, a Huge or smaller creature is also Grappled by both talons, escape DC 19. It is Restrained for as long as this grapple lasts.
sections.Bonus actions: Swoop (recharge 5–6). If the roc has a creature Grappled, it flies up to half its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, then drops the creature.

name: Winter Wolf
description: A horse-sized, speaking wolf that hunts in packs across the tundra. It can freeze prey with its breath.

sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The wolf has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if an ally of the wolf is within 5 ft. of the target and that ally isn't Incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. A Large or smaller creature hit also falls Prone.
Cold Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 12 Constitution save. It takes 18 (4d8) cold damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Ettercap
description: A hunched woodland predator spins webs across hunting paths and drags captives back to its lair. Ettercaps sometimes hunt alongside giant spiders.

sections.Traits:
Spider Climb. The ettercap traverses difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
Web Walker. Webs cannot impede its movement. It knows where every other creature touching its web is.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claw attack.
Bite. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) poison damage. The target is Poisoned until the start of the ettercap's next turn.
Claw. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.
Web Strand (recharge 5–6). Choose one visible creature within 30 ft. that is Large or smaller. It makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature is Restrained until the web is destroyed. The web has AC 10 and 5 HP. It is vulnerable to fire and immune to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Reel. Choose a creature within 30 ft. that the ettercap's Web Strand has Restrained. Pull it up to 25 ft. straight toward the ettercap.

name: Ettin
description: This giant has two heads with separate personalities. The pair may bicker or work together. Ettins sometimes join raiders or guard secrets coveted by druids and Fey.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, Unconscious.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Battleaxe attack and one Morningstar attack.
Battleaxe. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage and knocks a Large or smaller creature Prone.
Morningstar. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage. The target has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.
sections.Ettin interactions:
Roll 1d8 or choose what the heads are doing.
1. Psyching each other up for a fight.
2. Disputing dinner plans or battle tactics.
3. Judging each other's work while doing separate chores.
4. Seeing who blinks first.
5. Exchanging formal introductions.
6. Making a show of ignoring each other.
7. Adding complications to a shared plot.
8. Keeping each other from falling asleep.

name: Gargoyle
description: An elemental spirit animates a winged stone sculpture. It may wait motionless for months among statues or natural rock, or guard a site for the spellcaster who called it.

sections.Traits: Flyby. When the gargoyle flies out of an enemy's reach, that enemy cannot make an Opportunity Attack against it for that movement.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.
sections.Gargoyle sculptures:
Roll 1d6 or choose an appearance.
1. A smiling cherub.
2. Rough stone that looks barely carved.
3. A patched sculpture with pieces from other statues.
4. A dragon with smooth, shining stone scales.
5. A horned fiend with a tail.
6. A carved pillar or lectern.
sections.Gargoyle camouflage:
Roll 1d8 or choose where the gargoyle waits.
1. Knots in the trunk of a huge tree.
2. Stone monuments in a cemetery.
3. Projections on a cliff face.
4. Victims turned to stone by a basilisk or medusa.
5. Carved figures on a gate.
6. Rubble among ruins or refuse.
7. Stalactites or icicles overhead.
8. Statues inside a temple or grand residence.

name: Ogre
description: Ogres raid settlements and waylay travelers for food and loot. They may join a band that offers meals, plunder, or a chance to fight.

sections.Actions:
Greatclub. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
sections.Habitats: Arctic, Desert, Forest, Grassland, Hill, Mountain, Swamp, Underdark.

name: Ogre Zombie
description: An ogre corpse raised to haul heavy loads or smash through obstacles. It follows simple orders and keeps working after injuries that would stop a living ogre.

sections.Languages: Understands Common and Giant and cannot speak.
sections.Traits: Undead Fortitude. When damage brings the zombie to 0 HP, it makes a Constitution save with a DC of 5 plus the damage it just took. Radiant damage and Critical Hits bypass the save. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 HP instead.
sections.Actions: Slam. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Otyugh
description: This tentacled scavenger buries itself in refuse and watches with the eyes on its stalk. It can lure travelers close with gleaming scraps or telepathic bait.

sections.Languages: Otyugh. It can send telepathic messages within 120 ft. This telepathy is one-way.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks.
Bite. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage and leaves the target Poisoned. Whenever it finishes a Long Rest while Poisoned by this bite, it makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, reduce its maximum HP by 5 (1d10). That reduction lasts until the Poisoned condition ends. On a successful save, the Poisoned condition ends.
Tentacle. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller creature is Grappled (escape DC 13) by one of the otyugh's two tentacles.
Tentacle Slam. Every creature Grappled by the otyugh makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 16 (3d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and is Stunned until the start of the otyugh's next turn. A success halves the damage and avoids the stun.
sections.Otyugh lures:
Roll 1d4 or choose the bait.
1. Puppet shapes made of trash hide its tentacles.
2. It sings a song in Otyugh.
3. It sends a telepathic plea for help or promises a find.
4. It sends an image of a gem, a damaged weapon, or a snack.

name: Piercer
description: A young roper with one eye and a toothy mouth poses as a stalactite for months if need be. It drops on passing prey and slowly climbs back to its perch after feeding.

sections.Traits: Spider Climb. The piercer traverses difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.
Drop. The piercer falls. One creature directly below it makes a DC 11 Dexterity save, taking 10 (3d6) piercing damage on a failure. The piercer reduces any damage it takes from the fall by 20 regardless of the save result.

name: Hell Hound
description: A cunning pack hunter from the Lower Planes. It guards cruel masters and ambushes prey with a fiery blast.

sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The hound has Advantage when it attacks a creature with one or more of the hound's allies within 5 ft. of it, provided at least one of those allies isn't Incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. Cone makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. A failed save deals 17 (5d6) Fire damage, and a success halves it.
sections.Habitats: Mountains, the Lower Planes, and the Underdark.

name: Nightmare
description: A fiendish horse with a burning mane and hooves. It can carry willing creatures between the Material and Ethereal Planes.

sections.Languages: Understands Abyssal, Common, and Infernal but can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Confer Fire Resistance. The nightmare can give its rider Resistance to Fire damage while that rider remains mounted.
Illumination. The nightmare sheds Bright Light for 10 ft. in all directions, then Dim Light for 10 ft. farther.
sections.Actions:
Hooves. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.
Ethereal Stride. Teleport between the Material Plane and the Ethereal Plane in either direction. The nightmare can bring up to three willing creatures within 5 ft. of it.
sections.Nightmare riders:
Roll 1d6 or pick a rider.
1. A champion or envoy of an evil deity.
2. Imps or quasits out for a ride.
3. An innocent soul stranded on the runaway fiend.
4. A mage, cultist, or lich seeking lost lore.
5. A night hag driving larvae across the planes.
6. A wicked rider such as a death knight, erinyes, incubus, or vampire.

name: Oni
description: A shape-shifting fiend that slips into settlements under a disguise or the cover of invisibility.

sections.Traits: Regeneration. The oni heals 10 HP at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw or Nightmare Ray attacks. The oni can use Spellcasting in place of one attack.
Claw. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.
Nightmare Ray. Ranged attack, +5 to hit, range 60 ft. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) Psychic damage and leaves the target Frightened until the start of the oni's next turn.
Shape-Shift. Become a Small or Medium Humanoid or a Large Giant, or return to the oni's true form. Size is the only game statistic that changes between forms. Worn and carried gear keeps its original form.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Charisma, save DC 13. The spells need no Material components.
1/day each. Charm Person at level 2, Darkness, Gaseous Form, and Sleep.
sections.Bonus actions: Invisibility. The oni casts Invisibility on itself using Charisma without spell components.
sections.Oni troubles:
Roll 1d4 or pick a scheme.
1. Charm someone into playing a cruel trick.
2. Seize a bridge, gate, shrine, or trail and threaten to eat anyone who approaches.
3. Draw other monsters to town.
4. Drum at night to keep the town awake.

name: Salamander
description: A serpentine fire elemental that fights with a returning spear and wraps its coils around prey.

sections.Traits: Fire Aura. At the end of each of the salamander's turns, it chooses creatures in a 5-ft. Emanation centered on itself. Each chosen creature takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Flame Spear attacks. The salamander can use Constrict in place of one attack.
Flame Spear. Melee or ranged attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage. After a ranged attack, the spear returns to the salamander's hand immediately by magic.
Constrict. One visible creature within 10 ft. that is Large or smaller makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure it takes 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage and becomes Grappled (escape DC 14). It remains Restrained until that grapple ends.
sections.Habitats: The Elemental Plane of Fire and the Underdark.

name: Troglodyte
description: A cave hunter that climbs walls to ambush prey. Its stench may give it away before it strikes.

sections.Traits:
Stench. Any creature other than a troglodyte makes a DC 12 Constitution save when it starts its turn in a 5-ft. Emanation centered on the troglodyte. Failure leaves the creature Poisoned until the start of its next turn. Success makes it immune to the Stench of all troglodytes for 1 hour.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the troglodyte has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
sections.Actions: Rend. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage.

name: Vrock
description: A vulturelike demon from the Abyss. Its filthy feathers release poisonous spores, and its screech can stun nearby creatures.

sections.Traits:
Demonic Restoration. If the vrock dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor and it immediately revives at full HP in a new body somewhere in the Abyss.
Magic Resistance. The vrock has Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Shred attacks.
Shred. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Poison damage.
Spores (recharge 6). Each creature in a 20-ft. Emanation centered on the vrock makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure it becomes Poisoned, takes 5 (1d10) Poison damage at the start of each of its turns, and repeats the save at the end of each of those turns to end the effect on a success. Pouring a flask of Holy Water over the affected creature also ends the effect.
Stunning Screech (1/day). Each creature in a 20-ft. Emanation centered on the vrock makes a DC 15 Constitution save. Demons succeed automatically. On a failure, the creature takes 10 (3d6) Thunder damage and is Stunned until the end of the vrock's next turn.

name: Worg
description: A cunning, wolf-like Fey that hunts in forests and open country. It speaks both Goblin and Worg.

sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage. The next attack roll against that target has Advantage if it occurs before the start of the worg's next turn.
sections.Habitats: Forests, grasslands, hills, and the Feywild.

name: Commoner
description: A person trained in an everyday trade, such as farming, masonry, or smithing.

sections.Traits: Training. The DM chooses one skill. The commoner is proficient in that skill and has Advantage whenever it makes an ability check with it.
sections.Actions: Club. Melee attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Guard
description: A watch member equipped with a shield and spear.

sections.Actions: Spear. Melee or ranged attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

name: Knight
description: A warrior in plate armor whose sword strikes and bolts carry radiant power.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Greatsword or Heavy Crossbow for each.
Greatsword. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage and 4 (1d8) radiant damage.
Heavy Crossbow. Ranged attack, +2 to hit, range 100/400 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d10) piercing damage and 4 (1d8) radiant damage.
sections.Reactions: Parry. While holding a weapon, the knight can react to a melee attack roll that hits it. It gains +2 AC against that attack, which can turn the hit into a miss.

name: Noble
description: A person of rank who can defend themself with a rapier.

sections.Actions: Rapier. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Parry. While holding a weapon, the noble can react to a melee attack roll that hits it. It gains +2 AC against that attack, which can turn the hit into a miss.

name: Scout
description: A guide or lookout who tracks movement and can strike with a bow or blade.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Shortsword or Longbow for each.
Shortsword. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Longbow. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Spy
description: An infiltrator who climbs as fast as they walk and fights with poisoned weapons.

sections.Actions:
Shortsword. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage and 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Hand Crossbow. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage and 7 (2d6) poison damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Cunning Action. Take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

name: Homunculus
description: A mage uses their own blood in a ritual to animate this cat-sized, winged servant. It becomes inert when its creator dies.

sections.Languages: Understands Common and one other language but can't speak.
sections.Traits: Telepathic Bond. The homunculus and its creator can communicate telepathically while they share a plane of existence.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 1 piercing damage. The target then makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, the target is Poisoned until the end of the homunculus's next turn. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target is Poisoned for 1 minute and is Unconscious while Poisoned this way. Taking damage ends the Unconscious condition early.

name: Poltergeist
classification: Small or Medium undead, chaotic neutral
description: A spirit that moves objects around its haunts. Some absent-minded ghosts retrace old routines, while others use the things they move to play tricks or menace the living.

sections.Damage resistances: acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, piercing, slashing, thunder.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious.
sections.Traits: Incorporeal Movement. It treats creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain when passing through them. The poltergeist takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Object Slam attack and use Telekinetic Thrust.
Object Slam. Melee or ranged attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. A hit deals 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Telekinetic Thrust. Choose one creature the poltergeist can see within 30 ft. The target makes a DC 12 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 9 (2d6 + 2) force damage and is pushed straight away from the poltergeist by up to 30 ft.
sections.Bonus actions: Vanish. Become Invisible or end that condition on itself.

name: Scarecrow
description: A spirit of vengeance bound to a patchwork frame. It might obey its maker or defend a place, household, or community.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Unconscious.
sections.Actions:
Fearsome Claw. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage and leaves the target Frightened until the end of the scarecrow's next turn.
Terrifying Glare. One creature the scarecrow can see within 30 ft. makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Frightened until the end of the scarecrow's next turn and Paralyzed while Frightened by this glare.

name: Skeleton
description: An animated pile of bones that can fight with a blade or bow. It understands commands even though it cannot speak.

sections.Languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak.
sections.Actions:
Shortsword. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged attack, +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Yuan-ti Abomination
description: A large serpent-bodied yuan-ti that can tighten its coils around foes or take the shape of a large snake.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks. The yuan-ti can also cast Suggestion through Spellcasting if it is available.
Bite. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.
Constrict. One Large or smaller creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 28 (7d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and becomes Grappled (escape DC 14) and Restrained until that grapple ends. On a success, it takes half damage.
Poison Spray (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 21 (6d6) poison damage and is Poisoned until the end of the yuan-ti's next turn. A creature Poisoned this way is also Blinded for the duration of that condition. On a success, it takes half damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Shape-Shift. Become a Large snake or return to true form. Use the same statistics in either form except where a rule specifies otherwise. Worn and carried gear keeps its form. Death leaves the yuan-ti in its current form.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action in yuan-ti form, cast one of the listed spells using Wisdom (save DC 15). These spells require no material components.
At will. Animal Friendship (snakes only).
3/day. Suggestion.
sections.Habitats: Deserts, forests, swamps, and urban areas.

name: Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)
speed: 30 ft., climb 30 ft. in snake form only
description: A snake-headed yuan-ti that can spit poison at range in its true form.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
Stealth increases to +6 in snake form.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination using Bite or Poison Ray, subject to their form restrictions. The yuan-ti can also cast Suggestion through Spellcasting if it is available.
Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Poison Ray (yuan-ti form only). Ranged attack, +5 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) poison damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Shape-Shift. Become a Medium snake or return to true form. Use the same statistics in either form except where a rule specifies otherwise. Worn and carried gear keeps its form. Death leaves the yuan-ti in its current form.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action in yuan-ti form, cast one of the listed spells using Wisdom (save DC 13). These spells require no material components.
At will. Animal Friendship (snakes only).
2/day. Suggestion.
sections.Habitats: Deserts, forests, swamps, and urban areas.

name: Yuan-ti Malison (Type 2)
speed: 30 ft., climb 30 ft. in snake form only
description: A yuan-ti with snakes for arms. Its reach lets it bite foes across a gap.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
Stealth increases to +6 in snake form.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks. The yuan-ti can also cast Suggestion through Spellcasting if it is available.
Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Shape-Shift. Become a Medium snake or return to true form. Use the same statistics in either form except where a rule specifies otherwise. Worn and carried gear keeps its form. Death leaves the yuan-ti in its current form.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action in yuan-ti form, cast one of the listed spells using Wisdom (save DC 13). These spells require no material components.
At will. Animal Friendship (snakes only).
2/day. Suggestion.
sections.Habitats: Deserts, forests, swamps, and urban areas.

name: Yuan-ti Malison (Type 3)
description: A yuan-ti with a long serpentine lower body that can seize prey in its coils or send poison across a room.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with Advantage.
Stealth increases to +6 in snake form.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. In yuan-ti form, make two Poison Burst attacks. The yuan-ti can also cast Suggestion through Spellcasting if it is available.
Poison Burst (yuan-ti form only). Melee or ranged attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) poison damage.
Constrict. One Medium or smaller creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 13 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 21 (4d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and becomes Grappled (escape DC 13) and Restrained until that grapple ends.
sections.Bonus actions: Shape-Shift. Become a Medium snake or return to true form. Use the same statistics in either form except where a rule specifies otherwise. Worn and carried gear keeps its form. Death leaves the yuan-ti in its current form.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action in yuan-ti form, cast one of the listed spells using Wisdom (save DC 13). These spells require no material components.
At will. Animal Friendship (snakes only).
2/day. Suggestion.
sections.Habitats: Deserts, forests, swamps, and urban areas.

name: Modron Monodrone
description: The lowest rank of Mechanus follows orders from duodrones. It can fly and attack with force-charged gears.

sections.Traits: Disintegration. The modron turns to dust when it dies. Its gear and anything else it wore or carried remain.
sections.Actions:
Gear. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) Force damage.
Gear Flinger. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) Force damage.

name: Modron Duodrone
description: Duodrones direct monodrones as part of the Mechanus hierarchy. They can throw their clockwork blades and catch them as they fly back.

sections.Traits: Disintegration. The modron turns to dust when it dies. Its gear and anything else it wore or carried remain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Clockwork Blade attacks.
Clockwork Blade. Melee or ranged attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) Force damage. The blade immediately returns by magic to the duodrone's hand after a ranged attack, whether it hit or missed.

name: Modron Tridrone
description: Tridrones carry out quadrone orders and pass instructions to duodrones. A thrown clockwork spear returns to its wielder.

sections.Traits: Disintegration. The modron turns to dust when it dies. Its gear and anything else it wore or carried remain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Clockwork Spear attacks.
Clockwork Spear. Melee or ranged attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) Force damage. The spear immediately returns by magic to the tridrone's hand after a ranged attack, whether it hit or missed.

name: Modron Quadrone
description: A flying officer from Mechanus. It oversees tridrones and can fire gears over long distances.

sections.Traits: Disintegration. The modron turns to dust when it dies. Its gear and anything else it wore or carried remain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Choose either four Slam attacks or four Gears Launcher attacks.
Slam. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) Force damage.
Gears Launcher. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 320 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) Force damage.

name: Modron Pentadrone
description: A large enforcer in the Mechanus hierarchy. It directs quadrones and can pin down intruders with a blast of paralysis gas.

sections.Traits: Disintegration. The modron turns to dust when it dies. Its gear and anything else it wore or carried remain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Choose either five Slam attacks or five Electrical Discharge attacks.
Slam. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) Force damage.
Electrical Discharge. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) Lightning damage.
Paralysis Gas (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 11 Constitution save. A creature that fails is Paralyzed. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. After 1 minute it succeeds automatically.

name: Faerie Dragon Adult
description: A cat-sized dragon with butterfly wings and cool-colored scales. Its pranks often steer people toward someone in need or an injustice they can put right.

sections.Languages: Draconic and Sylvan. Telepathy 60 ft. with faerie dragons only.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The dragon has Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage.
Euphoria Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failure, the target becomes Incapacitated. It spends all its movement going in a random direction on each of its turns while affected. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. Success ends the effect, and the target succeeds automatically after 1 minute.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Charisma (save DC 13) without material components.
At will. Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion.
1/day each. Hallucinatory Terrain, Polymorph.
sections.Bonus actions: Superior Invisibility. Cast Greater Invisibility on itself using Charisma, without spell components.

name: Faerie Dragon Youth
description: A warm-scaled dragon about the size of a cat. It likes to surprise stuffy or discourteous strangers with a puff of euphoric breath.

sections.Languages: Draconic and Sylvan. Telepathy 60 ft. with faerie dragons only.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The dragon has Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) psychic damage.
Euphoria Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 12 Wisdom save. On a failure, the target is Incapacitated until the end of its next turn and spends all its movement that turn going in a random direction.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Charisma (save DC 12) without material components.
At will. Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion.
sections.Bonus actions: Superior Invisibility. Cast Greater Invisibility on itself using Charisma, without spell components.

name: Sahuagin Priest
description: A sea devil who directs sahuagin raids in the name of Sekolah or another fiend. The priest counts any life lost in battle as an offering, including those of its own allies.

sections.Traits:
Blood Frenzy. The priest attacks with Advantage against creatures below their hit point maximum.
Limited Amphibiousness. The priest breathes air and water. It must submerge at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating out of water.
Shark Telepathy. The priest uses magic to command sharks within 120 ft. telepathically.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Spectral Jaws attacks.
Spectral Jaws. Melee or ranged attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. On a hit, deal 11 (2d8 + 2) force damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Wisdom (save DC 12) without material components.
At will. Thaumaturgy.
2/day each. Hold Person, Tongues.
sections.Bonus actions: Fiendish Aid (2 uses per day total). Cast Bless or Healing Word using Wisdom.

name: Lizardfolk Geomancer
description: A lizardfolk spellcaster who calls on primal and earthen magic to protect its people and territory.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Earth Burst attacks.
Earth Burst. Melee or ranged attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. On a hit, deal 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Hail of Stone (recharge 5–6). Choose a point the geomancer can see within 60 ft. Each creature in a 20-ft.-radius, 40-ft.-high cylinder centered on that point makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 15 (6d4) bludgeoning damage and is knocked Prone. On a success, it takes half damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Wisdom (save DC 12) without material components.
At will. Elementalism.
1/day each. Meld into Stone, Speak with Plants, Spike Growth.

name: Lizardfolk Sovereign
description: A lizardfolk ruler who gains strength through rituals tied to the Elemental Plane of Earth. The rites can also bring out a violent streak.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Earthen Maul attack.
Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature other than a Construct or Undead, the sovereign gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the damage dealt.
Earthen Maul. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit by the attack is knocked Prone.
sections.Bonus actions: Charge. Move straight toward a visible enemy, up to the sovereign's Speed or Swim Speed.

name: Arch-hag
description: An ancient hag whose curses spread beyond her lair. Choose what she hates most before an encounter. That anathema determines where the characters can kill her.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (4/day, or 5/day in its lair). On a failed saving throw, the hag can spend one use to succeed.
Magic Resistance. The hag has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Spiteful Escape. At 0 HP, the hag dies if she is within 30 ft. of her anathema, the thing she hates most as chosen by the DM. Outside that range she drops to 1 HP, teleports to a harmless demiplane, and cannot return to the plane she left for 2d6 days. Every creature within 60 ft. of the space she left becomes cursed. Each cursed creature has Disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws. The hag knows each cursed creature's location anywhere in the multiverse until its curse ends.
sections.Coven Magic: While within 30 ft. of at least two allied hags, she can cast Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, or Unseen Servant. Use each spell's normal casting time, omit Material components, and use Intelligence with spell save DC 19. Each spell recovers its use after a Long Rest.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Spectral Claw attacks and use Crackling Wave.
Spectral Claw. Melee or ranged attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft. A hit deals 17 (3d6 + 7) Force damage. A Large or smaller creature hit also falls Prone.
Crackling Wave. Every creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 22 Dexterity save. Failure deals 32 (5d12) Lightning damage. Success halves the damage. Either outcome curses the creature until the end of the hag's next turn. The creature cannot take Reactions while this curse lasts.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one listed spell as an action, using Charisma (spell save DC 22) and omitting Material components.
At will. Detect Thoughts, Dimension Door, Dispel Magic, Hypnotic Pattern.
2/day each. Mass Suggestion, Modify Memory, Plane Shift.
sections.Bonus actions: Witch Strike. Every creature within 60 ft. that the hag has cursed takes 14 (4d6) Lightning damage.
sections.Reactions: Tongue Twister. Cast Counterspell on its normal trigger using Charisma (save DC 22). If the target fails its save, it becomes cursed until the end of its next turn. While this curse lasts it cannot cast spells with Verbal components, and its speech expresses the opposite of what it means.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 uses, or 4 in the hag's lair. Spend one immediately after another creature's turn to select one option. The hag recovers spent uses at the start of her turn and cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Hag's Swipe. Make one Spectral Claw attack.
Malicious Magic. Use Spellcasting to cast Dimension Door or Hypnotic Pattern. This option is unavailable again until the start of the hag's next turn.
sections.In its lair: 41,000 XP. Legendary Resistance increases to 5/day and Legendary Actions increase to 4 uses.
sections.Regional effects:
Lapsus Linguae. Within 1 mile of the lair, creatures other than the hag and her allies subtract 1d10 from ability checks made as part of the Influence action.
Meddlesome Magic. When a creature other than the hag or an ally finishes a Long Rest within 1 mile of the lair, its next spell cast with a spell slot also casts Confusion centered on that creature. Confusion uses the creature's spellcasting ability and requires no Concentration.
Both effects end immediately when the arch-hag is destroyed or relocates her lair.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), pp. 20–21. The stat block is on p. 21 and the regional effects are on p. 20.

name: Blob of Annihilation
description: A colossal ooze that engulfs prey and debris alike. Destroying its body sends whatever it has engulfed into the Astral Sea.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned, Unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Astral Implosion. At 0 HP, the blob implodes, sending engulfed creatures and objects to the Astral Sea. It vanishes and coats everything that was within 600 ft. with slime. It reforms on a random world on the Material Plane in 1d20 years.
Legendary Resistance (4/day). On a failed saving throw, the blob can spend one use to succeed.
Magic Resistance. The blob has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Pseudopod attacks and use Engulf. One Pseudopod attack can be replaced with Restraining Glob.
Pseudopod. Melee attack, +15 to hit, reach 30 ft. A hit deals 24 (3d10 + 8) Force damage.
Engulf. Move up to the blob's Speed, passing through spaces occupied by Huge or smaller creatures or objects. Each target makes a DC 23 Strength save the first time the blob enters its space during this move. Failure engulfs the target. Engulfed targets move with the blob and have Total Cover against attacks and effects outside it. A nonmagical object is destroyed after 1 minute inside. An engulfed creature is Restrained and suffocating, takes 21 (6d6) Force damage at the start of each of its turns, and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. If it drops to 0 HP while engulfed, it dissolves into ash and the blob ejects the ash into the Astral Sea. On a successful save, the target escapes to the nearest unoccupied space.
Restraining Glob. Choose one visible Large or smaller creature within 600 ft. It makes a DC 23 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 18 (3d6 + 8) Acid damage, rolls 60 ft. straight toward the blob, and is Restrained until the end of its next turn, when the glob dissolves harmlessly. Success halves the damage and avoids the movement and restraint.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 uses. Spend one immediately after another creature's turn to select one option. The blob recovers spent uses at the start of its turn and cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Decay. Each creature engulfed by the blob takes 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage. The blob cannot use this option again until the start of its next turn.
Grasping Glob. Use Restraining Glob. The blob cannot use this option again until the start of its next turn.
Lashing Goop. Make one Pseudopod attack.

name: Elemental Cataclysm
speed: 60 ft., burrow 60 ft., fly 80 ft. (hover), swim 80 ft.
description: A titan of the Elemental Chaos. It moves through earth, air, and water and can set off a different disaster each time it attacks with Cataclysmic Event.

sections.Damage immunities: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, Thunder.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned, Unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Earth Glide. The cataclysm can burrow through unworked, nonmagical earth and stone without disturbing the material.
Legendary Resistance (4/day). On a failed saving throw, the cataclysm can spend one use to succeed.
Siege Monster. The cataclysm deals double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Elemental Burst attacks.
Elemental Burst. Melee or ranged attack, +15 to hit, reach 30 ft. or range 150 ft. A hit deals 25 (5d6 + 8) damage. The cataclysm chooses Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder for that hit.
Control Weather. Cast Control Weather using Constitution and no spell components.
Cataclysmic Event (recharge 4–6). Roll 1d4 for one effect.
1. Clinging Flames. Center a 60-ft.-radius sphere on a visible point within 150 ft. Each creature inside makes a DC 23 Dexterity save. Failure deals 45 (13d6) Fire damage. Success halves the damage. The creature starts Burning either way.
2. Freezing Waves. Each creature in a 90-ft. cone makes a DC 23 Strength save. Failure deals 22 (5d8) Bludgeoning plus 22 (5d8) Cold damage and knocks it Prone. Success halves the damage and avoids the fall. Either way, the creature's Speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.
3. Raging Storm. Center a 60-ft.-radius sphere of storm cloud on a visible point within 150 ft. It lasts for 1 minute or until the cataclysm uses Cataclysmic Event again. Creatures wholly inside are Blinded and Deafened and cannot cast spells with Verbal components. A creature that first enters the cloud on a turn or starts its turn there makes a DC 23 Dexterity save. Failure deals 18 (4d8) Lightning plus 18 (4d8) Thunder damage. Success halves the damage.
4. Swallowing Earth. Choose a point on the ground within 150 ft. Each creature in a 90-ft. cube originating there makes a DC 23 Strength save. Failure deals 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning plus 18 (4d8) Acid damage, knocks it Prone, and buries it under rubble. Success halves the damage and avoids the fall and burial. A buried creature is Restrained and suffocating and has Total Cover. The buried creature or another creature within 5 ft. of it can take an action to free it with a successful DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 uses. Spend one immediately after another creature's turn to select one option. The cataclysm recovers spent uses at the start of its turn and cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Eruption. Make one Elemental Burst attack.
Rumbling Movement. Move up to the cataclysm's Speed, Fly Speed, or Swim Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Each creature it comes within 5 ft. of during the move makes one DC 23 Constitution save or falls Prone. The cataclysm cannot use this option again until the start of its next turn.

name: Cyclops Oracle
description: A one-eyed giant who uses divination to track what matters to its community. In a fight it can blindside opponents with flashes of light and replace a roll with a glimpse of the future.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Radiant Strike or Flash of Light in any combination.
Radiant Strike. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 22 (3d10 + 6) Radiant damage.
Flash of Light. Ranged attack, +10 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 17 (2d10 + 6) Radiant damage and gives the target Disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of the cyclops's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one listed spell as an action using Wisdom (spell save DC 16) and omitting Material components.
2/day each. Arcane Eye, Detect Magic, Locate Object.
1/day. Legend Lore.
sections.Reactions: Portent (recharge 4–6). When the cyclops or an ally it can see makes a D20 Test, roll 1d20. The cyclops may substitute its roll for the test's d20.
sections.Habitats: Coastal, desert, grassland, hill, mountain, underdark.

name: Cyclops Sentry
description: A one-eyed giant who guards a settlement or its approach. A sudden glimpse of an incoming strike helps it turn the attack back on its foe.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Stone Club or Rock in any combination.
Stone Club. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 16 (3d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. A Huge or smaller creature hit also falls Prone.
Rock. Ranged attack, +9 to hit, range 30/120 ft. A hit deals 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.
sections.Reactions: Limited Foresight (recharge 6). When a visible creature makes an attack roll against the cyclops, impose Disadvantage on the roll. The cyclops gains Advantage on attacks against that creature until the end of the cyclops's next turn.
sections.Habitats: Coastal, desert, grassland, hill, mountain, underdark.

name: Animated Flying Sword
description: An unseen hand seems to fence with this sword. An intact blade and a swarm of floating sword fragments fight the same way. Use similar statistics for other animated weapons.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Actions: Slash. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage.
sections.Animated object catalysts:
Roll 1d10 or choose what brought the object to life.
1. A celestial or fiend assigned it to protect or torment a mortal.
2. An experiment combined magic with alchemy, machinery, or alien science.
3. A supernatural trickster trapped someone’s essence in it.
4. A Fey animated it as part of a game or scheme.
5. The object awoke after a century of use.
6. A spellcaster wanted a servant or guard.
7. A magical instrument played a song over it.
8. A spirit took possession of it.
9. A spell went awry, wild magic flared, or a chaotic artifact affected it.
10. A powerful psychic being animated it by force of will.

name: Animated Rug of Smothering
description: This enchanted rug may seize whoever steps on it, or spring a trap when someone tries a false command word for a Carpet of Flying. Use the same statistics for an animated tapestry or fur.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned.
sections.Actions: Smother. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. Against a Medium or smaller creature, the rug can give the target the Grappled condition instead of dealing the initial damage (escape DC 13). Until that grapple ends, the target is Blinded, Restrained, and suffocating, and takes 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. The rug can smother only one creature at a time. While it holds that creature, it cannot use Smother. Halve any damage the rug takes and round down, then deal the same amount to the creature it is grappling.
sections.Animated object catalysts:
Roll 1d10 or choose what brought the object to life.
1. A celestial or fiend assigned it to protect or torment a mortal.
2. An experiment combined magic with alchemy, machinery, or alien science.
3. A supernatural trickster trapped someone’s essence in it.
4. A Fey animated it as part of a game or scheme.
5. The object awoke after a century of use.
6. A spellcaster wanted a servant or guard.
7. A magical instrument played a song over it.
8. A spirit took possession of it.
9. A spell went awry, wild magic flared, or a chaotic artifact affected it.
10. A powerful psychic being animated it by force of will.

name: Flaming Skeleton
description: Necromantic fire gives this skeleton the power to strike with flame and the awareness to command lesser undead.

sections.Languages: Understands Common and one other language and cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Death Burst. When the skeleton dies, each creature in a 10-ft. Emanation from the skeleton makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. It takes 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
Illumination. The skeleton sheds Bright Light out to 15 ft. and Dim Light for another 15 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Flame Scepter and Hurl Flame.
Flame Scepter. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.
Hurl Flame. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 60 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d10 + 2) fire damage.
sections.Skeleton pantomimes:
Roll 1d6 or choose what the skeleton does when left alone.
1. Takes a meal or old letters to its former master’s tomb.
2. Keeps drilling with other skeletons, even after they hack it to pieces.
3. Repeats an old pastime such as dancing, acting, or reading.
4. Returns to familiar work such as cleaning, cooking, mining, or praying.
5. Reenacts its final moments.
6. Guards the post it held in life.

name: Gas Spore Fungus
description: A round, floating fungus resembles a beholder. Its spores can kill an infected creature and sprout new fungi from the body.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Prone.
sections.Traits: Death Burst. When the fungus dies, each creature in a 20-ft. Emanation from the fungus makes a DC 10 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 10 (3d6) poison damage and is Poisoned for 1d12 hours. If that condition has not been removed by the end of that time, the creature dies and sprouts 2d4 Tiny Gas Spore Fungi, each with 1 HP. Those fungi reach Large size and 13 HP after 2d6 days.
sections.Actions: Tendril. Melee attack, +0 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 3 (1d6) poison damage and leaves the target Poisoned until the end of the target’s next turn.

name: Shrieker Fungus
description: This mushroom gives away intruders with a shrill wail that can bring predators or alert nearby guards.

sections.Actions: The stat block lists no actions.
sections.Reactions: Shriek. When a creature or a source of Bright Light moves within 30 ft. of the shrieker, it can emit a wail audible out to 300 ft. The wail continues for 1 minute and ends early if the shrieker dies.

name: Myconid Spore Servant
description: Fungal growth animates this corpse and makes it an extension of the Myconid Sovereign that raised it.

sections.Actions: Slam. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) poison damage.
sections.Creation: A Myconid Sovereign can use Animating Spores three times per day. It chooses a Small or Medium corpse within 5 ft. that was neither a Construct nor Undead. After 24 hours the corpse rises using this stat block. It stays animate for 1d4 + 1 weeks or until destroyed and cannot be raised by Animating Spores again.

name: Tree Blight
description: This predator resembles a dead tree with gnarled limbs and broken hollows. Remains may hang caught in its branches. It fights alongside other blights and attacks other tree-shaped creatures, including awakened trees and treants.

sections.Languages: Understands Common and Druidic and cannot speak.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Branch attacks and use Grasping Root.
Branch. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 15 ft. A hit deals 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Grasping Root. Choose one visible creature of Large size or smaller within 15 ft. It makes a DC 17 Strength save. On a failure, one of the blight’s six roots pulls that creature up to 10 ft. straight toward the blight and gives it the Grappled condition (escape DC 16). Until the grapple ends, the target takes 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns.
sections.Bonus actions: Gnash. Choose one creature Grappled by the blight. It makes a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Bugbear Stalker
description: A long-limbed goblinoid that grabs creatures and carries them away.

sections.Traits: Abduct. The bugbear can move a creature it has Grappled without spending extra movement.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks. Choose Javelin or Morningstar for each.
Javelin. Melee or ranged attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 30/120 ft. A hit deals 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Morningstar. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft. The bugbear has Advantage if it has the target Grappled. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Quick Grapple. Choose one Medium or smaller creature the bugbear can see within 10 ft. The target must pass a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or become Grappled (escape DC 13).

name: Bugbear Warrior
description: A goblinoid that grabs and drags opponents within reach of its hammer.

sections.Traits: Abduct. The bugbear can move a creature it has Grappled without spending extra movement.
sections.Actions:
Grab. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. On a hit, a Medium or smaller creature also becomes Grappled (escape DC 12).
Light Hammer. Melee or ranged attack, +4 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft. The bugbear has Advantage if it has the target Grappled. A hit deals 9 (3d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

name: Centaur Trooper
description: A fast centaur that fights with a pike and longbow and can trample creatures in its path.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks. Choose Pike or Longbow for each.
Pike. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.
Longbow. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Trampling Charge (Recharge 5–6). Move up to the centaur's Speed. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks and can pass through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space the centaur enters makes one DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failure, it takes 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and falls Prone.

name: Gnoll Warrior
description: A hyena-like fiend that closes in after landing a blow on an already wounded creature.

sections.Actions:
Rend. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Bone Bow. Ranged attack, +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Rampage (1/Day). Immediately after the gnoll damages a creature that was already Bloodied, it can move up to half its Speed and make one Rend attack.

name: Goblin Minion
description: A light-footed goblinoid armed with daggers.

sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Nimble Escape. Take the Disengage or Hide action.
sections.Habitats: Forest, Grassland, Hill, Planar (Acheron), Planar (Feywild), Underdark.

name: Goblin Warrior
description: A goblinoid skirmisher with a scimitar, shortbow, and shield.

sections.Actions:
Scimitar. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage. Add 2 (1d4) slashing damage if the roll had Advantage.
Shortbow. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. Add 2 (1d4) piercing damage if the roll had Advantage.
sections.Bonus actions: Nimble Escape. Take the Disengage or Hide action.
sections.Habitats: Forest, Grassland, Hill, Planar (Acheron), Planar (Feywild), Underdark.

name: Hobgoblin Warrior
description: An armored goblinoid that fights alongside allies and fires poisoned arrows.

sections.Gear: Half Plate Armor, Longbow, Longsword, Shield.
sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The hobgoblin has Advantage on an attack against a target with one or more of the hobgoblin's allies within 5 ft. of it. At least one of those allies must be free of the Incapacitated condition.
sections.Actions:
Longsword. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d10 + 1) slashing damage.
Longbow. Ranged attack, +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) poison damage.
sections.Habitats: Desert, Forest, Grassland, Hill, Mountain, Planar (Acheron), Underdark.

name: Kobold Warrior
description: A small draconic fighter that closes in with allies and falters in sunlight.

sections.Traits:
Pack Tactics. The kobold has Advantage on an attack against a target with one or more of the kobold's allies within 5 ft. of it. At least one of those allies must be free of the Incapacitated condition.
Sunlight Sensitivity. Sunlight imposes Disadvantage on the kobold's attack rolls and ability checks.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Habitats: Arctic, Coastal, Desert, Forest, Hill, Mountain, Swamp, Underdark, Urban.

name: Gnoll Demoniac
description: A gnoll that has eaten Abyss-tainted flesh in a rite and taken on Yeenoghu's appetite. It rushes headlong into battle and may turn on its pack in a frenzy.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Abyssal Strike attacks.
Abyssal Strike. Melee or ranged attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. A hit deals 20 (5d6 + 3) Poison damage.
Hunger of Yeenoghu (recharge 5–6). Choose a point the gnoll can see within 60 ft. A 30-ft. Cube of magical Darkness originates there. The Cube is Difficult Terrain and lasts up to 1 minute, ending early if the gnoll loses Concentration. A creature that starts its turn in the Cube or enters it for the first time on a turn makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 28 (8d6) Necrotic damage and the gnoll gives 10 Temporary Hit Points to itself or to a creature of its choice it can see. On a success, the target takes half damage only.
sections.Bonus actions: Rampage (2/day). Immediately after the gnoll damages a creature that was already Bloodied, it moves up to half its Speed and makes one Abyssal Strike attack.

name: Manes Vaporspawn
description: A contorted demon born from a tormented soul. Its sickening haze can incapacitate creatures nearby.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Poisoned, Restrained.
sections.Traits:
Contortionist. The demon can pass through an opening as narrow as 1 inch at its normal movement cost.
Sickening Vapors. At the end of the demon's turn, each creature in its 5-ft. Emanation makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, the creature is Incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a success, it is immune to this demon's Sickening Vapors for 24 hours.
sections.Actions: Claw. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage plus 5 (2d4) Necrotic damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. The demon takes the Hide action while in Dim Light or Darkness.

name: Swarm of Dretches
classification: Large swarm of Small fiends (demons), chaotic evil
description: A mob of dretches that might spill out of the Abyss or march with a demonic invasion. Left to itself, it tears through a place and ruins whatever it finds.

sections.Languages: Abyssal. Telepathy 60 ft., limited to creatures that understand Abyssal.
sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Piercing, Slashing.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned.
sections.Traits:
Fetid Aura. A creature that starts its turn in the swarm's 10-ft. Emanation makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, it is Poisoned until the start of its next turn. While Poisoned this way, it can take at most one action or Bonus Action on its turn and can't take Reactions.
Swarm. The swarm and other creatures can share spaces. It fits through openings a Small creature can use. It can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 12 (3d6 + 2) Slashing damage, reduced to 9 (3d4 + 2) if the swarm is Bloodied.

name: Swarm of Lemures
classification: Large swarm of Medium fiends (devils), lawful evil
description: A mass of lemures that acts with one mind after the devils crowd together or press themselves into a single body.

sections.Senses: Darkvision 120 ft., including through magical Darkness.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned.
sections.Traits:
Hellish Restoration. If the swarm dies in the Nine Hells, it returns to life at full Hit Points after 1d10 days. A kill by a creature under the effect of Bless or a sprinkling of Holy Water on the remains prevents its return.
Swarm. The swarm and other creatures can share spaces. It fits through openings a Medium creature can use. It can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Vile Slime attacks.
Vile Slime. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d8 + 2) Poison damage, reduced to 9 (2d6 + 2) if the swarm is Bloodied.

name: Swarm of Larvae
classification: Large swarm of Medium fiends, neutral evil
description: Larvae huddle together when desperate. The resulting mass can overwhelm vulnerable prey as it writhes forward amid whimpers.

sections.Languages: Understands all languages but can't speak.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned.
sections.Traits: Swarm. The swarm and other creatures can share spaces. It fits through openings a Medium creature can use. It can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.
sections.Actions: Bites. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) Necrotic damage, reduced to 7 (2d4 + 2) if the swarm is Bloodied.

name: Larva
description: A dead soul in a wormlike body. It has painful scraps of memory from its former life and usually tries to stay away from other creatures.

sections.Languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack, +1 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 1 (1d4 - 1) Necrotic damage.

name: Guard Captain
description: An officer of the watch who fights with a longsword or throws javelins.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Javelin or Longsword for each.
Javelin. Melee or ranged attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. A hit deals 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Longsword. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage.

name: Pirate
description: A dagger-armed raider who can distract an adversary with a flash of charm.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Dagger attacks. The pirate can use Enthralling Panache in place of one attack.
Dagger. Melee or ranged attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
Enthralling Panache. One creature the pirate can see within 30 ft. makes a DC 12 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Charmed until the pirate's next turn starts.

name: Pirate Captain
description: A pirate commander who fights with rapier and pistol and exploits an opening after a parry.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks, choosing Rapier or Pistol for each.
Rapier. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage and gives the captain Advantage on its next attack roll before the current turn ends.
Pistol. Ranged attack, +7 to hit, range 30/90 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Captain's Charm. One creature the captain can see within 30 ft. makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Charmed until the captain's next turn starts.
sections.Reactions: Riposte. When a melee attack roll hits the captain while it holds a weapon, the captain can add 3 to its AC against that attack. If this turns the hit into a miss, the captain makes one Rapier attack against the attacker if it is within reach.

name: Priest Acolyte
description: A junior cleric who channels radiant power in combat and can call on divine aid.

sections.Actions:
Mace. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage and 2 (1d4) radiant damage.
Radiant Flame. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 60 ft. A hit deals 7 (2d6) radiant damage.
Spellcasting. At will, cast Light or Thaumaturgy with Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.
sections.Bonus actions: Divine Aid (1/Day). Cast one of Bless, Healing Word, or Sanctuary with Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

name: Warrior Infantry
description: A spear fighter trained to attack alongside a nearby comrade.

sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. An attack roll against a creature has Advantage if at least one ally of the attacker is within 5 ft. of that creature and the ally is not Incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Spear. Melee or ranged attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

name: Warrior Veteran
description: An experienced soldier who wears splint armor and carries a greatsword and heavy crossbow.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Greatsword or Heavy Crossbow for each.
Greatsword. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Heavy Crossbow. Ranged attack, +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d10 + 1) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Parry. When a melee attack roll hits the veteran while it holds a weapon, the veteran can add 2 to its AC against that attack, potentially turning the hit into a miss.

name: Tough
description: An enforcer with a mace and heavy crossbow who fights better with backup.
