sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. An attack roll against a creature has Advantage if at least one ally of the attacker is within 5 ft. of that creature and the ally is not Incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Mace. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Heavy Crossbow. Ranged attack, +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.

name: Tough Boss
description: An armored gang leader who can knock an opponent back with a warhammer.

sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. An attack roll against a creature has Advantage if at least one ally of the attacker is within 5 ft. of that creature and the ally is not Incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Warhammer or Heavy Crossbow for each.
Warhammer. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. The boss can also push a Large or smaller creature up to 10 ft. directly away from itself.
Heavy Crossbow. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 100/400 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d10 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Archpriest
description: A senior cleric who channels radiant power and supports allies with divine magic.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Radiant Burst attacks.
Radiant Burst. Melee or ranged attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. A hit deals 27 (4d10 + 5) radiant damage.
Holy Word (recharge 4–6). Each enemy in a 20-ft. Emanation from the archpriest makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 21 (6d6) radiant damage and is Stunned until the end of the archpriest's next turn. On a success, it takes half damage only.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one listed spell as an action using Wisdom (spell save DC 17). These castings require no Material components.
At will. Light, Thaumaturgy.
1/day each. Flame Strike (level 6), Greater Restoration, Raise Dead, Zone of Truth.
sections.Bonus actions: Divine Aid (3/day total). Cast Bless, Dispel Magic, Healing Word, or Lesser Restoration using Wisdom (spell save DC 17).

name: Cultist Fanatic
description: A devoted member of a cult who fights with a necrotic pact blade and divine magic.

sections.Actions: Pact Blade. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage and 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one listed spell as an action using Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks).
At will. Light, Thaumaturgy.
2/day. Command.
1/day. Hold Person.
sections.Bonus actions: Spiritual Weapon (2/day). Cast Spiritual Weapon using Wisdom (+4 to hit with spell attacks).

name: Cultist Hierophant
description: A cult leader who wields radiant attacks, a magical storm, and mass enchantment.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks, choosing Pact Blade or Radiant Ray for each.
Pact Blade. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage and 18 (4d8) radiant damage.
Radiant Ray. Ranged attack, +9 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 31 (4d12 + 5) radiant damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one listed spell as an action using Charisma (spell save DC 17).
At will. Thaumaturgy.
1/day each. Jallarzi's Storm of Radiance (level 7), Mass Suggestion.

name: Aberrant Cultist
classification: Small or Medium humanoid, neutral evil
description: A cultist who ensnares enemies with two tentacles and attacks their minds with psychic magic.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Tentacle Lash attacks. Either or both attacks can be replaced by a use of Mind Rot.
Tentacle Lash. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage and 14 (4d6) psychic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, one of the cultist's two tentacles Grapples it (escape DC 14). It is Restrained until the grapple ends.
Mind Rot. One creature the cultist can see within 90 ft. makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage and is Poisoned until the start of the cultist's next turn. On a success, it takes half damage only.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one listed spell as an action using Wisdom (spell save DC 15).
At will. Detect Thoughts, Minor Illusion.
sections.Reactions: Counterspell (2/day). Cast Counterspell on the spell's normal trigger, using Wisdom (spell save DC 15).

name: Death Cultist
classification: Small or Medium humanoid, neutral evil
description: A cultist in splint armor who wounds with necrotic magic and summons a frightening wail.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks, choosing Dread Scythe or Deathly Ray for each.
Dread Scythe. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage and 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. The target cannot regain Hit Points until the end of the target's next turn.
Deathly Ray. Ranged attack, +6 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 22 (4d10) necrotic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one listed spell as an action using Wisdom (spell save DC 14).
At will. Speak with Dead, Thaumaturgy.
sections.Bonus actions: Spirit Wail (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 20-ft. Emanation from the cultist makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage and is Frightened until the end of that creature's next turn. On a success, it takes half damage only.

name: Elemental Cultist
classification: Small or Medium humanoid, chaotic evil
description: A cultist who can vary the element behind its attacks and move enemies from a distance.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks, choosing Elemental Flail or Elemental Claw for each.
Elemental Flail. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 25 (6d6 + 4) damage. The cultist chooses acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder for the damage type.
Elemental Claw. Ranged attack, +7 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 22 (4d10) damage. The cultist chooses acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder for the damage type. On a hit against a Medium or smaller creature, the cultist can move it up to 10 ft. straight toward or away from the cultist.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one listed spell as an action using Wisdom (spell save DC 15).
At will. Elementalism, Mage Hand.
sections.Reactions: Elemental Absorption (1/day). When the cultist takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, it gains Resistance to that instance of damage and gains 10 Temporary Hit Points.

name: Fiend Cultist
classification: Small or Medium humanoid, neutral evil
description: A cultist with a burning pact axe who can see through magical Darkness and retaliate with fire.

sections.Senses: Darkvision 90 ft. that works in magical Darkness.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Pact Axe attacks.
Pact Axe. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage and 13 (3d8) fire damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one listed spell as an action using Wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks).
At will. Scorching Ray (level 5), Thaumaturgy.
2/day. Fireball (level 6).
sections.Reactions: Hellish Rebuke (at will). Cast Hellish Rebuke on the spell's normal trigger using Wisdom (spell save DC 15).

name: Merfolk Skirmisher
description: A merfolk defender who guards its settlement against aquatic predators and raiders from the surface.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The merfolk breathes air and water.
sections.Actions: Ocean Spear. Melee or ranged attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 3 (1d6) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) cold damage. If the target is a creature, reduce its Speed by 10 ft. through the end of its next turn. After a ranged attack, the spear magically returns to the merfolk's hand immediately.

name: Merfolk Wavebender
description: A merfolk mage who calls on currents, storms, and sea creatures.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The merfolk breathes air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Aquatic Burst attacks.
Aquatic Burst. Melee or ranged attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. A hit deals 20 (3d10 + 4) cold damage. A Large or smaller creature hit also falls Prone.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell with Wisdom (save DC 15). Omit material components.
At will. Elementalism, Light.
1/day each. Control Water, Create or Destroy Water.
sections.Reactions: Watery Rebuke. When an enemy the merfolk can see enters a space within 5 ft. of it, the enemy makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 14 (4d6) cold damage. If it is Large or smaller and fails the save, a rush of conjured water pushes it up to 30 ft. directly away from the merfolk.

name: Sahuagin Warrior
description: A sea devil raider who hunts with sharks and keeps fighting once its claws draw blood.

sections.Traits:
Blood Frenzy. Attack rolls against creatures below their maximum HP have Advantage.
Limited Amphibiousness. The sahuagin breathes air and water. It must submerge at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating out of water.
Shark Telepathy. The sahuagin uses magical telepathy to control sharks within 120 ft. of itself.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Aquatic Charge. Swim in a straight line toward a visible enemy, up to the sahuagin's Swim Speed.

name: Ogrillon Ogre
description: A curse changes a Humanoid into an ogre-like giant over 8 feet tall. The ogrillon retains features of its former self and feels a constant, supernatural anger.

sections.Actions:
Battleaxe. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Habitats: Arctic, desert, forest, grassland, hill, mountain, swamp, Underdark.

name: Grick Ancient
description: A grick that has grown to immense size over centuries. It seeks out prey and may eat smaller gricks.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Beak attack, one Slam attack, and one Tentacles attack.
Beak. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Slam. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit also falls Prone.
Tentacles. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, all four tentacles Grapple it (escape DC 14).

name: Lacedon Ghoul
description: A loose-skinned ghoul that hunts in water. Some lacedons rise from drowned pirates or castaways who starved.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Icy Bite attacks.
Icy Bite. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) cold damage and reduces the target's Speed by 5 ft. until the start of the ghoul's next turn.
Claw. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage. An affected creature makes a DC 10 Constitution save unless it is Undead or an elf. On a failed save, it is Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.
sections.Bonus actions: Watery Rush. While underwater, move up to half the ghoul's Swim Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

name: Yuan-ti Infiltrator
description: A yuan-ti spy whose scales or forked tongue can pass unnoticed. Infiltrators gain access to rivals so other yuan-ti can act on what they learn.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The yuan-ti has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Scimitar attacks.
Scimitar. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.
Poison Ray. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) poison damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell with Wisdom (save DC 12). Omit material components.
At will. Animal Friendship (snakes only).
2/day. Suggestion.

name: Vampire Nightbringer
classification: Small or Medium undead, neutral evil
description: A vampire born from necromancy or a plane steeped in negative energy. It stalks through shadows and drains life with its bite.

sections.Traits: Sunlight Hypersensitivity. At the start of its turn in sunlight, the vampire takes 10 Radiant damage. Sunlight also gives it Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Shadow Strike.
Bite. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage and 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. Reduce the target’s HP maximum by the Necrotic damage it actually took and restore that many HP to the vampire.
Shadow Strike. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage and 14 (4d6) Cold damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. Take the Hide action while in Dim Light or Darkness.

name: Vampire Umbral Lord
classification: Small or Medium undead, lawful evil
description: A vampire that barters with powers of darkness for forbidden magic. Choose a concealed resting place when you prepare its lair.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). After failing a save, the vampire can spend one use to succeed.
Shadow Escape. If the vampire reaches 0 HP away from its resting place, it teleports there. If it can’t teleport, it is destroyed. It can’t teleport this way in sunlight or running water. After teleporting, it is Paralyzed for 1 hour, then recovers 1 HP.
Vampire Weakness. It needs an occupant’s invitation to enter a residence. It takes 20 Acid damage if it ends its turn in running water. If someone drives a weapon that deals Piercing damage into its heart while it is Incapacitated in its resting place, it remains Paralyzed until the weapon comes out. At the start of its turn in sunlight, it takes 20 Radiant damage. Sunlight gives it Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using any combination of Grave Strike and Sickening Ray.
Grave Strike. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (1d8 + 5) Slashing damage and 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage.
Sickening Ray. Ranged attack, +10 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 16 (2d10 + 5) Necrotic damage and leaves the target Poisoned until the start of the vampire’s next turn.
Hunger of Hadar (Recharge 5–6). Cast Hunger of Hadar at level 5 without components, using Charisma with spell save DC 18.
sections.Bonus actions: Sanguine Drain. Choose a creature the vampire can see within 30 ft. that is neither a Construct nor an Undead. On a failed DC 18 Constitution save, it takes 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage. Reduce its HP maximum by the damage it actually took and restore that many HP to the vampire.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 uses, or 4 in its lair. Spend one immediately after another creature’s turn to select one option. The vampire recovers spent uses at the start of its turn and cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Beguile. Cast Command without components, using Charisma with spell save DC 18. Beguile then becomes unavailable until the vampire’s next turn starts.
Umbral Strike. Move up to half its Speed and make one Grave Strike or Sickening Ray attack.
sections.In its lair: 15,000 XP. Legendary Resistance increases to 4/day and Legendary Actions increase to 4 uses.
sections.Regional effects:
Children of the Night. From dusk to dawn, Beasts of Medium size or smaller are Charmed while within 1 mile of the lair.
Looming Shadows. Shadows appear to move on their own. A creature that finishes a Short Rest within 1 mile must pass a DC 15 Wisdom save to benefit from that rest. The vampire and its allies are exempt.
Mists. Persistent fog makes the area within 1 mile Lightly Obscured. The vampire and creatures it chooses ignore the fog.
All three effects end as soon as the vampire dies or moves its lair.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), pp. 316 and 318. The stat block is on p. 318 and the regional effects are on p. 316.

name: Graveyard Revenant
description: A vengeful spirit pulls many corpses together into one body. It may hunt the people or institutions responsible for their deaths.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned, Unconscious.
sections.Traits: Undead Restoration. Unless Dispel Evil and Good is cast on its remains, the revenant revives after 24 hours. It animates a different group of corpses elsewhere on the same plane, changes appearance, and returns at full HP with this stat block.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Suffocate attacks.
Suffocate. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 10 (1d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage and 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. A Large or smaller creature hit is also Grappled (escape DC 15) and suffocates until that grapple ends. The revenant can grapple up to two targets with this attack at once.
Haunting Glare (Recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 30-ft. Emanation from the revenant makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On failure, the creature is Paralyzed. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

name: Haunting Revenant
description: A spirit possesses a ruin, wreck, or other abandoned place linked to its death. It waits for enemies to come close, then traps them inside.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Haunted Zone. A creature casting a spell inside the revenant’s space must pass a DC 17 Constitution save. On failure, the spell fails and is wasted.
Undead Restoration. Unless Dispel Evil and Good is cast on its remains, the revenant revives after 24 hours. It animates a different Gargantuan object or structure elsewhere on the same plane, changes appearance, and returns at full HP with this stat block.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Object Slam attacks and use Invitation.
Object Slam. Melee or ranged attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 30/90 ft. Roll with Advantage against targets inside the revenant’s space. A hit deals 27 (5d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.
Invitation. Every creature in a 60-ft. Cone makes a DC 17 Charisma save. On failure, the creature teleports into the revenant’s space and is swallowed. Swallowed creatures have Total Cover against attacks and effects from outside the revenant. As long as the revenant has HP, a swallowed creature can escape its space only through magic that enables planar travel, such as Plane Shift.

name: Death Knight Aspirant
classification: Small or Medium undead, chaotic evil
description: A follower who shared a death knight’s curse. The aspirant leads other Undead into battle and carries out the death knight’s orders.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The aspirant has Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Marshal Undead. Chosen Undead other than the aspirant have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws while in a 60-ft. Emanation from the aspirant. This trait stops working while the aspirant is Incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Dread Blade attacks.
Dread Blade. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage and 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.
Hellfire Orb (Recharge 5–6). Choose a point the aspirant can see within 120 ft. Each creature in a Sphere of 20-ft. radius centered there makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. On a failure it takes 21 (6d6) Fire damage and 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage. Success halves both.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one listed spell as an action, using Charisma with spell save DC 15.
At will. Phantom Steed.
1/day each. Destructive Wave (Necrotic) and Dispel Magic.
sections.Reactions: Parry. When a melee attack hits the aspirant while it holds a weapon, it can add 4 to its AC against that attack, potentially turning it into a miss.

name: Will-o’-Wisp
description: A wandering spirit that looks like a lantern. It lures travelers into danger and feeds when they fall.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Necrotic, Piercing, Slashing.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Ephemeral. The wisp cannot wear or carry anything.
Illumination. It sheds Bright Light out to 20 ft. and Dim Light for another 20 ft.
Incorporeal Movement. Creatures and objects count as Difficult Terrain for the wisp as it moves through them. If it ends its turn inside an object, it takes 5 (1d10) Force damage.
sections.Actions: Shock. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d8 + 2) Lightning damage.
sections.Bonus actions:
Consume Life. One living creature the wisp can see within 5 ft. with 0 HP makes a DC 10 Constitution save. On failure, the creature dies and the wisp regains 10 (3d6) HP.
Vanish. The wisp and its light become Invisible while it maintains Concentration. The effect also ends immediately after the wisp makes an attack roll or uses Consume Life.
sections.Ambush ideas: A 1d6 roll can pick the danger the wisp leads travelers toward. 1. A building on the verge of collapse. 2. Waiting ghouls or vampires. 3. Ruins that curse intruders. 4. A predator’s den, such as a bear’s or wyvern’s. 5. Brown mold or green slime. 6. Quicksand or a pool under thin ice.

name: Troll Limb
description: A severed troll limb that moves, attacks, and can grow into a new troll.

sections.Traits:
Regeneration. The limb regains 5 HP at the start of its turn. Acid or Fire damage stops this trait on its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn at 0 HP and does not regenerate.
Troll Spawn. A severed limb senses its surroundings as a whole troll would. If it survives 24 hours, roll a d12. On a 12 it becomes a Troll. On any other result, it withers away.
sections.Actions: Rend. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage.
sections.Severed by a troll: A limb created by a Troll’s Loathsome Limbs trait appears in the troll’s space and takes its turn immediately after the troll.
sections.Habitats: Arctic, Forest, Hill, Mountain, Swamp, Underdark.

name: Animal Lord
description: An immortal protector of animals from the Beastlands. It shifts between a humanoid guise and a great version of its animal, and calls the spirits of its kind to fight.

sections.Traits:
Animal Lordship. The DM chooses Forager, Hunter, or Sage. Use that role for both Lordly Presence and Animal Spirit.
Legendary Resistance (4/day). When the animal lord fails a saving throw, it can spend one use to succeed instead.
Lordly Presence. An enemy starting its turn in a 30-foot Emanation from the animal lord makes a DC 20 Wisdom save. On a failure, apply the effect for the chosen role. Forager. The enemy is Charmed until the end of its next turn. While Charmed this way, it is also Incapacitated. Hunter. The enemy is Frightened until the end of its next turn. Sage. The enemy takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage and is magically bewildered until the end of its next turn. While bewildered, it subtracts 1d4 from its saving throws.
Magic Resistance. The animal lord has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Rend and Radiant Ray, and use Animal Spirit.
Rend. Melee attack, +13 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 14 (2d6 + 7) Slashing damage and 7 (2d6) Force damage.
Radiant Ray. Ranged attack, +12 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 20 (4d6 + 6) Radiant damage.
Animal Spirit. Summon a spirit to strike one creature the animal lord can see within 120 ft. The target makes a DC 20 Dexterity save, taking 28 (4d10 + 6) Radiant damage on a failure or half on a success. Either way, apply the effect for the chosen role. Forager. The animal lord gains 20 Temporary Hit Points. Hunter. The animal lord has Advantage on attack rolls against the target until the start of the animal lord's next turn. Sage. The target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn. The spirit then disappears.
Spellcasting. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability (save DC 20). Cast the following spells without Material components. At will, Animal Friendship, Animal Messenger, and Speak with Animals. Twice per day each, Awaken and Greater Restoration. Once per day each, Animal Shapes and Sunburst.
sections.Bonus actions: Shape-Shift. Take the form of a Huge or smaller version of the animal the lord represents or a Small or Medium Humanoid, or return to its true form. Only size can change among its game statistics. Equipment it wears or carries stays as it was.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 uses, regained at the start of the animal lord's turn. Spend one use at the end of another creature's turn to take one option. The creature cannot take legendary actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Feral Strike. Move up to the animal lord's Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and make one Rend attack.
Radiant Strike. Make one Radiant Ray attack.

name: Animal Lord (Forager)

Radiant Strike. Make one Radiant Ray attack.

name: Empyrean (Celestial)
description: A titan descended from a deity of the Upper Planes. It may champion its patron's cause or set out to earn an honor of its own.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (4/day). When the empyrean fails a saving throw, it can spend one use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. The empyrean has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Sacred Weapon and Divine Ray.
Sacred Weapon. Melee attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 31 (6d6 + 10) Force damage, and the target is Stunned until the start of the empyrean's next turn. The target can choose to take 21 extra Force damage in place of the Stunned condition. The extra damage bypasses Resistance and Immunity.
Divine Ray. Ranged attack, +15 to hit, range 600 ft. A hit deals 35 (6d8 + 8) damage. The empyrean chooses Necrotic or Radiant.
Spellcasting. Charisma is the spellcasting ability (save DC 23). Cast the following spells without Material components. At will, Calm Emotions, Greater Restoration, Pass without Trace, and Water Breathing. Once per day each, Commune, Dispel Evil and Good, and Plane Shift.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 uses, regained at the start of the empyrean's turn. Spend one use at the end of another creature's turn to take one option. The creature cannot take legendary actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Bolster. The empyrean gains 10 Temporary Hit Points. It and each ally within 30 ft. gain Advantage on D20 Tests until the end of the empyrean's next turn. The empyrean cannot use Bolster again until the start of its next turn.
Shockwave of Glory. Every creature in a 30-foot Emanation from the empyrean makes a DC 23 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 27 (6d8) Force damage and falls Prone. On a success, it takes half the damage. The empyrean cannot use Shockwave of Glory again until the start of its next turn.
Smite. Make one Divine Ray attack.

description: A titan descended from a deity of the Lower Planes. It may try to seize its patron's power, raise an army, or escape its divine family.

Smite. Make one Divine Ray attack.

description: A thought or memory of a deity from the Upper Planes given a will of its own. It may appear as a floating glyph or a mote of color and carry messages for its creator.

Incorporeal Movement. Move through creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. If the iota ends its turn inside an object, it takes 5 (1d10) Force damage.
Magic Resistance. The iota has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Otherworldly Strike. Melee or ranged attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) damage. The iota chooses Necrotic or Radiant.
Spellcasting. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability. Cast Bless and Lesser Restoration once per day each without Material components. Cast Lesser Restoration as an action.
sections.Bonus actions: Healing Word (1/day). Cast Healing Word using Wisdom.

name: Axe Beak
description: This flightless bird cuts through brush with its axe-shaped bill. When a flock hunts together, some birds distract the prey while others attack or steer the young away from danger. Axe beaks raised from eggs can serve as mounts.

sections.Actions: Beak. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage.

name: Azer Sentinel
description: Azer sentinels defend their community's smiths. Their living bronze bodies radiate intense heat, and their weapons carry that heat into battle.

sections.Traits:
Fire Aura. Unless the sentinel is Incapacitated, at the end of each of its turns it deals 5 (1d10) Fire damage to every creature it chooses in a 5-ft. Emanation.
Illumination. The sentinel sheds Bright Light within 10 ft. and Dim Light for another 10 ft.
sections.Actions: Burning Hammer. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

name: Brazen Gorgon
description: Moloch's followers built this metal bull to guard their shrines. Its body glows from the heat inside. The ribs swing open during a charge, trapping a victim against the furnace-hot frame.

sections.Traits:
Flame Aura. At the end of each of the gorgon's turns, every creature in its 5-ft. Emanation takes 13 (3d8) Fire damage.
Illumination. The gorgon sheds Bright Light within 10 ft. and Dim Light for another 10 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Gore attacks.
Gore. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.
Smelting Charge (Recharge 5–6). The gorgon moves up to its Speed, ignores Opportunity Attacks during the move, and can pass through spaces occupied by Medium or smaller creatures. The first time it enters each creature's space during the charge, that creature makes a DC 16 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) Fire damage. The gorgon also pulls the creature into its space and Grapples it (escape DC 14). If the gorgon already has a creature Grappled, the new target instead falls Prone. The grappled creature is Restrained until the grapple ends, and it moves with the gorgon at no extra movement cost.

name: Bulette Pup
description: Young bulettes hunt in groups and erupt from below to seize prey in their jaws. The pups can bring down creatures larger than themselves, and an adult may be close by.

sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 14 (2d10 + 3) Piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Leap. The pup spends 10 ft. of movement to jump up to 30 ft.

name: Cockatrice Regent
description: Larger and bolder than other cockatrices, a regent attacks with a petrifying bite. Its unstable magic lashes out against creatures that hurt it, even from a distance.

sections.Traits: Flyby. Flying out of an enemy's reach doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Petrifying Bite attack and two Talons attacks.
Petrifying Bite. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage. A creature hit also makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure it is Restrained. If it is still Restrained at the end of its next turn, it repeats the save. A success ends the effect. A second failure replaces Restrained with Petrified.
Talons. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 18 (4d6 + 4) Slashing damage.
sections.Reactions: Magical Backlash. When a creature within 120 ft. damages the regent, that creature makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 13 (3d6 + 3) Force damage.

name: Colossus
description: Faithful artisans build these towering figures in honor of their gods. A divine power can awaken the crystal in a colossus's heart and send it to defend the faithful or carry out the deity's will. Many lie dormant in remote places.

sections.Languages: Understands Celestial and Common, and can't speak.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned, Unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. The colossus can't shape-shift.
Legendary Resistance (4/day). When it fails a saving throw, the colossus can spend a use to succeed.
Magic Resistance. The colossus has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Siege Monster. The colossus deals double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Slam or Radiant Ray in any combination.
Slam. Melee attack, +18 to hit, reach 20 ft. A hit deals 32 (4d10 + 10) Bludgeoning damage and pushes the target up to 20 ft. directly away from the colossus.
Radiant Ray. Ranged attack, +18 to hit, range 300 ft. A hit deals 22 (4d10) Radiant damage. A Large or smaller creature hit also falls Prone.
Divine Beam (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 300-ft.-long, 10-ft.-wide Line make a DC 26 Dexterity save. The beam deals 65 (10d12) Radiant damage on a failure or half as much on a success. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 HP, it disintegrates into dust. The magic items it wore or carried remain.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 uses. The colossus can spend one use on an option immediately after another creature's turn. It cannot do so while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. It regains spent uses at the start of its turn.
Smite. Make one Radiant Ray attack.
Stomp. Move up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. The colossus can make one Slam attack at any point during this move.

name: Dire Worg
description: This outsized worg unnerves prey with a supernatural howl. Dire worgs often hunt with ettins, ogres, and trolls, and can teleport with a willing ally.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The worg has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage and leaves the target Poisoned until the start of the worg's next turn. The target can't regain HP while Poisoned by this bite.
Dreadful Howl (Recharge 5–6). Each creature other than a worg within 30 ft. makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure the creature takes 36 (8d8) Psychic damage and is Frightened until the start of the dire worg's next turn. On a success it takes half damage only.
sections.Bonus actions: Warp Step. The worg and one willing creature of its choice within 5 ft. of it teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space the worg can see.

name: Ghast Gravecaller
description: Gravecallers speak with corpses and wield necrotic magic. Some pass themselves off as liches or vampires.

sections.Traits: Stench. Any creature that starts its turn in a 5-ft. Emanation from the ghast makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, it is Poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a success, it gains immunity to this ghast's Stench for 24 hours.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Horrific Necrosis attacks. The ghast can replace one of them with a Claw attack.
Claw. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 13 (3d6 + 3) Slashing damage. A target other than an Undead is also Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.
Horrific Necrosis. Melee or ranged attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) Necrotic damage and leaves the target Frightened until the end of its next turn.
Spellcasting. Cast Speak with Dead or Thaumaturgy at will using Intelligence. Neither spell requires Material components for the ghast.

name: Flying Snake
description: A small venomous snake that can fly and swim.

sections.Traits: Flyby. The snake can fly out of an enemy's reach without provoking an Opportunity Attack.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 1 Piercing damage and 5 (2d4) Poison damage.

name: Giant Axe Beak
description: A giant flightless bird that fights for territory with dinosaurs in remote primeval lands.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Sharpened Beak attack and one Talons attack.
Sharpened Beak. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 18 (2d12 + 5) Slashing damage. The axe beak chooses a creature within 5 ft. of the target to take 6 (1d12) Slashing damage.
Talons. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage, and a Large or smaller creature hit falls Prone.

name: Giant Eagle
description: A celestial eagle that strikes with radiant talons.

sections.Languages: Speaks Celestial and understands Common and Primordial (Auran).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage and 3 (1d6) Radiant damage.

name: Giant Elk
description: A celestial elk that bowls over foes with a charge.

sections.Languages: Speaks Celestial and understands Common, Elvish, and Sylvan.
sections.Actions: Ram. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage and 5 (2d4) Radiant damage. If the elk moved at least 20 ft. straight toward a Huge or smaller creature immediately before hitting it, that creature takes another 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage and falls Prone.

name: Giant Owl
description: A celestial owl that can detect magic and spy on distant places.

sections.Languages: Speaks Celestial and understands Common, Elvish, and Sylvan.
sections.Traits: Flyby. The owl can fly out of an enemy's reach without provoking an Opportunity Attack.
sections.Actions: Talons. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell with Wisdom and without components.
At will. Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic.
1/day. Clairvoyance.

name: Giant Vulture
description: A giant carrion bird whose gouging attack poisons its prey.

sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The vulture has Advantage when attacking a creature if at least one of the vulture's allies is within 5 ft. of that creature and is not Incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Gouge. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) Piercing damage and leaves the target Poisoned until the end of its next turn.

name: Githyanki Dracomancer
description: A githyanki spellcaster who upholds the pact with red dragons and conjures their fire in battle.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Draconic Strike attacks.
Draconic Strike. Melee or ranged attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage and 17 (5d6) Fire damage. The target is Frightened until the start of the dracomancer's next turn.
Conjured Dragon's Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 90-ft. Cone must make a DC 18 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 27 (6d8) Fire damage and 27 (6d8) Force damage. On a success, it takes half damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell with Intelligence (save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). Omit all components.
At will. Mage Hand (the hand is Invisible).
2/day each. Nondetection (self only), Plane Shift, Tongues.
sections.Bonus actions: Misty Step (3/day). Cast Misty Step using Intelligence without components.

name: Gulthias Blight
description: A cursed plant that feeds on blood and spreads its corruption by planting lesser blights.

sections.Traits: Blight Seeds. At the end of a Long Rest, the blight expels 1d6 seeds into unoccupied ground spaces within 30 ft. After 24 hours, each seed becomes a creature under its control. Roll 1d8 for each seed. On 1–4 it becomes a Twig Blight, on 5–6 a Needle Blight, and on 7–8 a Vine Blight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any mix of Slam and Thorn Volley, and use Life-Draining Root.
Slam. Melee attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 25 (4d8 + 7) Bludgeoning damage.
Thorn Volley. Ranged attack, +12 to hit, range 60/180 ft. A hit deals 20 (3d8 + 7) Piercing damage.
Life-Draining Root. Choose one Huge or smaller creature the blight can see within 30 ft. On a failed DC 20 Constitution save, the creature takes 14 (2d6 + 7) Necrotic damage and is Grappled by one of the blight's six roots (escape DC 17). Until the grapple ends, the creature is Restrained and takes 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The creature's Hit Point maximum decreases by the Necrotic damage it takes from this action, and the blight regains that many Hit Points.

name: Dracolich
classification: Huge or Gargantuan undead, lawful evil
description: An undead dragon bound to a soul gem. If the body is destroyed, the gem can give it a new one.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). After failing a save, the creature can spend a use to succeed instead.
Life Suppression. Creatures within 60 ft. of the dracolich cannot regain HP.
Magic Resistance. The dracolich has Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Soul Gem. If the dracolich is destroyed while its gem is on the same plane, it reforms with full HP in 1d20 days within 5 ft. of the gem. The gem is a Tiny object with AC 20 and 50 HP. Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage cannot harm it. At the end of every turn it returns to full HP, but it crumbles to dust at 0 HP. If the gem is destroyed, the dracolich can make a new one with an 8-hour ritual, a gem worth at least 1,000 gp, and an additional 5,000 gp that the ritual consumes.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. The dracolich can replace one with Spellcasting to cast the level 2 version of Ray of Sickness.
Rend. Melee attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 18 (2d10 + 7) Slashing damage and 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.
Necrotic Breath (Recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 60-ft. Cone makes a DC 20 Constitution save. On a failure the creature takes 52 (8d12) Necrotic damage. On a success it takes half damage.
Spellcasting. Cast one spell using Charisma (save DC 19, +11 to hit). These spells require no Material components. At will, Detect Magic and Ray of Sickness (level 2). Once per day each, Create Undead (level 8) and Finger of Death.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 uses, or 4 in its lair. Spend one use just after another creature's turn ends. All uses return at the start of the creature's turn. It cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Pounce. Move up to half its Speed and make one Rend attack.
Sickening Ray. Use Spellcasting to cast Ray of Sickness at level 2. This option is then unavailable until the start of the dracolich's next turn.
Terrifying Presence. Every creature in a 30-ft. Emanation from the dracolich makes a DC 19 Wisdom save. On a failure, the creature takes 11 (2d10) Psychic damage and is Frightened until the end of its next turn. After using this option, the dracolich cannot use it again until its next turn starts.
sections.In its lair: 20,000 XP. Legendary Resistance increases to 4/day and Legendary Actions increase to 4 uses.
sections.Regional effects:
Sapping Mist. Pale fog makes the area within 1 mile of the lair Lightly Obscured. A creature that finishes a Long Rest in that area must pass a DC 15 Constitution save or gain 1 Exhaustion level. The dracolich and its allies are exempt from this save.
Soul Drain. Creatures within 1 mile of the lair make Death Saving Throws with Disadvantage.
Both effects end immediately if the dracolich is destroyed or moves its lair. They resume if it gains a new body.

name: Half-Dragon
description: A magically created warrior with a breath weapon and resistance tied to its draconic origin.

sections.Damage resistances: Choose the damage type from Draconic Origin.
sections.Traits: Draconic Origin. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison for the half-dragon's origin. Its resistance, Claw damage, and Dragon's Breath use this damage type.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d4 + 4) Slashing damage and 7 (2d6) damage of the Draconic Origin type.
Dragon's Breath (Recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. On a failure the creature takes 28 (8d6) damage of the Draconic Origin type. On a success it takes half damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Leap. Spend 10 ft. of movement to jump up to 30 ft.

name: Juvenile Shadow Dragon
description: A young dragon that hunts in darkness and raises a slain Humanoid as a Shadow.

sections.Traits:
Living Shadow. While in Dim Light or Darkness, the dragon resists damage other than Force, Psychic, and Radiant.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the dragon makes ability checks and attack rolls with Disadvantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage and 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage.
Shadow Breath (Recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 30-ft. Cone makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. On a failure the creature takes 17 (5d6) Necrotic damage. On a success it takes half damage. A Humanoid this damage reduces to 0 HP dies and a Shadow rises from its corpse. The dragon controls the Shadow. The Shadow shares its Initiative count and acts immediately after it.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. Take the Hide action while in Dim Light or Darkness.

name: Shadow Dragon (Huge)
description: A dragon twisted by shadow magic. Its presence dims lights and weakens healing near its lair.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). After failing a save, the creature can spend a use to succeed instead.
Living Shadow. While in Dim Light or Darkness, the dragon resists damage other than Force, Psychic, and Radiant.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the dragon makes ability checks and attack rolls with Disadvantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage and 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage.
Shadow Breath (Recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 60-ft. Cone makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. On a failure the creature takes 35 (10d6) Necrotic damage. On a success it takes half damage. A Humanoid this damage reduces to 0 HP dies and a Shadow rises from its corpse. The dragon controls the Shadow. The Shadow shares its Initiative count and acts immediately after it.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. Take the Hide action while in Dim Light or Darkness.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 uses, or 4 in its lair. Spend one use just after another creature's turn ends. All uses return at the start of the creature's turn. It cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Pounce. Move up to half its Speed and make one Rend attack.
Veil of Shadow. Use Shadow Stealth. Choose one creature the dragon can see within 10 ft. It takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. This option is then unavailable until the start of the dragon's next turn.
sections.In its lair: 11,500 XP. Legendary Resistance increases to 4/day and Legendary Actions increase to 4 uses.
sections.Regional effects:
Negative Energy Suffusion. Within 1 mile of the lair, subtract 1d10 from the HP a creature regains from a spell.
Stifling Shadows. Within 1 mile of the lair, effects that would create Bright Light create Dim Light. Creatures in that area make Dexterity (Stealth) checks with Advantage.
Both effects end immediately if the dragon dies or moves its lair.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), pp. 274–275. Regional effects are on p. 274 and the stat block is on p. 275.

name: Minotaur of Baphomet
description: A devotee of the Demon Lord of Beasts that stalks intruders through mazes.

sections.Actions:
Abyssal Glaive. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage and 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.
Gore (Recharge 5–6). Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the minotaur moved at least 10 ft. straight toward it just before the hit, the target takes 10 (3d6) extra Piercing damage and falls Prone.

name: Pixie Wonderbringer
description: A winged fey whose dust and spells charm, distract, or transform intruders.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The pixie has Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Faerie Dust attacks.
Faerie Dust. Melee or ranged attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) Radiant damage. The pixie chooses whether the target is Charmed or Poisoned until the start of the pixie's next turn.
Spellcasting. Cast one spell using Charisma (save DC 15). These spells require no Material components. At will, Dancing Lights, Druidcraft, and Invisibility (self only). Once per day each, Detect Thoughts, Fly, and Major Image.
sections.Bonus actions: Burst of Wonder (Recharge 5–6). Cast Entangle, Polymorph, or Tasha's Hideous Laughter using Charisma (save DC 15), without Material components.

name: Primeval Owlbear
description: An enormous forest owlbear that climbs, makes short flights, and lets out a thunderous screech.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The owlbear has Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Ravage attacks.
Ravage. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d8 + 6) Slashing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature and the owlbear moved at least 20 ft. straight toward it just before the hit, the target takes 9 (2d8) extra Slashing damage and falls Prone.
Screech (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. Emanation from the owlbear makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, the creature takes 27 (6d8) Thunder damage and is Incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a success it takes half damage only.

name: Salamander Fire Snake
description: A young salamander that hatches from a burning egg and matures by feeding on fuel in extreme heat.

sections.Traits: Fire Aura. At the end of each of the salamander's turns, choose any creatures in a 5-ft. Emanation centered on it. Each chosen creature takes 3 (1d6) Fire damage.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage and 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

name: Salamander Inferno Master
description: An ancient salamander that trains apprentices in extreme heat. Its projects can include provoking an eruption or opening a portal to a plane of fire.

sections.Traits:
Fire Aura. At the end of each of the salamander's turns, choose any creatures in a 10-ft. Emanation centered on it. Each chosen creature takes 10 (3d6) Fire damage.
Magic Resistance. The creature has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Flame Trident attacks.
Flame Trident. Melee or ranged attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/90 ft. A hit deals 16 (2d8 + 7) Piercing damage and 14 (4d6) Fire damage. After a ranged attack, the trident immediately returns to the salamander's hand, even on a miss.
Inferno Blast (Recharge 5–6). Choose a point the salamander can see within 120 ft. Each creature in a 30-ft.-radius Sphere centered there makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 35 (10d6) Fire damage and starts Burning. Replace the normal Burning damage with 5 (1d10) Fire damage at the start of each of its turns. It gains one Exhaustion level every time it takes this Burning damage. A successful save halves the initial damage and avoids Burning.
sections.Bonus actions: Blazing Movement. The salamander moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. A 5-ft. Emanation of fire moves with it. A creature takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage when the Emanation enters its space, at most once per turn.

name: Satyr Revelmaster
description: A satyr whose enchanted songs drive a celebration or scatter enemies.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The creature has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Prance attacks.
Prance. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage and leaves the target Charmed until the start of the satyr's next turn.
Fey Melody (Recharge 4–6). Choose a charming or frightening song. Each enemy in a 60-ft. Emanation centered on the satyr makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. A creature that fails suffers the chosen effect.
Charming. The creature is Charmed for 1 minute. While Charmed by this song, it is Incapacitated and spends all its movement dancing in place. Any damage ends the effect for that creature.
Frightening. The creature takes 10 (2d6 + 3) Psychic damage and is Frightened for 1 minute. The condition ends early if it finishes its turn out of the satyr's line of sight.

name: Sphinx of Lore
description: A reclusive oracle that guards one great secret, such as an ancient text or a route to another world.

sections.Traits:
Inscrutable. Magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts only with its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks to judge its intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.
Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). After failing a saving throw, the sphinx can spend one use to succeed.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 14 (3d6 + 4) Slashing damage.
Mind-Rending Roar (Recharge 5–6). Each enemy in a 300-ft. Emanation centered on the sphinx makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. A creature that fails takes 35 (10d6) Psychic damage and is Incapacitated until the start of the sphinx's next turn.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell without Material components, using Intelligence (spell save DC 16).
At will. Detect Magic, Identify, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation.
1/day each. Dispel Magic, Legend Lore, Locate Object, Plane Shift, Remove Curse, Tongues.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 uses, or 4 in its lair. Immediately after another creature finishes its turn, spend one use on one option. The sphinx regains spent uses at the start of its turn and cannot spend a use while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Arcane Prowl. The sphinx can teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. It makes one Claw attack.
Weight of Years. Choose one creature the sphinx can see within 120 ft. It must pass a DC 16 Constitution save or gain one Exhaustion level. A target that fails looks 3d10 years older for as long as it has any Exhaustion levels. This option becomes available again at the start of the sphinx's next turn, regardless of the save result.
sections.In its lair: 8,400 XP. Legendary Resistance increases to 4/day and Legendary Actions increase to 4 uses.
sections.Regional effects:
Distant Sight. While inside its lair, the sphinx can cast Clairvoyance without spell components, using its Spellcasting ability. The spell has a range of 1 mile when cast this way.
Infusion of Knowledge. When the sphinx or one of its allies takes the Study action within 1 mile of the lair, it adds 1d6 to any ability check made for that action.
Both effects end immediately if the sphinx dies or relocates its lair.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), pp. 293–294. The stat block is on p. 293 and the regional effects are on p. 294.

name: Sphinx of Secrets
description: An immortal scholar that guards the site of its research, even if the library or sanctuary around it has fallen to ruin.

sections.Traits:
Inscrutable. Magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts only with its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks to judge its intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.
Magic Resistance. The creature has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Claw attacks. The sphinx can replace one attack with Curse of the Riddle.
Claw. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage and 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.
Curse of the Riddle. Choose one creature the sphinx can see within 60 ft. On a failed DC 15 Intelligence save, it takes 21 (6d6) Psychic damage and is cursed. The curse gives it Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls. Whenever it takes the Magic action, it must pass a DC 15 Intelligence save or waste the action. It can take the Study action to try a DC 15 Intelligence check, solving the riddle and ending the curse on a success. The curse also ends if the sphinx curses another target.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell without Material components, using Intelligence (spell save DC 15).
At will. Detect Magic, Identify, Prestidigitation.
1/day each. Locate Object, Remove Curse.

name: Sphinx of Valor
description: The guardian of a dangerous truth or Artifact, often hidden in a remote magical site.

sections.Traits:
Inscrutable. Magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts only with its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks to judge its intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.
Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). After failing a saving throw, the sphinx can spend one use to succeed.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks and use Roar.
Claw. Melee attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 20 (4d6 + 6) Slashing damage.
Roar (3/day). Each roar targets all enemies in a 500-ft. Emanation centered on the sphinx. Apply the effects in the order below. A Long Rest resets the sequence.
First Roar. Each target makes a DC 20 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Frightened for 1 minute.
Second Roar. Each target makes a DC 20 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Paralyzed. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. After 1 minute it succeeds automatically.
Third Roar. Each target makes a DC 20 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 44 (8d10) Thunder damage and is knocked Prone. On a success, it takes half the damage only.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell without Material components, using Wisdom (spell save DC 20).
At will. Detect Evil and Good, Thaumaturgy.
1/day each. Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Greater Restoration, Heroes' Feast, Zone of Truth.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 uses, or 4 in its lair. Immediately after another creature finishes its turn, spend one use on one option. The sphinx regains spent uses at the start of its turn and cannot spend a use while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Arcane Prowl. The sphinx can teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. It makes one Claw attack.
Weight of Years. Choose one creature the sphinx can see within 120 ft. It must pass a DC 16 Constitution save or gain one Exhaustion level. A target that fails looks 3d10 years older for as long as it has any Exhaustion levels. This option becomes available again at the start of the sphinx's next turn, regardless of the save result.
sections.In its lair: 20,000 XP. Legendary Resistance increases to 4/day and Legendary Actions increase to 4 uses.
sections.Regional effects:
Distant Sight. While inside its lair, the sphinx can cast Clairvoyance without spell components, using its Spellcasting ability. The spell has a range of 1 mile when cast this way.
Infusion of Knowledge. When the sphinx or one of its allies takes the Study action within 1 mile of the lair, it adds 1d6 to any ability check made for that action.
Both effects end immediately if the sphinx dies or relocates its lair.

name: Sphinx of Wonder
description: A bright-feathered sphinx the size of a lion cub. A new sphinx appears when someone on the Material Plane conceives a unique idea. The sphinx's forehead sigil hints at the subject it loves to study.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The creature has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions: Rend. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage and 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.
sections.Reactions: Burst of Ingenuity (2/day). When the sphinx or another creature within 30 ft. makes an ability check or saving throw, add 2 to the roll.

name: Stirge
description: A flying blood feeder that latches onto its prey.

sections.Actions: Proboscis. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. The stirge deals 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage on a hit and attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge cannot make Proboscis attacks. The target takes 5 (2d4) Necrotic damage at the start of each of the stirge's turns. The stirge can spend 5 ft. of movement to detach. The target or a creature within 5 ft. of it can also use an action to detach the stirge.
sections.Habitats: Desert, forest, grassland, hill, mountain, swamp, underdark, urban.

name: Swarm of Crawling Claws
classification: Medium swarm of Tiny undead, neutral evil
description: A mass of animated severed hands that pulls down creatures within reach.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Incapacitated, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned.
sections.Traits: Swarm. The swarm and other creatures can share spaces. It fits through openings large enough for a Tiny creature and cannot regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.
sections.Actions: Swarm of Grasping Hands. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 20 (4d8 + 2) Necrotic damage, or 11 (2d8 + 2) Necrotic damage while the swarm is Bloodied. A Medium or smaller creature hit by this attack also falls Prone.

name: Swarm of Stirges
classification: Medium swarm of Tiny monstrosities, unaligned
description: A cloud of blood feeders that can pin a creature caught in their midst.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned.
sections.Traits: Swarm. The swarm and other creatures can share spaces. It fits through openings large enough for a Tiny creature and cannot regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.
sections.Actions: Swarm of Proboscises. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 14 (2d10 + 3) Piercing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage while the swarm is Bloodied. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature in the swarm's space, it is also Grappled (escape DC 13). The target takes 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage at the end of each of its turns until the grapple ends.
sections.Habitats: Desert, forest, grassland, hill, mountain, swamp, underdark, urban.

name: Thri-kreen Marauder
description: A fast-moving thri-kreen that fights with a gythka and thrown chatkcha.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Gythka and Chatkcha.
Gythka. Melee attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.
Chatkcha. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Leap. Spend 5 ft. of movement to jump up to 15 ft.

name: Thri-kreen Psion
description: A thri-kreen that hovers and attacks with psychic force.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Psionic Lance attacks.
Psionic Lance. Melee or ranged attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. A hit deals 18 (4d6 + 4) Psychic damage.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell without components, using Intelligence (spell save DC 15). At will, Mage Hand creates an Invisible hand. Detect Thoughts, Sending, and Synaptic Static are each available once per day.

name: Vampire Familiar
classification: Small or Medium humanoid, neutral evil
description: A humanoid servant whose vampire master can see through its eyes.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, except when the source is its vampire master.
sections.Traits: Vampiric Connection. While the familiar and its vampire master share a plane, the master can contact it telepathically and perceive through the familiar's senses.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Umbral Dagger attacks.
Umbral Dagger. Melee or ranged attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) Necrotic damage. A target this attack reduces to 0 Hit Points becomes Stable and is Poisoned for 1 hour. The target is Paralyzed while Poisoned in this way.
sections.Bonus actions: Deathless Agility. Take the Dash or Disengage action.

name: Violet Fungus Necrohulk
description: An enormous fungal creature that seizes prey and grafts it to its own body.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rotting Slam attacks.
Rotting Slam. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.
Spore Bomb (Recharge 5–6). Center a 20-ft.-radius Sphere on a point the necrohulk can see within 60 ft. Each creature in the Sphere makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 28 (8d6) Necrotic damage and is Poisoned until the start of the necrohulk's next turn. It cannot regain Hit Points while Poisoned in this way. On a success, it takes half damage only.
sections.Bonus actions: Absorb Body. Choose one Small or Medium creature the necrohulk can see within 5 ft. The target makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure, the necrohulk pulls the target into its space and grafts it to its body. It can have only one target grafted at a time. The grafted target is Restrained, has Disadvantage on Constitution saves, and moves with the necrohulk. If the grafted target dies, its body is destroyed and the necrohulk regains 10 Hit Points. The target or a creature within 5 ft. of the necrohulk can use an action to make a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check. On a success, the target is freed and moves to an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the necrohulk.

name: Warrior Commander
description: An experienced officer who opens gaps for allies and counters attacks that come close.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Greatsword and Longbow.
Greatsword. Melee attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 19 (4d6 + 5) Slashing damage. The commander also chooses one effect. Sap gives the target Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of the commander's next turn. Maneuver lets one ally who can see or hear the commander use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
Longbow. Ranged attack, +9 to hit, range 150/600 ft. A hit deals 18 (3d8 + 5) Piercing damage and reduces the target's Speed by 10 ft. until the end of the target's next turn.
sections.Bonus actions: Tactical Charge. Move up to half the commander's Speed straight toward a visible enemy without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
sections.Reactions: Counterattack. When an attack roll hits the commander, it adds 4 to its AC against that attack, potentially making the attack miss. If it misses, the commander can make one Greatsword or Longbow attack against the attacker.

name: Abjurer Wizard
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A defensive mage who can ward an ally against damage and drive enemies back with a blast of force.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Arcane Burst attacks.
Arcane Burst. Melee or ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (3d10 + 4) force damage.
Force Blast. Each creature in a 20-ft. cube originating from the abjurer makes a DC 16 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 36 (8d8) force damage and is pushed up to 10 ft. away from the abjurer. On a success, it takes half damage and stays in place.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Intelligence (spell save DC 16).
At will. Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Message, Prestidigitation.
2/day each. Dispel Magic, Lightning Bolt, Mage Armor.
1/day each. Arcane Lock, Banishment, Globe of Invulnerability, Invisibility, Wall of Force.
sections.Reactions: Arcane Ward (Recharge 4–6). When the abjurer takes damage or sees a creature within 30 ft. take damage, it can create a barrier around the creature taking damage. The barrier reduces that damage by 26 (4d10 + 4), to a minimum of 0, then vanishes.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 260.

name: Adult Kruthik
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A rock-burrowing monstrosity that hunts in packs and can fire spikes at distant prey.

sections.Traits:
Pack Tactics. The kruthik has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kruthik's allies is within 5 ft. of that creature and that ally isn't incapacitated.
Tunneler. The kruthik can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed, leaving a tunnel 5 ft. across.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Stab or Spike attacks.
Stab. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Spike. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 169.

name: Adult Oblex
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A memory-eating ooze that can mimic its victims through slime-tethered doubles.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft. The oblex is blind beyond this range.
sections.Traits:
Amorphous. The oblex moves through openings as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Aversion to Fire. Fire damage gives the oblex disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.
Unusual Nature. The oblex needs no sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Pseudopod attacks and use Eat Memories.
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
Eat Memories. Choose one visible creature within 5 ft. It makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. Constructs, Oozes, Plants, and Undead succeed automatically. On a failure, the target takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage and is memory drained. A short or long rest, Greater Restoration, or Heal ends the drain. While drained, the target rolls a d4 and subtracts the result from its ability checks and attack rolls. Each further drain increases the die by one size through d6, d8, d10, d12, then d20. When the die reaches d20, the target falls unconscious for 1 hour. The effect then ends. The oblex learns the drained creature's languages and gains all its skill proficiencies.
sections.Spellcasting:
Spellcasting (Psionics). As an action, cast one of the following spells using Intelligence (spell save DC 15). No components are required.
3/day each. Charm Person at 5th level, Detect Thoughts, Hypnotic Pattern.
sections.Bonus actions: Sulfurous Impersonation. The oblex produces a double of a Medium or smaller creature whose memories it stole. It looks, feels, and sounds like that creature but smells faintly of sulfur. The oblex can impersonate 1d4 + 1 distinct creatures. A slime tether up to 120 ft. long links each double to the oblex. The oblex occupies its own space and the doubles' spaces at the same time. The tether is immune to damage. If no opening at least 1 inch wide connects the double to the body, the tether severs and the double disappears.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 198.
sections.Skill choice: Choose one of Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion. The oblex has a +7 bonus in that skill.

name: Air Elemental Myrmidon
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An air elemental bound inside plate armor, wielding a flail that can stun with lightning.

sections.Languages: Auran and one language chosen by its creator.
sections.Damage resistances: Lightning, thunder, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Flail attacks.
Flail. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) force damage.
Lightning Strike (Recharge 6). Make one Flail attack. On a hit, it deals an extra 18 (4d8) lightning damage. The target makes a DC 13 Constitution save or is stunned until the end of the myrmidon's next turn.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 122.

name: Alhoon
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
classification: Medium undead (mind flayer, wizard), typically neutral evil
description: An exiled mind flayer arcanist bound to undeath by a periapt that holds sacrificed souls.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The alhoon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Turn Resistance. The alhoon has advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Chilling Grasp or Arcane Bolt attacks.
Chilling Grasp. Melee spell attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (4d6) cold damage, and the alhoon regains 14 hit points.
Arcane Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 28 (8d6) force damage.
Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6). The alhoon releases magical psychic energy. Creatures in a 60-foot cone make a DC 16 Intelligence save. On a failure, a creature takes 22 (4d8 + 4) psychic damage and is stunned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the stun on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell without material components, using Intelligence (spell save DC 16).
At will. Dancing Lights, Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation.
1/day each. Dominate Monster, Globe of Invulnerability, Invisibility, Modify Memory, Plane Shift (self only), Wall of Force.
sections.Reactions: Negate Spell (3/day). When a creature the alhoon can see within 60 ft. casts a spell, the alhoon can target the caster. A spell of 3rd level or lower fails without wasting the slot or charge.
sections.Periapt of mind trapping: The periapt is a fist-sized container made of silver, emerald, and amethyst. At least three mind flayer arcanists create the periapt and sacrifice an equal number of living victims in a three-day ritual. Each alhoon remains undead for the lifespan remaining to its victim, and the rite can be repeated with new victims. When an alhoon is destroyed, its mind enters the periapt alongside the sacrificed souls. Destroying the periapt destroys the minds and souls trapped inside. Its holder has advantage on attacks, saves, and checks against the associated alhoons, and those alhoons have disadvantage on attacks, saves, and checks against the holder. The holder can speak telepathically with the trapped victims or silence them. Alhoons inside can speak telepathically to the holder without permission.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 43.

name: Alkilith
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A demon that clings to openings like fungal growth and turns them into permanent gates to the Abyss.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid, cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Abyssal Rift. If the alkilith continuously surrounds a door, window, or similar opening for 6d6 days, the opening becomes a permanent portal to a random layer of the Abyss.
Amorphous. The alkilith passes through openings as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
False Appearance. The alkilith has advantage on initiative if motionless at the start of combat. A creature that hasn't seen it move or act needs a successful DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to recognize it as something other than slime or fungus.
Foment Confusion. A creature other than a demon that starts its turn within 30 ft. makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. On a failure, it hears a brief buzz and has disadvantage on its next attack roll, save, or ability check. If it fails by 5 or more, it instead falls under Confusion for 1 minute without requiring the alkilith's concentration. While under that spell, it is immune to Foment Confusion.
Magic Resistance. The alkilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Spider Climb. The alkilith climbs difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
Unusual Nature. The alkilith needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Tentacle attacks.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (4d6 + 4) acid damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 44.

name: Allip
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A restless spirit driven to pass on the cursed secret that destroyed it.

sections.Languages: The languages it knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Acid, fire, lightning, thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained.
sections.Traits:
Incorporeal Movement. The allip moves through creatures and objects as difficult terrain. If it ends its turn inside an object, it takes 5 (1d10) force damage.
Unusual Nature. The allip needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Maddening Touch. Melee spell attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (4d6 + 3) psychic damage.
Howling Babble (Recharge 6). Each creature within 30 ft. that can hear the allip makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure, the creature takes 12 (2d8 + 3) psychic damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and avoids the stun. Constructs and undead are immune.
Whispers of Compulsion. The allip chooses up to three creatures it can see within 60 ft. Each makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 12 (2d8 + 3) psychic damage and must use its reaction to make a melee weapon attack against a creature the allip can see and chooses. Constructs and undead are immune.
sections.Insidious lore: Over days or weeks, a hidden allip can guide a scholar into writing its cursed knowledge without remembering what they wrote. Once the secret is recorded, the allip can pass into the afterlife. The writing still carries the curse.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 45.

name: Amnizu
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An infernal commander who can strip away memories and compel attackers to turn on those around them.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. Magical darkness doesn't block the amnizu's darkvision.
Magic Resistance. The amnizu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Blinding Rot or Forgetfulness if available. Also make two Taskmaster Whip attacks.
Taskmaster Whip. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 16 (3d10) force damage.
Blinding Rot. Choose one or two creatures the amnizu can see within 60 ft. Each makes a DC 19 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 26 (4d12) necrotic damage and is blinded until the start of the amnizu's next turn.
Forgetfulness (Recharge 6). Choose a creature the amnizu can see within 60 ft. It makes a DC 18 Intelligence save. On a failure, it takes 26 (4d12) psychic damage and is stunned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If the stun lasts the full minute, the creature forgets everything it sensed, experienced, or learned in the previous 5 hours.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell without material components, using Intelligence (spell save DC 19).
At will. Command.
3/day. Dominate Monster.
1/day. Feeblemind.
