sections.Reactions: Instinctive Charm. When a creature within 60 ft. makes an attack roll against the amnizu and another creature is within the attack's range, the attacker makes a DC 19 Wisdom save. On a failure, the attacker must instead target the creature closest to it, excluding itself and the amnizu. The attacker breaks ties. On a success, the attacker is immune to this amnizu's Instinctive Charm for 24 hours.
sections.Optional action: Summon Devil (1/day). Some amnizus can summon either 2d4 bearded devils or 1d4 barbed devils. The devils appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 ft. and act as allies. Summoned devils can't summon other devils. They remain for 1 minute, until the amnizu dies, or until it uses an action to dismiss them.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 46.

name: Angry Sorrowsworn
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A two-headed Shadowfell creature whose hook attacks grow more dangerous when it takes damage.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing while in dim light or darkness.
sections.Traits:
Two Heads. The sorrowsworn has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.
Rising Anger. When another creature damages the sorrowsworn, it gains advantage on its attack rolls until the end of its next turn. Its first Hook hit on its next turn deals another 19 (3d12) psychic damage. On its turn, its attack rolls have disadvantage if no other creature has damaged it since the end of its last turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Hook attacks.
Hook. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d12 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 222.

name: Annis Hag
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A hulking hag who can crush a captive and use enchanted pieces of iron to whisper across miles.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage.
Crushing Hug. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 36 (9d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and grapples a Large or smaller creature (escape DC 15). The creature takes 36 (9d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the hag's turns until the grapple ends. The hag can't make attacks while holding a creature this way.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Charisma (spell save DC 13).
3/day each. Disguise Self (can appear as a Medium humanoid), Fog Cloud.
sections.Coven: Challenge 8 (3,900 XP) as part of a coven.
sections.Iron token: The hag spends 1 minute shaping one of her own iron teeth or nails into a coin, ring, or tiny mirror. Its holder and the hag can whisper to each other within 10 miles. Neither hears other sounds at the opposite end. The hag can keep up to three tokens active, use an action to sense their direction and approximate distance, or deactivate one at any distance without an action. A deactivated token keeps its shape but loses its magic.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 47.

name: Apprentice Wizard
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A novice wizard who can throw bursts of force and cast a few practical spells.

sections.Actions: Arcane Burst. Melee or ranged spell attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d10 + 2) force damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 12).
At will. Mage Hand, Prestidigitation.
1/day each. Burning Hands, Disguise Self, Mage Armor.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 259.

name: Archdruid
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A guardian of wild places who can fight with wildfire or assume the form of a beast or elemental.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Staff or Wildfire attacks. The archdruid can replace one attack with Spellcasting.
Staff. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) poison damage.
Wildfire. Ranged spell attack, +9 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 26 (6d6 + 5) fire damage and blinds the target until the start of the archdruid's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Wisdom (spell save DC 17).
At will. Beast Sense, Entangle, Speak with Animals.
3/day each. Animal Messenger, Dominate Beast, Faerie Fire, Tree Stride.
1/day each. Commune with Nature (cast as an action), Mass Cure Wounds.
sections.Bonus actions: Change Shape (2/day). Magically assume the form of a Beast or Elemental of CR 6 or lower for up to 9 hours. Choose whether equipment falls, merges into the form, or remains worn. Use the new form's statistics except that the archdruid retains its current and maximum hit points, this bonus action, the languages it knows and the ability to speak, and Spellcasting. Attacks in the new form count as magical against resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks. The archdruid reverts when it dies or falls unconscious, or can revert as a bonus action.
sections.Favored shapes: Choose an eligible form or roll 1d8. 1 Air Elemental, 2 Earth Elemental, 3 Fire Elemental, 4 Giant Crocodile, 5 Mammoth, 6 Flail Snail, 7 Triceratops, 8 Water Elemental.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 48.

name: Archer
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A trained marksman who can turn a narrow miss into a hit or make a well-placed shot hurt more.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, using Shortsword or Longbow.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Archer's Eye (3/day). Immediately after making an attack roll or damage roll with a ranged weapon, the archer can roll 1d10 and add it to that roll's total.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 49.

name: Armanite
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A fast, hoofed demon that strikes with claws and a serrated tail or fires lightning through a line of foes.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The armanite has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Claw, one Hooves, and one Serrated Tail attack.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) lightning damage.
Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit must succeed on a DC 16 Strength save or fall prone.
Serrated Tail. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage.
Lightning Lance (Recharge 5–6). Release lightning in a line 60 ft. long and 10 ft. wide. Each creature in the line makes a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 36 (8d8) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 50.

name: Astral Dreadnought
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An Astral titan whose eye suppresses magic and whose jaws send swallowed prey to a private demiplane.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, stunned.
sections.Traits:
Antimagic Cone. Its open eye projects a 150-ft. cone with the effects of Antimagic Field. The dreadnought chooses the direction at the start of each of its turns. The cone stops working if its eye closes or it is blinded.
Astral Entity. The dreadnought cannot leave the Astral Plane. Banishment and other forms of transport cannot move it off the plane.
Demiplanar Donjon. Swallowed things enter an otherwise indestructible demiplane. Only Wish, Bite, or Donjon Visit can get a creature inside. Escape requires magic that enables planar travel, such as Plane Shift. The space resembles a stone cavern about 1,000 ft. across and 100 ft. high, littered with the remains of old meals. Nothing inside can injure the dreadnought. When the dreadnought dies, the demiplane disappears and its contents appear around the corpse.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the dreadnought fails a save, it can spend one use to succeed instead.
Sever Silver Cord. On a critical hit against a creature using Astral Projection, the dreadnought can sever the creature's silver cord in place of dealing damage.
Unusual Nature. The dreadnought needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 36 (5d10 + 9) force damage. The dreadnought swallows a Huge or smaller creature hit if it is incapacitated or if this damage reduces it to 0 hit points. It and its worn and carried gear appear in a free space on the Donjon floor.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d6 + 9) force damage.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 actions. Spend the indicated cost on one option at the end of another creature's turn. The creature regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It cannot use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must wait until after its first turn.
Claw (1 action). Make one Claw attack.
Donjon Visit (2 actions). One visible creature of Huge size or smaller within 60 ft. makes a DC 19 Charisma save. On a failure it teleports to an unoccupied space on the Donjon floor. At the end of its next turn, it reappears in the space it left or the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.
Psychic Projection (3 actions). Every creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 19 Wisdom save, taking 26 (4d10 + 4) psychic damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 51.

name: Autumn Eladrin
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A Feywild elf whose charm can disarm hostilities and whose weapon attacks carry psychic force.

sections.Traits:
Enchanting Presence. A creature other than an eladrin that starts its turn within 60 ft. makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure, the eladrin charms it for 1 minute. On a success it is immune to any eladrin's Enchanting Presence for 24 hours. If the eladrin damages a creature it has charmed this way, the creature can repeat the save and end the charm on a success.
Magic Resistance. The eladrin has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Longsword or Longbow. Spellcasting can replace one attack.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage one-handed or 6 (1d10 + 1) slashing damage two-handed, plus 22 (5d8) psychic damage either way.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 22 (5d8) psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Charisma (spell save DC 16). No material components are required.
At will. Hold Person.
2/day each. Cure Wounds at 5th level, Lesser Restoration.
1/day each. Greater Restoration, Revivify.
sections.Bonus actions: Fey Step (Recharge 4–6). Teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space the eladrin can see, taking worn and carried equipment along.
sections.Reactions: Foster Peace. When a creature charmed by the eladrin succeeds on an attack roll within 60 ft., the eladrin can magically turn that hit into a miss if it can see the attacker.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 115.

name: Babau
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A demon with acid-coated claws, a debilitating gaze, and several spells it can cast at will.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks. Spellcasting or Weakening Gaze can replace one attack.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) acid damage.
Weakening Gaze. One creature the babau can see within 20 ft. makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, for 1 minute its weapon attacks that use Strength deal half damage. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Wisdom (spell save DC 11). No material components are required.
At will. Darkness, Dispel Magic, Fear, Heat Metal, Levitate.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 52.

name: Bael
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An archdevil who frightens nearby foes, bolsters his allies, and regenerates unless exposed to cold or radiant damage.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Dread. A creature other than a devil that starts its turn within 10 ft. of Bael makes a DC 22 Wisdom save. On a failure it is frightened of him until the start of its next turn. It succeeds automatically if Bael chooses to let it or if he is incapacitated.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Bael fails a save, he can spend one use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Bael has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. Bael recovers 20 hit points at the start of his turn. Cold or radiant damage prevents recovery at the start of his next turn. He dies only if he starts his turn at 0 hit points and fails to regenerate.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Hellish Morningstar attacks.
Hellish Morningstar. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d8 + 7) force damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.
Infernal Command. Each of Bael's allies within 60 ft. cannot be charmed or frightened until the end of Bael's next turn.
Teleport. Bael teleports up to 120 ft. to an unoccupied space he can see, taking worn and carried equipment along.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Charisma (spell save DC 21). No material components are required.
At will. Alter Self (can become Medium), Charm Person, Detect Magic, Invisibility, Major Image.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Fly, Suggestion, Wall of Fire.
1/day. Dominate Monster.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 actions. Spend the indicated cost on one option at the end of another creature's turn. The creature regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It cannot use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must wait until after its first turn.
Fiendish Magic (1 action). Use Spellcasting or Teleport.
Infernal Command (1 action). Use Infernal Command.
Attack (2 actions). Make one Hellish Morningstar attack.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 54.

name: Balhannoth
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A blind ambusher that senses desire, shapes convincing traps, and can teleport away with grappled prey.

sections.Traits: Legendary Resistance (2/day). When the balhannoth fails a save, it can spend one use to succeed instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Tentacle attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d10 + 3) piercing damage.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, grapples the target (escape DC 15), and moves it up to 5 ft. toward the balhannoth. The target is restrained until the grapple ends. That tentacle cannot attack another target while the grapple lasts. The balhannoth has four tentacles.
sections.Legendary actions:
3 actions. Spend the indicated cost on one option at the end of another creature's turn. The creature regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It cannot use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must wait until after its first turn.
Bite (1 action). Make one Bite attack against a creature it has grappled.
Teleport (1 action). Teleport up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. Its worn and carried equipment and any creatures it has grappled go with it.
Vanish (1 action). Become magically invisible for up to 10 minutes. The effect ends immediately after the balhannoth makes an attack roll.
sections.Lair actions:
On initiative count 20, after anyone tied at that count, the balhannoth can use one option while in its lair. It cannot choose the same option in consecutive rounds. Using an option requires being in the lair and able to act. If surprised, the creature must finish its first turn before using one.
Teleport. One creature within 500 ft. makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure, the balhannoth teleports it and its worn or carried belongings to a free space of the balhannoth's choice within 60 ft. of the balhannoth.
Vanish. One creature within 500 ft. makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure, the balhannoth becomes invisible to that creature for 1 minute, or until it attacks that creature.
Warp Terrain. After 10 minutes, an area up to 500 ft. square resembles a location desired by one Humanoid the balhannoth sensed with Sense Desires. Only nonliving material changes. The effect cannot create moving parts or magical properties. Close inspection exposes imitations, such as blank books or fake valuables. The terrain stays changed until the balhannoth dies or uses Warp Terrain again.
sections.Regional effects:
The lair can cause one or more of these effects. All end immediately when the balhannoth dies.
Sense Desires. Within 1 mile of itself, the balhannoth detects the strongest desires of Humanoids and learns whether those desires involve a place, such as a safe place to rest, a temple, or a home.
Supernatural Lure. Creatures within 1 mile of the lair feel close to what they want most. The feeling strengthens as they approach the lair.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 55.

name: Banderhobb
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A shadow-walking kidnapper that can track a creature or object from a fragment of it.

sections.Languages: Understands Common and the languages of its creator but can't speak.
sections.Traits: Resonant Connection. While carrying a piece of a creature or object, such as a hair or splinter, the banderhobb knows the most direct route to its source if it is within 1 mile.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tongue attack. Shadow Step can replace one of those attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage and grapples a Large or smaller creature (escape DC 16). That creature is restrained until the grapple ends. While it remains grappled, the banderhobb cannot Bite or use Tongue against another target.
Tongue. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. A hit deals 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. On a failed DC 16 Strength save, the target is pulled into a space within 5 ft. of the banderhobb.
Shadow Step. Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space in dim light or darkness.
Swallow. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature the banderhobb has grappled. A hit deals 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage, swallows the creature, and ends the grapple. The creature is blinded and restrained while swallowed, with total cover against attacks and effects from outside the banderhobb. It takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of the banderhobb's turns. If this damage drops it to 0 hit points, the damage stops and the creature becomes stable.
Only one creature can be swallowed at a time. The banderhobb can regurgitate it at any time while not incapacitated, without spending an action. It also regurgitates the creature when it dies. The creature lands prone in a space within 5 ft. of the banderhobb.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. In dim light or darkness, take the Hide action.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 56.

name: Baphomet
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A demon lord who hunts through a labyrinth with a massive blade called Heartcleaver.

sections.Damage immunities: Poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing that is nonmagical.
sections.Traits:
Labyrinthine Recall. Baphomet remembers every path he has taken and is immune to the Maze spell.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Baphomet fails a saving throw, he can spend one use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Baphomet has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite, one Gore, and one Heartcleaver attack. Use Frightful Presence as part of the same action.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (2d8 + 10) piercing damage.
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d6 + 10) piercing damage. Add 16 (3d10) piercing damage if Baphomet moved at least 10 ft. directly toward the target immediately before the hit. A creature hit by Gore makes a DC 25 Strength save, falling prone and being pushed up to 10 ft. away on a failure.
Heartcleaver. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (2d10 + 10) force damage.
Frightful Presence. Choose any number of creatures within 120 ft. that are aware of Baphomet. Each makes a DC 18 Wisdom save or becomes frightened for 1 minute. A frightened creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if it has line of sight to Baphomet. A success ends the effect. A creature that succeeds on any save or whose fear ends becomes immune to this Frightful Presence for 24 hours.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 18). Material components are waived.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Dominate Beast, Maze, Wall of Stone.
1/day. Teleport.
sections.Legendary actions:
Baphomet has 3 legendary actions. Immediately after another creature's turn, spend the stated cost to use one option. He regains spent uses at the start of his turn and cannot spend them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, he cannot spend any until his first turn ends.
Heartcleaver Attack (1 action). Make one Heartcleaver attack.
Charge (2 actions). Move up to Baphomet's speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then make one Gore attack.
sections.Lair actions:
At initiative count 20, losing ties, Baphomet can take one of these actions. He cannot choose the same option in consecutive rounds. Using an option requires being in the lair and able to act. If surprised, the creature must finish its first turn before using one.
Illusory Room. Cast Mirage Arcane in one room of the lair that measures no more than 100 ft. along any dimension. Use Charisma. The illusion ends at the next initiative count 20.
Reverse Gravity. Reverse gravity in one room of the lair that measures no more than 100 ft. along any dimension, until the next initiative count 20. Creatures and objects in the room fall in the new direction unless they can stay aloft. Baphomet can ignore the reversal.
Seal the Way. Fill an unoccupied doorway or other opening in the lair with solid stone. The stone lasts 1 minute or until Baphomet uses this option again.
sections.Regional effects:
Choose one or more effects for the area around the lair.
Beguiling Realm. Within 6 miles, Charisma (Persuasion) and Charisma (Performance) checks have disadvantage. Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Intimidation) checks have advantage.
Hedge Mazes. Vegetation within 1 mile forms dense barriers around small mazes.
Panicked Beasts. Beasts within 1 mile are frightened and disoriented. They may panic or lash out even without a visible threat.
The effects fade over 1d10 days after Baphomet dies.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 58.

name: Bard
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A performer who fights with sword or bow and uses magic to scatter enemies.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Shortsword or Shortbow. Spellcasting can replace one of those attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Cacophony (Recharge 4–6). Every creature in a 15-ft. cube originating from the bard makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 9 (2d8) thunder damage and is pushed up to 10 ft. away from the bard. On a success, it takes half the damage and stays in place.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 12).
At will. Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation.
1/day each. Charm Person, Invisibility, Sleep.
sections.Bonus actions: Taunt (2/day). Choose one creature within 30 ft. If it can hear the bard, it makes a DC 12 Charisma save. On a failure, it has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the start of the bard's next turn.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 59.

name: Barghest
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A soul-eating fiend that can pass as a goblin.

sections.Languages: Abyssal, Common, Goblin, Infernal, telepathy 60 ft.
sections.Damage resistances: Cold, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Fire Banishment. If the barghest starts its turn engulfed in flames at least 10 ft. high or wide, it makes a DC 15 Charisma save. Failure instantly returns it to Gehenna.
Soul Feeding. The barghest can spend at least 1 minute eating the corpse of a Fey or Humanoid it killed within the past 10 minutes. This destroys the corpse and traps the soul inside the barghest for 24 hours. Magic that tries to restore the victim to life while the soul is trapped has a 50 percent chance to fail and is wasted on a failure. If the barghest dies before the 24 hours end, the soul escapes. Otherwise, the barghest digests the soul and the victim cannot be revived.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claw attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 12). Material components are waived.
At will. Levitate, Minor Illusion, Pass without Trace.
1/day each. Charm Person, Dimension Door, Suggestion.
sections.Bonus actions: Change Shape. Become a Small goblin or return to true form. Only size and speed change. Worn and carried equipment keeps its form. The barghest returns to its true form if it dies.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 60.

name: Berbalang
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A winged creature that questions the dead and sends a psychic double into danger.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claw attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage and 4 (1d8) psychic damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence. Material components are waived.
At will. Speak with Dead.
1/day. Plane Shift, self only.
sections.Bonus actions: Spectral Duplicate (Recharges after a short or long rest). Create one duplicate in a visible, unoccupied space within 60 ft. The berbalang remains unconscious while the duplicate exists, and it can have only one at a time. The duplicate disappears if either one drops to 0 hit points or if the berbalang dismisses it, which takes no action. The duplicate shares the berbalang's statistics and knowledge. The berbalang knows what the duplicate experiences. All damage from the duplicate's attacks is psychic.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 61.

name: Bheur Hag
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A winter hag who rides a flying staff and can turn a grisly feast into a weapon.

sections.Traits:
Control Weather (1/day). Cast Control Weather using Charisma and without material components.
Graystaff Magic. The hag can use her flying speed only while riding her magical graystaff. Only a bheur hag can use the staff. If it is lost or destroyed, she must make another, which takes a year and a day.
Ice Walk. The hag can move and climb across ice without an ability check. Difficult terrain caused by ice or snow costs her no extra movement.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Slam or Frost Shard.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage and 18 (4d8) cold damage.
Frost Shard. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 30 (6d8 + 3) cold damage and reduces the target's speed by 10 ft. until the start of the hag's next turn.
Horrific Feast. Feed on the corpse of an enemy within reach that died within the last minute. Choose any creatures within 60 ft. that can see the hag feeding. Each makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or becomes frightened of the hag for 1 minute. While frightened this way, the creature is incapacitated, cannot read or understand others' speech, and can speak only gibberish. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If it succeeds on a save or the effect ends, it is immune to this hag's Horrific Feast for 24 hours.
sections.Spellcasting:
While holding or riding the graystaff, cast one listed spell as an action using Charisma (spell save DC 14). Material components are waived.
At will. Hold Person.
1/day each. Cone of Cold, Ice Storm, Wall of Ice.
sections.Coven challenge: CR 9 (5,000 XP) when part of a coven.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 62.

name: Black Abishai
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A shadow-hunting devil that fights inside a pool of darkness it can reposition.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. The abishai's darkvision works in magical darkness.
Magic Resistance. The abishai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Scimitar attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage and 9 (2d8) acid damage.
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) force damage.
Creeping Darkness (Recharge 6). Cast Darkness at a point within 120 ft. using Wisdom. The spell requires neither components nor concentration. While it lasts, the abishai can move the area of darkness up to 60 ft. as a bonus action.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. In dim light or darkness, take the Hide action.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 38.

name: Blackguard
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A paladin who terrifies nearby enemies and blinds or knocks down foes with a smite.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Glaive and Shortbow.
Glaive. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Dreadful Aspect (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). Each enemy within 30 ft. makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is frightened of the blackguard for 1 minute. If it ends its turn more than 30 ft. from the blackguard, it can repeat the save, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Charisma (spell save DC 13).
2/day each. Command, Dispel Magic, Find Steed.
sections.Bonus actions:
Smite. Immediately after the blackguard hits a target with an attack roll, it can force that target to make a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failed save, choose Blind or Shove.
Blind. The target is blinded for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Shove. Push the target up to 10 ft. away from the blackguard and knock it prone.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 63.

name: Blue Abishai
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
classification: Medium fiend (devil, wizard), typically lawful evil
description: A winged devil that combines spellcasting with ranged lightning.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. Magical darkness does not block the abishai's darkvision.
Magic Resistance. The abishai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Bite or Lightning Strike attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) lightning damage.
Lightning Strike. Ranged spell attack, +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 36 (8d8) lightning damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Intelligence (spell save DC 20).
At will. Disguise Self, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion.
2/day each. Charm Person, Dispel Magic, Greater Invisibility, Wall of Force.
sections.Bonus actions: Teleport. The abishai teleports up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see and brings anything it wears or carries.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 39.

name: Bodak
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An undead creature whose gaze can drop a victim to 0 hit points.

sections.Languages: Abyssal, the languages it knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Death Gaze. When a creature starts its turn within 30 ft. and can see the bodak's eyes, the bodak can force it to make a DC 13 Constitution save if the bodak can see it and is not incapacitated. A creature that fails by 5 or more drops to 0 hit points unless it is immune to being frightened. Any other failed save deals 16 (3d10) psychic damage. Unless surprised, the creature can avert its eyes at the start of its turn to avoid the save. This gives it disadvantage on attack rolls against the bodak until the start of its next turn. Looking at the bodak before then triggers the save immediately.
Sunlight Hypersensitivity. The bodak takes 5 radiant damage if it begins its turn in sunlight. In sunlight it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
Unusual Nature. The bodak needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.
Withering Gaze. One creature the bodak can see within 60 ft. makes a DC 13 Constitution save. It takes 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Bonus actions: Aura of Annihilation. Turn the aura on or off. While it is active, each creature other than an undead or fiend takes 5 necrotic damage if it ends its turn within 30 ft. of the bodak.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 64.

name: Boggle
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A small fey that slicks the ground with oil and reaches through brief dimensional rifts.

sections.Actions:
Pummel. Melee weapon attack, +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage.
Oil Puddle. Cover the ground in the boggle's space with an inch of nonflammable oil for 1 hour. The oil is difficult terrain for creatures other than boggles. Choose Slippery Oil or Sticky Oil when creating it.
Slippery Oil. A creature other than a boggle must make a DC 11 Dexterity save on entering the puddle or starting its turn there. On a failure, it falls prone.
Sticky Oil. A creature other than a boggle must make a DC 11 Strength save on entering the puddle or starting its turn there. On a failure, it is restrained. On its turn, the creature can spend an action to attempt a DC 11 Strength check. If it succeeds, the restraint ends and it moves to the nearest unoccupied space it chooses.
sections.Bonus actions:
Boggle Oil. The boggle secretes nonflammable oil and chooses one of the following effects. It lasts until the boggle uses this bonus action again.
Slippery Oil. The boggle has advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks to escape bonds or end grapples. It can pass through a Tiny creature's opening without squeezing.
Sticky Oil. The boggle has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to grapple and on ability checks to hold on to a creature, surface, or object. It can climb difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
Dimensional Rift. Create a stationary, invisible rift in an opening or frame the boggle can see within 5 ft. No side of the opening can exceed 10 ft. The rift reaches a destination within 30 ft. of the opening, either one the boggle can see or one it specifies by direction and distance. While beside the rift, the boggle can see through it and counts as being beside the destination. Anything it pushes through, including part of its body, emerges there. Only the boggle can use the rift, which closes at the end of its next turn.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 65.

name: Boneclaw
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An undead servant that snatches foes from 15 feet away and drags them through shadows.

sections.Languages: Common plus one language spoken by its master.
sections.Traits:
Rejuvenation. If its master lives, a destroyed boneclaw returns in 1d10 hours with all its hit points. Its new body appears within 1 mile of its master.
Unusual Nature. The boneclaw needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Piercing Claw attacks.
Piercing Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (3d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, the boneclaw can pull it up to 10 ft. closer, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). The boneclaw has two claws. Each can attack only the creature it is grappling until that grapple ends.
Shadow Jump (Recharge 5–6). If the boneclaw is in dim light or darkness, it chooses creatures within 15 ft. Each makes a DC 14 Constitution save, taking 34 (5d12 + 2) necrotic damage on a failure. The boneclaw then teleports up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. It can take one creature it is grappling and place it in an unoccupied space it can see within 5 ft. of its destination. Both destinations must be in dim light or darkness.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. In dim light or darkness, take the Hide action.
sections.Reactions: Deadly Reach. When a creature enters a space within 15 ft. of the boneclaw, make one Piercing Claw attack against it.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 66.

name: Bulezau
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A leaping demon with a rotting aura and a diseased tail barb.

sections.Traits:
Rotting Presence. A creature other than a demon that starts its turn within 30 ft. of the bulezau must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution save or take 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.
Standing Leap. The bulezau can long jump up to 20 ft. or high jump up to 10 ft. without needing a running start.
Sure-Footed. The bulezau has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saves against effects that would knock it prone.
sections.Actions: Barbed Tail. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d12 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage. A creature hit makes a DC 13 Constitution save against disease. On a failure, it is poisoned until the disease ends, develops boils, coughs up flies, and sheds rotting skin. Every 24 hours it repeats the save. A success ends the disease. A failure reduces its hit point maximum by 4 (1d8). The creature dies if its maximum reaches 0.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 67.

name: Cadaver Collector
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A corpse-gathering construct that exhales paralyzing gas and calls up the spirits of its victims.

sections.Languages: Understands all languages but can't speak.
sections.Damage immunities: Necrotic, poison, psychic. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not adamantine.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The collector has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Unusual Nature. The collector needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.
Paralyzing Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failure, it is paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the effect on a success.
sections.Bonus actions: Summon Specters (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). Summon 1d4 specters without Sunlight Sensitivity in unoccupied spaces within 15 ft. of the collector. They share its initiative and act immediately after it. They fight until destroyed and vanish if the collector is destroyed.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 68.

name: Canoloth
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A yugoloth that guards against teleportation and drags prey into claw range with its tongue.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Dimensional Lock. A creature other than the canoloth that attempts to teleport into or out of a space within 60 ft. of it wastes the attempt.
Magic Resistance. The canoloth has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Uncanny Senses. The canoloth can be surprised only while incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite or Tongue attack and one Claw attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) force damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.
Tongue. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d12 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, the canoloth grapples it (escape DC 15) and pulls it up to 30 ft. closer. The target is restrained until the grapple ends. The tongue can hold one target at a time.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 69.

name: Catoblepas
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A swamp monstrosity with a stunning tail and a gaze that can kill outright.

sections.Traits: Stench. A creature other than a catoblepas that starts its turn within 10 ft. of the catoblepas makes a DC 16 Constitution save. On a failure, it is poisoned until its next turn starts. On a success, it is immune to every catoblepas's Stench for 1 hour.
sections.Actions:
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. On a hit, the target takes 21 (5d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and makes a DC 16 Constitution save. On a failure, it is stunned until the start of the catoblepas's next turn.
Death Ray (Recharge 5–6). Choose one creature the catoblepas can see within 30 ft. It makes a DC 16 Constitution save, taking 36 (8d8) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. If it fails by 5 or more, it takes 64 necrotic damage instead. A target reduced to 0 hit points by the ray dies.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 70.

name: Cave Fisher
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A cave predator that lowers a sticky filament from walls or ceilings and reels in trapped prey.

sections.Traits:
Flammable Blood. When the cave fisher drops to half its hit points or below, it gains vulnerability to fire damage.
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces and move upside down on ceilings without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Retract Filament. Choose one Large or smaller creature grappled by Adhesive Filament. It makes a DC 13 Strength save. On a failure, the cave fisher pulls it into an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of itself and makes one Claw attack against it. Retraction releases everyone else attached to the filament. The cave fisher cannot use Adhesive Filament until that target's grapple ends.
sections.Bonus actions: Adhesive Filament. Extend a sticky filament up to 60 ft. It adheres to anything that touches it. A creature caught by the filament is grappled (escape DC 13), with disadvantage on ability checks to escape. The filament has AC 15, 5 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. A weapon that attacks the filament and fails to sever it sticks. Freeing that weapon requires an action and a successful DC 13 Strength check. Destroying the filament leaves the cave fisher unharmed. Using Adhesive Filament again makes the old filament crumble.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 73.

name: Champion
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A veteran combatant in plate armor who hits hardest while above half hit points.

sections.Traits: Indomitable (2/day). The champion can reroll a failed saving throw.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Greatsword or Shortbow attacks.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage, plus 7 (2d6) slashing damage if the champion has more than half its hit points.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, plus 7 (2d6) piercing damage if the champion has more than half its hit points.
sections.Bonus actions: Second Wind (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). The champion regains 20 hit points.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 74.

name: Chitine
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A small, spiderlike ambusher that senses creatures through its web and attacks with daggers.

sections.Traits:
Fey Ancestry. The chitine has advantage on saves against being charmed, and magic cannot put it to sleep.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on sight.
Web Sense. While touching a web, it knows the exact location of other creatures touching that same web.
Web Walker. Webbing does not restrict its movement.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Dagger attacks.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 75.

name: Choker
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A boneless ambusher that seizes prey with two long tentacles.

sections.Traits:
Aberrant Quickness (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). The choker can take an additional action on its turn.
Boneless. It can pass through and occupy a space only 4 inches wide without squeezing.
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces and move upside down on ceilings without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Tentacle attacks.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. A Large or smaller creature hit is grappled (escape DC 15) and restrained until the grapple ends. The choker has two tentacles, and each can attack another target only once its current grapple ends. A creature grappled by a critical hit also cannot breathe or speak until the grapple ends.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 76.

name: Choldrith
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A spiderlike cleric that snares foes in webs and attacks with a floating dagger.

sections.Traits:
Fey Ancestry. The choldrith has advantage on saves against being charmed, and magic cannot put it to sleep.
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces and move upside down on ceilings without an ability check.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on sight.
Web Sense. While touching a web, it knows the exact location of other creatures touching that same web.
Web Walker. Webbing does not restrict its movement.
sections.Actions:
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.
Web (Recharge 5–6). Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. On a hit, webbing restrains the target. The target can use an action to break the webbing with a successful DC 11 Strength check. The webbing can also be attacked. It has AC 10, 5 hit points, fire vulnerability, and immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells with Wisdom (spell save DC 12).
At will. Guidance, Thaumaturgy.
1/day each. Bane, Hold Person.
sections.Bonus actions: Spectral Dagger (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). Conjure a floating spectral dagger within 60 ft. The choldrith can make a melee spell attack (+4 to hit) against one creature within 5 ft. of the dagger. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) force damage. The dagger lasts 1 minute. On later turns, the choldrith can use a bonus action to move it up to 20 ft. and repeat the attack against one creature within 5 ft. of it.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 77.

name: Clockwork Bronze Scout
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A clockwork scout that burrows beneath its prey and releases lightning through the ground.

sections.Languages: Understands one language of its creator but can't speak.

sections.Traits:
Earth Armor. Burrowing doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.
Magic Resistance. The clockwork has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Unusual Nature. The clockwork needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) lightning damage.
Lightning Flare (recharges after a short or long rest). Every creature touching the ground within 15 ft. of the scout makes a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking 14 (4d6) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 79.

name: Clockwork Iron Cobra
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A mechanical serpent with a bite that can bewilder, paralyze, or poison a creature.

sections.Languages: Understands one language of its creator but can't speak.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The clockwork has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Unusual Nature. The clockwork needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. A creature hit must make a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, roll 1d6 for the effect below.
1–2, Confusion. On its next turn, the target must use its action to make one weapon attack against a random creature it can see within 30 ft. of itself. It uses the weapon it is holding and moves into attack range first if necessary. If it holds no weapon, it makes an unarmed strike. If it sees no creature within 30 ft., it takes the Dash action and moves toward the nearest creature.
3–4, Paralysis. The target is paralyzed until the end of its next turn.
5–6, Poison. The target takes 13 (3d8) poison damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 79.

name: Clockwork Oaken Bolter
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A clockwork siege engine armed with bolts and a tethered harpoon.

sections.Languages: Understands one language of its creator but can't speak.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The clockwork has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Unusual Nature. The clockwork needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Lancing Bolt attacks, or make one Lancing Bolt attack and one Harpoon attack.
Lancing Bolt. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 100/400 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.
Harpoon. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 50/200 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage and grapples the target (escape DC 12). The grapple leaves a creature's speed unchanged but limits its movement to directions that bring it closer to the bolter. A creature takes 5 (1d10) slashing damage if it escapes the grapple or fails an escape attempt. The bolter can grapple only one creature at a time with the harpoon.
Explosive Bolt (Recharge 5–6). Choose a point within 120 ft. Each creature in a 20-ft.-radius sphere centered there makes a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 17 (5d6) fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Bonus actions: Reel In. Pull the creature grappled by Harpoon up to 20 ft. closer to the bolter.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 80.

name: Clockwork Stone Defender
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A stone-plated guard that knocks enemies down and shields creatures beside it.

sections.Languages: Understands one language of its creator but can't speak.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The clockwork has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Unusual Nature. The clockwork needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions: Slam. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage and knocks a Large or smaller target prone.
sections.Reactions: Intercept Attack. When an attack roll hits another creature within 5 ft. of the defender, the defender can give that creature +5 AC against the triggering attack, potentially turning the hit into a miss. The defender must see both the creature and the attacker.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 80.

name: Cloud Giant Smiling One
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A cloud giant trickster who changes shape, controls the weather, and strikes with telekinetic force.

sections.Traits: Control Weather (8th-level spell). The giant can cast Control Weather with Charisma and needs no material components.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks or two Telekinetic Strike attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) psychic damage.
Telekinetic Strike. Ranged spell attack, +7 to hit, range 240 ft., one target. A hit deals 25 (4d10 + 3) force damage.
Change Shape. The giant magically takes on the appearance and feel of a Beast or Humanoid it has seen, or returns to its true form. The new form absorbs any equipment the giant wears or carries. Its size can change, and it keeps its other statistics. Death returns the giant to its true form.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 15). These spells require no material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Fog Cloud, Light, Minor Illusion.
3/day each. Invisibility, Silent Image, Suggestion, Tongues.
1/day each. Gaseous Form, Major Image.
sections.Bonus actions: Cloud Step (Recharge 4–6). Teleport up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space the giant can see, taking all worn and carried equipment.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 81.

name: Conjurer Wizard
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A wizard who swaps places with willing allies and summons an elemental to fight alongside them.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Arcane Burst attacks.
Arcane Burst. Melee or ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d10 + 3) force damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 14).
At will. Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation.
2/day each. Fireball, Mage Armor, Unseen Servant.
1/day each. Fly, Stinking Cloud, Web.
sections.Bonus actions:
Benign Transportation (Recharge 4–6). Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space, taking all worn and carried equipment. The conjurer can instead choose a space within range occupied by a willing Small or Medium creature. They both teleport and swap places.
Summon Elemental (1/day). Magically summon an Air Elemental, Earth Elemental, Fire Elemental, or Water Elemental in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. of the conjurer. The elemental obeys the conjurer and takes its turn immediately after theirs. It lasts up to 1 hour and disappears sooner if it dies, the conjurer dies, or the conjurer dismisses it as a bonus action.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 260.

name: Corpse Flower
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A climbing plant that gathers humanoid corpses to feed on or raise as zombies.

sections.Traits:
Corpses. When first encountered, the flower holds 1d6 + 3 Humanoid corpses, up to its capacity of nine. These corpses have total cover against attacks and other effects coming from outside the flower. If the flower dies, the corpses can be pulled free.
Spider Climb. The flower climbs difficult surfaces, including ceilings upside down, without making an ability check.
Stench of Death. A creature that starts its turn within 10 ft. of the flower or one of its zombies makes a DC 14 Constitution save. Constructs and Undead are exempt. On a failure, the creature is poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a success, it is immune to Stench of Death from all corpse flowers for 24 hours.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Tentacle attacks.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.
Harvest the Dead. Swallow one unsecured Humanoid corpse within 10 ft. and everything it is wearing or carrying.
sections.Bonus actions:
Digest. Destroy one corpse stored in the flower and immediately regain 11 (2d10) hit points. The flower expels the corpse's equipment into its own space.
Reanimate. Raise one stored corpse as a Zombie in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the flower. The zombie acts immediately after the flower in initiative and is its ally. The flower can't control the zombie. It carries the flower's Stench of Death.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 82.

name: Cranium Rat
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A telepathic rat with an exposed brain that glows on command.

sections.Traits: Telepathic Shroud. Divination spells and effects that read the rat's thoughts or sense its emotions have no effect on it.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 1 piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Illumination. The rat can make its exposed brain shed dim light in a 5-ft. radius or turn the light off.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 83.

name: Darkling
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A fey ambusher whose body erupts in blinding light when it dies.

sections.Traits:
Death Flash. When the darkling dies, its body and belongings burn to ash, except for metal and magic objects. A flash of nonmagical light fills a 10-ft. radius. Every creature in the area must pass a DC 10 Constitution save or be blinded until the end of its next turn.
Light Sensitivity. Bright light gives the darkling disadvantage on attack rolls and sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 84.

name: Darkling Elder
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A blade-wielding elder who can conjure darkness and releases searing light at death.

sections.Traits: Death Burn. When the elder dies, its body and belongings burn to ash, except for metal and magic objects. Every creature within 10 ft. must make a DC 11 Constitution save against the flash of magical light. On a failure, it takes 7 (2d6) radiant damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn. A successful save halves the damage and prevents the blindness.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Scimitar attacks.
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.
sections.Spellcasting: Darkness (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). As an action, cast Darkness using Wisdom and without spell components.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 84.

name: Death Kiss
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A hovering beholderkin that seizes prey with long tentacles and feeds on the creatures it holds.

sections.Traits: Lightning Blood. When a creature within 5 ft. hits the death kiss with a melee attack that deals piercing or slashing damage, the attacker takes 5 (1d10) lightning damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Tentacle attacks. Substitute Blood Drain for any of those attacks, up to one substitution per tentacle grappling a creature.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. A Huge or smaller creature hit is also grappled (escape DC 14) and restrained while held. The death kiss has ten tentacles and cannot attack a different target with a tentacle that is already grappling.
Blood Drain. One creature grappled by a tentacle makes a DC 16 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 22 (4d10) lightning damage and the death kiss regains hit points equal to half the damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 85.

name: Deathlock
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An undead warlock that hurls bolts of necrotic magic.

sections.Languages: The languages it knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Turn Resistance. The deathlock has advantage on saving throws against effects that turn Undead.
Unusual Nature. The deathlock can go without air, food, drink, and sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks. Choose Deathly Claw or Grave Bolt for each.
Deathly Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) necrotic damage.
Grave Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d10 + 3) necrotic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Charisma (spell save DC 13).
At will. Detect Magic, Disguise Self, Mage Armor, Mage Hand.
1/day each. Dispel Magic, Hunger of Hadar, Invisibility, Spider Climb.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 86.

name: Deathlock Mastermind
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An undead warlock that sees through magical darkness and pins enemies with shadowy tendrils.

sections.Languages: The languages it knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. The deathlock sees through magical darkness within its darkvision range.
Turn Resistance. The deathlock has advantage on saving throws against effects that turn Undead.
Unusual Nature. The deathlock can go without air, food, drink, and sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks. Choose Deathly Claw or Grave Bolt for each.
Deathly Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (3d6 + 3) necrotic damage.
Grave Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (3d8) necrotic damage. A Large or smaller target hit must pass a DC 16 Strength save or be restrained by shadowy tendrils for 1 minute. While restrained this way, the target can spend its action to repeat the save, freeing itself on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Charisma (spell save DC 14).
At will. Detect Magic, Disguise Self, Mage Armor, Minor Illusion.
1/day each. Darkness, Dimension Door, Dispel Magic, Fly, Invisibility.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 87.

name: Deathlock Wight
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An undead warlock whose life-draining touch can raise slain Humanoids as zombies.

sections.Languages: The languages it knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight the deathlock has disadvantage on attack rolls and sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks.
Unusual Nature. The deathlock can go without air, food, drink, and sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks. Choose Life Drain or Grave Bolt for each.
Life Drain. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) necrotic damage. The target must pass a DC 13 Constitution save or lose maximum hit points equal to the damage taken. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum reaches 0. A Humanoid slain by Life Drain rises as a zombie under the deathlock's control after 24 hours unless it is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The deathlock can control up to twelve zombies at a time.
Grave Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) necrotic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Charisma (spell save DC 13).
At will. Detect Magic, Disguise Self, Mage Armor.
1/day each. Fear, Hold Person.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 87.

name: Deep Scion
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
speed: 30 ft. in true form. In hybrid form, walk 20 ft. and swim 40 ft.
description: An undersea power transforms someone facing drowning into a deep scion. The scion can return to shore in a humanlike form and spy for its new master.

sections.Traits: Amphibious (hybrid form only). The scion can breathe air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Battleaxe attacks. In hybrid form, the scion can instead make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Battleaxe. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage with one hand or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage with two hands.
Bite (hybrid form only). Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.
Claw (hybrid form only). Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.
Psychic Screech (hybrid form only, recharges after a short or long rest). The scream is audible within 300 ft. Each creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or becomes stunned until the end of the scion's next turn. If the scion and its master are in the same body of water, the scream also sends the master the scion's past 24 hours of memories telepathically at any distance.
sections.Bonus actions: Change Shape. Shift between a humanlike true form and a humanoid-fish hybrid. Speed changes according to form. Equipment keeps its form, and the scion returns to its true form on death.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 88.

name: Demogorgon
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Demogorgon's two heads, Aameul and Hathradiah, scheme from Abysm in the Gaping Maw. The palace has twin towers above water and caverns below.

sections.Damage immunities: Poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Demogorgon fails a save, he can spend one use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Demogorgon has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Two Heads. Demogorgon has advantage on saves against being blinded, deafened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Tentacle attacks. Demogorgon can replace one attack with Gaze.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 28 (3d12 + 9) force damage. A creature hit must make a DC 23 Constitution save. On a failure, reduce its hit point maximum by the damage it took until it finishes a long rest. The creature dies if its maximum reaches 0.
Gaze. Choose one creature Demogorgon can see within 120 ft. Demogorgon's magical gaze forces a DC 23 Wisdom save. On a failure, choose one result or roll 1d6.
1–2, Beguiling Gaze. The target is stunned until the start of Demogorgon's next turn or until he leaves its line of sight.
3–4, Confusing Gaze. The target is affected by Confusion until the start of Demogorgon's next turn. It makes no saving throw against the spell, and Demogorgon doesn't concentrate on it.
5–6, Hypnotic Gaze. The target is charmed by Demogorgon until the start of his next turn. He chooses how it uses its action, reaction, and movement.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 23). No material components are required.
At will. Detect Magic, Major Image.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Fear, Telekinesis.
1/day each. Feeblemind, Project Image.
sections.Legendary actions:
Demogorgon has 2 legendary actions. Immediately after another creature's turn, spend the stated cost to use one option. He regains spent uses at the start of his turn. He cannot spend any while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, he must finish his first turn before using one.
Gaze (1 action). Use Gaze and choose Beguiling Gaze or Confusing Gaze.
Tail (1 action). Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (2d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.
Cast a Spell (2 actions). Use Spellcasting.
sections.Lair actions:
In his lair, Demogorgon can use one option on initiative count 20, losing ties. He cannot select the same option on consecutive rounds. He must be able to act. If surprised, he must finish his first turn before using one.
Darkness. Cast Darkness four times in different areas, with no concentration needed. Each ends on initiative count 20 of the next round.
Illusory Duplicate. A double appears in Demogorgon's space and lasts until initiative count 20 of the next round. On his turn, Demogorgon can move it a distance equal to his walking speed without spending an action. On the first physical interaction with Demogorgon by a creature or object, roll a 50 percent chance that the double takes the effect instead. If it does, it disappears.
sections.Regional effects:
Choose one or more effects for the area around Abysm.
Beguiling Realm. Within 6 miles, Charisma (Persuasion) and Charisma (Performance) checks have disadvantage. Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Intimidation) checks have advantage.
Frenzied Animals. Beasts within 1 mile become violent, including usually docile animals. Checks involving Animal Handling in that area have disadvantage.
Venomous Beasts. Poisonous snakes and other venomous Beasts proliferate within 6 miles.
These effects fade over 1d10 days after Demogorgon dies.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 90.

name: Derro
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Derro are dwarf-kin of the Underdark. One account traces their origin to mind flayer experiments on an isolated dwarf community.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The derro has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the derro has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
sections.Actions:
Hooked Spear. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 3 (1d6) piercing damage. Against a Medium or smaller target, the derro can knock it prone instead of dealing damage.
Light Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 91.

name: Derro Savant
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A derro with sorcerous talent often leads others as a savant.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The savant has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the derro has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
sections.Actions:
Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage.
Chromatic Beam. The savant sends magical energy down a line 60 ft. long and 5 ft. wide. Each creature in the line makes a DC 12 Dexterity save, taking 21 (6d6) radiant damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 12).
At will. Mage Hand, Message, Prestidigitation.
1/day each. Invisibility, Sleep, Spider Climb.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 92.

name: Devourer
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Orcus sends devourers to trap souls and raise undead servants. Their hollow ribcages hold the dying.

sections.Traits: Unusual Nature. The devourer needs no air, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks. The devourer can also use one available option, Imprison Soul or Soul Rend.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage.
Imprison Soul. Choose a living Humanoid the devourer can see within 30 ft. that has 0 hit points. The target teleports into the devourer's ribcage and stays imprisoned there. It is restrained and has disadvantage on death saving throws while imprisoned. If it dies there, the devourer regains 25 hit points and immediately recharges Soul Rend. At the start of its next turn, the devourer uses a bonus action to spit out the dead victim as an Undead. A victim with up to 2 Hit Dice becomes a Zombie. A victim with 3–5 Hit Dice becomes a Ghoul. A victim with 6 or more Hit Dice becomes a Wight. Only one creature can be imprisoned at a time.
Soul Rend (recharge 6). Each creature in a 20-ft. radius centered on the devourer makes a DC 18 Constitution save, taking 44 (8d10) necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 93.

name: Dhergoloth
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: This yugoloth has five sets of claws. It takes mercenary work that calls for force and simple orders.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The dhergoloth has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) force damage.
Flailing Claws (recharge 5–6). Move up to the dhergoloth's speed in a straight line. Each creature within 5 ft. of it at any point in that move makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. Failure deals 22 (3d12 + 3) force damage.
Teleport. The dhergoloth and its worn or carried equipment teleport up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 10). No material components are required.
At will. Darkness, Fear.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 94.

name: Dire Troll
