sections.Bonus actions: Astral Step (recharge 4–6). Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space, taking along anything the githyanki is wearing or carrying.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 140.

name: Githyanki Kith’rak
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A githyanki officer who rallies nearby troops and fights with a psionically charged greatsword.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Greatsword attacks.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 17 (5d6) psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell with no components, using Intelligence (spell save DC 15).
At will. Mage Hand (invisible hand).
3/day each. Blur, Nondetection (self only).
1/day each. Plane Shift, Telekinesis.
sections.Bonus actions:
Astral Step (recharge 4–6). Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space, taking along anything the githyanki is wearing or carrying.
Rally the Troops. Magically end the charmed and frightened conditions on the githyanki and any creatures of its choice that it can see within 30 ft.
sections.Reactions: Parry. When a melee attack would hit, add 4 to the githyanki’s AC for that attack. It must see the attacker and have a melee weapon in hand.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 140.

name: Githyanki Supreme Commander
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A githyanki commander who leads troops from the front and wields a silver greatsword that can sever an astral traveler’s tether.

sections.Traits: Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the gith fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Silver Greatsword attacks.
Silver Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage plus 17 (5d6) psychic damage. On a critical hit against a target in an astral body, such as one using Astral Projection, the commander can sever the silvery cord connecting the target to its material body instead of dealing damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell with no components, using Intelligence (spell save DC 16).
At will. Mage Hand (invisible hand).
3/day each. Levitate (self only), Nondetection (self only).
1/day each. Bigby’s Hand, Mass Suggestion, Plane Shift, Telekinesis.
sections.Bonus actions: Astral Step. Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space, taking along anything the githyanki is wearing or carrying.
sections.Reactions: Parry. When a melee attack would hit, add 5 to the githyanki’s AC for that attack. It must see the attacker and have a melee weapon in hand.
sections.Legendary actions:
Spend the stated cost at the end of another creature’s turn to use one option. All 3 legendary actions refresh at the start of the gith’s turn. The gith can use none while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it cannot use any until its first turn ends.
Command Ally (1 action). Choose an ally the commander can see within 30 ft. If the ally can see or hear the commander, it may spend its reaction to make one melee weapon attack with advantage.
Attack (2 actions). Make one Silver Greatsword attack.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 141.

name: Githzerai Anarch
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A githzerai master whose discipline can shape Limbo and turn gravity in any direction.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the gith fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
Psychic Defense. When the githzerai wears no armor and wields no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Unarmed Strike attacks.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell with no components, using Wisdom (spell save DC 18).
At will. Mage Hand (invisible hand).
3/day each. See Invisibility, Telekinesis.
1/day each. Globe of Invulnerability, Plane Shift, Wall of Force.
sections.Legendary actions:
Spend the stated cost at the end of another creature’s turn to use one option. All 3 legendary actions refresh at the start of the gith’s turn. The gith can use none while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it cannot use any until its first turn ends.
Strike (1 action). Make one Unarmed Strike attack.
Teleport (1 action). Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space, bringing anything the anarch is wearing or carrying.
Change Gravity (3 actions). Cast Reverse Gravity using Wisdom. The spell otherwise works normally, but the anarch can aim its area in any direction and creatures and objects fall toward that end.
sections.Lair actions:
Use one option on initiative count 20, losing ties, while in the lair and able to act. The same option cannot be used in consecutive rounds. If surprised, the anarch must finish its first turn before using one.
Create Object. Cast Creation at 9th level using the unformed substance of Limbo in place of shadow material. In Limbo the object persists regardless of its composition until the anarch loses concentration. Its concentration also ends if it moves more than 120 ft. from the object.
Move Object. Choose a visible object within 150 ft. and make a Wisdom check with advantage to move it magically. The DC is 5 for Tiny, 10 for Small, 15 for Medium, 20 for Large, or 25 for Huge or larger.
Psionic Bolt. Cast Lightning Bolt at 5th level, with the option to change its damage from lightning to cold, fire, psychic, radiant, or thunder. Only fire and lightning can ignite flammable objects.
sections.Regional effects:
The anarch’s presence can cause one or both effects.
Form Substance. In Limbo, spend 10 minutes stabilizing the unformed substance in a 5-mile area centered on the anarch. The anarch gives it any inanimate shapes and material composition it chooses.
Stabilize Object. An object created in Limbo and brought to the Material Plane remains stable while within 1 mile of the anarch, with no action required.
After the anarch dies, the effects end in 1d6 rounds. Formed substances break down into unstable energy and matter and dissipate 1d6 rounds later.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 142.

name: Githzerai Enlightened
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A githzerai martial adept who can send a target one round forward in time.

sections.Traits: Psychic Defense. When the githzerai wears no armor and wields no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Unarmed Strike attacks.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage.
Temporal Strike (recharge 6). Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 52 (8d12) psychic damage. The target makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure, it moves one round forward in time. It vanishes for that round and then reappears in the space it left. If that space is occupied, it reappears in the nearest unoccupied space.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell with no components, using Wisdom (spell save DC 16).
At will. Mage Hand (invisible hand).
3/day. See Invisibility.
1/day each. Plane Shift, Teleport.
sections.Reactions: Slow Fall. When it falls, the githzerai can reduce the falling damage it takes by 50.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 143.

name: Gnoll Flesh Gnawer
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A quick gnoll that rushes through melee and follows a finishing blow with a bite.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Shortsword attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Sudden Rush. Until this turn ends, the gnoll gains 60 ft. of speed and provokes no opportunity attacks.
sections.Bonus actions: Rampage. On its own turn, after dropping a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack, the gnoll moves up to half its speed and makes a Bite attack.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 144.

name: Gnoll Hunter
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A gnoll skirmisher whose arrows slow their targets.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Bite, Spear, and Longbow.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage when making a melee attack with both hands.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage and reduces the target’s speed by 10 ft. until the end of its next turn.
sections.Bonus actions: Rampage. On its own turn, after dropping a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack, the gnoll moves up to half its speed and makes a Bite attack.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 144.

name: Gnoll Witherling
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: When a gnoll war band turns on itself, its survivors may raise the bones of their slain in the name of Yeenoghu. These witherlings kill alongside the war band and have no appetite of their own.

sections.Traits: Unusual Nature. The witherling needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Bite and Spiked Club.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) necrotic damage.
Spiked Club. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Rampage. If the witherling reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, it can move up to half its speed and make one Bite attack.
sections.Reactions: Vengeful Strike. When a gnoll within 30 ft. of the witherling drops to 0 hit points, make one Bite or Spiked Club attack.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 145.

name: Gray Render
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A gray render may offer to bond with an intelligent creature by warbling, scratching the earth, and bowing. Once bonded, it protects that creature fiercely, even when its behavior causes trouble outside combat.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d12 + 4) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength save or fall prone.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is prone, add 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Reactions: Bloody Rampage. When the render takes damage, it makes one Claw attack against a random creature it can reach. Exclude the render's master.
sections.Gray Render Quirks:
Choose a quirk or roll 1d12.
1. Detests riding animals.
2. Roars if another creature touches its master.
3. Wants to cuddle.
4. Pulls up trees to chew them.
5. Produces gas strong enough to make eyes water.
6. Offers meat to its master.
7. Digs wherever it goes.
8. Treats wagons and carts as enemies.
9. Howls in the rain.
10. Whimpers in darkness.
11. Buries any treasure it finds.
12. Leaps after birds even if it wrecks whatever is nearby.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 146.

name: Graz’zt
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Graz’zt rules from the Argent Palace in Zelatar, in the Abyssal realm of Azzatar. His chosen forms share six digits on each hand and foot. He carries Angdrelve, the acid-dripping greatsword also called Wave of Sorrow.

sections.Damage immunities: Poison. Nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Graz’zt fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Graz’zt has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Wave of Sorrow attacks. Graz’zt can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.
Wave of Sorrow (Greatsword). Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (4d6 + 6) force damage plus 14 (4d6) acid damage.
Teleport. Graz’zt and any equipment he wears or carries teleport up to 120 ft. to an unoccupied space he can see.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 23) without material components.
At will. Charm Person, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic.
3/day each. Darkness, Dominate Person, Telekinesis, Teleport.
1/day each. Dominate Monster, Greater Invisibility.
sections.Bonus actions: Change Shape. Take a form resembling a Medium humanoid or return to his true form. His size changes with the form. His other statistics and his worn or carried equipment stay the same.
sections.Reactions: Negate Spell (Recharge 5–6). When Graz’zt sees a creature within 60 ft. casting a spell, he can try to interrupt it. A spell of 3rd level or lower fails automatically. For a spell of 4th level or higher, make a Charisma check against DC 10 + the spell’s level. On a successful check, the spell fails and has no effect.
sections.Legendary actions:
Graz’zt has 3 legendary actions. Spend one at the end of another creature’s turn to use an option. He regains all spent actions at the start of his turn. He must be able to act and, if surprised, must finish his first turn before using an option.
Abyssal Magic. Use Spellcasting or the Teleport action.
Attack. Make one Wave of Sorrow attack.
Dance, My Puppet! Choose one creature Graz’zt can see that he has charmed. It must use its reaction to move up to its speed as he directs.
sections.Lair actions:
On initiative count 20, after anyone tied at that count, choose one option while Graz’zt is in his lair and able to act. He cannot repeat an option in consecutive rounds. If surprised, he must finish his first turn before taking a lair action.
Command. Cast Command on any creatures in the lair he chooses and knows are present. He can target creatures he cannot see and gives each target the same order.
Conjure Mirrors. Smooth surfaces in the lair become mirrorlike. Until he uses a different lair action, creatures in the lair have disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide.
sections.Regional effects:
Choose one or more effects for the area surrounding the lair. The effects fade over 1d10 days after Graz’zt dies.
Agitated Beasts. Wild beasts within 6 miles frequently fight and mate as if it were breeding season.
Beguiling Realm. Within 6 miles, Wisdom (Insight) checks have disadvantage. Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Persuasion) checks have advantage.
Mirrors Everywhere. Within 1 mile, flat stone and metal surfaces become supernaturally reflective.
sections.Cult: See Cult of Graz’zt for his followers’ encounter rules.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 148.

name: Green Abishai
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Green abishais use diplomacy and magic to extract secrets and manipulate wary opponents.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil’s Sight. Magical darkness does not hinder the abishai’s darkvision.
Magic Resistance. The abishai has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Fiendish Claw attacks, or make one Fiendish Claw attack and use Spellcasting.
Fiendish Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) force damage. A creature hit must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution save or take 16 (3d10) poison damage and be poisoned for 1 minute. The poisoned creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 17) without material components.
At will. Alter Self, Major Image.
3/day each. Charm Person, Detect Thoughts, Fear.
1/day each. Confusion, Dominate Person, Mass Suggestion.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 40.

name: Grung
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: This grung represents a typical hunter or warrior. Grungs can also serve as mercenaries, game wardens, guards, or bandits.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The grung can breathe both air and water.
Poisonous Skin. A creature that grapples the grung or touches its bare skin must make a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, the creature is poisoned for 1 minute. Once out of contact, it can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the condition on a success.
Standing Leap. The grung can jump up to 25 ft. horizontally or 15 ft. vertically, with or without a running start.
Water Dependency. At the end of any day when the grung has spent less than 1 hour immersed in water, it gains one level of exhaustion. It can recover from that exhaustion only through magic or at least 1 hour of immersion.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage and 5 (2d4) poison damage.
sections.Optional Grung poison mechanics:
If using this option, choose the grung’s color. A creature poisoned by the grung also suffers that color’s effect for as long as that poisoning lasts.
Blue. The poisoned creature must make a loud noise at the start and end of each of its turns.
Gold. The poisoned creature is charmed by the grung and can speak Grung.
Green. The poisoned creature can move only by climbing or standing jumps. While flying, it cannot take actions or reactions unless it lands.
Orange. The poisoned creature is frightened of its allies.
Purple. The poisoned creature can move or act only to soak itself in liquid or mud or to reach a place where it can do so.
Red. If food is within reach, the poisoned creature must use its action to eat.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 149.

name: Grung Elite Warrior
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An elite grung warrior leads others in battle. A grung wildling often fights alongside it.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The grung can breathe air and water.
Poisonous Skin. A creature that grapples the grung or touches its skin must make a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, the creature is poisoned for 1 minute. Once contact ends, it can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the poisoning on a success.
Standing Leap. The grung can long jump up to 25 ft. and high jump up to 15 ft. with or without a running start.
Water Dependency. If the grung spends less than 1 hour immersed in water during a day, it gains one level of exhaustion at the end of that day. Magic or at least 1 hour of immersion can remove exhaustion gained this way.
sections.Actions:
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage and 5 (2d4) poison damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage and 5 (2d4) poison damage.
Mesmerizing Chirr (Recharge 6). Each Humanoid or Beast within 15 ft. that can hear the chirr makes a DC 12 Wisdom save or is stunned until the end of the grung's next turn. Grungs are immune to the chirr.
sections.Optional Grung poison mechanics:
A creature poisoned by the grung can suffer the effect associated with its color. The effect ends when that poisoning ends.
Blue grung. The target makes a loud noise at the start and end of each of its turns.
Gold grung. The target is charmed by the grung and can speak Grung.
Green grung. The target can move only by climbing or making standing jumps. If flying, it cannot take actions or reactions until it lands.
Orange grung. The target is frightened of its allies.
Purple grung. The target can move and take actions only to reach liquid or mud or to soak itself in it.
Red grung. The target must spend its action eating whenever food is within reach.

name: Grung Wildling
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The wildling breathes air and water.
Poisonous Skin. A creature that grapples the wildling or otherwise touches its bare skin must make a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, the creature becomes poisoned for 1 minute. Once it breaks direct contact, it can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.
Standing Leap. The wildling can long jump up to 25 ft. or high jump up to 15 ft. from a standstill or with a running start.
Water Dependency. At the end of a day when the wildling has spent less than 1 hour immersed in water, it gains one level of exhaustion. It can recover from this exhaustion through magic or by immersing itself for at least 1 hour.
sections.Actions:
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Wisdom (spell save DC 12).
At will. Druidcraft.
2/day. Plant Growth.
3/day each. Cure Wounds, Spike Growth.
sections.Optional Grung poison mechanics:
Optional rule. Choose the effect that matches the wildling's color. When the wildling poisons a creature, that creature suffers the chosen effect until its poisoned condition from this wildling ends.
Blue. The creature must make a loud noise at both the start and the end of each of its turns.
Gold. The creature is charmed by the wildling and gains the ability to speak Grung.
Green. The creature can move only by climbing or making standing jumps. While flying, it can take actions or reactions only after it lands.
Orange. The creature is frightened of its allies.
Purple. The creature feels compelled to soak in liquid or mud. It can move and take actions only to soak or reach liquid or mud.
Red. If food is within reach, the creature must use its action to eat.

name: Guard Drake
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A guard drake looks like a squat, wingless version of the dragon whose scales created it. It bonds with the first creature to feed it and can learn the same commands as a guard dog.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Chromatic drake mechanics:
Choose the color of the dragon that supplied the scales. Each color adds the movement and defense listed below to the base stat block.
Black. Swim 30 ft. The drake breathes air and water and has acid resistance.
Blue. Burrow 20 ft. The drake has lightning resistance.
Green. Swim 30 ft. The drake breathes air and water and has poison resistance.
Red. Climb 30 ft. The drake has fire resistance.
White. Burrow 20 ft. and climb 30 ft. The drake has cold resistance.
sections.Creation and training: A chromatic dragon donates 10 pounds of fresh scales. The ritual also needs a large supply of fresh meat and an iron cauldron. After several days, a Small egg emerges and hatches within a few hours. A hatchling bonds to its first feeder. It reaches full size and can finish training in two to three weeks. Guard drakes cannot reproduce, and their scales cannot make another drake.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 151.

name: Hellfire Engine
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Devil commanders hold these magical siege machines in reserve against invading demons and mortals. A loose engine can rampage on its own.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold and psychic. Also bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, and unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. Spells and effects cannot change the engine's shape.
Magic Resistance. The engine has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Unusual Nature. The engine needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Flesh-Crushing Stride. Move in a straight line up to the engine's speed. The engine can enter spaces occupied by creatures of Large size or smaller. Each creature whose space it enters makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. On a success, push it to the nearest space outside the engine's path. On a failure, it falls prone and takes 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage.
If the engine stays in the prone creature's space, the creature is restrained while they share the space. The restrained creature or another creature within 5 ft. of it can make a DC 18 Strength check. On a success, the restrained creature moves to an unoccupied space it chooses within 5 ft. of the engine, ending the restraint.
Hellfire Weapons. Choose a weapon or roll a d6. On 1–2 use Bonemelt Sprayer, on 3–4 use Lightning Flail, and on 5–6 use Thunder Cannon.
Bonemelt Sprayer. Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 20 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 11 (2d10) fire damage plus 18 (4d8) acid damage. On a success, halve both. On a failure, the fuel coats the target and deals 5 (1d10) fire damage plus 9 (2d8) acid damage at the end of each of its turns. The target or another creature within 5 ft. of it can use an action to scrape off the fuel.
Lightning Flail. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. A hit deals 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 22 (5d8) lightning damage. Choose up to three other creatures the engine can see within 30 ft. of the target. Each makes a DC 20 Dexterity save, taking 22 (5d8) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
Thunder Cannon. Choose a point the engine can see within 120 ft. Each creature within 30 ft. of the point makes a DC 20 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 27 (5d10) bludgeoning damage plus 19 (3d12) thunder damage. On a success, halve both.
Soul of a slain creature. If the chosen weapon option kills a creature, its soul rises from the River Styx as a lemure in Avernus after 1d4 hours. If it remains dead when the lemure rises, restoring it requires Wish or killing the lemure and then casting True Resurrection on the creature's original body. Constructs and devils are immune to this soul effect.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 152.

name: Hobgoblin Devastator
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A Fey battlefield mage whose training lets it exempt allies from the effects of its spells.

sections.Traits: Army Arcana. When the devastator casts a spell that deals damage or forces a saving throw, it can select itself and any number of allies. Those creatures take no damage from that spell and succeed on its saving throw.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Quarterstaff or Devastating Bolt.
Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) if wielded in two hands, plus 13 (3d8) force damage either way.
Devastating Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (4d8 + 3) force damage and knocks the target prone.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 13).
At will. Mage Hand, Prestidigitation.
2/day each. Fireball, Fly, Fog Cloud, Gust of Wind, Lightning Bolt.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 153.

name: Hobgoblin Iron Shadow
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A masked Fey martial artist who uses illusion and short-range shadow magic to serve a court as a scout, spy, or assassin.

sections.Traits: Unarmored Defense. Add the iron shadow’s Wisdom modifier to its AC when it has no armor and no shield.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make four attacks in any combination of Unarmed Strike and Dart. Use Shadow Jaunt once before or after any one of the attacks, if desired.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Dart. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
Shadow Jaunt. Teleport up to 30 ft. with worn and carried gear to an unoccupied space the iron shadow can see. Both departure and destination must be in dim light or darkness.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 12).
At will. Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation.
1/day each. Charm Person, Disguise Self, Silent Image.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 154.

name: Howler
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A pack hunter from Pandemonium whose cry leaves its quarry too frightened to act. Lower Planes armies train howlers as war hounds.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The howler has advantage on attacks against a creature when a non-incapacitated ally is within 5 ft. of that creature.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rending Bite attacks.
Rending Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 22 (4d10) psychic damage if the target is frightened. The attack ignores damage resistance.
Mind-Breaking Howl (Recharge 4–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone must make a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage and is frightened until the end of the howler’s next turn. While frightened this way, it is incapacitated and its speed is halved. On a success, the creature is immune to the Mind-Breaking Howl of every howler for 24 hours.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 155.

name: Hungry Sorrowsworn
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing while in dim light or darkness.
sections.Traits: Life Hunger. When a creature within 60 ft. regains hit points, the sorrowsworn gains advantage on attack rolls and adds 22 (4d10) necrotic damage to each Bite hit until the end of its next turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claw attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage. A Medium or smaller target is also grappled (escape DC 16) and restrained for the length of the grapple. The sorrowsworn cannot use Claw while it has a creature grappled.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 223.

name: Hutijin
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A duke of Cania and loyal servant of Mephistopheles. Hutijin commands two companies of pit fiends and resents mortal conjurers who call him away from his post.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Infernal Despair. Every creature other than a devil has disadvantage on saving throws while within 30 ft. of Hutijin.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Hutijin fails a saving throw, he can spend a use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Hutijin has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. Hutijin regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. Radiant damage suppresses this recovery at the start of his next turn. He dies only if he starts a turn at 0 hit points and fails to regenerate.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one attack each with Bite, Claw, Mace, and Tail.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d6 + 8) fire damage. The target must pass a DC 22 Constitution save or become poisoned. While poisoned by this bite, the target cannot regain hit points and takes 10 (3d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. It can repeat the save at each turn’s end, ending the effect on a success.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d8 + 8) cold damage.
Mace. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d6 + 8) force damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (2d10 + 8) thunder damage.
Teleport. Hutijin teleports up to 120 ft. to an unoccupied space he can see, taking worn and carried gear.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 22) with no material components.
At will. Alter Self (may become Medium when changing appearance), Detect Magic, Hold Monster, Invisibility (self only), Lightning Bolt, Suggestion, Wall of Fire.
3/day. Dispel Magic.
sections.Reactions: Fearful Voice (Recharge 5–6). When Hutijin takes damage, each non-devil within 30 ft. makes a DC 22 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is frightened of him for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A successful save against Fearful Voice grants 24 hours of immunity to it.
sections.Legendary actions:
Hutijin has 3 legendary actions and regains spent uses when his turn starts. He can use one option immediately after another creature’s turn, paying the listed cost. He must be able to take actions and cannot do so before the end of his own first turn if surprised.
Attack (1 action). Make one Claw, Mace, or Tail attack.
Teleport (1 action). Use Teleport.
Lightning Storm (2 actions). Every other creature within 30 ft. without total cover from him makes a DC 22 Dexterity save. Deal 18 (4d8) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. Only total cover blocks the lightning.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 157.

name: Hydroloth
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An amphibious yugoloth that steals memories and recovers things lost beneath the water. Hydroloths sometimes take contracts to sink ships or raid settlements.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The hydroloth breathes air and water.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Secure Memory. The hydroloth is immune to the River Styx’s waters and to effects that read or detect its thoughts or steal or change its memories.
Watery Advantage. It has advantage on attack rolls while submerged in liquid.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Bite or Claw. Spellcasting can replace one attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d10 + 5) force damage plus 9 (2d10) psychic damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) force damage plus 9 (2d10) psychic damage.
Steal Memory (1/day). Choose a creature the hydroloth can see within 60 ft. It takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage and makes a DC 16 Intelligence save. Success grants 24-hour immunity to this hydroloth’s Steal Memory. On a failure the target loses all proficiencies, cannot cast spells or understand language, and has its Intelligence and Charisma scores reduced to 5 if they are higher. The target can repeat the save after each long rest and ends the effect on a success. Greater Restoration or Remove Curse ends it early.
Teleport. The hydroloth teleports up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see, taking worn and carried gear.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 16) with no material components.
At will. Darkness, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Invisibility (self only).
3/day each. Control Water, Crown of Madness, Fear, Suggestion.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 158.
sections.Printed damage note: The Bite and Claw each list 9 fixed psychic damage, or 2d10 when rolled. The dice average 11.

name: Illusionist Wizard
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Arcane Burst attacks.
Arcane Burst. Melee or ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d10 + 3) psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 13).
At will. Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion.
2/day each. Disguise Self, Invisibility, Mage Armor, Major Image, Phantasmal Force, Phantom Steed.
sections.Bonus actions: Displacement (Recharge 5–6). For 1 minute, an illusion offsets the wizard’s apparent position, imposing disadvantage on attacks against the wizard. The illusion ends if the wizard takes damage, becomes incapacitated, or has a speed of 0.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 263.

name: Juiblex
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: The demon lord of oozes consumes living matter and turns it into more slime. Its many red eyes shift through a roiling body that can rise 20 feet above the ground.

sections.Damage immunities: Acid, poison. Nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Foul. Any creature other than an Ooze that starts its turn within 10 ft. of Juiblex must pass a DC 21 Constitution save or be poisoned until the start of its next turn.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Juiblex fails a saving throw, it can spend a use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Juiblex has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. Juiblex regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn. Fire or radiant damage suppresses that recovery at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts a turn at 0 hit points and fails to regenerate.
Spider Climb. Juiblex climbs difficult surfaces and can move upside down on ceilings without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Acid Lash attacks.
Acid Lash. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (4d6 + 7) acid damage. A creature killed by this attack is pulled inside Juiblex and its corpse dissolves after 1 minute.
Eject Slime (Recharge 5–6). One visible creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity save or take 55 (10d10) acid damage. If the target takes any of this damage, any metal armor it wears suffers a permanent cumulative −1 penalty to the AC it grants. Any metal weapon the target carries or wears suffers a permanent cumulative −1 penalty to its damage rolls. An item is destroyed when its penalty reaches −5. Mending can remove the penalty on an object.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Wisdom (spell save DC 20) with no material components.
At will. Detect Magic.
3/day each. Contagion, Gaseous Form.
sections.Legendary actions:
Juiblex has 3 legendary actions and regains spent uses when its turn starts. It can use one option immediately after another creature’s turn, paying the listed cost. It must be able to take actions and cannot do so before the end of its own first turn if surprised.
Attack (1 action). Make one Acid Lash attack.
Corrupting Touch (2 actions). Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. A hit deals 21 (4d6 + 7) poison damage and coats the target in slime. The target is poisoned until the slime is removed by spending an action to scrape it off. While the slime remains, any non-Ooze creature within 10 ft. of the target is poisoned.
sections.Lair: Juiblex shares the Slime Pits of Shedaklah, a layer of the Abyss, with Zuggtmoy. In its lair, Juiblex is CR 24 (62,000 XP).
sections.Lair actions:
At initiative count 20, losing ties, use one option while in the lair and able to take actions. If surprised, Juiblex must finish its first turn first. It cannot use the same option in consecutive rounds.
Green Slime. A patch of the Green Slime hazard appears on a ceiling spot Juiblex chooses in the lair and disintegrates after 1 hour.
Slippery Slime. Coat a visible square on the lair floor, up to 10 ft. on each side. A creature on the square when the slime appears, entering it for the first time on a turn, or ending its turn there must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity save or fall prone and slide 10 ft. in a random direction (roll 1d8).
Sticky Slime. Coat a visible square on the lair floor, up to 10 ft. on each side. At the same three triggers, a creature must succeed on a DC 21 Strength save or be restrained while it remains in the area. It or another creature that can reach it can spend an action on a DC 21 Strength check, freeing it on a success.
Slippery and Sticky Slime last for 1 hour or until burned away. Burning slime disappears after 1 round and deals 22 (4d10) fire damage to creatures starting their turns in it.
sections.Regional effects:
Acidic Water. Small bodies of water within 1 mile turn acidic and corrode objects that touch them.
Corrupted Nature. Within 6 miles, Wisdom (Medicine) and Wisdom (Survival) checks have disadvantage.
Slime. Within 6 miles, surfaces are frequently coated with a slick film that sticks to whatever touches it.
The region can show one or more effects. They fade over 1d10 days after Juiblex dies.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 160.

name: Ki-rin
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A golden-scaled Celestial that guards sacred places and watches over broad territories. Its lair is usually difficult to reach, such as a high pinnacle or a magically solid cloud.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the ki-rin fails a saving throw, it can spend a use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. The ki-rin has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Hoof attacks and one Horn attack, or make two Sacred Fire attacks.
Hoof. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d4 + 5) force damage.
Horn. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) radiant damage.
Sacred Fire. Ranged spell attack, +9 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (3d8 + 5) radiant damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Wisdom (spell save DC 17) with no material components.
At will. Light, Major Image (6th level), Thaumaturgy.
3/day each. Cure Wounds, Dispel Magic, Lesser Restoration, Sending.
1/day each. Banishment, Calm Emotions, Create Food and Water, Greater Restoration, Plane Shift, Protection from Evil and Good, Revivify, Wind Walk.
sections.Legendary actions:
The ki-rin has 3 legendary actions and regains spent uses when its turn starts. It can use one option immediately after another creature’s turn, paying the listed cost. It must be able to take actions and cannot do so before the end of its own first turn if surprised.
Move (1 action). Move up to half speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Smite (1 action). Make one Hoof, Horn, or Sacred Fire attack.
sections.Lair actions:
At initiative count 20, losing ties, the ki-rin can use one option while in the lair and able to take actions. If surprised, it must finish its first turn first. Each option becomes available again after a long rest. The conjured objects appear 1 minute later at unoccupied spots the ki-rin chooses on the lair floor.
Create Comforts. Conjure permanent objects made of soft plant material, including manufactured goods, that collectively fit in a 20-ft. cube.
Create Stone and Metal. Conjure stone or metal objects that collectively fit in a 2-ft. cube. They vanish after 1 hour.
Create Wood. Conjure permanent wooden objects or objects made of comparably hard plant material that collectively fit in a 10-ft. cube.
sections.Regional effects:
Each effect can occur up to 3 miles from the lair.
Blessed Nature. Beasts, Plants, and Celestials become more vigorous and approach idealized forms. They rarely attack creatures they would not normally hunt.
Controlled Weather. The ki-rin can cast Control Weather in this area. The spell originates outdoors at the point nearest the lair’s center. It requires neither a clear path to the sky nor concentration to persist.
Pure Waters. The water runs pure. Deliberate contamination clears within 3 minutes.
Realm of Respite. Curses, diseases, and poisons are suppressed while affected creatures remain in the area, except for Aberrations, Fiends, and Undead.
Safe Descents. Creatures whose falls were not caused by the ki-rin or its allies descend at 60 ft. per round and take no falling damage. Aberrations, Fiends, and Undead fall normally.
On the ki-rin’s death, these effects end immediately, except the extra vigor of local flora and fauna lasts 3 years.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 162.

name: Kobold Dragonshield
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A kobold champion empowered by a dragon, often to protect its eggs. Its shield is made from dragon scales.

sections.Traits:
Dragon’s Resistance. Choose the dragon that empowered the kobold or roll 1d10 for its damage resistance. On 1–2, acid (black or copper). On 3–4, cold (silver or white). On 5–6, fire (brass, gold, or red). On 7–8, lightning (blue or bronze). On 9–10, poison (green).
Heart of the Dragon. At the start of its turn, the dragonshield can repeat the save against any effect that allows a save and leaves it frightened or paralyzed. A success ends that effect for the dragonshield and every kobold within 30 ft. Each beneficiary gains advantage on its next attack roll.
Pack Tactics. The dragonshield has advantage on an attack against a creature if a non-incapacitated ally is within 5 ft. of the target.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the dragonshield has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Spear attacks.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) if wielded with two hands for a melee attack.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 163.

name: Kobold Inventor
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A kobold that brings fragile improvised weapons into battle to injure, distract, or frighten opponents.

sections.Traits:
Pack Tactics. The inventor has advantage on an attack against a creature if a non-incapacitated ally is within 5 ft. of the target.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the inventor has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight.
sections.Actions:
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Sling. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Weapon Invention. Choose an option or roll 1d8. Each option can be used at most once per day.
1. Acid. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 5/20 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (2d6) acid damage.
2. Alchemist’s Fire. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 5/20 ft., one target. On a hit, the target takes 2 (1d4) fire damage at the start of each of its turns until it spends an action and succeeds on a DC 10 Dexterity check to extinguish the flames.
3. Basket of Centipedes. Throw the basket into a 5-ft. square within 20 ft. A Swarm of Centipedes emerges with 11 hit points and rolls initiative. It has a 50 percent chance to disperse at the end of each of its turns.
4. Green Slime Pot. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 5/20 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d10) acid damage and coats the target in slime, which deals 5 (1d10) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can use an action to scrape or wash the slime away.
5. Rot Grub Pot. Break the pot in a 5-ft. square within 20 ft. A Swarm of Rot Grubs emerges and remains a hazard in that space.
6. Scorpion on a Stick. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 1 piercing damage. The target then makes a DC 9 Constitution save and takes 4 (1d8) poison damage on a failure or half on a success.
7. Skunk in a Cage. Release a skunk in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. It has AC 10, 1 hit point, a walking speed of 20 ft., and no effective attacks. It rolls initiative and on its turn uses its action to spray a random creature within 5 ft. The creature must pass a DC 9 Constitution save or be incapacitated by retching for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that does not need to breathe or is immune to poison succeeds automatically. The skunk must finish a short or long rest before spraying again.
8. Wasp Nest in a Bag. Throw the bag into a 5-ft. square within 20 ft. A Swarm of Wasps emerges with 11 hit points and rolls initiative. It has a 50 percent chance to disperse at the end of each of its turns.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 164.

name: Kobold Scale Sorcerer
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A kobold spellcaster who advises its community. Those who speak for a dragon sometimes wear artificial wings as a sign of office.

sections.Traits:
Pack Tactics. The kobold has advantage on attacks against a creature when at least one ally is within 5 ft. of that creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
Sunlight Sensitivity. While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Dagger or Chromatic Bolt for each. The kobold can replace one attack with Spellcasting.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Chromatic Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) damage. The kobold chooses acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 12), without material components.
At will. Mage Hand, Prestidigitation.
2/day each. Charm Person, Fog Cloud, Levitate.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 165.

name: Korred
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A secretive fey that can tunnel through rock and bind intruders with rope made from its own hair.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Stone Camouflage. The korred has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Greatclub or Rock for each.
Greatclub. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, or 19 (3d8 + 6) if the korred is on the ground.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, or 19 (3d8 + 6) if the korred is on the ground.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Wisdom (spell save DC 13), without any components.
At will. Commune with Nature, Meld into Stone, Stone Shape. Commune with Nature takes an action for the korred.
1/day. Otto's Irresistible Dance.
sections.Bonus actions:
Command Hair. The korred has at least one 50-ft. rope woven from its hair. Choose one such rope within 30 ft. and command it to move up to 20 ft. and entangle a visible Large or smaller creature. Unless the creature succeeds on a DC 13 Dexterity save, the rope grapples it (escape DC 13). It is restrained for as long as the grapple lasts. The korred can release it as a bonus action. The grapple also ends if the korred dies or becomes incapacitated.
Hair rope. The rope has AC 20 and 20 hit points. At the start of each of the korred's turns, the rope regains 1 hit point if it still has at least 1 hit point and the korred is alive. The rope is destroyed at 0 hit points.
sections.Magical hair: When cut, hair from a korred's head turns into the material of the cutting tool. A korred uses iron shears to make strands it can weave into iron ropes.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 166.

name: Kraken Priest
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A kraken grants this devotee power and changes its appearance. The kraken can speak through the priest.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The priest can breathe air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Thunderous Touch or Thunderbolt for each.
Thunderous Touch. Melee spell attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 27 (5d10) thunder damage.
Thunderbolt. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d10) lightning damage plus 11 (2d10) thunder damage and knocks the target prone.
Voice of the Kraken (recharges after a short or long rest). The kraken speaks through the priest in Abyssal, Infernal, or Primordial, and its voice carries 300 ft. Each creature the priest chooses that can hear the words must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom save or be frightened of the priest for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Wisdom (spell save DC 13), without material components.
At will. Command, Create or Destroy Water.
3/day each. Control Water, Darkness, Water Breathing, Water Walk.
1/day. Evard's Black Tentacles.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 167.

name: Kruthik Hive Lord
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An armored burrower that hunts alongside its hive. Kruthiks nest near heat sources such as forges and lava.

sections.Traits:
Pack Tactics. The kruthik has advantage on attacks against a creature when at least one ally is within 5 ft. of that creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
Tunneler. The kruthik burrows through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a tunnel 10 ft. in diameter.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Stab or Spike for each.
Stab. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.
Spike. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Acid Spray (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone must make a DC 14 Dexterity save, taking 22 (4d10) acid damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 169.

name: Leucrotta
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A foul-smelling predator that leaves deerlike tracks and mimics voices to draw prey close. It often hunts alongside gnolls.

sections.Traits:
Mimicry. The leucrotta can imitate Beast sounds and Humanoid voices. A listener can identify the imitation with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.
Stench. Each creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the leucrotta must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution save or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. This trait exempts leucrottas and gnolls. A successful save makes the creature immune to the Stench of all leucrottas for 1 hour.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Hooves attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage. On a critical hit, roll the bite's damage dice three times.
Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Kicking Retreat. Take the Disengage action immediately after making a Hooves attack.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 170.

name: Leviathan
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A vast serpent formed from water. It can drag ships under or flood a settlement along the coast.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). After failing a saving throw, the leviathan can choose to succeed.
Partial Freeze. If the leviathan takes at least 50 cold damage during one turn, both of its speeds drop to 20 ft. and it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
Siege Monster. The leviathan deals double damage to objects and structures.
Water Form. The leviathan can enter and stop in a hostile creature's space. It can pass through openings at least 1 inch wide without squeezing.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Slam attack and one Tail attack.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (2d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (2d12) acid damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (2d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) acid damage.
Tidal Wave (recharge 6). Magically send a wave out from a visible point within 120 ft. The wave can reach up to 250 ft. long, 250 ft. tall, and 50 ft. wide. Each creature in it makes a DC 24 Strength save. It takes 45 (7d12) bludgeoning damage and falls prone on a failure. A success halves the damage and avoids falling prone. Water spreads along the ground in all directions, extinguishes unprotected flames in the wave's area and within 250 ft. of that area, and vanishes.
sections.Legendary actions:
The leviathan has 3 legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It can use one option at the end of another creature's turn. It needs to be able to act and, if surprised, can spend them only after its first turn ends.
Move (costs 1 action). Move up to the leviathan's speed.
Slam (costs 2 actions). Make one Slam attack.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 171.

name: Lonely Sorrowsworn
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A Shadowfell creature that draws others close on the ends of its harpoon arms.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing while in dim light or darkness.
sections.Traits:
Psychic Leech. At the start of each of the sorrowsworn's turns, every creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage.
Thrives on Company. The sorrowsworn has advantage on attack rolls when at least two other creatures are within 30 ft. It has disadvantage on attack rolls at all other times.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Harpoon Arm attack and use Sorrowful Embrace.
Harpoon Arm. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (4d8 + 3) piercing damage and grapples the target if it is a Large or smaller creature (escape DC 15). The sorrowsworn has two harpoon arms and can grapple up to two creatures at once.
Sorrowful Embrace. Each creature the sorrowsworn is grappling makes a DC 15 Wisdom save, taking 18 (4d8) psychic damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Regardless of the save, pull each of those creatures up to 30 ft. directly toward the sorrowsworn.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 223.

name: Lost Sorrowsworn
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A Shadowfell creature that seizes travelers in its spiked arms and tightens its grip when injured.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing while in dim light or darkness.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Arm Spike attacks.
Arm Spike. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage.
Embrace (recharge 4–6). Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 25 (4d10 + 3) piercing damage and grapples a Medium or smaller creature (escape DC 14). The sorrowsworn can grapple only one creature at a time. Until the grapple ends, the target is frightened and takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage at the end of each of its turns.
sections.Reactions: Tightening Embrace. When the sorrowsworn takes damage, the creature it is grappling with Embrace takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 224.

name: Male Steeder
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An Underdark hunting spider that duergar often train to pull loads. Sticky secretions on its legs hold prey and grip stone.

sections.Traits:
Extraordinary Leap. A long jump covers 3 ft. for each foot of walking speed the steeder spends on it.
Spider Climb. The steeder can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings while upside down, without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.
Sticky Leg. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Small or Tiny creature. On a hit, the creature sticks to the steeder's leg and is grappled (escape DC 12). The steeder can hold one creature in this grapple at a time.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 231.

name: Martial Arts Adept
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A trained monk who might guard a monastery, travel to learn another fighting style, or earn a living as a bodyguard.

sections.Traits: Unarmored Defense. Add the adept's Wisdom modifier to its AC while it wears no armor and uses no shield.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Unarmed Strikes or five Dart attacks.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. Once per turn, the adept can add Knock Down or Push. Choose the effect or roll a d4, with Knock Down on 1–2 and Push on 3–4.
Knock Down. The target makes a DC 13 Dexterity save or falls prone.
Push. The target makes a DC 13 Strength save or is pushed up to 10 ft. directly away from the adept.
Dart. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Deflect Missile. When a ranged weapon attack hits the adept, reduce its damage by 1d10 + 3. If that reduces the damage to 0, the adept can catch the missile if it fits in one hand and a hand is free.
sections.Optional tattoo: Roll a d8 or choose a tattoo. 1, arm patterns like marble or granite. 2, bright dragon scales. 3, Elementals or Fey at play. 4, stars forming constellations on the palms. 5, an excerpt from a combat manual. 6, poisonous flowers. 7, a pair of metallic-ink couatls twisting together. 8, a detailed landscape.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 172.

name: Marut
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An inevitable created by Primus to enforce contracts registered at the Hall of Concordance in Sigil. The contract is engraved on a gold plate carried in the marut's chest.

sections.Damage resistances: Thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. The marut is immune to spells and effects that change its form.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the marut fails a save, it can spend one use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. The marut has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Unusual Nature. The marut needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Unerring Slam attacks.
Unerring Slam. Melee weapon attack, reach 5 ft., one target. It hits automatically and deals 60 force damage. A Huge or smaller target is pushed up to 5 ft. away from the marut.
Blazing Edict (Recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 60-ft. cube originating from the marut's chest takes 45 radiant damage. Any creature that takes damage from the edict makes a DC 20 Wisdom save or is stunned until the end of the marut's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting: Plane Shift (3/day). Cast Plane Shift as an action using Intelligence, without material components. Use the spell as written or choose an unwilling creature the marut sees within 60 ft. That creature makes a DC 20 Charisma save. On a failure, it is sent to a teleportation circle in the Hall of Concordance in Sigil.
sections.Contract enforcement: The Kolyarut accepts enforceable contracts, records the agreed terms on a gold plate, and places it in the marut. The marut follows the written terms until the contract is fulfilled, including punishment for breaches. It uses lethal force only if the terms require it, the contract is completely broken, or someone attacks the marut.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 173.

name: Master Thief
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A practiced heist artist who might retire to lead a thieves' guild or fund a life of luxury.

sections.Languages: Any one language, usually Common, and thieves' cant.
sections.Traits: Evasion. When a Dexterity save normally halves damage, the thief takes no damage on a success and half on a failure. Evasion is unavailable while the thief is incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Shortsword or Shortbow.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Cunning Action. Take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.
sections.Reactions: Uncanny Dodge. When an attack hits the thief and the thief can see the attacker, halve the attack's damage to the thief.
sections.Optional calling card: Roll a d10 or pick a calling card. 1, a tiny origami cat. 2, a red feather. 3, a rose petal. 4, a twig-and-twine figurine. 5, a handwritten farewell. 6, a glass eye bead. 7, pistachio shells. 8, two playing cards leaned together. 9, a bitten coin with no value. 10, a charcoal or chalk sketch of a domino mask.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 174.

name: Maurezhi
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A demon created by Doresain to lead ghouls and ghasts. It takes on a victim's appearance after consuming the body, and the disguise rots over time.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning, necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Assume Form. The maurezhi can look like any Medium Humanoid it eats. The disguise lasts 1d6 days and decays until it falls away.
Magic Resistance. The maurezhi has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claw attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage. A Humanoid hit also loses 1d4 Charisma until it finishes a short or long rest. If its Charisma reaches 0, it dies. Its corpse rises as a ghoul 24 hours later unless the victim was revived or its corpse destroyed.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage. A creature hit other than an Undead makes a DC 12 Constitution save or is paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the paralysis on a success.
Raise Ghoul (Recharge 5–6). Revive one dead ghoul or ghast the maurezhi can see within 30 ft. It returns with full hit points.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 175.
sections.Feeding behavior: Consuming the corpse of a Humanoid it killed takes about 10 minutes.

name: Maw Demon
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A demon drawn to gnoll war bands that worship Yeenoghu. It follows them into battle and eats whatever it can.

sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Disgorge (Recharge 6). The demon spews into a 15-ft. cube. Each creature in it makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 11 (2d10) acid damage and falls prone.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 176.
sections.Stomach contents mechanics: When the demon finishes an 8-hour rest, everything it swallowed goes to Yeenoghu's gullet. Choose what remains in its stomach before then or roll a d8. 1, a wineskin containing wine. 2, an iron skillet. 3, scraps of a silk banner embroidered with a moon and stars. 4, a rusty gauntlet around a skeletal hand. 5, assorted keys. 6, an old leather boot. 7, a beehive. 8, Humanoid teeth.

name: Meazel
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A Shadowfell hermit that ambushes travelers with a garrote and drags them through the shadows. Other creatures can then sense the cursed victim.

sections.Actions:
Garrote. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target of the meazel's size or smaller. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and grapples the target. Escape requires a DC 13 check with disadvantage. The victim takes 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the meazel's turns until the grapple ends. The meazel cannot make weapon attacks while it holds a creature this way.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.
Shadow Teleport (Recharge 5–6). The meazel, its worn and carried gear, and any creature it grapples teleport up to 500 ft. Both ends must be in dim light or darkness. The meazel must have seen the destination before. It can choose a spot outside its current line of sight. If that space is occupied, the teleport ends in the nearest unoccupied space. Each other creature carried by the teleport is cursed for 1 hour. Remove Curse or Greater Restoration ends the curse early. Until it ends, Undead and creatures native to the Shadowfell within 300 ft. of the cursed creature sense it, so it cannot hide from them.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. Take the Hide action while in dim light or darkness.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 177.

name: Meenlock
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Overwhelming fear can bring these crustacean-like fey into being. When several spawn together, a network of moss-lined tunnels may form nearby.

sections.Traits:
Fear Aura. A Beast or Humanoid that starts its turn within 10 ft. of the meenlock makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is frightened until the start of its next turn.
Light Sensitivity. In bright light, the meenlock has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
sections.Actions: Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage. The target must pass a DC 11 Constitution save or be paralyzed for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the paralysis on a success.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Teleport (Recharge 5–6). Teleport to an unoccupied space within 30 ft. Both the starting space and destination must be in dim light or darkness. The meenlock can teleport to a space it cannot see.
sections.Telepathic Torment mechanics:
Up to four meenlocks can torment one incapacitated creature with telepathy. They can move, act, and react normally, but cannot use telepathy for another purpose during the torment. A creature immune to being frightened is unaffected.
If the target remains incapacitated for 1 hour, it makes a Wisdom save. The DC is 10 plus the number of participating meenlocks that stayed within sight of the target and were never incapacitated during the hour. On a failure, the target takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage. On a success, it takes half damage. The meenlocks can repeat the process.
A Humanoid reduced to 0 hit points by this damage immediately becomes a full-health meenlock under the DM's control. Wish or divine intervention can reverse the transformation.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 178.

name: Merregon
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Faceless soldiers of the Nine Hells, merregons wear metal masks marked with the identity of their commander and the layer they serve.

sections.Languages: Understands Infernal but cannot speak, telepathy 120 ft.
sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. The merregon's darkvision works in magical darkness.
Magic Resistance. The merregon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Halberd attacks.
Halberd. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage.
Heavy Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Loyal Bodyguard. When an attack roll hits another Fiend within 5 ft. of the merregon, the merregon can take the hit in its place.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 179.

name: Merrenoloth
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: These grim ferrymasters navigate the River Styx and wield fiery oars against unwelcome boarders.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The merrenoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Oar attack and use Fear Gaze.
Oar. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) fire damage.
Fear Gaze. Choose one creature the merrenoloth can see within 60 ft. It must pass a DC 13 Wisdom save or be frightened of the merrenoloth for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the fear on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 13). No material components are required.
At will. Charm Person, Darkness, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Gust of Wind.
3/day. Control Water.
sections.Bonus actions: Teleport. Teleport up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space the merrenoloth can see, taking any equipment it wears or carries.
sections.Lair actions:
While captaining a vessel, the merrenoloth can choose one option on initiative count 20, losing ties. It cannot use the same option in consecutive rounds. It must be able to act and, if surprised, must first finish its first turn.
Gale. For one round, the air within 60 ft. of the vessel is difficult terrain. A Medium or smaller creature that flies into the area or starts its turn flying there must pass a DC 13 Strength save or fall prone. The gale ends on initiative count 20 of the next round.
Propel. Increase the vessel's speed by 30 ft. until initiative count 20 of the next round.
Repair. The vessel regains 22 (4d10) hit points.
sections.Regional effects:
Choose one or both effects for the vessel.
Unerring. The vessel stays on course for the destination the merrenoloth names.
Unsinkable. The vessel stays afloat even if its hull is breached.
The effects fade over 1d6 hours after the merrenoloth dies.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 180.

name: Mindwitness
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An elder brain can convert a stunned beholder in its brine pool into a mindwitness. The colony uses it to relay messages telepathically.

sections.Traits: Telepathic Hub. When the mindwitness receives a telepathic message, it can relay it to up to seven other creatures it can see within 600 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tentacles attack, or use Eye Ray three times.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (4d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. A hit deals 20 (4d8 + 2) psychic damage. A Large or smaller creature is also grappled (escape DC 13) and must pass a DC 13 Intelligence save or be restrained until the grapple ends.
Eye Ray. Roll a d6 to choose a magical ray and reroll any result already used this turn. Choose one target the mindwitness can see within 120 ft.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 181.
sections.Eye Ray outcomes mechanics:
Aversion Ray (1). On a failed DC 13 Charisma save, the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Fear Ray (2). On a failed DC 13 Wisdom save, the creature is frightened for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the fear on a success.
Psychic Ray (3). The target takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage on a failed DC 13 Intelligence save.
