sections.Changeable Natures mechanics: After finishing a long rest, an eladrin that is not incapacitated can adopt another season's stat block. Carry over its damage taken, conditions, and other ongoing effects.

name: Star Spawn Grue
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Grues swarm ahead of more powerful star spawn. Their shrieks unsettle creatures nearby and draw attention away from their allies.

sections.Traits: Aura of Shrieks. Creatures within 20 ft. that aren't Aberrations have disadvantage on saving throws and on attack rolls against any creature other than a star spawn grue.
sections.Actions: Confounding Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (2d4 + 1) piercing damage. The target must pass a DC 10 Wisdom save or attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of the grue's next turn.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 227.

name: Star Spawn Hulk
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: This hulking servant usually guards a Star Spawn Seer. A seer can hit it with a Psychic Orb and let Psychic Mirror spread the damage to creatures near the hulk.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Psychic Mirror. If the hulk would take psychic damage, it takes none. Every creature within 10 ft. of it takes that damage instead. Magic can't reveal the hulk's thoughts or location.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks. If both hit the same target, it also takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage and must make a DC 17 Constitution save. On a failure, it is stunned until the end of its next turn.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Reaping Arms (Recharge 5–6). Make a separate Slam attack against each creature within 10 ft. Each creature hit must make a DC 17 Dexterity save or fall prone.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 227.

name: Star Spawn Larva Mage
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An emissary of an Elder Evil can fuse with a mortal cultist, replacing their personality. Its body breaks into a swarm of insects when defeated.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, restrained.
sections.Traits: Return to Worms. At 0 hit points, the mage breaks apart into a Swarm of Insects in its space. It reforms from the swarm 24 hours later unless someone destroys the swarm first.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Slam or Eldritch Bolt attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. The target must make a DC 19 Constitution save or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.
Eldritch Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d10 + 3) force damage.
Plague of Worms (Recharge 6). Each creature within 10 ft., except star spawn, makes a DC 19 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 22 (5d8) necrotic damage and the worms leave it blinded and restrained. It takes another 22 (5d8) necrotic damage at the start of each of the mage's turns. At the end of each of its own turns, it can repeat the save, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast a listed spell using Charisma (save DC 16). No material components are required.
At will. Mage Hand, Message, Minor Illusion.
1/day. Dominate Monster.
sections.Reactions: Feed on Weakness. When a creature within 20 ft. of the mage fails a saving throw, the mage gains 10 temporary hit points.
sections.Legendary actions:
The mage has 3 legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It can spend the listed cost on one option at the end of another creature's turn. It must be able to act and, if surprised, must first finish its first turn.
Slam (1 action). Make one Slam attack.
Eldritch Bolt (2 actions). Make one Eldritch Bolt attack.
Feed (3 actions). Each creature restrained by Plague of Worms takes 13 (3d8) necrotic damage. The mage gains 6 temporary hit points.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 228.

name: Star Spawn Mangler
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Cultists use manglers as guards and assassins. They crawl across walls and crouch in shadows with four to eight long arms.

sections.Traits: Ambusher. The mangler rolls initiative with advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage. If the attack roll had advantage, the target also takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
Flurry of Claws (Recharge 5–6). Make six Claw attacks. Before or after the attacks, the mangler can move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. In dim light or darkness, take the Hide action.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 229.

name: Star Spawn Seer
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A seer often leads a cult that seeks to bring an Elder Evil into the Material Plane. A Star Spawn Hulk makes both a bodyguard and a means of spreading the seer's psychic damage through Psychic Mirror.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Out-of-Phase Movement. Treat other creatures and objects as difficult terrain when moving through them. The seer's movement provokes no opportunity attacks. A creature the seer moves through takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage, at most once per turn from this trait. The seer takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Comet Staff or Psychic Orb attacks.
Comet Staff. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage. If the target is a creature, it must make a DC 19 Constitution save or be incapacitated until the end of its next turn.
Psychic Orb. Ranged spell attack, +11 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. A hit deals 27 (5d10) psychic damage.
Collapse Distance (Recharge 6). Choose a creature the seer can see within 30 ft. It makes a DC 19 Wisdom save. On a failure, teleport it and its worn and carried equipment up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space the seer can see. Each creature within 10 ft. of the target's original space takes 39 (6d12) psychic damage. On a success, the target stays in place and takes 19 (3d12) psychic damage.
sections.Reactions: Bend Space. When an attack roll would hit the seer, it can exchange places with another star spawn it can see within 60 ft. by teleporting with its equipment. The attack hits the other star spawn instead.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 230.

name: Steel Predator
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An exiled modron in Sigil builds steel predators to hunt named targets. The machine uses an identifying object to fix on its prey. The predator tracks the target across planes to within 1,000 yards, then uses sight and smell to close in.

sections.Languages: Understands Modron and the language of its owner but can't speak.
sections.Damage immunities: Poison, psychic. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, stunned.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The predator makes saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Unusual Nature. The predator needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (2d10 + 7) lightning damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d8 + 7) force damage.
Stunning Roar (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 19 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 33 (6d10) thunder damage, drops everything it holds, and is stunned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the stun on a success. On a successful initial save, it takes half damage and suffers no stun.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast a listed spell using Wisdom. No spell components are required.
3/day each, self only. Dimension Door, Plane Shift.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 232.

name: Stench Kow
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: These bison from the Lower Planes have orange and green hides and give off a toxic stench. A wizard may disguise one as an ox and loose it on a village.

sections.Traits: Stench. A creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the kow makes a DC 12 Constitution save. Stench kows are exempt. On a failure, the creature is poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a success, it is immune to the Stench of every stench kow for 1 hour.
sections.Actions: Gore. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage. Add 7 (2d6) piercing damage if the kow moved at least 20 ft. straight toward the target immediately before the hit.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 72.

name: Stone Cursed
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An alchemical rite animates a petrified Humanoid as a guardian. The rite uses basilisk blood and ashes from burned cockatrice feathers. It obeys the creator of the rite. An obsidian skull falls out when the guardian shatters, and the skull holds traces of the original victim's memories.

sections.Languages: The languages it knew in life.
sections.Traits:
Cunning Opportunist. The stone cursed makes opportunity attacks with advantage.
False Appearance. If it starts combat motionless, it rolls initiative with advantage. A creature that hasn't seen it move or act must pass a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to tell it apart from a statue.
Unusual Nature. The stone cursed needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions: Petrifying Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage. A creature hit must make a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, it starts turning to stone and is restrained until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. The effect ends on a success. On a failure, it is petrified for 24 hours.
sections.Cryptic Whispers mechanics: At the end of a short rest, a character can ask the obsidian skull a question aloud and make a DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) check. On a success, the skull yields a memory that answers the question. The skull yields no further memories after the attempt, regardless of the result.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 233.

name: Stone Giant Dreamwalker
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Stone giants who lose themselves in the surface world treat it like a dream. Other stone giants value them as guides. As they travel, peculiar treasures and petrified creatures accumulate on their bodies.

sections.Traits: Dreamwalker's Charm. An enemy that starts its turn within 30 ft. must make a DC 13 Charisma save unless the giant is incapacitated. On a failure, the enemy is charmed by the giant and can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the charm on a success. A creature that succeeds on the save is immune to this giant's Dreamwalker's Charm for 24 hours.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Greatclub or Rock.
Greatclub. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 24 (4d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +10 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it falls prone unless it succeeds on a DC 17 Strength save.
Petrifying Touch. Touch one Medium or smaller creature within 10 ft. that the giant has charmed. On a failed DC 17 Constitution save, the target is petrified, and the giant can attach it to its body. For a petrified creature attached this way, Greater Restoration and other magic that reverses petrification work only after the giant dies. Successful magic then frees the creature and ends the petrification.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 234.

name: Storm Giant Quintessent
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A storm giant near the end of its life may disperse into a lasting storm. It resumes giant form briefly to speak, perform a task, or defend its lair.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The giant can breathe air and water.
Legendary Resistance (1/day). When the giant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Lightning Sword attacks or use Wind Javelin twice.
Lightning Sword. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 40 (9d6 + 9) lightning damage.
Wind Javelin. Choose a creature the giant can see within 600 ft. The javelin strikes automatically for 19 (3d6 + 9) force damage and disappears.
sections.Legendary actions:
The giant has 3 legendary actions, which it regains at the start of its turn. Spend the listed cost to take one option just after another creature's turn. It must be able to act. If surprised, it can begin using these options after its first turn.
Gust (1 action). Choose a creature the giant can see within 60 ft. On a failed DC 18 Strength save, a magical gust moves the creature up to 20 ft. in a horizontal direction of the giant's choice.
Thunderbolt (2 actions). Choose a creature the giant can see within 600 ft. The creature takes 22 (4d10) thunder damage on a failed DC 18 Dexterity save, or half as much on a success.
One with the Storm (3 actions). The giant vanishes into its lair's storm and can choose to reappear anywhere in the lair at the start of any of its turns. While dispersed, it can take only lair actions and cannot be targeted by attacks, spells, or other effects. It can disperse only in its lair, and only if another creature is not quelling the storm with Control Weather or similar magic.
sections.Lair actions:
On initiative count 20, after creatures tied at that count, use one option in giant or storm form. Choose a different option from the one used in the prior round. The giant must be able to act and, if surprised, must finish its first turn before using a lair action.
Deafening Boom. Choose a point in the lair. Each creature within 20 ft. of it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution save or become deafened until the end of its next turn.
Fog. Choose a point in the lair and create a 20-ft.-radius sphere of fog, or murky water underwater. It spreads around corners and heavily obscures its area. Wind cannot disperse it. It lasts until the giant ends it without spending an action.
Gale. Create a line of wind, or current underwater, 60 ft. long and 10 ft. wide from a point in the lair. Each creature in the line must succeed on a DC 18 Strength save or be pushed 15 ft. in its direction. The gale clears gas and vapor and extinguishes exposed flames. Each protected flame has a 50 percent chance of going out.
sections.Regional effects:
One or more of these effects surround the lair.
Downpour. Rain, snow, blowing dust, or blowing sand is constant within 1 mile, as appropriate for the region. Rain fills or overflows waterways. Snow, dust, and sand build deep drifts or dunes.
Lightning. Lightning and thunder are constant within 5 miles, day and night.
Winds. High winds within 1 mile prevent fires from being lit in unprotected places.
When the giant dies, lightning, thunder, and high winds cease immediately. Rain, snow, and blowing dust taper off within 1d8 days.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, pp. 235–236.

name: Summer Eladrin
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Anger can draw an eladrin into its summer aspect. Its magic feeds the fighting form's quick movement and fiery attacks.

sections.Traits:
Fearsome Presence. A creature other than an eladrin that starts its turn within 60 ft. must make a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is frightened of this eladrin for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the fear on a success. A successful save or the end of the effect gives it immunity to every eladrin's Fearsome Presence for 24 hours.
Magic Resistance. The eladrin has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Changeable Natures mechanics: After finishing a long rest, an eladrin that is not incapacitated can adopt another season's stat block. Carry over its damage taken, conditions, and other ongoing effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Longsword or Longbow.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage with two hands, plus 9 (2d8) fire damage either way.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage and 9 (2d8) fire damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Fey Step (Recharge 4–6). Teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space the eladrin can see, taking its worn and carried equipment.
sections.Reactions: Parry. The eladrin adds 3 to its AC against a melee attack that would hit it if it can see the attacker and is wielding a melee weapon.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 116.

name: Swarm of Cranium Rats
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
classification: Medium swarm of Tiny aberrations, typically lawful evil

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned.
sections.Traits:
Swarm. The swarm can share a creature's space and fit through openings a Tiny rat could use. It cannot regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.
Telepathic Shroud. No effect can sense the swarm's emotions or read its thoughts. It is immune to all divination spells.
sections.Actions: Bites. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. A hit deals 14 (4d6) piercing damage, or 7 (2d6) piercing damage when the swarm has half its hit points or fewer, plus 22 (5d8) psychic damage in either case.
sections.Spellcasting:
Spellcasting (Psionics). As an action while above half its hit points, the swarm casts one listed spell using Intelligence (save DC 13), with no components.
At will. Command, Comprehend Languages, Detect Thoughts.
1/day each. Confusion, Dominate Monster.
sections.Bonus actions: Illumination. The swarm makes its brains shed dim light within 5 ft., shed bright light to a chosen radius from 5 to 20 ft. and dim light that much farther, or stop shedding light.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 83.

name: Swashbuckler
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A showy duelist with a personal code and a taste for notoriety. Many sail as pirates or corsairs.

sections.Traits: Suave Defense. Add the swashbuckler's Charisma modifier to its AC while it wears light armor or no armor and wields no shield.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Dagger attack and two Rapier attacks.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.
Rapier. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Lightfooted. Take the Dash or Disengage action.
sections.Swashbuckler flourishes:
Choose a signature flourish or roll a d8.
1. Wink and smile.
2. Make a theatrical bow.
3. Flip a dagger repeatedly.
4. Interrupt conversation with a booming laugh.
5. Sing sea shanties.
6. Walk a silver coin across the knuckles.
7. Toss out inventive insults.
8. Add an elaborate sweep to each rapier strike.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 238.

name: Sword Wraith Commander
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A battlefield ghost that answers insults to its courage with violence. It may show favor to those who praise its valor.

sections.Languages: The languages it knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Turning Defiance. The commander and other sword wraiths within 30 ft. of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn Undead.
Unusual Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Longsword or Longbow.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) with two hands.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Call to Honor (1/day). The commander must have taken damage during this combat. It gains advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn and brings forth 1d4 + 1 Sword Wraith Warriors in unoccupied spaces within 30 ft. of it. They take their turns just after the commander on the same initiative count and last until they reach 0 hit points.
sections.Bonus actions: Martial Fury. Make one Longsword or Longbow attack, dealing an extra 9 (2d8) necrotic damage on a hit. Attack rolls against the commander have advantage until the start of its next turn.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 239.

name: Sword Wraith Warrior
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A ghost of a soldier slain after being surrounded. Sword wraiths haunt the battlefields where they died.

sections.Languages: The languages it knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Unusual Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Battleaxe. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) with two hands.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Martial Fury. Make one Battleaxe or Longbow attack. Attack rolls against the warrior have advantage until the start of its next turn.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 239.

name: Tanarukk
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Abyssal magic turns warriors into tanarukks. Their allies often keep them imprisoned between battles to contain their violent attempts to seize power.

sections.Languages: Abyssal, Common, and one other language.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The tanarukk has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Greatsword attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Aggressive. Move up to the tanarukk's speed toward an enemy it can see.
sections.Reactions: Unbridled Fury. When a melee attack hits the tanarukk, make one Bite or Greatsword attack with advantage against the attacker.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 240.

name: Thorny Vegepygmy
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse

sections.Traits:
Plant Camouflage. The thorny has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in terrain with ample vegetation to hide it.
Regeneration. Regain 5 hit points at the start of the thorny's turn. Taking cold, fire, or necrotic damage prevents this healing at the start of its next turn. The thorny dies only if it begins its turn at 0 hit points and fails to regenerate.
Thorny Body. At the start of its turn, the thorny deals 2 (1d4) piercing damage to each creature grappling it.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d8 + 1) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 253.

name: Titivilus
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Titivilus negotiates on Dispater's behalf. He recruits outsiders to remove rivals and create problems that he can solve to secure his place at court.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that do not use silvered weapons.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Titivilus fails a save, he can spend one use to succeed.
Magic Resistance. Titivilus has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. Titivilus regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn. Taking cold or radiant damage prevents this healing at the start of his next turn. He dies only if he begins his turn at 0 hit points and fails to regenerate.
Ventriloquism. When Titivilus speaks, he can make his voice come from a point he chooses within 60 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Silver Sword attack and use Frightful Word.
Silver Sword. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) force damage with one hand or 9 (1d10 + 4) force damage with two hands, plus 16 (3d10) necrotic damage either way. A creature hit loses maximum hit points equal to half the necrotic damage it takes.
Frightful Word. Choose a visible creature within 10 ft. It must pass a DC 21 Wisdom save or be frightened of Titivilus for 1 minute. On its turns, it must Dash and move away by the safest available route. It can skip the Dash if it has nowhere to move. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Teleport. Titivilus and his worn or carried equipment teleport up to 120 ft. to an unoccupied space he can see.
Twisting Words. Choose a visible creature within 60 ft. It must pass a DC 21 Charisma save or become charmed by Titivilus for 1 minute. If Titivilus damages the charmed creature, it can repeat the save to end the charm. A creature that succeeds on the save gains immunity to his Twisting Words for 24 hours.
sections.Spellcasting:
Use an action to cast one spell without material components. Charisma is the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21).
At will. Alter Self, Major Image, Nondetection, Sending, Suggestion.
3/day each. Mislead, Modify Memory.
sections.Legendary actions:
Titivilus has 3 legendary actions and recovers them at the start of his turn. Spend the stated cost on one option immediately after another creature finishes its turn. He cannot use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, he must finish his first turn before using them.
Corrupting Guidance (1 action). Use Twisting Words, or choose a creature within 60 ft. that Titivilus has charmed. On a failed DC 21 Charisma save, he decides how it acts during its next turn.
Teleport (1 action). Use Teleport.
Assault (2 actions). Make one Silver Sword attack or use Frightful Word.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 242.

name: Tlincalli
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: These desert hunters have humanoid torsos and scorpion bodies. They hunt at dawn and dusk and shelter in loose earth or ruins between hunts.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Longsword or Spiked Chain attack and one Sting attack.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage with one hand or 8 (1d10 + 3) with two hands.
Spiked Chain. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. A Large or smaller creature hit is grappled (escape DC 11) and restrained until the grapple ends. The tlincalli cannot use this chain against another target during the grapple.
Sting. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage. The creature must pass a DC 14 Constitution save or be poisoned for 1 minute. If it fails by 5 or more, it is paralyzed while poisoned this way. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 242.

name: Tortle
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse

sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The tortle can hold its breath for 1 hour.
sections.Actions:
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) if wielded with two hands in melee.
Light Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +2 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d8) piercing damage.
Shell Defense. Withdraw into the shell and gain +4 AC and advantage on Strength and Constitution saves until emerging. Inside the shell, the tortle is prone, its speed is 0 and cannot increase, and it has disadvantage on Dexterity saves. It cannot take reactions, and its only available action is a bonus action to emerge.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 244.

name: Tortle Druid
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse

sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The tortle can hold its breath for 1 hour.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make four Claw attacks or two Nature's Wrath attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
Nature's Wrath. Ranged spell attack, +4 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, chosen by the druid.
Shell Defense. Withdraw into the shell and gain +4 AC and advantage on Strength and Constitution saves until emerging. Inside the shell, the tortle is prone, its speed is 0 and cannot increase, and it has disadvantage on Dexterity saves. It cannot take reactions, and its only available action is a bonus action to emerge.
sections.Spellcasting:
Use an action to cast one listed spell. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12).
At will. Druidcraft, Guidance.
2/day each. Cure Wounds, Hold Person, Speak with Animals, Thunderwave.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 244.

name: Transmuter Wizard
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse

sections.Traits: Transmuter's Stone. While carrying the magic stone the wizard made, it gains one benefit of its choice. Choose the benefit at the end of each long rest.
sections.Transmuter's Stone mechanics:
Darkvision. Gain darkvision out to 60 ft.
Resilience. Gain proficiency in Constitution saving throws.
Resistance. Gain resistance to one type of damage, chosen when selecting this benefit. The options are acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder.
Speed. Increase the wizard's walking speed by 10 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Arcane Burst attacks.
Arcane Burst. Melee or ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d10 + 3) acid damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Use an action to cast one listed spell. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14).
At will. Light, Message, Prestidigitation.
2/day each. Fireball, Hold Person, Knock, Mage Armor, Polymorph, Slow.
1/day. Telekinesis.
sections.Bonus actions: Transmute (Recharge 4–6). Cast Alter Self or, while carrying the stone, change the benefit of Transmuter's Stone.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 265.

name: Trapper
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: This subterranean ambush predator spreads against floors, walls, and ceilings. It matches the color and texture of stone, earth, or wood and sometimes leaves old bones and treasure in view as bait.

sections.Traits:
False Appearance. The trapper has advantage on initiative if it starts combat motionless on a floor, wall, or ceiling. A creature that has never seen it move or act needs a successful DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to distinguish it from that surface.
Spider Climb. The trapper climbs difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without making an ability check.
sections.Actions: Smother. Choose one Large or smaller creature within 10 ft. It must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity save or be grappled (escape DC 14). Until the grapple ends, it is restrained, blinded, and deprived of air. It takes 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. The trapper can smother one creature at a time.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 245.

name: Ulitharid
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
classification: Large aberration (mind flayer), typically lawful evil
description: An ulitharid is a six-tentacled mind flayer that sometimes leaves its colony with followers to found another.

sections.Traits:
Creature Sense. The ulitharid detects creatures with Intelligence 4 or higher within 2 miles. It learns each creature’s distance, direction, and Intelligence score. Mind Blank, Nondetection, and similar protections block this sense.
Magic Resistance. The ulitharid has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Psionic Hub. An Elder Brain psychically linked to the ulitharid can link to any other creature the ulitharid detects with Creature Sense. That creature’s link ends once it leaves the telepathy range of both. The ulitharid’s link to the Elder Brain persists across any distance on the same plane. More than 5 miles away from the Elder Brain, the ulitharid can end their link at any time without an action.
sections.Actions:
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. A hit deals 27 (4d10 + 5) psychic damage. A Large or smaller target is also grappled (escape DC 14) and must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence save or be stunned until the grapple ends.
Extract Brain. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated Humanoid grappled by the ulitharid. A hit deals 55 (10d10) piercing damage. If this reduces the target to 0 HP, the ulitharid kills it by removing and eating its brain.
Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6). The ulitharid projects magical psychic energy. Each creature in a 60-ft. cone must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence save or take 31 (4d12 + 5) psychic damage and be stunned for 1 minute. A stunned creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Spellcasting (Psionics):
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 17). No components are needed.
At will. Detect Thoughts, Levitate.
1/day each. Dominate Monster, Feeblemind, Mass Suggestion, Plane Shift (self only), Project Image, Scrying, Telekinesis.
sections.Founding a colony: An ulitharid preparing to give up its life can extract its brain using its psionic staff. Its followers plant the brain and staff in its corpse, which dissolves into ichor and helps form the new Elder Brain’s brine pool. A brain from an ulitharid that died naturally is unsuitable.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 249.

name: Vampiric Mist
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A vampire that fails to return to its resting place can disintegrate into a blood-drinking mist. The mist senses blood from up to 1 mile away and favors injured prey.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid, cold, lightning, necrotic, thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained.
sections.Traits:
Life Sense. The mist knows the location of every creature within 60 ft. except Constructs and Undead.
Forbiddance. The mist can enter a residence only with an occupant’s invitation.
Misty Form. The mist and other creatures can occupy each other’s spaces. It can pass without squeezing wherever air can pass. Moving through water costs 2 extra feet for each foot moved. It cannot manipulate objects that require fingers or manual dexterity.
Sunlight Hypersensitivity. The mist takes 10 radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
Unusual Nature. The mist needs neither air nor sleep.
sections.Actions: Life Drain. The mist touches one creature in its space. Constructs and Undead automatically succeed on the DC 13 Constitution save. On a failed save, the target takes 10 (2d6 + 3) necrotic damage, the mist regains 10 HP, and the target’s maximum HP drops by the necrotic damage taken. The reduction ends when the target finishes a long rest. The creature dies if its maximum reaches 0.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 250.

name: Vargouille
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A vargouille looks like a flying head with wings in place of ears. It sometimes escapes the Abyss by latching on to a creature summoned to another plane.

sections.Languages: Understands Abyssal, Infernal, and languages it knew before transforming. It cannot speak.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.
Abyssal Curse. Choose one incapacitated Humanoid within 5 ft. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma save or become cursed. Each hour the curse progresses, it loses 1 Charisma. Time spent in sunlight or the area of a Daylight spell does not count. At Charisma 2, the victim dies and its head splits off as a new vargouille. Before the transformation, Remove Curse, Greater Restoration, or similar magic ends the curse and reverses its changes.
Stunning Shriek (Recharge 5–6). Every Humanoid or Beast within 30 ft. that can hear the vargouille must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom save or become frightened of it until the end of the vargouille’s next turn. A creature frightened this way is also stunned. Once the creature succeeds on the save or the effect ends for it, it is immune to every vargouille’s Stunning Shriek for 1 hour.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 251.

name: Vegepygmy
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Vegepygmies hunt in small bands in dark, damp places and use hisses, gestures, and taps to communicate. They often live near Myconids and other fungi.

sections.Traits:
Plant Camouflage. The vegepygmy has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in terrain where vegetation provides ample concealment.
Regeneration. The vegepygmy regains 3 HP at the start of its turn. Cold, fire, or necrotic damage suppresses this trait at the start of its next turn. The vegepygmy dies only if it starts its turn at 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Sling. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Russet mold mechanics: One or more vegepygmies emerge a day after russet mold kills a Humanoid or Giant. A Beast killed by the mold can instead produce a Thorny Vegepygmy. See the Russet Mold hazard in Volo’s Guide to Monsters for exposure and removal.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 252.

name: Vegepygmy Chief
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An older vegepygmy grows tougher and develops spore clusters. Other vegepygmies defer to it as their chief.

sections.Traits:
Plant Camouflage. The vegepygmy has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in terrain where vegetation provides ample concealment.
Regeneration. The vegepygmy regains 5 HP at the start of its turn. Cold, fire, or necrotic damage suppresses this trait at the start of its next turn. The vegepygmy dies only if it starts its turn at 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make either two Claws attacks or two melee Spear attacks.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if wielded in two hands for a melee attack.
Spores (1/day). A cloud extends 15 ft. from the chief and spreads around corners. Each creature in the area other than a Plant must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution save or be poisoned. While poisoned this way, the target takes 9 (2d8) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Spore infection mechanics: If a creature dies while infected by the chief’s spores, its corpse produces vegepygmies under the Russet Mold rules. A Humanoid or Giant corpse produces one or more vegepygmies after one day. A Beast corpse can produce a Thorny Vegepygmy instead.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 253.

name: Venom Troll
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A troll that survives heavy poisoning can regenerate with venom in its blood and tissues. Its wounds spray poison into nearby spaces.

sections.Traits:
Poison Splash. Whenever the troll takes damage other than psychic damage, every creature within 5 ft. of it takes 9 (2d8) poison damage.
Regeneration. The troll regains 10 HP at the start of its turn. Acid or fire damage suppresses regeneration at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn at 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claws attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage. A creature hit is poisoned until the start of the troll’s next turn.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.
Venom Spray (Recharge 6). The troll cuts itself to release poison in a 15-ft. cube, taking 7 (2d6) slashing damage that cannot be reduced. Each creature in the area makes a DC 16 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 18 (4d8) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a success, it takes half damage and avoids the condition. A poisoned creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 248.

name: War Priest
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: War priests serve deities of war, protection, and strategy. They lead troops, counter enemy spellcasters, and care for the wounded.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Maul attacks and use Holy Fire.
Maul. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) radiant damage.
Holy Fire. Choose one creature the priest can see within 60 ft. It makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 12 (2d8 + 3) radiant damage and is blinded until the start of the priest’s next turn. On a success, it takes half the damage and avoids blindness.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Wisdom (spell save DC 15).
At will. Light, Spare the Dying, Thaumaturgy.
1/day each. Banishment, Command, Dispel Magic, Flame Strike, Guardian of Faith, Hold Person, Lesser Restoration, Revivify.
sections.Bonus actions: Healing Light (Recharge 4–6). The priest or one creature it chooses within 60 ft. regains 12 (2d8 + 3) hit points.
sections.Holy symbol ideas: Choose a symbol or roll a d8. 1, a vial of shimmering fluid. 2, a broken sword’s hilt. 3, a fragment of shrine glass. 4, a clay model of a ki-rin or another Celestial. 5, a torch carved like a hand cradling fire. 6, a reed circlet. 7, carved bone. 8, a vessel such as a cup or urn.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 254.

name: Warlock of the Archfey
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse

sections.Languages: Any two languages, usually including Sylvan.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rapier attacks or use Bewildering Word twice.
Rapier. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) force damage.
Bewildering Word. The warlock speaks a magical word at one creature it can see within 60 ft. It must pass a DC 14 Wisdom save or take 9 (2d8) psychic damage and have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of the warlock’s next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 14).
At will. Dancing Lights, Disguise Self, Mage Armor (self only), Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation, Speak with Animals.
1/day each. Charm Person, Dimension Door, Hold Monster.
sections.Reactions: Misty Escape (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). When the warlock takes damage, it becomes invisible and teleports up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied spot it can see, taking anything it wears or carries. Invisibility ends at the start of its next turn or when it attacks, rolls damage, or casts a spell.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 255.

name: Warlock of the Fiend
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse

sections.Languages: Any two languages, usually including Abyssal or Infernal.
sections.Traits: Dark One’s Own Luck (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). When making an ability check or saving throw, the warlock can add 1d10 to the result. It can choose to do so after rolling, before the roll takes effect.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Scimitar attacks.
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage.
Hellfire. Green flames erupt in a sphere with a 10-ft. radius centered on a point within 120 ft. Each creature inside makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 16 (3d10) fire damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. On a success, halve both amounts.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 15).
At will. Alter Self, Mage Armor (self only), Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation.
1/day each. Banishment, Plane Shift, Suggestion.
sections.Reactions: Fiendish Rebuke (3/day). When a creature the warlock can see within 60 ft. damages it, that creature makes a DC 15 Constitution save. It takes 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 255.

name: Warlock of the Great Old One
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse

sections.Traits: Whispering Aura. At the start of the warlock’s turn, each creature it chooses within 10 ft. must pass a DC 15 Wisdom save or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage. Incapacitation suppresses the aura.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Dagger attacks.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage.
Howling Void. Open a momentary rift within 60 ft., filling a 20-ft. cube with screams. Each creature in the cube makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage and is frightened of the warlock until the start of the warlock’s next turn. On a success, it takes half the damage and avoids fear.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 15).
At will. Detect Magic, Guidance, Levitate, Mage Armor (self only), Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation.
1/day each. Arcane Gate, Detect Thoughts, True Seeing.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 256.

name: Warlord
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A warlord whose victories draw followers may become a general or rule in their own right.

sections.Traits:
Indomitable (3/day). The warlord can reroll a failed saving throw and must use the new result.
Survivor. At the start of its turn, the warlord regains 10 hit points if it has at least 1 hit point and is below half its maximum.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Greatsword or Shortbow for each.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Legendary actions:
The warlord has 3 legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It can use one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn. It cannot use these actions while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or before the end of its first turn if surprised.
Command Ally (1 action). Choose an ally the warlord can see within 30 ft. If that ally can see and hear the warlord, it can use its reaction to make one weapon attack with advantage.
Weapon Attack (1 action). Make one Greatsword or Shortbow attack.
Frighten Foe (2 actions). Choose one creature the warlord can see within 30 ft. If the creature can see and hear the warlord, it must pass a DC 16 Wisdom save or be frightened until the end of the warlord’s next turn.
sections.Battle cry ideas: Choose a cry or roll a d8. 1, remind the troops of their cause. 2, promise victory. 3, rally them to the crown. 4, urge them to show the enemy no mercy. 5, boast that the enemy will learn to fear them. 6, call for weapons and spells at the ready. 7, curse the enemy to the Abyss. 8, tell the troops to do what they trained for.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 257.

name: Wastrilith
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Wastriliths stake out bodies of water tainted by the Abyss. They can foul water on land and in containers as well as underwater.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The wastrilith breathes air and water.
Corrupt Water. At the start of the wastrilith’s turn, exposed water within 30 ft. becomes corrupted. Underwater, the affected area is lightly obscured until a current flushes it out. Water held in a container stays corrupted until it evaporates.
A creature that drinks or swims in the water makes a DC 18 Constitution save. On a success, it is immune to the foul water for 24 hours. On a failure, it takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. At the end of the minute, it repeats the save. On a failure, it takes 18 (4d8) poison damage and remains poisoned until it finishes a long rest.
Another demon that uses an action to drink the water gains 11 (2d10) temporary hit points.
Magic Resistance. The wastrilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claws attacks, and use Grasping Spout.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 30 (4d12 + 4) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage.
Grasping Spout. The wastrilith magically hurls a jet of water at one creature it can see within 60 ft. It makes a DC 17 Strength save, with disadvantage if underwater. On a failure, it takes 22 (4d8 + 4) acid damage and is pulled up to 60 ft. toward the wastrilith. On a success, it takes half the damage and stays in place.
sections.Bonus actions: Undertow. If the wastrilith is underwater, water within 60 ft. becomes difficult terrain for all other creatures until the start of its next turn.
sections.Optional Abyssal corruption mechanics: Use the 2014 Dungeon Master’s Guide’s optional Abyssal Corruption rule if you want the poisoned creature to risk corruption after drinking the foul water.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 258.

name: Water Elemental Myrmidon
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse

sections.Damage resistances: Acid. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Languages: Aquan and one language chosen by its creator.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Trident attacks.
Trident. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) force damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) force damage if the myrmidon uses the trident two-handed for a melee attack.
Freezing Strikes (Recharge 6). Use Multiattack. Each hit deals an extra 5 (1d10) cold damage. A target hit at least once has its speed reduced by 10 ft. until the end of the myrmidon’s next turn.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 123.

name: White Abishai
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: White abishais are reckless shock troops in Tiamat's armies.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. Magical darkness does not interfere with the abishai's darkvision.
Magic Resistance. The abishai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Reckless. At the start of its turn, it can give itself advantage on melee weapon attack rolls for that turn. If it does, attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite, one Claw, and one Longsword attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage and 3 (1d6) cold damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) force damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) force damage when wielded with two hands.
sections.Reactions: Vicious Reprisal. When the abishai takes damage, it makes one Bite attack against a randomly selected creature within 5 ft. If nobody is within reach, it moves up to half its speed toward an enemy it can see. That movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 41.

name: Winter Eladrin
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Winter eladrin embody sorrow. Their tears freeze on their faces, and the cold around them reflects their grief.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The eladrin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Sorrowful Presence. A non-eladrin creature starting its turn within 60 ft. makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On failure it is charmed by the eladrin for 1 minute, with disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws while charmed this way. The creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns and whenever this eladrin damages it, ending the effect on a success. When the creature succeeds or the effect ends, it gains immunity to any eladrin's Sorrowful Presence for 24 hours.
sections.Changeable Natures mechanics: After finishing a long rest, an eladrin that is not incapacitated can adopt another season's stat block. Carry over its damage taken, conditions, and other ongoing effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Longsword or Longbow. The eladrin can replace one attack with Spellcasting.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d8) slashing damage, or 5 (1d10) slashing damage with two hands, plus 13 (3d8) cold damage.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage and 13 (3d8) cold damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 16). No material components are required.
At will. Fog Cloud, Gust of Wind, Sleet Storm.
sections.Bonus actions: Fey Step (Recharge 4–6). The eladrin teleports up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see, bringing any gear it wears or carries.
sections.Reactions: Frigid Rebuke. When a creature the eladrin can see within 60 ft. damages it, force that creature to make a DC 16 Constitution save. On failure, it takes 11 (2d10) cold damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 117.

name: Wood Woad
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A wood woad houses a mortal soul in a body of bark and protects the place or people entrusted to it. After the rite binds its soul to a tree, it sprouts from the tree's roots on the third day.

sections.Traits:
Plant Camouflage. The woad has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in terrain with plenty of concealing vegetation.
Regeneration. The woad regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn while touching the ground. Fire damage disables this trait at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and does not regenerate.
Tree Stride. Once on each of its turns, the woad can spend 10 ft. of movement to enter a living tree magically within 5 ft. It appears in an empty space within 5 ft. of a second living tree it can see within 60 ft. of itself. Both trees must be Large or larger.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Club attacks.
Club. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (4d4 + 4) force damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 266.

name: Wretched Sorrowsworn
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Wretched sorrowsworn hunt in packs in the Shadowfell, feeding on the life force of anyone they can latch onto.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing while in dim light or darkness.
sections.Traits: Wretched Pack Tactics. The sorrowsworn has advantage on an attack against a creature while an ally that is not incapacitated is within 5 ft. of that creature. Otherwise, its attack rolls have disadvantage.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage and the sorrowsworn attaches to the target. While attached it cannot attack, moves with the target without spending movement, and deals 6 (1d10 + 1) necrotic damage to the target at the start of each of its own turns. The sorrowsworn can spend 5 ft. of movement on its turn to detach. Any creature, including the target, can use its action to detach it.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 224.

name: Xvart
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Raxivort created the xvarts in his image. Magic that would locate him points to the nearest xvart instead.

sections.Traits: Raxivort's Tongue. The xvart can communicate with bats, giant bats, rats, and giant rats.
sections.Actions:
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. If at least one of the xvart's allies is within 5 ft. of the target and the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the xvart can push it 5 ft.
Sling. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Low Cunning. Take the Disengage action.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 267.

name: Xvart Warlock of Raxivort
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Raxivort's warlocks can speak to bats and rats, and their patron rewards them for felling enemies.

sections.Traits:
Raxivort's Blessing. When the xvart reduces an enemy to 0 hit points, it gains 4 temporary hit points.
Raxivort's Tongue. The xvart can communicate with bats, giant bats, rats, and giant rats.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Scimitar or Raxivort's Bite.
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Raxivort's Bite. Ranged spell attack, +3 to hit, range 30 ft., one creature. A hit deals 7 (1d10 + 2) poison damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 11). No material components are required.
At will. Detect Magic, Mage Armor (self only), Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation.
1/day each. Burning Hands, Invisibility.
sections.Bonus actions: Low Cunning. Take the Disengage action.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 267.

name: Yagnoloth
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Yagnoloths negotiate contracts for other yugoloths. They sign contracts with their smaller arm and use the other to fight.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The yagnoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Electrified Touch attack and one Massive Arm attack, or make one Massive Arm attack and use either Battlefield Cunning (if available) or Teleport.
Electrified Touch. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 27 (6d8) lightning damage.
Massive Arm. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 23 (3d12 + 4) force damage. If the target is a creature, it must pass a DC 16 Constitution save or be stunned until the end of the yagnoloth's next turn.
Battlefield Cunning (Recharge 4–6). Up to two allied yugoloths within 60 ft. that can hear the yagnoloth can each use a reaction for one melee attack.
Life Leech. Touch one incapacitated creature within 15 ft. It takes 36 (7d8 + 4) necrotic damage, and the yagnoloth gains temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt. On a failed DC 16 Constitution save, the target's hit point maximum falls by half the necrotic damage it took. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. A creature whose maximum falls to 0 dies.
Teleport. The yagnoloth and any equipment it wears or carries teleport up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 16). No material components are required.
At will. Darkness, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Invisibility (self only), Suggestion.
3/day. Lightning Bolt.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 268.

name: Yeenoghu
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: The demon lord known as the Beast of Butchery carries the Butcher, a three-headed flail he can summon to his hand. His lair, the Death Dells, is a hunting ground in the Abyss.

sections.Damage immunities: Poison. Nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). If Yeenoghu fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed.
Magic Resistance. Yeenoghu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Flail attacks.
Flail. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 22 (2d12 + 9) force damage. On his turn, Yeenoghu can add one effect to a hit. He can use each effect only once per turn.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (2d10 + 9) acid damage.
sections.Flail effects mechanics:
Confusion. On a failed DC 17 Wisdom save, the target is affected by Confusion until the start of Yeenoghu's next turn.
Force. The target takes 13 (2d12) extra force damage.
Paralysis. On a failed DC 17 Constitution save, the target is paralyzed until the start of Yeenoghu's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 17). No material components are required.
At will. Detect Magic.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Fear, Invisibility.
1/day. Teleport.
sections.Bonus actions: Rampage. When Yeenoghu reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack, he can move up to half his speed and make one Bite attack.
sections.Legendary actions:
Yeenoghu has 3 legendary actions. Use one option, paying its listed cost, at the end of another creature's turn. He regains spent legendary actions at the start of his turn. He cannot use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, he must finish his first turn before using them.
Charge (1 action). Move up to his speed.
Swat Away (1 action). Make one Flail attack. On a hit, the target must pass a DC 24 Strength save or be pushed up to 15 ft. straight away from Yeenoghu. If it fails by 5 or more, it also falls prone.
Savage (2 actions). Make a separate Bite attack against each creature within 10 ft.
sections.Lair: When encountered in his lair in the Death Dells, Yeenoghu is CR 25 (75,000 XP).
sections.Lair actions:
On initiative count 20, after creatures tied on that count, Yeenoghu can choose one option. He cannot choose the same option two rounds in a row.
Incite the Pack. Until the next initiative count 20, gnolls and hyenas in the lair have advantage on melee weapon attack rolls, and attack rolls against them have advantage.
Iron Spike. An iron spike 5 ft. tall and 1 inch wide erupts from a point on the ground Yeenoghu can see within 100 ft. A creature in that space makes a DC 24 Dexterity save. On failure, it takes 27 (6d8) piercing damage and is restrained on the spike. A creature can use its action to free itself or another creature within reach, ending the restraint.
Pack Rush. Each gnoll or hyena Yeenoghu can see can use its reaction to move up to its speed.
sections.Regional effects:
Choose one or both effects around Yeenoghu’s lair.
Savage Predators. Predatory Beasts within 6 miles of the lair kill far more prey than they need and leave the carcasses to rot.
Spiky Terrain. Large iron spikes grow from the ground and stone surfaces within 1 mile of the lair. Yeenoghu mounts the bodies of his victims on them.
If Yeenoghu dies, these effects fade over 1d10 days.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 270.

name: Yeth Hound
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Powerful Fey grant packs of yeth hounds to their favorites. The hounds run their prey down at night and flee the daylight.

sections.Languages: Understands Common, Elvish, and Sylvan but cannot speak.
sections.Damage immunities: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.
sections.Traits:
Sunlight Banishment. If the hound starts its turn in sunlight, it moves to the Deep Ethereal and must stay there while sunlight falls on the spot it left. After sunset it returns to that spot on the Border Ethereal. The hound and creatures on the Material Plane can see one another across the border but cannot affect one another. Once the hound is adjacent to its master or a pack mate on the Material Plane, it can use an action to return to that plane.
Telepathic Bond. While the hound and its master are on the same plane, they can communicate telepathically and the hound can magically share what it senses.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. A frightened target also takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage.
Baleful Baying. The hound bays magically. Each enemy within 300 ft. that hears it must pass a DC 13 Wisdom save or be frightened of the hound until the end of the hound's next turn or until the hound is incapacitated. A creature frightened this way that starts its turn within 30 ft. of the hound must use all its movement before acting, taking the most direct route to get as far away as possible even through hazards. A creature that succeeds on the save is immune to every yeth hound's baying for 24 hours.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 271.

name: Young Kruthik
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Young kruthiks start to hunt as soon as they outgrow the nest. They burrow through rock and fight in packs.

sections.Traits:
Pack Tactics. The kruthik has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if one of its allies is within 5 ft. of that creature and is not incapacitated.
Tunneler. It can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a tunnel 2½ ft. across.
sections.Actions: Stab. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 168.

name: Yuan-ti Anathema
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An anathema is a yuan-ti abomination transformed by a rite that sacrifices hundreds of snakes and bathes the subject in its enemies' blood. Anathemas do not age and seek sacrifices and riches as they claim divinity.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The anathema has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Ophidiophobia Aura. Choose creatures other than snakes or yuan-ti that start their turns within 30 ft. Each must pass a DC 17 Wisdom save or become frightened of snakes and yuan-ti. A frightened target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A successful save or the end of the effect grants immunity to this anathema's aura for 24 hours.
Six Heads. It has advantage on saves against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack (Anathema Form Only). Make two Claw attacks and one Flurry of Bites attack.
Claw (Anathema Form Only). Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.
Flurry of Bites (Anathema Form Only). Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. A hit deals 27 (6d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.
Constrict (Snake Form Only). Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. A hit deals 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage and grapples the target (escape DC 16). The creature is restrained and takes the same damage at the start of each of its turns until the grapple ends. The anathema can constrict only one creature at a time.
sections.Spellcasting (Anathema Form Only):
Cast one listed spell as an action, using Charisma (spell save DC 17) and omitting material components.
At will. Animal Friendship (snakes only).
3/day each. Darkness, Entangle, Fear, Polymorph, Suggestion.
sections.Bonus actions: Change Shape. Become a Huge constrictor snake or return to true form. The creature's statistics stay the same, and its equipment does not transform.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 272.

name: Yuan-ti Broodguard
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Yuan-ti transform captives with a magical brew to create broodguards. They obey yuan-ti instinctively and guard eggs or patrol for intruders.

sections.Traits: Reckless. At the start of its turn, the broodguard can give itself advantage on all melee weapon attacks it makes during that turn. Attack rolls against it then have advantage until the start of its next turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 273.

name: Yuan-ti Mind Whisperer
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Mind whisperers make a pact with Sseth, the Sibilant Death. They use magic to recruit converts, confuse enemies, and play rival factions against each other.

sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. Magical darkness does not impede this yuan-ti's darkvision.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Sseth's Blessing. When the yuan-ti reduces an enemy to 0 HP, it gains 9 temporary hit points.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks and one Scimitar attack, or make two Spectral Fangs attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Scimitar (Yuan-ti Form Only). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Spectral Fangs. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (3d8 + 3) psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting (Yuan-ti Form Only):
Cast one listed spell as an action, using Charisma (spell save DC 13) and omitting material components.
At will. Animal Friendship (snakes only), Message, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation.
3/day. Suggestion.
2/day each. Detect Thoughts, Hypnotic Pattern.
sections.Bonus actions: Change Shape. Become a Medium snake or return to true form. The creature's statistics stay the same. Its equipment does not transform, and it keeps its current form if it dies.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 274.

name: Yuan-ti Nightmare Speaker
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Nightmare speakers feed their victims' fears to Dendar the Night Serpent. They interpret the visions Dendar sends as prophecies and act to make them come true.

sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. Magical darkness does not impede this yuan-ti's darkvision.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Constrict and one Scimitar attack, or make two Spectral Fangs attacks.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature is grappled (escape DC 14) and restrained until the grapple ends. The yuan-ti can constrict only one creature at a time.
Scimitar (Yuan-ti Form Only). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Spectral Fangs. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (3d8 + 3) necrotic damage.
Invoke Nightmare (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. Create an immobile illusion of its deepest fear that only it can see. On a failed DC 13 Intelligence save, it takes 22 (4d10) psychic damage and is frightened of the illusion, believing it is real. The yuan-ti concentrates as if on a spell for up to 1 minute, and the illusion cannot be damaged. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the illusion on a success or taking 11 (2d10) psychic damage on a failure.
sections.Spellcasting (Yuan-ti Form Only):
Cast one listed spell as an action, using Charisma (spell save DC 13) and omitting material components.
At will. Animal Friendship (snakes only), Mage Hand, Message, Prestidigitation.
3/day. Suggestion.
2/day each. Darkness, Fear.
sections.Bonus actions: Change Shape. Become a Medium snake or return to true form. The creature's statistics stay the same. Its equipment does not transform, and it keeps its current form if it dies.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 275.

name: Yuan-ti Pit Master
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: These yuan-ti have snakes in place of arms. They serve Merrshaulk and sacrifice humanoids in the hope of waking him. They favor slow plans that keep yuan-ti cities hidden.

sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. Magical darkness does not impede this yuan-ti's darkvision.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Bite attacks or two Spectral Fangs attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Spectral Fangs. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (3d8 + 3) poison damage.
Merrshaulk's Slumber (1/Day). Choose up to five visible creatures within 60 ft. Each must pass a DC 13 Constitution save or fall unconscious in magical sleep for 10 minutes. Damage or another creature spending an action to shake or slap it awakens the target. Creatures immune to being charmed are unaffected.
sections.Spellcasting (Yuan-ti Form Only):
Cast one listed spell as an action, using Charisma (spell save DC 14) and omitting material components.
At will. Animal Friendship (snakes only), Guidance, Mage Hand, Message.
3/day. Suggestion.
2/day each. Hold Person, Invisibility.
sections.Bonus actions: Change Shape. Become a Medium snake or return to true form. The creature's statistics stay the same. Its equipment does not transform, and it keeps its current form if it dies.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 276.

name: Zaratan
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Summoning this elemental from the Plane of Earth raises the ground into an armored reptile. Its steps can level buildings, and it can draw into its shell to recover.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/Day). When it fails a saving throw, the zaratan can choose to succeed instead.
Siege Monster. It deals double damage to objects and structures. Earth-Shaking Movement already includes this increase.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Stomp attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 28 (4d8 + 10) force damage.
Stomp. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 26 (3d10 + 10) thunder damage.
Spit Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +17 to hit, range 120/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 31 (6d8 + 10) force damage.
