Spew Debris (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 90-ft. cube makes a DC 25 Dexterity save, taking 33 (6d10) bludgeoning damage on a failure or half as much on a success. A creature that fails by 5 or more is also knocked prone.
sections.Bonus actions: Earth-Shaking Movement. After moving at least 10 ft. on the ground, the zaratan creates a shock wave across a 120-ft.-radius circle centered on itself. That ground is difficult terrain for 1 minute. Each concentrating creature on the ground there loses concentration unless it passes a DC 25 Constitution save. Structures touching the ground in the area take 100 thunder damage. A creature within half the height of a collapsing structure makes a DC 25 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 17 (5d6) bludgeoning damage, falls prone, and is trapped and restrained in the rubble. A successful save halves the damage and avoids the collapse’s prone and restrained effects. A buried creature can use an action to escape with a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check. An adjacent helper within 5 ft. can spend an action clearing debris to grant advantage on the check. With three helpers spending their actions, the check succeeds automatically.
sections.Legendary actions:
The zaratan has 3 legendary actions. Use one option at a time at the end of another creature's turn, spending the listed action cost. Spent legendary actions return at the start of the creature's turn. A creature cannot use these actions while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using them.
Stomp (1 Action). Make one Stomp attack.
Move (1 Action). Move up to its speed.
Spit (2 Actions). Make one Spit Rock attack.
Retract (2 Actions). Withdraw into its shell. Until it emerges, the zaratan is restrained and has resistance to all damage. Its next legendary action must be Revitalize or Emerge.
Revitalize (2 Actions). Only while retracted, regain 52 (5d20) HP. The next legendary action must be Emerge.
Emerge (2 Actions). Only while retracted, leave the shell and make one Spit Rock attack.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 278.
sections.Table notes: Spit Rock lists 31 fixed force damage or 6d8 + 10 when rolled. The dice average 37.

name: Zariel
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Once an angel assigned to watch the Blood War, Zariel fell and accepted Asmodeus's offer to rule Avernus. She bargains for the souls of practiced warriors to replenish her legions.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, radiant. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. Magical darkness does not impede Zariel's darkvision.
Legendary Resistance (3/Day). When Zariel fails a save, she can choose to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. She has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. Zariel recovers 20 HP at the start of her turn. Radiant damage prevents this recovery at the start of her next turn. She dies only if she begins her turn at 0 HP and does not regenerate.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Flail or Longsword in any combination. Replace one attack with Horrid Touch if available.
Flail. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d8 + 8) force damage plus 36 (8d8) fire damage.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d8 + 8) radiant damage, or 19 (2d10 + 8) radiant damage with two hands, plus 36 (8d8) fire damage in either case.
Horrid Touch (Recharge 5–6). Touch one creature within 10 ft. On a failed DC 26 Constitution save, it takes 44 (8d10) necrotic damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned this way, it is also blinded and deafened. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Teleport. Zariel and her equipment teleport up to 120 ft. to an unoccupied space she can see.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one listed spell as an action, using Charisma (spell save DC 26) and omitting material components.
At will. Alter Self (Zariel may become Medium when changing her appearance), Detect Evil and Good, Fireball, Invisibility (self only), Major Image, Wall of Fire.
3/day each. Blade Barrier, Dispel Evil and Good, Finger of Death.
sections.Legendary actions:
Zariel has 3 legendary actions. Use one option at a time at the end of another creature's turn, spending the listed action cost. Spent legendary actions return at the start of the creature's turn. A creature cannot use these actions while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using them.
Teleport (1 Action). Use Teleport.
Immolating Gaze (2 Actions). Choose one visible creature within 120 ft. It must pass a DC 26 Wisdom save or take 22 (4d10) fire damage.
sections.Lair actions:
Zariel can choose one of the following options at initiative count 20, losing ties. An option cannot be used in consecutive rounds.
Fireball. Cast Fireball.
Infernal Illusions. Cast Major Image four times in different areas without concentration. All four illusions end at initiative count 20 of the next round. Each creature that can see these illusions must pass a DC 26 Wisdom save or be frightened of the illusion for 1 minute. A frightened creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Regional effects:
Choose one or more effects around Zariel's basalt citadel in Avernus.
Hellscape. Screams and the smell of burning meat fill the area within 9 miles of the lair.
Pyres. Within 1 mile, jets of flame 10 ft. high rise every 60 ft. A creature or object touching a flame takes 7 (2d6) fire damage at most once per round.
Smoke. From 500 ft. out to 2 miles, persistent smoke heavily obscures the area and cannot be dispersed.
After Zariel dies, the effects fade over 1d10 days.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 280.

name: Zuggtmoy
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: The Demon Queen of Fungi spreads spores that turn living creatures into servants and eventually into hosts for fungal growth. Her principal palace on Shedaklah consists of two dozen giant mushrooms linked by shelf-fungus bridges.

sections.Damage immunities: Poison. Nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/Day). When Zuggtmoy fails a save, she can choose to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. She has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Pseudopod attacks.
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d8 + 6) force damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one listed spell as an action, using Charisma (spell save DC 22) and omitting material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Locate Animals or Plants.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Entangle, Plant Growth.
1/day each. Etherealness, Teleport.
sections.Bonus actions:
Infestation Spores (3/Day). Create a 20-ft.-radius spherical cloud centered on Zuggtmoy for 1 minute. Any creature inside when it appears or entering afterward makes a DC 19 Constitution save. Success grants immunity to these spores for 24 hours. Failure causes the spores of Zuggtmoy disease until cured or the creature dies. While infected, the creature cannot be reinfected and repeats the save at the end of every 24 hours. A success ends the infection. After three failed repeat saves, fungal growth kills the host and reanimates it as a spore servant if that creature can become one.
Mind Control Spores (Recharge 5–6). Create a 20-ft.-radius spherical cloud centered on Zuggtmoy for 1 minute. Humanoids and Beasts inside when it appears or entering afterward make a DC 19 Wisdom save. Success grants immunity to those spores for 24 hours. Failure causes the influence of Zuggtmoy disease for 24 hours. During that time the creature is charmed by Zuggtmoy and cannot be reinfected by these spores.
sections.Reactions: Protective Thrall. When an attack roll hits Zuggtmoy, redirect that hit to one creature within 10 ft. of her that is charmed by her.
sections.Legendary actions:
Zuggtmoy has 3 legendary actions. Use one option at a time at the end of another creature's turn, spending the listed action cost. Spent legendary actions return at the start of the creature's turn. A creature cannot use these actions while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using them.
Attack (1 Action). Make one Pseudopod attack.
Exert Will (1 Action). Choose one visible creature charmed by Zuggtmoy. It uses its reaction if available, either to move up to its speed as directed or make one weapon attack against a target she designates.
sections.Lair actions:
Zuggtmoy can choose one of the following options at initiative count 20, losing ties. An option cannot be used in consecutive rounds.
Rally Plants. Up to four friendly Plant creatures Zuggtmoy can see can spend their reactions to move up to their speed and make one weapon attack.
Summon Fungi. Four gas spores or violet fungi appear in unoccupied spaces Zuggtmoy chooses in her lair and vanish after 1 hour.
Unleash Spores. Use Infestation Spores or Mind Control Spores, centering the cloud on a mushroom or other fungus in the lair instead of Zuggtmoy.
sections.Regional effects:
Choose one or more effects around Zuggtmoy's lair.
Corrupted Nature. Within 6 miles, Wisdom (Medicine) and Wisdom (Survival) checks have disadvantage.
Fungal Infestation. Within 6 miles, molds and fungi grow even on surfaces where they would not normally take hold.
Mutating Vegetation. Within 1 mile, parasitic fungi slowly alter the vegetation they infest.
After Zuggtmoy dies, the effects fade over 1d10 days.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 281.

name: Abjurer
description: A wizard who wards allies and strongholds against magic.

sections.Armor: AC 15 while Mage Armor is active.
sections.Traits: Arcane Ward. A magical ward with 30 hit points absorbs damage in the abjurer’s place. When the ward drops to 0 hit points, the abjurer takes the excess. Casting an abjuration spell of 1st level or higher restores hit points to the ward equal to twice the spell’s level.
sections.Actions: Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) when the abjurer uses two hands.
sections.Spellcasting:
The abjurer casts as a 13th-level Intelligence-based wizard (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Blade Ward, Dancing Lights, Mending, Message, Ray of Frost.
Level 1 (4 slots). Alarm (abjuration), Mage Armor (abjuration), Magic Missile, Shield (abjuration).
Level 2 (3 slots). Arcane Lock (abjuration), Invisibility.
Level 3 (3 slots). Counterspell (abjuration), Dispel Magic (abjuration), Fireball.
Level 4 (3 slots). Banishment (abjuration), Stoneskin (abjuration).
Level 5 (2 slots). Cone of Cold, Wall of Force.
Level 6 (1 slot). Flesh to Stone, Globe of Invulnerability (abjuration).
Level 7 (1 slot). Symbol (abjuration), Teleport.

name: Alhoon
description: Exiled mind flayer arcanists use a periapt of mind trapping to gain a precarious form of undeath.

sections.Languages: Deep Speech, Undercommon, and telepathy 120 ft.
sections.Damage immunities: Poison. Immune to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The alhoon has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Turn Resistance. The alhoon has advantage on saves against effects that turn Undead.
sections.Actions:
Chilling Grasp. Melee spell attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (3d6) cold damage.
Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 16 Intelligence save against a magical blast. On a failure it takes 22 (4d8 + 4) psychic damage and is stunned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the stun on a success.
sections.Innate Spellcasting (Psionics):
Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16). These spells require no components.
At will. Detect Thoughts, Levitate.
1/day each. Dominate Monster, Plane Shift (self only).
sections.Spellcasting:
The alhoon casts as a 12th-level Intelligence-based wizard (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Chill Touch, Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation, Shocking Grasp.
Level 1 (4 slots). Detect Magic, Disguise Self, Magic Missile, Shield.
Level 2 (3 slots). Invisibility, Mirror Image, Scorching Ray.
Level 3 (3 slots). Counterspell, Fly, Lightning Bolt.
Level 4 (3 slots). Confusion, Evard's Black Tentacles, Phantasmal Killer.
Level 5 (2 slots). Modify Memory, Wall of Force.
Level 6 (1 slot). Disintegrate, Globe of Invulnerability.
sections.Periapt of mind trapping mechanics: At least three mind flayer arcanists spend three days making a fist-sized vessel of silver, emerald, and amethyst. The rite sacrifices one living soul per arcanist. Each arcanist gains undeath for the time its victim would have lived and can renew it with another rite. If an alhoon is destroyed, its mind joins the trapped souls in the periapt. Destroying the periapt destroys every mind and soul inside it. Its holder has advantage on attacks, saves, and checks against associated alhoons. Those alhoons have disadvantage on attacks, saves, and checks against the holder. The holder can speak telepathically with the trapped victims and silence them. Trapped alhoons can speak to the holder telepathically without permission.

name: Annis Hag
description: This hulking hag inhabits hills and mountains. She spreads fear among nearby settlements and sometimes takes command of ogres or trolls.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. The hag also resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage.
Crushing Hug. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 36 (9d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature is also grappled (escape DC 15) and takes another 36 (9d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the hag’s turns until the grapple ends. The hag cannot make attacks while she grapples it this way.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma is the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13).
3/day each. Disguise Self (can take the form of a Medium humanoid), Fog Cloud.
sections.Iron token mechanics: The hag pulls out one of her iron teeth or nails and takes 1 minute to shape it into a coin, ring, or tiny mirror. She and its holder can whisper to each other while on the same plane and within 10 miles. They hear only each other’s voice through the token. She can have up to three active tokens. As an action she can sense the direction and approximate distance of each one. She can deactivate one at any distance without an action, leaving an ordinary object.
sections.Lair actions:
Optional for a powerful hag. Grandmothers usually have three to five lair actions, and powerful aunties usually have at most one. Use one on initiative count 20, losing ties, and avoid repeating the same effect two rounds in a row. A required save uses the hag’s highest save DC unless the option specifies a different one.
Pass Through Surfaces. The hag can move through solid doors, walls, floors, and ceilings until initiative count 20 of the next round.
Doors and Windows. The hag opens or closes as many doors and windows as she can see. She can magically lock a closed opening until she unlocks it or opens it with this action. A creature can force it open with a DC 20 Strength check.
Caustic Smoke. Fill a 20-ft.-radius sphere centered on a visible point within 120 ft. with black smoke until initiative count 20 of the next round. The smoke heavily obscures creatures and objects in or behind it. A creature takes 10 (3d6) acid damage if it enters the smoke for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there.
sections.Regional effects:
Choose effects to suit the hag’s power. A lair usually has three to five. A grandmother’s, auntie’s, or coven’s lair has more dangerous effects than a lone hag’s. Use the hag’s highest save DC for an effect that calls for a save. When the hag dies or abandons her lair, an effect ends immediately or fades over up to 2d10 days.
Generic grandmother effects within 1 mile. Small animals grow unusually abundant. Beasts with Intelligence 2 or lower are charmed and sicced on intruders. Figurines, dolls, and twig charms appear in trees.
Additional Annis Hag effects within 1 mile. Gravel can turn into caltrops along 100-ft. stretches. Rockslides can block trails or bury intruders, who are restrained and must hold their breath until freed. Laughter sometimes carries from nowhere. Cairns may hold old bones, lie empty, or draw skeletons, specters, or hostile Fey.
sections.Coven mechanics: An annis hag in a three-hag coven is CR 8 (3,900 XP). Use a Coven profile for its shared spellcasting and Hag Eye rules.

sections.Shared Spellcasting:
All three hags must be within 30 ft. of one another. Each casts as a 12th-level Intelligence-based spellcaster (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). The three hags spend slots from one shared pool. Innate Spellcasting uses its own daily limits.
Level 1 (4 slots). Identify, Ray of Sickness.
Level 2 (3 slots). Hold Person, Locate Object.
Level 3 (3 slots). Bestow Curse, Counterspell, Lightning Bolt.
Level 4 (3 slots). Phantasmal Killer, Polymorph.
Level 5 (2 slots). Contact Other Plane, Scrying.
Level 6 (1 slot). Eyebite.
sections.Hag Eye mechanics: A coven can keep one Hag Eye at a time. A hag can spend an action to see through it while on the same plane. The eye has AC 10, 1 HP, and darkvision 60 ft. If it is destroyed, each coven member takes 3d10 psychic damage and is blinded for 24 hours. All three hags must perform the 1-hour crafting ritual together and none of them can be blinded. Taking an unrelated action during it forces them to restart.

sections.Shared Spellcasting:
All three hags must be within 30 ft. of one another. Each casts as a 12th-level Intelligence-based spellcaster (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). The three hags spend slots from one shared pool. Innate Spellcasting uses its own daily limits.
Level 1 (4 slots). False Life, Inflict Wounds.
Level 2 (3 slots). Gentle Repose, Ray of Enfeeblement.
Level 3 (3 slots). Animate Dead, Revivify, Speak with Dead.
Level 4 (3 slots). Blight, Death Ward.
Level 5 (2 slots). Contagion, Raise Dead.
Level 6 (1 slot). Circle of Death.
sections.Hag Eye mechanics: A coven can keep one Hag Eye at a time. A hag can spend an action to see through it while on the same plane. The eye has AC 10, 1 HP, and darkvision 60 ft. If it is destroyed, each coven member takes 3d10 psychic damage and is blinded for 24 hours. All three hags must perform the 1-hour crafting ritual together and none of them can be blinded. Taking an unrelated action during it forces them to restart.

name: Annis Hag (Coven; Nature)
description: This hulking hag inhabits hills and mountains. She spreads fear among nearby settlements and sometimes takes command of ogres or trolls.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. The hag also resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage.
Crushing Hug. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 36 (9d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature is also grappled (escape DC 15) and takes another 36 (9d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the hag’s turns until the grapple ends. The hag cannot make attacks while she grapples it this way.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma is the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13).
3/day each. Disguise Self (can take the form of a Medium humanoid), Fog Cloud.
sections.Iron token mechanics: The hag pulls out one of her iron teeth or nails and takes 1 minute to shape it into a coin, ring, or tiny mirror. She and its holder can whisper to each other while on the same plane and within 10 miles. They hear only each other’s voice through the token. She can have up to three active tokens. As an action she can sense the direction and approximate distance of each one. She can deactivate one at any distance without an action, leaving an ordinary object.
sections.Lair actions:
Optional for a powerful hag. Grandmothers usually have three to five lair actions, and powerful aunties usually have at most one. Use one on initiative count 20, losing ties, and avoid repeating the same effect two rounds in a row. A required save uses the hag’s highest save DC unless the option specifies a different one.
Pass Through Surfaces. The hag can move through solid doors, walls, floors, and ceilings until initiative count 20 of the next round.
Doors and Windows. The hag opens or closes as many doors and windows as she can see. She can magically lock a closed opening until she unlocks it or opens it with this action. A creature can force it open with a DC 20 Strength check.
Caustic Smoke. Fill a 20-ft.-radius sphere centered on a visible point within 120 ft. with black smoke until initiative count 20 of the next round. The smoke heavily obscures creatures and objects in or behind it. A creature takes 10 (3d6) acid damage if it enters the smoke for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there.
sections.Regional effects:
Choose effects to suit the hag’s power. A lair usually has three to five. A grandmother’s, auntie’s, or coven’s lair has more dangerous effects than a lone hag’s. Level 3 (3 slots). Call Lightning, Plant Growth.
Level 4 (3 slots). Dominate Beast, Grasping Vine.
Level 5 (2 slots). Insect Plague, Tree Stride.
Level 6 (1 slot). Wall of Thorns.

name: Apprentice Wizard
description: A student of arcane magic who takes on chores for a tutor or attends a school.

sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 2 (1d4) piercing damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
The apprentice is a 1st-level wizard spellcaster using Intelligence (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Fire Bolt, Mending, Prestidigitation.
1st level (2 slots). Burning Hands, Disguise Self, Shield.

name: Archdruid
description: A guardian of the natural wonders in its domain, often supported by druidic students and loyal beasts or fey.

sections.Actions:
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Change Shape (2/day). The archdruid magically takes the form of a Beast or Elemental of CR 6 or lower for up to 9 hours. Choose whether its gear drops, merges with the form, or remains worn. It reverts if it dies or falls unconscious, and it can revert as a bonus action on its turn.
In the new form, replace its AC, movement modes, Strength, and Dexterity with the form's values. It retains its other statistics and can still speak. Add the form's special senses, proficiencies, traits, actions, and reactions that the archdruid lacks. Exclude class features, legendary actions, and lair actions. It can cast spells with verbal or somatic components in the form, and the form's attacks count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.
sections.Spellcasting:
The archdruid is an 18th-level druid spellcaster using Wisdom (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Druidcraft, Mending, Poison Spray, Produce Flame.
1st level (4 slots). Cure Wounds, Entangle, Faerie Fire, Speak with Animals.
2nd level (3 slots). Animal Messenger, Beast Sense, Hold Person.
3rd level (3 slots). Conjure Animals, Meld into Stone, Water Breathing.
4th level (3 slots). Dominate Beast, Locate Creature, Stoneskin, Wall of Fire.
5th level (3 slots). Commune with Nature, Mass Cure Wounds, Tree Stride.
6th level (1 slot). Heal, Heroes' Feast, Sunbeam.
7th level (1 slot). Fire Storm.
8th level (1 slot). Animal Shapes.
9th level (1 slot). Foresight.

name: Archer
description: A bow specialist who might defend a castle, guard a caravan, or provide long-range support for a military unit.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Longbow attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Archer's Eye (3/day). Add 1d10 to the next attack or damage roll with a longbow or shortbow.

name: Babau
description: A spear-wielding demon whose gaze weakens foes who rely on strength.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks. The babau can also use Weakening Gaze before or after those attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage if used two-handed in melee.
Weakening Gaze. One creature the babau can see within 20 ft. makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, its Strength-based weapon attacks deal half damage for 1 minute. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The babau casts innately using Wisdom (spell save DC 11) and needs no material components.
At will. Darkness, Dispel Magic, Fear, Heat Metal, Levitate.

name: Banderhobb
description: A giant, toadlike servant made of flesh and shadow. Its creator can send it after a target using a small piece of the target or a related object. It typically lasts only a few days before dissolving into tar and shadow.

sections.Languages: Understands Common and its creator’s languages but cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Resonant Connection. If the banderhobb carries even a small piece of a creature or object, it knows the most direct route to that target while within 1 mile of it.
Shadow Stealth. In dim light or darkness, the banderhobb can Hide as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 22 (5d6 + 5) piercing damage. A Large or smaller creature is grappled (escape DC 15) and restrained until the grapple ends. While that grapple lasts, the banderhobb can use Bite and Tongue only against the grappled target.
Tongue. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure, pull it into a space within 5 ft. of the banderhobb, which can then Bite it as a bonus action.
Swallow. Make a Bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature already grappled by the banderhobb. On a hit, swallow the creature and end the grapple. The creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover from outside attacks and effects, and takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of the banderhobb's turns. If that damage reduces it to 0 HP, it stabilizes and stops taking the necrotic damage.
The banderhobb can hold only one swallowed creature. It can expel that creature at any time without an action while free of the incapacitated condition. It also expels the creature if it dies. The creature lands prone in a space within 5 ft. of the banderhobb.
Shadow Step. Magically teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space in dim light or darkness. It can make one Bite or Tongue attack before or after teleporting.

name: Bard
description: A traveling entertainer and storyteller found among adventurers, mercenaries, and wealthy patrons.

sections.Traits: Song of Rest. During a short rest, the bard can perform for its allies. An ally who hears the song and spends Hit Dice to heal at the end of the rest regains an extra 1d6 HP. The bard can also benefit.
sections.Actions:
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Taunt (2/day). On its turn, the bard chooses one creature within 30 ft. that can hear the bard. It makes a DC 12 Charisma save. On a failure, it has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the start of the bard's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
The bard is a 4th-level bard spellcaster using Charisma (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Friends, Mage Hand, Vicious Mockery.
1st level (4 slots). Charm Person, Healing Word, Heroism, Sleep, Thunderwave.
2nd level (3 slots). Invisibility, Shatter.

name: Barghest
description: A goblin-born fiend sent by the General of Gehenna to consume seventeen goblinoid souls. It can hide among goblins while seeking powerful victims.

sections.Languages: Abyssal, Common, Goblin, Infernal, telepathy 60 ft.
sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action, the barghest can take the form of a Small goblin or return to its true form. Only its size and speed change. Its gear stays in its original form. The barghest reverts when it dies.
Fire Banishment. If the barghest starts its turn engulfed by flames at least 10 ft. high or wide, it must pass a DC 15 Charisma save or immediately return to Gehenna. Instantaneous flames, such as Fireball or a red dragon's breath, cannot banish it.
Keen Smell. The barghest has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on smell.
Soul Feeding. The barghest can take at least 1 minute to devour the body and soul of a Humanoid it killed less than 10 minutes ago. This destroys the body. Its soul remains trapped for 24 hours and is released if the barghest dies in that time. A revival that would otherwise work has a 50 percent chance while the soul is trapped and frees the soul on success. Once the soul is digested, mortal magic cannot revive the victim.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The barghest casts innately using Charisma (spell save DC 12) and needs no material components.
At will. Levitate, Minor Illusion, Pass without Trace.
1/day each. Charm Person, Dimension Door, Suggestion.

name: Bheur Hag
description: A winter hag who rides a flying staff and uses blizzards to turn isolated settlements against one another.

sections.Traits:
Graystaff Magic. The hag can ride her graystaff as a Broom of Flying. Holding it lets her cast the staff spells under Innate Spellcasting. Only a bheur hag can use the staff. Replacing it after loss or destruction takes a year and a day.
Ice Walk. The hag can walk and climb on ice without ability checks. Ice and snow that count as difficult terrain cost her no additional movement.
sections.Actions:
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.
Maddening Feast. The hag feeds on the corpse of an enemy within 5 ft. that died in the past minute. Any creatures she chooses within 60 ft. that can see her must make a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, a creature is frightened of her for 1 minute. While frightened this way, it is incapacitated. It cannot read or understand speech and speaks only gibberish. The DM controls its erratic movement. The creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A successful save or the end of the effect makes the creature immune to this hag's Maddening Feast for 24 hours.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
The hag uses Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks) and needs no material components.
At will. Ray of Frost.
1/day. Control Weather.
While holding the graystaff. Hold Person at will. Cone of Cold, Ice Storm, and Wall of Ice 3/day each.
sections.Coven challenge: A bheur hag in a coven is CR 9 (5,000 XP). Use the Bheur Hag (Coven) profile for standard shared spells, or the Death, Nature, or Prophecy profile for the corresponding spell list.

Optional lair actions for powerful hags. Grandmothers usually have three to five options. Aunties usually have at most one. On initiative count 20, after any creature tied with the hag, she can use one available option while in her lair and able to act. She cannot use the same option in consecutive rounds. If surprised, she must finish her first turn before she can use one. If an effect calls for a saving throw without giving a DC, use the DC of the hag's most powerful ability.

It lasts until initiative count 20 of the next round and lightly obscures creatures and objects in it. A creature that starts its turn there or enters for the first time on a turn is blinded until that same initiative count.

If surprised, she must finish her first turn before she can use one. If an effect calls for a saving throw without giving a DC, use the DC of the hag's most powerful ability.
Pass Through Surfaces. The hag can pass through solid doors, walls, ceilings, and floors until initiative count 20 of the next round.
Doors and Windows. Open or close any number of visible doors and windows, choosing separately for each. A door closed this way can be magically locked. Forcing it open requires a DC 20 Strength check. The lock lasts until she unlocks the door or opens it with this lair action.
Blizzard. Center a cylinder 40 ft. tall and 20 ft. in radius on a point the hag can see within 120 ft. It lasts until initiative count 20 of the next round and lightly obscures creatures and objects in it. A creature that starts its turn there or enters for the first time on a turn is blinded until that same initiative count.
sections.Regional effects:
Pick regional effects for the hag's lair. A typical hag lair has three to five. Powerful hags and covens usually have more than a lone hag. If an effect calls for a save without giving a DC, use that of the hag's most powerful ability. When the hag dies or abandons the lair, effects can end immediately or fade within 2d10 days.
A grandmother's lair can produce any of the following within 1 mile. Appropriate small animals become unusually abundant. Beasts with Intelligence 2 or lower are charmed by the hag and act aggressively toward intruders at her direction. Carved figures, twig fetishes, or rag dolls appear in trees.
A powerful bheur hag can add any of the following within 1 mile. Snow slides can block routes or bury creatures, leaving them restrained and holding their breath until dug out. Human-sized blocks of ice contain bodies that can break out as zombies or release specters. Blizzards strike once every 2d12 hours and last 1d3 hours, halving overland speed and reducing normal visibility to 30 ft. Routes can loop back on themselves, making navigation difficult.
sections.Shared coven spellcasting:
All three members must be within 30 ft. of one another to cast these spells. They draw from a single pool of slots, so one hag's casting spends a slot for the whole coven. Each counts as a 12th-level spellcaster for these wizard spells and uses Intelligence (save DC 13, +5 to hit).
Level 1 (4 shared slots). False Life, Inflict Wounds.
Level 2 (3 shared slots). Gentle Repose, Ray Of Enfeeblement.
Level 3 (3 shared slots). Animate Dead, Revivify, Speak With Dead.
Level 4 (3 shared slots). Blight, Death Ward.
Level 5 (2 shared slots). Contagion, Raise Dead.
Level 6 (1 shared slot). Circle Of Death.
sections.Hag Eye mechanics: A coven can keep one Hag Eye at a time. It has AC 10, 1 hit point, and darkvision 60 ft. Any member on the same plane as the eye can use an action to see through it. If the eye is destroyed, each member takes 3d10 psychic damage and is blinded for 24 hours. Making one takes an hour with all three hags present. None can be blinded. If any takes another action during the ritual, they must start over.

name: Bheur Hag (Coven; Nature)
description: A winter hag who rides a flying staff and uses blizzards to turn isolated settlements against one another.

sections.Traits:
Graystaff Magic. The hag can ride her graystaff as a Broom of Flying. Holding it lets her cast the staff spells under Innate Spellcasting. Only a bheur hag can use the staff. Replacing it after loss or destruction takes a year and a day.
Ice Walk. The hag can walk and climb on ice without ability checks. Ice and snow that count as difficult terrain cost her no additional movement.
sections.Actions:
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.
Maddening Feast. The hag feeds on the corpse of an enemy within 5 ft. that died in the past minute. Any creatures she chooses within 60 ft. that can see her must make a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, a creature is frightened of her for 1 minute. While frightened this way, it is incapacitated. It cannot read or understand speech and speaks only gibberish. The DM controls its erratic movement. The creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A successful save or the end of the effect makes the creature immune to this hag's Maddening Feast for 24 hours.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
The hag uses Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks) and needs no material components.
At will. Ray of Frost.
1/day. Control Weather.
While holding the graystaff. Hold Person at will. Cone of Cold, Ice Storm, and Wall of Ice 3/day each.

name: Black Guard Drake
description: A wingless dragon bred as a guard from the scales of a black dragon.

sections.Languages: Understands Draconic and cannot speak it.
sections.Traits: Amphibious. The drake can breathe air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

name: Blackguard
classification: Medium humanoid (any race), any evil alignment
description: A fallen paladin who pursues personal ambitions and allies with fiends and undead.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Glaive or Shortbow.
Glaive. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Dreadful Aspect (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). Each enemy within 30 ft. must make a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is frightened for 1 minute. A frightened target can repeat the save whenever it ends its turn more than 30 ft. from the blackguard. Success ends the effect.
sections.Spellcasting:
A 10th-level spellcaster using Charisma (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). The following paladin spells are prepared.
Level 1 (4 slots). Command, Protection from Evil and Good, Thunderous Smite.
Level 2 (3 slots). Branding Smite, Find Steed.
Level 3 (2 slots). Blinding Smite, Dispel Magic.

name: Blue Guard Drake
description: A wingless dragon bred as a guard from the scales of a blue dragon.

sections.Languages: Understands Draconic and cannot speak it.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

name: Bodak
description: An undead servant of Orcus whose gaze can drop a victim to 0 hit points. Orcus can recall what it sees and hears and can speak through it.

sections.Languages: Abyssal and the languages it knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Death Gaze. When a creature starts its turn within 30 ft. and can see the bodak's eyes, the bodak can force it to make a DC 13 Constitution save. The bodak must be able to see it and cannot use the gaze while incapacitated. A failure by 5 or more drops the creature to 0 hit points unless it is immune to being frightened. Any remaining failure deals 16 (3d10) psychic damage. A creature that is not surprised can avert its eyes at the start of its turn to avoid the save. It then has disadvantage on attacks against the bodak until the start of its next turn. If it looks at the bodak before then, it must make the save immediately.
Sunlight Hypersensitivity. The bodak takes 5 radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
Undead Nature. The bodak needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.
Withering Gaze. One creature the bodak can see within 60 ft. makes a DC 13 Constitution save. It takes 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Bonus actions: Aura of Annihilation. Turn the aura on or off. While it is active, any creature that ends its turn within 30 ft. of the bodak takes 5 necrotic damage. Undead and fiends ignore this aura.
sections.Ravaged soul: Only Wish or similar magic can restore a bodak to its former life.

name: Booyahg Booyahg Booyahg
description: A wild magic sorcerer whose spells always bring a surge. Goblins call any kind of magic booyahg.

sections.Armor: AC 15 while Mage Armor is active.
sections.Traits: Nimble Escape. On each of its turns, the goblin can use a bonus action to Disengage or Hide.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
The indexed Mage build is a 9th-level spellcaster using Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The build uses the prepared wizard spells and slots listed below.
Cantrips (at will). Fire Bolt, Light, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation.
1st level (4 slots). Detect Magic, Mage Armor, Magic Missile, Shield.
2nd level (3 slots). Misty Step, Suggestion.
3rd level (3 slots). Counterspell, Fireball, Fly.
4th level (3 slots). Greater Invisibility, Ice Storm.
5th level (1 slot). Cone of Cold.
sections.Wild Magic mechanics: Every spell the goblin casts, including a cantrip, triggers a roll on the 2014 Wild Magic Surge table.
sections.Printed source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 43. The book describes a Wild Magic sorcerer. This runnable version follows the indexed 2014 Mage on Monster Manual p. 347 with the Goblin adjustments on Dungeon Master's Guide p. 282. That adaptation retains the Mage’s HP and Hit Dice. The Wild Magic Surge table is on Player's Handbook (2014) p. 104.

name: Booyahg Caster
description: A goblin who picked up one spell by spying on a hobgoblin wizard’s spellbook and rehearsing its magic.

sections.Traits: Nimble Escape. On each of its turns, the goblin can use a bonus action to Disengage or Hide.
sections.Actions:
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Spellcasting: Randomly determine one 1st-level wizard spell for this goblin. It can cast that spell once per day, using Intelligence (spell save DC 10, +2 to hit with spell attacks).
sections.Printed source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 42. Uses the 2014 Monster Manual Goblin on p. 166 with the option on Volo's p. 42.

name: Booyahg Slave of the Archfey
description: This goblin owes its magic to an archfey. A hag coven that rules the tribe can be its patron.

sections.Traits: Nimble Escape. The goblin can take Disengage or Hide as a bonus action on each of its turns.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The goblin uses Charisma (spell save DC 15) and needs no material components for these spells.
At will. Disguise Self, Mage Armor (self only), Silent Image, Speak with Animals.
1/day. Conjure Fey.
sections.Spellcasting:
The goblin is an 11th-level spellcaster. It uses Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It regains its three 5th-level spell slots when it finishes a short or long rest.
Cantrips at will. Dancing Lights, Eldritch Blast, Friends, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation, Vicious Mockery.
Warlock spells. Blink, Charm Person, Dimension Door, Dominate Beast, Faerie Fire, Fear, Hold Monster, Misty Step, Phantasmal Force, Seeming, Sleep.
sections.Reactions: Misty Escape (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). When it takes damage, the goblin turns invisible and teleports up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. The invisibility lasts until the start of its next turn or until it attacks, rolls damage, or casts a spell.
sections.Printed source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 42, and Warlock of the Archfey, p. 219. Apply the Goblin NPC features from the Dungeon Master's Guide, p. 282.

name: Booyahg Slave of the Fiend
description: This goblin owes its magic to a fiend that demands payment if the goblin breaks its promises.

sections.Traits:
Dark One's Own Luck (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). The goblin can add 1d10 to an ability check or saving throw after rolling, before the roll takes effect.
Nimble Escape. The goblin can take Disengage or Hide as a bonus action on each of its turns.
sections.Actions: Mace. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The goblin uses Charisma (spell save DC 15) and needs no material components for these spells.
At will. Alter Self, False Life, Levitate (self only), Mage Armor (self only), Silent Image.
1/day each. Feeblemind, Finger of Death, Plane Shift.
sections.Spellcasting:
The goblin is a 17th-level spellcaster. It uses Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It regains its four 5th-level spell slots when it finishes a short or long rest.
Cantrips at will. Eldritch Blast, Fire Bolt, Friends, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation, Shocking Grasp.
Warlock spells. Banishment, Burning Hands, Flame Strike, Hellish Rebuke, Magic Circle, Scorching Ray, Scrying, Stinking Cloud, Suggestion, Wall of Fire.
sections.Printed source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 42, and Warlock of the Fiend, p. 219. Apply the Goblin NPC features from the Dungeon Master's Guide, p. 282.
