description: This goblin draws magic from a Great Old One. Its patron's influence reaches anyone who stands too close.

sections.Traits:
Whispering Aura. At the start of each of the goblin's turns, the aura affects each creature it chooses within 5 ft. Each target makes a DC 15 Wisdom save, taking 10 (3d6) psychic damage on a failure. Incapacitating the goblin suppresses the aura.
Nimble Escape. The goblin can take Disengage or Hide as a bonus action on each of its turns.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The goblin uses Charisma (spell save DC 15) and needs no material components for these spells.
At will. Detect Magic, Jump, Levitate, Mage Armor (self only), Speak with Dead.
1/day each. Arcane Gate, True Seeing.
sections.Spellcasting:
The goblin is a 14th-level spellcaster. It uses Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It regains its three 5th-level spell slots when it finishes a short or long rest.
Cantrips at will. Chill Touch, Eldritch Blast, Guidance, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation, Shocking Grasp.
Warlock spells. Armor of Agathys, Arms of Hadar, Crown of Madness, Clairvoyance, Contact Other Plane, Detect Thoughts, Dimension Door, Dissonant Whispers, Dominate Beast, Telekinesis, Vampiric Touch.
sections.Printed source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 42, and Warlock of the Great Old One, p. 220. Apply the Goblin NPC features from the Dungeon Master's Guide, p. 282.

name: Booyahg Whip
description: A goblin empowered by Khurgorbaeyag to command a small retinue.

sections.Traits:
Nimble Escape. On each of its turns, the goblin can use a bonus action to Disengage or Hide.
Khurgorbaeyag's Gift. The whip has 1d3 goblins who obey its orders. Run each follower with the 2014 Goblin stat block.
sections.Actions:
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 42. Uses the 2014 Monster Manual Goblin on p. 166 with the option on Volo's p. 42.

name: Booyahg Wielder
description: A goblin who found a magic item and figured out how to activate it.

sections.Traits: Nimble Escape. On each of its turns, the goblin can use a bonus action to Disengage or Hide.
sections.Actions:
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Magic item mechanics: Choose one magic item the wielder knows how to operate, such as a Necklace of Fireballs or Circlet of Blasting. Use the selected item’s own activation, range, attack or save, and uses. The source leaves the item and any remaining charges to the DM.
sections.Printed source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 42. Uses the 2014 Monster Manual Goblin on p. 166 with the option on Volo's p. 42.

name: Catoblepas
description: A swamp-dweller that browses, eats carrion, and guards its young. The marsh around its lair grows stagnant and foul.

sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. The catoblepas has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
Stench. A creature other than a catoblepas that starts its turn within 10 ft. must make a DC 16 Constitution save. On a failure, it is poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a success, it is immune to the stench of any catoblepas for 1 hour.
sections.Actions:
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (5d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, and the target is stunned until the start of the catoblepas’s next turn unless it succeeds on a DC 16 Constitution save.
Death Ray (Recharge 5–6). Choose one creature the catoblepas can see within 30 ft. The target makes a DC 16 Constitution save, taking 36 (8d8) necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success. A failure by 5 or more deals 64 necrotic damage instead. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by the ray dies.

name: Cave Fisher
description: A subterranean ambusher that hangs from rock and reels in bats or lone travelers on a sticky thread. Dwarves use its alcoholic blood in spirits and weave the filament into rope.

sections.Traits:
Adhesive Filament. The cave fisher can spend an action to extend a sticky filament up to 60 ft. Anything that touches it sticks to it. A creature that sticks is grappled (escape DC 13) and has disadvantage on checks to escape. The filament has AC 15, 5 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. A weapon that fails to sever the filament becomes stuck. Freeing it takes an action and a successful DC 13 Strength check. Destroying the filament leaves the cave fisher unharmed, and it can extend a replacement on its next turn.
Flammable Blood. The cave fisher gains vulnerability to fire damage when it drops to half its hit points or fewer.
Spider Climb. The cave fisher can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Filament. Choose a creature grappled by the filament that weighs no more than 200 lb. It makes a DC 13 Strength save. On a failure, it is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the cave fisher, which makes a Claw attack against it as a bonus action. Reeling it in releases everyone else attached to the filament. The cave fisher cannot extend another filament until its grapple on the reeled-in creature ends.

name: Champion
description: A seasoned fighter whose battlefield or arena record makes them influential among soldiers and sought after by rulers.

sections.Traits: Indomitable (2/day). The champion can reroll a failed saving throw.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks with a Greatsword or Shortbow.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage. Add 7 (2d6) slashing damage if the champion has more than half of its maximum hit points.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. Add 7 (2d6) piercing damage if the champion has more than half of its maximum hit points.
sections.Bonus actions: Second Wind (recharges after a short or long rest). The champion regains 20 hit points.

name: Chitine
description: A multi-armed scout or warrior of a web-built colony. Chitines serve Lolth and defend their choldrith leaders.

sections.Traits:
Fey Ancestry. The chitine has advantage on saves against being charmed. Magic cannot put it to sleep.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the chitine has disadvantage on attacks and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on sight.
Web Sense. While touching a web, the chitine knows the exact location of every other creature touching it.
Web Walker. Webbing imposes no movement restrictions on the chitine.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Dagger attacks.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Choldrith
description: A spiderlike priest of Lolth that directs chitine colonies. Choldriths compete for standing and raise more chitines when their sovereign permits it.

sections.Traits:
Fey Ancestry. The choldrith has advantage on saves against being charmed. Magic cannot put it to sleep.
Spider Climb. The choldrith can climb difficult surfaces and cross ceilings upside down without an ability check.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the choldrith has disadvantage on attacks and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on sight.
Web Sense. While touching a web, the choldrith knows the exact location of every other creature touching it.
Web Walker. Webbing imposes no movement restrictions on the choldrith.
sections.Actions:
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.
Web (Recharge 5–6). Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one Large or smaller creature. A hit restrains the target in webbing. The target can use an action to break free with a successful DC 11 Strength check. Attacks can destroy the webbing, which has AC 10, 5 HP, vulnerability to fire damage and immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
The choldrith is a 4th-level cleric spellcaster using Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Guidance, Mending, Resistance, Thaumaturgy.
1st level (4 slots). Bane, Healing Word, Sanctuary, Shield of Faith.
2nd level (3 slots). Hold Person, Spiritual Weapon (dagger).

name: Cloud Giant Smiling One
description: A cloud giant trickster who prizes deception, illusion, and the advantage of an unexpected form.

sections.Traits: Keen Smell. The giant has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on smell.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Morningstar attacks.
Morningstar. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage. Add 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage if the giant had advantage on the attack roll.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +12 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage. Add 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage if the giant had advantage on the attack roll.
Change Shape. The giant magically becomes a Beast or Humanoid it has seen, or returns to its true form. Its equipment merges with the new form. Size is the only statistic that changes. It returns to its true form when it dies.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The giant uses Charisma (spell save DC 15) and needs no material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Fog Cloud, Light.
3/day each. Feather Fall, Fly, Misty Step, Telekinesis.
1/day each. Control Weather, Gaseous Form.
sections.Spellcasting:
The giant is a 5th-level bard spellcaster using Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation, Vicious Mockery.
1st level (4 slots). Cure Wounds, Disguise Self, Silent Image, Tasha’s Hideous Laughter.
2nd level (3 slots). Invisibility, Suggestion.
3rd level (2 slots). Major Image, Tongues.

name: Conjurer
description: A wizard who brings in extraplanar creatures for protection or war and can summon materials out of thin air.

sections.Armor: AC 15 while Mage Armor is active.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Benign Transportation. Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space. The conjurer can instead choose a space in range occupied by a willing Small or Medium creature, swapping places with it. The conjurer regains this option after casting a conjuration spell of 1st level or higher.
sections.Spellcasting:
The conjurer is a 9th-level wizard spellcaster using Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Acid Splash, Mage Hand, Poison Spray, Prestidigitation.
1st level (4 slots). Mage Armor, Magic Missile, Unseen Servant.
2nd level (3 slots). Cloud of Daggers, Misty Step, Web.
3rd level (3 slots). Fireball, Stinking Cloud.
4th level (3 slots). Evard’s Black Tentacles, Stoneskin.
5th level (2 slots). Cloudkill, Conjure Elemental.
The prepared spells that recharge Benign Transportation are Unseen Servant, Cloud of Daggers, Misty Step, Web, Stinking Cloud, Evard’s Black Tentacles, Cloudkill, and Conjure Elemental.

name: Darkling
description: A reclusive fey that prefers darkness and fights with a dagger.

sections.Traits:
Death Flash. When the darkling dies, its body and possessions burn to ash, with metal and magic objects surviving. The resulting nonmagical flash reaches 10 ft. from the darkling. A creature in that radius that can see the flash must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution save or be blinded until the end of its next turn.
Light Sensitivity. In bright light, the darkling has disadvantage on attacks and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on sight.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. Add 7 (2d6) piercing damage if the darkling had advantage on the attack roll.

name: Darkling Elder
description: A darkling elder uses magical darkness to set up devastating close-range attacks.

sections.Traits: Death Burn. When the elder dies, its body and possessions burn to ash, with metal and magic objects surviving. Magical light flashes out to 10 ft., and every creature in that radius makes a DC 11 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 7 (2d6) radiant damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn if it can see the flash. A successful save halves the damage and avoids the blindness.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. Add 10 (3d6) piercing damage if the elder had advantage on the attack roll.
Darkness (recharges after a short or long rest). Cast Darkness using Wisdom and without components.

name: Death Kiss
description: A floating beholderkin whose ten tentacles hold prey while it feeds.

sections.Traits: Lightning Blood. When a creature within 5 ft. hits the death kiss with a melee attack that deals piercing or slashing damage, that creature takes 5 (1d10) lightning damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Tentacle attacks. The death kiss can replace up to three attacks with Blood Drain, with at most one replacement for each tentacle that is grappling a creature.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage. A creature of Huge size or smaller is also grappled (escape DC 14) and stays restrained until the grapple ends. That tentacle cannot attack a different target while the grapple lasts. The death kiss has ten tentacles.
Blood Drain. A creature grappled by one of the death kiss’s tentacles makes a DC 16 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 22 (4d10) lightning damage, and the death kiss regains hit points equal to half that damage.

name: Deep Scion
speed: 30 ft. in humanoid form. In hybrid form, walk 20 ft., swim 40 ft.
description: An agent of an undersea power. It infiltrates settlements in humanoid form and can report its memories to its master from the water.

sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action, polymorph into a humanoid-fish hybrid or return to true form. Only speed changes. Worn and carried equipment stays as it is. The scion returns to true form when it dies.
Amphibious (hybrid form only). Breathe air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. In humanoid form, make two melee attacks. In hybrid form, make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Battleaxe (humanoid form only). Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) with two hands.
Bite (hybrid form only). Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.
Claw (hybrid form only). Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.
Psychic Screech (hybrid form only, recharges after a short or long rest). The scream carries 300 ft. Each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom save or be stunned until the end of the scion's next turn. If the scion and its master are in the same body of water, a screech made in that water telepathically sends the master the scion's memories of the previous 24 hours, regardless of distance.

name: Devourer
description: A creation of Orcus that traps dying humanoids in its ribcage and turns those who die there into undead.

sections.Traits: Fiendish Nature. It needs souls for food and can go without air, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks. The devourer can also use either Imprison Soul or Soul Rend if available.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage.
Imprison Soul. Pick one living Humanoid at 0 hit points that the devourer can see within 30 ft. The target teleports into the devourer's ribcage and is imprisoned there. It has disadvantage on death saving throws. Only one creature can be imprisoned at a time. If the captive dies, the devourer regains 25 hit points, immediately recharges Soul Rend, and gains an extra action on its next turn. At the start of that turn, it regurgitates the victim as a bonus action. A victim with 2 or fewer Hit Dice becomes a Zombie. A victim with 3 to 5 Hit Dice becomes a Ghoul. A victim with 6 or more Hit Dice becomes a Wight.
Soul Rend (Recharge 6). Each Humanoid within 20 ft. makes a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failed save, it takes 44 (8d10) necrotic damage, plus 10 damage for each living Humanoid at 0 hit points in the area. Halve the total on a successful save.

name: Diviner
description: A specialist wizard who uses divination to uncover secrets and influence an uncertain outcome.

sections.Armor: AC 15 while Mage Armor is active.
sections.Traits: Portent. When the diviner or a creature it can see makes an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check, the diviner can roll a d20 and choose to substitute the new roll. Portent recharges when the diviner casts a divination spell of 1st level or higher.
sections.Actions: Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) with two hands.
sections.Spellcasting:
The diviner is a 15th-level wizard who uses Intelligence (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Fire Bolt, Light, Mage Hand, Message, True Strike.
Level 1 (4 slots). Detect Magic (divination), Feather Fall, Mage Armor.
Level 2 (3 slots). Detect Thoughts (divination), Locate Object (divination), Scorching Ray.
Level 3 (3 slots). Clairvoyance (divination), Fly, Fireball.
Level 4 (3 slots). Arcane Eye (divination), Ice Storm, Stoneskin.
Level 5 (2 slots). Rary's Telepathic Bond (divination), Seeming.
Level 6 (1 slot). Mass Suggestion, True Seeing (divination).
Level 7 (1 slot). Delayed Blast Fireball, Teleport.
Level 8 (1 slot). Maze.

name: Draegloth
description: A four-armed, half-drow demon raised to enforce the will of a drow house.

sections.Traits: Fey Ancestry. The draegloth has advantage on saving throws against being charmed. Magic cannot put it to sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claws attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Use Charisma (spell save DC 11) and omit material components.
At will. Darkness.
1/day each. Confusion, Dancing Lights, Faerie Fire.

name: Elder Brain
description: An elder brain lives in a brine pool at the heart of a mind flayer colony. It coordinates the colony and reaches other minds across great distances.

sections.Languages: Understands Common, Deep Speech, and Undercommon. It communicates through telepathy with a range of 5 miles and cannot speak aloud.
sections.Traits:
Creature Sense. Detect creatures within 5 miles whose Intelligence is at least 4. The elder brain knows their direction, distance, and Intelligence score. Mind Blank, Nondetection, and similar magic defeat this sense.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The elder brain can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. The elder brain has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Telepathic Hub. The elder brain can hold up to ten simultaneous telepathic conversations. It may let the connected creatures hear one another telepathically.
sections.Actions:
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (4d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage. A creature of Huge size or smaller is grappled (escape DC 15) and takes 9 (1d8 + 5) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns until the grapple ends. The elder brain can grapple up to four targets.
Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6). Release magical psychic energy and choose creatures within 60 ft. Each must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence save or take 32 (5d10 + 5) psychic damage and be stunned for 1 minute. A stunned target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Psychic Link. Link with one incapacitated creature detected by Creature Sense. The elder brain perceives what the target senses until the link ends. The target notices the link once it is no longer incapacitated. It can use an action on its turn to make a DC 18 Charisma save, breaking the link and taking 10 (3d6) psychic damage on a success. The brain can end the link without an action. Separation of more than 5 miles ends the link with no consequences for the target. The elder brain can maintain up to ten psychic links.
Sense Thoughts. Read a linked creature's reasoning, emotions, and foremost thoughts. The elder brain can plant a false belief or feeling by making a Charisma (Deception) check with advantage, contested by the target's Wisdom (Insight). If the elder brain wins, the target believes the deception for 1 hour or until presented with evidence of the lie.
sections.Innate spellcasting (psionics):
Use Intelligence (spell save DC 18). These spells require no components.
At will. Detect Thoughts, Levitate.
1/day each. Dominate Monster, Plane Shift (self only).
sections.Legendary actions:
The elder brain has 3 legendary actions. It can spend one to use one option at the end of another creature's turn. Spent uses return at the start of its turn. It cannot use legendary actions while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using one.
Tentacle (1 action). Make one Tentacle attack.
Break Concentration (1 action). Choose a linked creature within 120 ft. End its concentration on a spell it cast. It takes 1d4 psychic damage per level of the spell.
Psychic Pulse (1 action). Choose a linked creature within 120 ft. Each enemy of the elder brain within 10 ft. of that target takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage.
Sever Psychic Link (1 action). End a psychic link with a creature within 120 ft. The creature has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the end of its next turn.
sections.Lair actions:
While fighting in its lair, the elder brain can use one option at initiative count 20, losing ties. It cannot use the same option in consecutive rounds. It must be able to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using a lair action.
Force Wall. Cast Wall of Force.
Psychic Inspiration. Pick a friendly creature the elder brain can sense within 120 ft. It gains advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it makes by the end of its next turn. The benefit expires if unused.
Psionic Anchor. Pick a creature the elder brain can sense within 120 ft. On a failed DC 18 Charisma save, the target is unable to leave its current space. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Regional effects:
Choose one or more effects around the lair. All end immediately when the elder brain dies.
Paranoia. Creatures within 5 miles feel that someone is following them.
Telepathic Eavesdropping. The elder brain can overhear any telepathic conversation within 5 miles. When contact first begins, the creature that initiated it makes a DC 18 Wisdom (Insight) check. A success reveals an eavesdropper without identifying it. The elder brain can join only if it has a psychic link with the initiator.
Psychic Whispers. Creatures linked to the elder brain hear faint, incomprehensible traces of its thoughts and the thoughts of others in the link.

name: Enchanter
description: A specialist wizard who uses magic to influence minds and divert attacks.

sections.Armor: AC 15 while Mage Armor is active.
sections.Actions: Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) with two hands.
sections.Reactions: Instinctive Charm. Before an attack against the enchanter hits or misses, the enchanter can try to redirect it magically if it can see the attacker within 30 ft. The attacker makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure, it targets the creature nearest to itself, excluding the enchanter and the attacker. The attacker chooses among tied creatures. This reaction recharges when the enchanter casts an enchantment spell of 1st level or higher.
sections.Spellcasting:
The enchanter is a 9th-level wizard who uses Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Friends, Mage Hand, Mending, Message.
Level 1 (4 slots). Charm Person (enchantment), Mage Armor, Magic Missile.
Level 2 (3 slots). Hold Person (enchantment), Invisibility, Suggestion (enchantment).
Level 3 (3 slots). Fireball, Haste, Tongues.
Level 4 (3 slots). Dominate Beast (enchantment), Stoneskin.
Level 5 (2 slots). Hold Monster (enchantment).

name: Evoker
description: A specialist wizard who shapes destructive spells around creatures it wants to spare.

sections.Armor: AC 15 while Mage Armor is active.
sections.Traits: Sculpt Spells. When an evocation spell the evoker casts forces other creatures it can see to make a saving throw, it can choose up to 1 + the spell's level of those creatures. They automatically succeed. If a success would deal half damage, they take no damage.
sections.Actions: Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) with two hands.
sections.Spellcasting:
The evoker is a 12th-level wizard who uses Intelligence (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Fire Bolt (evocation), Light (evocation), Prestidigitation, Ray of Frost (evocation).
Level 1 (4 slots). Burning Hands (evocation), Mage Armor, Magic Missile (evocation).
Level 2 (3 slots). Mirror Image, Misty Step, Shatter (evocation).
Level 3 (3 slots). Counterspell, Fireball (evocation), Lightning Bolt (evocation).
Level 4 (3 slots). Ice Storm (evocation), Stoneskin.
Level 5 (2 slots). Bigby's Hand (evocation), Cone of Cold (evocation).
Level 6 (1 slot). Chain Lightning (evocation), Wall of Ice (evocation).

name: Fire Giant Dreadnought
description: A dreadnought moves coal and ore in the foundry. When called to fight, it fills its two spiked shields with hot coals and charges behind them.

sections.Traits: Dual Shields. Both shields count toward the giant's AC. It must stow or drop one of them before it can throw a rock.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Fireshield attacks.
Fireshield. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 22 (4d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage and 7 (2d6) piercing damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +13 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 30 (4d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.
Shield Charge. Move up to 30 ft. in a straight line, passing through spaces occupied by creatures smaller than Huge. Make a Fireshield attack against each creature the first time the giant enters its space during this move. On a hit, the target makes a DC 21 Strength save. On a failure, the giant pushes it ahead for the rest of the move. If the target fails by 5 or more, it also falls prone and takes 18 (3d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage, or 29 (6d6 + 8) if it was already prone.

name: Firenewt Warlock of Imix
description: Firenewts build settlements around boiling springs and channels that circulate hot water. Warlocks of Imix direct their warriors on raids and claim a share of the spoils for their patron.

sections.Senses: Darkvision 120 ft., including through magical darkness.
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The firenewt can breathe air and water.
Imix's Blessing. When the firenewt reduces an enemy to 0 hit points, it gains 5 temporary hit points.
sections.Actions: Morningstar. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.
sections.Innate Spellcasting: Using Charisma, the firenewt can cast Mage Armor on itself at will without material components. Its AC is 13 while the spell is active.
sections.Spellcasting:
The firenewt is a 3rd-level warlock who casts using Charisma (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). It regains spent slots after finishing a short or long rest.
Cantrips (at will). Fire Bolt, Guidance, Light, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation.
1st- and 2nd-level spells (two 2nd-level slots). Burning Hands, Flaming Sphere, Hellish Rebuke, Scorching Ray.

name: Firenewt Warrior
description: Firenewt warriors raid from settlements heated by springs and volcanic vents. Elite warriors ride Giant Striders, which the firenewts shelter and feed in their lairs.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The firenewt can breathe air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Scimitar attacks.
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.
Spit Fire (recharges after a short or long rest). One creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 11 Dexterity save, taking 9 (2d8) fire damage on a failure or half on a success.

name: Flail Snail
description: The snail grazes on stone and mineral deposits. It leaves a glassy trail that can be harvested and worked into panes or other glassware.

sections.Traits:
Antimagic Shell. The snail has advantage on saves against spells. Spell attacks against it have disadvantage. When it succeeds on a spell save or a spell attack misses it, roll a d6 for the shell effect below.
Flail Tentacles. The snail starts with five flail tentacles. Whenever it takes at least 10 damage during a single turn, one tentacle dies. If at least one survives, the dead tentacles regrow in 1d4 days. If all five die, the snail withdraws for total cover and wails audibly out to 600 ft. until it dies 5d6 minutes later. Limb-restoring magic such as Regenerate can stop the dying process.
sections.Antimagic Shell mechanics:
1–2. An area or multitarget spell fails entirely. A spell targeting only the snail leaves it unaffected and rebounds on the caster, using that caster's slot level, spell save DC, spell attack bonus, and casting ability.
3–4. No further effect.
5–6. Each creature within 30 ft. of the snail makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 1d6 force damage per level of the spell. On a success it takes half as much.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Flail Tentacle attack per surviving tentacle, all against the same target.
Flail Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Scintillating Shell (recharges after a short or long rest). Until the end of the snail's next turn, the shell sheds bright light out to 30 ft. and dim light another 30 ft. Creatures that see the snail have disadvantage on attacks against it while the light lasts. A creature in the bright light that can see it when the effect begins must pass a DC 15 Wisdom save or be stunned until the light ends.
Shell Defense. Withdraw into the shell to gain +4 AC until it emerges.
sections.Bonus actions: Emerge. The snail can emerge from Shell Defense on its turn.
sections.Shell harvesting: An intact shell weighs about 250 lb. and can sell for 5,000 gp. A skilled armorer can make three shields from it. Each shield grants the wielder Antimagic Shell for one month. Once that magic fades, the shield can be used to craft a Spellguard Shield. Ground shell can instead be mixed into dye for a Robe of Scintillating Colors and used in its enchanting ritual.

name: Flind
description: A war band follows a single flind. Its flail is a gift from Yeenoghu, and it leads raids in person.

sections.Traits: Aura of Blood Thirst. While the flind is not incapacitated, any creature with Rampage can use a bonus action to make a bite attack while within 10 ft. of it.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one attack with each of the three listed flail attacks, or make three Longbow attacks.
Flail of Madness. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. On a failed DC 16 Wisdom save, the target must make a melee attack against a randomly chosen target within reach on its next turn. If it cannot reach any target even after moving, it loses its action that turn.
Flail of Pain. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 22 (4d10) psychic damage.
Flail of Paralysis. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. On a failed DC 16 Constitution save, the target is paralyzed until the end of its next turn.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

name: Froghemoth
description: A froghemoth hides in pools with only its three-eyed stalk above the water. Bullywugs sometimes feed and guard one as a god.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The froghemoth can breathe air and water.
Shock Susceptibility. After taking lightning damage, halve its speed and apply a −2 penalty to its AC and Dexterity saves until the end of its next turn. For the same duration, it loses reactions and Multiattack and can use only one action or one bonus action on its turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Tentacle attacks. The froghemoth can also use Tongue or Bite.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A Huge or smaller creature is grappled (escape DC 16). The froghemoth has four tentacles, and a tentacle holding a creature is unavailable against other targets.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage and swallows a Medium or smaller creature, subject to the two-creature limit below.
Tongue. Choose one visible Medium or smaller creature within 20 ft. On a failed DC 18 Strength save, pull it into an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the froghemoth. The froghemoth can then Bite that creature as a bonus action.
sections.Swallowing mechanics: The froghemoth holds up to two creatures. Each swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects outside the froghemoth, and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the froghemoth's turns. If a creature inside deals at least 20 damage to the froghemoth in one turn, the froghemoth must pass a DC 20 Constitution save at that turn's end or regurgitate all swallowed creatures. They fall prone within 10 ft. If the froghemoth dies, the swallowed creatures are no longer restrained and can spend 10 ft. of movement to exit prone.

name: Frost Giant Everlasting One
description: An everlasting one gains a troll's regeneration by accepting Vaprak's blessing. Repeated injuries can leave it with vestigial limbs or an extra head.

sections.Traits:
Extra Heads. There is a 25 percent chance that the giant has more than one head. If it does, it has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saves against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.
Regeneration. The giant regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. Acid or fire damage prevents regeneration at the start of its next turn. The giant dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and fails to regenerate.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greataxe attacks.
Greataxe. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 26 (3d12 + 7) slashing damage, or 30 (3d12 + 11) while raging.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +11 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Vaprak's Rage (recharges after a short or long rest). Enter a rage at the start of the giant's turn. It lasts 1 minute or until the giant is incapacitated. During the rage, the giant has advantage on Strength checks and saves, adds +4 to melee weapon damage rolls, and has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

name: Gauth
description: A hungry beholderkin that drains magic items and demands tribute. A flawed attempt to summon a spectator can draw a gauth through the connection.

sections.Traits:
Stunning Gaze. When a creature begins its turn within 30 ft. and can see the gauth's central eye, the gauth can force a DC 14 Wisdom save if it can see that creature and isn't incapacitated. On a failure, the creature is stunned until the start of its next turn. A creature that is not surprised can look away at the start of its turn to skip the save. It then cannot see the gauth until its next turn begins and must make the save immediately if it looks at the gauth sooner.
Death Throes. When the gauth dies, each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. It takes 13 (3d8) force damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d8) piercing damage.
Eye Rays. Choose one to three targets the gauth can see within 120 ft. Roll three d6s for the rays and reroll duplicates.
sections.Eye ray outcomes mechanics:
Devour Magic Ray (1). On a failed DC 14 Dexterity save, one randomly chosen magic item the target has loses its magical properties until the start of the gauth's next turn. Exclude single-use items such as potions and scrolls. If the item uses charges, it also loses 1d4 charges.
Enervation Ray (2). DC 14 Constitution save. The target takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.
Pushing Ray (3). On a failed DC 14 Strength save, the target moves up to 15 ft. straight away from the gauth and its speed drops by half until the start of the gauth's next turn.
Fire Ray (4). On a failed DC 14 Dexterity save, the target takes 22 (4d10) fire damage.
Paralyzing Ray (5). On a failed DC 14 Constitution save, the target is paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the paralysis on a success.
Sleep Ray (6). On a failed DC 14 Wisdom save, the target falls unconscious for 1 minute. Damage or another creature spending an action to wake the target ends the sleep. Constructs and undead are unaffected.
sections.Magical metabolism: The gauth can eat meat, but several weeks without magic force it back to its home plane.

name: Gazer
description: A Tiny beholderkin formed from a beholder's dreams. It follows its creator and harasses lone intruders.

sections.Languages: None. Mimicry lets it reproduce simple speech.
sections.Traits: Mimicry. The gazer can imitate simple speech sounds it has heard in any language. A listener can spot the imitation with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 1 piercing damage.
Eye Rays. Choose one or two targets the gazer can see within 60 ft. Roll two d4s for the rays and reroll duplicates.
sections.Eye ray outcomes mechanics:
Dazing Ray (1). On a failed DC 12 Wisdom save, the target is charmed until the start of the gazer's next turn. While charmed this way, its speed is halved and it has disadvantage on attack rolls.
Fear Ray (2). On a failed DC 12 Wisdom save, the target is frightened until the start of the gazer's next turn.
Frost Ray (3). On a failed DC 12 Dexterity save, the target takes 10 (3d6) cold damage.
Telekinetic Ray (4). On a failed DC 12 Strength save, a Medium or smaller creature moves up to 30 ft. directly away from the gazer. The ray can instead move an object weighing 10 lb. or less up to 30 ft. in any direction if no one is wearing or carrying it. The gazer can manipulate the object precisely enough to use a simple tool or open a container.
sections.Bonus actions: Aggressive. Move up to the gazer's speed toward a hostile creature it can see.
sections.Gazer familiar mechanics: Optional. The gazer can form a telepathic bond with a willing master who is at least a 3rd-level spellcaster. The master can use the gazer's senses while they are within 1 mile of each other. If the master physically harms the gazer, it leaves the master's service and breaks the bond.

name: Giant Strider
description: This birdlike reptilian creature serves as a mount for elite firenewts. Their settlements provide it with food, shelter, and breeding grounds.

sections.Traits: Fire Absorption. When exposed to fire damage, the strider regains hit points equal to half the damage it would take.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Fire Burst (Recharge 5–6). Choose a point the giant strider can see within 60 ft. Each creature in a 10-ft.-radius sphere around that point makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. It takes 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failure or half on a success. The flames spread around corners and ignite flammable objects that no creature is wearing or carrying.

name: Girallon
description: A four-armed, white-furred predator that hunts in forests and climbs the walls and rooftops of ruins.

sections.Traits: Keen Smell. The girallon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on smell.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and four Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Aggressive. Move up to the girallon's speed toward a hostile creature it can see.

name: Gnoll Flesh Gnawer
description: A gnoll skirmisher that uses short blades to run down stragglers.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Shortsword attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Sudden Rush. Increase the gnoll's speed by 60 ft. until the end of this turn. Its movement provokes no opportunity attacks during that time.
sections.Bonus actions: Rampage. When the gnoll drops a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its own turn, it can move up to half its speed and make a Bite attack.

name: Gnoll Hunter
description: A scout that picks off isolated prey with barbed arrows and uses a bone horn to alert the war band when stealth is unnecessary.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee Spear attacks or two ranged Longbow attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) if the gnoll uses both hands for a melee attack.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage and reduces the target's speed by 10 ft. until the end of its next turn.
sections.Bonus actions: Rampage. When the gnoll drops a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its own turn, it can move up to half its speed and make a Bite attack.

name: Gnoll Witherling
description: A skeletal gnoll raised through a rite to Yeenoghu. It follows living war bands and fights with a simple club.

sections.Traits: Undead Nature. The witherling needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Club attack, or make two Club attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Club. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Rampage. When the witherling drops a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its own turn, it can move up to half its speed and make a Bite attack.
sections.Reactions: Vengeful Strike. When a gnoll within 30 ft. of the witherling drops to 0 hit points, the witherling can make one melee attack.

name: Green Guard Drake
description: A wingless guardian made from green dragon scales. A newly hatched drake bonds with the first creature that feeds it and can learn simple guard commands.

sections.Languages: Understands Draconic and cannot speak it.
sections.Traits: Amphibious. The drake can breathe air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

name: Grung
description: Grungs are territorial amphibians that live in the trees of tropical forests. Green, blue, and purple grungs normally use this stat block in Volo's.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The grung breathes air and water.
Poisonous Skin. Grappling the grung or touching its skin directly triggers a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is poisoned for 1 minute. After contact ends, the creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns. A success ends the condition.
Standing Leap. The grung can jump up to 25 ft. horizontally or 15 ft. vertically from a standstill or with a running start.
Water Dependency. If the grung spends less than 1 hour immersed in water during a day, it gains one level of exhaustion at the end of that day. Magic or at least 1 hour of immersion can remove exhaustion gained this way.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. The target also takes 5 (2d4) poison damage if it fails a DC 12 Constitution saving throw.
sections.Optional Grung poison mechanics:
Use the weapon’s listed Constitution save for its extra poison damage. The color effect follows the poisoned condition from this grung.
Poison removed from a grung remains potent for 1 minute. Its poison also loses potency after 1 minute when the grung dies.
The optional effect lasts as long as the target remains poisoned by this grung.
Green. The creature can move only by climbing or jumping from a standstill. While flying, it cannot take actions or reactions until it lands.
Blue. The creature must shout or make another loud noise at both the start and the end of each turn.
Purple. The creature can move and act only to soak in liquid or mud, or to reach a place where it can soak.
Red. If food is within reach, the creature must spend its action eating.
Orange. The creature is frightened of its allies.
Gold. The creature is charmed by the grung and can speak Grung.

name: Grung Elite Warrior
description: Elite warriors command members of the lower castes. Volo gives this profile to orange warriors and gold leaders.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The grung breathes air and water.
Poisonous Skin. A creature that grapples the grung or makes direct contact with its skin must pass a DC 12 Constitution save or be poisoned for 1 minute. Once direct contact ends, the poisoned creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Standing Leap. The grung can long jump up to 25 ft. and high jump up to 15 ft. with or without a running start.
Water Dependency. A grung that spends less than 1 hour immersed in water during a day gains one level of exhaustion at the end of that day. Magic or at least 1 hour of immersion can remove exhaustion gained this way.
sections.Actions:
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. The target also takes 5 (2d4) poison damage if it fails a DC 12 Constitution save.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. The target also takes 5 (2d4) poison damage if it fails a DC 12 Constitution save.
Mesmerizing Chirr (Recharge 6). Each Humanoid or Beast within 15 ft. that can hear the chirr must pass a DC 12 Wisdom save or be stunned until the end of the grung's next turn. Grungs are immune to the chirr.
sections.Optional Grung poison mechanics:
Use the weapon’s listed Constitution save for its extra poison damage. The color effect follows the poisoned condition from this grung.
The poison loses its potency 1 minute after removal from the grung. Its poison also loses potency 1 minute after it dies.
Choose the effect that matches the grung's color. It lasts as long as the target remains poisoned by this grung.
Green. The target can move only by climbing or making standing jumps. If it is flying, it cannot take actions or reactions until it lands.
Blue. The target must shout or make another loud noise at both the start and the end of each turn.
Purple. The target must seek liquid or mud to soak in. It can move and take actions only to reach it or soak in it.
Red. If food is within reach, the target must spend its action eating.
Orange. The target is frightened of its allies.
Gold. The target is charmed by the grung and can speak Grung.

sections.Lich variant: Use the 2014 Monster Manual lich for the base rules. This variant changes its CR, languages, and legendary actions, and adds Magic Resistance, Innate Spellcasting (Psionics), Tentacles, Extract Brain, and Mind Blast. Creating a phylactery and casting Imprisonment are prerequisites to becoming an illithilich. Feeding captured souls to its phylactery maintains its tentacle strength and ability to extract brains.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The illithilich can turn a failed save into a success.
Rejuvenation. If destroyed while its phylactery survives, the illithilich returns in 1d10 days at full hit points. Its new body appears within 5 ft. of the phylactery.
Turn Resistance. The illithilich has advantage on saves against effects that turn undead.
Magic Resistance. The illithilich has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Paralyzing Touch. Melee spell attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 10 (3d6) cold damage. The target must make a DC 18 Constitution save or be paralyzed for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 21 (3d10 + 5) psychic damage. A target of Large size or smaller is grappled (escape DC 15) and must make a DC 20 Intelligence save or be stunned until the grapple ends.
Extract Brain. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated humanoid grappled by the illithilich. A hit deals 55 (10d10) piercing damage. If reduced to 0 hit points by this damage, the target dies as the illithilich extracts and eats its brain.
Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6). The illithilich releases a 60 ft. cone of magical psychic energy. Each creature in the cone makes a DC 18 Intelligence save. On a failure, it takes 27 (5d8 + 5) psychic damage and is stunned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the stun on a success.

sections.Legendary actions:
The illithilich has 3 legendary actions. It can use one option at a time at the end of another creature's turn and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It must be able to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using one.
Tentacles (1 action). Make one Tentacles attack.
Extract Brain (2 actions). Use Extract Brain.
Mind Blast (3 actions). Recharge and use Mind Blast.
Cast Spell (1–3 actions). Spend a spell slot to cast a prepared 1st-, 2nd-, or 3rd-level spell. The cost is one legendary action per level of the spell.
sections.Lair actions:
Use one magical option on initiative count 20, losing ties. The illithilich must be able to act and cannot choose the same option on consecutive rounds. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using one.
Recover Spell Slot. Roll a d8 and recover one spent slot of the rolled level or lower, if any.
Negative Energy Tether. Tether a visible creature within 30 ft. to the illithilich. Each time the illithilich takes damage, the target makes a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failure, the illithilich takes half the damage (rounded down) and the target takes the rest. The tether ends on initiative count 20 in the next round or when either creature leaves the lair.
Attack of the Dead. Spirits of creatures that died in the lair strike one visible creature within 60 ft. and disappear. The target makes a DC 18 Constitution save, taking 52 (15d6) necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

sections.Lair conjuration:
While inside its lair, the ki-rin can use each of these options once per day.
Soft Plant Material. Permanently create enough objects made from soft plant material to fill a 20 ft. cube. This can include manufactured objects such as clothing, rope, and pillows.
Hard Plant Material. Permanently create enough objects made from wood or other hard plant material to fill a 10 ft. cube.
Stone or Metal. Create enough objects made from stone or metal to fill a 2 ft. cube. They vanish after 1 hour.
sections.Regional effects:
These effects can occur within 3 miles of the lair. The effects end when the ki-rin dies, except that the vigor in plants and animals lasts 3 years.
Pure Water. Water stays pure. Deliberate contamination lasts no more than 3 minutes.
Vigor. Plants, animals, and good creatures grow toward ideal forms. They seldom attack creatures they would not normally hunt. Evil creatures find the holy atmosphere intolerable and usually stay away.
Suppression. Curses, diseases, and poisons affecting good creatures are suppressed within the area.
Control Weather. The ki-rin can cast Control Weather from anywhere within the area. The spell originates from the outdoor point nearest the lair's center. It can cast without a clear path to the sky and need not concentrate for the change to persist.
Gentle Winds. Winds support any falling non-evil creature if the ki-rin and its allies did not cause the fall. It descends 60 ft. per round and takes no falling damage.

Pack Tactics. The kobold has advantage on attacks against a target if at least one ally within 5 ft. of the target is not incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Sling. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Weapon Invention. Roll a d8 or choose one option. The kobold can use each option at most once per day. An inventor typically has one or two improvised weapons in an encounter.
1. Acid. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 5/20 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (2d6) acid damage.
2. Alchemist's Fire. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 5/20 ft., one target. On a hit, the target takes 2 (1d4) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can use an action to extinguish the flames with a successful DC 10 Dexterity check.
3. Basket of Centipedes. Throw a basket into a 5 ft. square within 20 ft. A swarm of centipedes with 11 hit points emerges and rolls initiative. It has a 50% chance of dispersing at the end of each of its turns.
4. Green Slime Pot. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 5/20 ft., one target. A hit covers the target with a patch of Green Slime. A miss puts it on a randomly chosen 5 ft. square of wall or floor within 5 ft. of the target.
5. Rot Grub Pot. Throw a pot into a 5 ft. square within 20 ft. A swarm of rot grubs emerges from the broken pot and remains a hazard in that square.
6. Scorpion on a Stick. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 1 piercing damage. The target makes a DC 9 Constitution save, taking 4 (1d8) poison damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
7. Skunk in a Cage. Release a skunk into an unoccupied space within 5 ft. The skunk rolls initiative and has AC 10, 1 hit point, speed 20 ft., and no effective attacks. It uses its action to spray a random creature within 5 ft. The target must make a DC 9 Constitution save or retch and be unable to take actions for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that does not breathe or is immune to poison automatically succeeds. The skunk can spray again after a short or long rest.
8. Wasp Nest in a Bag. Throw a bag into a 5 ft. square within 20 ft. A swarm of wasps with 11 hit points emerges and rolls initiative. It has a 50% chance of dispersing at the end of each of its turns.

name: Kobold Scale Sorcerer
description: A kobold sorcerer advises its tribe and uses magic to strengthen the warren. It may speak for a dragon that the tribe serves.

sections.Traits:
Sorcery Points. The kobold has 3 sorcery points and regains all spent points when it finishes a long rest. When it casts a spell that calls for a saving throw, it can spend all 3 points to give one target disadvantage on its first save against that spell (Heightened Spell). It can also spend 1 point when it casts a spell to skip that spell's somatic and verbal components (Subtle Spell).
Pack Tactics. The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if an ally is within 5 ft. of that creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
Sunlight Sensitivity. While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
sections.Spellcasting:
The kobold is a 3rd-level spellcaster and uses Charisma for its prepared sorcerer spells (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Fire Bolt, Mage Hand, Mending, Poison Spray.
1st level (4 slots). Charm Person, Chromatic Orb, Expeditious Retreat.
2nd level (2 slots). Scorching Ray.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Korred
description: A reclusive fey that knows stone and ore. Korreds meet weekly to dance and beat out rhythms on stone with their clubs and hooves.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Stone Camouflage. The korred has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain.
Stone's Strength. The korred rolls two extra damage dice with each weapon attack it makes while on the ground. Its attacks below include those dice.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The korred uses Wisdom for its innate spells (spell save DC 13) and supplies no components.
At will. Commune with Nature, Meld into Stone, Stone Shape.
1/day each. Conjure Elemental (cast at 6th level, summoning only a galeb duhr, gargoyle, earth elemental, or xorn), Otto's Irresistible Dance.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatclub attacks or two Rock attacks.
Greatclub. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, or 19 (3d8 + 6) if the korred is on the ground.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, or 24 (4d8 + 6) if the korred is on the ground.
sections.Bonus actions:
Command Hair. The korred has at least one 50-ft. rope made from its hair. It can command one such rope within 30 ft. to move up to 20 ft. and entangle a Large or smaller creature it can see. On a failed DC 13 Dexterity save, the rope grapples the target (escape DC 13). The target is restrained for as long as the grapple lasts. The korred can release the target as a bonus action. The target is also freed if the korred dies or becomes incapacitated.
Hair rope. The rope has AC 20 and 20 hit points. It recovers 1 hit point at the start of each of the korred's turns if it has at least 1 hit point and the korred is alive. At 0 hit points, the rope is destroyed.
sections.Magical hair: When cut, hair from the korred's head becomes the material that cut it. Korreds use iron shears to make the strands for their iron ropes.

name: Kraken Priest
classification: Medium humanoid (any race), any evil alignment
description: A kraken grants magical power to a follower. The priest's body changes to reflect its patron, sometimes growing tentacles or mouths that dribble seawater.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Amphibious. The priest can breathe air and water.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The priest uses Wisdom for its innate spells (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks) and supplies no material components.
At will. Command, Create or Destroy Water.
3/day each. Control Water, Darkness, Water Breathing, Water Walk.
1/day each. Call Lightning, Evard's Black Tentacles.
sections.Actions:
Thunderous Touch. Melee spell attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 27 (5d10) thunder damage.
Voice of the Kraken (recharges after a short or long rest). A kraken speaks through the priest in Abyssal, Infernal, or Primordial. Its voice carries 300 ft. A creature the priest chooses that can hear the words must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma save or be frightened for 1 minute. An affected creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Patron control: While on the same plane, the kraken can faintly sense the priest's thoughts. It can push aside the priest's personality and take control.

name: Leucrotta
description: This foul-smelling creature has a badgerlike head, a hyena's body, and deerlike legs. It mimics voices to draw prey into an ambush and leaves tracks that can pass for those of a deer.

sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. The leucrotta has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
Mimicry. The leucrotta imitates animal sounds and humanoid voices. A listener can recognize the imitation with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Hooves attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage. On a critical hit, roll the damage die three times instead of twice.
Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus actions:
Kicking Retreat. If the leucrotta attacks with its hooves, it can take the Disengage action as a bonus action.
Rampage. When the leucrotta drops a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, it can move up to half its speed and make one Hooves attack as a bonus action.

name: Martial Arts Adept
description: A trained monk who might guard a monastery, travel to learn new techniques, or work as a bodyguard.

sections.Traits: Unarmored Defense. The adept adds its Wisdom modifier to its AC while it wears no armor and wields no shield.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Unarmed Strikes or three Dart attacks.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, the adept may choose one additional effect. A failed DC 13 Strength save makes the target drop a held item of the adept's choice. A failed DC 13 Dexterity save knocks the target prone. A failed DC 13 Constitution save stuns the target until the end of the adept's next turn.
Dart. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Deflect Missile. When a ranged weapon attack hits the adept, it reduces the damage by 1d10 + 3. If this reduces the damage to 0, the adept catches the missile if it has a free hand and the missile is small enough to hold in one hand.

name: Master Thief
description: A thief known for daring heists. A master thief may leave fieldwork behind to run a guild or spend the proceeds in peace.

sections.Languages: Any one language, usually Common, plus Thieves' Cant.
sections.Traits:
Evasion. If a Dexterity save would let the thief take half damage, the thief takes no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.
Sneak Attack (1/turn). When the thief hits with a weapon attack, it adds 14 (4d6) damage if it had advantage on the roll. It can also add the damage if an ally that isn't incapacitated is within 5 ft. of the target and the thief didn't have disadvantage on the roll.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Shortsword attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Light Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Cunning Action. On each of its turns the thief can Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.
sections.Reactions: Uncanny Dodge. When an attacker the thief can see hits it with an attack, the thief halves the damage it takes from that attack.

name: Maw Demon
description: A demon of Yeenoghu that joins gnoll raiding parties and attacks their prey. Gnolls summon one through a ritual offering of freshly slain humanoids.

sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Rampage. When the demon drops a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, it can move up to half its speed and make one Bite attack as a bonus action.
sections.Devoured offerings mechanics: After the demon rests for 8 hours, anything it devoured goes directly into Yeenoghu's gullet.

name: Meenlock
description: A fear-born fey that hunts from a dark warren. It paralyzes victims and brings them back alive to torment them.

sections.Traits:
Fear Aura. A Beast or Humanoid that starts its turn within 10 ft. makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is frightened until the start of its next turn.
Light Sensitivity. In bright light, the meenlock has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Teleport (Recharge 5–6). Teleport to an unoccupied space within 30 ft. if both the starting space and destination are in dim light or darkness. The meenlock can use this even when it cannot see the destination.
sections.Actions: Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution save or be paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the paralysis on a success.
sections.Telepathic Torment: Up to four meenlocks can torment one incapacitated creature. They give up other uses of telepathy for the duration and can otherwise move and act normally. A creature immune to being frightened is unaffected. After the victim spends an hour incapacitated, count only meenlocks that stayed within sight of it and never became incapacitated for the whole hour. The victim makes a Wisdom save with DC 10 plus the number of qualifying meenlocks. On a failed save it takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage, or half as much on a success. The meenlocks can repeat the process. A Humanoid reduced to 0 hit points by this damage immediately becomes a full-health meenlock under the DM's control. Only Wish or divine intervention can reverse the transformation.

name: Mind Flayer Psion
description: An illithid that channels its psionic power through a broad spell repertoire and attacks prey with mind blasts and feeding tentacles.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The psion has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Spellcasting:
Innate Spellcasting (Psionics). A 10th-level spellcaster using Intelligence (save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). Its spells require no components.
At will: Guidance, Mage Hand, Vicious Mockery, True Strike, Detect Thoughts, Levitate.
1/day each: Dominate Monster, Plane Shift (self only).
1st level (4 slots): Charm Person, Command, Comprehend Languages, Sanctuary.
2nd level (3 slots): Crown of Madness, Phantasmal Force, See Invisibility.
3rd level (3 slots): Clairvoyance, Fear, Meld into Stone.
4th level (3 slots): Confusion, Stone Shape.
5th level (2 slots): Scrying, Telekinesis.
sections.Actions:
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) psychic damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 15) and must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence save or be stunned until the grapple ends.
Extract Brain. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated Humanoid grappled by the psion. A hit deals 55 (10d10) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the psion extracts its brain and kills it.
Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 15 Intelligence save against the magical blast. On a failure, the creature takes 22 (4d8 + 4) psychic damage and is stunned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the stun on a success.

name: Mindwitness
description: A Beholder transformed by illithid ceremorphosis. It relays the Elder Brain’s orders across the colony.

sections.Traits: Telepathic Hub. When the mindwitness receives a telepathic message, it can relay it telepathically to as many as seven other creatures it can see within 600 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Tentacles attack and one Bite attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 16 (4d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 20 (4d8 + 2) psychic damage. A Large or smaller target is grappled (escape DC 13) and must succeed on a DC 13 Intelligence save or be stunned until the grapple ends.
Eye Rays. Randomly roll three different rays from the list below, rerolling duplicates. Choose one to three targets the mindwitness can see within 120 ft.
sections.Eye Rays:
1. Aversion Ray. On a failed DC 13 Charisma save, the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.
2. Fear Ray. On a failed DC 13 Wisdom save, the creature is frightened for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.
3. Psychic Ray. On a failed DC 13 Intelligence save, the target takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage.
4. Slowing Ray. On a failed DC 13 Dexterity save, for 1 minute the creature’s speed is halved, it cannot take reactions, and on each of its turns it can take either an action or a bonus action. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.
5. Stunning Ray. On a failed DC 13 Constitution save, the creature is stunned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the start of each of its turns to end the effect.
6. Telekinetic Ray. On a failed DC 13 Strength save, the ray moves a creature up to 30 ft. in any direction and restrains it until the start of the mindwitness’s next turn or until the mindwitness becomes incapacitated. The ray can also move up to 30 ft. any object of 300 lb. or less that nobody is wearing or carrying, and can manipulate objects with enough control to use a simple tool or open a door or container.

name: Morkoth
description: A planar collector whose island lair draws in visitors and siphons their possessions into its hoard.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Amphibious. The morkoth breathes air and water.
sections.Spellcasting:
An 11th-level wizard spellcaster using Intelligence (save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will): Acid Splash, Mage Hand, Mending, Ray of Frost, Shocking Grasp.
1st level (4 slots): Detect Magic, Identify, Shield, Witch Bolt.
2nd level (3 slots): Darkness, Detect Thoughts, Shatter.
3rd level (3 slots): Dispel Magic, Lightning Bolt, Sending.
4th level (3 slots): Dimension Door, Evard's Black Tentacles.
5th level (3 slots): Geas, Scrying.
6th level (1 slot): Chain Lightning.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks and one Tentacles attack, or make three Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (3d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage and grapples a Large or smaller creature (escape DC 14). While grappled, the target is restrained and takes another 15 (3d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the morkoth’s turns. The morkoth cannot use Tentacles on another target until the grapple ends.
Hypnosis. Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 17 Wisdom save against the magical effect. On a failure, the morkoth charms the creature for 1 minute. The charmed target tries to get as close to the morkoth as it can. It uses its actions to Dash until it is within 5 ft. of the morkoth. The target can save again at the end of each of its turns or when it takes damage, ending the effect on a success. A creature that succeeds on its save or is no longer under the effect has advantage on saves against this morkoth’s Hypnosis for 24 hours.
sections.Reactions: Spell Reflection. When the morkoth succeeds on a save against a spell or a spell attack misses it, choose another creature it can see within 120 ft., including the caster. The spell targets that creature in its place. The new target makes its own save or the spell attack is rerolled against it.
sections.Lair actions:
In its lair, the morkoth is CR 12 (8,400 XP). At initiative count 20, losing ties, it can use one of the following options.
Hypnosis. Use Hypnosis from a point within 120 ft. The morkoth can pick a point it cannot see.
Cast a Spell. Cast Darkness, Dispel Magic, or Misty Step using Intelligence and without expending a spell slot.
sections.Regional effects:
Island Watch. The morkoth notices new creatures and objects arriving on its island or within its sanctum. As an action, it can find the location of one creature or object on the island. Visitors feel watched during their stay.
Lost Possessions. When a creature that has spent less than a year on the island finishes a short or long rest, it makes a DC 10 Intelligence (Investigation) check. On a failure, one possession goes missing. A player chooses what their character loses. The object stays hidden nearby and can be found on a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check. An hour later, an unrecovered object arrives in the morkoth’s lair. The owner immediately recognizes it there and can easily recover it.
Lure. While in its lair and not incapacitated, the morkoth can turn the enchantment on its entrances on or off at any time. A creature that can see an enchanted entrance within 30 ft. must make a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, it uses its movement on each of its turns to enter and take the most direct route toward the morkoth without knowing where the urge leads. It can save again on seeing the morkoth, at the end of each of its turns, and whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.
Alter Water. The morkoth can change the water in its lair with a thought. The change takes 1 minute and requires no action. It can make the water as clear and breathable as air or return it to ordinary water, clear or murky.
These effects end immediately when the morkoth dies.

name: Mouth of Grolantor
description: A starved hill giant that its clan keeps shackled until it needs to unleash the giant in a raid or defense.

sections.Traits:
Mouth of Madness. The giant is immune to Confusion and similar magic. On its turn, it uses all its movement to approach the nearest creature or anything else it regards as food. Roll 1d10 at the start of each of the giant’s turns to determine its action.
1–3. Make three Fist attacks against one random target within reach. If no other creature is within reach, the giant rages and gains advantage on all attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
4–5. Make one Fist attack against each creature within reach. If no other creature is within reach, the giant attacks itself once with Fist.
6–7. Make one Bite attack against a random target within reach. If no other creature is within reach, the giant is stunned until the start of its next turn.
8–10. Make one Bite attack and two Fist attacks against one random target within reach. If no other creature is within reach, the giant rages as on a roll of 1–3.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage and magically restores the giant’s hit points by the damage dealt.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

name: Necromancer
description: A wizard who specializes in life, death, and undeath. A necromancer might raise undead servants or turn the same knowledge against them.

sections.Traits: Grim Harvest (Once per Turn). When the necromancer kills a creature other than a Construct or Undead with a spell of 1st level or higher, it heals hit points equal to twice the spell’s level. A necromancy spell heals three times its level instead.
sections.Spellcasting:
A 12th-level wizard spellcaster using Intelligence (save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). An asterisk marks a necromancy spell of 1st level or higher.
Cantrips (at will): Chill Touch, Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Mending.
1st level (4 slots): False Life*, Mage Armor, Ray of Sickness*.
2nd level (3 slots): Blindness/Deafness*, Ray of Enfeeblement*, Web.
3rd level (3 slots): Animate Dead*, Bestow Curse*, Vampiric Touch*.
4th level (3 slots): Blight*, Dimension Door, Stoneskin.
5th level (2 slots): Bigby's Hand, Cloudkill.
6th level (1 slot): Circle of Death*.
sections.Actions: Withering Touch. Melee spell attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 5 (2d4) necrotic damage.

name: Neogi
description: An eel-headed, spiderlike slaver that uses venom and domination to control prey. Neogi often force Umber Hulks to serve them.

sections.Traits:
Mental Fortitude. The neogi has advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened. Magic cannot put it to sleep.
Spider Climb. The neogi can climb difficult surfaces and move along ceilings without making an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage and 14 (4d6) poison damage. On a failed DC 12 Constitution save, the target is also poisoned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.
Enslave (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). Choose one creature the neogi can see within 30 ft. On a failed DC 14 Wisdom save, the target is magically charmed for 1 day or until the neogi dies or is more than 1 mile from the target. While charmed, the target obeys its commands and cannot take reactions. The two can communicate telepathically up to 1 mile apart. Whenever the target takes damage, it can repeat the save to end the charm.

name: Neogi Hatchling
