description: The youngest neogi hatch on the body of an elder transformed into food for the brood. They feed on the elder and on one another until the strongest remain.

sections.Traits:
Mental Fortitude. The neogi rolls saves against being charmed or frightened with advantage and cannot be put to sleep by magic.
Spider Climb. The neogi climbs difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage and 7 (2d6) poison damage. The target becomes poisoned for 1 minute on a failed DC 10 Constitution save. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the poison on a success.

name: Neogi Master
description: A neogi master commands servants through magical domination and wields warlock magic granted by entities that resemble stars.

sections.Senses: Darkvision 120 ft., including through magical darkness.
sections.Languages: Common, Deep Speech, Undercommon, telepathy 30 ft.
sections.Traits:
Mental Fortitude. The neogi rolls saves against being charmed or frightened with advantage and cannot be put to sleep by magic.
Spider Climb. The neogi climbs difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
sections.Spellcasting:
The neogi is a 7th-level warlock who uses Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It recovers expended spell slots after a short or long rest.
Cantrips (at will). Eldritch Blast (range 300 ft., +4 to each damage roll), Guidance, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation, Vicious Mockery.
1st- through 4th-level spells (two 4th-level slots). Arms of Hadar, Counterspell, Dimension Door, Fear, Hold Person, Hunger of Hadar, Invisibility, Unseen Servant.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage and 14 (4d6) poison damage. The target becomes poisoned for 1 minute on a failed DC 12 Constitution save. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the poison on a success.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.
Enslave (recharges after a short or long rest). Choose one creature the neogi can see within 30 ft. On a failed DC 14 Wisdom save, the neogi magically charms it for 1 day. The charm ends early if the neogi dies or is more than 1 mile from the target. While charmed, the target obeys the neogi's orders, cannot take reactions, and shares two-way telepathy with the neogi out to 1 mile. Each time the target takes damage, it may repeat the save and end the charm on a success.

name: Neothelid
description: This immense, slime-covered worm can emerge when the tadpoles of a ruined mind flayer colony consume one another. It hunts other creatures for their brains.

sections.Traits:
Creature Sense. Within 1 mile, the neothelid detects creatures with Intelligence 4 or higher. It learns their direction, distance, and Intelligence score alone. Mind Blank, Nondetection, or similar magic shields a creature from this sense.
Magic Resistance. The neothelid rolls saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
sections.Innate Spellcasting (Psionics):
The neothelid uses Wisdom (spell save DC 16) and needs no components.
At will. Levitate.
1/day each. Confusion, Feeblemind, Telekinesis.
sections.Actions:
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage and 13 (3d8) psychic damage. A Large or smaller creature must pass a DC 18 Strength save or be swallowed. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover from attacks and other effects outside the neothelid, and takes 35 (10d6) acid damage at the start of each of the neothelid's turns. If a swallowed creature deals 30 or more damage to the neothelid on one turn, the neothelid makes a DC 18 Constitution save at the end of that turn. On a failure, it expels all swallowed creatures. They land prone in spaces within 10 ft. of it. When the neothelid dies, swallowed creatures are freed from its restraint. Each can spend 20 ft. of movement to escape the corpse, emerging prone.
Acid Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 18 Dexterity save, taking 35 (10d6) acid damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Nilbog
description: A fragment of a goblin trickster god possesses a goblin and upends the discipline of a goblinoid host. Praise and good treatment can keep the mischief in check.

sections.Traits:
Nilbogism. Before trying to damage the nilbog, a creature must pass a DC 12 Charisma save. On a failure, it is charmed until the end of its next turn and must spend its action praising the nilbog. Reversal of Fortune is the nilbog's only means of regaining hit points, even when magical healing is available.
Nimble Escape. On each of its turns, the nilbog can Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The nilbog uses Charisma (spell save DC 12) and needs no material components.
At will. Mage Hand, Tasha's Hideous Laughter, Vicious Mockery.
1/day. Confusion.
sections.Actions:
Fool's Scepter. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Reversal of Fortune. When another creature deals damage to the nilbog, the nilbog can reduce that damage to 0 and regain 1d6 hit points.
sections.Nilbog spirit (possession): Without a host, the invisible spirit has a flying speed of 30 ft., cannot speak or be attacked, and can take only one kind of action: attempt to possess a goblin within 5 ft. The goblin makes a DC 15 Charisma save. On a failure, its alignment becomes chaotic evil, its Charisma rises to 15 if lower, and it gains Innate Spellcasting, Nilbogism, and Reversal of Fortune from the nilbog stat block. A success prevents this spirit from possessing that goblin for 24 hours. If the host dies or magic ends the possession (such as Hallow, Magic Circle, or Protection from Evil and Good), the spirit looks for another goblin. The spirit can leave at any time but leaves willingly only if it knows of another potential host nearby. A former host reverts to its usual statistics and loses the features granted by the spirit.

name: Orc Blade of Ilneval
description: Dedicated to Gruumsh's battle captain, these tacticians advise their chiefs and direct allied soldiers while leading from the front.

sections.Traits:
Aggressive. As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a visible hostile creature.
Foe Smiter of Ilneval. A successful longsword strike deals one extra damage die, already factored into the attack.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make either two melee Longsword attacks or two ranged Javelin attacks. If Ilneval's Command is available, the orc can issue it after both attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 14 (2d10 + 3) if wielded with two hands.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Ilneval's Command (recharge 4–6). Select up to three allied orcs within 120 ft. that can hear the blade. Each may spend its reaction to make one weapon attack.

name: Orc Claw of Luthic
description: The Cave Mother's devoted priests protect orc strongholds. A claw uses healing and warding magic and fights with the long, lacquered nails she grows in Luthic's honor.

sections.Traits: Aggressive. As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a visible hostile creature.
sections.Spellcasting:
The orc prepares cleric spells as a 5th-level caster using Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Guidance, Mending, Resistance, Thaumaturgy.
1st level (4 slots). Bane, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt.
2nd level (3 slots). Augury, Warding Bond.
3rd level (2 slots). Bestow Curse, Create Food and Water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks, or four if the orc has fewer than half its hit points remaining.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage.

name: Orc Hand of Yurtrus
description: These silent priests of death and disease tend to the dying and perform rites for the dead. They wear pale gloves in honor of Yurtrus.

sections.Languages: Understands Common and Orc. Cannot speak.
sections.Traits: Aggressive. As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a visible hostile creature.
sections.Spellcasting:
The orc prepares cleric spells as a 4th-level caster using Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). Its spells require no verbal components.
Cantrips (at will). Guidance, Mending, Resistance, Thaumaturgy.
1st level (4 slots). Bane, Detect Magic, Inflict Wounds, Protection from Evil and Good.
2nd level (3 slots). Blindness/Deafness, Silence.
sections.Actions: Touch of the White Hand. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

name: Orc Nurtured One of Yurtrus
description: This orc carries a deadly infection and can sacrifice itself to spread it to enemies nearby.

sections.Traits:
Corrupted Carrier. When the orc drops to 0 HP, it bursts. Every creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, the creature takes 14 (4d6) poison damage, is poisoned and can't regain HP while poisoned this way. On a success, the creature takes half damage and avoids the condition. A creature poisoned by the burst repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Nurtured One of Yurtrus. The orc has advantage on saves against disease and poison.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) necrotic damage.
Corrupted Vengeance. The orc drops its own HP to 0, activating Corrupted Carrier.
sections.Bonus actions: Aggressive. The orc moves up to its speed toward a hostile creature it can see.

name: Orc Red Fang of Shargaas
description: An orc ambusher that can see through its own magical darkness and strikes hardest before its victims get a turn.

sections.Traits:
Hand of Shargaas. A weapon hit deals two extra damage dice, already included in the attacks below.
Shargaas's Sight. The orc's darkvision works through magical darkness.
Slayer. In the first round, the orc has advantage on attacks against creatures that haven't taken a turn. Any hit it lands that round against a creature that was surprised is a critical hit.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. The orc makes two attacks with its scimitar or dart.
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (3d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Dart. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (3d4 + 3) piercing damage.
Veil of Shargaas (recharges on a short or long rest). The orc uses Wisdom to cast Darkness without components.
sections.Bonus actions: Cunning Action. On its turn, the orc can Dash, Disengage or Hide.

name: Quickling
description: A tiny fey whose movements blur as it darts between targets with a dagger.

sections.Traits:
Blurred Movement. Attacks against the quickling have disadvantage unless it is incapacitated or restrained.
Evasion. When a Dexterity save would halve incoming damage, the quickling takes half on a failed save and no damage on a success.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. The quickling makes three dagger attacks.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d4 + 6) piercing damage.

name: Red Guard Drake
description: A red-scaled guard drake that can scramble up walls and withstand fire.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. The drake uses Bite once and Tail once.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

name: Redcap
description: A murderous fey with a sickle and heavy iron boots. The boots give away its approach and make its kick dangerous.

sections.Traits:
Iron Boots. The redcap has disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while moving.
Outsize Strength. The redcap counts as Medium for grappling. Heavy weapons don't impose disadvantage on its attacks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. The redcap makes three Wicked Sickle attacks.
Wicked Sickle. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.
Ironbound Pursuit. The redcap moves up to its speed toward a creature it can see and kicks it. On a failed DC 14 Dexterity save, that creature takes 20 (3d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage and falls prone.

name: Sea Spawn
description: A transformed humanoid that returns to the sea each day. Its body may grow fangs, poisonous quills or a tentacle.

sections.Languages: Understands Aquan and Common and cannot speak.
sections.Traits: Limited Amphibiousness. The sea spawn breathes air and water. It must spend at least 1 minute underwater in the sea each day or begin suffocating.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Two Unarmed Strikes and one attack granted by Piscine Anatomy.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Piscine Anatomy:
Choose one or more options to match the sea spawn's body.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Poison Quills. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 3 (1d6) poison damage. The creature must make a DC 12 Constitution save or become poisoned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage and grapples a Medium or smaller creature (escape DC 12). While this grapple lasts, the sea spawn can use this tentacle only on the creature it has grappled.

name: Shadow Mastiff
description: A hound of the Shadowfell that vanishes in low light and can see into the Ethereal Plane.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks while the mastiff is in dim light or darkness.
sections.Traits:
Ethereal Awareness. The mastiff sees creatures and objects on the Ethereal Plane.
Keen Hearing and Smell. The mastiff has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks using hearing or smell.
Sunlight Weakness. In bright sunlight, the mastiff has disadvantage on attacks, ability checks and saving throws.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. A creature hit must make a DC 13 Strength save or fall prone.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Blend. In dim light or darkness, the mastiff turns invisible along with anything it wears or carries. Invisibility ends if it attacks, enters bright light, becomes incapacitated or spends another bonus action to end it.

name: Shadow Mastiff Alpha
description: A hardier shadow mastiff with a howl that can frighten beasts and humanoids from hundreds of feet away.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks while the mastiff is in dim light or darkness.
sections.Traits:
Ethereal Awareness. The mastiff sees creatures and objects on the Ethereal Plane.
Keen Hearing and Smell. The mastiff has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks using hearing or smell.
Sunlight Weakness. In bright sunlight, the mastiff has disadvantage on attacks, ability checks and saving throws.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. A creature hit must make a DC 13 Strength save or fall prone.
Terrifying Howl. Each beast or humanoid within 300 ft. that can hear the alpha must make a DC 11 Wisdom save. A failed save leaves the creature frightened for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success. After a successful save or when the effect ends, the creature is immune to Terrifying Howl from any shadow mastiff for 24 hours.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Blend. In dim light or darkness, the mastiff turns invisible along with anything it wears or carries. Invisibility ends if it attacks, enters bright light, becomes incapacitated or spends another bonus action to end it.
sections.Variant hit points: Volo’s sidebar gives the alpha 42–54 hit points. This profile uses 48, the midpoint of that range.
sections.Printed source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 190, Shadow Mastiff variant sidebar.

name: Shoosuva
description: Yeenoghu sends this hyena-like demon to fight alongside an especially powerful gnoll. Its venomous tail can immobilize creatures for the war band to finish.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Bonus actions: Rampage. When the shoosuva reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its own turn, it can move up to half its speed and make one Bite attack.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tail Stinger attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 26 (4d10 + 4) piercing damage.
Tail Stinger. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. The creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned. The creature is also paralyzed while poisoned this way. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

name: Slithering Tracker
description: A creature driven by revenge can undergo a ritual to survive as a sentient puddle. A tracker slips through cracks and smothers its quarry as it feeds.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, deafened, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, unconscious.
sections.Languages: Understands the languages it knew in its previous form but cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Ambusher. In combat's first round, the tracker has advantage on attacks against creatures it surprised.
Damage Transfer. While the tracker grapples a creature, it takes half the damage dealt to it and the grappled creature takes the other half.
False Appearance. While the tracker sits motionless, a creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to distinguish it from a puddle.
Keen Tracker. The tracker makes Wisdom checks to track prey with advantage.
Liquid Form. The tracker can enter an enemy's space and stop there. It can pass through openings as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Spider Climb. The tracker can traverse difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without making an ability check.
Watery Stealth. Underwater, the tracker makes Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide with advantage and can Hide as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Life Leech. Choose one Large or smaller creature the tracker can see within 5 ft. The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 13). Until the grapple ends, it is restrained, cannot breathe unless it can breathe water, and takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The tracker can grapple only one creature at a time.

name: Spawn of Kyuss
description: Green worms infest this walking corpse and jump onto nearby humanoids. A victim's soul remains trapped in the animated corpse and cannot be raised or resurrected until the spawn is destroyed.

sections.Languages: Understands the languages it knew in life but cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Regeneration. At the start of its turn, the spawn regains 10 hit points if it has at least 1 hit point and is outside sunlight and running water. Acid, fire, or radiant damage prevents regeneration at the start of the spawn's next turn. The spawn is destroyed only if its turn starts at 0 hit points and it fails to regenerate.
Worms. An effect that targets the spawn and cures disease or removes a curse kills its worms. The spawn loses Burrowing Worm.
Undead Nature. The spawn has no need for air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks and use Burrowing Worm.
Burrowing Worm. Launch a worm at one humanoid the spawn can see within 10 ft. The worm latches onto its skin unless the humanoid succeeds on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw. The worm is a Tiny undead with AC 6, 1 hit point, speed 1 ft., and 2 (-4) in every ability score. Before it burrows, the worm can be killed normally or scraped off with an action. The spawn can use that action to launch a scraped-off worm at a humanoid it can see within 10 ft. of the worm.
If still attached at the end of the target's next turn, the worm burrows into its skin and deals 1 piercing damage. At the end of each of that target's subsequent turns, it takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage per burrowed worm, up to a total of 10d6. An infested target dies upon reaching 0 hit points and rises 10 minutes later as a spawn of Kyuss. An effect targeting the victim that cures disease or removes a curse kills all the infesting worms.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

name: Stone Giant Dreamwalker
description: A stone giant lost in the dream it believes the surface world to be. It collects objects and creatures meaningful to it, attaching them to its stony body.

sections.Traits: Dreamwalker's Charm. An enemy that starts its turn within 30 ft. of the giant must make a DC 13 Charisma saving throw unless the giant is incapacitated. On a failure it is charmed by the giant. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the charm on a success. Once it succeeds on the save, it is immune to this giant's Dreamwalker's Charm for 24 hours.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatclub attacks.
Greatclub. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Petrifying Touch. Touch one Medium or smaller creature within 10 ft. that this giant has charmed. The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be petrified. The giant can attach the petrified creature to its body. While attached to the living giant, the creature is unaffected by Greater Restoration or other magic that reverses petrification. If the giant is dead, such magic works normally, ending petrification and freeing the creature.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +10 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

name: Storm Giant Quintessent
description: A storm giant evades death by dispersing into a persistent storm. It can take giant form again to speak with visitors or defend its lair.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Amphibious. The giant can breathe air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Lightning Sword attacks or use Wind Javelin twice.
Lightning Sword. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 40 (9d6 + 9) lightning damage.
Wind Javelin. Choose one creature the giant can see within 600 ft. The giant throws a javelin of wind that counts as a magic weapon and strikes automatically for 19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage. It disappears after hitting.
sections.Legendary actions:
The giant has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. Spend the listed cost to use one option at the end of another creature's turn. The giant cannot use these actions while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it can use them after completing its first turn.
Gust (1 action). Choose one creature the giant can see within 60 ft. A magical gust pushes it up to 20 ft. in a horizontal direction the giant chooses unless it succeeds on a DC 18 Strength saving throw.
Thunderbolt (2 actions). Choose one creature the giant can see within 600 ft. It takes 22 (4d10) thunder damage on a failed DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, or half as much on a success.
One with the Storm (3 actions). The giant disperses into the storm around its lair. While dispersed, it can only take lair actions and cannot be targeted by attacks, spells, or other effects. It can end the effect at the start of any of its turns and reappear anywhere in its lair. It cannot disperse outside its lair or while another creature uses Control Weather or similar magic to calm the storm.
sections.Lair actions:
In giant or storm form, use one option on initiative count 20, losing ties. The giant cannot choose the same option two rounds in a row. It cannot use lair actions while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it can use them after completing its first turn.
Thunderclap. Choose a point anywhere in the lair. Each creature within 20 ft. must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be deafened until the end of its next turn.
Fog or Murk. Center a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog, or murky water underwater, on a point anywhere in the lair. It spreads around corners and heavily obscures its area. It lasts until the giant disperses it without using an action. Wind cannot disperse it.
Wind or Current. Create a 60-ft. line of strong wind, or a strong current underwater, that is 10 ft. wide and starts at a point anywhere in the lair. Each creature in the line must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 ft. in the direction of the gust. The gust disperses gas and vapor and extinguishes unprotected flames. Each protected flame has a 50 percent chance of going out.
sections.Regional effects:
Choose one or more effects around the lair.
High Wind. Within 1 mile, a fire can be lit only where it is sheltered from the wind.
Persistent Weather. Rain, snow, or blowing dust or sand persists within 1 mile, as appropriate for the region. Rain fills or overflows streams and rivers. Snow, dust, or sand accumulates in deep drifts or dunes.
Lightning and Thunder. Lightning flashes and thunder rolls day and night within 5 miles.
When the giant dies, lightning, thunder, and high wind cease immediately. Rain, snow, and blowing dust subside gradually within 1d8 days.
sections.Lair: A secluded place defined by the storm around it, such as a mountain peak, a waterfall, an island, a foggy lake, a reef, or a desert bluff.

name: Swashbuckler
classification: Medium humanoid (any race), any non-lawful alignment
description: A charming duelist who courts fame and adventure and often makes a living as a pirate or corsair.

sections.Traits: Suave Defense. While wearing light armor or no armor and wielding no shield, the swashbuckler adds its Charisma modifier to AC.
sections.Bonus actions: Lightfooted. The swashbuckler can Dash or Disengage as a bonus action on each of its turns.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Dagger attack and two Rapier attacks.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.
Rapier. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

name: Tanarukk
description: An orc transformed before birth by abyssal magic associated with Baphomet.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The tanarukk has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Bonus actions: Aggressive. Move up to the tanarukk's speed toward a hostile creature it can see.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Greatsword attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.
sections.Reactions: Unbridled Fury. When hit by a melee attack, make one melee weapon attack against the attacker with advantage.

name: Thorny
description: Vegepygmies keep these spiny quadrupeds as guards and hunting companions.

sections.Traits:
Plant Camouflage. The thorny has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in terrain with enough plant growth to hide it.
Regeneration. The thorny heals 5 HP at the start of its turn. Taking cold, fire, or necrotic damage prevents this healing at the start of its next turn. The thorny dies only if it starts a turn at 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
Thorny Body. At the start of its turn, the thorny deals 2 (1d4) piercing damage to each creature grappling it.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (2d6 + 1) piercing damage.

name: Tlincalli
description: These desert hunters have humanoid torsos and the bodies of giant scorpions. They use their stingers and chains to catch live prey for their young.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Longsword or Spiked Chain attack and one Sting attack.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing with two hands.
Spiked Chain. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. A Large or smaller creature hit is grappled (escape DC 11) and restrained until the grapple ends. The tlincalli can't use the chain against another target while it maintains the grapple.
Sting. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage. The creature must pass a DC 14 Constitution save or be poisoned for 1 minute. Failure by 5 or more also leaves it paralyzed for as long as it remains poisoned by the sting. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Table notes: The printed stat block lists passive Perception 13 and a Perception modifier of +4, which would normally give a passive score of 14.

name: Transmuter
description: This specialist uses magic to transform creatures and objects. Its stone can protect or grant new abilities to whoever carries it.

sections.Traits: Transmuter's Stone. The stone grants its bearer one benefit chosen by the transmuter: darkvision 60 ft., 10 ft. of extra speed while unencumbered, proficiency in Constitution saving throws, or resistance to one of acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage. The transmuter can switch the benefit when it casts a transmutation spell of 1st level or higher while carrying the stone.
sections.Spellcasting:
9th-level wizard. Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). An asterisk marks a spell eligible to change the Transmuter's Stone.
Cantrips (at will): light, mending, prestidigitation, ray of frost.
1st level (4 slots): chromatic orb, expeditious retreat*, mage armor.
2nd level (3 slots): alter self*, hold person, knock*.
3rd level (3 slots): blink*, fireball, slow*.
4th level (3 slots): polymorph*, stoneskin.
5th level (1 slot): telekinesis*.
sections.Actions: Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning with two hands.
sections.Table notes: The printed stat block gives the transmuter three 4th-level spell slots.

name: Trapper
description: A trapper flattens itself against a surface and waits until it can fold around passing prey. A victim's undigested gear can lure the next meal within reach.

sections.Traits:
False Appearance. A motionless trapper pressed against a ceiling, floor, or wall looks like part of that surface. A creature that can see it can spot it with a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation or Nature) check.
Spider Climb. The trapper can climb difficult surfaces, including the underside of ceilings, without an ability check.
sections.Actions: Smother. Choose one Large or smaller creature within 5 ft. It must pass a DC 14 Dexterity save or be grappled (escape DC 14). While held this way, it is restrained, blinded, and at risk of suffocation. At the start of each of its turns it takes 17 (4d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage until the grapple ends. The trapper can smother one creature at a time.

name: Ulitharid
description: A rare six-tentacled mind flayer can serve as an elder brain's lieutenant or lead a splinter colony. Its brain can mature into an elder brain after its body dies.

sections.Traits:
Creature Sense. The ulitharid detects creatures within 2 miles if their Intelligence is at least 4. It learns their distance, direction, and Intelligence scores. Mind blank, nondetection, and comparable magic block this sense.
Magic Resistance. The ulitharid has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Psionic Hub. An elder brain psychically linked to the ulitharid can also link to any creature the ulitharid detects with Creature Sense. The new link ends if the creature leaves both the elder brain's and the ulitharid's telepathy ranges. The link between the ulitharid and the elder brain works across any distance on the same plane. Beyond 5 miles, the ulitharid can end that link without using an action.
sections.Innate spellcasting (psionics):
Intelligence (spell save DC 17). These spells use no components.
At will: detect thoughts, levitate.
1/day each: confusion, dominate monster, eyebite, feeblemind, mass suggestion, plane shift (self only), project image, scrying, telekinesis.
sections.Actions:
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. A hit deals 27 (4d10 + 5) psychic damage. A Large or smaller creature hit is grappled (escape DC 14) and must pass a DC 17 Intelligence save or be stunned until the grapple ends.
Extract Brain. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated humanoid the ulitharid has grappled. A hit deals 55 (10d10) piercing damage. If that drops the target to 0 HP, the ulitharid kills it by eating its brain.
Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6). The ulitharid emits magical psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must pass a DC 17 Intelligence save or take 31 (4d12 + 5) psychic damage and become stunned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the stun on a success.

name: Vargouille
description: This Abyssal fiend looks like a severed head with bat wings in place of ears. Bright light stalls the curse it uses to make more of its kind.

sections.Languages: Understands Abyssal, Infernal, and any languages it knew before the transformation. It can't speak.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.
Kiss. Choose one incapacitated humanoid within 5 ft. of the vargouille. The target must pass a DC 12 Charisma save or become cursed. It loses 1 point of Charisma per hour as its head changes. Time spent in sunlight or in the area of daylight doesn't count. At Charisma 2 the target dies and its head breaks free as a new vargouille. Before the transformation finishes, remove curse, greater restoration, or similar magic can lift the curse and reverse its effects.
Stunning Shriek. Each humanoid and beast within 30 ft. that can hear the vargouille makes a DC 12 Wisdom save. A creature that fails is frightened until the end of the vargouille's next turn. It is stunned while frightened by the shriek. Once it succeeds on the save or the effect ends, it is immune to all vargouilles' Stunning Shriek for 1 hour.

name: Vegepygmy
description: A small fungus person that hunts in damp forests and caves. It communicates by hissing, gesturing, and tapping its body, and often lives among myconids and other fungi.

sections.Traits:
Plant Camouflage. The fungus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks where abundant plant growth provides concealment.
Regeneration. The fungus regains 3 hit points at the start of its turn. Cold, fire, or necrotic damage prevents this recovery at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and this trait fails to restore any.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Sling. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Russet Mold:
Identification. This reddish-brown mold grows in darkness and damp warmth. On metal, a successful DC 15 Intelligence (Nature) or Wisdom (Survival) check distinguishes it from rust.
Exposure. A creature that comes within 5 ft. must make a DC 13 Constitution save against the released spores. On a failure, it is poisoned and takes 7 (2d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns as mold sprouts on it. At the end of each of its turns, it can repeat the save to end the effect. Magic that neutralizes poison or cures disease also destroys the infestation.
New growth. A creature dies if this damage reduces it to 0 HP. If the victim is a beast, giant, or humanoid, its corpse produces newborn Vegepygmies after 24 hours. A Small corpse produces one, Medium two, Large four, Huge eight, and Gargantuan sixteen. Moldies born from beasts take the form of Thornies.
Clearing it. Each point of acid, necrotic, or radiant damage clears 1 square foot. A pound of salt, a gallon of alcohol, or magic that cures disease clears a 10-foot square. Sunlight destroys exposed patches. Weapons and most other damage have no effect.

name: Vegepygmy Chief
description: Other Vegepygmies defer to these hardy elders. Each grows clusters of spores that can poison nearby creatures and seed new mold folk.

sections.Traits:
Plant Camouflage. The fungus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks where abundant plant growth provides concealment.
Regeneration. The fungus regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn. Cold, fire, or necrotic damage prevents this recovery at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and this trait fails to restore any.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claws attacks or two melee Spear attacks.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) with a two-handed melee attack.
Spores (1/day). A spore cloud spreads in a 15-foot radius around the chief and reaches around corners. Each non-plant creature in the area makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, it is poisoned and takes 9 (2d8) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. At the end of each of its turns, it can repeat the save to end the effect.
sections.Spore-borne offspring: An eligible creature that dies while infected by the chief’s spores produces new Vegepygmies as described under Russet Mold in the Vegepygmy profile.

name: War Priest
description: A devotee of a war deity who plans battles, leads soldiers, counters hostile spellcasters, and tends to the wounded.

sections.Spellcasting:
A 9th-level cleric spellcaster using Wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Light, Mending, Sacred Flame, Spare the Dying.
1st level (4 slots). Divine Favor, Guiding Bolt, Healing Word, Shield of Faith.
2nd level (3 slots). Lesser Restoration, Magic Weapon, Prayer of Healing, Silence, Spiritual Weapon.
3rd level (3 slots). Beacon of Hope, Crusader's Mantle, Dispel Magic, Revivify, Spirit Guardians, Water Walk.
4th level (3 slots). Banishment, Freedom of Movement, Guardian of Faith, Stoneskin.
5th level (1 slot). Flame Strike, Mass Cure Wounds, Hold Monster.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks.
Maul. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Reactions: Guided Strike (recharges after a short or long rest). After the priest or another creature within 30 ft. rolls an attack, the priest can grant +10 to the roll before the hit or miss is determined.

name: Warlock of the Archfey
description: A pact with a lord of the Feywild gives this warlock magic. It may keep company with boggles, quicklings, redcaps, satyrs, or sprites.

sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The warlock uses Charisma to cast these spells (spell save DC 15) without material components.
At will. Disguise Self, Mage Armor (self only), Silent Image, Speak with Animals.
1/day. Conjure Fey.
sections.Spellcasting:
An 11th-level warlock spellcaster using Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). It regains all spent slots after a short or long rest.
Cantrips (at will). Dancing Lights, Eldritch Blast, Friends, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation, Vicious Mockery.
1st–5th level (3 5th-level slots). Blink, Charm Person, Dimension Door, Dominate Beast, Faerie Fire, Fear, Hold Monster, Misty Step, Phantasmal Force, Seeming, Sleep.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Misty Escape (recharges after a short or long rest). When the warlock takes damage, it becomes invisible and teleports up to 60 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space. It stays invisible until the start of its next turn or until it attacks, makes a damage roll, or casts a spell.

name: Warlock of the Fiend
description: An archfiend of the Lower Planes grants this warlock power. Imps or quasits sometimes serve as companions. The warlock may aid fiendish cults or hunt them down.

sections.Languages: Any two languages (usually Abyssal or Infernal).
sections.Damage resistances: Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks, unless the attack uses a silvered weapon.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The warlock uses Charisma to cast these spells (spell save DC 15) without material components.
At will. Alter Self, False Life, Levitate (self only), Mage Armor (self only), Silent Image.
1/day each. Feeblemind, Finger of Death, Plane Shift.
sections.Spellcasting:
A 17th-level warlock spellcaster using Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It regains all spent slots after a short or long rest.
Cantrips (at will). Eldritch Blast, Fire Bolt, Friends, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation, Shocking Grasp.
1st–5th level (4 5th-level slots). Banishment, Burning Hands, Flame Strike, Hellish Rebuke, Magic Circle, Scorching Ray, Scrying, Stinking Cloud, Suggestion, Wall of Fire.
sections.Traits: Dark One's Own Luck (recharges after a short or long rest). After making an ability check or saving throw, the warlock can add 1d10 to the roll before any of its effects occur.
sections.Actions: Mace. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.

name: Warlock of the Great Old One
description: This warlock draws power from a distant eldritch being. It might work alongside aberrations and cultists or investigate the harm its patron has caused.

sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The warlock uses Charisma to cast these spells (spell save DC 15) without material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Jump, Levitate, Mage Armor (self only), Speak with Dead.
1/day each. Arcane Gate, True Seeing.
sections.Spellcasting:
A 14th-level warlock spellcaster using Charisma (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It regains all spent slots after a short or long rest.
Cantrips (at will). Chill Touch, Eldritch Blast, Guidance, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation, Shocking Grasp.
1st–5th level (3 5th-level slots). Armor of Agathys, Arms of Hadar, Crown of Madness, Clairvoyance, Contact Other Plane, Detect Thoughts, Dimension Door, Dissonant Whispers, Dominate Beast, Telekinesis, Vampiric Touch.
sections.Traits: Whispering Aura. If the warlock is not incapacitated, at the start of each of its turns it chooses creatures within 5 ft. Each chosen creature makes a DC 15 Wisdom save, taking 10 (3d6) psychic damage on a failure.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Warlord
description: This renowned commander can rally devoted followers and might turn a run of victories into an army command or a claim to the throne.

sections.Traits:
Indomitable (3/day). The warlord can reroll a failed saving throw and must use the new result.
Survivor. At the start of its turn, the warlord regains 10 hit points if it has at least 1 hit point and is below half its hit point maximum.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two weapon attacks.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Legendary actions:
The warlord has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. Use one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Weapon Attack (1 action). Make one weapon attack.
Command Ally (1 action). Choose an ally the warlord can see within 30 ft. If it can see and hear the warlord, the ally can use its reaction to make one weapon attack with advantage.
Frighten Foe (2 actions). Choose a visible enemy within 30 ft. If the enemy can see and hear the warlord, it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom save or be frightened until the end of the warlord’s next turn.

name: White Guard Drake
description: A squat, wingless guard drake created with white dragon scales. It bonds with the first creature that feeds it and can learn simple commands.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Printed source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 158, Guard Drake and Chromatic Guard Drakes sidebar.

name: Wood Woad
description: A guardian grown from the sacrifice of a mortal life. It carries a club and shield of gnarled wood and takes nourishment by rooting itself in the soil.

sections.Traits:
Magic Club. The club counts as magical while in the woad's hand and deals an extra 7 (3d4) damage, already included in Club.
Plant Camouflage. The woad has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks where ample vegetation can conceal it.
Regeneration. The woad regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn while touching the ground. Taking fire damage prevents this recovery at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and fails to regenerate.
Tree Stride. Once on each of its turns, the woad can spend 10 ft. of movement to enter a living tree within 5 ft. of it and emerge in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of another living tree it can see within 60 ft. Both trees must be Large or bigger.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Club attacks.
Club. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (4d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Xvart
description: A small, blue-skinned humanoid that looks to its pack for protection. Xvarts keep bats and rats as scouts, food and allies.

sections.Traits:
Overbearing Pack. The xvart has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to shove a creature when at least one non-incapacitated ally is within 5 ft. of the target.
Raxivort's Tongue. The xvart can communicate with bats, rats, giant bats and giant rats.
sections.Bonus actions: Low Cunning. The xvart can take the Disengage action as a bonus action on each of its turns.
sections.Actions:
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Sling. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

name: Xvart Speaker
description: Each xvart tribe has one speaker who leads it and can bargain in another language.

sections.Languages: Abyssal and one other language, usually Common or Goblin.
sections.Traits:
Overbearing Pack. The xvart has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to shove a creature when at least one non-incapacitated ally is within 5 ft. of the target.
Raxivort's Tongue. The xvart can communicate with bats, rats, giant bats and giant rats.
sections.Bonus actions: Low Cunning. The xvart can take the Disengage action as a bonus action on each of its turns.
sections.Actions:
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Sling. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Printed source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 200, Xvart stat block and Xvart Speakers sidebar.

name: Xvart Warlock of Raxivort
description: An xvart that struck a pact after stealing a treasure valuable enough to draw Raxivort's attention. It hunts for the next prize with a retinue of xvarts and giant rats.

sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma is the spellcasting ability. No material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Mage Armor (self only).
sections.Spellcasting:
The xvart is a 3rd-level warlock spellcaster. Charisma is the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11, +3 to hit with spell attacks). It recovers both slots when it finishes a short or long rest.
Cantrips (at will). Eldritch Blast, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Poison Spray, Prestidigitation.
1st- and 2nd-level spells (two 2nd-level slots). Burning Hands, Expeditious Retreat, Invisibility, Scorching Ray.
sections.Traits:
Raxivort's Blessing. The xvart gains 4 temporary hit points when it reduces an enemy to 0 hit points.
Raxivort's Tongue. The xvart can communicate with bats, rats, giant bats and giant rats.
sections.Bonus actions: Low Cunning. The xvart can take the Disengage action as a bonus action on each of its turns.
sections.Actions: Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

name: Yeth Hound
description: A flying fey hound with a humanlike face and a bay that drives prey into the dark. Its pack hunts for a master and retreats to its den before dawn.

sections.Languages: Understands Common, Elvish and Sylvan but cannot speak.
sections.Damage immunities: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.
sections.Traits:
Keen Hearing and Smell. The hound has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
Sunlight Banishment. Starting its turn in sunlight sends the hound to the Deep Ethereal. It stays there while sunlight reaches the spot it left. After sunset it reappears at that spot in the Border Ethereal. It and creatures on the Material Plane can see one another across the boundary but cannot affect one another.
Telepathic Bond. When the hound and its master share a plane, the hound can magically relay what it senses and they can communicate telepathically.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage and an additional 14 (4d6) psychic damage if the target is frightened.
Baleful Baying. Each enemy that can hear the magical bay within 300 ft. must pass a DC 13 Wisdom save or be frightened through the end of the hound's next turn. The effect ends early if the hound becomes incapacitated. An affected creature starting its turn within 30 ft. of the hound must spend all its movement getting as far away as possible by the most direct route, even through hazards, before taking an action. A creature that passes the save is immune to all yeth hounds' baying for 24 hours.
Return to the Material Plane (Sunlight Banishment). While in the Border Ethereal, the hound can use its action to return when adjacent to its master or a pack mate on the Material Plane.

name: Yuan-ti Anathema
description: A six-headed yuan-ti that gained this form through a ritual in pursuit of godhood. It expects obedience from lesser yuan-ti and can take the shape of an enormous constrictor.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The anathema has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Ophidiophobia Aura. When a creature of the anathema’s choice starts its turn within 30 ft. of it and can see or hear it, the creature must make a DC 17 Wisdom save or become frightened of snakes and yuan-ti. Snakes and yuan-ti are exempt. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Success on the save or the end of the effect grants immunity to this aura for 24 hours.
Six Heads. The anathema has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saves against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned or knocked unconscious.
Shapechanger. The anathema can use its action to become a Huge giant constrictor snake or return to its true form. Its statistics remain the same. Worn and carried gear stays unchanged.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Anathema form only. Charisma is the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17). No material components.
At will. Animal Friendship (snakes only).
3/day each. Darkness, Entangle, Fear, Haste, Suggestion, Polymorph.
1/day. Divine Word.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack (anathema form only). Make two Claw attacks, one Constrict attack and one Flurry of Bites attack.
Claw (anathema form only). Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. A hit deals 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning and 7 (2d6) acid damage and grapples the target (escape DC 16). The grappled target is restrained and takes both damage amounts again at the start of each of its own turns until the grapple ends. The anathema can constrict only one target at a time.
Flurry of Bites. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. A hit deals 27 (6d6 + 6) piercing and 14 (4d6) poison damage.
sections.Optional variant traits:
Apply one or more of these options if you use the p. 98 variant rules.
Acid Slime (bonus action). The anathema coats itself in acid for 1 minute. A creature takes 5 (1d10) acid damage if it touches the anathema, hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft. or is hit by its Constrict.
Chameleon Skin. The anathema has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide.
Shed Skin (1/day, bonus action). The anathema sheds its skin to escape a grapple, shackles or another restraint. Eating the shed skin over 1 minute restores hit points equal to half its maximum.
sections.Printed source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, pp. 98 and 202. The p. 98 traits are optional.

name: Yuan-ti Broodguard
description: Yuan-ti brew a potion that turns captive humanoids into scaly guards for their eggs and settlements.

sections.Traits:
Mental Resistance. The broodguard has advantage on saves against being charmed and cannot be paralyzed by magic.
Reckless. At the start of its turn, the broodguard can give itself advantage on all melee weapon attacks that turn. If it does, attacks against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.
sections.Making a Broodguard: The magical potion immediately incapacitates a captive humanoid and transforms it into a broodguard in 1d6 + 6 days. A creature forced to drink can attempt a DC 15 Constitution save. On a success, it takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and suffers no other effect. Lesser Restoration or Remove Curse can stop an ongoing transformation. Once it finishes, only Wish can reverse it.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claws attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
sections.Optional yuan-ti traits (p. 98):
Chameleon Skin. The yuan-ti has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide.
Shed Skin (1/day). As a bonus action, it sheds its skin to slip out of a grapple, shackles, or other restraints. Eating its discarded skin for 1 minute restores half its maximum hit points.

name: Yuan-ti Malison (Type 4)
description: One or more snakelike tails trail behind this human-shaped malison. Type 4 malisons rank low in their caste and have venom only in snake form.

sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action, the yuan-ti becomes a Medium snake or returns to its true form. Its statistics stay the same, its gear keeps its shape, and death leaves it in its current form.
Magic Resistance. The yuan-ti has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Malison Type. Type 4 has a human form with one or more snakelike tails.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
In yuan-ti form, it can cast these spells without material components. Charisma sets the save DC at 13.
At will. Animal Friendship (snakes only).
3/day. Suggestion.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack (Yuan-ti Form Only). Make two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.
Bite (Snake Form Only). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. On a hit, deal 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Scimitar (Yuan-ti Form Only). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Longbow (Yuan-ti Form Only). Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Optional yuan-ti traits (p. 98):
Acid Slime. As a bonus action, the yuan-ti coats itself in acid for 1 minute. A creature takes 5 (1d10) acid damage if it touches the yuan-ti or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft.
Chameleon Skin. The yuan-ti has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide.
Shed Skin (1/day). As a bonus action, it sheds its skin to slip out of a grapple, shackles, or other restraints. Eating its discarded skin for 1 minute restores half its maximum hit points.
sections.Printed source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 96. The sidebar replaces the Malison Type trait and actions of the 2014 Monster Manual yuan-ti malison.

name: Yuan-ti Malison (Type 5)
description: Scales cover this human-shaped malison. Type 5 malisons rank low in their caste and have venom only in snake form.

sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action, the yuan-ti becomes a Medium snake or returns to its true form. Its statistics stay the same, its gear keeps its shape, and death leaves it in its current form.
Magic Resistance. The yuan-ti has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Malison Type. Type 5 has a scaled human form.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
In yuan-ti form, it can cast these spells without material components. Charisma sets the save DC at 13.
At will. Animal Friendship (snakes only).
3/day. Suggestion.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack (Yuan-ti Form Only). Make two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.
Bite (Snake Form Only). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. On a hit, deal 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Scimitar (Yuan-ti Form Only). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Longbow (Yuan-ti Form Only). Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Optional yuan-ti traits (p. 98):
Acid Slime. As a bonus action, the yuan-ti coats itself in acid for 1 minute. A creature takes 5 (1d10) acid damage if it touches the yuan-ti or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft.
Chameleon Skin. The yuan-ti has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide.
Shed Skin (1/day). As a bonus action, it sheds its skin to slip out of a grapple, shackles, or other restraints. Eating its discarded skin for 1 minute restores half its maximum hit points.
sections.Printed source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 96. The sidebar replaces the Malison Type trait and actions of the 2014 Monster Manual yuan-ti malison.

name: Yuan-ti Mind Whisperer
description: A snake-headed malison who uses magic granted by Sseth to recruit followers and manipulate rivals.

sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action, the yuan-ti becomes a Medium snake or returns to its true form. Its statistics stay the same, its gear keeps its shape, and death leaves it in its current form.
Magic Resistance. The yuan-ti has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Mind Fangs (2/day). On its first melee hit on its turn, the yuan-ti can deal an extra 16 (3d10) psychic damage.
Sseth's Blessing. The yuan-ti gains 9 temporary hit points when it reduces an enemy to 0 HP.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
In yuan-ti form, it can cast these spells without material components. Charisma sets the save DC at 13.
At will. Animal Friendship (snakes only).
3/day. Suggestion.
sections.Spellcasting:
In yuan-ti form, the yuan-ti casts as a 6th-level warlock using Charisma (save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It has two 3rd-level slots for its 1st- through 3rd-level spells and recovers both slots after a short or long rest.
Cantrips (at will). Eldritch Blast (300 ft. range, +3 to each damage roll), Friends, Message, Minor Illusion, Poison Spray, Prestidigitation.
1st through 3rd level. Charm Person, Crown of Madness, Detect Thoughts, Expeditious Retreat, Fly, Hypnotic Pattern, Illusory Script.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack (Yuan-ti Form Only). Make one Bite attack and one Scimitar attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Scimitar (Yuan-ti Form Only). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
sections.Optional yuan-ti traits (p. 98):
Acid Slime. As a bonus action, the yuan-ti coats itself in acid for 1 minute. A creature takes 5 (1d10) acid damage if it touches the yuan-ti or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft.
Chameleon Skin. The yuan-ti has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide.
Shed Skin (1/day). As a bonus action, it sheds its skin to slip out of a grapple, shackles, or other restraints. Eating its discarded skin for 1 minute restores half its maximum hit points.
sections.Printed source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 204. Uses Wisdom 14 as corrected in the publisher's errata.

name: Yuan-ti Nightmare Speaker
description: A priestess of Dendar with a humanoid upper body and a snake's tail. She seeks to make her deity's nightmarish visions come true.

sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action, the yuan-ti becomes a Medium snake or returns to its true form. Its statistics stay the same, its gear keeps its shape, and death leaves it in its current form.
Magic Resistance. The yuan-ti has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Death Fangs (2/day). On its first melee hit on its turn, the yuan-ti can deal an extra 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
In yuan-ti form, it can cast these spells without material components. Charisma sets the save DC at 13.
At will. Animal Friendship (snakes only).
3/day. Suggestion.
sections.Spellcasting:
In yuan-ti form, the yuan-ti casts as a 6th-level warlock using Charisma (save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It has two 3rd-level slots for its 1st- through 3rd-level spells and recovers both slots after a short or long rest.
Cantrips (at will). Chill Touch, Eldritch Blast (300 ft. range, +3 to each damage roll), Mage Hand, Message, Poison Spray, Prestidigitation.
1st through 3rd level. Arms of Hadar, Darkness, Fear, Hex, Hold Person, Hunger of Hadar, Witch Bolt.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack (Yuan-ti Form Only). Make one Constrict attack and one Scimitar attack.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit by the attack is grappled (escape DC 14) and restrained until the grapple ends. While the grapple lasts, the yuan-ti cannot use Constrict on another target.
Scimitar (Yuan-ti Form Only). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Invoke Nightmare (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). Choose one creature the yuan-ti can see within 60 ft. The yuan-ti creates an immobile illusion of that creature's worst fear. Only the target can see it. On a failed DC 13 Intelligence save, the target takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage and becomes frightened of the illusion, believing it to be real. The illusion lasts up to 1 minute with concentration as for a spell and cannot be harmed. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns. A success ends the illusion and a failure deals another 11 (2d10) psychic damage.
sections.Optional yuan-ti traits (p. 98):
Acid Slime. As a bonus action, the yuan-ti coats itself in acid for 1 minute. A creature takes 5 (1d10) acid damage if it touches the yuan-ti, hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft., or is hit by its Constrict.
Chameleon Skin. The yuan-ti has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide.
Shed Skin (1/day). As a bonus action, it sheds its skin to slip out of a grapple, shackles, or other restraints. Eating its discarded skin for 1 minute restores half its maximum hit points.

name: Yuan-ti Pit Master
description: A priest of Merrshaulk with snakes for arms. Pit masters favor long schemes and seek to rouse their god from sleep.

sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action, the yuan-ti becomes a Medium snake or returns to its true form. Its statistics stay the same, its gear keeps its shape, and death leaves it in its current form.
Magic Resistance. The yuan-ti has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Poison's Disciple (2/day). On its first melee hit on its turn, the yuan-ti can deal an extra 16 (3d10) poison damage.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
In yuan-ti form, it can cast these spells without material components. Charisma sets the save DC at 13.
At will. Animal Friendship (snakes only).
3/day. Suggestion.
sections.Spellcasting:
In yuan-ti form, the yuan-ti casts as a 6th-level warlock using Charisma (save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It has two 3rd-level slots for its 1st- through 3rd-level spells and recovers both slots after a short or long rest.
Cantrips (at will). Eldritch Blast (300 ft. range, +3 to each damage roll), Friends, Guidance, Mage Hand, Message, Poison Spray.
1st through 3rd level. Command, Counterspell, Hellish Rebuke, Invisibility, Misty Step, Unseen Servant, Vampiric Touch.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack (Yuan-ti Form Only). Make two Bite attacks with the snake arms.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Merrshaulk's Slumber (1/day). Choose up to five creatures the yuan-ti can see within 60 ft. Each must pass a DC 13 Constitution save or fall unconscious in magical sleep for 10 minutes. A sleeping target wakes if damaged or if someone spends an action to shake or slap it awake. Creatures immune to being charmed are unaffected.
sections.Optional yuan-ti traits (p. 98):
Acid Slime. As a bonus action, the yuan-ti coats itself in acid for 1 minute. A creature takes 5 (1d10) acid damage if it touches the yuan-ti or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft.
Chameleon Skin. The yuan-ti has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide.
Shed Skin (1/day). As a bonus action, it sheds its skin to slip out of a grapple, shackles, or other restraints. Eating its discarded skin for 1 minute restores half its maximum hit points.
sections.Printed source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 206. Uses the listed attack bonus, save DCs, saving throws, and skill bonuses.

name: Abyssal Wretch
description: Creatures warped by a rutterkin’s bite can rise as abyssal wretches and follow the mob that made them.

sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage.

name: Adult Kruthik
description: Adult kruthiks carve tunnels through stone. They rush prey as a pack and fire spikes when it stays out of reach.

sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. The kruthik makes Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell with advantage.
Pack Tactics. It has advantage on an attack roll if at least one ally is within 5 ft. of its target and that ally isn’t incapacitated.
Tunneler. It can dig through solid rock at half its burrow speed, leaving a tunnel 5 ft. across.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Stab attacks or two Spike attacks.
Stab. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Spike. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Adult Oblex
description: An oblex steals memories and sends out convincing doubles of its victims. A faint sulfur smell can give a double away.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft. The oblex is blind beyond that range.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion and prone.
sections.Other skill proficiency: Give the oblex one of Arcana +7, History +7, Nature +7 or Religion +7.
sections.Traits:
Amorphous. The oblex can pass through openings 1 inch wide without squeezing.
Aversion to Fire. Taking fire damage gives it disadvantage on attacks and ability checks through the end of its next turn.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The oblex casts with Intelligence (spell save DC 15) and needs no components.
3/day each. Charm Person at 5th level, Color Spray, Detect Thoughts and Hold Person at 3rd level.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Pseudopod attack and use Eat Memories.
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) psychic damage.
Eat Memories. Choose one visible creature within 5 ft. It makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. Constructs, oozes, plants and undead automatically succeed. On a failure, the target takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage and is memory drained until it finishes a short or long rest or benefits from Greater Restoration or Heal. While drained, it subtracts 1d4 from every attack roll and ability check. Each further instance of memory drain increases the die by one step, from d4 to d6 to d8 and so on. When the die reaches d20, the creature falls unconscious for 1 hour and the effect ends after that hour. Whenever the oblex drains a creature, it learns that creature’s languages and gains its proficiencies except saving throw proficiencies.
sections.Bonus actions: Sulfurous Impersonation. Extrude a double of a Medium or smaller creature whose memories the oblex has stolen. It looks, feels and sounds like the original, with a faint smell of sulfur. The oblex can impersonate 1d4 + 1 creatures at a time. Each double shares the oblex’s body and occupies its own space alongside the main body. A slime tether reaches up to 120 ft. from the main body to each double. Damage cannot break the tether. If no path with at least 1 inch of clearance connects the two, the tether breaks and the double disappears.

name: Air Elemental Myrmidon
description: This air elemental is bound into a suit of plate armor. It has lost its memories of freedom and serves its creator.

sections.Languages: Auran and one language its creator chooses.
sections.Damage resistances: Lightning and thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Magic Weapons. The myrmidon’s weapon attacks count as magical.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Flail attacks.
Flail. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Lightning Strike (Recharge 6). Make one Flail attack. On a hit, also deal 18 (4d8) lightning damage. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution save or be stunned through the end of the myrmidon’s next turn.

name: Alkilith
description: A motionless alkilith looks like fungus growing around a window or doorway. Given time, it can turn that opening into a portal to the Abyss.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid, cold, fire and lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Amorphous. The alkilith can pass through gaps 1 inch wide without squeezing.
False Appearance. While motionless, it passes for ordinary slime or fungus.
Foment Madness. A creature other than a demon that starts its turn within 30 ft. makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. On a failure, buzzing in its head gives it disadvantage on its next attack roll, saving throw or ability check, whichever comes first. If it fails by 5 or more, it is affected by Confusion for 1 minute instead. This effect requires no concentration. The creature is immune to Foment Madness while that Confusion lasts.
Magic Resistance. The alkilith has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Tentacle attacks.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (4d6 + 4) acid damage.

name: Allip
description: An allip is the ghostly remnant of someone destroyed by a forbidden secret. It tries to pass fragments of that knowledge to others.

sections.Languages: The languages it knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Acid, fire, lightning and thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone and restrained.
sections.Traits:
Incorporeal Movement. The allip treats creatures and objects as difficult terrain when moving through them. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
Undead Nature. The allip needs no air, food, drink or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Maddening Touch. Melee spell attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (4d6 + 3) psychic damage.
Whispers of Madness. Choose up to three visible creatures within 60 ft. Each makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 7 (1d8 + 3) psychic damage and must spend its reaction to make a melee weapon attack against a creature the allip chooses and can see. Constructs and undead are immune to this effect.
Howling Babble (Recharge 6). Every creature within 30 ft. that hears the allip makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 12 (2d8 + 3) psychic damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and avoids the stun. Constructs and undead are immune to this effect.
sections.Insidious Lore: Over days or weeks, an allip can coax a scholar into recording the secret that cursed it. If the scholar records the secret, the allip can pass into the afterlife. The record can claim another victim.

name: Amnizu
description: An officer of the Nine Hells that marshals lemures into infernal legions and guards fortresses along the River Styx.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. Magical darkness doesn't interfere with the amnizu's darkvision.
Magic Resistance. The amnizu makes saving throws against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Intelligence (spell save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks). No material components.
At will. Charm Person, Command.
3/day each. Dominate Person, Fireball.
1/day each. Dominate Monster, Feeblemind.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Poison Mind, make one Taskmaster Whip attack, and make one Disruptive Touch attack.
Taskmaster Whip. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing damage and 33 (6d10) force damage.
Disruptive Touch. Melee spell attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 44 (8d10) necrotic damage.
Poison Mind. Pick one or two visible creatures within 60 ft. Each makes a DC 19 Wisdom save. On a failure it takes 26 (4d12) necrotic damage and is blinded until the start of the amnizu's next turn.
Forgetfulness (Recharge 6). Pick one visible creature within 60 ft. On a failed DC 18 Intelligence save, it is stunned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the stun on a success. A target stunned for the full minute loses all memory of the preceding 5 hours of sensations, experiences, and learning.
sections.Reactions: Instinctive Charm. When a creature within 60 ft. makes an attack roll against the amnizu and has another creature within that attack's range, the amnizu can force the attacker to make a DC 19 Wisdom save. On a failure it redirects the attack to the nearest creature other than itself or the amnizu, choosing among ties. On a success the attacker gains immunity to this amnizu's Instinctive Charm for 24 hours.
sections.Devil Summoning variant:
Some amnizus gain this optional action.
Summon Devil (1/day). Summon 2d4 Bearded Devils or 1d4 Barbed Devils in unoccupied spaces within 60 ft. They act as allies and cannot summon other devils. They remain for 1 minute or until the amnizu dies or uses an action to dismiss them.

name: Armanite
description: Abyssal heavy cavalry that tears through the flanks of an enemy formation and opens gaps with lightning.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The armanite makes saving throws against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Magic Weapons. The armanite's weapon attacks count as magical.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Hooves attack, one Claws attack, and one Serrated Tail attack.
Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing damage.
Serrated Tail. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage.
Lightning Lance (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. line 10 ft. wide makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. It takes 27 (6d8) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.

name: Astral Dreadnought
description: A lone predator of the Astral Plane whose single eye suppresses magic. Creatures it swallows arrive in a cavern holding the remains of past meals.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, stunned.
sections.Traits:
Antimagic Cone. The open eye projects Antimagic Field in a 150-ft. cone. Choose its direction at the start of each of the dreadnought's turns. The cone stops when the eye closes or the dreadnought is blinded.
Astral Entity. The dreadnought cannot willingly leave the Astral Plane or be transported or banished out of it.
Demiplanar Donjon. Swallowed creatures and objects enter a stone cavern 1,000 ft. across and 100 ft. high. Wish and Donjon Visit are the only other ways in. Only planar travel magic such as Plane Shift lets creatures leave. The dreadnought cannot be harmed from inside the cavern. The cavern cannot be destroyed while it lives. When it dies, the cavern vanishes and deposits everything inside around its corpse.
