The eidolon leaves when the statue reaches 0 hit points, when it spends a bonus action to leave, or when an effect such as Dispel Evil and Good turns or forces it out. It reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the statue.

name: Elder Oblex
description: An elder oblex feeds on memories and sends lifelike copies of its victims to lure more prey or infiltrate a settlement.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion and prone.
sections.Traits:
Amorphous. It can pass through gaps at least 1 inch wide without squeezing.
Aversion to Fire. After taking fire damage, the oblex has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks through the end of its next turn.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Intelligence sets the save DC at 18. The oblex needs no material components.
At will. Charm Person (cast at 5th level), Detect Thoughts, Hold Person.
3/day each. Confusion, Dimension Door, Dominate Person, Fear, Hallucinatory Terrain, Hold Monster, Hypnotic Pattern, Telekinesis.
sections.Bonus actions: Sulfurous Impersonation. Form a copy of one Medium or smaller creature whose memories the oblex stole. The copy looks, feels and sounds like the original but smells faintly of sulfur. The oblex can impersonate 2d6 + 1 different creatures. A strand of slime up to 120 ft. long joins each copy to the main body. The oblex occupies its own space and each copy’s space at the same time. The strand is immune to damage. If the route between the body and copy has no opening at least 1 inch wide, the strand breaks and the copy vanishes.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Pseudopod attacks and use Eat Memories.
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (4d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
Eat Memories. Choose a visible creature within 5 ft. Constructs, oozes, plants and undead automatically succeed on the DC 18 Wisdom save. On a failed save the target takes 44 (8d10) psychic damage and becomes memory drained until it finishes a short or long rest or receives Greater Restoration or Heal. It subtracts a d4 from its ability checks and attack rolls. Each further drain raises the penalty die in order from d4 to d6, d8, d10, d12 and d20. At d20 the target becomes unconscious for 1 hour, after which the effect ends. Whenever the oblex drains a target’s memories, it learns the target’s languages and gains its proficiencies except saving throw proficiencies.

name: Elder Tempest
description: A serpent of clouds and lightning travels at the center of a miles-wide storm. Its wind and rain reach far beyond its body.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained and stunned.
sections.Traits:
Air Form. The tempest can enter and stop in hostile creatures’ spaces and pass through gaps at least 1 inch wide without squeezing.
Flyby. Flying out of an enemy’s reach provokes no opportunity attack from that enemy.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the tempest fails a save, it can succeed instead.
Living Storm. A storm 1d6 + 4 miles across stays centered on the tempest. Heavy rain or snow lightly obscures the area. Rain extinguishes open flames and imposes disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing. Strong winds impose disadvantage on ranged attack rolls, extinguish open flames and disperse fog.
Siege Monster. The tempest deals double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Thunderous Slam attacks.
Thunderous Slam. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 23 (4d6 + 9) thunder damage.
Lightning Storm (Recharge 6). Each other creature within 120 ft. makes a DC 20 Dexterity save. It takes 27 (6d8) lightning damage on a failure, or half on a success. A creature that fails by 5 or more is also stunned until the end of its next turn.
sections.Legendary actions:
The tempest has three legendary actions and regains them at the start of its turn. Use one option at a time, only at the end of another creature’s turn.
Move (1 action). Move up to its speed.
Lightning Strike (2 actions). Strike a point on the ground anywhere under the storm. Each creature within 5 ft. of that point makes a DC 20 Dexterity save and takes 16 (3d10) lightning damage on a failure, or half on a success.
Screaming Gale (3 actions). The tempest sends wind and thunder down a line 1 mile long and 20 ft. wide. Objects in the line take 22 (4d10) thunder damage. A creature in the line must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity save or take 22 (4d10) thunder damage and be thrown up to 60 ft. away from the line. If it hits an immovable object, it takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage per 10 ft. traveled before impact. If it would hit another creature instead, that creature must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity save or take the same impact damage and fall prone.

name: Female Steeder
description: Duergar ride these giant hunting spiders into battle. The steeder grips prey with an adhesive from its legs.

sections.Traits:
Spider Climb. The steeder climbs difficult surfaces and can move upside down along ceilings without an ability check.
Extraordinary Leap. The steeder’s long-jump distance is tripled. Each foot of walking speed spent on a long jump moves it 3 ft.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.
Sticky Leg. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. On a hit, the creature sticks to the leg and is grappled (escape DC 12). The steeder can grapple only one creature at a time this way.

name: Fire Elemental Myrmidon
description: Ritual magic binds a fire elemental into a suit of plate armor, leaving it to fight at its creator’s command.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Languages: Ignan and one language chosen by its creator.
sections.Traits:
Illumination. The myrmidon casts bright light within 20 ft. and dim light out to 40 ft.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
Water Susceptibility. Whenever it moves 5 ft. through water at least 1 ft. deep, it takes 2 (1d4) cold damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Scimitar attacks.
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.
Fiery Strikes (Recharge 6). Use Multiattack and add 5 (1d10) fire damage to each hit.

name: Fraz-Urb’luu
description: The demon lord of illusions wears false identities even when dealing with his own cultists. He looks like a long-necked, winged gargoyle in his true form.

sections.Damage immunities: Poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical sources.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Fraz-Urb’luu can choose to succeed when he fails a saving throw.
Magic Resistance. He has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. His weapon attacks are magical.
Undetectable. Divination magic cannot target him, magical scrying sensors cannot reveal him, and abilities that sense demons or fiends cannot detect him.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma (spell save DC 23). No material components.
At will. Alter Self (can become Medium when changing his appearance), Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Phantasmal Force.
3/day each. Confusion, Dream, Mislead, Programmed Illusion, Seeming.
1/day each. Mirage Arcane, Modify Memory, Project Image.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Fist attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 22 (3d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Legendary actions:
Three legendary actions are available. Use one option at the end of another creature’s turn. Spent actions return at the start of this creature’s turn.
Tail (1 action). Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (2d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit by the tail is grappled (escape DC 24) and restrained while grappled. The tail can hold only one creature at a time.
Phantasmal Killer (2 actions). Cast Phantasmal Killer without needing concentration.
sections.Lair: Zoragmelok is a circular fortress of twisted towers and domes in Hollow’s Heart. Fraz-Urb’luu is CR 24 (62,000 XP) when encountered in his lair.
sections.Lair actions:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one option. The same option cannot be used two rounds in a row.
Move doors. Replace up to five doors within the lair with wall and open the same number of new doors in previously solid walls.
Simulacrum. Copy one humanoid within the lair as if by Simulacrum. The copy appears instantly, follows Fraz-Urb’luu’s commands, and is destroyed on the next initiative count 20.
Wave of anguish. Each creature he can see within the lair takes 33 (6d10) psychic damage if it fails a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw.
sections.Regional effects:
Intelligent creatures within 1 mile of the lair often glimpse dead friends or comrades that disappear almost immediately.
Within 6 miles, warped roads and paths loop back on themselves and make travel difficult.
A humanoid that spends at least 1 hour within 1 mile must pass a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or gain a flaw from Madness of Fraz-Urb’luu. A successful save grants immunity to this effect for 24 hours.
These effects fade over 1d10 days after Fraz-Urb’luu dies.
sections.Madness of Fraz-Urb’luu:
If a creature goes mad in the lair or within Fraz-Urb’luu’s line of sight, roll d100 for a flaw. It lasts until cured.
01–20. The creature hides the truth about its intentions and actions even when honesty would help.
21–40. Hallucinations and episodes of catatonia come and go.
41–60. The creature drifts into elaborate daydreams and has trouble telling them apart from actual memories.
61–80. The creature holds on to a belief even in the face of overwhelming evidence.
81–100. The creature’s perception of reality differs from everyone else’s, leading to violent delusions.

name: Frost Salamander
description: This Frostfell predator digs through ice and follows heat. A lit forge or campfire can draw it out of its tunnels.

sections.Traits: Burning Fury. Taking fire damage immediately recharges Freezing Breath.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make four Claws attacks and one Bite attack.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) cold damage.
Freezing Breath (Recharge 6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure it takes 44 (8d10) cold damage. It takes half as much on a success.

name: Geryon
description: An archdevil and relentless hunter who rules from Coldsteel and vies with Levistus for control of Stygia.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Geryon can choose to succeed when he fails a saving throw.
Magic Resistance. He has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. His weapon attacks are magical.
Regeneration. Geryon regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. Radiant damage prevents this recovery at the start of his next turn. He dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and fails to regenerate.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma (spell save DC 21). No material components.
At will. Alter Self (can become Medium when changing his appearance), Detect Magic, Geas, Ice Storm, Invisibility (self only), Locate Object, Suggestion, Wall of Ice.
1/day each. Divine Word, Symbol (pain only).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Claws attack and one Stinger attack.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 23 (4d6 + 9) slashing damage. A Large or smaller target is grappled (escape DC 24) and restrained until the grapple ends. Geryon can grapple one creature at a time. A target he was already grappling takes another 27 (6d8) slashing damage.
Stinger. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one creature. A hit deals 14 (2d4 + 9) piercing damage. On a failed DC 21 Constitution saving throw, the target also takes 13 (2d12) poison damage and is poisoned until it finishes a short or long rest. Its hit point maximum drops by half the poison damage taken and recovers when the poisoned condition ends. A target dies if its hit point maximum reaches 0.
Teleport. Magically move up to 120 ft. to a visible unoccupied space. Worn and carried equipment comes with Geryon.
sections.Legendary actions:
Three legendary actions are available. Use one option at the end of another creature’s turn. Spent actions return at the start of this creature’s turn.
Infernal Glare (1 action). Choose a visible creature within 60 ft. If it can see Geryon, it must pass a DC 23 Wisdom save or be frightened of him until the end of its next turn.
Swift Sting (2 actions). Make one Stinger attack.
Teleport (1 action). Use Teleport.
sections.Lair actions:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one option. The same option cannot be used two rounds in a row.
Cold burst. Center a 10-ft. cube on a point Geryon can see within 120 ft. Each creature in the cube takes 28 (8d6) cold damage on a failed DC 21 Constitution save.
Turn on an ally. Choose one creature Geryon can see within 60 ft. On a failed DC 21 Wisdom save, it is restrained for 1 minute. It can end the effect on itself by dealing damage to an ally.
Banishment. Geryon casts Banishment.
sections.Regional effects:
Within 1 mile, intelligent creatures often see shimmering portals to places they consider safe. Entering one deposits the traveler somewhere in Stygia. Freezing winds and howls fill the same area.
A creature that finishes a short or long rest within 1 mile must pass a DC 21 Wisdom save or get no benefit from that rest.
These effects fade over 1d10 days after Geryon dies.
sections.Optional variant: Sound the Horn (1/day). Summon 5d4 Minotaurs in unoccupied spaces Geryon chooses within 600 ft. They roll initiative on arrival and remain until they die or he uses an action to dismiss any or all of them.

name: Giff
description: Hippo-headed mercenaries drill in regiments and often ask to be paid in gunpowder. Their contracts let them sit out fights against other giff.

sections.Traits:
Headfirst Charge. After the giff moves at least 20 ft. in a straight line and ends within 5 ft. of a Large or smaller creature, it can force that creature to make a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and falls prone.
Firearms Knowledge. The giff ignores the loading property of muskets and pistols.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Pistol attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) if used with two hands.
Musket. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d12 + 2) piercing damage.
Pistol. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.
Fragmentation Grenade (1/day). Throw the grenade up to 60 ft. Each creature within 20 ft. of its detonation makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) piercing damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Gunpowder by the Keg: As one action, the giff lights a keg and can throw it up to 15 ft. It explodes at the start of the giff’s next turn. Each creature within 20 ft. makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure it takes 24 (7d6) fire damage and is knocked prone. On a success it takes half as much damage and the explosion does not knock it prone. Each other keg within 20 ft. has a 50 percent chance of exploding. Check each keg at most once per turn.

name: Githyanki Gish
description: Gish train for raids, espionage, and assassination by combining swordplay with psionics and wizard spells.

sections.Innate Spellcasting (Psionics):
Intelligence (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). No components.
At will. Mage Hand (invisible hand).
3/day each. Jump, Misty Step, Nondetection (self only).
1/day each. Plane Shift, Telekinesis.
sections.Spellcasting:
8th-level wizard spellcasting. Intelligence (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Blade Ward, Light, Message, True Strike.
1st level (4 slots). Expeditious Retreat, Magic Missile, Sleep, Thunderwave.
2nd level (3 slots). Blur, Invisibility, Levitate.
3rd level (3 slots). Counterspell, Fireball, Haste.
4th level (2 slots). Dimension Door.
sections.Traits: War Magic. After using its action to cast a spell, the gish can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Longsword attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage with two hands. Either hit also deals 18 (4d8) psychic damage.

name: Githyanki Kith’rak
description: Kith'raks are githyanki officers who earn their rank through grueling training and psionic tests. Each commands ten sarths, who lead squads of ten warriors.

sections.Innate Spellcasting (Psionics):
Intelligence (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). No components.
At will. Mage Hand (invisible hand).
3/day each. Blur, Jump, Misty Step, Nondetection (self only).
1/day each. Plane Shift, Telekinesis.
sections.Bonus actions: Rally the Troops. The kith'rak uses magic to end the charmed and frightened conditions on itself and on any creatures it chooses and can see within 30 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Greatsword attacks.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 17 (5d6) psychic damage.
sections.Reactions: Parry. Add 4 to AC against one melee attack that would hit the kith'rak. It must see the attacker and wield a melee weapon.

name: Githyanki Supreme Commander
description: A supreme commander leads ten kith'raks and the soldiers under them. Most ride red dragons into battle.

sections.Innate Spellcasting (Psionics):
Intelligence (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). No components.
At will. Mage Hand (invisible hand).
3/day each. Jump, Levitate (self only), Misty Step, Nondetection (self only).
1/day each. Bigby's Hand, Mass Suggestion, Plane Shift, Telekinesis.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Silver Greatsword attacks.
Silver Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage plus 17 (5d6) psychic damage. On a critical hit against a creature in an astral body, such as one using Astral Projection, the commander can sever the silver cord linking it to its material body in place of damage.
sections.Reactions: Parry. Add 5 to AC against one melee attack that would hit the commander. It must see the attacker and wield a melee weapon.
sections.Legendary actions:
The commander has 3 legendary actions. It spends the listed cost on one option at the end of another creature's turn and recovers all spent actions at the start of its own turn.
Attack (2 actions). Make one Silver Greatsword attack.
Command Ally (1 action). Pick one visible ally within 30 ft. If the ally can see or hear the commander, it can spend its reaction to make one melee weapon attack with advantage.
Teleport (1 action). Magically teleport with worn and carried gear to a visible, unoccupied space within 30 ft. The commander becomes insubstantial until the start of its next turn, treating creatures and objects as difficult terrain for movement. If it ends its turn inside an object, it takes 16 (3d10) force damage and moves to the nearest unoccupied space.

name: Githzerai Anarch
description: Githzerai anarchs lead their communities and use psionics to shape raw Limbo into settlements and citadels.

sections.Innate Spellcasting (Psionics):
Wisdom (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). No components.
At will. Mage Hand (invisible hand).
3/day each. Feather Fall, Jump, See Invisibility, Shield, Telekinesis.
1/day each. Globe of Invulnerability, Plane Shift, Teleportation Circle, Wall of Force.
sections.Traits: Psychic Defense. The anarch adds its Wisdom modifier to AC while wearing no armor and wielding no shield.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Unarmed Strikes.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage.
sections.Legendary actions:
The anarch has 3 legendary actions. It spends the listed cost on one option at the end of another creature's turn and recovers all spent actions at the start of its own turn.
Strike (1 action). Make one Unarmed Strike.
Teleport (1 action). Magically teleport with worn and carried gear to a visible, unoccupied space within 30 ft.
Change Gravity (3 actions). Cast Reverse Gravity. The anarch can orient the spell area in any direction, and objects and creatures fall toward its far end.
sections.Lair actions:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one option. The anarch cannot choose the same option in consecutive rounds.
Lightning Bolt. Cast Lightning Bolt at 5th level. The anarch can change the damage type to cold, fire, psychic, radiant, or thunder. Only lightning and fire versions ignite flammable objects.
Creation. Cast Creation at 9th level using raw Limbo rather than shadow material. In Limbo, the object lasts as long as the anarch maintains concentration, whatever the material. Concentration breaks if the anarch goes more than 120 ft. from the object.
Move Object. Pick a visible object within 150 ft. and make a Wisdom check with advantage to move it magically. The DC is 5 for Tiny, 10 for Small, 15 for Medium, 20 for Large, and 25 for Huge or larger.
sections.Regional effects:
Shape Limbo. The anarch can spend 10 minutes stabilizing a 5-mile area centered on it in Limbo. It chooses the shapes and materials of the inanimate forms that take shape there.
Keep Limbo Objects Intact. A Limbo-made object brought to the Material Plane stays stable while the anarch is within 1 mile of it. This requires no action.
When the anarch dies, both effects end after 1d6 rounds. The shaped matter unravels, and the resulting chaotic energy and matter dissipate another 1d6 rounds later.

name: Githzerai Enlightened
description: A githzerai zerth who reaches the next stage of training can use psionics to displace an enemy in time.

sections.Innate Spellcasting (Psionics):
Wisdom (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). No components.
At will. Mage Hand (invisible hand).
3/day each. Blur, Expeditious Retreat, Feather Fall, Jump, See Invisibility, Shield.
1/day each. Haste, Plane Shift, Teleport.
sections.Traits: Psychic Defense. The githzerai adds its Wisdom modifier to AC while wearing no armor and wielding no shield.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Unarmed Strikes.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) psychic damage.
Temporal Strike (Recharge 6). Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 52 (8d12) psychic damage. The creature makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure it vanishes for 1 round, then returns to its former space or the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

name: Gloom Weaver
description: A shadar-kai in the Raven Queen's service that stalks from cover and weakens nearby creatures before it attacks.

sections.Traits:
Burden of Time. Beasts and humanoids within 10 ft. of the gloom weaver have disadvantage on saving throws. Shadar-kai are exempt.
Fey Ancestry. The gloom weaver has advantage on saves against being charmed, and magic cannot put it to sleep.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). No material components.
At will. Arcane Eye, Mage Armor, Speak with Dead.
1/day each. Arcane Gate, Bane, Compulsion, Confusion, True Seeing.
sections.Spellcasting:
12th-level warlock spellcasting. Charisma (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). All spent slots return after a short or long rest.
Cantrips (at will). Chill Touch (3d8 damage), Eldritch Blast (3 beams, +4 to each beam's damage roll), Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation.
1st–5th level (three 5th-level slots). Armor of Agathys, Blight, Darkness, Dream, Invisibility, Fear, Hypnotic Pattern, Major Image, Contact Other Plane, Vampiric Touch, Witch Bolt.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Shadow Spear attacks and cast one spell with a casting time of 1 action.
Shadow Spear. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage with two hands. Either hit also deals 26 (4d12) necrotic damage.
sections.Reactions: Misty Escape (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). When the gloom weaver takes damage, it turns invisible and teleports up to 60 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space. It stays invisible until the start of its next turn, or until it attacks or casts a spell.

name: Gray Render
description: A gray render seeks an intelligent creature to bond with. It fiercely protects its master, but its impulses can wreak havoc among its allies.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claws attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d12 + 4) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller target also makes a DC 16 Strength save, falling prone on a failure.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is prone, it also takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Reactions: Bloody Rampage. When the render takes damage, it makes one Claws attack against a random creature in reach, excluding its master.
sections.Gray Render quirks:
Choose a quirk or roll a d12.
1. Detests horses and other mounts.
2. Roars if anyone touches its master.
3. Wants to cuddle.
4. Pulls up trees to chew on them.
5. Passes gas strong enough to make eyes water.
6. Gives its master gifts of meat.
7. Digs whenever it can.
8. Attacks carts and wagons as though they were monsters.
9. Howls in rain.
10. Whimpers in darkness.
11. Buries any treasure it finds.
12. Leaps at birds without regard for what it breaks.

name: Graz’zt
description: The Dark Prince rules from his Argent Palace in Zelatar. His cultists hide behind ornate masks, gather secrets, and turn other people’s appetites against them. He carries the acid-slick greatsword Angdrelve, also called Wave of Sorrow.

sections.Damage immunities: Poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing that is nonmagical.
sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action, Graz’zt takes the form of a Medium humanoid or returns to his true form. Only his size changes. Worn and carried equipment keeps its form.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Graz’zt can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. He has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. His weapon attacks are magical.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Graz’zt casts with Charisma (spell save DC 23) without material components.
At will. Charm Person, Crown of Madness, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Dissonant Whispers.
3/day each. Counterspell, Darkness, Dominate Person, Sanctuary, Telekinesis, Teleport.
1/day each. Dominate Monster, Greater Invisibility.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Wave of Sorrow attacks.
Wave of Sorrow (Greatsword). Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (4d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) acid damage.
Teleport. Graz’zt and his worn or carried equipment magically move up to 120 ft. to an unoccupied space he can see.
sections.Legendary actions:
Graz’zt has 3 legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of his turn. Use one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn. Each option costs 1 action unless stated otherwise.
Attack. Make one Wave of Sorrow attack.
Dance, My Puppet! One creature Graz’zt can see that he has charmed must spend its reaction to move up to its speed as he directs.
Sow Discord. Cast Crown of Madness or Dissonant Whispers.
Teleport. Use the Teleport action.
sections.Lair actions:
On initiative count 20, after all creatures tied at that count, Graz’zt can choose one option. He cannot choose the same option two rounds in a row.
Command. He casts Command on any number of creatures he knows are in his lair, whether or not he can see them. All targets receive the same command.
Mirrored surfaces. Smooth surfaces in the lair turn mirrorlike. Creatures there have disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide until Graz’zt uses a different lair action.
sections.Regional effects:
Flat stone or metal surfaces within 1 mile of the lair become smooth enough to give mirrorlike reflections.
Wild beasts within 6 miles fight and mate more often, as in their mating season.
A humanoid who spends at least 1 hour within 1 mile of the lair makes a DC 23 Wisdom save. On a failure, roll on the Madness of Graz’zt table. A success grants 24 hours of immunity to this regional effect.
The effects fade over 1d10 days after Graz’zt dies.
sections.Madness of Graz’zt:
If a creature goes mad in the lair or within sight of Graz’zt, roll d100. The resulting flaw lasts until cured.
01–20. Obsesses over their reflection and looks down on anyone who fails to admire them.
21–40. Treats sex as the answer to every problem and cannot see why others disagree.
41–60. Craves pleasurable food and other substances and will do anything to get more.
61–80. Passes along rumors without caring if they are true.
81–90. Feels compelled to devise elaborate rites of debauchery to honor Graz’zt.
91–100. Believes that anyone who defies their orders deserves misery.

name: Green Abishai
description: A green abishai uses illusion and charm to put rivals at odds. It works on behalf of Tiamat and can hide its influence behind a different face.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil’s Sight. Magical darkness does not block the abishai’s darkvision.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The abishai casts with Charisma (spell save DC 17) without material components.
At will. Alter Self, Major Image.
3/day each. Charm Person, Detect Thoughts, Fear.
1/day each. Confusion, Dominate Person, Mass Suggestion.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Claws and one Longsword attack, or cast one innate spell and make one Claws attack.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage, or 6 (1d10 + 1) with two hands.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. A creature hit makes a DC 16 Constitution save. On a failure, it also takes 11 (2d10) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the condition on a success.

name: Hellfire Engine
description: Infernal generals hold these siege engines in reserve for large incursions. An engine that breaks loose attacks until it runs out of targets.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, psychic. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. Spells and effects cannot change the engine’s form.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Constructed Nature. The engine needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Flesh-Crushing Stride. The engine moves up to its speed in a straight line and can cross the spaces of Large or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space it enters makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. A success pushes the creature to the nearest space outside the engine’s path. A failure deals 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage and knocks the creature prone. If the engine stays in the prone creature’s space, the creature is restrained until they no longer share that space. The restrained creature or somebody within 5 ft. of it can make a DC 18 Strength check. On a success, the creature moves to an open space it chooses within 5 ft. of the engine and is no longer restrained.
Hellfire Weapons. Choose one weapon option below. If it kills a creature, that creature’s soul rises from the River Styx as a lemure in Avernus in 1d4 hours. After that, restoring the victim to life requires Wish, or killing the lemure and casting True Resurrection on the original body. Constructs and devils are immune to the soul effect.
Bonemelt Sprayer. Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 20 Dexterity save, taking 11 (2d10) fire damage plus 18 (4d8) acid damage on a failure or half as much on a success. On a failure, burning residue also deals 5 (1d10) fire damage plus 9 (2d8) acid damage at the end of each of its turns until it or another creature within 5 ft. uses an action to scrape the residue off.
Lightning Flail. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. A hit deals 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 22 (5d8) lightning damage. Up to three other creatures the engine can see within 30 ft. of the target make DC 20 Dexterity saves, each taking 22 (5d8) lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
Thunder Cannon. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Each creature within 30 ft. of that point makes a DC 20 Dexterity save, taking 27 (5d10) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (2d12) thunder damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen’s Tome of Foes, p. 165, with the official Flesh-Crushing Stride erratum.

name: Howler
description: Howlers come from Pandemonium. Fiends train them as war hounds, then loose the pack to pin down enemies with a howl before closing in.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The howler has advantage on attacks against a creature if an ally that is not incapacitated is within 5 ft. of that creature.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rending Bite attacks.
Rending Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 22 (4d10) psychic damage if the target is frightened. The attack ignores damage resistance.
Mind-Breaking Howl (Recharge 6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone that is not deafened makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is frightened until the end of the howler’s next turn. While frightened by this howl, it moves at half speed and is incapacitated. A successful save grants immunity to Mind-Breaking Howl from all howlers for 24 hours.

name: Hutijin
description: Hutijin commands Mephistopheles’s pit fiends in Cania. He resents mortals who summon him and may come after a summoner once their bargain ends.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered.
sections.Traits:
Infernal Despair. Creatures within 15 ft. of Hutijin have disadvantage on saving throws. Devils are exempt.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Hutijin can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. He has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. His weapon attacks are magical.
Regeneration. Hutijin recovers 20 HP at the start of his turn. Taking radiant damage prevents this recovery at the start of his next turn. He dies only if he starts his turn at 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Hutijin casts with Charisma (spell save DC 22) without material components.
At will. Alter Self (may become Medium when changing appearance), Animate Dead, Detect Magic, Hold Monster, Invisibility (self only), Lightning Bolt, Suggestion, Wall of Fire.
3/day. Dispel Magic.
1/day each. Heal, Symbol (hopelessness only).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite, one Claw, one Mace, and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d6 + 8) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 22 Constitution save. On a failure, it is poisoned and cannot regain HP. It takes 10 (3d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns and can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage.
Mace. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (2d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.
Teleport. Hutijin and his equipment magically move up to 120 ft. to an unoccupied space he can see.
sections.Reactions: Fearful Voice (Recharge 5–6). When Hutijin takes damage, each creature within 30 ft. of him other than a devil makes a DC 22 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is frightened of him for 1 minute. An affected creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A successful save grants immunity to Hutijin’s Fearful Voice for 24 hours.
sections.Legendary actions:
Hutijin has 3 legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of his turn. Use one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn. Each option costs 1 action unless stated otherwise.
Attack. Make one Mace attack.
Lightning Storm (2 actions). Each other creature within 20 ft. of Hutijin makes a DC 22 Dexterity save, taking 18 (4d8) lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
Teleport. Use the Teleport action.

name: Hydroloth
description: Hydroloths make their home in the River Styx. They steal memories for their employers and take contracts to recover sunken objects, sink ships, or raid coastlines.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The hydroloth breathes air and water.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
Secure Memory. The hydroloth is immune to the River Styx and to effects that steal or change memories or detect or read its thoughts.
Watery Advantage. It has advantage on attack rolls while submerged in liquid.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The hydroloth casts with Intelligence (spell save DC 16) without material components.
At will. Darkness, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Invisibility (self only), Water Walk.
3/day each. Control Water, Crown of Madness, Fear, Phantasmal Killer, Suggestion.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks. The hydroloth can replace one attack with an innate spell that takes one action to cast.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.
Steal Memory (1/day). Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. The target takes 4d6 psychic damage and makes a DC 16 Intelligence save. A success grants immunity to this hydroloth’s Steal Memory for 24 hours. On a failure, the target loses all proficiencies and the ability to cast spells or understand language. If both its Intelligence and Charisma scores are above 5, both become 5. The target can repeat the save at the end of each long rest, ending the effect on a success. Greater Restoration or Remove Curse also ends it.
Teleport. The hydroloth and its equipment magically move up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see.

name: Infernal Cambion
description: Zariel and Geryon sometimes spawn cambions to lead their followers in battle. This variant can direct an ally to strike harder and hold its ground.

sections.Armor: Scale mail. The listed AC includes Fiendish Blessing.
sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning and poison. Also bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Fiendish Blessing. The cambion adds its Charisma bonus to AC. The bonus is already included in its listed AC.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The cambion casts with Charisma (spell save DC 14) without material components.
3/day each. Alter Self, Command, Detect Magic.
1/day. Plane Shift (self only).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks or use Fire Ray twice.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) when wielded in two hands for a melee attack. Add 3 (1d6) fire damage either way.
Fire Ray. Ranged spell attack, +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (3d6) fire damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Fury of the Nine. Choose another creature within 120 ft. that can see or hear the cambion. It has advantage on attack rolls and saving throws for up to 1 minute. The effect ends early if the cambion uses Fury of the Nine again.
sections.Infernal patron options: Use the listed spells for the standard Fury of the Nine profile. To customize an infernal cambion, the DM can replace an innate spell with a same-level signature spell from the parent’s cult. The cambion can cast each replacement once per day. A cambion tied to a specific archdevil typically also gains the traits that devil gives its cultists. Fury of the Nine replaces Fiendish Charm for the Zariel and Geryon examples.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen’s Tome of Foes, p. 21, Infernal Cambions, using the base Cambion from Monster Manual (2014), p. 36.

name: Iron Cobra
description: The cobra slips ahead of other clockworks. Its bite can poison an intruder, freeze them in place, or turn them against their companions.

sections.Damage immunities: Poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Languages: Understands one language of its creator but cannot speak.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The cobra has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. A creature hit makes a DC 13 Constitution save. Roll 1d3 for the poison effect on a failure.
1. Poison Damage. The target takes 13 (3d8) poison damage.
2. Confusion. On its next turn, the target uses its action for one weapon attack against a random creature it can see within 30 ft. It uses the weapon it is holding and moves into range if necessary. If it has no weapon in hand, it makes an unarmed strike. If it sees no creature within 30 ft., it uses Dash and moves toward the nearest creature.
3. Paralysis. The target is paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

name: Juiblex
description: Eyes flicker in a heap of black and green ooze. Juiblex rules the Slime Pits of Shedaklah, where victims it consumes can become sentient oozes.

sections.Damage immunities: Poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical sources.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Foul. Any creature other than an ooze that starts its turn within 10 ft. of Juiblex must pass a DC 21 Constitution save or be poisoned until the start of that creature's next turn.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Juiblex can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. Juiblex has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Juiblex's weapon attacks are magical.
Regeneration. Juiblex regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn. If Juiblex takes fire or radiant damage, it does not regenerate at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn at 0 hit points and cannot regenerate.
Spider Climb. Juiblex can climb difficult surfaces and hang from ceilings without an ability check.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Juiblex uses Charisma (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks) and needs no material components.
At will. Acid Splash (17th level), Detect Magic.
3/day each. Blight, Contagion, Gaseous Form.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Acid Lash attacks.
Acid Lash. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (4d6 + 7) acid damage. Juiblex draws in a creature this attack kills and destroys the corpse after 1 minute.
Eject Slime (Recharge 5–6). Pick one creature Juiblex can see within 60 ft. A failed DC 21 Dexterity save deals 55 (10d10) acid damage. If the target takes any of this damage, each metal armor piece it wears grants 1 less AC and each metal weapon it wears or carries takes a −1 penalty to damage rolls. These penalties are permanent and cumulative. An item is destroyed once its penalty reaches −5.
sections.Legendary actions:
Juiblex has 3 legendary actions and regains them at the start of its turn. Use only one option at a time, at the end of another creature's turn.
Acid Splash (1 action). Cast Acid Splash.
Attack (1 action). Make one Acid Lash attack.
Corrupting Touch (2 actions). Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. A hit deals 21 (4d6 + 7) poison damage and coats the target in slime. The target is poisoned. Other creatures besides oozes are poisoned while within 10 ft. of the target. Scraping off the slime takes an action and ends both effects.
sections.Lair actions:
On initiative count 20, after creatures tied on that count have acted, Juiblex may choose one option. It cannot use the same option in consecutive rounds.
Restraining slime. Coat a visible square of ground up to 10 ft. on each side. A creature there when the slime appears, entering it for the first time on a turn, or ending its turn there must pass a DC 21 Strength save or be restrained while in the area. The restrained creature or another creature within reach can spend an action to free it with a DC 21 Strength check.
Slippery slime. Coat a visible square of ground up to 10 ft. on each side. A creature there when the slime appears, entering it for the first time on a turn, or ending its turn there must pass a DC 21 Dexterity save or fall prone and slide 10 ft. in a random direction determined by a d8.
Either ground slime lasts 1 hour. Fire burns it away after 1 round. A creature starting its turn in burning slime takes 22 (4d10) fire damage.
Green Slime. A patch of Green Slime appears on a spot Juiblex chooses on the lair ceiling. It disintegrates after 1 hour.
sections.Regional effects:
The region around Juiblex’s lair gains one or more of these effects.
Within 1 mile, small bodies of water become acidic and corrode objects that touch them. Within 6 miles, slick, sticky slime often coats surfaces.
A humanoid that spends at least 1 hour within 1 mile makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. On a failure, roll on Madness of Juiblex. A success gives 24 hours of immunity to that regional effect.
The regional effects fade over 1d10 days after Juiblex dies.
sections.Madness of Juiblex:
If a creature goes mad in the lair or in Juiblex's line of sight, roll d100. The flaw lasts until cured.
01–20. The creature compulsively consumes everything it can.
21–40. It refuses to give up anything it owns.
41–60. It urges others to eat and drink past their usual limits.
61–80. It tries to acquire as many possessions as possible.
81–100. It judges its own worth entirely by what it consumes.

name: Kruthik Hive Lord
description: A kruthik hive lord keeps adult guards near its chamber. If it dies, the hive abandons the nest and its largest survivor eventually molts into a replacement.

sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. The kruthik has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
Pack Tactics. The kruthik has advantage on an attack roll if an ally is within 5 ft. of the target and that ally is not incapacitated.
Tunneler. The kruthik can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a tunnel 10 ft. across.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make either two Stab attacks or two Spike attacks.
Stab. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.
Spike. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Acid Spray (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-foot cone makes a DC 14 Dexterity save, taking 22 (4d10) acid damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Leviathan
description: A leviathan rises out of deep water on the scale of a moving flood. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The leviathan can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Partial Freeze. If the leviathan takes at least 50 cold damage in one turn, all its speeds become 20 ft. and it has disadvantage on attacks until the end of its next turn.
Siege Monster. The leviathan deals double damage to objects and structures. The Tidal Wave rules already account for this trait.
Water Form. The leviathan can enter and stop in a hostile creature's space. It can pass through gaps at least 1 inch wide without squeezing.
Elemental Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Slam and one Tail attack.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (1d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d10) acid damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (1d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage plus 6 (1d12) acid damage.
Tidal Wave (Recharge 6). While submerged, the leviathan creates a wall of water centered on itself. The maximum dimensions are 250 ft. long, 250 ft. high, and 50 ft. thick. When the wall appears, each other creature in it makes a DC 24 Strength save and takes 33 (6d10) bludgeoning damage on a failure or half as much on a success. At the start of each of the leviathan's following turns, the wall and the creatures in it move 50 ft. away from the leviathan. Each Huge or smaller creature already in the wall or whose space it enters must pass a DC 24 Strength save or take 27 (5d10) bludgeoning damage. This moving-wall damage applies at most once per creature per turn. After each turn when the wall moves, the wall loses 50 ft. of height and the damage it deals in later rounds drops by 1d10. The wall vanishes at 0 ft. A creature caught in the wave must pass a DC 24 Strength (Athletics) check to swim during its turn.
sections.Legendary actions:
The leviathan has 3 legendary actions and regains them at the start of its turn. Use only one option at a time, at the end of another creature's turn.
Slam (2 actions). Make one Slam attack.
Move (1 action). Move up to the leviathan's speed.

name: Male Steeder
description: Duergar train steeders from hatching. A steeder climbs with sticky legs and hunts without a web.

sections.Traits:
Spider Climb. The steeder climbs difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
Extraordinary Leap. The steeder triples its long-jump distance and covers 3 ft. of a long jump for every foot of walking speed it spends.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.
Sticky Leg. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Small or Tiny creature. A hit leaves the target grappled on the steeder's leg (escape DC 12). The steeder can hold only one creature this way.

name: Marut
description: A marut carries a formal contract written on a gold plate and enforces its exact terms. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.

sections.Damage resistances: Thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. The marut is immune to spells and effects that would change its form.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The marut can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. The marut has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Constructed Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The marut uses Intelligence (spell save DC 20) and needs no material components.
At will. Plane Shift (self only).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Unerring Slam attacks.
Unerring Slam. Melee weapon attack, automatic hit, reach 5 ft., one target. The hit deals 60 force damage. A target of Huge size or smaller is pushed up to 5 ft. away.
Blazing Edict (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-foot cube emanating from the marut's chest takes 45 radiant damage. A creature that takes any of this damage must pass a DC 20 Wisdom save or be stunned until the end of the marut's next turn.
Justify. Pick up to two creatures the marut can see within 60 ft. Each makes a DC 20 Charisma save and automatically fails if incapacitated. A creature that fails teleports to the Hall of Concordance's teleportation circle in Sigil. The marut travels with any target it teleports. Once the marut has teleported this way, it can use Justify again only after a short or long rest.

name: Maurezhi
description: Doresain created these demons to lead ghouls and ghasts. A maurezhi can take a victim’s appearance after consuming the body, but the disguise decays.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning, necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Assume Form. The maurezhi can look like any Medium humanoid it has eaten. The appearance decays over 1d6 days, then falls away. Consuming the corpse of a humanoid it slew takes about 10 minutes and grants the disguise immediately.
Magic Resistance. The maurezhi has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage. A humanoid target also loses 1d4 Charisma until it finishes a short or long rest. At Charisma 0 the target dies and rises as a ghoul 24 hours later unless it has been revived or its corpse destroyed.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage. A creature other than an undead must also pass a DC 12 Constitution save or be paralyzed for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the paralysis on a success.
Raise Ghoul (Recharge 5–6). Revive one dead ghoul or ghast that the maurezhi can see within 30 ft. The creature returns with all its hit points.

name: Meazel
description: A recluse twisted by the Shadowfell. It ambushes travelers near crossings and spirits captured prey away through the dark.

sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. Take the Hide action in dim light or darkness.
sections.Actions:
Garrote. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target no larger than the meazel. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and grapples the target (escape DC 13, with disadvantage). The grappled target takes 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the meazel’s turns. The meazel cannot make weapon attacks while holding a creature this way.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.
Shadow Teleport (Recharge 5–6). Teleport up to 500 ft. with worn or carried gear and any grappled creature. Both spaces must be in dim light or darkness. The meazel must have seen the destination before, but does not need to see it now. If the destination is occupied, arrive in the nearest unoccupied space. Any other creature transported is cursed for 1 hour. Undead and creatures native to the Shadowfell within 300 ft. can sense the cursed creature, which cannot hide from them.

name: Merregon
description: A masked legionnaire of the Nine Hells. Markings on its mask identify whose orders it follows and the layer it serves.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.
sections.Languages: Understands Infernal but cannot speak. Telepathy 120 ft.
sections.Traits:
Devil’s Sight. The merregon can use its darkvision through magical darkness.
Magic Resistance. It makes saving throws against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Halberd attacks. Make three instead if an allied fiend of CR 6 or higher is within 60 ft.
Halberd. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage.
Heavy Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Loyal Bodyguard. When an attack hits another fiend within 5 ft., take that hit in the other fiend’s place.

name: Merrenoloth
description: A gaunt ferryman of the River Styx. The yugoloth bonds magically with ships it is hired to captain and may stipulate that it will stay out of fights.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The merrenoloth makes saving throws against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Intelligence (spell save DC 13). No material components needed.
At will. Charm Person, Darkness, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Gust of Wind.
3/day. Control Water.
1/day. Control Weather.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Fear Gaze once and make one Oar attack.
Oar. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.
Fear Gaze. Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. It must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the merrenoloth for 1 minute. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Bonus actions: Teleport. Magically move to a visible, unoccupied space within 60 ft., bringing worn or carried equipment.
sections.Lair actions:
A ship becomes the lair when the merrenoloth takes a contract to captain it. When fighting aboard, it can use one option on initiative count 20, losing ties. It cannot use the same option in consecutive rounds.
Restore 22 (4d10) hit points to the ship.
Wind adds 30 ft. to the ship’s speed until initiative count 20 of the next round.
The air within 60 ft. of the ship becomes difficult terrain until initiative count 20 of the next round. During that time, a Medium or smaller creature that flies into the area or starts its turn flying there must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or fall prone.
sections.Regional effects:
The merrenoloth’s ship gains one or more of these effects.
The hull can be breached without sinking the ship.
The ship stays on course for the destination the merrenoloth names.
Passengers it chooses to take aboard are comfortable through wind and weather but remain subject to damage.
If the merrenoloth dies, these effects fade over 1d6 hours.

name: Moloch
description: The exiled archdevil schemes to seize his old throne in Malbolge. In the Nine Hells he is reduced to an imp until he leaves.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. Moloch makes saving throws against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Magic Weapons. His weapon attacks are magical.
Regeneration. Moloch regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. Radiant damage prevents this recovery at the start of his next turn. He dies only if he starts his turn at 0 hit points and does not regenerate.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma (spell save DC 21). No material components needed.
At will. Alter Self (can become Medium when changing appearance), Animate Dead, Burning Hands (as a 7th-level spell), Confusion, Detect Magic, Fly, Geas, Major Image, Stinking Cloud, Suggestion, Wall of Fire.
1/day each. Flame Strike, Symbol (stunning only).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite, one Claw, and one Many-Tailed Whip attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 26 (4d8 + 8) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage.
Many-Tailed Whip. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d4 + 8) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) lightning damage. A creature hit must succeed on a DC 24 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 30 ft. straight toward Moloch.
Breath of Despair (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. cube must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or take 27 (5d10) psychic damage, drop what it is holding, and become frightened for 1 minute. On each of its turns, an affected creature must Dash away from Moloch along the safest available route. If it has nowhere to go, it can skip the Dash. If it ends its turn without line of sight to Moloch, it can repeat the save and end the effect on a success.
Teleport. Magically move to a visible, unoccupied space within 120 ft., bringing worn or carried equipment.
sections.Legendary actions:
Moloch has three legendary actions. He can use one of these options at the end of another creature’s turn, spending one action each time. He regains all spent legendary actions at the start of his turn.
Stinking Cloud. Cast Stinking Cloud.
Teleport. Use the Teleport action.
Whip. Make one Many-Tailed Whip attack.

name: Molydeus
description: A demon lord’s wolf-headed enforcer with a second, serpentine head through which its master watches and speaks.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, poisoned, stunned.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. The molydeus makes saving throws against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma (spell save DC 22). No material components needed.
At will. Dispel Magic, Polymorph, Telekinesis, Teleport.
3/day. Lightning Bolt.
1/day. Imprisonment.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Demonic Weapon attack, one Wolf Bite, and one Snakebite.
Demonic Weapon. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (2d10 + 9) slashing damage. On a natural 20 against a target with at least one head, cut off a head, killing the target if it needs that head to survive. A target that takes none of the damage, has legendary actions, or is Huge or larger is immune to decapitation and takes an extra 6d8 slashing damage from the hit instead.
Wolf Bite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d6 + 9) piercing damage.
Snakebite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. A hit deals 12 (1d6 + 9) piercing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or lose that much from its hit point maximum until it finishes a long rest. At a maximum of 0, it becomes a Manes. Only Wish can reverse the transformation.
sections.Legendary actions:
The molydeus has three legendary actions. It can use one of these options at the end of another creature’s turn, spending one action each time. It regains all spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.
Attack. Make one Demonic Weapon attack or Snakebite.
Move. Move without provoking opportunity attacks.
Cast a Spell. Cast one spell from Innate Spellcasting.
sections.Variant rules: Summon Demon (1/day). For a molydeus that has this option, spend an action for a 50 percent chance to summon its choice of 1d6 Babaus, 1d4 Chasmes, or one Marilith. Each appears in an unoccupied space within 60 ft., fights as its ally, and cannot summon other demons. A demon stays for 1 minute, until it or the molydeus dies, or until the molydeus dismisses it with an action.
sections.Lore: The demonic weapon reflects its maker. Baphomet grants a glaive, Demogorgon a whip, Fraz-Urb’luu a battleaxe, Graz’zt a greatsword, Orcus a morningstar, and Yeenoghu a flail. All use the same weapon rules. The weapon dissolves when the molydeus dies.

name: Nabassu
description: Other demons shun this soul-eater. A conjurer who calls one out of the Abyss may become its first meal.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Also bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Demonic Shadows. The nabassu keeps the area within 10 ft. of itself in dim light. Nonmagical light cannot brighten it.
Devour Soul. The nabassu can consume the soul of a creature it killed in the past hour, excluding constructs and undead. Spend at least 10 minutes within 5 ft. of the body. Gain half the victim’s number of Hit Dice as d8s, roll them, and add the result to the nabassu’s hit points. Every four d8s gained this way add 3 (1d6) damage to each attack hit. The benefits last six days. Only Wish restores a creature whose soul was eaten.
Magic Resistance. The nabassu has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Soul-Stealing Gaze and make one Claws attack and one Bite attack.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 32 (4d12 + 6) piercing damage.
Soul-Stealing Gaze. Choose a visible creature within 30 ft. If it can see the nabassu and is neither a construct nor undead, it must make a DC 16 Charisma save. On a failure, reduce its hit point maximum by 13 (2d12) and give the nabassu that many temporary hit points. The reduction ends after the target completes a short or long rest. At a maximum of 0 HP, the target dies. A humanoid killed this way immediately rises as a ghoul controlled by the nabassu.

name: Nagpa
description: The Raven Queen’s curse left thirteen scheming wizards with vulturelike faces. They engineer catastrophes so they can loot magical secrets from the ruins.

sections.Languages: Common plus up to five other languages.
sections.Spellcasting:
A 15th-level wizard spellcaster using Intelligence (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Chill Touch, Fire Bolt, Mage Hand, Message, Minor Illusion.
1st level (4 slots). Charm Person, Detect Magic, Protection from Evil and Good, Witch Bolt.
2nd level (3 slots). Hold Person, Ray of Enfeeblement, Suggestion.
3rd level (3 slots). Counterspell, Fireball, Fly.
4th level (3 slots). Confusion, Hallucinatory Terrain, Wall of Fire.
5th level (2 slots). Dominate Person, Dream, Geas.
6th level (1 slot). Circle of Death, Disintegrate.
7th level (1 slot). Etherealness, Prismatic Spray.
8th level (1 slot). Feeblemind.
sections.Bonus actions:
Corruption. Choose a creature the nagpa can see within 90 ft. It makes a DC 20 Charisma save, with disadvantage if evil. A failure leaves it charmed by the nagpa until the start of the nagpa’s next turn. A success gives it immunity to that nagpa’s Corruption for 24 hours.
Paralysis (Recharge 6). Every creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 20 Wisdom save or is paralyzed for 1 minute. Constructs and undead are immune. An affected target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns and end the effect on a success.
sections.Actions: Staff. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

name: Narzugon
description: A paladin who bargains with devils can end up leading their troops from the saddle of a nightmare.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid, cold. Also bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.
sections.Traits:
Diabolical Sense. The narzugon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice good-aligned creatures.
Infernal Tack. The narzugon’s spurs let it call its nightmare under the rules in the sidebar.
Magic Resistance. The narzugon has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Infernal Command or Terrifying Command and make three Hellfire Lance attacks.
Hellfire Lance. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (1d12 + 5) piercing and 16 (3d10) fire damage. A creature killed by the lance becomes a lemure in the River Styx in Avernus in 1d4 hours. Once that happens, only Wish or slaying the lemure and casting True Resurrection on the original body can bring the creature back. Constructs and devils are immune to this soul effect.
Infernal Command. Allies within 60 ft. cannot be charmed or frightened through the end of the narzugon’s next turn.
Terrifying Command. Non-fiends within 60 ft. that hear the narzugon must make a DC 17 Charisma save or be frightened of it for 1 minute. A target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Passing the save makes it immune to this narzugon’s Terrifying Command for 24 hours.
Healing (1/day). The narzugon or one creature it touches regains up to 100 hit points.
sections.Infernal Tack sidebar:
Infernal Tack is a legendary wondrous item that requires attunement by an evil creature. The wearer commands a nightmare already subdued and fitted with the matching tack. Its service lasts until the wearer dies or the tack comes off.
Use an action to clash the spurs or scrape them through blood to call the nightmare. It arrives within 20 ft. at the start of the wearer’s next turn, acts as an ally on the wearer’s initiative count, and stays up to one day. It also departs if either creature dies or the wearer dismisses it as an action. If slain, the nightmare reforms in the Nine Hells within 24 hours and can then be called again.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen’s Tome of Foes, p. 167, including the Infernal Tack sidebar.

name: Nightwalker
description: A nightwalker can emerge when a living creature crosses into the Negative Plane. The traveler remains trapped while its counterpart walks free.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder. Also bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained.
sections.Traits:
Annihilating Aura. Except for undead, a creature that starts its turn within 30 ft. must make a DC 21 Constitution save. On failure, it takes 14 (4d6) necrotic damage and the nightwalker has advantage on attack rolls against it until the start of that creature’s next turn.
Life Eater. Any creature the nightwalker reduces to 0 hit points with damage dies. Only Wish can revive it.
Undead Nature. The nightwalker needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Enervating Focus twice or use it once together with Finger of Doom if available.
Enervating Focus. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 28 (5d8 + 6) necrotic damage. The target must make a DC 21 Constitution save. Failure reduces its hit point maximum by the necrotic damage it took until it completes a long rest.
Finger of Doom (Recharge 6). Choose a creature the nightwalker can see within 300 ft. It must make a DC 21 Wisdom save. On failure, it takes 26 (4d12) necrotic damage and is frightened until the end of the nightwalker’s next turn. This fear paralyzes it for the same duration. On a success, it is immune to this nightwalker’s Finger of Doom for 24 hours.
sections.Negative Plane exchange: When a nightwalker takes the place of a creature drawn into the Negative Plane, the creature can escape only if the nightwalker is lured back with living prey. Destroying the nightwalker closes that way out.

name: Nupperibo
description: Nupperibos drift across the Nine Hells in blind, hungry packs. The vermin swarming around them can make even a narrow crossing costly.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid, cold. Also bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.
sections.Senses: Blindsight 10 ft. The nupperibo is blind beyond that distance.
sections.Traits:
Cloud of Vermin. Non-devils that start their turns within 20 ft. make a DC 11 Constitution save, with disadvantage if in the clouds of at least two nupperibos. Failure deals 2 (1d4) piercing damage.
Hunger-Driven. In the Nine Hells, a nupperibo can track without error anyone damaged by any nupperibo’s Cloud of Vermin within the past 24 hours.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Oaken Bolter
description: This walking ballista can bring down distant targets or reel them into reach of other clockworks.

sections.Damage immunities: Poison. Also bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without adamantine weapons.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Languages: Understands one language of its creator but cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Constructed Nature. The clockwork needs no air, food, drink or sleep.
Magic Resistance. The oaken bolter has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Lancing Bolt attacks or one Lancing Bolt attack and one Harpoon attack.
Lancing Bolt. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 100/400 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.
Harpoon. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 50/200 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage and grapples the target (escape DC 12). Its speed is unchanged, but its own movement must take it closer to the oaken bolter. An escape attempt deals 5 (1d10) slashing damage to the creature whether or not it succeeds. The oaken bolter can hold only one target in this grapple at a time.
Explosive Bolt (Recharge 5–6). Choose a point within 120 ft. Creatures within 20 ft. of it make a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 17 (5d6) fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Bonus actions: Reel In. Pull a creature held by Harpoon 20 ft. closer.
sections.Clockwork enhancements:
For an individual clockwork, choose or roll one enhancement and one potential malfunction, both on d10.
1. Camouflaged. Gain Stealth proficiency if needed. While still, the clockwork passes for an inactive machine.
2. Sensors. Raise darkvision to at least 120 ft. and add Perception proficiency if needed.
3. Improved Armor. Increase AC by 2.
4. Increased Speed. Increase speed by 10 ft.
5. Reinforced Construction. Gain resistance to force, lightning and thunder damage.
6. Self-Repairing. At the start of its turn, recover 5 HP if it has at least 1 HP. Lightning damage skips the next recovery.
7. Sturdy Frame. Add its number of Hit Dice to its maximum HP.
8. Suction. Gain a 30-ft. climbing speed.
9. Vocal Resonator. It speaks rudimentary Common or Gnomish, as its maker decides.
10. Water Propulsion. Gain a 30-ft. swimming speed.
sections.Clockwork malfunctions:
1. Faulty Sensors. Roll a d6 at turn start. On a 1, the clockwork is blinded until turn end.
2. Flawed Targeting. Roll a d6 at turn start. On a 1, its attack rolls have disadvantage until turn end.
3. Ground Fault. Gain vulnerability to lightning damage.
4. Imprinting Loop. Roll a d6 at turn start. On a 1, it mistakes a visible creature within 30 ft. for its maker. It avoids harming that creature for 1 minute or until the creature attacks or damages it.
5. Leaking Lubricant. Roll a d6 at turn start. On a 1, it gains one level of exhaustion despite immunity.
6. Limited Steering. It moves in straight lines, turning up to 90 degrees before moving and once at the halfway point. It can rotate freely on a turn when it uses none of its speeds.
7. Overactive Sense of Self-Preservation. At the start of a combat turn while at half HP or less, roll a d6. On a 1, the clockwork retreats if it can. If it cannot retreat, it keeps fighting.
8. Overheats. Roll a d6 at turn start. On a 1, it is incapacitated until turn end.
9. Rusty Gears. It has disadvantage on initiative rolls and its speed drops by 10 ft.
10. Weak Armor. Remove its immunity to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical, non-adamantine attacks.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen’s Tome of Foes, p. 126, with Clockwork customization on p. 124.

name: Oblex Spawn
description: An older oblex sheds a personality it has consumed to create one of these small oozes. The spawn hunts memories until it grows large enough to imitate its victims.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft. The spawn is blind beyond that distance.
sections.Traits:
Amorphous. The oblex can pass through a 1-inch opening without squeezing.
Aversion to Fire. Taking fire damage gives the oblex disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks through the end of its next turn.
Ooze Nature. The oblex needs no sleep.
sections.Actions: Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning plus 2 (1d4) psychic damage.

name: Ogre Battering Ram
description: An ogre armed with an enormous club breaks doors and holds gaps in enemy lines.

sections.Traits: Siege Monster. The ogre deals double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:
Bash. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage. The ogre can push a Huge or smaller target 5 ft. away.
Block the Path. Until the start of the ogre’s next turn, attack rolls against it have disadvantage. It has advantage on its opportunity attack roll, which deals an extra 16 (3d10) bludgeoning damage on a hit. An enemy that tries to leave its reach without teleporting must pass a DC 14 Strength save or have its speed reduced to 0 until the start of the ogre’s next turn.

name: Ogre Bolt Launcher
description: An ogre carries a crossbow the size of a ballista and can improvise ammunition from beams or small trees.

sections.Actions:
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Bolt Launcher. Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (3d10 + 1) piercing damage.

name: Ogre Chain Brute
description: The ogre wields a spiked chain in both hands to sweep enemies off their feet or knock one foe unconscious.

sections.Actions:
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Chain Sweep. Every creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and falls prone. On a success, it takes half as much damage without falling prone.
