Chain Smash (Recharge 6). Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. The target makes a DC 14 Constitution save or falls unconscious for 1 minute. It repeats the save whenever it takes damage and at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

name: Ogre Howdah
description: A palisade on the ogre’s back gives up to four goblins or other Small fighters a place to shoot and thrust with spears.

sections.Traits: Howdah. The fort on the ogre’s back holds up to four Small creatures without squeezing. A rider must use a spear or another weapon with reach for a melee attack against a target within 5 ft. of the ogre. Riders have three-quarters cover against attacks and effects originating outside the fort. If the ogre dies, place its riders in unoccupied spaces within 5 ft. of it.
sections.Actions: Mace. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Oinoloth
description: Armies hire this yugoloth when they cannot break a siege. Its plagues can empty a battlefield, and its remedies exact a cost from survivors.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, and lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The oinoloth has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. The oinoloth’s weapon attacks are magical.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma governs the oinoloth’s innate spells (save DC 16). It casts them without material components.
At will. Darkness, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Invisibility (self only).
1/day each. Feeblemind, Globe of Invulnerability, Wall of Fire, Wall of Ice.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Transfixing Gaze and make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 22 (4d10) necrotic damage.
Corrupted Healing (Recharge 6). Touch one willing creature within 5 ft. It regains all its hit points. The oinoloth may also end one disease or remove one condition from the following list: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned. The target then gains one level of exhaustion and loses 7 (2d6) from its hit point maximum. It dies if that maximum reaches 0. Only Wish or three castings of Greater Restoration on it within the same hour can undo this reduction.
Teleport. The oinoloth and its worn or carried equipment magically move up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see.
Transfixing Gaze. Choose one visible creature within 30 ft. It makes a DC 16 Wisdom save against the magic. On a failure, it is charmed until the end of the oinoloth’s next turn and restrained while charmed this way. A success grants immunity to this oinoloth’s gaze for 24 hours.
sections.Bonus actions:
Bringer of Plagues (Recharge 5–6). Blight the area within 30 ft. of the oinoloth for 24 hours. Normal plants in that area wither and die, and spells restore only half as many hit points to creatures there. A creature that moves into the area or starts its turn there makes a DC 16 Constitution save. On a success, it is immune to this oinoloth’s Bringer of Plagues for 24 hours. On a failure, it takes 14 (4d6) necrotic damage and becomes poisoned.
A creature poisoned this way cannot regain hit points. Every 24 hours it can repeat the save. A failed repeat save reduces its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10) until the poison ends, and it dies if that maximum reaches 0. Three successful saves end the poison.

name: Orcus
description: The Demon Prince of Undeath rules from Naratyr, a fortress city on Thanatos. He rewards cultists who raise the dead and keeps an undead army under his command.

sections.Armor: Natural armor. AC 20 while holding the Wand of Orcus.
sections.Damage immunities: Necrotic, poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical sources.
sections.Traits:
Wand of Orcus. The wand holds up to 7 charges and regains 1d4 + 3 at dawn. Its abilities that call for a save use DC 18. While holding it, Orcus can use an action to cast Animate Dead, Blight, or Speak with Dead. He can also cast Circle of Death or Finger of Death for 1 charge each, or Power Word Kill for 2 charges.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). If Orcus fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed.
Magic Resistance. Orcus has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Orcus’s weapon attacks are magical.
Master of Undeath. Orcus chooses the spell level when he casts Animate Dead or Create Undead. The creatures they create remain under his control indefinitely. He can cast Create Undead at any time of day.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Orcus uses Charisma (spell save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks). He needs no material components.
At will. Chill Touch (17th level), Detect Magic.
3/day each. Create Undead, Dispel Magic.
1/day. Time Stop.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Wand of Orcus attacks.
Wand of Orcus. Melee weapon attack, +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (2d12) necrotic damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (3d8 + 8) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.
Conjure Undead (Wand of Orcus, once per dawn). While holding the wand, Orcus creates undead creatures with no more than 500 combined average hit points. They appear in unoccupied spaces within 300 ft. and obey him until destroyed or dismissed. Dismissing them takes an action.
sections.Legendary actions:
Orcus has 3 legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of his turn. He can use one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Tail (1 action). Make one Tail attack.
A Taste of Undeath (1 action). Cast Chill Touch at 17th level.
Creeping Death (2 actions). Choose a point on the ground Orcus can see within 100 ft. A cylinder 60 ft. high with a 10-ft. radius appears there until the end of Orcus’s next turn. Creatures inside have vulnerability to necrotic damage.
sections.Lair actions:
On initiative count 20, losing initiative ties, Orcus can use one option. He cannot pick the same option two rounds in a row.
Power Word Kill. One creature Orcus knows is in the lair is subject to Power Word Kill. He can choose it without seeing it. The spell uses its normal hit-point threshold.
Animate Corpses. Raise up to six corpses in the lair as skeletons, zombies, or ghouls. They obey Orcus by telepathy from anywhere in the lair.
Skeletal Arms. Choose a 20-ft. square on the ground Orcus can see. Each creature in the square when the arms appear must succeed on a DC 23 Strength save or be restrained. The arms vanish at the next initiative count 20. Orcus can release their grasp before then without taking an action.
sections.Regional effects:
Dead beasts sometimes animate, and skeletal or zombified local wildlife roam the area.
The air reeks of decay and swarms with flies, even without carrion.
A humanoid who spends at least 1 hour within 1 mile of the lair must make a DC 23 Wisdom save. On a failure, roll on the Madness of Orcus table. A success grants immunity to this regional effect for 24 hours.
After Orcus dies, these effects fade over 1d10 days.
sections.Madness of Orcus:
Roll d100 when a creature succumbs to this madness in the lair or within Orcus’s sight. The resulting flaw lasts until cured.
01–20. Withdraws into bitter thoughts about living.
21–40. Feels driven to torment the weak.
41–60. Disturbs the dead freely while trying to understand death.
61–80. Seeks to become undead and endure forever.
81–100. Dwells on the futility of life.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen’s Tome of Foes, pp. 152–153. Official errata removes the listed saving throw from the first lair action.

name: Orthon
description: This infernal bounty hunter turns invisible to stalk prey. Its specialized crossbow bolts can disable or track a quarry.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The orthon has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Bonus actions: Invisibility Field. The orthon and the gear it wears or carries become invisible. The effect ends as soon as the orthon makes an attack roll or an attack hits it.
sections.Actions:
Infernal Dagger. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d4 + 6) slashing damage. The target must make a DC 17 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 22 (4d10) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a success, it takes half the poison damage. A poisoned target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.
Brass Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage and one of the following effects.
Acid. The target makes a DC 17 Constitution save, taking 17 (5d6) extra acid damage on a failure or half on a success.
Blindness (1/day). The target takes 5 (1d10) radiant damage. The target and each other creature within 20 ft. of it must make a DC 17 Dexterity save or be blinded until the end of the orthon’s next turn.
Concussion. The target and each other creature within 20 ft. of it make a DC 17 Constitution save, taking 13 (2d12) thunder damage on a failure or half on a success.
Entanglement. The target must make a DC 17 Dexterity save or be restrained by webbing for 1 hour. A restrained creature can use an action to escape with a successful DC 17 Dexterity or Strength check. Other than an orthon, a creature that touches a restrained creature must make the same Dexterity save or also become restrained.
Paralysis (1/day). The target takes 22 (4d10) lightning damage and must make a DC 17 Constitution save or be paralyzed for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.
Tracking. For 24 hours, the orthon knows the target’s distance and direction while they share a plane. If they are on different planes, the orthon knows which plane the target is on.
sections.Reactions: Explosive Retribution. When reduced to 15 hit points or fewer, the orthon can explode. Each other creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 9 (2d8) fire damage plus 9 (2d8) thunder damage. On a success, halve both amounts. The explosion destroys the orthon, its dagger, and its crossbow.

name: Phoenix
description: This elder elemental sweeps across the sky as a giant bird of fire. A phoenix’s last blaze leaves behind a cinder that hatches into a new phoenix.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned.
sections.Traits:
Fiery Death and Rebirth. When the phoenix dies, each creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 20 Dexterity save, taking 22 (4d10) fire damage on a failure or half on a success. The blast ignites flammable objects in the area that nobody wears or carries. The body is destroyed, leaving a 5-lb. egg-shaped cinder. A creature touching the cinder takes 21 (6d6) fire damage, at most once per round. The cinder is immune to all damage and hatches a new phoenix after 1d6 days.
Fire Form. The phoenix can pass through openings as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. A creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage when it touches the phoenix or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft. The phoenix can enter and stop in a hostile creature’s space. The first time on a turn it enters a creature’s space, that creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. The phoenix can also ignite unattended flammable objects by touching them without spending an action.
Flyby. Flying out of an enemy’s reach does not provoke an opportunity attack.
Illumination. The phoenix sheds bright light within 60 ft. and dim light for another 30 ft.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). If the phoenix fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed.
Siege Monster. The phoenix deals double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Beak attack and one Fiery Talons attack.
Beak. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d6 + 8) fire damage. A creature or flammable object hit by the attack ignites and takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns until a creature takes an action to douse the flames.
Fiery Talons. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d8 + 8) fire damage.
sections.Legendary actions:
The phoenix has 3 legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It can use one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Peck (1 action). Make one Beak attack.
Move (1 action). Move up to its speed.
Swoop (2 actions). Move up to its speed and make one Fiery Talons attack.

name: Red Abishai
description: A commander among Tiamat’s abishai, it rallies followers and can turn dragons into allies.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.
sections.Traits:
Devil’s Sight. Magical darkness does not interfere with the abishai’s darkvision.
Magic Resistance. The abishai has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. The abishai’s weapon attacks are magical.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. The abishai may use Frightful Presence, then makes one Morningstar attack, one Claw attack, and one Bite attack.
Morningstar. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 38 (7d10) fire damage.
Frightful Presence. Each chosen creature within 120 ft. that is aware of the abishai must make a DC 18 Wisdom save or be frightened of it for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect. On a success or when the effect ends, the creature is immune to this abishai’s Frightful Presence for 24 hours.
Incite Fanaticism. Choose up to four allies within 60 ft. that can see the abishai. For 1 minute, those allies have advantage on attack rolls and cannot be frightened.
Power of the Dragon Queen. Choose a dragon the abishai can see within 120 ft. The dragon makes a DC 18 Charisma save. Chromatic dragons save with disadvantage. A success grants immunity to this abishai’s Power of the Dragon Queen for 1 hour. On a failure, the dragon is charmed for 1 hour and treats the abishai as a trusted friend to heed and protect. The charm ends if the abishai or its companions damage the dragon.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen’s Tome of Foes, p. 162. Official errata corrects the Bite’s piercing damage dice from 5d10 + 6 to 3d10 + 6.

name: Retriever
description: The drow built this spider-shaped construct to bring back prey from the Abyss. It carries a captive demon spirit and can shift planes with its quarry.

sections.Damage immunities: Necrotic, poison, psychic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without adamantine weapons.
sections.Languages: Understands Abyssal, Elvish, and Undercommon. It cannot speak.
sections.Traits: Faultless Tracker. Its master assigns one quarry at a time. This can be a specific creature or object the master knows personally, or a kind of creature or object the master has seen. The retriever knows the quarry’s direction and distance on the same plane. It always knows its master’s location.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The retriever uses Wisdom (spell save DC 13) and needs no material components.
3/day each. Plane Shift (itself and up to one incapacitated creature, which counts as willing), Web.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Foreleg attacks and use one beam, either Force Beam or Paralyzing Beam if available.
Foreleg. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage.
Force Beam. One creature the retriever can see within 60 ft. makes a DC 16 Dexterity save, taking 27 (5d10) force damage on a failure or half on a success.
Paralyzing Beam (Recharge 5–6). One creature the retriever can see within 60 ft. must make a DC 18 Constitution save or be paralyzed for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect. The retriever can pick up a Medium or smaller creature it paralyzes this way as part of its move and carry it at full walking or climbing speed.

name: Rot Troll
description: Necrotic energy eats away at the troll and harms creatures that stand close to it.

sections.Traits: Rancid Degeneration. At the end of the troll’s turn, every creature within 5 ft. takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. Skip this damage if the troll took acid or fire damage after its previous turn ended.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claws attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.

name: Rutterkin
description: Rutterkins hunt in mobs. Their numbers pin intruders in place, and a bite can turn a dying victim into an Abyssal Wretch.

sections.Traits: Crippling Fear. When a creature other than a demon starts its turn within 30 ft. of at least three rutterkins, it makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. If six or more rutterkins are within range, it has disadvantage. Success grants immunity to all rutterkins’ Crippling Fear for 24 hours. Failure leaves the creature frightened of the rutterkins for 1 minute and restrained while frightened this way. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect on a success.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (3d6 + 2) piercing damage. A creature hit must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution save against disease or become poisoned. It can repeat the save at the end of each long rest to end the effect. If reduced to 0 HP while poisoned by the bite, it dies and immediately becomes a living Abyssal Wretch. Only Wish can undo the body’s transformation.

name: Sacred Statue
classification: Large construct, shares the eidolon’s alignment
description: An eidolon animates this statue to defend a sacred site.

sections.Languages: The languages the eidolon knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Acid, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Traits:
False Appearance. A motionless sacred statue is indistinguishable from an ordinary statue.
Ghostly Inhabitant. The Eidolon leaves if the statue drops to 0 HP, if it uses a bonus action to exit, or if it is turned or forced out by an effect such as Dispel Evil and Good. It appears in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the statue.
Inert. An empty statue is an object.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 43 (6d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 37 (6d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Sacred animation mechanics: When an Eidolon enters the statue’s space, it can animate the statue with Sacred Animation (Recharge 5–6) and use this block instead of its own. Page 194 lists CR 12 and 8,400 XP for the Eidolon. The statue has no separate CR or XP.

name: Shadow Dancer
description: This shadar-kai strikes with a bladed chain and can step through shadows between blows.

sections.Traits: Fey Ancestry. The shadow dancer has advantage on saves against being charmed, and magic cannot put it to sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Spiked Chain attacks.
Spiked Chain. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. On a failure, choose one effect. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, grapple it (escape DC 14). It is restrained while grappled, and the shadow dancer cannot grapple another target until that grapple ends. Alternatively knock the target prone or deal 22 (4d10) necrotic damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Jump. Teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied visible space. Both the starting space and the destination must be in dim light or darkness. The dancer can jump between weapon attacks made as part of another action.

name: Sibriex
description: A floating demon that twists living flesh. Its corrupted ground and poisonous aura make it dangerous to approach.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Contamination. Noncreature plants wither within 30 ft. of the sibriex, and the ground within that radius is difficult terrain for other creatures. A creature starting its turn there must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution save or take 14 (4d6) poison damage. Success grants immunity to that sibriex’s Contamination for 24 hours.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The sibriex can choose to succeed when it fails a saving throw.
Magic Resistance. The sibriex has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma sets the spell save DC at 21. The sibriex needs no material components.
At will. Charm Person, Command, Dispel Magic, Hold Monster.
3/day. Feeblemind.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Squirt Bile once and make three attacks in any combination of Chain and Bite.
Chain. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (2d12 + 7) piercing damage.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d8) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) acid damage.
Squirt Bile. Choose one visible creature within 120 ft. It must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity save or take 35 (10d6) acid damage.
Warp Creature. Choose up to three visible creatures within 120 ft. Each makes a DC 20 Constitution save. A creature that succeeds on this initial save becomes immune to this sibriex’s Warp Creature. A creature that fails becomes poisoned and gains one level of exhaustion. While poisoned this way, it repeats the save at the start of each of its turns. Each failure adds one level of exhaustion. Three successes end the poison and remove exhaustion from this effect. At six levels of exhaustion, the creature dies and becomes a living Abyssal Wretch under the sibriex’s control. Only Wish can undo the body’s transformation.
sections.Legendary actions:
The sibriex can spend up to 3 legendary actions between its turns and regains them at the start of its turn. Use one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Cast a Spell (1 action). Cast one of its spells.
Spray Bile (1 action). Use Squirt Bile.
Warp (2 actions). Use Warp Creature.
sections.Flesh Warping variant:
On each failed Warp Creature save, the DM can roll d100 and apply the corresponding extra effect. It lasts until Warp Creature ends on that target or becomes permanent if the target turns into an Abyssal Wretch. A willing creature can instead remain within 30 ft. of the sibriex for at least 1 hour. It permanently gains one rolled or chosen effect.
01–05. Hair, skin, and eyes become blue, red, yellow, or patterned.
06–10. The eyes extend on stalks.
11–15. Hand claws can be used as daggers.
16–20. Uneven legs reduce walking speed by 10 ft.
21–25. Open eyes cast dim light in a 15-ft. cone.
26–30. Back wings grant a flying speed of 30 ft.
31–35. The ears tear away. The target is deafened.
36–40. Two teeth grow into tusks.
41–45. Scabbed skin raises AC by 1 and reduces Charisma by 2, to a minimum of 1.
46–50. Arms and legs trade places. The target can move only by crawling.
51–55. Tentacle arms add 5 ft. of reach.
56–60. Springy legs increase walking speed by 10 ft.
61–65. A new tail works as a whip.
66–70. Blackened eyes gain darkvision 120 ft.
71–75. The body swells to three times its weight.
76–80. The skeletal body weighs half as much.
81–85. The head doubles in size.
86–90. Wings replace the ears and grant a flying speed of 5 ft.
91–95. A brittle body grants vulnerability to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
96–100. An extra head grants advantage on saves against being charmed, frightened, or stunned.

name: Skulk
description: A lost traveler’s empty shell, invisible except under a few specific conditions.

sections.Traits:
Fallible Invisibility. The skulk is invisible. A mirror or other reflective surface shows it as a dull, smooth-skinned humanoid. A candle made from the rendered fat of an unidentified corpse reveals it as a dim, translucent shape. Humanoid children age 10 or younger can see it.
Trackless. The skulk leaves no tracks that reveal its path or destination.
sections.Actions: Claws. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage, plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage if the skulk had advantage on the attack roll.
sections.Summoning mechanics: A ritual can bring a skulk from the Shadowfell. When given a part of the summoner’s identity, it obeys that summoner for 30 days and vaguely resembles them when visible. It can return to the Shadowfell only when it dies.

name: Skull Lord
description: Three dead leaders bound into a single body command undead armies in the Shadowfell.

sections.Languages: All languages it knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Cold, necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, stunned, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The skull lord can choose to succeed when it fails a saving throw.
Master of the Grave. Undead allies within 30 ft. have advantage on saving throws. Such an ally regains 1d6 HP when it starts its turn within range.
Evasion. When a Dexterity save would halve damage, the skull lord instead takes none on a success and half on a failure.
Undead Nature. The skull lord needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Spellcasting:
A 13th-level sorcerer using Charisma (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Chill Touch, Fire Bolt, Mage Hand, Poison Spray, Ray of Frost, Shocking Grasp.
1st level (4 slots). Magic Missile, Expeditious Retreat, Thunderwave.
2nd level (3 slots). Mirror Image, Scorching Ray.
3rd level (3 slots). Fear, Haste.
4th level (3 slots). Dimension Door, Ice Storm.
5th level (2 slots). Cloudkill, Cone of Cold.
6th level (1 slot). Eyebite.
7th level (1 slot). Finger of Death.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Bone Staff attacks.
Bone Staff. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.
sections.Legendary actions:
The skull lord can spend up to 3 legendary actions between its turns and regains them at the start of its turn. Use one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Bone Staff (2 actions). Make one Bone Staff attack.
Cantrip (1 action). Cast a cantrip.
Move (1 action). Move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Summon Undead (3 actions). Up to five Skeletons or Zombies appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 ft. They remain until destroyed, roll initiative, and act on their next available turn. The skull lord can have at most five undead summoned this way at once.

name: Soul Monger
description: A shadar-kai that drains a victim’s vitality and leaves nearby creatures struggling to move.

sections.Traits:
Fey Ancestry. The soul monger has advantage on saves against being charmed, and magic cannot put it to sleep.
Magic Resistance. The soul monger has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Soul Thirst. When the soul monger reduces a creature to 0 HP, it can gain temporary HP equal to half that creature’s maximum HP. While it has temporary HP from this trait, its attack rolls have advantage.
Weight of Ages. A beast or humanoid other than a shadar-kai that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the soul monger loses 20 ft. of speed until the start of that creature’s next turn.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Intelligence sets the spell save DC at 16 and the spell attack bonus at +8. The soul monger needs no material components.
At will. Chill Touch (3d8 damage), Poison Spray (3d12 damage).
1/day each. Bestow Curse, Chain Lightning, Finger of Death, Gaseous Form, Phantasmal Killer, Seeming.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Phantasmal Dagger attacks.
Phantasmal Dagger. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (4d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 19 (3d12) necrotic damage. The target has disadvantage on saving throws until the start of the soul monger’s next turn.
Wave of Weariness (Recharge 4–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cube makes a DC 16 Constitution save. Failure deals 45 (10d8) psychic damage and adds one level of exhaustion. Success deals 22 (5d8) psychic damage.
sections.Table notes: Page 226 lists Wisdom 15 with a +3 modifier. The score of 15 normally gives +2. The Wisdom save and Perception bonus are both +7 as printed.

name: Spirit Troll
description: Psychic trauma can leave a regenerating troll with a shadowlike body. Its teeth and claws can still tear at a creature’s mind.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid, cold, fire, lightning and thunder.
sections.Damage immunities: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained and unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Incorporeal Movement. The troll treats creatures and objects as difficult terrain when it moves through them. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
Regeneration. The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. Psychic or force damage prevents this healing at the start of its next turn. The troll dies only when it starts its turn at 0 hit points and fails to regenerate.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claws attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 19 (3d10 + 3) psychic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 14 (2d10 + 3) psychic damage.

name: Spring Eladrin
description: A Feywild elf whose exuberance can sweep bystanders into celebration before they realize they are under a spell.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Joyful Presence. A non-eladrin creature that starts its turn within 60 ft. must make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it is charmed by this eladrin for 1 minute. A success grants immunity to every eladrin’s Joyful Presence for 24 hours. Whenever this eladrin damages the charmed creature, it can repeat the save to end the charm on a success.
Magic Resistance. The eladrin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The eladrin uses Charisma (spell save DC 16) and needs no material components.
At will. Charm Person, Tasha’s Hideous Laughter.
3/day each. Confusion, Enthrall, Suggestion.
1/day each. Hallucinatory Terrain, Otto’s Irresistible Dance.
sections.Bonus actions: Fey Step (Recharge 4–6). Teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space the eladrin can see.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two weapon attacks, or make one weapon attack and cast one spell in place of the other attack.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) if wielded with two hands, plus 4 (1d8) psychic damage either way.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage and 4 (1d8) psychic damage.

name: Star Spawn Grue
description: Spindly, fanged creatures cluster around more powerful star spawn. Their chittering unsettles anyone who comes close.

sections.Traits: Aura of Madness. Non-aberrations within 20 ft. of the grue have disadvantage on saving throws and on attack rolls against any target other than a star spawn grue.
sections.Actions: Confounding Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (2d4 + 1) piercing damage. On a failed DC 10 Wisdom saving throw, attack rolls against the target have advantage until the start of the grue’s next turn.
sections.Tactics: Keep the grue near creatures facing a seer or larva mage. Its aura weakens their saves against Collapse Distance and Plague of Worms.

name: Star Spawn Hulk
description: A hulking aberration with translucent skin and lidless eyes. It stays close to the seer it protects.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Psychic Mirror. When the hulk would take psychic damage, each creature within 10 ft. of it takes that damage and the hulk takes none. Magic cannot reveal the hulk’s thoughts or location.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks. If both hit the same target, it takes an extra 9 (2d8) psychic damage and must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Reaping Arms (Recharge 5–6). Make one Slam attack against each creature within 10 ft. of the hulk. Any creature hit must also succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.
sections.Tactics: A seer can aim Psychic Orb at the hulk to spread the damage through Psychic Mirror. Keep other allies outside its 10-ft. radius unless they can take the damage.

name: Star Spawn Larva Mage
description: An emissary of an Elder Evil can overtake a cultist and leave behind a mage whose body comes apart into worms.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned and restrained.
sections.Traits: Return to Worms. At 0 hit points, the larva mage becomes a Swarm of Insects in its space. It reforms from the swarm 24 hours later if the swarm survives.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The larva mage uses Charisma (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks) and needs no material components.
At will. Eldritch Blast (3 beams, +3 damage per beam), Minor Illusion.
3/day. Dominate Monster.
1/day. Circle of Death.
sections.Actions:
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.
Plague of Worms (Recharge 6). Each creature within 10 ft. that is not a star spawn makes a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. A failed save deals 22 (5d8) necrotic damage and leaves the creature blinded and restrained. It takes another 22 (5d8) necrotic damage at the start of each of the mage’s turns. The creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its own turns. A success ends the effect on it.
sections.Reactions: Feed on Weakness. When a creature within 20 ft. fails a saving throw, the larva mage can gain 10 temporary hit points.
sections.Legendary actions:
Spend up to 3 legendary actions, choosing one option at the end of another creature’s turn. The mage regains spent legendary actions at the start of its own turn.
Cantrip (2 actions). Cast one cantrip.
Slam (2 actions). Make one Slam attack.
Feed (3 actions). Each creature restrained by Plague of Worms takes 13 (3d8) necrotic damage. The mage gains 6 temporary hit points.

name: Star Spawn Mangler
description: Cultists send this many-armed climber to guard dark passages or strike from hiding.

sections.Traits: Ambush. During the first round of combat, the mangler has advantage on attacks against creatures that have not taken a turn yet.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. The mangler can take the Hide action in dim light or darkness as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage. If the attack roll had advantage, it also deals 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
Flurry of Claws (Recharge 4–6). Make six Claw attacks against one target. As a bonus action, the mangler can move up to its speed immediately before or after the attacks without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
sections.Tactics: Against a target that has yet to act, use Flurry of Claws while Ambush can add psychic damage to each hit.

name: Star Spawn Seer
description: A seer guides lesser star spawn and distorts space around the creatures it fights.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Out-of-Phase Movement. The seer crosses creatures and objects as difficult terrain. A creature it passes through takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage, at most once per turn. The seer takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Comet Staff attacks or use Psychic Orb twice.
Comet Staff. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage, or 10 (1d8 + 6) with two hands, plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage either way. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated until the end of its next turn.
Psychic Orb. Ranged spell attack, +11 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 27 (5d10) psychic damage.
Collapse Distance (Recharge 6). Choose a creature the seer can see within 30 ft. The target makes a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the seer teleports the target and its gear up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. Every other creature within 10 ft. of the target’s former space takes 39 (6d12) psychic damage. On a success, only the target takes 19 (3d12) psychic damage.
sections.Reactions: Bend Space. When an attack would hit the seer, it can swap places by teleporting with another star spawn it can see within 60 ft. The attack hits that star spawn instead.
sections.Tactics: Use Bend Space to shift a dangerous hit onto a sturdier ally. Psychic Orb can also trigger a hulk’s Psychic Mirror when enemies surround it.

name: Steel Predator
description: A renegade hexton in Sigil builds these steel assassins to pursue a chosen quarry across planes.

sections.Languages: Understands Modron and its owner's language. It cannot speak.
sections.Damage immunities: Poison and psychic. Also bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, stunned.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The predator has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The predator casts with Wisdom and requires no components.
3/day each. Dimension Door and Plane Shift, both self only.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d6 + 7) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage.
Stunning Roar (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 19 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 27 (5d10) thunder damage, drops everything it holds and is stunned for 1 minute. On a success, it takes half damage. A stunned creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns and end the stun on a success.
sections.Pursuit: To build a predator, the hexton needs a personal item linked to the quarry. The predator detects the quarry across planes to within about 1,000 yards and uses sight and smell to close the remaining distance. It targets the quarry unless another creature blocks its way. It normally returns to Sigil for disassembly afterward. A damaged predator may stay behind and hunt lookalikes or nearby creatures.
sections.Constructed nature: The predator needs no air, food, drink or sleep.

name: Stone Cursed
description: An alchemist can animate a petrified humanoid as a loyal guardian. Fragments of the victim’s memories survive in an obsidian skull inside it.

sections.Languages: The languages it knew in life.
sections.Traits:
Cunning Opportunist. The stone cursed has advantage on opportunity attack rolls.
False Appearance. While motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary statue.
sections.Actions: Petrifying Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage, or 14 (2d10 + 3) if the attack roll had advantage. A creature hit must make a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure, it begins turning to stone and is restrained until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. A second failure petrifies it for 24 hours. A success ends the effect.
sections.Cryptic Whispers: When the stone cursed dies, its body shatters and reveals its obsidian skull. At the end of a short rest, a character can ask the skull a question aloud and try a DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) check. On a success, a memory answers the question. The skull can be used this way only once, even if the check fails.
sections.Constructed nature: The stone cursed needs no air, food, drink or sleep.

name: Stone Defender
description: Riveted stone plates let this clockwork bodyguard blend into rough masonry and shield nearby allies.

sections.Languages: Understands one language of its creator. It cannot speak.
sections.Damage immunities: Poison. Also bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without adamantine weapons.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Traits:
False Appearance. While motionless against rough earth or stone, the defender is indistinguishable from that surface.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions: Slam. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it falls prone.
sections.Reactions: Intercept Attack. When another creature within 5 ft. is hit by an attack roll, the defender can grant it +5 AC against that attack, potentially turning the hit into a miss. The defender must see both attacker and target.
sections.Clockwork enhancements:
For an individual clockwork, choose or roll one enhancement and one potential malfunction, both on d10.
1. Camouflaged. Gain Stealth proficiency if needed. While still, the clockwork passes for an inactive machine.
2. Sensors. Raise darkvision to at least 120 ft. and add Perception proficiency if needed.
3. Improved Armor. Increase AC by 2.
4. Increased Speed. Increase speed by 10 ft.
5. Reinforced Construction. Gain resistance to force, lightning and thunder damage.
6. Self-Repairing. At the start of its turn, recover 5 HP if it has at least 1 HP. Lightning damage skips the next recovery.
7. Sturdy Frame. Add its number of Hit Dice to its maximum HP.
8. Suction. Gain a 30-ft. climbing speed.
9. Vocal Resonator. It speaks rudimentary Common or Gnomish, as its maker decides.
10. Water Propulsion. Gain a 30-ft. swimming speed.
sections.Clockwork malfunctions:
1. Faulty Sensors. Roll a d6 at turn start. On a 1, the clockwork is blinded until turn end.
2. Flawed Targeting. Roll a d6 at turn start. On a 1, its attack rolls have disadvantage until turn end.
3. Ground Fault. Gain vulnerability to lightning damage.
4. Imprinting Loop. Roll a d6 at turn start. On a 1, it mistakes a visible creature within 30 ft. for its maker. It avoids harming that creature for 1 minute or until the creature attacks or damages it.
5. Leaking Lubricant. Roll a d6 at turn start. On a 1, it gains one level of exhaustion despite immunity.
6. Limited Steering. It moves in straight lines, turning up to 90 degrees before moving and once at the halfway point. It can rotate freely on a turn when it uses none of its speeds.
7. Overactive Sense of Self-Preservation. At the start of a combat turn while at half HP or less, roll a d6. On a 1, the clockwork retreats if it can. If it cannot retreat, it keeps fighting.
8. Overheats. Roll a d6 at turn start. On a 1, it is incapacitated until turn end.
9. Rusty Gears. It has disadvantage on initiative rolls and its speed drops by 10 ft.
10. Weak Armor. Remove its immunity to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical, non-adamantine attacks.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen’s Tome of Foes, p. 126, with Clockwork customization on p. 124.

name: Summer Eladrin
description: An eladrin in its summer aspect moves quickly and pours its anger into burning weapon strikes.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Fearsome Presence. A creature other than an eladrin that starts its turn within 60 ft. must make a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is frightened of this eladrin for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns and end the effect on a success. When the effect ends or the creature succeeds on the save, it is immune to any eladrin's Fearsome Presence for 24 hours.
Magic Resistance. The eladrin has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two weapon attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 15 (2d10 + 4) using two hands, plus 4 (1d8) fire damage either way.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) fire damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Fey Step (Recharge 4–6). Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space.
sections.Reactions: Parry. The eladrin adds 3 to its AC against a melee attack that would hit it. It must see the attacker and wield a melee weapon.
sections.Printing notes: The printed stat block lists passive Perception 9. The usual calculation from its Wisdom score gives 11.

name: Sword Wraith Commander
description: A disgraced officer's ghost leads fallen soldiers in pursuit of a victory that will restore its honor.

sections.Languages: The languages it knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Also bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two weapon attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) using two hands.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Call to Honor (1/Day). The commander can use this action only after taking damage in the current combat. It gains advantage on attack rolls through the end of its next turn. Roll 1d4 + 1 to determine how many Sword Wraith Warriors appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 ft. They act immediately after the commander's turn on its initiative count and remain until they drop to 0 hit points.
sections.Bonus actions: Martial Fury. Make one weapon attack. A hit deals an extra 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. After it uses Martial Fury, attack rolls against the wraith have advantage until the start of its next turn.
sections.Undead nature: The wraith needs no air, food, drink or sleep.
sections.Traits: Turning Defiance. The commander and other Sword Wraiths within 30 ft. of it have advantage on saves against effects that turn undead.

name: Sword Wraith Warrior
description: A fallen warrior returns as an armed ghost, still guarding its reputation and spoiling for battle.

sections.Languages: The languages it knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Also bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Actions:
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) using two hands.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Martial Fury. Make one weapon attack. After it uses Martial Fury, attack rolls against the wraith have advantage until the start of its next turn.
sections.Undead nature: The wraith needs no air, food, drink or sleep.

name: The Angry
description: This two-headed sorrowsworn feeds on violence. The heads bicker until something gives them a reason to fight.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing while in dim light or darkness.
sections.Traits:
Two Heads. The Angry has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saves against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned or knocked unconscious.
Rising Anger. When another creature damages the Angry, its attack rolls gain advantage through the end of its next turn. The first Hook hit on that next turn deals an extra 19 (3d12) psychic damage. The Angry has disadvantage on attack rolls on its turn if no other creature has damaged it since the end of its previous turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Hook attacks.
Hook. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d12 + 3) piercing damage.

name: The Hungry
description: A Shadowfell predator with grasping claws and an enormous mouth. Seeing another creature recover makes its appetite more dangerous.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing while in dim light or darkness.
sections.Traits: Life Hunger. When a creature the Hungry can see regains hit points, the Hungry gains advantage on attack rolls and deals an extra 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on Bite hits. Both benefits last until the end of its next turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage. A Medium or smaller target is grappled (escape DC 16) and restrained until the grapple ends. The Hungry cannot use Claws while grappling a creature.

name: The Lonely
description: This sorrowsworn throws out its harpoon-like arms to pull distant creatures into reach.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing while in dim light or darkness.
sections.Traits:
Psychic Leech. At the start of the Lonely’s turn, each creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage.
Thrives on Company. The Lonely has advantage on attack rolls when at least two other creatures are within 30 ft. Otherwise, it has disadvantage on attack rolls.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Harpoon Arm attack and use Sorrowful Embrace.
Harpoon Arm. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (4d8 + 3) piercing damage. It also grapples a Large or smaller creature (escape DC 15). The Lonely has two harpoon arms and can grapple up to two creatures at once.
Sorrowful Embrace. Every creature the Lonely has grappled makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage. On a success, it takes half damage. Either way, the Lonely pulls each grappled creature up to 30 ft. directly toward itself.

name: The Lost
description: A desperate sorrowsworn that reaches for nearby creatures. Its embrace spreads the panic it feels.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing while in dim light or darkness.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Arm Spike attacks.
Arm Spike. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage.
Embrace. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 25 (4d10 + 3) piercing damage and grapples a Medium or smaller creature (escape DC 14). Until the grapple ends, the creature is frightened and takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage at the end of each of its turns. The Lost can embrace only one creature at a time.
sections.Reactions: Tightening Embrace. When the Lost takes damage while grappling a creature, it can deal 18 (4d8) psychic damage to the grappled creature.

name: The Wretched
description: These small sorrowsworn hunt in packs and drain the life of creatures they latch onto.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing and slashing while in dim light or darkness.
sections.Traits: Wretched Pack Tactics. The Wretched has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Wretched’s allies is within 5 ft. of that creature and is not incapacitated. Otherwise, the Wretched has disadvantage on attack rolls.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage and attaches the Wretched to the target. While attached, the Wretched cannot attack. The target takes 6 (1d10 + 1) necrotic damage whenever the Wretched starts its turn. The Wretched moves with the target without spending movement and can spend 5 ft. of movement on its own turn to detach. Any creature, including the target, can use its action to detach it.

name: Titivilus
description: Dispater’s adviser uses a silver sword, deceptive speech and magical misdirection to manipulate enemies.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Also bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/Day). When Titivilus fails a saving throw, he can succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Titivilus has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. His weapon attacks are magical.
Regeneration. Titivilus regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn. Cold or radiant damage suppresses this healing at the start of his next turn. He dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and does not regenerate.
Ventriloquism. Whenever Titivilus speaks, he can make his voice come from a point he chooses within 60 ft.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Titivilus casts with Charisma (spell save DC 21) and needs no material components.
At will. Alter Self, Animate Dead, Bestow Curse, Confusion, Major Image, Modify Memory, Nondetection, Sending, Suggestion.
3/day each. Greater Invisibility (self only), Mislead.
1/day each. Feeblemind, Symbol (discord or sleep only).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Silver Sword attack and use Frightful Word once.
Silver Sword. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage with two hands. Both grips also deal 16 (3d10) necrotic damage. A creature’s hit point maximum decreases by half the necrotic damage it takes.
Frightful Word. Choose one visible creature within 10 ft. It must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom save or become frightened of Titivilus for 1 minute. On each turn while frightened this way, the creature must Dash and take the safest route away from him. If no route is available, it does not have to Dash. At the end of each of the target’s turns, it can save again to end the effect.
Teleport. Titivilus magically moves himself and the equipment he wears or carries up to 120 ft. to a visible unoccupied space.
Twisting Words. Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. It must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma save or become charmed by Titivilus for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the save if Titivilus damages it. A successful save makes it immune to his Twisting Words for 24 hours.
sections.Legendary actions:
Titivilus has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of his turn. He can use one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn.
Assault (Costs 2 Actions). Make a Silver Sword attack or use Frightful Word.
Corrupting Guidance. Use Twisting Words, or choose one creature within 60 ft. that Titivilus has charmed. That creature makes a DC 21 Charisma save. On a failure, Titivilus decides how the creature acts during its next turn.
Teleport. Use the Teleport action.

name: Tortle
description: A turtlelike traveler whose shell protects it in a fight and lets it shelter in place.

sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The tortle can hold its breath for 1 hour.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage with two hands.
Light Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +2 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d8) piercing damage.
Shell Defense. The tortle withdraws into its shell and gains +4 AC and advantage on Strength and Constitution saves until it emerges. While withdrawn, it is prone, its speed is 0 and cannot increase, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saves, and it cannot take reactions or take any action except a bonus action to emerge.

name: Tortle Druid
description: This turtle-shelled wanderer draws on the natural world for magic and can retreat inside its shell to weather an attack.

sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The tortle can hold its breath for up to 1 hour.
sections.Spellcasting:
The tortle is a 4th-level druid spellcaster. Wisdom is its spellcasting ability (DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Druidcraft, Guidance, Produce Flame.
1st level (4 slots). Animal Friendship, Cure Wounds, Speak with Animals, Thunderwave.
2nd level (3 slots). Darkvision, Hold Person.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) with two hands.
Shell Defense. The tortle withdraws into its shell, gaining +4 AC and advantage on Strength and Constitution saves until it emerges. Inside its shell, it is prone, has disadvantage on Dexterity saves, has a speed of 0 that cannot increase, and cannot take reactions. The only action it can take is a bonus action to emerge.

name: Vampiric Mist
description: A vampire denied rest can dissolve into a hungry mist. It lurks in fog and takes on a deeper red hue whenever it feeds.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid, cold, lightning, necrotic, and thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained.
sections.Traits:
Life Sense. The mist locates creatures within 60 ft., except constructs and undead.
Forbiddance. The mist can enter a residence only if an occupant invites it inside.
Misty Form. The mist and other creatures can share spaces. It passes wherever air can flow without squeezing. In water, each foot of movement costs 2 extra feet. It cannot manipulate anything that requires fingers or manual dexterity.
Sunlight Hypersensitivity. The mist takes 10 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
Undead Nature. The mist needs no air or sleep.
sections.Actions: Life Drain. Touch one creature in the mist’s space. The target makes a DC 13 Constitution save. Constructs and undead automatically succeed. On a failure, the target takes 10 (2d6 + 3) necrotic damage and the mist recovers 10 HP. The target loses as many points from its HP maximum as it took in necrotic damage until it finishes a long rest. If that maximum falls to 0, the target dies.
sections.Tactics: The mist can smell blood from up to 1 mile away and concentrates on wounded targets. Its feeding can go unnoticed by a sleeping victim.

name: Venom Troll
description: Heavy exposure to poison can turn a troll’s own blood into venom. Even a successful hit can splash poison onto nearby creatures.

sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. The troll has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on smell.
Poison Splash. Whenever the troll takes damage other than psychic damage, each creature within 5 ft. takes 9 (2d8) poison damage.
Regeneration. The troll regains 10 HP at the start of its turns. Acid or fire damage stops this recovery at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn at 0 HP and cannot regenerate.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claws attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage and 4 (1d8) poison damage. The target is poisoned until the start of the troll’s next turn.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage and 4 (1d8) poison damage.
Venom Spray (Recharge 6). The troll cuts itself for 7 (2d6) slashing damage that cannot be reduced. Each creature in the 15-ft. cube of spray makes a DC 16 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 18 (4d8) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a success, it takes half damage and is not poisoned. A poisoned creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.

name: Wastrilith
description: This Abyssal demon taints the water around it, churning currents to hold its prey in place or drag it within reach.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, and lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The wastrilith can breathe air and water.
Corrupt Water. At the start of each of its turns, the wastrilith corrupts exposed water within 30 ft. Corruption lightly obscures the area underwater until a current disperses it. Contaminated water held in containers stays foul until it evaporates. A creature that drinks or swims in the water makes a DC 18 Constitution save. Success grants immunity to the foul water for 24 hours. Failure deals 14 (4d6) poison damage and poisons the creature for 1 minute. At the end of that minute, the poisoned creature must repeat the save. On another failure, it takes 18 (4d8) poison damage and stays poisoned until it finishes a long rest. Another demon that spends an action drinking the water gains 11 (2d10) temporary HP.
Magic Resistance. The wastrilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Bonus actions: Undertow. While underwater, the wastrilith can make all water within 60 ft. difficult terrain for other creatures until the start of its next turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Grasping Spout and make one Bite and two Claws attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 30 (4d12 + 4) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage.
Grasping Spout. Choose a visible creature within 60 ft. The magical jet forces a DC 17 Strength save, made with disadvantage if the target is underwater. On a failure, it takes 22 (4d8 + 4) acid damage and is pulled up to 60 ft. toward the wastrilith. On a success, it takes half damage and stays in place.
sections.Optional abyssal corruption: The book suggests applying the 2014 Dungeon Master’s Guide chapter 2 Abyssal Corruption rule to a creature poisoned by drinking the corrupt water.

name: Water Elemental Myrmidon
description: A summoned water elemental bound inside a suit of plate armor carries out its maker’s orders with an enchanted trident.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Languages: Aquan plus one language its creator chooses.
sections.Traits: Magic Weapons. The myrmidon’s weapon attacks are magical.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Trident attacks.
Trident. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) if used with two hands to make a melee attack.
Freezing Strikes (Recharge 6). Use Multiattack. Each hit deals an extra 5 (1d10) cold damage. A target hit by one or more of those attacks loses 10 ft. of speed until the end of the myrmidon’s next turn.
sections.Table notes: The printed Constitution score is 15 but its adjacent modifier is +3. Use the standard +2 when rolling from the score. The stat block retains the printed 127 HP and 17d8 + 51 formula.

name: White Abishai
description: A ferocious winged devil rushes into close combat with a sword and turns to snap at anything within reach when wounded.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.
sections.Traits:
Devil’s Sight. Magical darkness does not impede the abishai’s darkvision.
Magic Resistance. The abishai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. The abishai’s weapon attacks are magical.
Reckless. At the start of its turn, the abishai can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls for that turn. If it does, attack rolls against the abishai have advantage until the start of its next turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Longsword and one Claw attack.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage or 8 (1d10 + 3) with two hands.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage and 3 (1d6) cold damage.
sections.Reactions: Vicious Reprisal. When the abishai takes damage, it makes a Bite attack against a random creature within 5 ft. If no creature is within reach, it moves up to half its speed toward an enemy it can see without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Winter Eladrin
description: A Feywild elf’s melancholy takes physical form. Bitter cold surrounds it and frozen tears gather on its cheeks.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The eladrin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Sorrowful Presence. A creature other than an eladrin that starts its turn within 60 ft. of the eladrin makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is charmed for 1 minute and has disadvantage on ability checks and saves while charmed. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, and whenever this eladrin damages it, ending the effect on a success. A creature that succeeds on the save or whose effect ends is immune to any eladrin’s Sorrowful Presence for 24 hours.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The eladrin casts with Intelligence (DC 16) and needs no material components.
At will. Fog Cloud, Gust of Wind.
1/day each. Cone of Cold, Ice Storm.
sections.Actions:
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d8) slashing damage, or 5 (1d10) with two hands.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d8) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Fey Step (Recharge 4–6). Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space.
sections.Reactions: Frigid Rebuke. When a creature the eladrin can see within 60 ft. damages it, that creature must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution save or take 11 (2d10) cold damage.
sections.Changeable nature: On finishing a long rest while not incapacitated, the eladrin can adopt a different season and use the new season’s stat block. Damage taken, conditions, and other ongoing effects carry over to the new form.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen’s Tome of Foes, p. 197 for the stat block and p. 195 for Changeable Nature.

name: Yagnoloth
description: Yagnoloths draw up yugoloth contracts and negotiate on behalf of their kind. The smaller arm handles the paperwork. The larger arm settles disputes by force.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The yagnoloth uses Charisma (spell save DC 16) and needs no material components.
At will. Darkness, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Invisibility (self only), Suggestion.
3/day. Lightning Bolt.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The yagnoloth has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Massive Arm attack and one Electrified Touch attack. Alternatively, make one Massive Arm attack and use Teleport before or after it.
Electrified Touch. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 27 (6d8) lightning damage.
Massive Arm. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 23 (3d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 16 Constitution save or be stunned until the end of the yagnoloth's next turn.
Life Leech. Touch one incapacitated creature within 15 ft. The target takes 36 (7d8 + 4) necrotic damage, and the yagnoloth gains temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt. On a failed DC 16 Constitution save, reduce the target's maximum hit points by the damage it took until it finishes a long rest. The target dies if the reduction brings its maximum to 0.
Battlefield Cunning (Recharge 4–6). Up to two allied yugoloths within 60 ft. that can hear the yagnoloth can each spend their reaction to make one melee attack.
Teleport. The yagnoloth and its worn or carried equipment magically move up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see.

name: Yeenoghu
description: The Gnoll Lord hunts captives across the Death Dells with gnolls and hyenas. He calls his three-headed flail the Butcher and can summon it into his hand at will.

sections.Damage immunities: Poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical sources.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Yeenoghu uses Charisma (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks) and needs no material components.
At will. Detect Magic.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Fear, Invisibility.
1/day. Teleport.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Yeenoghu can choose to succeed on a failed saving throw.
Magic Resistance. He has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. His weapon attacks are magical.
Rampage. After reducing a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on his turn, Yeenoghu can use a bonus action to move up to half his speed and make one Bite attack.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Flail attacks. After each hit, Yeenoghu may choose or roll for one extra effect below. Each effect can apply only once per Multiattack.
1. Deal another 13 (2d12) bludgeoning damage.
2. The target makes a DC 17 Constitution save. On a failure, it is paralyzed until the start of Yeenoghu's next turn.
3. The target makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure, it suffers the effects of Confusion until the start of Yeenoghu's next turn.
Flail. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (1d12 + 9) bludgeoning damage.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (1d10 + 9) piercing damage.
sections.Legendary actions:
Yeenoghu has 3 legendary actions. He can use one option at the end of another creature's turn and recovers all spent actions at the start of his turn.
Charge (1 action). Move up to his speed.
Swat Away (1 action). Make one Flail attack. On a hit, the target makes a DC 24 Strength save. On a failure, it is pushed 15 ft. directly away from Yeenoghu. If the save fails by 5 or more, it also falls prone.
Savage (2 actions). Make a separate Bite attack against each creature within 10 ft.
sections.Lair actions:
On initiative count 20, losing initiative ties, choose one effect. Yeenoghu cannot repeat the same effect in consecutive rounds.
Iron Spike. A spike 5 ft. tall and 1 inch wide rises from a point on the ground Yeenoghu can see within 100 ft. Each creature in that space makes a DC 24 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 27 (6d8) piercing damage and is restrained by the spike. A creature can use an action to pull itself or a creature it can reach off the spike, ending the restraint.
Pack Rush. Every gnoll or hyena Yeenoghu can see can use its reaction to move up to its speed.
Enrage the Pack. Until the next initiative count 20, all gnolls and hyenas in the lair have advantage on melee weapon attack rolls. Attack rolls against them also have advantage.
sections.Regional effects:
Choose one or more effects around the lair.
Iron spikes grow from ground and stone within 1 mile. Yeenoghu uses them to display bodies.
Predatory beasts within 6 miles kill far more than they need to eat and leave the carcasses to rot.
A humanoid that spends at least 1 hour within 1 mile must pass a DC 17 Wisdom save or roll on the Madness of Yeenoghu table. A successful save grants 24 hours of immunity to this effect.
The effects fade over 1d10 days after Yeenoghu dies.
sections.Madness of Yeenoghu:
Roll d100 when a creature goes mad in the lair or in Yeenoghu's line of sight. The resulting flaw lasts until cured.
01–20. Feeds on others' anger and tries to whip up a mob.
21–40. Craves the flesh of other intelligent creatures.
41–60. Rejects laws and customs in favor of a more primitive way of life.
61–80. Starts fights in the hope that someone will die.
81–100. Makes ornaments from trophies taken from the dead.
sections.Source notes: Page 155 lists Constitution 23 with a +8 modifier and Intelligence 15 with a +3 modifier. Under the standard ability rules the scores yield +6 and +2. The printed scores, listed saving throws, and hit points are preserved here.

name: Young Kruthik
description: Young kruthiks hunt as a pack in rocky warrens near sources of heat. Guards warn the hive by tapping the stone with their legs. Kruthiks tend to avoid places that smell of their dead.

sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. The young kruthik has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
Pack Tactics. Its attack roll has advantage if an ally that isn't incapacitated is within 5 ft. of the target.
Tunneler. The young kruthik can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed. It leaves a tunnel 2½ ft. across.
sections.Actions: Stab. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Zaratan
description: A zaratan resembles an immense stone turtle. Its movements shake the ground and topple structures.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Elemental Nature. The zaratan needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). It can choose to succeed on a failed saving throw.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
Siege Monster. It deals double damage to objects and structures. The damage to structures in Earth-Shaking Movement already includes this trait.
sections.Bonus actions:
Earth-Shaking Movement. After moving at least 10 ft. on the ground, the zaratan can send a shock wave through the ground in a 120-ft. radius centered on it. The affected area becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute. A concentrating creature on the ground makes a DC 25 Constitution save or loses concentration.
Each structure in the area in contact with the ground takes 100 thunder damage. When one collapses, each creature within a distance equal to half the structure's height makes a DC 25 Dexterity save. On a failure it takes 17 (5d6) bludgeoning damage, falls prone, and is restrained by the rubble. On a success it takes half damage and avoids both conditions.
A buried creature can use an action to attempt a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check to escape. A helper within 5 ft. can use an action to clear rubble and grant advantage on the check. If three helpers do so, the check succeeds automatically.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Stomp attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 28 (4d8 + 10) piercing damage.
Stomp. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 26 (3d10 + 10) bludgeoning damage.
Spit Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +17 to hit, range 120/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 31 (6d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage.
Spew Debris (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 90-ft. cube makes a DC 25 Dexterity save. Deal 33 (6d10) bludgeoning damage on a failure or half on a success. A creature that fails by 5 or more also falls prone.
sections.Legendary actions:
The zaratan has 3 legendary actions. It can use one option at the end of another creature's turn and recovers all spent actions at the start of its turn.
Stomp (1 action). Make one Stomp attack.
Move (1 action). Move up to its speed.
Spit (2 actions). Use Spit Rock.
Retract (2 actions). Withdraw into its shell. It is restrained and has resistance to all damage until it uses Emerge. Its next legendary action must be Revitalize or Emerge.
Revitalize (2 actions). While retracted, regain 52 (5d20) hit points. Its next legendary action must be Emerge.
Emerge (2 actions). While retracted, leave the shell and use Spit Rock.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen’s Tome of Foes, p. 201. The shared Elemental Nature rule appears on p. 198.

name: Zariel
description: The archduke of Avernus leads the infernal armies in the Blood War. Her basalt citadel rises above the Styx.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, radiant. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Zariel uses Charisma (spell save DC 26) and needs no material components.
At will. Alter Self (can appear Medium when changing appearance), Detect Evil and Good, Fireball, Invisibility (self only), Wall of Fire.
3/day each. Blade Barrier, Dispel Evil and Good, Finger of Death.
sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. Zariel's darkvision works through magical darkness.
Fiery Weapons. Her weapon attacks are magical. Her weapons deal 36 (8d8) extra fire damage on a hit, already included in the Longsword and Javelin damage.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). She can choose to succeed on a failed saving throw.
Magic Resistance. She has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. Zariel regains 20 hit points at the start of her turn. Taking radiant damage prevents this recovery at the start of her next turn. She dies only if she starts a turn at 0 hit points and fails to regenerate.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Zariel makes two Longsword attacks or two Javelin attacks. She can replace one attack with Horrid Touch when it is available.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage with one hand or 19 (2d10 + 8) with two hands, plus 36 (8d8) fire damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d6 + 8) piercing damage plus 36 (8d8) fire damage.
Horrid Touch (Recharge 5–6). Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 44 (8d10) necrotic damage and leaves the target poisoned for 1 minute.
