Stone Avalanche (requires Hill Rune). Conjure rocks in a 20-ft.-radius, 40-ft.-high cylinder centered on a visible point on the ground within 120 ft. Each creature there makes a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes 28 (8d6) bludgeoning damage and falls prone. On a success, it takes half damage. The rocks make the ground in the area difficult terrain until the start of the giant’s next turn, when they vanish.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell using Wisdom (spell save DC 16). At will: Druidcraft, Guidance. 1/day each: Stone Shape, Wall of Stone.
sections.Reactions: Hill Rebuff (requires Hill Rune). Immediately after a visible creature within 10 ft. damages the giant, that creature must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) force damage and be pushed 10 ft. horizontally away from the giant.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 157.

name: Lightning Hulk
publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
description: A living lightning bolt with a giant’s face flickering at its head. It briefly takes on the shape of a storm giant before streaking away again.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold and thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained.
sections.Traits:
Illumination. The hulk sheds bright light for 20 ft. and dim light for another 20 ft.
Lightning Form. The hulk can enter and stop in hostile creatures’ spaces, and can move through openings as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. A creature takes 7 (2d6) lightning damage the first time the hulk enters its space on a turn or if the hulk starts its turn there. A creature also takes 7 (2d6) lightning damage if it touches the hulk or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 ft.
sections.Actions: Arc Lightning. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (4d8) lightning damage. A creature hit cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn. If the target is a creature, lightning also jumps to another creature the hulk chooses and can see within 30 ft. of the target. The second creature must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 18 (4d8) lightning damage.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 158.

name: Maw of Yeenoghu
publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
description: A hill giant transformed into a ravenous fiend by Yeenoghu. Its teeth grow fast enough to replace the ones it tears out and throws.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The maw has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Bite or Fang Fling for each.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (2d12 + 6) piercing damage.
Fang Fling. Ranged weapon attack, +10 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (1d10 + 6) piercing damage.
Gorging Charge (Recharge 5–6). Move up to the maw’s speed without provoking opportunity attacks, including through spaces occupied by Large or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space the maw enters for the first time during this move makes a DC 18 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 25 (3d12 + 6) piercing damage and is grappled (escape DC 16). If already grappled this way, it also falls prone. The maw can hold only one creature this way at a time, and the creature is restrained until the grapple ends.
sections.Reactions: Fanged Rebuke. After taking damage, make one Bite attack against a random creature within 10 ft. If no creature is within reach, the maw can make two Fang Fling attacks instead.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 159.

name: Mist Hulk
publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
description: Living rain clouds in the shape of a giant. Their wails stir old regrets, and their bodies collapse into a surge of water when slain.

sections.Traits:
Air Form. The hulk can enter another creature’s space and stop there. It can pass through a 1-inch opening without squeezing.
Death Burst. When the hulk dies, every creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 16 Dexterity save against its surge of water. On a failure, the creature takes 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage and falls prone. On a success, it takes half damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d10 + 5) cold damage.
Hideous Wailing (Recharge 5–6). The hulk lets out a magical wail. Every creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 14 Wisdom save, with disadvantage if it shares the hulk’s space. On a failure, it takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage and is incapacitated for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the incapacitation on a success.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 160.

name: Mud Hulk
publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
description: Descended from isolated hill giants, this elemental sheds wet mud wherever it walks and absorbs anything it can engulf.

sections.Traits:
Amorphous. The hulk can pass through a 1-inch opening without squeezing.
Sticky Mud. Other creatures treat the ground within 15 ft. of the hulk as difficult terrain.
sections.Actions:
Enveloping Slam. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 9 (1d12 + 3) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit makes a DC 13 Strength save. On a failure, the hulk pulls it into its space and engulfs it. The target is restrained, cannot breathe, takes 6 (1d12) acid damage at the start of each of its turns, and moves with the hulk. The hulk can engulf one target at a time and cannot use Amorphous while it holds a target. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, it escapes to the nearest unoccupied space.
Mud Splash. Choose a point within 30 ft. All creatures within 10 ft. of that point make a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage on a failure or half as much on a success. The area is difficult terrain until the start of the hulk’s next turn.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 161.

name: Regisaur
publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
description: This immense predator can clamp one foe in its jaws while sweeping at another with its tail.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The regisaur has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Tail attack and do not target the same creature with both.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 47 (6d12 + 8) piercing damage and grapple the target (escape DC 18). The target remains restrained while held, and the regisaur cannot Bite a different target until the grapple ends.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 26 (4d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Swallow. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., against one Huge or smaller creature the regisaur has grappled. A hit swallows the creature and ends the grapple. The creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover from attacks and effects outside the regisaur, and takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. The regisaur can hold two swallowed creatures at once. If a swallowed creature deals 25 or more damage to the regisaur in one turn, the regisaur makes a DC 16 Constitution save at the end of that turn. On a failure, it expels that creature, which lands prone within 5 ft. and is no longer blinded or restrained by Swallow.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 130.

name: Rime Hulk
publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
description: An elemental descendant of isolated frost giants. Its unstable body trails frost and breaks apart in a burst of icy air at death.

sections.Traits: Death Burst. When the hulk dies, creatures within 10 ft. make a DC 15 Constitution save. A creature that fails takes 10 (3d6) cold damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) cold damage.
Trail of Frost (Recharge 5–6). The hulk moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. It can cross spaces occupied by Medium or smaller creatures. The first time it enters a particular creature’s space during this move, that creature makes a DC 15 Constitution save. A failure deals 22 (4d10) cold damage and reduces its speed by 10 ft. until the start of the hulk’s next turn. A success halves the damage.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 162.

name: Runic Colossus
publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
description: A 30-foot guardian of stone and metal built by several kinds of giant working together. Unless ordered otherwise, it attacks non-giants it sees.

sections.Damage immunities: Poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. The colossus is immune to spells and effects that would change its form.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Siege Monster. The colossus deals double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks, then use Stomp.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 26 (3d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
Stomp. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. A Huge or smaller creature hit must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity save to avoid falling prone. The creature is restrained until the colossus uses Stomp again or moves. The restrained creature or another creature within 5 ft. of it can use an action to attempt a DC 22 Strength check. On a success, the restrained creature moves to an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 ft. of the colossus and the restraint ends.
Arcane Beam (Recharge 5–6). The colossus fires magical force from its chest, hands, or head in a 150-ft. line that is 10 ft. wide. Each creature in the line makes a DC 22 Dexterity save, taking 58 (9d12) force damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Reactions: Spell Reflection (2/day). Ranged spell attack, +14 to hit, range 120 ft., against a creature casting a spell of 5th level or lower. On a hit, deal 26 (4d12) force damage. The caster then makes a DC 15 Intelligence save. The spell fails with no effect if the caster fails that save.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 163.

name: Spectral Cloud
publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
description: A skeletal cloud giant haunts the heart of a fog bank. Some rise after a betrayal or failed wager, and others seek this fate through a ritual.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained.
sections.Traits:
Blurred Form. Attack rolls against the cloud have disadvantage unless the attacker is within 15 ft. or the cloud is incapacitated.
Incorporeal Movement. The cloud treats other creatures and objects as difficult terrain when passing through them. If it ends its turn inside an object, it takes 5 (1d10) force damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Spectral Touch attacks.
Spectral Touch. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 20 (3d8 + 7) force damage and 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. A creature hit must make a DC 20 Constitution save. On a failure, subtract the necrotic damage taken from its maximum HP until it finishes a long rest. It dies if this reduces its maximum to 0 HP. A humanoid slain by this attack immediately rises as a miniature cloud using the 2014 Specter stat block. It is an independent ally of the cloud.
Chilling Winds (Recharge 5–6). A 60-ft. line of cold wind, 10 ft. wide, forces each creature in the area to make a DC 20 Constitution save. A failure deals 38 (7d10) cold damage and incapacitates the creature for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns. A success on the initial save halves the damage and avoids incapacitation. A creature that succeeds on the save or whose incapacitation ends is immune to this cloud’s Chilling Winds for 24 hours.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 176.

name: Stalker of Baphomet
publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
description: A stone giant transformed through service to Baphomet. It builds mazes as both works of art and hunting grounds.

sections.Traits:
Labyrinthine Recall. The stalker remembers every route it has traveled.
Magic Resistance. It has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Glaive attacks or two Rock attacks.
Glaive. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (2d10 + 7) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +11 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit must succeed on a DC 19 Strength save or fall prone. After each throw, roll a d6. On a 1–3, the stalker runs out of rocks.
Erupting Horns (Recharge 5–6). Choose a visible point on the ground within 60 ft. Six stone horns rise in a cylinder centered there, 30 ft. high and 30 ft. in radius, then crumble. Every creature in the cylinder makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. A failure deals 33 (6d10) piercing damage and pushes the creature up to 30 ft. upward, after which it falls. A success halves the damage.
Spellcasting. Cast one listed spell with no components, using Wisdom (save DC 15).
1/day each. Meld into Stone, Stone Shape, Wall of Stone.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 178.

name: Stone Giant of Evil Earth
publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
description: Armored devotees of Ogrémoch wield thunderous clubs in the service of the Cult of Evil Earth.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Thundering Stone Club and Boulder.
Thundering Stone Club. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage. Once per turn, the giant can make the club emit a burst that deals 10 (3d6) thunder damage to every creature other than the giant within 30 ft. of the target.
Boulder. Ranged weapon attack, +10 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and knocks the target prone unless it succeeds on a DC 18 Strength save. After throwing a boulder, roll a d6. On a 1–3, the giant has no boulders left to throw.
sections.Reactions: Unyielding. If the giant fails a saving throw to avoid being moved, knocked prone, or both, it succeeds instead.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 179.

name: Stone Giant Rockspeaker
publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
description: A stone giant sculptor and oracle channels rune magic through the crystals it wears.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The giant can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Stone Rune. The giant can use Prismatic Rays while holding or wearing its rune-bearing mineral object. The object has AC 18, 30 HP, and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. It regains all HP at the end of every turn and turns to dust if it reaches 0 HP or the giant dies. If the rune is destroyed, the giant can carve a replacement into an object it possesses when it finishes a short or long rest.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Prism Staff attacks.
Prism Staff. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage.
Exploding Geode. Throw a geode at a point within 60 ft. Each creature in a 20-ft.-radius sphere centered there makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. Failure deals 13 (3d8) piercing plus 13 (3d8) radiant damage and leaves the creature blinded until the end of its next turn. Success halves the damage and avoids the blindness. After throwing, roll a d6. On a 1–4, the giant has no geodes left to throw.
Prismatic Rays (requires Stone Rune). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. Roll a d6 separately for each creature to determine its ray. A success halves the damage and avoids the condition. Any condition imposed ends at the end of the giant's next turn.
1–2, Blazing Red. On a failure, take 35 (10d6) radiant damage and become blinded.
3–4, Dreadful Blue. On a failure, take 35 (10d6) necrotic damage and become frightened.
5–6, Sapping Green. On a failure, take 35 (10d6) force damage and become incapacitated.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 180.

name: Storm Crab
publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
description: This four-clawed crustacean patrols the drowned strongholds of storm giants.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The crab breathes air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks and one Stinger attack.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage and grapples a Huge or smaller creature (escape DC 16). Each of the crab's four claws can hold one target.
Stinger. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. A hit deals 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage. The creature must pass a DC 17 Constitution save or be poisoned and paralyzed for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending both conditions on a success.
Water Jet (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 150-ft. line 10 ft. wide makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. Failure deals 27 (6d8) bludgeoning damage, pushes the creature up to 30 ft. from the crab, and knocks it prone. Success halves the damage with no push or knockdown.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 181.

name: Storm Giant Tempest Caller
publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
description: With a runed crystal ball embedded in its body, this storm giant watches for omens and calls elemental vortices.

sections.Traits:
Alert. The giant cannot be surprised and rolls initiative with advantage.
Amphibious. The giant breathes air and water.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The giant can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Scrying (requires Storm Rune). The giant can cast Scrying with its crystal ball (save DC 17).
Storm Rune. The giant can use Tempest Call and its Scrying trait while its rune-bearing crystal ball is embedded in its body. The ball has AC 17, 50 HP, and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. It regains all HP at the end of every turn and turns to dust at 0 HP or when the giant dies. If the rune is destroyed, the giant can inscribe another crystal ball it possesses when it finishes a short or long rest.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Lightning Blade or Lightning Lance.
Lightning Blade. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 22 (3d8 + 9) slashing damage plus 16 (3d10) lightning damage.
Lightning Lance. Ranged spell attack, +13 to hit, range 500 ft., one target. A hit deals 39 (5d12 + 7) lightning damage.
Tempest Call (requires Storm Rune). An elemental vortex fills a 60-ft.-radius sphere centered on the giant. Every creature in that area except the giant makes a DC 21 Dexterity save. Failure deals 43 (8d8 + 7) cold, lightning, or thunder damage (giant's choice). Success halves the damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell without material components, using Charisma (spell save DC 21, +13 to hit with spell attacks).
At will. Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts.
1/day each. Control Water, Control Weather (as an action), Dispel Magic, Plane Shift, Sending, Time Stop.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 182.

name: Storm Herald
publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
description: Deep-sea powers twist storm giants into finned heralds whose psychic gifts serve their masters.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The herald breathes air and water.
Magic Resistance. The herald has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Claw attack, one Tentacles attack, and one Trident attack.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (3d6 + 8) slashing damage.
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 18) and restrained. It takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns until this grapple ends. The herald can grapple only one creature with its tentacles at a time.
Trident. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (3d6 + 8) piercing damage, or 21 (3d8 + 8) piercing damage with two hands, plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage either way.
Psychic Wave (Recharge 6). Choose up to three visible creatures within 90 ft. Each makes a DC 21 Intelligence save. Failure deals 23 (3d10 + 7) psychic damage and stuns the creature for 1 minute. Success halves the damage and avoids the stun. A stunned creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature reduced to 0 HP by this damage dies, and its head explodes if it has one.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 21). These psionics require no components.
At will. Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Mage Hand (invisible hand).
1/day each. Control Water, Control Weather (as an action), Sending.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 183.

name: Tempest Spirit
publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
description: A storm giant’s ritual near the Shadowfell leaves its soul bound to a cloud that rains hail and necrotic lightning.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, necrotic, poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained.
sections.Traits:
Incorporeal Movement. The spirit treats other creatures and objects as difficult terrain when moving through them. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The spirit can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Lightning Fist and Hailstone.
Lightning Fist. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 25 (4d8 + 7) lightning damage.
Hailstone. Ranged weapon attack, +12 to hit, range 90/180 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (3d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.
Death Bolt (Recharge 5–6). Hurl magical lightning in a 120-ft. line 10 ft. wide. Each creature in the line makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. Failure deals 27 (6d8) lightning damage plus 16 (3d10) necrotic damage. Success halves both. Either way, reduce the creature's HP maximum by the necrotic damage it takes. The reduction lasts until it finishes a long rest, and it dies if its maximum reaches 0.
sections.Bonus actions: Hailstorm (Recharge 4–6). Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Each creature in a cylinder centered there, 20 ft. in radius and 40 ft. high, makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. Failure deals 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) cold damage and knocks the creature prone. Success halves both types of damage without knocking it prone.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 184.

name: Troll Amalgam
publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
description: Extraordinary regeneration binds troll flesh into a massive form that can attack with severed limbs.

sections.Damage resistances: Poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The amalgam can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. The amalgam has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. The amalgam recovers 15 HP at the start of its turn. If it takes acid or fire damage, it recovers only 5 HP at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it takes at least 20 acid or fire damage while at 0 HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 25 (4d8 + 7) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions:
Fling Limb (3/day). Ranged weapon attack, +13 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (1d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage and grapples a Medium or smaller creature (escape DC 17). While grappled this way, the creature is restrained and takes 25 (4d8 + 7) slashing damage at the start of each of its turns.
The limb uses the amalgam's statistics with these changes: Medium size, 45 HP, speed 30 ft., no challenge rating or Legendary Resistance. Its only action is the Attack action, which it can use only to grapple. If the limb survives 24 hours after being thrown, roll a d12. On a 12 it regenerates into a Troll from the Monster Manual. Otherwise it withers away.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 186.

name: Troll Mutate
publication: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants
description: Unusual wounds and healing leave this troll with body mutations that can accumulate when it regenerates from 0 HP.

sections.Traits:
Mutation. When created, randomly determine the mutate's starting mutation. Roll a d4: 1 Elastic Body, 2 Psionic Mirror, 3 Spell Scarred, 4 Winged Form.
Amorphous (Elastic Body only). The mutate can pass through a gap as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Magic Resistance (Spell Scarred only). The mutate has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Psychic Rebuke (Psionic Mirror only). When the mutate takes psychic damage, each creature within 20 ft. also takes that damage.
Regeneration. The mutate recovers 10 HP at the start of its turn. Acid or fire damage prevents this at the start of its next turn. The mutate dies only if it starts its turn at 0 HP and fails to regenerate. Each time it starts at 0 HP and regenerates, randomly give it a mutation it does not already have, up to a total of four.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. (15 ft. with Elastic Body), one target. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.
Psychic Burst (Recharge 5–6). Each creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 14 Intelligence save. Failure deals 28 (8d6) psychic damage. Success halves the damage.
sections.Printed source: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants, p. 187.

name: Anarch
classification: Small or Medium humanoid (any race), chaotic neutral
description: A Gruul raider who rushes enemies and knocks down anything built in the way.

sections.Traits: Siege Monster. The anarch deals double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Bonus actions: Aggressive. Move up to the anarch’s speed toward a hostile creature it can see.
sections.Actions: Spiked Club. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage when wielded with two hands.

name: Archon of the Triumvirate
description: An armored embodiment of strict law, often riding a winged felidar over the Azorius guildhall.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Immortal Nature. The archon needs no food, drink, or sleep.
Mount. While the archon is mounted and not incapacitated, it cannot be surprised. It and its mount have advantage on Dexterity saving throws. If the mounted archon reaches 0 HP, its mount also drops to 0 HP.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Wisdom is the spellcasting ability (save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). No material components are required.
At will. Calm Emotions, Command, Compelled Duel.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Hammer of Justice attacks.
Hammer of Justice. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning and 18 (4d8) force damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 18 Strength save or fall prone.
Pacifying Presence. Choose any number of creatures the archon can see within 120 ft. On a failed DC 18 Wisdom save, a target drops held weapons, loses concentration, and becomes charmed by the archon for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect. A creature that succeeds on the save or recovers from the effect is immune to this archon’s Pacifying Presence for 24 hours.
sections.Bonus actions:
Eye of the Law. Choose a visible creature within 120 ft. to learn which laws it broke in the past 24 hours.
Mount. While unmounted, the archon can magically teleport with all worn and carried equipment into the saddle of its mount if both are on the same plane.
sections.Legendary actions:
The archon has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. Use one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn.
Rejoin Mount (1 action). If unmounted, magically teleport onto its mount and mount it, provided both are on the same plane.
Smite (2 actions). Make a Hammer of Justice attack. Its mount can then spend its reaction to make a melee weapon attack.
Detention (3 actions). Choose a visible creature within 60 ft. On a failed DC 18 Charisma save, the target is magically sent to a harmless demiplane. At the end of the archon’s next turn, it reappears where it left or in the nearest unoccupied space.
sections.Mount stat block: Use Felidar for the usual mount and add a fly speed of 40 ft. as described in the Winged Felidars sidebar.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 192. Winged Felidars on p. 199.

name: Arclight Phoenix
description: A bird of living lightning. Its death leaves a warm mizzium egg that can hatch when fed magic.

sections.Damage resistances: Thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, restrained, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Elemental Nature. The phoenix needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Flyby. Flying out of an enemy’s reach does not provoke an opportunity attack.
Grounded Lightning. The first time it touches the ground on any turn, the phoenix takes 11 (2d10) force damage.
Illumination. It sheds bright light for 15 ft. and dim light for another 15 ft.
Lightning Form. The phoenix fits through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. A creature that touches it or hits it in melee from within 5 ft. takes 9 (2d8) lightning damage. The phoenix can enter a hostile creature’s space and stop there. The first time the phoenix enters any given creature’s space on a turn, that creature takes the same lightning damage.
Crackling Death. When the phoenix dies, each creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 18 Dexterity save, taking 36 (8d8) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. Only a warm Tiny egg with a mizzium shell remains. A spell that deals lightning damage hatches it if the egg is in the spell’s area. A creature touching the egg can also hatch it by spending spell slots totaling at least 13 levels. The new phoenix appears in the egg’s space.
sections.Actions: Arclight Touch. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 27 (6d8) lightning damage. Lightning then jumps to a second creature of the phoenix’s choice that it can see within 30 ft. of the first target. The second creature takes 27 (6d8) lightning damage on a failed DC 18 Dexterity save.

name: Aurelia
description: The Boros guildmaster leads from the front, sending allies into the fight and turning a strike into battlefield healing.

sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic and radiant. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Immortal Nature. As a Ravnican angel, Aurelia needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Aurelia can turn a failed save into a success.
Magic Resistance. Aurelia has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Longsword attacks and use Leadership.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (1d8 + 8) slashing or 13 (1d10 + 8) slashing with two hands, plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage either way.
Leadership. Choose one visible creature within 30 ft. If it can hear Aurelia, it can add 1d10 to one attack roll or saving throw before the start of Aurelia’s next turn.
Warleader’s Helix (Recharge 5–6). Ranged spell attack, +17 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. A hit deals 54 (12d8) radiant damage. Aurelia can also choose a different creature she can see within 10 ft. of the target to regain 27 (6d8) HP.
sections.Reactions:
Parry. Add 7 to AC against a melee attack that would hit Aurelia. She must see the attacker and wield a melee weapon.
Unyielding. When an effect would move Aurelia, knock her prone, or both, she can prevent both outcomes.
sections.Legendary actions:
Aurelia has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of her turn. Use one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn.
Command Allies (1 action). Choose up to three creatures Aurelia can see within 30 ft. Each chosen creature that can see or hear her can immediately spend its reaction on one weapon attack with advantage.
Longsword Attack (2 actions). Make one Longsword attack.
Frighten Foes (3 actions). Choose up to five visible creatures within 30 ft. Each must pass a DC 25 Wisdom save or become frightened of Aurelia until the end of her next turn. Targets within 5 ft. of her have disadvantage on the save.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 230. Ravnican angel traits on p. 189.

name: Battleforce Angel
description: A Boros officer who dives into battle and rallies nearby troops.

sections.Traits:
Immortal Nature. The angel needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Flyby. Flying out of an enemy’s reach does not provoke an opportunity attack.
Magic Resistance. The angel has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks and use Battlefield Inspiration.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing with two hands, plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage either way. A target within 5 ft. of one or more of the angel’s allies takes another 2 (1d4) radiant damage.
Battlefield Inspiration. Choose up to three visible creatures within 30 ft. They can add 1d4 to their attack rolls and saving throws until the end of the angel’s next turn.

name: Biomancer
description: A Simic wizard whose life magic sustains allies while the fight continues around them.

sections.Traits:
Bolstering Presence. An ally that starts its turn within 30 ft. of the biomancer regains 5 (1d10) HP from the biomancer’s magic.
Magic Resistance. The biomancer has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Spellcasting:
The biomancer is a 16th-level Simic spellcaster with wizard spells prepared. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Acid Splash, Light, Mending, Poison Spray, Shocking Grasp.
1st level (4 slots). Detect Magic, Grease, Shield.
2nd level (3 slots). Alter Self, Darkvision, Enlarge/Reduce, Hold Person.
3rd level (3 slots). Counterspell, Dispel Magic, Haste, Protection from Energy.
4th level (3 slots). Confusion, Conjure Minor Elementals, Polymorph.
5th level (2 slots). Cone of Cold, Creation, Hold Monster.
6th level (1 slot). Move Earth, Wall of Ice.
7th level (1 slot). Prismatic Spray.
8th level (1 slot). Control Weather.
sections.Actions: Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

name: Blistercoil Weird
description: An Izzet mixture of water and molten rock. Magical fire feeds its growth until the accumulated energy bursts free.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold and fire. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Elemental Nature. The weird needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Feed on Fire. Fire damage from a spell or another magical effect increases the weird’s size by one category, limited by available space. At Large or bigger, it has advantage on Strength checks and saves. If it starts its turn Gargantuan, it explodes and returns to Medium. Each creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 12 Dexterity save, taking 28 (8d6) fire damage on a failure or half on a success. The explosion ignites flammable objects that nobody wears or carries.
Form of Fire and Water. The weird can pass through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. It can enter a hostile creature’s space and stop there. The first time the weird enters any given creature’s space on a turn, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and ignites. It takes another 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns until someone uses an action to douse the fire.
Heated Body. A creature that touches the weird or hits it in melee from within 5 ft. takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.
Illumination. It sheds bright light for 30 ft. and dim light for another 30 ft.
sections.Actions: Slam. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the weird is Large or bigger, use 11 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning plus 14 (4d6) fire damage instead.

name: Blood Drinker Vampire
description: An undead predator that can turn a victim’s blood into an infatuating bond. Blood drinkers haunt Ravnica’s alleys and sewers, and some collect blood tithes for the Orzhov Syndicate.

sections.Languages: The languages the vampire knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic damage. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three melee attacks, at most one of which can be a Bite.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. Target one willing creature or one creature the vampire has grappled, or that is incapacitated or restrained. On a hit, deal 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. A humanoid hit makes a DC 15 Charisma save. On a failure, the vampire charms it for 1 minute and it becomes infatuated with the vampire for that duration. Reduce the target’s hit point maximum by the necrotic damage it took. The vampire regains the same amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum reaches 0.
Rapier. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. With a free hand, the vampire can also grapple a creature it hits (escape DC 14).
sections.Reactions: Parry. Add 3 to the vampire’s AC against one melee attack that would hit it. It must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

name: Blood Witch
description: An influential Rakdos cultist who claims to speak for Rakdos. A blood witch uses Hex to steer a foe while fighting with a sword in each hand.

sections.Languages: Abyssal and one other language, usually Common.
sections.Traits: Devil’s Sight. Magical darkness does not block the witch’s darkvision.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The witch uses Charisma (save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks) and needs no material components.
At will. Alter Self, Detect Magic, Eldritch Blast (as an 11th-level caster), False Life, Levitate (self only), Mage Armor (self only, raising AC to 15).
3/day each. Hellish Rebuke, Hex, Scorching Ray (at 3rd level).
1/day each. Circle of Death, Enthrall, Suggestion.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Longsword attack and one Shortsword attack.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Blood Witch Dance. Choose one creature within 30 ft. that the witch can see and has cursed with Hex. On a failed DC 15 Charisma save, the creature uses its reaction to move up to 30 ft. in a direction the witch chooses.

name: Bloodfray Giant
description: A Rakdos bouncer or enforcer. Some hold up the mobile stages during performances and lash out at anyone who disrupts the show.

sections.Actions:
Chain. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit is grappled (escape DC 17) and restrained until the grapple ends. The giant can use Chain only against that creature while the grapple lasts.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Reactions: Furious Defense. When a foe within 20 ft. of the giant damages a creature the giant can see, the giant makes one Chain attack against that foe.

name: Borborygmos
description: The cyclops chief of the Burning Tree clan. He has kept command of the Gruul by defeating challengers and often travels with clan members whom he protects.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Borborygmos can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Poor Depth Perception. He has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets more than 30 ft. away.
Siege Monster. He deals double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Borborygmos may use Frightful Presence, and makes one Maul attack and one Stomp attack.
Maul. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 28 (6d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 21 Strength save or fall prone.
Stomp. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (2d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +13 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 29 (4d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
Frightful Presence. Choose any creatures within 60 ft. that can see or hear him. Each makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. A failed save frightens the creature of him for 1 minute. It may repeat the save at the end of each of its turns and end the effect on a success. A successful save or the end of the effect grants that creature immunity to his Frightful Presence for 24 hours.
sections.Legendary actions:
Borborygmos has 3 legendary actions and recovers spent actions at the start of his turn. Use one option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Attack (1 action). Make one weapon attack.
Bellow (2 actions). Choose one creature Borborygmos can see within 60 ft. The target makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is frightened of him for 1 minute. If it was already frightened, this option stuns it instead. It may repeat the save at the end of each of its turns and end the effect on a success. A successful save or the end of the effect grants immunity to his Bellow for 24 hours.
Wide Berth (3 actions). Move up to half speed, passing through the space of any creature smaller than Huge. The first time he enters a creature’s space during this move, it makes a DC 21 Dexterity save. On a success, push it 5 ft. away from him. On a failure, it falls prone and he may make a Stomp attack against it.

name: Cackler
description: A small Rakdos demon that performs as a jester or impersonator. Its dying laugh strikes the minds of nearby creatures.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, and lightning damage. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Last Laugh. When the cackler dies, each creature within 10 ft. must pass a DC 11 Wisdom save or take 2 (1d4) psychic damage.
Mimicry. The cackler can copy any sound it has heard, including voices. A listener can recognize the imitation with a successful DC 11 Wisdom (Insight) check.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The cackler uses Charisma (save DC 11, +3 to hit with spell attacks) and needs no material components.
At will. Fire Bolt.
1/day. Tasha's Hideous Laughter.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
Spiked Chain. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

name: Category 1 Krasis
description: A medium hybrid creature fashioned by Simic Combine biomancers. Each specimen has one major and one minor adaptation.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The krasis can breathe air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.
sections.Creating a krasis: Roll a d8 or choose once on each table. Apply one major and one minor adaptation to this base stat block before running the encounter.
sections.Major adaptations:
1. Acidic Skin. A creature that touches the krasis or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft. takes 2 (1d4) acid damage.
2. Armored Hide. Natural plates or scales increase AC by 4, to 19.
3. Bioluminescent Markings. Runelike markings grant advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
4. Flight. Wings provide a flying speed equal to its walking speed (30 ft.).
5. Grabber. A creature hit by Claws is grappled by a specialized appendage (escape DC 13). The krasis can grapple only one creature this way at a time.
6. Hypnotic Display (Recharge 5–6). As an action, surround the krasis with shifting shapes and colors. Each creature within 15 ft. that can see it must make a DC 12 Wisdom save. On a failure, the creature is stunned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect. A successful save grants immunity to Hypnotic Display from any krasis for 24 hours.
7. Venomous Sting. A creature hit by Claws must pass a DC 12 Constitution save or become poisoned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.
8. Regeneration. At the start of each of its turns, the krasis regains 2 HP if it has at least 1 HP.
sections.Minor adaptations:
1. Amorphous Structure. The krasis can pass through a 1-inch gap without squeezing.
2. Aquatic. A swimming speed equal to its walking speed (30 ft.).
3. Climbing Speed. A climbing speed equal to its walking speed (30 ft.).
4. Cryptic Skin. The krasis can shift its color to blend in. It has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide.
5. Heightened Awareness. Enhanced sensory organs prevent the krasis from being surprised.
6. Ink Cloud (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). While underwater, the krasis can spend a bonus action to release ink and then move up to its speed. The ink stays in a 20-ft.-radius sphere centered on a point in the space the krasis occupied before moving. The sphere is heavily obscured until the ink disperses after 1 minute or a strong current clears it.
7. Leaping Legs. The krasis can long jump 20 ft. and high jump 10 ft., with or without a running start.
8. Stabilizing Legs. Extra crablike legs grant advantage on Strength and Dexterity saves against effects that would knock the krasis prone.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 210. Shared adaptation rules on pp. 210–212.

name: Category 2 Krasis
description: A large hybrid creature fashioned by Simic Combine biomancers. Each specimen has one major and one minor adaptation.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The krasis can breathe air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 17 (2d12 + 4) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage.

sections.Major adaptations:
1. Acidic Skin. A creature that touches the krasis or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft. takes 4 (1d8) acid damage.
2. Armored Hide. Natural plates or scales increase AC by 4, to 19.
3. Bioluminescent Markings. Runelike markings grant advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
4. Flight. Wings provide a flying speed equal to its walking speed (40 ft.).
5. Grabber. A creature hit by Claws is grappled by a specialized appendage (escape DC 15). The krasis can grapple only one creature this way at a time.

On a failure, the creature is stunned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect. A successful save grants immunity to Hypnotic Display from any krasis for 24 hours.
7. Venomous Sting. A creature hit by Claws must pass a DC 14 Constitution save or become poisoned for 1 minute. It is also paralyzed while poisoned by this sting. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.

sections.Minor adaptations:

4. Cryptic Skin. The krasis can shift its color to blend in. It has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide.
5. Heightened Awareness. Enhanced sensory organs prevent the krasis from being surprised.

The ink stays in a 20-ft.-radius sphere centered on a point in the space the krasis occupied before moving. The sphere is heavily obscured until the ink disperses after 1 minute or a strong current clears it.
7. Leaping Legs. The krasis can long jump 30 ft. and high jump 20 ft., with or without a running start.
8. Stabilizing Legs. Extra crablike legs grant advantage on Strength and Dexterity saves against effects that would knock the krasis prone.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 211. Shared adaptation rules on pp. 210–212.

sections.Actions:

sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 212. Shared adaptation rules on pp. 210–212.

name: Cosmotronic Blastseeker
description: An Izzet field tester who uses experimental gear to push spell damage beyond its usual limits.

sections.Traits:
Empowered Spell (3/day). When rolling a spell’s damage, reroll as many as four of its damage dice. Use the results of the rerolls.
Tides of Chaos (1/day). Make an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw with advantage.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Intelligence sets the spell save DC at 14 and the spell attack bonus at +6. It uses its own Izzet gear to cast. It needs no other components, and the gear does not work for other creatures.
3/day each. Scorching Ray, Shield, Thunderwave.
2/day. Fireball.
sections.Actions: Warhammer. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) if wielded with two hands.

name: Counterflux Blastseeker
description: An Izzet field tester whose overcasting can make an area more or less susceptible to magic.

sections.Traits: Counterflux Overcast (Recharge 5–6). Immediately after it casts a spell, the blastseeker can create an invisible 15-ft.-radius sphere centered on itself. The sphere lasts until the end of the blastseeker’s next turn. Roll a d6 when creating it. On 1–3, creatures inside have disadvantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. On 4–6, those creatures have advantage on those saves.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Intelligence sets the spell save DC at 14 and the spell attack bonus at +6. It uses its own Izzet gear to cast. It needs no other components, and the gear does not work for other creatures.
3/day each. Enlarge/Reduce, Mage Armor (self only), Scorching Ray.
1/day each. Counterspell, Dispel Magic, Protection from Energy.
sections.Actions: Rapier. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Flux Blastseeker
description: An Izzet field tester whose overcasting can swap two creatures’ positions or release a thunderous pulse.

sections.Traits: Fluxbending Overcast (Recharge 5–6). Immediately after it casts a spell, the blastseeker can roll a d6 for an additional effect. On 1–3, it teleports and switches places with a creature it can see within 30 ft. On 4–6, the blastseeker and each creature within 10 ft. of it must pass a DC 16 Constitution save or take 11 (2d10) thunder damage.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Intelligence sets the spell save DC at 16 and the spell attack bonus at +8. It uses its own Izzet gear to cast. It needs no other components, and the gear does not work for other creatures.
3/day each. Mage Armor (self only), Scorching Ray.
1/day each. Banishment, Cone of Cold, Dimension Door, Fireball, Ice Storm.
sections.Actions: Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) if wielded with two hands.

name: Galvanic Blastseeker
description: An Izzet field tester who channels lightning through experimental gear and moves on brief gusts of air.

sections.Languages: Common, Primordial, and one other language.
sections.Traits:
Galvanic Overcast (Recharge 5–6). When casting Lightning Bolt or Thunderwave, the blastseeker can roll a die. On an odd result, the blastseeker takes 9 (2d8) force damage. On an even result, each target that fails its save against the spell also takes 9 (2d8) lightning damage.
Heart of the Storm. Whenever the blastseeker casts Lightning Bolt or Thunderwave, it deals 3 lightning damage to every other creature within 10 ft.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Intelligence sets the spell save DC at 15 and the spell attack bonus at +7. It uses its own Izzet gear to cast. It needs no other components, and the gear does not work for other creatures.
3/day each. Levitate, Lightning Bolt, Thunderwave.
1/day. Stoneskin.
sections.Actions: Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 3 (1d6) piercing damage, or 4 (1d8) when wielded with two hands for a melee attack.
sections.Bonus actions: Gust-Propelled Leap. Fly up to 10 ft. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

name: Conclave Dryad
description: Selesnya dryads advise the Conclave and help design its enclaves. A dryad leading troops may ride an elk-shaped mount made from living branches and vines.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The dryad makes saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Speak with Beasts and Plants. The dryad can converse with beasts and plants as though they share a language.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma sets the dryad's spell save DC to 17. It needs no material components.
At will. Druidcraft.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Entangle, Plant Growth, Spike Growth.
1/day each. Moonbeam, Grasping Vine, Wall of Thorns.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Vine Staff and Longbow.
Vine Staff. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. On a failure, vines restrain it for 1 minute. It can use an action to end the effect on itself with a successful DC 17 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Summon Mount (1/day). Magically bring forth the mount in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. Use the Elk stat block. The mount is a plant with Intelligence 6 and understands Sylvan but cannot speak. It remains for 8 hours, until it or the dryad dies, or until the dryad spends an action to dismiss it. The dryad can speak with it telepathically within 1 mile.
Suppress Magic (Recharge 5–6). Choose one magic item the dryad can see within 120 ft. If it is an artifact, the effect fails. Otherwise its magic shuts off for 10 minutes, until the dryad becomes incapacitated or dies, or until it uses a bonus action to restore the item's magic.

name: Deathpact Angel
description: An Orzhov angel grants favors to petitioners and collects the debt through service. Some debtors continue serving as indentured spirits after death.

sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic and radiant. Also bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Flyby. Leaving a foe's reach in flight does not provoke an opportunity attack.
Magic Resistance. The angel makes saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Immortal Nature. The angel needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma sets the angel's spell save DC to 19 and spell attack bonus to +11. It needs no material components.
At will. Command (as a 2nd-level spell), Detect Evil and Good.
1/day. Raise Dead.
3/day each. Charm Person (as a 5th-level spell), Darkness, Suggestion.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Scythe attacks. Chains of Obligation can replace one Scythe attack.
Scythe. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage plus 27 (6d8) necrotic damage.
Chains of Obligation. Choose a creature the angel has charmed that it can see within 90 ft. It must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma save or become paralyzed for 1 minute. Taking any damage ends this paralysis.
sections.Bonus actions: Exploitation of the Debtors. Choose a creature charmed by the angel that it can see within 30 ft. Deal 11 (2d10) necrotic damage to it and gain temporary HP equal to the damage it takes.
sections.Debts Paid: A deathpact angel may offer an indentured spirit release from its debt. If the spirit sees the angel fall to 0 HP, the spirit can destroy itself to bring the angel back to life with 1 HP.

name: Devkarin Lich
description: A Golgari elf that has prolonged its life through undeath. Fungi help hold its decaying body together.

sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Also bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed.
Regeneration. The lich recovers 10 HP at the start of its turn. Fire or radiant damage disables the next start-of-turn recovery. The lich dies only when it starts its turn at 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
Turn Resistance. The lich makes saves against effects that turn undead with advantage.
Undead Fortitude. If damage drops the lich to 0 HP, roll a Constitution save with DC 5 plus the damage taken. Skip this save for radiant damage or damage from a critical hit. On a success, the lich drops to 1 HP.
Undead Nature. The lich needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Spellcasting:
The lich is a 14th-level Golgari spellcaster with wizard spells prepared. It uses Intelligence (save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Acid Splash, Chill Touch, Mage Hand, Poison Spray, Prestidigitation.
1st level (4 slots). Chromatic Orb, Magic Missile, Ray of Sickness.
2nd level (3 slots). Melf's Acid Arrow, Ray of Enfeeblement, Spider Climb, Web.
3rd level (3 slots). Animate Dead, Bestow Curse, Fear, Vampiric Touch.
4th level (3 slots). Blight, Evard's Black Tentacles.
5th level (2 slots). Cloudkill, Insect Plague.
6th level (1 slot). Circle of Death, Create Undead.
7th level (1 slot). Finger of Death.
sections.Actions: Noxious Touch. Melee spell attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 14 (4d6) poison damage. The creature must also succeed on a DC 17 Constitution save or become poisoned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns and end the effect on itself on a success.
sections.Legendary actions:
The lich has 3 legendary actions. Spend them on one option at the end of another creature's turn. The lich regains spent actions when its turn begins.
Cantrip (1 action). Cast one of the lich's cantrips.
Noxious Touch (2 actions). Use Noxious Touch.
Disrupt Life (3 actions). Every creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 17 Constitution save. Failure deals 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. Success halves the damage.

name: Druid of the Old Ways
description: A Gruul druid devoted to ancient animal gods and the belief that Ilharg the Raze-Boar will one day trample Ravnica's city into rubble.

sections.Traits:
Siege Monster. The druid deals double damage to objects and structures.
Speak with Beasts and Plants. The druid can converse with beasts and plants as though they share a language.
sections.Spellcasting:
The druid is a 12th-level Gruul spellcaster with druid spells prepared. It uses Wisdom (save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Druidcraft, Produce Flame, Resistance, Thorn Whip.
1st level (4 slots). Cure Wounds, Faerie Fire, Thunderwave.
2nd level (3 slots). Beast Sense, Flame Blade, Pass without Trace.
3rd level (3 slots). Conjure Animals, Dispel Magic, Plant Growth.
4th level (3 slots). Dominate Beast, Freedom of Movement, Wall of Fire.
5th level (2 slots). Commune with Nature, Conjure Elemental, Scrying.
6th level (1 slot). Transport via Plants, Wall of Thorns.
sections.Actions: Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage with two hands.

name: Felidar
description: A silver-patterned celestial cat that forms a close bond with one creature. Azorius officials use these bonds to help locate escaped prisoners.

sections.Languages: Understands Celestial and Common but can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Bonding. The felidar can form a magical bond with a creature it can see immediately after observing it for at least 1 hour within 30 ft. The bond ends if that creature dies or the felidar bonds with another creature. The partners can speak telepathically within 100 ft. On the same plane the felidar can sense how far away its partner is and in which direction. Either partner can take an action to see and hear through the other's senses until the start of its next turn. While doing so, it loses its own sight and hearing.
Keen Hearing and Sight. The felidar makes Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight with advantage.
Pounce. After moving at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hitting it with Claws on the same turn, the victim must succeed on a DC 15 Strength save or fall prone. If the victim is prone, the felidar can make a Claws attack against it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage.
sections.Winged Felidars: A winged felidar uses this block and gains a flying speed of 40 ft.

name: Firefist
description: A Boros veteran who fights in plate, leads legion troops, and can direct an ally's attack with divine magic.

sections.Spellcasting:
The firefist is a 9th-level Boros spellcaster with cleric spells prepared. It uses Wisdom (save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Fire Bolt, Light, Sacred Flame, Spare the Dying.
1st level (4 slots). Guiding Bolt, Healing Word, Heroism, Shield of Faith.
2nd level (3 slots). Lesser Restoration, Scorching Ray.
3rd level (3 slots). Blinding Smite, Crusader's Mantle, Revivify.
4th level (3 slots). Banishment, Wall of Fire.
5th level (1 slot). Flame Strike.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatsword attacks.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
sections.Reactions: Guided Attack (recharges after a short or long rest). When the firefist or a creature it can see within 30 ft. makes an attack roll, add +10 to the roll.

name: Firemane Angel
description: A Boros champion who seeks out the strongest enemy in a fight. Its red hair can ignite into a mane of flame in battle.

sections.Damage resistances: Fire and radiant. Also bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Flyby. Leaving a foe's reach in flight does not provoke an opportunity attack.
Magic Resistance. The angel makes saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Relentless (recharges after a short or long rest). When 21 damage or less would drop the angel to 0 HP, the angel drops to 1 HP.
Immortal Nature. The angel needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma sets the angel's spell save DC to 18 and spell attack bonus to +10. It needs no material components.
3/day each. Compelled Duel, Guiding Bolt (as a 5th-level spell).
1/day each. Daylight, Fireball (as a 6th-level spell).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d8 + 6) slashing damage, or 11 (1d10 + 6) with two hands. Add 22 (5d8) fire or radiant damage, chosen by the angel.

name: Fluxcharger
description: Izzet engineers bound lightning, fire, and smoke inside an angel-shaped mizzium frame. The elemental is harder to control than its solemn faceplate suggests.

sections.Damage resistances: Thunder, plus bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Amplify Lightning. A spell that deals lightning damage gains an extra 9 (2d8) lightning damage if its area contains at least one fluxcharger. Additional fluxchargers in the same area cause no further increase.
Elemental Nature. The weird needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks or use Arc Lightning twice.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage.
Arc Lightning. Ranged spell attack, +7 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 16 (3d10) lightning damage. The bolt then jumps to one creature the fluxcharger can see within 30 ft. of the first target. That creature takes 13 (3d8) lightning damage on a failed DC 15 Dexterity save. After the attack resolves, the fluxcharger takes 5 (1d10) force damage whether the attack hit or missed.

name: Flying Horror
description: Dimir agents send these winged horrors after targets who would ordinarily be safe behind walls or on rooftops.

sections.Traits:
Fear Frenzy. The horror has advantage on attack rolls against frightened creatures.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the horror has disadvantage on attacks and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 8 (1d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) psychic damage.
Frightening Screech (Recharge 5–6). Each creature within 30 ft. that can hear the screech must pass a DC 13 Wisdom save or become frightened of the horror for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Once it succeeds on the save or the effect ends, it is immune to this horror’s screech for 24 hours.
sections.Customizing a Horror:
For a customized Flying Horror, choose or roll one primary and one secondary feature on two d4s.
Primary 1. Avoidance. If a successful save would halve damage, take no damage on a success and half as much on a failure.
Primary 2. Damage Resistances. Gain resistance to necrotic and psychic damage.
Primary 3. Innate Spellcasting. Cast Darkness three times per day using Charisma (spell save DC 13), without material components.
Primary 4. Psychic Rebuke. When a melee attack deals damage to the horror, it can use its reaction to deal 3 (1d6) psychic damage to each creature within 5 ft.
Secondary 1. Grasping Tendrils. The horror has four tendrils (AC 12 and 10 HP each). Destroying one deals no damage to the horror. As a bonus action, choose a creature it can see within 10 ft. The target makes a DC 9 Dexterity save or is grappled (escape DC 9). Each tendril can hold only one target at a time.
Secondary 2. Indomitable Mind. Gain immunity to being charmed.
Secondary 3. Keen Senses. Gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, hearing, or smell.
Secondary 4. Mind Sight. Magical darkness does not impede the horror’s darkvision.
sections.Horrors and Madness: If you use the book’s optional madness rule, track each failed save against a Flying Horror’s Frightening Screech, a Shadow Horror’s claw attack, or a Skittering Horror’s Maddening Presence. After the encounter, each character with any such failures makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. Failure causes short-term madness after one tracked failure, long-term madness after two or three, or indefinite madness after four or more. Consult the Dungeon Master’s Guide for the corresponding madness rules.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 203. The optional customization rules appear on p. 204.

name: Frontline Medic
description: Boros medics wear plate and carry shields so they can keep treating soldiers under fire.

sections.Spellcasting:
A 3rd-level Boros spellcaster using Wisdom (spell save DC 11).
Cantrips (at will). Mending, Resistance, Spare the Dying.
1st level (4 slots). Cure Wounds, Sanctuary.
2nd level (2 slots). Aid, Lesser Restoration.
sections.Actions: Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage when wielding it with two hands for a melee attack.

name: Galvanice Weird
description: A rigid body of elemental ice holds a lightning core. Izzet workshops use these weirds as guards and laborers.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold and lightning, plus bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Death Burst. When the weird dies, each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking 7 (2d6) lightning damage on a failure or half that damage on a success.
Elemental Nature. The weird needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions: Slam. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) lightning damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 13 Constitution save or lose its reactions until the start of the weird’s next turn.

name: Gloamwing
description: A Nightveil Specter’s undead mount has a ratlike skull, leathery wings, and patches of exposed bone plates.

sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic, plus bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Death Link. The gloamwing is destroyed if its Nightveil Specter rider drops to 0 HP.
Flyby. Flying out of a foe’s reach provokes no opportunity attacks.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the gloamwing has disadvantage on attacks and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
Undead Nature. The gloamwing needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 18 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage.
sections.Rider: The Nightveil Specter’s Mount trait grants both creatures advantage on Dexterity saves while the specter is mounted and not incapacitated. See the rider’s profile for its mounting and replacement-mount rules.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 215. The shared Undead Nature rule appears on p. 214.

name: Golgari Shaman
description: The Golgari Swarm’s shamans use fungi and necromancy to teach how new life grows from death.

sections.Traits: Fey Ancestry. The shaman has advantage on saves against being charmed, and magic cannot put it to sleep.
sections.Spellcasting:
An 8th-level Golgari spellcaster using Wisdom (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Poison Spray, Shillelagh, Thorn Whip.
1st level (4 slots). Cure Wounds, Entangle, Ray of Sickness.
2nd level (3 slots). Pass without Trace, Ray of Enfeeblement, Spike Growth.
3rd level (3 slots). Animate Dead, Dispel Magic, Plant Growth.
4th level (2 slots). Blight, Giant Insect.
sections.Actions:
Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage when wielding it with two hands.
Fungal Rot. Melee spell attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. The target also makes a DC 14 Constitution save, taking 18 (4d8) poison damage on a failure or half that damage on a success.
sections.Reactions: Feed on Death. When a creature within 30 ft. drops to 0 HP, the shaman gains 5 (1d10) temporary hit points.
sections.Lair actions:
Golgari Lairs. These actions belong to a group of six or more Golgari defending their territory. At least one defender must be Jarad Vod Savo, a Golgari Shaman, a Kraul Death Priest, an Undercity Medusa, or a Devkarin Lich. Count the lair as one additional CR 1 creature when estimating encounter difficulty.
On initiative count 20, losing ties, the group uses one lair action. It must choose a different option from the one used the previous round.
Sewer Overflow. Sewage spills from sewer openings the Golgari can see. A creature within 20 ft. of an affected opening must pass a DC 15 Dexterity save or fall prone and be pushed up to 20 ft. straight away from that opening.
Spore Cloud. Center a 20-ft.-radius sphere within 120 ft. of any member of the group. The spores spread around corners and lightly obscure the area. A creature inside when the cloud appears makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failure or half that damage on a success. A creature ending its turn inside takes 10 (3d6) poison damage. The cloud lasts until a Golgari defender dismisses it as an action, the group uses this option again, or all defenders die.
Fungal Tendrils. Center a 15-ft.-radius sphere within 60 ft. of any member of the group. Creatures in it who are not allied with the group must pass a DC 15 Dexterity save or become restrained. An affected creature can use its action to end the restraint on itself with a successful DC 15 Strength check. The restraint also ends if the group uses this option again, all defenders die, or no member remains within 60 ft. of the effect.
sections.Regional effects: A Golgari lair produces one or both of these effects, only belowground. Moss and fungi cover underground surfaces within half a mile. When a Small or Medium humanoid dies within the lair, roll any die. On an odd result the corpse rises as a fungus drudge using the 2014 Zombie stat block after 1d8 hours, unless the body is destroyed first. If all Golgari in the lair die, its effects fade over 1d10 days.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 236. This page also gives the group’s lair rules.

name: Guardian Giant
description: Boros garrisons use these Skorskal giants as watchful gatekeepers and living cover for smaller soldiers.

sections.Traits: Vigilant. The giant cannot be surprised.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Spear attacks.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60/240 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 17 (3d6 + 7) piercing damage, or 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage when wielding it with two hands for a melee attack.
sections.Reactions: Protection. When an attacker the giant can see rolls to hit a creature within 10 ft. of the giant, the giant can impose disadvantage on that roll.

name: Horncaller
description: Horncallers tend animals in Selesnya parks and enlist wild beasts to fight alongside Selesnya troops.

sections.Traits: Speak with Beasts. The horncaller can communicate with beasts as though they shared a language.
sections.Innate Spellcasting: The horncaller casts using Wisdom (spell save DC 14) and needs no material components. Once per day each, cast Bless or Conjure Animals.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Staff attacks and use One with the Worldsoul.
Staff. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage when wielding it with two hands.
One with the Worldsoul. Choose one beast the horncaller can see within 30 ft. If it can hear the horncaller, it spends its reaction to make one melee attack against a target the horncaller can see.

name: Hybrid Brute
description: A Guardian Project volunteer with thick natural armor and claws suited to close combat on land or underwater.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The hybrid breathes air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

name: Hybrid Flier
description: A Simic guardian who fights from the air with javelins and jets of acid.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Javelin attacks. You can replace one with Spit Acid.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Spit Acid. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (4d4) acid damage.

name: Hybrid Poisoner
description: A Simic guardian whose poison punishes attackers who close to melee range.

sections.Traits:
Assassinate. On the hybrid’s first turn, it has advantage on attacks against creatures that have yet to take a turn. A hit against a surprised creature is a critical hit.
Poisonous Skin. A creature takes 3 (1d6) poison damage if it touches the hybrid or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft.
sections.Actions: Toxic Touch. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. The target must pass a DC 12 Constitution save or become poisoned for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns while poisoned this way, it must repeat the save. On a failure it takes 3 (1d6) poison damage. On a success the poison ends.

name: Hybrid Shocker
description: An electrically charged Simic guardian that pulls enemies into reach with its tentacles.

sections.Traits:
Electrified Body. A creature takes 5 (1d10) lightning damage if it touches the hybrid or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft.
Illumination. The hybrid gives off bright light within 10 ft. and dim light for another 10 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Shocking Touch attack and one Tentacles attack.
Shocking Touch. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d8) lightning damage.
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. A hit grapples the creature (escape DC 11) and pulls it up to 15 ft. straight toward the hybrid. The creature takes 5 (1d10) lightning damage at the start of each of its turns while this grapple lasts. Until the grapple ends, the hybrid cannot use Tentacles on another creature.

name: Hybrid Spy
description: A Simic scout who can blend into a wall and cross a ceiling.

sections.Traits:
Chameleon Skin. The hybrid has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide.
