Spider Climb. The hybrid can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Shortsword attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Indentured Spirit
description: An Orzhov debtor bound to serve after death, with chains draped across its ghostly robes.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid, fire, lightning, and thunder. Also bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, and restrained.
sections.Languages: The languages it knew while alive.
sections.Traits: Incorporeal Movement. Treat other creatures and objects as difficult terrain when moving through them. The spirit takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
sections.Actions: Withering Touch. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.
sections.Debts Paid: If a Deathpact Angel has granted the spirit this clause, the spirit can destroy itself when it sees that angel drop to 0 HP. This clears the debt and restores the angel to life with 1 HP. This optional pact appears on p. 191.

name: Isperia
description: The Azorius Senate’s sphinx guildmaster serves as its supreme judge. In a fight, she favors subduing offenders for trial.

sections.Damage immunities: Psychic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Inscrutable. Isperia is immune to effects that sense her emotions or read her thoughts. Divination spells affect her only with her permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks to discern her intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Isperia fails a saving throw, she can succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Isperia has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Innate Spellcasting: Wisdom is the spellcasting ability (save DC 23). Isperia can cast Imprisonment twice per day without material components.
sections.Spellcasting:
Isperia casts as a 15th-level Azorius cleric. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability (save DC 23, +14 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Guidance, Light, Resistance, Sacred Flame, Thaumaturgy.
Level 1 (4 slots). Command, Detect Evil and Good, Ensnaring Strike, Sanctuary, Shield of Faith.
Level 2 (3 slots). Arcane Lock, Augury, Calm Emotions, Hold Person, Silence, Zone of Truth.
Level 3 (3 slots). Bestow Curse, Clairvoyance, Counterspell, Dispel Magic, Tongues.
Level 4 (3 slots). Divination, Locate Creature.
Level 5 (2 slots). Dispel Evil and Good, Scrying.
Level 6 (1 slot). Word of Recall.
Level 7 (1 slot). Divine Word.
Level 8 (1 slot). Antimagic Field.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks. Isperia can replace one with a spell that takes 1 action to cast.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (3d10 + 5) slashing damage. A creature hit must make a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage after each attack it makes against Isperia before the start of Isperia’s next turn.
Supreme Legal Authority. Choose up to three creatures Isperia can see within 90 ft. Each makes a DC 23 Intelligence saving throw. For each failure, choose one action the target cannot take for 1 minute: Attack, Cast a Spell, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, Hide, Ready, Search, or Use an Object. The target can repeat the DC 23 Intelligence save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that succeeds on the save is immune to Isperia’s Supreme Legal Authority for 24 hours.
sections.Legendary actions:
The creature has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. Use one legendary action option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Claw Attack (1 action). Make one Claw attack.
Cast a Spell (2 actions). Cast a prepared spell of 3rd level or lower, spending a spell slot.
Supreme Legal Authority (3 actions). Use Supreme Legal Authority.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 227. Isperia’s role and tactics appear on p. 226.

name: Jarad Vod Savo
description: The Devkarin lich leads the Golgari Swarm, whose kraul legions and undercity creatures protect his seat in the guild.

sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Jarad fails a saving throw, he can succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Jarad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. Jarad regains 25 HP at the start of his turn. Taking fire or radiant damage suppresses this recovery at the start of his next turn. He dies only if he starts his turn at 0 HP and fails to regenerate.
Turn Resistance. Jarad has advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.
Undead Fortitude. If damage drops Jarad to 0 HP, he makes a Constitution saving throw with DC 5 + the damage taken. On a success, he drops to 1 HP. This trait does not apply to radiant damage or damage from a critical hit.
Undead Nature. Jarad needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Spellcasting:
Jarad casts as a 14th-level Golgari wizard. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Acid Splash, Chill Touch, Mage Hand, Poison Spray, Prestidigitation.
Level 1 (4 slots). Entangle, Ray of Sickness, Sleep.
Level 2 (3 slots). Melf's Acid Arrow, Ray of Enfeeblement, Spider Climb, Web.
Level 3 (3 slots). Animate Dead, Plant Growth, Vampiric Touch.
Level 4 (3 slots). Blight, Giant Insect, Grasping Vine.
Level 5 (2 slots). Cloudkill, Insect Plague.
Level 6 (1 slot). Circle of Death, Create Undead.
Level 7 (1 slot). Finger of Death, Forcecage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Noxious Touch attack and one Staff of Svogthir attack. Jarad can replace one attack with a spell that takes 1 action to cast.
Noxious Touch. Melee spell attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 28 (8d6) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Staff of Svogthir. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, 13 (3d8) poison damage, and 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Spore Infusion. Choose one creature Jarad can see within 10 ft. His spores deal 11 (2d10) poison damage to it.
sections.Legendary actions:
The creature has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. Use one legendary action option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Cantrip (1 action). Cast a cantrip.
Noxious Touch (2 actions). Use Noxious Touch.
Disrupt Life (3 actions). Every creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Golgari lairs: Jarad Vod Savo or a Kraul Death Priest can qualify a group of at least six Golgari defending their territory for the shared lair actions. See Golgari Shaman for the encounter rules and regional effects on p. 236.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 235. Undead Nature appears on p. 234 and Golgari Lairs on p. 236.

name: Kraul Death Priest
description: A winged priest who leads the buzzing rites of the Golgari kraul and turns nearby deaths into protection for its allies.

sections.Traits:
Feed on Death. When a creature within 30 ft. drops to 0 HP, the priest or another creature it chooses within 30 ft. gains 5 (1d10) temporary HP. This happens only if the priest is not incapacitated.
Hive Mind. While within 30 ft. of another kraul, the kraul is immune to being charmed and frightened.
Pack Tactics. The kraul has advantage on attacks against a creature if an ally that is not incapacitated is within 5 ft. of the target.
Spider Climb. The kraul can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Wisdom is the spellcasting ability (save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). These spells require no material components.
At will. Chill Touch, Poison Spray.
3/day each. Ray of Enfeeblement, Ray of Sickness.
1/day each. Animate Dead, Blight, Vampiric Touch.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Quarterstaff attack and cast one of the priest’s spells that takes 1 action to cast.
Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) when used with two hands.
sections.Golgari lairs: Jarad Vod Savo or a Kraul Death Priest can qualify a group of at least six Golgari defending their territory for the shared lair actions. See Golgari Shaman for the encounter rules and regional effects on p. 236.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 214. Golgari Lairs appears on p. 236.

name: Kraul Warrior
description: A six-legged Golgari soldier that fights best with other kraul and can advance across walls and ceilings.

sections.Languages: Kraul. Understands Common but cannot speak it.
sections.Traits:
Hive Mind. While within 30 ft. of another kraul, the kraul is immune to being charmed and frightened.
Pack Tactics. The kraul has advantage on attacks against a creature if an ally that is not incapacitated is within 5 ft. of the target.
Spider Climb. The kraul can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
sections.Actions: Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, one target. Reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) with a two-handed melee attack.
sections.Winged variant: The Winged Kraul Warrior adds gossamer wings and a flying speed of 40 ft. It uses the same statistics and can serve as a scout or shock troop.
sections.Source notes: The printed Kraul Warrior has passive Perception 11, which this profile uses. The indexed data gives 10.

name: Lawmage
description: An Azorius spellcaster trained to restrain suspects and protect bystanders during arrests.

sections.Spellcasting:
The lawmage casts as an 8th-level Azorius wizard. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Fire Bolt, Friends, Light, Message.
Level 1 (4 slots). Alarm, Expeditious Retreat, Shield.
Level 2 (3 slots). Arcane Lock, Detect Thoughts, Hold Person.
Level 3 (3 slots). Clairvoyance, Dispel Magic, Slow.
Level 4 (2 slots). Locate Creature, Stoneskin.
sections.Actions: Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) when used with two hands.

name: Lazav
description: The unseen guildmaster of House Dimir gathers secrets through his agents and his own disguises. Nobody in his network has seen his true form.

sections.Traits:
Elusive. Attacks against Lazav cannot have advantage unless he is incapacitated.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Lazav fails a saving throw, he can succeed instead.
Psychic Defenses. While Lazav is not incapacitated, magic cannot read his thoughts, detect lies he tells, reveal his alignment, or identify his creature type. Telepathic communication with him requires his permission.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (save DC 20). These spells require no material components.
At will. Detect Thoughts, Encode Thoughts, Freedom of Movement, Vicious Mockery (4d4 psychic damage).
3/day each. Blur, Confusion, Mirror Image.
1/day each. Modify Memory, Rary's Telepathic Bond.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Shortsword attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d6 + 7) piercing damage and 10 (3d6) psychic damage. The target has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before Lazav’s next turn.
sections.Bonus actions: Shapechanger Savant. Lazav polymorphs into a Small or Medium humanoid he has seen. His size changes to match that form. He keeps his other statistics and his equipment stays unchanged.
sections.Legendary actions:
The creature has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. Use one legendary action option at the end of another creature’s turn.
Attack (1 action). Make one weapon attack.
Cast a Spell (2 actions). Cast one of Lazav’s innate spells.
Shifting Nightmare (3 actions). Each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes 18 (4d8) damage. Lazav chooses acid, cold, fire, lightning, or necrotic damage.

name: Winged Kraul Warrior
description: Gossamer wings elevate these kraul warriors to scouting and shock troop roles.

sections.Languages: Kraul. Understands Common but cannot speak it.
sections.Traits:
Hive Mind. While within 30 ft. of another kraul, the kraul is immune to being charmed and frightened.
Pack Tactics. The kraul has advantage on attacks against a creature if an ally that is not incapacitated is within 5 ft. of the target.
Spider Climb. The kraul can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
sections.Actions: Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, one target. Reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) with a two-handed melee attack.
sections.Winged variant: Apply the printed Winged Kraul Warriors sidebar to Kraul Warrior. Its sole change to the base statistics is a flying speed of 40 ft.
sections.Source notes: The printed Kraul Warrior has passive Perception 11, which this profile uses. The indexed data gives 10.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 213, Kraul Warrior stat block and Winged Kraul Warriors sidebar.

name: Master of Cruelties
description: A Rakdos ringleader whose performances compel spectators to turn on one another.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, and lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Aura of Blood Lust. Any other creature that starts its turn within 30 ft. must pass a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure it immediately takes the Attack action and makes one melee attack against a random creature within reach. If no creature is in reach, it makes one ranged attack against a random creature within range, throwing its weapon if necessary.
Feed on the Crowd. When a creature dies within 60 ft., the master gains 15 temporary HP and has advantage on attacks, checks, and saves through the end of its next turn.
Magic Resistance. The master has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma is the spellcasting ability (DC 17). These spells require no material components.
At will. Charm Person as a 3rd-level spell, Crown of Madness.
1/day. Dominate Person.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee Spear attacks.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage when wielded in two hands for a melee attack. Either hit also deals 13 (3d8) psychic damage.
Captivating Presence (Recharge 6). Each creature within 120 ft. must pass a DC 17 Wisdom save or be charmed by the master for 1 hour. Its speed is 0 while charmed this way. Taking damage lets a charmed creature repeat the save, ending the effect on itself if it succeeds. A creature that succeeds on the save is immune to every Master of Cruelties’ Captivating Presence for 24 hours.

name: Mind Drinker Vampire
description: A Dimir vampire that probes memories and emotions. Mind drinkers often lead small cells and quietly watch their own agents for signs of betrayal.

sections.Languages: The languages the vampire knew in life.
sections.Traits: Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the vampire has disadvantage on attacks and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. In dim light or darkness, the vampire can take the Hide action.
sections.Innate Spellcasting (Psionics):
Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (DC 14). These spells require no components.
At will. Message.
3/day each. Charm Person, Hold Person, Mirror Image, Sleep.
1/day each. Gaseous Form, Major Image.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, at most one of which can be Bite.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. Choose one willing creature or a creature the vampire has grappled, or that is incapacitated or restrained. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing and 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. Reduce the target’s maximum HP by the necrotic damage taken and heal the vampire by that amount. The reduction lasts until the target completes a long rest. The target dies if its maximum HP reaches 0.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature and the vampire has a free hand, it can also grapple the target (escape DC 13).
Mind Siphon (Recharge 5–6). Choose one visible creature within 30 ft. It makes a DC 14 Intelligence save with disadvantage if the vampire has already drunk its blood. On a failure, it takes 28 (8d6) psychic damage and the vampire reads its surface emotions and thoughts. On a success, halve the damage and reveal only its general emotional state.

name: Mind Mage
description: A Dimir operative who reads and alters memories. Many mind mages run their own cells.

sections.Traits: Special Equipment. The mage wears Spies’ Murmur, a magic item described in chapter 5.
sections.Innate Spellcasting (Psionics):
Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (DC 16). These spells require no components.
At will. Encode Thoughts, Friends.
3/day each. Charm Person, Detect Thoughts, Mage Armor, Sleep, Suggestion.
1/day each. Dominate Person, Mass Suggestion, Modify Memory.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Source notes: The printed score is Strength 10, which normally gives a +0 modifier. The stat block prints +1 beside the score.

name: Nightveil Specter
description: A hooded Dimir guardian that patrols on a Gloamwing and strips secrets from an intruder’s memory.

sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Mount. While mounted and not incapacitated, the specter is immune to surprise, and both rider and mount have advantage on Dexterity saves.
Undead Nature. The specter and its Gloamwing need no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Bonus actions: Mount. While unmounted and on the same plane as its Gloamwing, the specter can magically teleport into the saddle with its worn and carried equipment.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Scythe attacks.
Scythe. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage and 13 (3d8) psychic damage.
Mind Twist (Recharge 5–6). The specter magically emits psychic energy in a 60-ft. cone. Each creature in the cone must pass a DC 15 Wisdom save or take 22 (5d8) psychic damage and be stunned for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, a stunned target can repeat the save to end the effect on itself.
Reap Memory (3/day). Touch one incapacitated creature and choose one hour from the past 24 hours. The target must pass a DC 15 Intelligence save or lose every memory from the chosen hour. The memory returns only if the specter dies within the next 24 hours.
sections.Gloamwing mount: The Gloamwing is destroyed if its specter rider drops to 0 HP. If the Gloamwing is killed first, the surviving specter becomes fixated on destroying those responsible. It can create a replacement over one month, during which the specter is incapacitated.

name: Niv-Mizzet
description: The ancient dragon who founded the Izzet League. From a private laboratory at the top of its guildhall, he coordinates research and gathers secrets in place of a conventional hoard.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Niv-Mizzet can choose to succeed on a saving throw he failed.
Locus of the Firemind. Niv-Mizzet can concentrate on two different spells at once. He has advantage on saving throws to maintain concentration.
Magic Resistance. Niv-Mizzet has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Master Chemister. When Niv-Mizzet casts a damaging spell, he can change its damage type to cold, fire, force, lightning, or thunder.
sections.Spellcasting:
Niv-Mizzet is a 20th-level Izzet wizard. Intelligence is his spellcasting ability (DC 26, +18 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Fire Bolt, Light, Prestidigitation, Ray of Frost, Shocking Grasp.
1st level (4 slots). Detect Magic, Magic Missile, Shield, Thunderwave, Unseen Servant.
2nd level (3 slots). Blur, Enlarge/Reduce, Flaming Sphere, Scorching Ray.
3rd level (3 slots). Counterspell, Fireball, Hold Person, Lightning Bolt, Slow.
4th level (3 slots). Confusion, Dimension Door, Fabricate.
5th level (2 slots). Conjure Elemental, Polymorph, Wall of Fire, Wall of Force.
6th level (1 slot). Chain Lightning, Disintegrate, True Seeing.
7th level (1 slot). Project Image, Reverse Gravity, Teleport.
8th level (1 slot). Control Weather, Maze, Power Word Stun.
9th level (1 slot). Prismatic Wall.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (2d8 + 9) piercing damage and 14 (4d6) fire damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d4 + 9) slashing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage.
Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in the 90-ft. cone makes a DC 25 Dexterity save, taking 91 (26d6) fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Legendary actions:
Niv-Mizzet has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of his turn. He can use one option at a time, at the end of another creature’s turn.
Cantrip (1 action). Cast a cantrip from his spell list.
Tail Attack (1 action). Make a Tail attack.
Wing Attack (2 actions). Each creature within 15 ft. must pass a DC 25 Dexterity save or take 14 (2d4 + 9) bludgeoning damage and fall prone. Niv-Mizzet can then fly up to half his flying speed.
Dracogenius (3 actions). Regain one expended spell slot of 3rd level or lower.
sections.Roleplaying: Niv-Mizzet values invention, has spent more than ten thousand years studying the world, and quickly loses patience with people he thinks lack imagination.
sections.Source notes: The printed spell list places Hold Person at 3rd level, using a 3rd-level slot. The indexed reference places it at 2nd level.

name: Nivix Cyclops
description: The Izzet League outfits these cyclopes with piston gauntlets and telescopic helmets for work in its laboratories.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The cyclops has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Reactions: Spell Vitalization. Immediately after a creature within 120 ft. casts a spell of 1st level or higher, the cyclops can move up to twice its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. It can then make one Slam attack against a target of its choice.

name: Obzedat Ghost
description: Five dead oligarchs still control the Orzhov Syndicate. Karlov breaks ties when the council disagrees.

sections.Armor: Natural armor. Each other Obzedat ghost within 30 ft. increases this ghost’s AC by 1.
sections.Damage resistances: Acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder. The ghost also resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, and restrained.
sections.Traits:
Council of Five. Use the trait for the ghost’s council member.
Ethereal Sight. The ghost can see 60 ft. into the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane and vice versa.
Incorporeal Movement. Creatures and objects count as difficult terrain for the ghost. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
Legendary Resistance (1/day). The ghost can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Undead Nature. The ghost needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Council of Five:
Enezesku: Enfeebling Ray. Add Ray of Enfeeblement to his at-will innate spells.
Fautomni: Undead Fortitude. If damage drops him to 0 HP, make a Constitution save with a DC of 5 plus the damage taken. On a success he drops to 1 HP. Radiant damage and critical hits bypass this trait.
Karlov: Unnatural Vigor. Whenever he regains HP, he has advantage on attack rolls during his next turn.
Vuliev: Teleportation. Add Misty Step to his at-will innate spells.
Xil Xaxosz: Lingering Spite. When he drops to 0 HP, each creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 16 Constitution save against the burst. Failure deals 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. Success halves the damage.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The ghost casts with Wisdom (save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks) and needs no components.
At will. Chill Touch, using the 5th-level cantrip damage of 2d8. The ghost regains HP equal to half the damage the target takes.
1/day each. Sanctuary and Spirit Guardians (cast at 4th level).
sections.Actions:
Life Drain. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 18 (4d8) necrotic damage. The ghost regains HP equal to half the damage the target takes. The target must pass a DC 13 Constitution save or reduce its HP maximum by the full damage it took. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its HP maximum reaches 0.
Convene the Ghost Council. Summon the other four council members. At the start of the summoning ghost’s next turn, they appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 ft. of it and each rolls initiative.
sections.Legendary actions:
When all five Obzedat ghosts are within 30 ft. of one another, the council shares a pool of three legendary actions. It can use one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn. The pool refreshes at the start of the turn of the ghost with the highest initiative.
Forced Obedience (1 action). One target that all five ghosts can see makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure, the target bows until the end of its next turn. While bowing it cannot take actions or reactions and its speed is 0 and cannot increase.
Indentured Spirits (3 actions). Conjure 1d6 Indentured Spirits within 60 ft. of one of the ghosts.

name: Orzhov Giant
description: An Orzhov enforcer who singles out a foe and keeps pressing it.

sections.Bonus actions: Focus. Choose one creature the giant can see within 30 ft. The focus lasts 1 minute or until either creature drops to 0 HP. The giant adds 1d4 to attack rolls against its focus and subtracts 1d4 from attack rolls against other targets while its focus lasts.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greataxe attacks.
Greataxe. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 25 (3d12 + 6) slashing damage. On a critical hit, roll the damage dice three times instead of twice.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

name: Precognitive Mage
description: An Azorius mage who uses glimpses of possible futures to change the outcome of a fight.

sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The mage casts with Intelligence (save DC 14) and needs no material components.
3/day total, shared. Detect Thoughts and Mage Armor. Mage Armor raises the mage’s AC to 14.
1/day each. Clairvoyance and Locate Object.
sections.Actions:
Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) if wielded with two hands.
Glimpse the Temporal Flood (Recharge 5–6). Pick one creature the mage can see within 120 ft. The target takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage and must pass a DC 14 Intelligence save or be stunned until the end of its next turn.
sections.Reactions: Precognitive Insight (3/day). When the mage or a creature it can see makes an attack roll, a saving throw, or an ability check, the mage can grant advantage or impose disadvantage on that roll.

name: Rakdos
description: The winged demon who leads the Cult of Rakdos carries a flaming scythe and prizes a performance he has never seen before.

sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Rakdos also resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Captivating Presence. Any creature starting its turn within 30 ft. of Rakdos makes a DC 25 Wisdom save. On a failure, it becomes charmed by Rakdos for 1 minute or until it gets farther than 30 ft. from him. A successful save grants immunity to Captivating Presence for 24 hours.
Cruel Entertainment. When a creature Rakdos can see within 60 ft. drops to 0 HP, he gains 25 temporary HP.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Rakdos can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. Rakdos has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Rakdos’s weapon attacks are magical.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Rakdos casts with Charisma (save DC 25) and needs no material components.
At will. Hellish Rebuke (cast at 5th level).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks with Curtain-Call Scythe or Claw.
Curtain-Call Scythe. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 24 (3d10 + 8) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) fire damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage.
sections.Legendary actions:
Rakdos has three legendary actions and regains them at the start of his turn. He can use one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn.
Sadistic Revelry (1 action). Each ally of Rakdos or creature charmed by him within 60 ft. must use its reaction. It moves up to half its speed toward the nearest creature it can see if it is more than 5 ft. away, then makes one melee attack against that creature if able.
Scythe (2 actions). Use Curtain-Call Scythe.
Touch of Pain (3 actions). Make one Claw attack against a creature within 10 ft. The target makes a DC 25 Constitution save. On a failure it is poisoned for 1 minute and cannot maintain concentration while poisoned this way. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Lair context: Rakdos sometimes withdraws for months or years to his lair below the guildhall. The book describes the retreat on p. 246.

name: Rakdos Lampooner
description: A Rakdos satirist who uses pranks and caricatures to ridicule powerful figures.

sections.Spellcasting:
The lampooner casts as a 4th-level Rakdos spellcaster using Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks).
At will (cantrips). Dancing Lights, Minor Illusion, Vicious Mockery.
1st level (4 slots). Bane, Dissonant Whispers, Silent Image, Tasha’s Hideous Laughter, Thunderwave.
2nd level (3 slots). Crown of Madness, Enthrall, Suggestion.
sections.Actions: Club. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Rakdos Performer, Blade Juggler
description: A Rakdos stage performer who turns juggling knives into a flurry of attacks.

sections.Traits: Performer Type. This profile gives the shared Rakdos Performer statistics with the blade juggler action options.
sections.Bonus actions: Nimble. Take the Disengage action.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Dagger attacks.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 249, Rakdos Performer and Blade Juggler actions.

name: Rakdos Performer, Fire Eater
description: A Rakdos stage performer with a bladed chain and a fiery breath trick.

sections.Traits: Performer Type. This profile gives the shared Rakdos Performer statistics with the fire eater action options.
sections.Bonus actions: Nimble. Take the Disengage action.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bladed Chain attacks.
Bladed Chain. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Spew Flame (Recharge 4–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking 9 (2d8) fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 249, Rakdos Performer and Fire Eater actions.

name: Rakdos Performer, High-Wire Acrobat
description: A Rakdos stage performer who uses a barbed pole and springs out of reach.

sections.Traits: Performer Type. This profile gives the shared Rakdos Performer statistics with the high-wire acrobat action options.
sections.Bonus actions: Nimble. Take the Disengage action.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Barbed Pole attacks.
Barbed Pole. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. On the hit, the acrobat can jump up to 20 ft. without provoking opportunity attacks.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 249, Rakdos Performer and High-Wire Acrobat actions.

name: Reckoner
description: A Boros shock trooper who combines sword strikes with lightning magic. Many reckoners are minotaurs.

sections.Traits: First Strike. The reckoner has advantage on initiative rolls.
sections.Spellcasting:
The reckoner casts as a 5th-level Boros spellcaster using Intelligence (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks).
At will (cantrips). Blade Ward, Light, Message, Shocking Grasp.
1st level (4 slots). Guiding Bolt, Shield, Thunderwave, Witch Bolt.
2nd level (3 slots). Blur, Levitate.
3rd level (2 slots). Lightning Bolt.
sections.Actions: Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) if used with two hands.
sections.Reactions: Lightning Backlash (Recharge 5–6). When a creature hits the reckoner with an attack, the attacker takes lightning damage equal to half the damage dealt by the attack.

name: Rubblebelt Stalker
description: A Gruul scout who ambushes enemies in ruins and uses the rubble to escape.

sections.Traits:
Ambusher. In the first round of combat, the stalker has advantage on attack rolls against creatures that have yet to take a turn.
Ruin Dweller. The stalker has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in ruins. Rubble does not slow it.
Siege Monster. The stalker deals double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Bonus actions: Nimble Escape. Take the Disengage or Hide action.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Shortsword attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Scorchbringer Guard
description: An Izzet guard armed with a flame projector fed by a volatile backpack tank.

sections.Traits: Explosive Tank. The guard’s tank explodes when it dies or rolls a 1 on the Scorchbringer recharge check. Each creature in the 10-ft.-radius sphere makes a DC 12 Dexterity save, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. The blast ignites flammable objects no one wears or carries and destroys the scorchbringer.
sections.Actions:
Light Hammer. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Scorchbringer (Recharge 4–6). The device emits a line of fire 30 ft. long and 5 ft. wide. Each creature in the line makes a DC 12 Dexterity save, taking 7 (2d6) fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Servitor Thrull
description: A small construct that runs errands and carries possessions for the Orzhov. It will step into a blow meant for its master.

sections.Traits: Construct Nature. The thrull needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions: Claws. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage.
sections.Reactions: Self-Sacrifice. After an attack hits a creature within 5 ft. of the thrull, it swaps places with that creature and takes the hit instead.

name: Shadow Horror
description: A nightmare that moves through solid objects and slips between shadows. The Rakdos sometimes bring one onstage.

sections.Traits:
Incorporeal Movement. The horror treats creatures and objects as difficult terrain when moving through them. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the horror has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
sections.Bonus actions:
Shadow Stealth. The horror can Hide while in dim light or darkness.
Shadow Stride. Step into a shadow within 5 ft. and magically appear in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of a second shadow up to 60 ft. away. Each shadow must come from a Small or larger creature or object.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (4d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (3d6 + 3) slashing damage, and the target must make a DC 16 Wisdom save or become frightened of the horror until the end of the target’s next turn.
Lashing Shadows (Recharge 5–6). Each creature within 60 ft. except other horrors must make a DC 16 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 27 (6d8) necrotic damage.
sections.Optional primary features:
Choose or roll one primary and one secondary feature using the d4 tables on p. 204. Add them to the base stat block.
1. Avoidance. If an effect allows a save for half damage, a success instead deals no damage and a failure deals half.
2. Damage Resistances. The horror gains resistance to necrotic and psychic damage.
3. Innate Spellcasting. With Charisma and spell save DC 16, it can cast Darkness 3/day and Fear 1/day without material components.
4. Psychic Rebuke. When a melee attack damages the horror, it can use its reaction to deal 7 (2d6) psychic damage to each creature within 5 ft.
sections.Optional secondary features:
1. Grasping Tendrils. The horror has four tendrils, each with AC 12 and 10 HP. Destroying a tendril does not harm the horror. As a bonus action, it can target a visible creature within 10 ft. The target must make a DC 13 Dexterity save or be grappled (escape DC 13). A tendril can hold only one target at a time.
2. Indomitable Mind. The horror becomes immune to being charmed.
3. Keen Senses. It gains advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, sound, or smell.
4. Mind Sight. Magical darkness does not impede its darkvision.
sections.Optional madness: If you use the optional madness rule on p. 203, record each time a character fails the save against Claw. See Flying Horror for the shared end-of-encounter save and severity table.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 205. Optional horror rules on pp. 203–204.

name: Simic Merfolk
description: A guild member from Ravnica’s deep oceans. Its legs let it move as comfortably through the city as it swims through a Simic zonot.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The merfolk can breathe air and water.
sections.Actions: Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 3 (1d6) piercing damage, or 4 (1d8) piercing damage if the merfolk uses two hands for a melee attack.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 187. The setting variant uses the 2014 Monster Manual Merfolk with walking speed 30 ft. and Common and Merfolk as its languages.

name: Sire of Insanity
description: A bloated, reptilian demon that hides beneath a Rakdos venue and feeds on the torment above.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Aura of Mind Erosion. A creature that starts its turn within 30 ft. makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. Success grants immunity to this aura for 24 hours. Failure gives the creature disadvantage on Wisdom and Charisma checks and saves for 1 minute. The sire can suppress its aura at the start of its turn until the start of its next turn.
Magic Resistance. The sire has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
The sire uses Charisma (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks) and needs no material components.
At will. Clairvoyance, Crown of Madness, Major Image, Suggestion.
1/day each. Confusion, Mass Suggestion.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 25 (3d12 + 6) piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) psychic damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d8 + 6) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) psychic damage.

name: Skittering Horror
description: A many-legged nightmare that climbs walls and ceilings. The Golgari put these horrors to work guarding their territory.

sections.Traits:
Spider Climb. The horror can climb difficult surfaces, even upside down on ceilings, without an ability check.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the horror has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. The horror can use Maddening Presence and makes one Bite and two Claws attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 28 (4d10 + 6) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 24 (4d8 + 6) slashing damage.
Maddening Presence. Choose a visible creature within 30 ft. If it can see or hear the horror, it makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure it is paralyzed until the end of its next turn. On a success it is immune to this horror’s Maddening Presence for 24 hours.
sections.Optional primary features:
Choose or roll one primary and one secondary feature using the d4 tables on p. 204. Add them to the base stat block.
1. Avoidance. If an effect allows a save for half damage, a success instead deals no damage and a failure deals half.
2. Damage Resistances. The horror gains resistance to necrotic and psychic damage.
3. Innate Spellcasting. With Charisma and spell save DC 17, it can cast Darkness 3/day and Fear and Phantasmal Killer 1/day each without material components.
4. Psychic Rebuke. When a melee attack damages the horror, it can use its reaction to deal 10 (3d6) psychic damage to each creature within 5 ft.
sections.Optional secondary features:
1. Grasping Tendrils. The horror has four tendrils, each with AC 12 and 10 HP. Destroying a tendril does not harm the horror. As a bonus action, it can target a visible creature within 10 ft. The target must make a DC 19 Dexterity save or be grappled (escape DC 19). A tendril can hold only one target at a time.
2. Indomitable Mind. The horror becomes immune to being charmed.
3. Keen Senses. It gains advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, sound, or smell.
4. Mind Sight. Magical darkness does not impede its darkvision.
sections.Optional madness: If you use the optional madness rule on p. 203, record each time a character fails the save against Maddening Presence. See Flying Horror for the shared end-of-encounter save and severity table.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 205. Optional horror rules on pp. 203–204.

name: Skyjek Roc
description: An armored Boros mount large enough to carry an aerial scout or cavalry rider.

sections.Traits: Keen Sight. The roc has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Beak and one Talons attack.
Beak. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.
Talons. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing damage.

name: Winged Thrull
description: A small flying construct used as an Orzhov messenger and spy. It often imitates the mannerisms of its master.

sections.Traits: Construct Nature. The thrull needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Reactions: Self-Sacrifice. After an attack hits a creature within 5 ft. of the thrull, it swaps places with that creature and takes the hit instead.

name: Skyswimmer
description: An airborne leviathan that hunts drakes, rocs, griffins, and other creatures above Ravnica.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The skyswimmer breathes both air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Slam attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Deal 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage on a hit. A Large or smaller creature hit must pass a DC 19 Dexterity save or be swallowed. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the skyswimmer, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the skyswimmer's turns. If a swallowed creature deals at least 30 damage to the skyswimmer in one turn, the skyswimmer must pass a DC 18 Constitution save at the end of that turn. On a failure, it regurgitates that creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 ft. If the skyswimmer dies, it no longer restrains the swallowed creature. That creature can spend 15 ft. of movement to escape the corpse and emerges prone.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Deal 19 (2d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage on a hit.

name: Soldier
description: Ravnica's guild soldiers fight in formation. Their gear varies with the guild and assignment.

sections.Traits: Formation Tactics. While within 5 ft. of at least one ally, the soldier makes saving throws against being charmed, frightened, grappled, or restrained with advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage on a hit, or 7 (1d10 + 2) if the sword is wielded with two hands.

name: Sphinx of Judgment
description: An Azorius gynosphinx who uses law magic to compel truth and imprison offenders.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Inscrutable. The sphinx is immune to effects that sense its emotions or read its thoughts and to divination spells it chooses to refuse. Wisdom (Insight) checks to gauge its intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.
Magic Weapons. The sphinx's weapon attacks are magical.
sections.Spellcasting:
The sphinx is a 9th-level Azorius wizard spellcaster. Intelligence sets its save DC to 16 and its spell attack bonus to +8. It casts these prepared spells without material components.
Cantrips (at will). Friends, Mage Hand, Message.
1st level (4 slots). Command, Ensnaring Strike, Shield.
2nd level (3 slots). Calm Emotions, Hold Person, Suggestion.
3rd level (3 slots). Clairvoyance, Counterspell, Dispel Magic.
4th level (3 slots). Banishment, Divination.
5th level (1 slot). Dominate Person.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage on a hit.
sections.Legendary actions:
The sphinx has 3 legendary actions and recovers spent actions at the start of its turn. It can take one option at a time, at the end of another creature's turn. It cannot use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before it can use them.
Claw Attack (1 action). Make one Claw attack.
Teleport (2 actions). The sphinx and its worn or carried equipment magically move up to 120 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space.
Cast a Spell (3 actions). Cast a prepared spell, spending a spell slot as normal.
sections.Lair actions:
When the sphinx is in its lair, it can choose one of these magical effects on initiative count 20, losing initiative ties. It must finish a short or long rest before it can repeat an effect. It cannot use a lair action while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before it can use one.
Reroll initiative. Every creature in the lair rerolls initiative. The sphinx can keep its existing result.
Change age. Every creature in the lair makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure it becomes 1d20 years older or younger, as the sphinx chooses. The creature cannot become younger than 1 year. Greater Restoration can restore its age.
Shift the lair in time. Move everything in the lair up to 10 years forward or backward. Only the sphinx notices immediately. Wish can return its caster and up to seven creatures the caster chooses to their normal time.
Shift planes. The sphinx transports itself and up to seven other creatures it can see in the lair to another plane. It cannot use lair actions while away. It can return to the lair as a bonus action on its turn and bring up to seven creatures with it.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 183, gives the Gynosphinx a replacement spell list. The base block and lair actions are in the 2014 Monster Manual, pp. 281–282.

name: Sunder Shaman
description: A Gruul giant who wears pieces of buildings as armor and turns its rage on Ravnica's growing city.

sections.Traits:
Reckless. At the start of its turn, the giant can choose to gain advantage on its melee weapon attack rolls for that turn. If it does, attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.
Siege Monster. The giant deals double damage to objects and structures.
Stone Camouflage. The giant makes Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain with advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks. If the giant has taken damage since its last turn, the first of those attacks to hit deals an extra 18 (4d8) damage.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Deal 24 (4d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage on a hit.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +10 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Deal 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage on a hit. A creature hit must pass a DC 18 Strength save or fall prone.

name: Winged Felidar
description: A celestial cat with broad feathered wings. Winged felidars usually bond with Azorius archons.

sections.Languages: Understands Celestial and Common but can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Bonding. The felidar can magically bond with a creature it can see immediately after observing it for at least 1 hour within 30 ft. The bond ends when the felidar bonds with another creature or its partner dies. They can communicate telepathically within 100 ft. The felidar can sense its partner's direction and distance while both are on the same plane. Either can take an action to experience the other's sight and hearing, losing its own sight and hearing until the start of its next turn.
Keen Hearing and Sight. The felidar makes Wisdom (Perception) checks based on hearing or sight with advantage.
Pounce. If the felidar moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hits it with Claws on the same turn, that creature must pass a DC 15 Strength save or fall prone. If the target is prone, the felidar can make one Claws attack against it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage on a hit.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage on a hit.
sections.Variant rules: Use the Felidar stat block and add a flying speed of 40 ft. The winged variant is printed in the Winged Felidars sidebar.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 199, Felidar stat block and Winged Felidars sidebar.

name: Thought Spy
description: House Dimir trains these infiltrators to use mental magic alongside mundane disguise and stealth.

sections.Bonus actions: Cunning Action. On its turn, the spy can Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.
sections.Innate Spellcasting (Psionics):
Intelligence (spell save DC 13), with no components.
At will. Charm Person, Disguise Self, Encode Thoughts.
1/day each. Blur, Detect Thoughts, Gaseous Form.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks or three ranged Dagger attacks.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Rapier. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Trostani
description: Three dryads share the body and life force of the Selesnya guildmaster. They embody order, life, and harmony and usually speak as one from their home in Vitu-Ghazi.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Trostani can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. Trostani has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Her weapon attacks are magical.
Speak with Beasts and Plants. She can communicate with beasts and plants as if they share a language.
Tree Stride. Once on her turn, spend 10 ft. of movement to magically enter a living tree within reach and emerge in an open space within 5 ft. of a second living tree. The trees must both be Large or larger and within 60 ft. of each other.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Wisdom (spell save DC 24), with no material components.
At will. Dispel Magic, Druidcraft.
3/day each. Bless, Conjure Animals, Giant Insect, Moonbeam, Plant Growth, Spike Growth, Suggestion.
1/day each. Conjure Fey, Mass Cure Wounds.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Constrict, use Touch of Order, and cast one spell with a casting time of 1 action.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. The creature is grappled (escape DC 19) and restrained until that grapple ends. Trostani can hold up to three targets at once.
Touch of Order. Melee spell attack, +16 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 23 (3d8 + 10) radiant damage. Trostani can suppress the magic of one visible magic item in the target’s possession until her next turn starts. Artifacts are exempt.
Wrath of Mat’Selesnya (Recharge 5–6). Choose a visible point within 60 ft. Each creature in the 30-ft. cube there makes a DC 24 Dexterity save. Failure deals 21 (6d6) bludgeoning plus 21 (6d6) slashing damage. Success halves both.
sections.Legendary actions:
The creature can spend up to three legendary actions, choosing one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.
Voice of Harmony (1 action). Make one melee attack with advantage.
Voice of Life (1 action). Grant 20 temporary HP to another visible creature within 120 ft.
Voice of Order (1 action). Cast Dispel Magic.
Chorus of the Conclave (2 actions). Cast Suggestion, spending a daily use.
Awaken Grove Guardians (3 actions). One or two visible trees within 120 ft. uproot and become Awakened Trees for 1 minute or until Trostani ends the effect as a bonus action. They understand Druidic and follow her spoken orders. They cannot speak. In the absence of orders they follow her and Dodge.
sections.Source notes: The print pairs Strength 19 with a +5 modifier. This profile keeps the printed score and Constrict numbers. The usual modifier for Strength 19 is +4.
sections.Roleplaying: Trostani wants every community to join the Conclave. She takes a member’s departure as a betrayal. Her three personalities disagree over how to meet Ravnica’s rising tensions. See p. 251.

name: Undercity Medusa
description: Ravnica’s gorgons have writhing cables for hair and clawed hands. Their gaze petrifies when they choose to use it.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The medusa has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Surprise Attack. In the first round, it attacks surprised creatures with advantage and deals an extra 10 (3d6) damage each time one of those attacks hits.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Intelligence (spell save DC 14), with no material components.
1/day each. Expeditious Retreat, Fog Cloud, Misty Step.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks. The medusa can also use Petrifying Gaze before or after the pair.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Petrifying Gaze. Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. that can see the medusa’s eyes. It makes a DC 14 Constitution save. Failure by 5 or more petrifies it immediately. Any other failure restrains it as it turns to stone. A restrained creature repeats the save at the end of its next turn. Failure petrifies it and success ends the effect. Greater Restoration or similar magic ends the petrification.
sections.Golgari lair rules: An Undercity Medusa can qualify a group of six or more Golgari for the shared lair actions on p. 236 while they defend their territory. See Golgari Shaman for the actions and regional effects.
sections.Named example: Ludmilla, the Tunnel Viper, survived the other Sisters of Stone Death. She keeps her petrified victims in the undercity and plots against Jarad Vod Savo.

name: Wurm
description: A limbless, wingless burrower that liquefies loose soil with vibrations. The Gruul sometimes lure it toward settled districts.

sections.Traits:
Earth Tremors. When a creature first comes within 30 ft. of the moving wurm on a turn, it makes a DC 20 Dexterity save. Failure deals 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage and knocks it prone. A ground-anchored object or structure that first comes within the same distance on a turn takes 10 (3d6) force damage.
Siege Monster. The wurm deals double damage to objects and structures.
Tunneler. The wurm burrows through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a 10-ft.-diameter tunnel.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 24 (5d6 + 7) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit must pass a DC 20 Dexterity save or be swallowed. It is blinded and restrained inside, has total cover from external attacks and effects, and takes 17 (5d6) acid damage at the start of each of the wurm’s turns. If a creature inside deals 30 or more damage to the wurm in one turn, the wurm makes a DC 21 Constitution save at that turn’s end. On a failure it regurgitates all swallowed creatures, which land prone within 10 ft. When the wurm dies, swallowed creatures are no longer restrained by it. They can spend 20 ft. of movement to exit prone.

name: Zegana
description: The Simic Combine’s Prime Speaker defends the guild’s traditions and keeps her post with the support of the Speakers’ Chamber.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. Zegana breathes air and water.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). She can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. She has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Spellcasting:
Zegana is a 15th-level Simic spellcaster with prepared wizard spells. Intelligence sets spell save DC 18 and +10 to hit with spell attacks.
Cantrips (at will). Acid Splash, Druidcraft, Ray of Frost, Shape Water.
1st level (4 slots). Color Spray, Expeditious Retreat, Fog Cloud, Shield.
2nd level (3 slots). Enlarge/Reduce, Gust of Wind.
3rd level (3 slots). Counterspell, Fly, Slow.
4th level (3 slots). Control Water, Ice Storm, Polymorph.
5th level (2 slots). Conjure Elemental, Creation.
6th level (1 slot). Move Earth, Wall of Ice.
7th level (1 slot). Prismatic Spray, Teleport.
8th level (1 slot). Control Weather, Dominate Monster.
sections.Actions:
Prime Speaker’s Trident. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage and the trident booms. Each creature in a 15-ft. cube from its prongs makes a DC 18 Constitution save. Failure deals 9 (2d8) thunder damage, or 13 (3d8) to a creature underwater, and pushes the creature 10 ft. away from Zegana. Success halves the thunder damage and prevents the push.
Deluge (Recharge 4–6). Send a wave to an area within 120 ft., up to 30 ft. long, 10 ft. wide, and 10 ft. high. Each creature there makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. Failure deals 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage and knocks it prone. Success halves the damage and prevents the knockdown. The water puts out unprotected flames it touches before vanishing.
sections.Legendary actions:
The creature can spend up to three legendary actions, choosing one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.
Adaptive Skin (1 action). Gain resistance to acid, fire, lightning, or thunder damage until her next turn starts.
Trident (1 action). Make one melee attack with the Prime Speaker’s Trident.
Enlarge (2 actions). Cast Enlarge/Reduce on herself using Enlarge without spending a spell slot.
Deluge (3 actions). Use Deluge if available.
sections.Roleplaying: Zegana treats nature’s patterns as a guide for improving life. She commits her resources to Ravnica and struggles to understand anyone who rejects progress. See p. 254.

name: Abhorrent Overlord
description: A treasure-hoarding Underworld demon that attracts crows, harpies, and other scavengers.

sections.Traits:
Insatiable Greed. The overlord detects gold within 1,000 ft. It knows the direction of the largest concentration and the direction in which any detected gold is moving. Any layer of clay or lead blocks detection along that path.
Magic Resistance. The creature has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Immortal Nature. The creature needs no food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma sets the spell save DC at 15. These spells require no material components.
1/day each. Confusion, Crown of Madness, Suggestion.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claws attacks.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, the overlord regains HP equal to half the necrotic damage dealt.
Storm of Crows (Recharge 6). Center a 20-ft.-radius sphere of spectral crows and harpies on a visible point within 120 ft. It is lightly obscured and difficult terrain. It lasts 1 minute or until the overlord loses concentration as if concentrating on a spell. A creature that first moves into the sphere on a turn or starts its turn there makes a DC 15 Constitution save. It takes 16 (3d10) slashing plus 16 (3d10) psychic damage on a failure, or half of each on a success.

name: Akroan Hoplite
description: An Akroan stratiot trained to halt an enemy advance with spear and shield.

sections.Traits: Hold the Line. While the hoplite holds a spear, other creatures provoke an opportunity attack from the hoplite when they move within 5 ft. If one of those attacks hits with the spear, it adds 4 (1d8) piercing damage and drops the target's speed to 0 for the rest of the turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three melee attacks or two ranged attacks.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) if wielded in two hands for a melee attack.
Shield Bash. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller target must pass a DC 13 Strength save or fall prone.

name: Alseid
description: A sunlit nymph who protects meadows and cultivated land.

sections.Traits:
Hide in Plain Sight. The alseid has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in grassland.
Magic Resistance. The creature has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Immortal Nature. The creature needs no food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma sets the spell save DC at 14. These spells require no material components.
3/day each. Cure Wounds, Charm Person, Sleep.
1/day each. Calm Emotions, Lesser Restoration, Plant Growth.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Radiant Touch attacks.
Radiant Touch. Melee spell attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) radiant damage.
sections.Printed source: Mythic Odysseys of Theros, pp. 234–235. The stat block appears on p. 235.

name: Anvilwrought Raptor
description: A metal hawk or owl that carries messages and can repeat voices it has heard.

sections.Languages: Understands one language of its creator but can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Keen Sight. The raptor has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
Recorded Mimicry. The raptor can imitate any sound it heard in the past 24 hours, including voices. A listener can spot the imitation with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Insight) check.
Constructed Nature. The raptor needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Variant familiar:
Some raptors are built to be familiars and gain the following trait.
Familiar. The raptor can form a magical telepathic bond with a willing master. The master can share the raptor's senses while they are within 1 mile of each other.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Beak attacks.
Beak. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Aphemia
description: A harpy whose songs terrify the living and command the dead.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (2/day). Aphemia can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. The creature has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Discordant Song. Aphemia sings magically. Each humanoid within 120 ft. makes a DC 14 Wisdom save or becomes frightened of Aphemia until her song ends. While she sings, frightened creatures take 7 (2d6) psychic damage at the start of their turns. Each frightened creature can repeat the save at the end of its turns to end the effect. A successful save or the end of the effect grants immunity to Aphemia's Discordant Song for 24 hours.
Grave Calling Song. Aphemia sings magically. Each undead within 300 ft. must pass a DC 14 Wisdom save or fall under Aphemia's control until the song ends.
sections.Bonus actions: Continue singing. Aphemia must spend a bonus action on subsequent turns to keep either song going. As part of the same bonus action for Grave Calling Song, she can give mental orders to the undead it controls. She may stop singing at any time. A song also ends if she is incapacitated or dies.

name: Arasta
description: Once one of Nylea's dryads, Arasta now nests in the hollow of Enorasi, a vast olive tree in the Nessian Wood.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Armor of Spiders (Mythic Trait, recharges after a short or long rest). When Arasta drops to 0 HP, she stays conscious and alive. She regains 200 HP, and her spiders cover her body and grant 100 temporary HP. While she retains temporary HP from this trait, her mythic actions are available.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Arasta can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. The creature has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Spider Climb. Arasta can climb difficult surfaces and ceilings upside down without making an ability check.
Web Walker. Webbing does not hinder Arasta's movement.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claws attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 20 (3d8 + 7) piercing damage. The target also makes a DC 21 Constitution save, taking 32 (5d12) poison damage on a failure or half on a success. If this damage reduces the creature to 0 HP, it stabilizes and is poisoned for 1 hour, even if it recovers HP. It is paralyzed while poisoned this way.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (3d6 + 7) slashing damage.
Web of Hair (Recharge 4–6). Fill a 30-ft. cube adjacent to Arasta with webbing for 1 minute. The cube is lightly obscured and difficult terrain. A creature that moves into the web or starts its turn there makes a DC 21 Dexterity save. On a failure, it is restrained while in the web. A creature can use its action to attempt a DC 21 Strength check to free itself or a creature within 5 ft. restrained by this web. Only magical fire can damage the web. A 5-ft. cube burns away if it takes at least 20 magical fire damage on one turn.
sections.Legendary actions:
Arasta has 3 legendary actions. Use one option at the end of another creature's turn. She recovers spent actions at the start of her turn.
Claws (1 action). Make one Claws attack.
Swarm (2 actions). Summon two swarms of spiders in unoccupied spaces within 5 ft. of Arasta.
Toxic Web (3 actions). Each creature restrained by her Web of Hair takes 18 (4d8) poison damage.
sections.Mythic actions:
These options spend legendary actions and are available only while Arasta retains temporary HP from Armor of Spiders.
Swipe (1 action). Make two Claws attacks.
Web of Hair (2 actions). Recharge and use Web of Hair.
Nyx Weave (2 actions). Each creature restrained by Web of Hair must pass a DC 21 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 26 (4d12) force damage and any spells of 6th level or lower affecting it end.
sections.Mythic encounter: If Arasta uses Armor of Spiders, award 66,000 XP total for defeating her. This is equivalent to defeating two CR 21 creatures.
sections.Lair actions:
At initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one of the following options. The same option cannot be used in successive rounds.
Read the Web. Each creature restrained by a web or by Web of Hair makes a DC 21 Intelligence save. For each failure, Arasta learns the creature's name, race, what it considers home, and why it came to her web.
Giant Insect. Arasta casts Giant Insect on spiders only. It lasts until she uses this lair option again or dies.
sections.Regional effects:
One or both of these effects can shape the area within 1 mile of Arasta's lair.
Spiders and insects spy for Arasta. Birds and other flying creatures vanish from the skies, although some turn up trapped in webs.
Webs fill 10-ft. cubes of open space wherever two solid surfaces can anchor them. They burn away in 1 round when exposed to fire. Destroyed webs magically repair themselves at the next dawn.
On Arasta's death, the spiders and insects lose their link to her. The webs dissolve within 1d10 days.
sections.Printed source: Mythic Odysseys of Theros, pp. 248–249. The stat block and mythic reward appear on p. 248.

name: Archon of Falling Stars
description: A spear-bearing champion of Heliod who rides a winged celestial mount into battle.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The creature has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Mount. While the archon is mounted and not incapacitated, it cannot be surprised and both it and its mount have advantage on Dexterity saves. Reducing a mounted archon to 0 HP also reduces the mount to 0 HP.
Radiant Rebirth (recharges after a long rest). At 0 HP, the archon regains 30 HP and springs back to its feet. Creatures it chooses within 30 ft. must pass a DC 16 Constitution save or take 13 (3d8) radiant damage and become blinded until the start of the archon's turn.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Wisdom sets the spell save DC at 17 and the spell attack bonus at +9. These spells require no material components.
At will. Command, Guiding Bolt, Spare the Dying.
1/day each. Crusader's Mantle, Spirit Guardians.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Radiant Spear attacks.
Radiant Spear. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing plus 10 (3d6) radiant damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Mount. If unmounted, the archon can magically teleport astride its mount with its worn and carried equipment, provided they are on the same plane. Winged Bull and Winged Lion are common mounts.
sections.Legendary actions:
The archon has 3 legendary actions. Use one option at the end of another creature's turn. The archon recovers spent actions at the start of its turn.
Attack (1 action). Make one Radiant Spear attack or cast Guiding Bolt.
Coordinated Assault (2 actions). Make one Radiant Spear attack. The mount can then make a melee weapon attack with its reaction.
Return to Nyx (3 actions). Destroy a visible corpse within 30 ft. in a burst of stars, leaving its equipment behind. Each creature within 10 ft. of the corpse at the time of the burst must pass a DC 16 Dexterity save or take 22 (4d10) radiant damage.
sections.Printed source: Mythic Odysseys of Theros, p. 212. Archon mounts appear on p. 214.

name: Ashen Rider
description: These fallen archons fled to the Underworld when their empires collapsed. They return on winged mounts and show little mercy to the heroes who stand in their way.

sections.Traits:
Aura of Silence. When a creature the rider can see starts its turn within 30 ft., the rider can require a DC 18 Wisdom save. On a failure, the creature is deafened and can't speak until the start of its next turn. A creature that succeeds is immune to this aura for 24 hours.
Mount. While mounted and not incapacitated, the rider can't be surprised, and the rider and mount have advantage on Dexterity saves. If the rider drops to 0 HP while mounted, its mount drops to 0 HP too.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Wisdom is the spellcasting ability (save DC 18). No material components are required.
At will. Command, Compelled Duel.
1/day each. Banishment, Blade Barrier.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Ashen Blade attacks or two Bolt of Ash attacks.
Ashen Blade. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 13 (2d12) radiant damage.
Bolt of Ash. Ranged spell attack, +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. A hit deals 22 (4d10) necrotic damage and prevents the target from regaining HP until the start of the rider's next turn.
sections.Bonus actions: Mount. While unmounted and on the same plane as its mount, the rider can magically teleport onto the mount with everything it wears or carries.
sections.Legendary actions:
The rider has 3 legendary actions and regains them at the start of its turn. It can use just one option at the end of another creature's turn.
Attack (1 action). Make one Ashen Blade or Bolt of Ash attack.
Coordinated Assault (2 actions). Make one Ashen Blade or Bolt of Ash attack. Then the mount can use its reaction to make one melee weapon attack.
Reduce to Ash (3 actions). A creature the rider can see within 60 ft. makes a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 27 (5d10) necrotic damage, and its HP maximum drops by the necrotic damage taken until it finishes a long rest. At a maximum of 0 HP, the creature and all its worn or carried gear except magic items turn to ash. Only Wish can revive it.
sections.Archon mounts: Winged Bull and Winged Lion are the most common archon mounts.
sections.Printed source: Mythic Odysseys of Theros, p. 213. Archon mounts appear on p. 214.

name: Blood-Toll Harpy
description: Bands of these harpies gather at lonely crossings and caves, where they prey on travelers and pick over the dead.

sections.Traits:
Blood Frenzy. The harpy has advantage on melee attacks against creatures below their HP maximum.
Dark Devotion. The harpy has advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.

name: Broken King Antigonos
description: A decrepit minotaur with a dented crown and a clay amphora wanders the Katachthon foothills. He claims Mogis cursed him after he chose his child as his heir, and now tests strangers for the right to succeed him.

sections.Starting hit points: Antigonos uses the 2014 Minotaur and begins the encounter with 38 of its usual 76 HP. The listed Hit Dice and most other statistics come from the base creature.
sections.Traits:
Charge. After moving at least 10 ft. straight toward a target, hitting it with Gore on the same turn deals an extra 9 (2d8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength save or be pushed up to 10 ft. away and knocked prone.
Labyrinthine Recall. Antigonos remembers every route he has traveled.
Reckless. At the start of his turn he can choose to gain advantage on melee weapon attack rolls that turn. If he does, attacks against him have advantage until the start of his next turn.
Decrepit State. Antigonos has disadvantage on his attack rolls.
sections.Actions:
Greataxe. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage.
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Amphora. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the amphora is empty, the target is restrained inside. A restrained creature can use an action to make a DC 14 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, escaping on a success. Destroying the amphora also ends the restraint. The amphora has AC 8, 20 HP, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
sections.Test of the Amphora:
Antigonos invites a Medium creature to climb into the amphora while he steadies it. After the creature enters, roll a d20.
1–9. He judges the creature too small and pours dirt into the amphora. The creature makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, it is blinded and restrained and begins suffocating. On a success, apply the effects of a hit from his Amphora attack.
10–19. He judges the creature too large and attacks it with his greataxe.
20. He declares the creature his heir, gives it his crown, robes, and belt pouch, and leaves.
sections.Contending with Antigonos: He leaves if no one agrees to his test. Insults and theft can provoke him, and in a fight he may switch to random targets with his greataxe or empty amphora. If the party refrains from attacking him, he calms after a few rounds. A character who urges him to turn away from Mogis can make a DC 14 Charisma (Persuasion) check. On a success, he abandons the amphora and leaves to learn about a new deity. On a failure, he still departs in thought. Award experience for overcoming him whether or not the party fights.
