sections.Orders: A working autognome follows its maker's orders. Most protect themselves if attacked, defend gnomes against non-gnome attackers, and protect children regardless of species. An autognome might step between a Lunar Dragon Wyrmling and the adults fighting it.
sections.Printed source: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Boo's Astral Menagerie, p. 14.

name: Braxat
description: This upright carnivore has a jointed shell over its back, a horned head, and enormous hands. Braxats hunt alone or in pairs in dry wastelands and on remote asteroids. They tend to save their acid breath for emergencies because it ruins the meat they hunt.

sections.Traits: Intellect Fortress. The braxat adds its Intelligence modifier to AC. Its listed AC already includes this bonus.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatclub attacks.
Greatclub. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.
Acid Breath (Recharge 6). Exhale acid in a 15-ft. cone. Each creature in the cone makes a DC 18 Constitution save, taking 26 (4d12) acid damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Spellcasting (Psionics): As an action, cast one spell using Intelligence (save DC 14). The spells require no components. Each is available 1/day. Compulsion, Fear.
sections.Reactions: Psionic Shield (3/day). When an attack roll would hit or a Magic Missile would strike, the braxat can raise a barrier if it sees the source. The invisible barrier lasts until the start of its next turn. It grants +5 AC, including against the triggering attack, and blocks all Magic Missile damage.
sections.Printed source: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Boo's Astral Menagerie, p. 15.

name: Brown Scavver
description: A ten-foot, one-eyed hunter with a gold-brown to umber hide. It needs days to digest a meal and fights only in self-defense while it digests.

sections.Traits: Unusual Nature. The scavver needs no air.
sections.Actions:
Swallowing Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. The bite deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit by it must pass a DC 13 Dexterity save or be swallowed. The scavver can hold one creature at a time.
A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained. It has total cover from attacks and other effects outside the scavver. At the start of each of the scavver’s turns, gas in its gullet deals 13 (3d8) poison damage to the creature.
If a creature inside the scavver deals it at least 15 damage on a single turn, the scavver makes a DC 20 Constitution save at that turn’s end. On a failure, it regurgitates the creature, which lands prone within 10 ft. If the scavver dies, the swallowed creature is freed from restraint and can spend 10 ft. of movement to exit prone.

name: B’rohg
description: A broad, orange-skinned giant with four arms and a preference for solitude. B’rohgs communicate with grunts and gestures. One that learns to trust a stranger may repay that kindness by carrying gear or guiding them through dangerous terrain.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make four Fist attacks or two Rock attacks.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 23 (4d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Hideous Rend. The giant reaches with all four hands for one visible Large or smaller creature within 10 ft. On a failed DC 16 Dexterity save, the target is grappled (escape DC 16). The giant cannot use Fist or Rock attacks while this grapple holds. The target takes 49 (8d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. If this damage drops it to 0 HP, the giant tears it into four pieces.

name: Chwinga Astronaut
description: A tiny spirit with a mask-like face. Astronauts make their homes on habitable moons and asteroids. Some stow away aboard ships or ride a Space Guppy.

sections.Traits:
Evasion. If a Dexterity save normally halves damage, the chwinga takes none on a success and half on a failure. This trait has no effect while the chwinga is incapacitated.
Unusual Nature. The chwinga needs no air, food, or drink. At death, the DM chooses what it becomes: moondust, sparkling spores, a likeness in miniature, a piece of ice, or a twelve-sided sponge.
sections.Actions:
Magical Gift (1/day). Bestow a supernatural charm of the DM’s choice on a visible Humanoid within 5 ft. See the Spelljammer charms below or the Dungeon Master’s Guide.
Natural Shelter. Enter a rock, bush, tree, or natural freshwater source located in the chwinga’s space. While sheltered, the chwinga retains its blindsight and cannot be targeted by attacks, spells, or other effects. It can emerge as an action. Destroying the shelter places the chwinga unharmed in the shelter’s space.
Spellcasting. Cast Druidcraft, Guidance, Pass without Trace, or Resistance at will using Charisma. The spells require no material or verbal components.
sections.Spelljammer charms:
Charm of Air Bubbles. The recipient can cast Air Bubble as an action. They lose this charm after casting it three times.
Charm of Instant Tools. The recipient conjures one set of Artisan’s Tools, Navigator’s Tools, or Thieves’ Tools in hand or in their space. The charm ends after one use. The tools stay.

name: Cosmic Horror
description: A Far Realm aberration about a hundred feet long or tall, with a different tangle of eyes, jaws, wings and tentacles on every specimen. It follows starlight to inhabited worlds to feed, then sleeps adrift.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The horror can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Unusual Nature. The horror needs no air.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Tentacle attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 22 (4d6 + 8) piercing damage.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (3d6 + 8) force damage. A creature hit is grappled (escape DC 18). The horror has 1d8 + 1 tentacles. Each can hold one target and cannot attack a different target until it releases the creature.
Psychic Whispers (recharge 5–6). Each non-Aberration in a 60-ft.-radius sphere centered on the horror makes a DC 21 Wisdom save. The whispers deal 33 (6d10) psychic damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Legendary actions:
The horror has 3 legendary actions. Use one option at the end of another creature’s turn. It recovers all uses at the start of its own turn.
Crushing Tentacle (1 action). One creature grappled by the horror makes a DC 22 Constitution save. It takes 18 (3d6 + 8) force damage on a failure or half on a success.
Poison Jet (2 actions). Each creature in a 30-ft. line 5 ft. wide takes 14 (4d6) poison damage unless it passes a DC 21 Constitution save.
Teleport (2 actions). Move the horror and the creatures it is grappling to a visible unoccupied space within 120 ft.

name: Dohwar
description: A flightless, penguin-like Feywild traveler that prefers to do business out of sight. A dohwar’s brightly colored feathers can unpredictably change color, often after a strong emotion.

sections.Languages: Common, Dohwar, telepathy 30 ft. (see also Merging below).
sections.Traits: Merging. Two dohwars can speak telepathically together with one willing third creature. Each participant must be within 30 ft. of both others.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.
Spellcasting (Psionics, 3/day). Cast Detect Thoughts using Charisma (save DC 11), with no components.

name: Esthetic
description: An organic warship grown by a Reigar, usually resembling a vast jellyfish or cephalopod. Without its creator, its actions are driven by self-preservation.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, petrified, prone.
sections.Traits:
Bioluminescence. With at least 1 HP, the esthetic lights the area within 30 ft. brightly and the next 30 ft. dimly. Its compartments have dim light.
Spelljamming. The esthetic has the properties of a Spelljamming Helm. Its Reigar creator is the only creature that can attune to it.
Unusual Nature. The esthetic needs no air, food, or drink.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Tentacle attacks.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (3d6 + 7) force damage. A creature hit is grappled (escape DC 17) and takes 18 (4d8) acid damage at the start of each of its turns while held. The esthetic has 1d4 × 2 tentacles. Each can grapple one target and cannot attack a different target until it releases the creature.
sections.Bonus actions: Jammerscream (recharge 6). Choose one spelljamming ship within 300 ft. If it has several helms, randomly select one. Its helm’s magic shuts down for 2d10 days unless a creature attuned to it opts to make a DC 17 Charisma save. On a failed save, that creature takes 42 (12d6) psychic damage and the shutdown lasts 2d10 hours. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and the shutdown lasts 2d10 minutes.
sections.Passengers and creator: There is room for the Reigar and up to six Medium passengers. The Reigar can open or close the hatch by touching it. The esthetic can live indefinitely on the Astral Plane while its creator lives. If its creator dies, the esthetic sickens and dies after 1d12 days.

name: Eye Monger
description: With mouth and eye shut, this ambusher resembles a twelve-foot asteroid. It opens its eye when it senses vibrations. Coins, metal weapons, gems, and magic items can remain in the gullet after a meal.

sections.Senses: Darkvision 120 ft., blindsight 120 ft. while the eye monger's eye is closed.
sections.Traits:
Antimagic Gullet. The gullet suppresses magic, including spells and magic items. Magic from artifacts or deities is exempt. Slots or item charges spent inside on suppressed magic are wasted. Suppression counts against an effect’s duration. Outside magic cannot affect creatures or objects inside unless it comes from an artifact or deity.
False Appearance. If it starts combat motionless with both mouth and eye closed, it has advantage on initiative. A creature that has never seen it move or act needs a successful DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to recognize it as animate.
Unusual Nature. The eye monger needs no air.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit must pass a DC 18 Dexterity save or be swallowed into the antimagic gullet. The eye monger can hold one swallowed creature at a time.
A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained. It has total cover from attacks and other effects originating outside the eye monger. It takes 35 (10d6) acid damage at the start of each of its own turns.
If a creature in the gullet deals at least 25 damage to the eye monger in one turn, the monster regurgitates it. The creature lands prone within 10 ft. If the eye monger dies, the swallowed creature is freed from restraint and can spend 10 ft. of movement to exit prone.
sections.Printing note: The updated printing uses blindsight while the eye is closed. The original printing listed tremorsense.

name: Feyr
description: A hovering tentacled horror that feeds on strong emotions. It avoids confrontation by hiding aboard spelljamming ships and feeding on the nightmares of sleeping crew.

sections.Traits: Unusual Nature. The feyr has no need to breathe.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Frightful Bite attack and one Tentacle attack.
Frightful Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Deal 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage on a hit. After the hit, every creature within 10 ft. that can see the feyr must pass a DC 13 Wisdom save or be frightened of it until the end of the feyr's next turn.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. On a hit, the target takes 17 (4d6 + 3) psychic damage and is grappled (escape DC 13). Each of the feyr's two tentacles can hold one creature and cannot attack a different target while holding one.
Invisibility. The feyr turns invisible. An attack or use of Nightmare Fuel ends the effect. It can also end it as a bonus action.
Nightmare Fuel (1/day). Choose an unconscious creature the feyr can see within 10 ft. The target must pass a DC 13 Wisdom save or take 27 (5d10) psychic damage. The feyr gains as many temporary hit points as the damage it actually deals.

name: Gaj
description: A six-legged ambush predator that buries itself in loose ground or waits on dark stone ledges. It interrogates captured prey by wrapping its antennae around the victim’s head.

sections.Languages: Understands all languages and cannot speak.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Mandibles attack and use Mind-Probing Antennae or, if recharged, Paralyze.
Mandibles. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. On a hit, the target takes 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage and is grappled (escape DC 11). The target takes another 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage at the start of each of the gaj's turns while held. The gaj can attack only the held creature with its mandibles until that grapple ends.
Mind-Probing Antennae. One creature grappled by the gaj makes a DC 12 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage and the gaj magically learns one piece of information it seeks from the creature's mind. On a success, it takes half damage and reveals nothing.
Paralyze (Recharge 6). The gaj magically targets one creature it can see within 60 ft. The target must pass a DC 12 Wisdom save or become paralyzed for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

name: Giff Shipmate
description: A disciplined sailor who makes up the rank and file on a giff spelljamming vessel.

sections.Traits:
Firearms Knowledge. The giff ignores the loading property on any firearm.
Steady as She Goes. On a ship’s deck, the giff has advantage on ability checks and saving throws against being knocked prone or shoved overboard.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks with the Longsword or Musket.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage on a hit, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage when wielded with two hands.
Musket. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. Deal 8 (1d12 + 2) piercing damage on a hit.
Force Grenade. Throw a grenade to a point within 60 ft. Each creature in the 20-ft.-radius sphere makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. It takes 17 (5d6) force damage on a failure or half on a success. Roll a d6 after the throw. On a 1–4, the giff is out of grenades.

name: Giff Shock Trooper
description: An armored assault specialist who breaks up defenses with gunfire and follows with a charge.

sections.Traits:
Firearms Knowledge. The giff ignores the loading property on any firearm.
Headfirst Charge. If the giff moves straight for at least 20 ft. and ends within 5 ft. of a Large or smaller creature, that creature must pass a DC 16 Strength save or take 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and fall prone.
Siege Monster. The giff deals twice its normal damage to structures and objects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks with the Greatsword or Musket.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 15 (3d6 + 5) slashing damage on a hit.
Musket. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. Deal 15 (2d12 + 2) piercing damage on a hit.
Thunder Bomb. Light a bomb and throw it to a point within 60 ft. Every creature in a 10-ft.-radius sphere centered there makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. It takes 18 (4d8) thunder damage on a failure or half on a success. Roll a d6 after throwing it. The giff has no bombs left on a 1–4.

name: Giff Warlord
description: A mercenary commander who leads a small spelljamming fleet from a fortified base. A giff shock trooper or a hired mage might serve in the warlord's forces.

sections.Traits:
Firearms Knowledge. The giff ignores the loading property on any firearm.
Legendary Resistance (2/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Morningstar attacks.
Morningstar. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage on a hit.
Double-Barreled Musket. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. Deal 28 (4d12 + 2) piercing damage on a hit.
sections.Legendary actions:
The giff has 3 legendary actions and recovers any it has spent at the start of its turn. Use only one option at the end of another creature's turn.
Move (1 action). Move up to the giff's speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Rallying Cry (1 action). End the frightened condition on the giff and on any creatures it chooses that it can see within 30 ft.
Weapon of Choice (2 actions). Make two Morningstar attacks or one Double-Barreled Musket attack.

name: Githyanki Buccaneer
description: A pirate who raids ships in the Astral Plane and keeps the spoils in a hidden stronghold. Many buccaneers once fought for Vlaakith before leaving her service.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks with the Greatsword or Telekinetic Bolt.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage on a hit.
Telekinetic Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Deal 13 (3d6 + 3) force damage on a hit.
Spellcasting (Psionics). Use an action to cast one of the spells below without components. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (save DC 13).
At will. Light and Mage Hand. The hand is invisible.
1/day each. Plane Shift and Telekinesis.
sections.Bonus actions: Astral Step (Recharge 4–6). Teleport up to 30 ft. into an unoccupied space the githyanki can see, taking along anything it wears or carries.

name: Githyanki Star Seer
description: A spellcaster who questions stellar entities such as Acamar, Caiphon, and Hadar, then commits their answers to journals. Star seers search Wildspace for beings no one has contacted before.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Astral Bolt attacks.
Astral Bolt. Melee or ranged spell attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Deal 20 (3d10 + 4) radiant damage on a hit.
Spellcasting (Psionics). Use an action to cast one of the spells below without components. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (save DC 15).
At will. Light and Mage Hand. The hand is invisible.
2/day each. Detect Magic, Invisibility (self only), Mage Armor (self only), and Tongues.
1/day each. Contact Other Plane (takes one action), Plane Shift, and Telekinesis.
sections.Bonus actions: Astral Step (Recharge 4–6). Teleport up to 30 ft. into an unoccupied space the githyanki can see, taking along anything it wears or carries.

name: Githyanki Xenomancer
description: A githyanki researcher who travels Wildspace to find unfamiliar creatures. Captured specimens may end up in its laboratory on the Astral Plane.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Staff and Telekinetic Bolt.
Staff. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage one-handed, or 6 (1d8 + 2) two-handed. Either way, add 14 (4d6) psychic damage.
Telekinetic Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 20 (3d10 + 4) force damage.
sections.Spellcasting (Psionics):
As an action, cast one spell from the list. Wisdom sets the spell save DC at 16, and the spells require no components.
At will. Druidcraft, Light, Mage Hand (the hand is invisible).
2/day each. Invisibility (self only), Pass without Trace (self only).
1/day each. Dominate Monster, Forcecage, Plane Shift, Telekinesis.
sections.Bonus actions: Astral Step (Recharge 4–6). Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space. Worn and carried equipment travels with the githyanki.

name: Gray Scavver
description: A six-foot scavver that hunts in packs. The smell of blood draws it in, though a wounded scavver usually breaks off the attack.

sections.Traits: Unusual Nature. The gray scavver survives without air.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Roll with advantage if the target is a creature below its hit point maximum. On a hit, deal 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Hadozee Explorer
description: A Wildspace explorer who often navigates for a spelljamming crew. An explorer can cross gaps by gliding and carries a musket for longer shots.

sections.Traits: Glide. For each foot it descends through the air, the hadozee can extend its membranes and glide up to 5 ft. horizontally. Heavy armor or the incapacitated condition prevents it from gliding.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Shortsword attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Musket. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 16 (2d12 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Nimble Escape. Take the Disengage or Hide action.
sections.Reactions: Safe Descent. When a fall would deal damage to the hadozee, it can spread its membranes to reduce that damage to 0 if it is wearing light, medium, or no armor.

name: Hadozee Shipmate
description: A hadozee deckhand who can climb the rigging and glide back down.

sections.Traits: Glide. For each foot it descends through the air, the hadozee can extend its membranes and glide up to 5 ft. horizontally. Heavy armor or the incapacitated condition prevents it from gliding.
sections.Actions: Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Safe Descent. When a fall would deal damage to the hadozee, it can spread its membranes to reduce that damage to 0 if it is wearing light, medium, or no armor.

name: Hadozee Warrior
description: A breastplate-clad mercenary armed with a shortsword and light crossbow. Some work in squads aboard pirate ships.

sections.Traits: Glide. For each foot it descends through the air, the hadozee can extend its membranes and glide up to 5 ft. horizontally. Heavy armor or the incapacitated condition prevents it from gliding.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Shortsword attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Light Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions:
Safe Descent. When a fall would deal damage to the hadozee, it can spread its membranes to reduce that damage to 0 if it is wearing light, medium, or no armor.
Uncanny Dodge. When an attacker the hadozee can see hits it, halve the damage it takes from that attack.

name: Jammer Leech
description: A barnacle-like plant that clamps onto spelljamming hulls and feeds on their magic. Its reddish-purple body hides inside a shell that matches the hull.

sections.Traits:
Spelljammer Overload. If the leech drops to 0 HP while attached to a ship with a spelljamming helm, the creature attuned to that helm makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 10 (4d4) psychic damage and is incapacitated for 1 minute. On a success it takes half damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn.
Unusual Nature. The leech needs neither air nor sleep.
sections.Actions: Spiked Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 2 (1d4) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Attach to Hull. Fasten to a ship's hull in the leech's space, dealing 2 (1d4) piercing damage to the ship regardless of its damage threshold. This damage cannot be repaired until the leech is scraped off. While attached, the leech has speed 0 and can detach as a bonus action. A creature within reach can spend an action and make a DC 18 Strength check to scrape it off. Failure leaves it in place. Scraping it off deals no damage to the leech or the ship.
sections.Reactions: Magical Discharge (1/day). When the leech takes damage, it can fire at a creature it can see within 30 ft. The target makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. On a failure it takes 10 (3d6) force damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn.
sections.Ecology: Spores settle on hulls, then puncture them after a few days and grow shells about 1 ft. across. A mated pair produces 1d6 spores per month.

name: Kindori
description: A whale-shaped celestial that feeds on starlight. Small eyes along its front edge signal to others at a distance and flash to drive off predators.

sections.Traits: Unusual Nature. The kindori needs no food, drink, or air.
sections.Actions: Tail. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 23 (3d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Flashing Eyes (Recharge 6). Project bright light in a 120-ft. cone. Creatures in the cone make a DC 14 Wisdom save or become blinded for 1 minute. An affected creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
sections.Ecology: A kindori has its own air envelope and gravity plane. Scavvers can live on it and eat the parasites growing there. A dead kindori's skeleton can carry a spelljamming helm and become a ship. Lunar dragons and solar dragons prey on kindori.
sections.Printed source: Boo’s Astral Menagerie, p. 31. Bonus action name follows the official Spelljammer errata.

name: Lunar Dragon Wyrmling
description: An alabaster dragon newly hatched from a stony egg. Lunar dragons carve their lairs into barren moons.

sections.Traits:
Tunneler. The wyrmling digs through solid rock at half its burrowing speed, leaving a tunnel 5 ft. across.
Unusual Nature. It needs no air.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage and 3 (1d6) cold damage.
Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 13 (3d8) cold damage and its speed is halved until the end of its next turn. On a success, halve the damage and leave its speed unchanged.
sections.Bonus actions: Phase (2/day). The wyrmling becomes partly incorporeal while it maintains concentration as if on a spell. It resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage in this state. Its phase does not let it pass through creatures or solid objects.
sections.Lunar dragon ages: Young Lunar Dragon, Adult Lunar Dragon, and Ancient Lunar Dragon are the older forms.

name: Megapede
description: A fur-armored centipede that can reach 150 ft. It ambushes prey under loose sand or in deep caverns and carries its eggs on its back.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Bite once and use either Life Drain or Psychic Bomb.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage and 22 (5d8) poison damage.
Life Drain. Each other creature within 15 ft. makes a DC 15 Constitution save against the megapede's magic. It takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
Psychic Bomb. Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. It makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 22 (5d8) psychic damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half as much damage and avoids incapacitation.

name: Mercane
description: A tall blue merchant in fine robes who trades in magic items and information on the Astral Sea. Mercanes share warnings about customers who cheat one of their own.

sections.Languages: Common, Giant, telepathy 60 ft. (see also Mercane telepathy).
sections.Traits: Mercane Telepathy. The mercane can speak telepathically with any mercane it knows, at any distance.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Psi-Imbued Blade attacks.
Psi-Imbued Blade. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage on a hit. A creature hit must also pass a DC 15 Wisdom save or be frightened of the mercane until the end of the target's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting (Psionics):
As an action, the mercane casts a spell from the list below. It uses Intelligence (spell save DC 15) and needs no components.
At will. Detect Magic, Light.
1/day each. Dimension Door, Invisibility, Mage Armor (self only).

name: Murder Comet
description: A screaming stone head in a trail of fire. Its creator fuses the essences of an Earth Elemental and a Fire Elemental. It prowls Wildspace for ships and crews.

sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Explode. At 0 hit points, the comet bursts in a 20-ft.-radius sphere centered on itself. Each creature inside takes 28 (8d6) fire damage on a failed DC 16 Dexterity save, or half as much on a successful one.
Flyby. Leaving an enemy's reach while flying provokes no opportunity attack.
Illumination. The comet gives off bright light within 30 ft., then dim light for another 30 ft.
Siege Monster. Its attacks and effects deal double damage to objects and structures when they can damage them.
Unusual Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Slam attack and one Spit Fire attack.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage and 7 (2d6) fire damage.
Spit Fire. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 13 (2d10 + 2) fire damage.
sections.Creator-bound form: A creator can bind their spirit to the comet and take its form, becoming ageless and immortal. The comet bears the creator's face. Use the creator's Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, alignment, and languages in place of the base comet's.

name: Neh-thalggu
description: A six-legged brain collector from the Far Realm. Its head develops a bulge for each stored brain, and after collecting twelve it focuses on finding a way home.

sections.Languages: Deep Speech. See Brain Dump for additional languages.
sections.Encounter setup: Roll 1d12 to set the number of brains the collector already has. Track any more it consumes during the encounter.
sections.Traits:
Brain Dump. After it consumes a brain, the collector magically learns to speak and understand the languages the former owner knew.
Unusual Nature. It needs no air.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage on a hit.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage on a hit.
Extract Brain. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated Humanoid. On a hit, deal 35 (10d6) piercing damage. If that reduces the target to 0 hit points, the collector kills it and consumes its brain.
Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6). Choose one Humanoid the collector can see within 10 ft. It makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half as much damage and avoids incapacitation.
sections.Spellcasting (Psionics):
As an action, cast a spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 11) and no components. Each spell can be cast once per day if the collector has consumed at least its listed number of brains. Casting does not spend a brain.
1 brain. Arms of Hadar.
2 brains. Detect Magic.
3 brains. Magic Missile.
4 brains. Tenser's Floating Disk.
5 brains. Darkness.
6 brains. Hold Person.
7 brains. Invisibility.
8 brains. Spider Climb.
9 brains. Fear.
10 brains. Hypnotic Pattern.
11 brains. Major Image.
12 brains. Stinking Cloud.

name: Neogi Hatchling Swarm
classification: Medium swarm of Tiny aberrations, typically lawful evil
description: A mass of newborn neogi that hunt together instead of fighting one another for food.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned.
sections.Traits:
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces or traverse ceilings without an ability check.
Swarm. The swarm can enter another creature's space, and other creatures can enter its space. The swarm fits through gaps large enough for one Tiny neogi hatchling. It can neither regain hit points nor gain temporary hit points.
sections.Actions: Swarm of Bites. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Deal 22 (6d6 + 1) poison damage on a hit, or 11 (3d6 + 1) if the swarm is at half its maximum hit points or fewer. The target must pass a DC 12 Constitution save or be poisoned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the effect on a success.
sections.Adult neogi: Neogi Pirate and Neogi Void Hunter are adult forms.

name: Neogi Pirate
description: An adult neogi crew member, often aboard a nightspider. It uses dyes and other markings to show its rank and identify its leader.

sections.Traits:
Mental Fortitude. The pirate has advantage on saving throws against the charmed and frightened conditions. Magic cannot put it to sleep.
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces or traverse ceilings without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage and 14 (4d6) poison damage. The target must pass a DC 12 Constitution save or be poisoned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the effect on a success.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage on a hit.
sections.Other neogi: A Neogi Void Hunter often captains a nightspider. A Neogi Hatchling Swarm is a cluster of newborn neogi.

name: Neogi Void Hunter
description: A neogi warlock in service to a malevolent entity that resembles a star. Void hunters are larger than other adult neogi and often command a Nightspider.

sections.Languages: Common, Deep Speech, Undercommon, telepathy 30 ft.
sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. The void hunter's darkvision works in magical darkness.
Mental Fortitude. The void hunter has advantage on saves against the charmed and frightened conditions. It cannot be put to sleep by magic.
Spider Climb. Climb difficult surfaces and cross ceilings upside down without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Bite once and Claw twice, or use Eldritch Bolt twice.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing plus 14 (4d6) poison damage on a hit. The target must pass a DC 12 Constitution save or become poisoned for 1 minute. It can end the condition with a successful repeat save at the end of any of its turns.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage on a hit.
Eldritch Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. Deal 20 (3d10 + 4) force damage on a hit.
Spellcasting. Cast Dimension Door or Invisibility using Charisma. Each spell is available once per day.
sections.Bonus actions: Enslave (recharges after a short or long rest). Choose a creature the void hunter can see within 30 ft. If the target fails a DC 14 Wisdom save, the void hunter magically charms it for 1 day. The effect also ends if the hunter dies or the two are more than 1 mile apart. While charmed, the target follows the hunter's commands and cannot take reactions. The two can communicate telepathically up to 1 mile apart. Each time the target takes damage, it can repeat the save to end the effect on a success.
sections.Encounter context: The ship encounters table has Yeshk, a void hunter, captain a Nightspider crewed by 24 Neogi Pirates and 5 Umber Hulks.
sections.Printed source: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Boo's Astral Menagerie, p. 41.

name: Night Scavver
description: A fifteen-foot Wildspace predator with one glowing eye and a star-speckled hide. It flies straight into a ship's air envelope to hunt on deck.

sections.Traits: Unusual Nature. The scavver can survive without air.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Roll with advantage when the target is a creature below its hit point maximum. A hit deals 27 (4d10 + 5) piercing damage.
sections.Encounter context: In the Wildspace encounter table, a night scavver hunts with 2d6 Gray Scavvers.
sections.Printed source: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Boo's Astral Menagerie, p. 49.

name: Plasmoid Boss
description: A plasmoid that grew unusually large at maturity. Its strength can win it a guild, a gang or a ship, but keeping command takes social skill.

sections.Traits:
Amorphous. Unencumbered by gear or clothing, the plasmoid can pass through a 1-inch gap. It has advantage on ability checks to start a grapple or get out of one.
Hold Breath. The plasmoid can go 1 hour without taking another breath.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Pseudopod attacks.
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Roll with advantage if the boss has at least one ally within 10 ft. of itself. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Reactions: Uncanny Dodge. When an attack hits the boss and it can see the attacker, it can halve the damage it takes from that attack.
sections.Allies: Use a Plasmoid Warrior for an armed bodyguard or a Plasmoid Explorer for a scout.
sections.Printing note: Some printings list 1,000 XP. This profile uses the standard CR 4 award of 1,100 XP.
sections.Printed source: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Boo's Astral Menagerie, p. 42.

name: Plasmoid Explorer
description: An ooze traveler who packs light to visit new worlds on the Material Plane and wander the Astral Plane.

sections.Traits:
Amorphous. Unencumbered by gear or clothing, the plasmoid can pass through a 1-inch gap. It has advantage on ability checks to start a grapple or get out of one.
Hold Breath. The plasmoid can go 1 hour without taking another breath.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Pseudopod attacks. One of the two may be a Javelin attack instead.
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.
sections.Other plasmoids: See the Plasmoid Boss for a leader or the Plasmoid Warrior for an armed escort.
sections.Printed source: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Boo's Astral Menagerie, p. 43.

name: Plasmoid Warrior
description: A veteran whose outer surface hardens into armor. A warrior can fight with an unarmed pseudopod, a spear or a pistol.

sections.Traits:
Amorphous. Unencumbered by gear or clothing, the plasmoid can pass through a 1-inch gap. It has advantage on ability checks to start a grapple or get out of one.
Hold Breath. The plasmoid can go 1 hour without taking another breath.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Pseudopod attacks. The warrior may substitute one Spear or Pistol attack.
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) if held in two hands for a melee attack.
Pistol. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Other plasmoids: A Plasmoid Boss might employ a warrior as a guard. Use a Plasmoid Explorer for a scout.
sections.Printed source: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Boo's Astral Menagerie, p. 43.

name: Psurlon
description: A robed, eyeless astral aberration with a wormlike head, a toothed maw, three-fingered hands and hooves.

sections.Armor: Mage Armor is included in AC 15.
sections.Traits: Aberrant Mind. The psurlon is immune to magical sleep and to magic that reads its thoughts.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
Psychic Crush. Choose one creature the psurlon can see within 120 ft. The target makes a DC 13 Wisdom save, taking 14 (2d10 + 3) psychic damage on a failed save or half as much on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell.
Spellcasting (Psionics). Cast one of these spells with Intelligence, save DC 13. The spells require no components.
2/day each. Disguise Self and Mage Armor (self only).
1/day. Suggestion.
sections.Encounter context: Psurlons return from the Deep Astral about once a century for the seven-year Feast of Worlds. They infiltrate settlements and sometimes partner with a Mind Flayer that consumes their victims’ brains. Githyanki raid their astral strongholds because of this alliance. A Psurlon Leader can oversee a raid and a Psurlon Ringer can infiltrate a settlement.
sections.Life cycle: Other psurlons hide the corpse of one of their own and lay eggs in it. Tiny worms hatch after 24 hours and feed on the corpse and one another. After seven days, the lone survivor emerges as an adult.
sections.Printed source: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Boo's Astral Menagerie, p. 44.

name: Psurlon Leader
description: About one psurlon in a hundred develops a head at each end of its wormlike body. These mutants are exceptionally intelligent and lead other psurlons.

sections.Armor: Mage Armor is included in AC 15.
sections.Traits:
Aberrant Mind. The psurlon is immune to magical sleep and to magic that reads its thoughts.
Two Heads. The leader rolls saves to avoid or end the frightened, stunned and unconscious conditions with advantage. One head stays awake when the other sleeps.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks and two Claw attacks. The leader can also use Psychic Crush. It may use Pacify in place of Psychic Crush if Pacify is available.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage.
Pacify (Recharge 5–6). Choose one creature the leader can see within 120 ft. On a failed DC 16 Wisdom save, the target is unconscious for 10 minutes. Damage wakes it early, as does another creature using an action to shake it awake.
Psychic Crush. Choose one creature the leader can see within 120 ft. The target makes a DC 16 Wisdom save, taking 21 (3d10 + 5) psychic damage on a failed save or half as much on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell.
Spellcasting (Psionics). Cast one of these spells with Intelligence, save DC 16. The spells require no components.
2/day each. Disguise Self and Mage Armor (self only).
1/day each. Dimension Door and Suggestion.
sections.Followers: Use Psurlon for a rank-and-file follower or Psurlon Ringer for an infiltrator in an assumed identity.
sections.Printed source: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Boo's Astral Menagerie, p. 45.

name: Psurlon Ringer
description: A psurlon that has eaten a humanoid and taken on that person’s appearance, memories and languages.

sections.Armor: Mage Armor is included in AC 13.
sections.Languages: Deep Speech plus the languages of the Humanoid it is imitating, telepathy 120 ft.
sections.Traits: Aberrant Mind. The psurlon is immune to magical sleep and to magic that reads its thoughts.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Dagger attacks.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 2 (1d4) piercing damage and 4 (1d8) psychic damage.
Psychic Crush. Choose one creature the ringer can see within 120 ft. The target makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. It takes 12 (2d8 + 3) psychic damage on a failed save or half as much on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell.
Spellcasting (Psionics). Cast one of these spells with Intelligence, save DC 13. The spells require no components.
2/day. Mage Armor (self only).
1/day. Suggestion.
sections.Assumed identity: A Psurlon must eat the specific Medium Humanoid it wants to imitate, then spend 8 hours in a psionic trance. It takes the victim’s appearance, memories and languages. The victim’s class features and other abilities do not transfer. The ringer is still an Aberration, and other psurlons recognize it. Only Wish can reverse the permanent transformation.
sections.Printing note: The stat block uses the official errata, with no separate saving throw or skill bonuses. The printed Multiattack makes two Dagger attacks, and Psychic Crush uses 2d8 + 3.
sections.Printed source: Spelljammer: Adventures in Space, Boo's Astral Menagerie, p. 45.

name: Reigar
description: A Ysgardian traveler with changing skin colors, luminous freckles, and a halo that turns attacks aside.

sections.Traits:
Glory. The reigar adds its Charisma modifier to its AC. The AC above already includes this bonus.
Hold Breath. The reigar can go without breathing for 1 hour.
Special Equipment. The reigar wears a personally crafted Talarith. Its weapon hits deal an extra 3 (1d6) force damage while it wears the item. The extra damage is already listed in Trident.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Trident attacks.
Trident. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, one target within reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage. Use 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage for a two-handed melee hit. Add 3 (1d6) force damage if the reigar wears its Talarith.
Chromatic Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +10 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. A hit deals 22 (5d8) damage. The reigar chooses cold, fire, lightning, or radiant.
Summon Duplicate (recharges after a short or long rest). Use the Talarith to create an obedient duplicate. It uses this stat block, with type Construct and unaligned, and it has no Talarith. It takes its turn immediately after the reigar and vanishes after 1 hour or at 0 hit points.
sections.Spellcasting (Psionics):
Cast one listed spell as an action with Charisma and spell save DC 18. No components are needed.
At will: Light, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation.
2/day each: Dimension Door, Phantasmal Force.
1/day each: Mass Suggestion, Sending.
sections.Encounter context: At sea, look for a living Esthetic ship built by its reigar. Only the creator can attune to its Talarith. A lost or destroyed one takes 1d10 + 20 days to replace.
sections.Printing note: Official errata names the action Summon Duplicate.

name: Solar Dragon Wyrmling
description: A newly hatched sun dragon with glimmering scales, a sinuous body, finned forelimbs, and luminous wings.

sections.Traits:
Flyby. Leaving an enemy’s reach by flying does not provoke opportunity attacks.
Unusual Nature. The dragon does not need air.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make a Bite and a Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) radiant damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Photonic Breath (recharge 5–6). Send a mote to a point the dragon can see within 120 ft. It bursts in a 10-ft.-radius sphere. Each creature in the sphere makes a DC 14 Constitution save, taking 22 (4d10) radiant damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Solar dragon ages: Light from the wyrmling’s wings shows through the black shell just before the egg hatches. See Young Solar Dragon, Adult Solar Dragon, and Ancient Solar Dragon for later ages.

name: Space Clown
description: A marauder from Clownspace that can take the appearance of a person or a carnival prop.

sections.Traits:
Dying Burst. At 0 hit points, the clown bursts. Each creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 12 Dexterity save or takes 10 (3d6) acid damage. A success halves the damage.
Squeakers. The clown’s shoes squeak when it walks and can be heard up to 30 ft. away. Phantasmal Form silences them.
sections.Actions:
Shock. Melee spell attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (4d6 + 3) lightning damage.
Ray Gun. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. A hit deals 7 (2d6) psychic damage. A Humanoid target with Intelligence 3 or higher also makes a DC 12 Wisdom save. On a failure, everything it sees or hears seems hilarious and it is incapacitated for up to 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
Cast one listed spell as an action using Charisma, without material components.
At will: Friends, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation.
1/day each: Mirror Image, Spider Climb.
sections.Bonus actions: Phantasmal Form (3/day). Cloak the clown and its equipment in an illusion. It can look like another creature of its size or smaller, or an object that fits its space. The disguise needs Concentration as if it were a spell and fails under physical inspection. A creature that sees the disguise can use its action to make a DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check, recognizing the clown’s true form on a success.
sections.Encounter context: Dohwar merchants supplied the first Clownspace ships with spelljamming helms. The clowns lure prey into carnival tents on settled worlds. Their ray guns are harmless in anyone else’s hands.

name: Space Hamster
description: A small Wildspace rodent with telepathy that it usually keeps secret.

sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 1 piercing damage.
Go for the Eyes (recharge 6). Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage. The target must pass a DC 15 Dexterity save or become blinded until the start of the hamster’s next turn.
sections.Bonus actions: Escape. Take the Dash or Disengage action.
sections.Encounter context: Wizards shrank the Giant Space Hamster to create the first small space hamsters. The transformation also sharpened their minds and gave them telepathy.

name: Ssurran Defiler
description: A reptilian psion that withers nearby vegetation and siphons life from creatures.

sections.Traits:
Hold Breath. The ssurran can go without breathing for 15 minutes.
Intellect Fortress. The ssurran adds its Intelligence modifier to AC. The AC above already includes it.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks, then use Defile if available.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.
Defile (recharge 6). Ordinary plants within 10 ft. of the ssurran wither and die. Each creature within 10 ft. of it makes a DC 11 Constitution save, taking 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. The ssurran heals 5 (1d10) hit points for each creature that fails.
sections.Spellcasting (Psionics):
Cast one listed spell as an action using Intelligence, without components.
At will: Mage Hand, with an invisible hand.
1/day: Invisibility, self only.
sections.Other ssurran: A Ssurran Poisoner has a shield, poisoned javelins, and gas bombs.

name: Ssurran Poisoner
description: A reptilian combatant armed with toxin-coated javelins and bombs that release poisonous gas.

sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The ssurran can go without breathing for 15 minutes.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, one target within reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.
Poison Bomb. Throw a bomb at a point up to 60 ft. away. Each creature in the resulting 10-ft.-radius sphere makes a DC 11 Constitution save, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failure or half on a success. The gas disperses quickly. Roll a d6 after the throw. On 1–4, the poisoner has run out of bombs.
sections.Other ssurran: A Ssurran Defiler drains life instead of carrying poison bombs.

name: Starlight Apparition
description: A radiant image of someone who died in Wildspace or the Astral Sea. It reaches across the Astral Plane to help a living creature through a particular ordeal, then fades once its help is no longer needed.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid, cold and fire. Also bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained.
sections.Traits:
Astral Existence. It can survive only on the Astral Plane. Sending it anywhere else destroys it.
Illumination. With 1 or more hit points, it casts bright light to 20 ft. and dim light another 20 ft.
Incorporeal Movement. The apparition treats objects and other creatures as difficult terrain when passing through them. Ending its turn inside an object deals it 5 (1d10) force damage.
Unusual Nature. It needs no air, food, drink or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Radiant Eruption. Melee or ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Deal 20 (5d6 + 3) radiant damage on a hit. A creature hit must also pass a DC 14 Wisdom save or be blinded for 1 minute. It can repeat that save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.
Possession (Recharge 6). Choose one Humanoid the apparition can see within 5 ft. On a failed DC 14 Charisma save, the apparition vanishes into the target and takes control. The target stays aware but becomes incapacitated and cannot control its body. Attacks, spells and other effects cannot target the apparition directly. It keeps its own alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma, and its immunity to being charmed or frightened. Otherwise use the host’s statistics, without access to its knowledge, class features or proficiencies.
The possession ends if the host drops to 0 hit points or leaves the Astral Plane, if the apparition spends a bonus action to leave, or if an effect such as Dispel Evil and Good forces it out. It returns to an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the host and is destroyed if that space lies outside the Astral Plane. After a successful initial save or the end of a possession, the target is immune to this apparition’s Possession for 24 hours.

name: Thri-kreen Gladiator
description: An arena fighter eager to test its weapons and reflexes. Some mark their carapaces with the blood of their foes.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Gythka attacks and one Chatkcha attack.
Gythka. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage. Roll the attack with advantage while the gladiator is below its hit point maximum.
Chatkcha. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage. Roll the attack with advantage while the gladiator is below its hit point maximum.
sections.Bonus actions: Leap. Jump up to 20 ft. in any direction while the gladiator has a speed above 0.
sections.Reactions: Parry. If a visible attacker would hit it with a melee attack while it is wielding a melee weapon, the gladiator raises its AC by 3 against that attack.

name: Thri-kreen Hunter
description: A forager and tracker with a color-changing shell. In Wildspace it might pursue a fugitive or head up a pirate gang.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks with Gythka or Chatkcha.
Gythka. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage.
Chatkcha. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions:
Chameleon Carapace. The hunter adjusts the color of its shell to match the surroundings’ color and texture. It gains advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in those surroundings.
Leap. With a speed above 0, the hunter can jump up to 20 ft. in any direction.
sections.Reactions: Parry. While holding a melee weapon, the hunter can add 2 to its AC against a melee attack that would hit it. The attacker must be visible to it.

name: Thri-kreen Mystic
description: A psionic adept who levitates over obstacles and drains life from prey. Mystics often act as pilots aboard thri-kreen spelljamming ships.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make either two Gythka attacks or four Psychic Bolt attacks.
Gythka. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d8 + 1) slashing damage.
Psychic Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) psychic damage.
Drain Vitality (recharges on a short or long rest). Choose a creature the mystic can see within 30 ft. It makes a DC 14 Constitution save, taking 32 (5d12) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. The mystic heals for the damage it actually deals.
sections.Spellcasting (Psionics):
As an action, cast one spell from the list using Wisdom and no components.
At will: Levitate (self only), Mage Hand (the hand is invisible).
1/day each: Freedom of Movement and Invisibility (both self only).
sections.Bonus actions: Chameleon Carapace. The mystic changes the color of its shell to match the surroundings’ color and texture. It rolls Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide there with advantage.

name: Vampirate
description: A gaunt undead pirate who steals life energy by touch or at a distance. Some sleep in coffins filled with grave dirt or make do among cargo in the hold.

sections.Traits:
Explode. Reaching 0 hit points blasts nearby creatures with ash. Every creature within 5 ft. must pass a DC 14 Constitution save or take 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.
Spider Climb. It can scale difficult surfaces and cross ceilings without an ability check.
Unusual Nature. It needs no air or drink.
sections.Actions:
Energy Drain. Melee or ranged spell attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature. A hit deals 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. A Humanoid that drops to 0 hit points from this attack dies and immediately rises as a free-willed Shadow run by the DM.
Light Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Crew: A vampirate crew may keep one or more Shadows of its former victims aboard.

name: Vampirate Captain
description: An undead raider who can conceal an entire ship. Its temperament sets the tone aboard, from strict codes of conduct to attacks that leave no survivors.

sections.Traits:
Explode. At 0 hit points the captain bursts into ash. Every creature within 5 ft. must pass a DC 15 Constitution save or take 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.
Spider Climb. Difficult walls and ceilings require no ability check to climb.
Unusual Nature. The captain needs no air or drink.
sections.Actions:
Energy Drain. Melee or ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature. A hit deals 22 (4d10) necrotic damage. A Humanoid this reduces to 0 hit points dies and immediately rises as a free-willed Shadow or Vampirate, chosen by the captain and run by the DM.
Heavy Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d10 + 3) piercing damage.
Ship Invisibility (recharges on a short or long rest). While standing aboard a ship, the captain can make it and everything aboard invisible to anyone outside it. The magic lasts up to 1 hour with Concentration, as with a spell. It ends immediately if the captain leaves the ship.
sections.Reactions: Uncanny Dodge. When an attacker the captain can see hits it with an attack, the captain halves that attack’s damage against itself.
sections.Companions: A Crawling Claw or Will-o'-Wisp often accompanies the captain.
sections.Encounter context: The ship table puts Captain Veluna Valderak aboard the hammerhead Jander Sunstar with 13 Vampirates and one Priest.

name: Vampirate Mage
description: A gaunt, white-eyed spellcaster who rarely strays from the spelljamming helm of a vampirate ship. It feeds on life energy instead of blood.

sections.Languages: the languages it knew in life.
sections.Traits:
Explode. At 0 hit points, the mage bursts into ash. Each creature within 5 ft. must pass a DC 14 Constitution save or take 11 (2d10) necrotic damage.
Spider Climb. The mage can cross difficult climbing surfaces and move upside down along ceilings without an ability check.
Unusual Nature. The mage needs neither air nor drink.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Ray of Cold attacks.
Energy Drain. Make a +5 melee or ranged spell attack against one creature, with a reach of 5 ft. or a range of 30 ft. A hit deals 22 (4d10) necrotic damage. A Humanoid this attack reduces to 0 hit points dies and immediately becomes a free-willed Shadow controlled by the DM.
Ray of Cold. Make a +5 ranged spell attack against one target within 120 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d8 + 2) cold damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell below using Charisma (spell save DC 13).
At will. Mage Hand or Message.
1/day. Choose Darkness, Dimension Door, Fly, or Hypnotic Pattern.

name: Void Scavver
description: A pitch-black scavver about twenty feet long with one large eye and a sharklike maw. It hunts alone and can send an invisible ray of fear from its eye.

sections.Traits: Unusual Nature. The scavver can live without air.
sections.Actions:
Swallowing Bite. Make a +10 melee weapon attack against one target within 10 ft. A hit deals 45 (6d12 + 6) piercing damage. On a hit against a Large or smaller creature, it must pass a DC 16 Dexterity save or the scavver swallows it. The scavver can hold only one creature at a time.
While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover from attacks and other effects outside the scavver, and takes 11 (2d10) acid damage at the start of each of the scavver’s turns.
If a creature inside the scavver deals at least 25 damage to it in one turn, the scavver makes a DC 20 Constitution save at that turn’s end. On a failure, it ejects the swallowed creature, which falls prone within 10 ft. of the scavver. If the scavver dies, the swallowed creature stops being restrained and can spend 10 ft. of movement to crawl out, emerging prone.
sections.Bonus actions: Ray of Fear (Recharge 4–6). Fire an invisible magical ray at one creature the scavver can see within 60 ft. The target must pass a DC 16 Wisdom save or become frightened of the scavver until the start of the scavver’s next turn.
sections.Encounter context: The Wildspace encounters table can place a lone Void Scavver in the party’s path. Smaller varieties include the Brown Scavver, Gray Scavver, and Night Scavver.
sections.Printed source: Boo’s Astral Menagerie, p. 49. The Wildspace encounter table appears on p. 6.

name: Young Lunar Dragon
description: A pale, rock-burrowing dragon that carves its home into barren moons and collects treasure stripped from intruding ships.

sections.Traits:
Tunneler. Burrow through solid rock at half the dragon’s burrow speed, leaving a tunnel 10 ft. in diameter.
Unusual Nature. The dragon can live without air.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Make a +7 melee weapon attack against one target within 10 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.
Claw. Make a +7 melee weapon attack against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.
Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in the dragon’s 30-ft. frost cone makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 27 (6d8) cold damage and its speed is halved until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and keeps its normal speed.
sections.Bonus actions: Phase (2/day). The dragon becomes partially incorporeal while it maintains concentration as if on a spell. Until concentration ends, it has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
sections.Lunar dragon ages: The Lunar Dragon Wyrmling is alabaster white. Its scales darken as it ages into an Adult Lunar Dragon, then turn slate-colored as an Ancient Lunar Dragon. During Phase, part of the dragon looks spectral, but it still cannot move through creatures or solid objects.
sections.Printed source: Boo’s Astral Menagerie, p. 35. The printed stat block gives typically neutral evil.

name: Young Solar Dragon
description: A star-born hunter with luminous wings, gleaming scales, and a sinuous body. A young dragon might defend an asteroid belt where Kindori and scavvers are plentiful.

sections.Traits:
Flyby. The dragon does not provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.
Unusual Nature. The dragon can live without air.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Tail attack.
Bite. Make a +9 melee weapon attack against one target within 10 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) radiant damage.
Tail. Make a +9 melee weapon attack against one target within 15 ft. A hit deals 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Photonic Breath (Recharge 5–6). Choose a point the dragon can see within 120 ft. A mote of radiant energy travels there and bursts into a sphere with a 20-ft. radius. Each creature in that sphere makes a DC 17 Constitution save, taking 44 (8d10) radiant damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Solar dragon ages: The Solar Dragon Wyrmling hatches from an obsidian egg. An Adult Solar Dragon typically nests in a star, while an Ancient Solar Dragon may hunt throughout an entire Wildspace system. A solar dragon sometimes approaches a spelljamming ship after mistaking it for prey.
sections.Printed source: Boo’s Astral Menagerie, p. 53. Official errata sets its hit points to 178 (17d10 + 85) and challenge to 9 (5,000 XP).

name: Zodar
description: A silent, hovering figure with an obsidian exoskeleton and two narrow eye slits. A zodar weighs about 1,500 pounds and may spend its life pursuing a purpose it never explains.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Disembodied Voice. On at most three occasions in its life, the zodar can make the surrounding air deliver a message of up to 25 words. It reserves this for matters of great importance. A creature with Intelligence 2 or higher understands the message.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the zodar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed.
Transport Inhibitor. No effect can teleport the zodar or take it to another plane against its will.
Unusual Nature. The zodar needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Crushing Fist attacks. Use Forced Teleport either before both attacks or after both.
Crushing Fist. Make a +15 melee weapon attack against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 21 (2d10 + 10) force damage.
Forced Teleport. Choose one creature the zodar can see within 60 ft. It makes a DC 21 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 22 (4d10) force damage, and the zodar moves it and its worn or carried gear up to 60 ft. by magic. The destination must be visible to the zodar, unoccupied, and able to support the target. On a success, the target takes half damage and stays in place.
Wish. Cast Wish using Charisma (spell save DC 17) without components. After the spell is cast, the zodar crumbles into dust and is destroyed.

name: Aurumach Rilmani
description: From a stronghold near the Spire, this gold-skinned strategist watches for forces that could upset the balance of the planes. It leaves the Outlands only when the imbalance threatens the multiverse.

sections.Damage resistances: Psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks, choosing Manifested Blade or Gleaming Ray for each.
Manifested Blade. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 23 (4d8 + 5) force damage.
Gleaming Ray. Ranged spell attack, +11 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 24 (3d12 + 5) force damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell from the following list using Intelligence (save DC 19), with no material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts.
1/day each. Fly, Geas (cast as an action), Slow, Suggestion.
sections.Bonus actions:
Aura of Blades. Manifest spectral blades around the aurumach. A creature that starts its turn within 10 ft. makes a DC 19 Dexterity save, taking 16 (3d10) force damage on a failure or half as much on a success. The aura ends after 1 minute, when the aurumach is incapacitated or dies, or when it spends a bonus action to dismiss it.
Invoke Weakness (Recharge 5–6). Choose a creature the aurumach can see within 120 ft. It must pass a DC 19 Wisdom save or be cursed until the end of the aurumach’s next turn. The next Manifested Blade or Gleaming Ray hit against it while cursed adds 27 (6d8) force damage.
sections.Rilmani: Aurumachs oversee the work of the Cuprilach Rilmani and Ferrumach Rilmani in maintaining planar balance.

name: Avoral Guardinal
description: A golden-eyed celestial with an eagle’s features and winged arms. Avorals leave Elysium more often than other guardinals and commonly travel as lone scouts.

sections.Traits:
Dive Attack. While flying, dive at least 30 ft. straight toward a Medium or smaller creature and end within 5 ft. of it. The target makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure it takes 14 (4d6) piercing damage and falls prone.
Flyby. Flying beyond an enemy’s reach does not provoke an opportunity attack from that enemy.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Talon attacks, with the option to replace one with Spellcasting.
Talon. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing plus 13 (2d12) radiant damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell from the following list using Charisma (save DC 16), with no material components.
1/day each. Command, Hold Person.
sections.Guardinals: The celestials of Elysium fight cruelty and injustice. Equinal Guardinals and Musteval Guardinals are other members of this family.

name: Baernaloth
description: A gaunt yugoloth with a horned, horse-like skull and ember eyes. Baernaloths seek secrets in the Gray Wastes of Hades and prolong the suffering of creatures they capture.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold; fire; lightning; necrotic; psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (4/day). Turn a failed save into a success.
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Anguishing Bite and one Claw attack. The baernaloth can also use Teleport.
Anguishing Bite. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage. A creature hit cannot regain HP until the start of the baernaloth’s next turn.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing plus 17 (5d6) necrotic damage.
Miasma of Discord (Recharge 5–6). Choose a visible point within 120 ft. for a momentary 20-ft.-radius sphere of vapor. Each non-yugoloth inside makes a DC 19 Wisdom save. Failure deals 35 (10d6) psychic damage and leaves the creature charmed until the end of its next turn. During the charm, it treats allies as foes, and its body and gear turn gray. Success halves the damage and prevents the charm.
Summon Yugoloth (1/day). Roll a 50% chance to summon the baernaloth’s choice of 1d4 Mezzoloths, one Arcanaloth, or one Baernaloth. Each ally appears in an unoccupied spot within 60 ft. and cannot summon other yugoloths. It stays for up to 1 minute, until it or the summoning baernaloth dies, or until the summoner dismisses it as an action.
Teleport. The baernaloth and its gear teleport up to 120 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell from the following list using Intelligence (save DC 20), with no material components.
At will. Detect Thoughts, Phantasmal Force, Suggestion.
1/day each. Cloudkill, Plane Shift (self only), Scrying (cast as an action).
sections.Reactions:
The baernaloth can take three reactions per round, with a maximum of one per turn.
Afflict Despair. When a visible creature within 60 ft. hits with an attack roll or succeeds on a save, force it to reroll the d20 and keep the new roll.
Inescapable Pain. When another creature damages the baernaloth, that creature makes a DC 19 Constitution save. Failure deals 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. Success halves it.
sections.Lair actions:
On initiative count 20, after other combatants tied at 20, choose one action. The same action cannot be used in consecutive rounds. In its lair the baernaloth is CR 18 (20,000 XP).
Consume Suffering. Until initiative count 20 next round, whenever another creature in the lair takes necrotic or psychic damage or drops to 0 HP, the baernaloth regains 10 (3d6) HP.
Discover Secrets. Use Spellcasting to cast Detect Thoughts. A target of the spell cast this way also takes 13 (3d8) psychic damage.
Recurring Wound. Choose a visible creature in the lair that is below its HP maximum. It makes a DC 19 Constitution save, taking 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Regional effects:
The lair can produce either or both effects within 10 miles. Both end immediately if the baernaloth dies.
Persistent Anguish. A spell that restores HP or removes the charmed or frightened condition fails and is wasted unless its caster passes a DC 19 save using its spellcasting ability. A caster that succeeds ignores this effect for 24 hours.
Slow Healing. Other creatures regain HP equal to only half their maximum after a long rest. They regain half the usual HP when spending Hit Dice on a short rest.

name: Bleak Cabal Void Soother
classification: Small or Medium humanoid, any alignment
description: A Bleak Cabal healer who travels to dangerous planes and places scarred by war to treat curses and other planar afflictions.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Mace or Void Bolt for each.
Mace. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning plus 3 (1d6) force damage.
Void Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +4 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d8) force damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell from the following list using Wisdom (save DC 12).
At will. Guidance, Light.
1/day each. Calm Emotions, Lesser Restoration, Remove Curse, Protection from Energy.
sections.Bonus actions: Soothing Word (3/day). Choose a creature the void soother can see within 60 ft. It magically regains 4 (1d4 + 2) HP.

name: Cranium Rat Squeaker Swarm
classification: Medium swarm of Tiny aberrations, typically neutral
description: A crowd of Sigil’s cranium rat squeakers pools its memories and acts as one mind. In numbers, the rats can send messages and use stronger psionics than any squeaker alone.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned.
sections.Traits:
Psychic Messenger. Sending can reach someone familiar to a creature that is in telepathic contact with the swarm.
Swarm. The swarm and another creature can share a space. It fits through any opening a Tiny rat can pass through. It cannot regain HP or gain temporary HP.
Telepathic Shroud. Divination spells and effects that read thoughts or sense emotions cannot affect the swarm.
sections.Actions: Bites. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target sharing the swarm’s space. A hit deals 14 (4d6) piercing plus 22 (5d8) psychic damage. At half its maximum HP or less (38 HP by default), the piercing damage drops to 7 (2d6).
sections.Spellcasting (Psionics):
With more than half its maximum HP (above 38 HP by default), cast one spell from the following list as an action using Intelligence (save DC 13). No spell components are required.
At will. Command, Detect Thoughts, Sending.
1/day each. Confusion, Dominate Monster.
sections.Bonus actions: Illumination. Set the swarm’s light to dim within 5 ft., choose a bright radius from 5 to 20 ft. with an equal band of dim light beyond it, or extinguish the light.

name: Cuprilach Rilmani
description: A wiry copper infiltrator whose torso floats above its waist, separated by a polished sphere. Cuprilachs spy and kill on orders from the aurumachs.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks, choosing Burnished Blade or Bolt for each.
Burnished Blade. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing plus 13 (2d12) psychic damage.
Bolt. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing plus 13 (2d12) psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell from the following list using Intelligence (save DC 15), with no material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Disguise Self.
1/day each. Alter Self, Fog Cloud, Silence.
sections.Bonus actions: Assassin’s Agility. Dash, Disengage, or make one Burnished Blade attack.
sections.Reactions: Uncanny Dodge. When an attacker the cuprilach can see hits it, halve the damage from that attack.
sections.Rilmani: The Cuprilach Rilmani takes orders from the Aurumach Rilmani.

name: Darkweaver
description: An arachnid hunter from the Shadowfell that ambushes its victims with webs made of darkness. A captive might buy time by describing a memorable meal or promising to bring back a rare spice.

sections.Traits:
Shadowy Form. Attacks against the darkweaver have disadvantage while it is in dim light or darkness, unless it is incapacitated.
Spider Climb. Climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings upside down, without an ability check.
Sunlight Hypersensitivity. Starting its turn in sunlight deals 10 radiant damage to the darkweaver. It makes attack rolls and ability checks with disadvantage while in sunlight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Shadow Web attacks and one Bite. The darkweaver can use Reel after any of those attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing plus 17 (5d6) necrotic damage. A creature’s maximum HP decreases by the necrotic damage actually taken until it finishes a long rest. It dies if its maximum HP reaches 0.
Shadow Web. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, up to 120 ft., one creature. A hit deals 16 (3d10) necrotic damage and leaves the target grappled (escape DC 15). The web can be destroyed. It has AC 16, 20 HP, vulnerability to radiant damage, and immunity to bludgeoning, necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The darkweaver can hold up to six creatures this way.
Reel. Pull each creature the darkweaver has grappled up to 60 ft. toward it.
sections.Lair actions:
On initiative count 20, after other combatants tied at 20, choose one action. The same action cannot be used in consecutive rounds. In its lair the darkweaver is CR 11 (7,200 XP).
Extinguish. Put out nonmagical flames within 30 ft. Dispel any spell of 2nd level or lower whose area of light overlaps that space.
Shadow Fears. Creatures grappled by Shadow Web make a DC 15 Wisdom save. Those that fail are frightened until the end of their next turn.
Shadow Step. If the darkweaver is in dim light or darkness, teleport with its gear to a visible, unoccupied spot in dim light or darkness within 60 ft.
sections.Darkweaver webs:
A web has a 50% chance to contain 1d6 cocoons. Roll a d6 for each.
