1. Roll a die. Even means humanoid bones. Odd means bones of another creature, such as a Flumph or a Mule.
2. A Swarm of Insects that might be the darkweaver’s young.
3. A corpse holding a jar of Universal Solvent with a stuck lid.
4. A collection of menus from Sigil.
5. 4d12 gp in digested sludge.
6. A forgotten halfling Commoner or Musteval Guardinal.

name: Decaton Modron
description: A spherical ten-eyed machine with ten grasping tentacles, tasked with keeping lower-ranking modrons in working order.

sections.Traits:
Axiomatic Mind. No effect can compel the decaton to disobey its instructions or act against its nature.
Combat Ready. Roll initiative with advantage.
Disintegration. When the decaton dies, it crumbles to dust and leaves behind anything it was carrying.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Tentacle attacks.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit is grappled (escape DC 14). The decaton has ten tentacles. Each can hold one creature and cannot attack another target until that grapple ends.
Lightning Rays (Recharge 6). All creatures within 30 ft. of the decaton make DC 13 Dexterity saves against its electrical barrage. It deals 38 (7d10) lightning damage on a failed save or half on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell.
Intelligence (spell save DC 13), no material components. At will: Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, and Mending (as an action). 1/day each: Plane Shift (self only) and Protection from Evil and Good.
sections.Encounter context: The lawful planar encounter table suggests one decaton and 2d6 Quadrones returning to Mechanus. Modron orders pass from one rank to the next, and decatons form the lowest rank of hierarchs.

name: Doomguard Doom Lord
classification: Small or Medium humanoid, any alignment
description: A senior Doomguard agent whose weapons and presence accelerate decay. Even fortifications decay under a doom lord’s blows.

sections.Traits:
Aura of Doom. Any creature that starts its turn within 10 ft. of the doom lord makes a DC 16 Constitution save. The aura deals 18 (4d8) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. At the start of its own turn, the doom lord can turn the aura off or on without spending an action, provided it is not incapacitated.
Siege Monster. Double the doom lord’s damage to structures and objects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Entropic Greatsword or Entropic Javelin.
Entropic Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. If this attack kills a creature, turn its body and its worn and carried gear to ash, except for magic items.
Entropic Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. If this attack kills a creature, turn its body and its worn and carried gear to ash, except for magic items.
sections.Faction context: Doomguard Rot Blades carry similar entropic weapons into the field.

name: Doomguard Rot Blade
classification: Small or Medium humanoid, any alignment
description: A Doomguard field agent armed with weapons steeped in necrotic magic.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Entropic Blade or Entropic Javelin.
Entropic Blade. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If this attack kills a creature, its body and everything it wore or carried turns to ash except for magic items. Hit or miss, the rot blade can release a magical burst once per turn. Every creature except the rot blade in a 10-ft.-radius sphere centered on the weapon takes 6 (1d12) necrotic damage if it fails a DC 13 Constitution save.
Entropic Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing plus 13 (2d12) necrotic damage. If this attack kills a creature, its body and everything it wore or carried turns to ash except for magic items.
sections.Faction context: Doomguard Doom Lords are the faction’s senior agents.

name: Eater of Knowledge
description: A hulking biped of exposed brain tissue and muscle. Servants of Ilsensine cultivate these hunters to bring back secrets from their prey.

sections.Traits:
Brains Devoured. When the party first encounters this creature, roll 1d10 for the number of brains it has consumed.
Magic Resistance. The eater makes saving throws against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks. If both hit the same Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 14) and must pass a DC 15 Intelligence save or be stunned until that grapple ends.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Extract Brain. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated humanoid. A hit deals 45 (10d8) piercing damage. If the damage drops the target to 0 hit points, the eater kills it and consumes its brain.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell.
Spellcasting (Psionics). Intelligence (spell save DC 15), no components. Once per day per spell, subject to the number of brains already consumed.
0 brains: Plane Shift (self only). 1: Detect Magic. 2: Silent Image. 3: Invisibility. 4: Hypnotic Pattern. 5: Major Image.
6 brains: Telekinesis. 7: Arcane Eye. 8: Mislead. 9: Greater Invisibility. 10 or more: Mass Suggestion.

name: Equinal Guardinal
description: A horse-faced guardinal with a crested mane and powerful legs. Equinals can halt foes with a ringing shout or close the distance with a charge.

sections.Traits: Headfirst Charge. After moving at least 30 ft. straight toward a creature and finishing within 5 ft. of it, the equinal forces that creature to make a DC 17 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and falls prone.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Fist attacks.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning plus 3 (1d6) radiant damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. A hit deals 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit falls prone unless it passes a DC 17 Strength save.
Shout (Recharge 6). Each creature within 30 ft. must pass a DC 14 Constitution save or be stunned until the end of the equinal’s next turn.
sections.Guardinals: Guardinals hail from Elysium and often visit the Outlands gate-towns of Ecstasy and Faunel. Other guardinals in this book include the Avoral Guardinal and Musteval Guardinal.

name: Farastu Demodand
description: A Carceri fiend coated in sticky tar. Farastus are cruel trackers sometimes charged with hunting down escaped prisoners.

sections.Traits:
Boundless Movement. Ignore difficult terrain and any magical reduction in speed. The farastu can spend 5 ft. of movement to end the grappled condition on itself automatically.
Magic Resistance. The farastu has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Spider Climb. Traverse hard-to-climb surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks and one Bite attack.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage. A Large or smaller creature hit is grappled (escape DC 15, with disadvantage on the escape check). The farastu can hold one creature in each claw.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Roll with advantage against a creature the farastu is grappling. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing plus 24 (7d6) acid damage.
Summon Demodand (1/day). There is a 40 percent chance another farastu appears in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. It fights as an ally and cannot summon other demodands. It stays up to 1 minute and disappears sooner if either farastu dies or the summoner dismisses it as an action.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell.
Charisma, no material components. At will: Invisibility (self only). 1/day each: Dispel Magic and Fog Cloud.
sections.Demodands: Carceri’s bureaucratic Kelubar Demodands rank above farastus and often send them to do their fighting. A demodand that dies outside Carceri reforms there after 2d20 days.

name: Fated Shaker
classification: Small or Medium humanoid, any alignment
description: A Fated enforcer who backs the faction’s tax collectors and evictors, using spells to intimidate debtors.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Golden Rod or Radiant Bolt.
Golden Rod. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.
Radiant Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d10 + 3) radiant damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell.
Wisdom (spell save DC 14), no material components. At will: Mage Armor and Mage Hand. 1/day each: Enlarge/Reduce, Fly, and Suggestion.
sections.Bonus actions:
Commanding Words. Choose a visible creature within 30 ft. The target makes a DC 14 Wisdom save against a magical command. On a failure, choose an effect or roll 1d4.
1–2, Grovel. The target takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage, drops everything it holds, and falls prone.
3–4, Cower. The target takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage and is frightened until the end of its next turn.

name: Ferrumach Rilmani
description: An iron-bodied rilmani that fights to maintain the balance between the planes. Ferrumachs guard the Spire and take orders from aurumachs.

sections.Traits:
Bladed Edges. At the start of a creature's turn, it takes 10 (3d6) slashing damage if it is grappling the ferrumach or is grappled by it.
Skewering Charge. The ferrumach must move at least 20 ft. in a straight line toward a Large or smaller creature and finish within 5 ft. of it. The creature makes a DC 16 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 10 (3d6) piercing damage and is grappled (escape DC 18).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Sharpened Limb and Bolt.
Sharpened Limb. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing plus 11 (2d10) psychic damage.
Bolt. Ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing plus 11 (2d10) psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Intelligence (save DC 14). No material components are required.
At will. Detect Magic.
1/day each. Dispel Magic, Ice Storm.
sections.Rilmani: The Aurumach Rilmani directs ferrumach foot soldiers. The Cuprilach Rilmani works as a spy or assassin on the same mission to keep the planes in balance.

name: Fraternity of Order Law Bender
classification: Small or Medium humanoid, any alignment
description: A Fraternity of Order magistrate who exploits loopholes in planar law to manipulate distance and probability.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Arcane Burst attacks and use Power of Authority or Spellcasting.
Arcane Burst. Melee or ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d12 + 4) force damage.
Power of Authority. Choose one creature within 60 ft. that the law bender can see. It makes a DC 16 Intelligence save. On a failure, it takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage and is incapacitated for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Any creature that succeeds on the save is immune to this law bender's Power of Authority for 24 hours.
sections.Spellcasting: As an action, use Intelligence to cast Dispel Magic, Fly, Mage Armor, Mage Hand, or Prestidigitation. Each is available at will and needs no material components.
sections.Bonus actions: Spatial Loophole. Teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space the law bender can see. Worn and carried equipment travels with it.
sections.Reactions: Probability Loophole (3/Day). When the law bender or a creature it can see makes an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check, impose advantage or disadvantage on the roll.

name: Githzerai Futurist
description: A githzerai meditator who glimpses possible futures and uses those visions to change the outcome of a fight.

sections.Traits: Psychic Defense. Add the githzerai's Wisdom modifier to its AC while it wears no armor and wields no shield.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Unarmed Strike and Psychic Bolt.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning plus 11 (2d10) psychic damage.
Psychic Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +7 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. A hit deals 21 (4d8 + 3) psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting (Psionics):
As an action, cast one spell using Wisdom (save DC 15). No spell components are required.
At will. Dispel Magic, Levitate (self only), Mage Hand (invisible hand), See Invisibility.
1/day each. Plane Shift (self only), Scrying (cast as an action), Slow, Telekinesis.
sections.Reactions: Future Insight (3/Day). When the githzerai or a creature it can see makes an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check, impose advantage or disadvantage on the roll.
sections.Other githzerai: A Githzerai Traveler shapes energy from the plane it visits. A Githzerai Uniter uses its psionics to prevent violence.

name: Githzerai Traveler
description: A githzerai pilgrim who seeks enlightenment across the multiverse and draws on the energy of each plane it visits.

sections.Traits: Psychic Defense. Add the githzerai's Wisdom modifier to its AC while it wears no armor and wields no shield.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Unarmed Strike attacks.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning plus 4 (1d8) psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting (Psionics):
As an action, cast one spell using Wisdom (save DC 13). No spell components are required.
At will. Mage Hand (invisible hand).
1/day each. Jump, Plane Shift (self only), See Invisibility.
sections.Bonus actions:
Matter Manipulation (Recharge 4–6). Choose one result below, or roll 1d6.
1–2, Astral Step. The githzerai and its worn or carried equipment teleport up to 40 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. Its walking speed becomes 40 ft. until the start of its next turn.
3–4, Growth. Flowers and vines make the ground within 15 ft. of the githzerai difficult terrain for other creatures until the start of its next turn, when the plants vanish.
5–6, Retaliating Light. Until the start of the githzerai's next turn, a creature within 5 ft. that hits it with a melee attack roll takes 3 (1d6) force damage.
sections.Other githzerai: A Githzerai Futurist catches glimpses of possible futures. A Githzerai Uniter uses its psionics to prevent violence.

name: Githzerai Uniter
description: A githzerai martial artist who aims to subdue opponents alive. Many uniters join the Sha'sal Khou to work toward unification with the githyanki.

sections.Traits: Psychic Defense. Add the githzerai's Wisdom modifier to its AC while it wears no armor and wields no shield.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Unarmed Strike and Psychic Bolt. Pacifying Touch can stand in for any of those attacks.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage.
Psychic Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. A hit deals 17 (5d6) psychic damage.
Pacifying Touch. Touch one creature the githzerai can see within 5 ft. The target makes a DC 14 Intelligence save. On a failure, the githzerai chooses Attack, Cast a Spell, or Dash, and the target cannot take that action for 1 minute. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the effect on a success. Any creature that succeeds on the save is immune to this githzerai's Pacifying Touch for 24 hours.
sections.Spellcasting (Psionics):
As an action, cast one spell using Wisdom (save DC 14). No spell components are required.
At will. Mage Hand (invisible hand), See Invisibility.
1/day each. Plane Shift (self only), Telekinesis.
sections.Other githzerai: A Githzerai Futurist catches glimpses of possible futures. A Githzerai Traveler shapes energy from the plane it visits.

name: Hands of Havoc Fire Starter
classification: Small or Medium humanoid, any alignment
description: A Hands of Havoc agitator who attacks oppressive institutions with a flame-wreathed hammer and a supply of volatile flasks.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Havoc Hammer and Havoc Flask.
Havoc Hammer. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning plus 9 (2d8) fire damage. A creature hit also suffers the lingering flames described below.
Havoc Flask. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d12) fire damage. A creature hit also suffers lingering flames. After throwing a flask, roll 1d6. On a result of 3 or lower, the fire starter has no flasks left.
Lingering flames. At the start of each of its turns, the creature takes 3 (1d6) fire damage. Immediately after taking this damage on its turn, it can make a DC 13 Dexterity save to end the effect on a success.

name: Harmonium Captain
classification: Small or Medium humanoid, any alignment
description: A Harmonium officer who leads peacekeeper patrols in Sigil and issues magically binding orders.

sections.Traits: Aura of Command. The captain's allies within 30 ft. are immune to being charmed and frightened. The aura is suppressed while the captain is incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Harmonium Blade attacks. The captain can also use Dictate if it is available.
Harmonium Blade. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing plus 10 (3d6) lightning damage.
Dictate (Recharge 5–6). Give a verbal, magical command to up to three creatures the captain can see within 60 ft. The command must direct the creatures to take an action or refrain from acting. Each target makes a DC 14 Wisdom save and automatically succeeds if obeying would directly harm it. On a failure, the target is charmed for 1 minute and follows the command. Damage or completion of the command ends the effect early for that target. An affected creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
sections.Harmonium patrol: The captain commands a patrol of Harmonium Peacekeepers.

name: Harmonium Peacekeeper
classification: Small or Medium humanoid, any alignment
description: A Sigil patrol officer in red plate armor. The jaws of its electrified polearm hold suspects in place and block an escape by teleportation.

sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The peacekeeper attacks with advantage if one of its allies is within 5 ft. of the target and that ally is not incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Electrified Mancatcher. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing plus 4 (1d8) lightning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit by the attack is grappled (escape DC 13) and restrained while the grapple lasts. The target cannot teleport and takes 8 (1d10 + 3) lightning damage at the start of each of its turns until free. The peacekeeper cannot attack with the mancatcher while holding that target.
sections.Faction: The Harmonium enforces order through force. A Harmonium Captain leads peacekeeper patrols through Sigil.

name: Heralds of Dust Remnant
classification: Small or Medium humanoid, any alignment
description: A Duster left between life and undeath after a failed ritual. Remnants carry messages and gather information for the Heralds of Dust.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Necrotic Surge attacks.
Necrotic Surge. Melee or ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d10 + 3) necrotic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell.
Intelligence, save DC 13. The remnant casts one of the following spells without material components. It can cast Mage Armor, Mage Hand, and Prestidigitation at will. Bane, Dimension Door, and Web are each available once per day.
sections.Bonus actions: Phase (2/Day). The remnant becomes partly incorporeal while it maintains concentration as though concentrating on a spell. It resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until that concentration ends.

name: Hexton Modron
description: A six-tentacled commander from Mechanus. Hextons lead modron forces in the field, including contingents of the Great Modron March.

sections.Traits:
Axiomatic Mind. The hexton cannot be compelled to disobey its instructions or act against its nature.
Combat Ready. Roll initiative with advantage.
Disintegration. On death, the hexton turns to dust. It leaves behind everything it carried.
Legendary Resistance (4/Day). The hexton can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Pincer attack and two Tentacle attacks.
Pincer. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Deal 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning plus 10 (3d6) force damage on a hit. A creature hit must pass a DC 17 Constitution save or be incapacitated through the end of its next turn.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Deal 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage on a hit. A Medium or smaller creature hit is also grappled (escape DC 14). The hexton has six tentacles, each able to hold one creature. A tentacle holding a creature cannot attack another target.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell.
Intelligence, save DC 17. No material components. At will, cast Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, or Mending. Mending takes an action. Plane Shift (self only) and Protection from Evil and Good are each available once per day.
sections.Reactions:
The hexton can take three reactions per round, with a limit of one per turn.
Counter Magic. When a creature the hexton sees casts a spell, the hexton can interrupt it. A spell of 3rd level or lower fails automatically. To stop a spell of 4th level or higher, make an Intelligence check against DC 10 + the spell level. On a success, the spell fails and has no effect.
Lightning Rebuke. When a creature within 120 ft. damages the hexton, it can retaliate with magical lightning. The attacker makes a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 11 (2d10) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.

name: Hound Archon
description: A soldier of Mount Celestia that guards vulnerable communities. It can watch a settlement in the shape of a dog or wolf.

sections.Traits: Aura of Menace. While the archon is not incapacitated, it can choose which creatures must make a DC 12 Wisdom save when their turns start within 20 ft. of it. A failed save leaves that creature frightened until its next turn starts. A successful save grants immunity to every archon’s Aura of Menace for 24 hours.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks. In true form, one Bite can be replaced with Shining Blade.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage on a hit. A Large or smaller creature hit must pass a DC 14 Strength save or fall prone.
Shining Blade (true form only). Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 11 (2d6 + 4) radiant damage on a hit.
Teleport. Choose a visible, unoccupied space within 120 ft. The archon and its worn or carried equipment teleport there.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell.
Charisma. No material components. Cast Detect Evil and Good at will. Aid and Continual Flame are each available once per day.
sections.Bonus actions: Change Shape. The archon magically takes the form of a Medium or Large dog or wolf. It retains its statistics except for its size and the loss of Shining Blade. The archon can revert with a bonus action and reverts automatically at 0 hit points.
sections.Archons: Lantern Archons guide travelers through Mount Celestia, and Warden Archons watch its planar paths. Their auras share the Hound Archon’s 24-hour immunity rule.

name: Kelubar Demodand
description: A squat, winged bureaucrat of Carceri whose skin oozes acid. Kelubars often send Farastu Demodands to fight in their place.

sections.Traits:
Acidic Secretions. A creature that touches the kelubar or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft. takes 5 (2d4) acid damage.
Boundless Movement. Difficult terrain does not slow the kelubar, and magic cannot reduce its speed. It can spend 5 ft. of movement to end the grappled condition on itself.
Magic Resistance. The kelubar saves with advantage against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 11 (1d10 + 6) piercing plus 18 (4d8) acid damage on a hit.
Spit Acid. Each creature in a 60-ft. line that is 5 ft. wide makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 27 (6d8) acid damage. On a success, it takes half.
Summon Demodand (1/Day). The kelubar has a 40 percent chance to summon its choice of 1d2 Farastu Demodands or one Kelubar Demodand. Each summoned demodand appears in an unoccupied space within 60 ft., acts as an ally, and cannot summon demodands. A summoned ally remains for up to 1 minute. It disappears early if it or its summoner dies, or if the summoner dismisses it as an action.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell.
Charisma, save DC 17. No material components. Cast Invisibility on itself at will. Dispel Magic and Scrying are each available once per day. Scrying takes an action.
sections.Bonus actions: Nauseating Fog (Recharge 6). Center a magical green cloud on a point within 120 ft. The 20-ft.-radius cloud is heavily obscured and counts as difficult terrain. It lasts 1 minute or until the kelubar uses this bonus action again. A creature that starts its turn in the cloud or enters it for the first time on a turn must pass a DC 17 Constitution save or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.
sections.Demodands: A demodand that dies outside Carceri re-forms in Carceri after 2d20 days.

name: Kolyarut
description: A four-armed component of the contract-forging machine at Sigil’s Hall of Concordance. It investigates disputed facts and brings its findings back to the larger machine.

sections.Damage resistances: Thunder. Also bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. Spells and effects cannot change the kolyarut’s form.
Legendary Resistance (4/Day). The kolyarut can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. It saves with advantage against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make four Unerring Blade attacks.
Unerring Blade. This melee weapon attack automatically hits one target within 5 ft. for 24 force damage. Choose a rider or roll 1d6. On 1–2, Disarm makes the target drop one held item of the kolyarut’s choice. On 3–4, Imbalance prevents reactions until the kolyarut’s next turn starts. On 5–6, Push moves a Large or smaller target up to 15 ft. away.
Edict of Blades (Recharge 5–6). Move up to the kolyarut’s speed without provoking opportunity attacks. The kolyarut can use Unerring Blade once against each creature it passes. Each hit from this movement ends all spells of 5th level or lower on the target. It also leaves the target incapacitated through the end of the kolyarut’s next turn.
Plane Shift (3/Day). Cast Plane Shift with Intelligence and no material components. The kolyarut can use the normal spell or target a visible, unwilling creature within 60 ft. In the latter case, a failed DC 18 Charisma save sends the target to a teleportation circle in Sigil’s Hall of Concordance.
sections.Reactions: Parry. When an attack would hit the kolyarut, it can add 6 to its AC against that roll if it sees the attacker and is wielding a melee weapon.
sections.Inevitables: The Kolyarut brokers planar contracts. A Marut can pursue a party that breaks one of these agreements.

printing.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse

name: Maelephant
description: An elephant-headed fiend hired to guard a place or object. A maelephant honors its contract even if it holds the same post for decades.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. Roll saving throws against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Barbed Trunk attack and two Glaive attacks.
Barbed Trunk. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing and 13 (2d12) poison damage. A Medium or smaller creature is grappled (escape DC 14) and restrained until the grapple ends. While holding it, the maelephant cannot use Barbed Trunk against anyone else.
Glaive. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage.
Mind Poison (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 60-ft. cone make a DC 16 Constitution save. A failure deals 39 (6d12) poison damage and leaves the creature poisoned. While poisoned this way, it loses all weapon and skill proficiencies, cannot cast spells or understand language, and has disadvantage on Intelligence saves. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A success on the initial save deals half damage, causes no condition, and grants immunity to this maelephant’s Mind Poison for 24 hours.

name: Mercykiller Bloodhound
classification: Small or Medium humanoid, any alignment
description: A Mercykiller in black plate and clawed gauntlets. Bloodhounds pursue people wanted for serious crimes in Sigil, even after the trail leaves the plane.

sections.Traits: Portal Sense. Detect portals within 30 ft., even when they are inactive, and know where each leads.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Clawed Gauntlet attacks.
Clawed Gauntlet. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing and 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Marked for Pursuit (3/Day). One visible creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 13 Charisma save, with disadvantage if it is below its maximum HP. Failure leaves it magically cursed for 24 hours. The bloodhound senses the creature’s direction and distance on the same plane. Across planes, the bloodhound knows only which plane the creature is on.

name: Musteval Guardinal
description: A mouse-like celestial from Elysium that uses stealth and illusion magic to spy for allies. It carries a blade made of bone.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bone Blade attacks.
Bone Blade. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing and 3 (1d6) radiant damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma, without material components.
At will. Dancing Lights.
1/day each. Disguise Self and Invisibility.
sections.Reactions: Skirmish Movement. When a creature finishes its turn within 5 ft., the musteval can move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
sections.Guardinals: Other Elysian guardinals include the Avoral Guardinal and Equinal Guardinal. Guardinals also travel the Outlands, particularly around Ecstasy and Faunel.

name: Nonaton Modron
description: A worm-shaped inspector with nine mechanical arms. Nonatons bring rogue modrons back in line with the will of Primus and question captives on Mechanus.

sections.Traits:
Axiomatic Mind. The modron can't be forced to act against its nature or orders.
Combat Ready. The modron rolls initiative with advantage.
Disintegration. On death, the body crumbles to dust and leaves its carried belongings behind.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Arm attacks and use either Pillar of Truth or Spellcasting.
Arm. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit by the attack is grappled (escape DC 14). Each of the nine arms can hold one target, and an arm holding a target cannot attack another target.
Pillar of Truth. Choose a visible point on the ground within 60 ft. A magical cylinder of force rises 60 ft. from that point with a radius of 20 ft. Each creature in the cylinder makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. Failure deals 21 (6d6) force damage, returns a creature in an altered form to its original form, and prevents it from taking a different form until the end of its next turn. Success deals only half damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 15). No material components are needed.
At will. Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, or Mending. Mending takes an action.
1/day each. Plane Shift (self only) and Protection from Evil and Good.
sections.Mechanus hierarchy: See Octon Modron for the administrators who govern individual sectors of Mechanus.

name: Octon Modron
description: An eight-tentacled hierarch who oversees the daily operation of a sector of Mechanus. It sends productivity reports to septons and diagnostic records to decatons.

sections.Traits:
Axiomatic Mind. The modron can't be forced to act against its nature or orders.
Combat Ready. The modron rolls initiative with advantage.
Disintegration. On death, the body crumbles to dust and leaves its carried belongings behind.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Tentacle attacks.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning and 9 (2d8) lightning damage.
Whirlwind of Tentacles (Recharge 5–6). Each creature within 20 ft. must pass a DC 16 Strength save or be pulled up to 10 ft. straight toward the octon. After resolving the pull, make two Tentacle attacks against every creature within 10 ft. of the octon.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 15). No material components are needed.
At will. Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, or Mending. Mending takes an action.
1/day each. Plane Shift (self only) and Protection from Evil and Good.
sections.Mechanus hierarchy: A Septon Modron receives the octon’s sector reports. A Decaton Modron uses its diagnostic records to keep base modrons functioning.

name: Planar Incarnate
classification: Gargantuan celestial or fiend, any alignment
description: A living surge of energy from an Outer Plane. Incarnates arise when their home is threatened and return to the plane after defending it. Upper Planar forms can resemble blooms of brilliant life, while Lower Planar forms can resemble moving walls of flame.

sections.Damage immunities: Necrotic, poison, and radiant. Also immune to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, restrained, stunned, and unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/Day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. Roll saving throws against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Planar Form. On the Upper Planes, use the celestial form. On the Lower Planes, use the fiend form. When an incarnate appears elsewhere, choose one of these forms. A unique appearance can still use either form’s mechanics.
Siege Monster. Double the damage dealt to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Slam or Energy Bolt for each.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 27 (3d12 + 8) force damage.
Energy Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 32 (5d12) radiant damage in celestial form or necrotic damage in fiend form.
Planar Exhalation (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 60-ft. cone make a DC 23 Constitution save. Failure deals 52 (8d12) radiant damage in celestial form or necrotic damage in fiend form. It also leaves the target blinded until the end of the incarnate’s next turn. Success deals only half damage.
sections.Reactions:
The incarnate can take up to three reactions per round, with a limit of one per turn.
Searing Gaze. When hit by an attack roll, choose a creature the incarnate can see within 120 ft. The chosen creature must pass a DC 20 Wisdom save or take 16 (3d10) fire damage.
Teleport. Immediately after a visible creature ends its turn, teleport up to 60 ft. into a visible unoccupied space.
sections.Adventure variant: For the fixed fiend form used in Turn of Fortune’s Wheel, see Modron Planar Incarnate.

name: Septon Modron
description: A seven-limbed modron that audits the work of lower ranks in Mechanus.

sections.Traits:
Axiomatic Mind. No effect can force the septon to violate its nature or instructions.
Combat Ready. Roll initiative with advantage.
Disintegration. On death, leave its carried items behind and reduce its body to dust.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make four Tentacle attacks and use either Lightning Network or Spellcasting.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit is grappled (escape DC 14). The septon has seven tentacles. Each can hold one target and cannot attack another target while holding a creature.
Lightning Network. Electricity fills a 30-ft. cube originating at the septon and disperses immediately. Each creature in the cube makes a DC 16 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 33 (6d10) lightning damage and is stunned for 1 minute. On a success, it takes half damage only. The stunned target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, or as part of Multiattack, cast one spell below using Intelligence (save DC 16), with no material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Mending (casting time of one action).
1/day each. Plane Shift (self only), Protection from Evil and Good, Sending.

name: Shator Demodand
description: A hulking, fungus-covered demodand that claims the right to police Carceri and commands those beneath it.

sections.Languages: Abyssal, Common, Demodand, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, and restrained.
sections.Traits:
Boundless Movement. Ignore difficult terrain and magical reductions to speed. Spend 5 ft. of movement to end the grappled condition on the shator automatically.
Jailer (1/day). Cast Imprisonment using Intelligence (save DC 18), without material components. The spell can use only the chaining option.
Liquefaction Ritual. Spend 1 minute to turn any number of willing Farastu Demodands and Kelubar Demodands within 60 ft. into living liquid. Each fits into a flask. Each is paralyzed despite immunity to that condition, takes no damage, and has any curses on it suspended. A shator can end the effect as an action, and opening a container also restores the demodand inside.
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Numbing Secretions. A creature that touches the shator or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft. must make a DC 17 Dexterity save. A failure halves the creature’s speed and gives it disadvantage on attack rolls through the end of its next turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Enervating Trident attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (3d6 + 7) piercing plus 26 (4d12) acid damage. A creature hit must make a DC 16 Constitution save or be paralyzed until the start of the shator’s next turn.
Enervating Trident. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (2d10 + 7) necrotic damage.
Inhibitory Spray (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 100-ft. line, 5 ft. wide, makes a DC 16 Dexterity save. On a failure, the creature takes 40 (9d8) acid damage and is paralyzed for 1 minute. A success halves the damage and avoids paralysis. A paralyzed creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the paralysis on a success.
Summon Demodand (1/day). Choose one group to summon: 1d4 Farastu Demodands, 1d2 Kelubar Demodands, or one Shator Demodand. The attempt has a 50 percent chance of success. Each appears in a free space within 60 ft., acts as the shator’s ally, and cannot summon another demodand. Each stays for 1 minute unless it or the summoner dies, or the shator dismisses it with an action.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell below using Intelligence (save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks), without material components.
At will. Invisibility (self only), Suggestion.
1/day each. Dispel Magic, Plane Shift (Carceri only), Scrying (casting time of one action).
sections.Carceri: A demodand killed outside Carceri re-forms there in 2d20 days. Shators also keep records of their prisoners and subordinates.

name: Shemeshka
description: A red-furred arcanaloth who runs Fortune’s Wheel. She uses her casino in Sigil to collect secrets, influence rivals, and trade in favors across the planes.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, and lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (4/day). Shemeshka can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Special Equipment. In someone else’s hands, her Razorvine Tiara works as a Tentacle Rod that deals slashing damage in place of bludgeoning damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Arcane Flux or Spellcasting, then make one Claw or Razorvine Tiara attack.
Arcane Flux. Choose a visible creature within 120 ft. It makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 45 (7d12) force damage and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage only.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d4 + 5) slashing plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.
Razorvine Tiara. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (3d6) slashing plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage. A creature hit makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, its speed is halved and it has disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws through the end of its next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, or as part of Multiattack, cast one spell below using Intelligence (save DC 18), with no material components.
At will. Alter Self, Darkness, Invisibility (self only), Mage Hand, Prestidigitation.
2/day each. Detect Thoughts, Dimension Door, Suggestion.
1/day each. Banishment, Contact Other Plane (casting time of one action), Mind Blank.
sections.Bonus actions: Teleport. Move Shemeshka and her worn or carried gear up to 60 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space.
sections.Reactions: Fell Counterspell (3/day). React when Shemeshka sees a creature casting a spell. A spell of 5th level or lower fails. For a higher-level spell, Shemeshka makes an Intelligence check with DC 10 + the spell’s level. The spell fails if she succeeds. Regardless of whether the spell fails, its caster is poisoned until the end of the caster’s next turn.
sections.House of Liars (adventure encounter):
Turn of Fortune’s Wheel, chapter 14, area P6a. An invisible Eater of Knowledge that has consumed five brains and an invisible Maelephant attack at Shemeshka’s call. She relies on defensive spells, Teleport, Fell Counterspell, and the area defenses. Once both guards fall, she offers a truce and escapes with an Amulet of the Planes after sharing what she knows, or if fighting resumes after that disclosure.
With Shemeshka present in a fight in P6, roll 1d4 at initiative count 0 each round. Choose which creatures in the area each result affects.
1. Wind fills the area for 1 round. Chosen creatures make a DC 18 Wisdom save or gain one level of exhaustion.
2. Chosen creatures touching the floor make a DC 18 Dexterity save. On a failure, a creature takes 22 (4d10) slashing damage and is restrained through the end of the next round. Success halves the damage and avoids restraint.
3. Chosen creatures make a DC 18 Wisdom save or suffer the effects of Confusion.
4. Chosen creatures make a DC 18 Wisdom save. Failure deals 27 (5d10) psychic damage and gives disadvantage on their next attack roll or save before initiative count 0 next round. Success halves the damage only.

name: Society of Sensation Muse
classification: Small or Medium humanoid, any alignment
description: A Sensate performer who seeks out new experiences and uses music or other displays to distract hostile crowds.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Beguiling Resonance attacks.
Beguiling Resonance. Melee or ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d8) psychic damage. A creature hit must make a DC 13 Charisma save. If it fails, its next attack roll before the end of its next turn has disadvantage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell below using Charisma (save DC 13).
At will. Dancing Lights.
1/day each. Comprehend Languages, Hypnotic Pattern.
sections.Bonus actions: Enchanting Presence. Each creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is charmed for 1 minute. On a success, it is immune to every muse’s Enchanting Presence for 24 hours. Whenever this muse damages a creature charmed by this effect, that creature can repeat the save to end the charm.
sections.Encounter context: The neutral planar encounters table suggests 1d4 muses trying increasingly daring feats to discover new sensations.

name: Time Dragon Wyrmling
description: A sleek, bright-scaled dragon whose tiny horn buds grow into branching horns as it masters time.

sections.Languages: Draconic and any two additional languages.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing plus 3 (1d6) force damage.
Time Breath (Recharge 5–6). Cover a 15-ft. cone in shimmering light. Nonmagical objects and vegetation there turn to dust if nobody wears or carries them. Each creature in the cone makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 27 (6d8) force damage and slips out of sync with time, giving attacks against it advantage. On a success, it takes half damage only. A creature out of sync can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the effect on itself on a success.
sections.Encounter context: Time dragons collect lost records and relics of vanished cultures. A wyrmling may ask travelers to help make an object or structure it knows will matter later.
sections.Other ages: Use Young Time Dragon, Adult Time Dragon, or Ancient Time Dragon as the dragon matures. The adult and ancient printings have lair and regional rules.

name: Transcendent Order Conduit
classification: Small or Medium humanoid, any alignment
description: A martial artist of the Transcendent Order trained to react before conscious thought.

sections.Traits:
Instinctive Reflexes. Roll initiative with advantage. The conduit cannot have disadvantage on attack rolls.
Unarmored Defense. Add the conduit’s Wisdom modifier to AC while it has neither armor nor a shield.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Unarmed Strike attacks.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. On hitting a creature, the conduit may choose one of the following effects. Each option can be used once per turn.
Incapacitate. The creature makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is incapacitated through the end of the conduit’s next turn.
Push. Move the creature horizontally up to 10 ft. away from the conduit.
sections.Reactions:
The conduit can take as many as three reactions per round and only one per turn.
Deflect Attack. When an attack roll hits the conduit, reduce that attack’s damage to the conduit by 1d10.
Don’t Be There. When the conduit must make a saving throw, it can move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If the new position puts it out of range or otherwise makes it an invalid target, it avoids the effect entirely.
sections.Faction context: The Transcendent Order also fields a lighter martial artist, the Transcendent Order Instinct.

name: Transcendent Order Instinct
classification: Small or Medium humanoid, any alignment
description: A martial artist trained to act on instinct. In a fight, an instinct can deflect blows from several attackers in rapid succession.

sections.Traits: Unarmored Defense. Add the instinct's Wisdom modifier to its AC while it goes without armor or a shield.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Unarmed Strikes.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Reactions:
The instinct has up to three reactions each round, with a limit of one each turn.
Deflect Blow. When a melee attack hits the instinct, reduce the attack's damage to it by 1d6.
sections.Faction: The Transcendent Order practices acting without deliberation. See Transcendent Order Conduit for the faction's faster, preternaturally alert martial artists.

name: Vargouille Reflection
description: A winged, severed head that stalks Undersigil. Its victims can see their own faces staring back before it swoops in.

sections.Languages: Understands Abyssal, Infernal, and the languages it knew before its transformation. It cannot speak.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The reflection has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing and 10 (3d6) psychic damage.
Abyssal Curse. Choose an incapacitated Humanoid within 5 ft. On a failed DC 12 Charisma save, the target is cursed. Its head takes on fiendish traits and its Charisma drops by 1 per hour. While cursed, its Charisma cannot rise. Sunlight or Daylight pauses the curse's progress. At Charisma 2, the target dies and its head breaks free as a new Vargouille Reflection. Before the transformation finishes, Remove Curse, Greater Restoration, or comparable magic lifts the curse and restores the lost Charisma.
Horrific Reflection (Recharge 5–6). Copy the face of one visible Humanoid within 120 ft. The target makes a DC 12 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage and is frightened for up to 1 hour, maintained with Concentration as for a spell. After a successful save or when the effect ends, the target is immune to all vargouille reflections' Horrific Reflection for 1 hour.
sections.Encounter context: This Undersigil variety mimics the faces of its prey. Use Vargouille for the more common creature that spreads its curse across the planes.

printing.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse

name: Warden Archon
description: A bear-headed celestial with silver-lit eyes and a deep, resonant voice. It guards a planar passage, questions those who cross, and hunts intruders it has marked with its bite.

sections.Traits:
Aura of Menace. While the archon is free of the incapacitated condition, each creature it chooses that starts its turn within 20 ft. must make a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, the creature is frightened until its next turn starts. On a success, it is immune to any archon's Aura of Menace for 24 hours.
Eternal Vigil. The archon cannot be surprised and senses whenever a creature uses a portal it has been assigned to guard.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks and one Tracker's Bite.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 18). The archon can hold only one target with this attack at a time.
Tracker's Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage. For 24 hours after hitting a creature, the archon knows that creature's distance and direction whenever both are on the same plane.
Teleport. The archon transports itself and its worn or carried gear to a vacant space it can see within 120 ft.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (save DC 15) without material components.
At will. Detect Evil and Good.
Once per day each. Aid, Continual Flame, Protection from Evil and Good, Scrying (as an action).
sections.Related archons: A Hound Archon pursues evil across the planes. A Lantern Archon helps travelers find their way.

name: Young Time Dragon
description: A sleek dragon with iridescent veins branching through its growing horns. It prizes records of lost civilizations and can push a creature out of step with time.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing and 7 (2d6) force damage.
Time Breath (Recharge 5–6). The dragon exhales a 30-ft. cone that reduces unworn and uncarried nonmagical objects and vegetation to dust. Each creature in the cone makes a DC 17 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 31 (7d8) force damage and becomes magically weakened. Attacks against it have advantage while weakened. On a success, it takes half damage only. A weakened creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns. Its second successful repeat ends the effect.
sections.Lairs and hoards: Time dragons preserve ruins and temples associated with dead gods. Their hoards often hold historical records and artifacts from forgotten cultures. Use the Adult Time Dragon or Ancient Time Dragon profiles for the rules that govern a mature dragon's lair and the surrounding region.
sections.Other ages: For a newly hatched dragon, use Time Dragon Wyrmling. Ancient time dragons can open gates to a particular place and time.
sections.Printed source: Morte's Planar Parade, pp. 48–51. Young stat block on p. 51.

name: Agdon Longscarf
speed: 35 ft., or 70 ft. with his scarf
description: A boastful harengon brigand with an enchanted blue scarf. Zybilna pinned him to a tree by it. Bavlorna freed him in exchange for the best item taken from each victim.

sections.Traits:
Evasion. When a Dexterity save would halve damage, Agdon instead takes none on a success or half on a failure. This trait has no effect while he is incapacitated.
Standing Leap. Agdon can long jump up to 20 ft. or high jump up to 10 ft. without needing a running start.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Branding Iron or Dagger for each.
Branding Iron. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 10 (3d6) fire damage and magically brand the target. Agdon is invisible to creatures bearing his brand. The mark lasts 24 hours unless removed sooner by a spell that ends a curse. The iron cools when he lets go of it and works only for him.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Quick Fingers. Target a creature Agdon can see within 5 ft. Roll Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) against DC 1 + its passive Perception. On a success, he steals one object of 1 lb. or less that it carries but does not have in hand. It does not notice the theft.
sections.Reactions: Uncanny Dodge. When an attack hits Agdon, halve its damage if he can see the attacker.
sections.Encounter context: Agdon and his Harengon Brigands ambush travelers at the Brigands’ Tollway, with Harengon Snipers in support. A creature can use an action and succeed on a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check to catch Agdon’s scarf. While it holds the scarf, his speed is 35 ft. and he cannot move more than 15 ft. from it. He can try once to pull free as an action, resolved by a contested Strength (Athletics) check. If he loses, he surrenders on the spot. The scarf cannot be removed, even if Agdon dies.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, pp. 72–74. Stat block on p. 73.

name: Alagarthas
description: An elf prince stranded in Yon after making a bargain with Endelyn Moongrave. He wants to return to the Misty Forest to face the green dragon threatening his kingdom.

sections.Traits:
Brave. Alagarthas has advantage on saves against being frightened.
Fey Ancestry. He has advantage on saves against being charmed, and magic cannot put him to sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 bludgeoning damage.
Leadership (recharges after a short or long rest). For 1 minute, when Alagarthas sees a nonhostile creature within 30 ft. make an attack roll or saving throw, he can call out a command or warning. The creature can add 1d4 if it hears and understands him. Only one Leadership die can apply to a roll. The effect ends early if Alagarthas becomes incapacitated.
sections.Encounter context: The Fey Beacons show the route home only if Alagarthas lights all eight himself. It takes him 8 hours once the Perytons stop snuffing them out. Their flock was once a troupe of actors that performed for Endelyn Moongrave.
sections.Printing note: The adventure applies changes to the 2014 Knight. Alagarthas starts unarmed, so he uses an unarmed strike for 1 + Strength modifier damage and cannot use Parry. If he later wields a melee weapon and can see an attacker that would hit him with a melee attack, he can use the base Knight’s Parry reaction to add 2 AC against that attack.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 144. Base Knight on p. 347 of the 2014 Monster Manual.

name: Amidor the Dandelion
description: A sword-wielding dandelion who speaks in verse and helps travelers find their way in Yon. Its beloved companion is Pollenella the Honeybee.

sections.Traits: Speak with Beasts and Plants. Amidor can converse with Beasts and Plants as though it shares a language with them.
sections.Actions:
Rapier. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Seed Sling. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Reactions: Parry. Add 2 to Amidor’s AC against one melee attack about to hit it. Amidor must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.
sections.Encounter context: The party meets Amidor, Pollenella, and the masked elf acrobat Gleam during the journey through Yon. Use Selenelion Twin for Gleam. Amidor is quick to fall in love, puts others first, and tends to guard Pollenella rather than take the lead in a fight.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, pp. 134–135 and Appendix D. Stat block on p. 135.

name: Bavlorna Blightstraw
description: Slack-jawed Lorna bargains for immediate relief from other people’s troubles. The hag of the present distrusts visitors and relies on diminutive copies of herself in her Downfall cottage.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. Bavlorna breathes air and water.
Boon of Immortality. Aging has no effect on her, and old age cannot kill her.
Widdershins Allergy. If a creature within 10 ft. spends at least 10 ft. of movement running in place counterclockwise, Bavlorna starts sneezing and cannot cast spells through the end of her next turn. Any creature she has swallowed is expelled at once into an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of her and falls prone.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Bite once and Withering Ray once.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage on a hit. A Medium or smaller target is also grappled (escape DC 16) and restrained until the grapple ends. Bavlorna cannot Bite another target while holding this one.
Withering Ray. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Deal 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage on a hit.
Create Lornlings (Recharge 5–6). Create one or two 1-ft.-tall duplicates in unoccupied spaces within 5 ft. Each obeys Bavlorna and acts immediately after her. Use the Quickling stat block. Each lasts 1 hour, until it or Bavlorna dies, or until Bavlorna dismisses it as an action. No more than eight can exist at once.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast a listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 14), without material components.
At will. Detect Magic.
2/day each. Create Food and Water, Polymorph, Remove Curse.
1/day. Plane Shift (self only).
sections.Bonus actions: Swallow. Swallow a Small or smaller creature that Bavlorna is grappling, ending that grapple. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects from outside her, and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. If this damage reduces a lornling to 0 HP, Bavlorna gains its memories. Only one creature can be swallowed at a time. If she dies, the swallowed creature is no longer restrained and can spend 5 ft. of movement to leave her corpse, emerging prone.
sections.Hourglass Coven: When Bavlorna, Endelyn Moongrave, and Skabatha Nightshade are all within 30 ft. of one another, any one can spend an action to cast Detect Thoughts, Dispel Magic, Finger of Death, Glibness, Locate Creature, or Mass Suggestion without material components (spell save DC 14). Once any sister casts one of these shared spells, the whole coven loses access to that spell until the next dawn.
sections.Encounter context: Bavlorna must spend an hour submerged in brine each day. Without it she dries out and her body eventually locks up until she is submerged again. She uses a Bobbing Lily Pad to travel from her cottage, accompanied by lornlings. Witchlight’s appendix C uses the Quickling whose Blurred Movement ends when it is incapacitated or its speed becomes 0.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, pp. 215–216 and 239. Stat block on p. 216.

printing.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse

name: Brigganock
description: A mouse-sized Feywild miner with its soul floating outside its body as a little light. Brigganocks pull wish stones from the earth and use bursts of accelerated time to finish jobs.

sections.Traits:
Fey Ancestry. The brigganock has advantage on saves against being charmed, and magic cannot put it to sleep.
Soul Light. A tangible body does not contain this brigganock’s soul. It travels alongside the creature as an invulnerable, insubstantial light. It sheds bright light out to 10 ft. and dim light for another 10 ft. The brigganock cannot switch it off or adjust it. It fades when the brigganock dies.
Tunneler. With a pickaxe or similar tool, the brigganock can burrow through solid rock at 5 ft., leaving a 6-inch-wide tunnel.
sections.Actions:
Pickaxe. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Time Lapse (recharges after a short or long rest). Finish up to 1 hour of work in seconds within a 10-ft. cube. The work can affect the brigganock and unattended objects, but no other creature or any object worn or carried by one.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast a listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 11), without material components.
At will. Minor Illusion, Spare the Dying.
1/day each. Animal Friendship, Faerie Fire, Meld into Stone, Silence.
sections.Bonus actions: Move Soul Light. Move the light up to 30 ft. in any direction to an unoccupied space the brigganock can see. It returns at the end of the current turn.
sections.Encounter context: A mortal’s nonmagical wish can leave an echo inside a stone deep in the Feywild. Brigganocks keep and cut stones with kindly wishes and discard malicious ones. Powerful fey can use a wish stone to scry on the person who wished, power a supernatural charm, or awaken an animated object.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 230.

name: Bullywug Knight
description: A plate-clad champion of the Soggy Court. Bullywug knights insist that both sides fight fairly. Morgort, the imprisoned Knight of Warts in Downfall, is one example.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The knight breathes air and water.
Speak with Frogs and Toads. When speaking Bullywug, it can communicate simple ideas to frogs and toads.
Standing Leap. It can long jump up to 20 ft. or high jump up to 10 ft. without a running start.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Glaive attacks.
Glaive. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Croak of Charming (recharges after a short or long rest). Target one creature the knight can see within 30 ft. The knight croaks loudly. The target must pass a DC 12 Wisdom save or become charmed through the end of its next turn.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 231.

name: Campestri
description: A salt-loving mushroom creature with a spotted red or purple cap. It joins any tune it hears in a nasal falsetto, even when the performance is dreadful.

sections.Languages: Understands Common but speaks only through the use of its Mimicry trait.
sections.Traits: Mimicry. Reproduce any voice or song the campestri has heard, in its own nasal falsetto.
sections.Actions:
Head Butt. Melee weapon attack, +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 1 bludgeoning damage.
Spores (1/day). Release spores in a 5-ft. radius around the campestri. They spread around corners and do not affect Constructs, Elementals, Plants, or Undead. Every other creature in the area makes a DC 10 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is incapacitated and its speed halves for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending both effects on a success.
sections.Encounter context: A campestri remembers a song after three or four rehearsals. Several may sing and dance together. Use Swarm of Campestris for an attacking group.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 232.

name: Clapperclaw the Scarecrow
description: A three-foot scarecrow with pincers and a gourd head that rattles. It fled Granny Nightshade and wants its stolen stag skull back.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, unconscious.
sections.Traits: Unusual Nature. Clapperclaw needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.
Stuffing. Clapperclaw packs itself with straw or other dead plants and regains 2d4 + 4 hit points. Then roll a d6. On a 1 or 2, it runs out of filling and must forage for 8 hours before using this action again.
sections.Bonus actions: Unsettling Presence (Recharge 6). Choose one visible creature within 15 ft. It must pass a DC 11 Wisdom save or become magically frightened until the end of Clapperclaw’s next turn.
sections.Guide to Thither: Clapperclaw will guide the party from Hither to Thither if they help recover its skull. Agdon Longscarf stole it and gave it to Bavlorna Blightstraw, who keeps it in her cottage’s treasure room (B19). Clapperclaw avoids the hags and waits outside the cottage.
sections.Printing note: The printed Stuffing action on p. 78 restores 2d4 + 4 hit points. The indexed transcription gives 2d4 + 2.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 78 (D5).

name: Displacer Beast Kitten
description: A young displacer beast whose illusion makes it seem to be a short distance from its true position. Star, the kitten in Thither, recognizes its mirrored toy ball.

sections.Traits: Displacement. A magical illusion offsets the kitten’s apparent position, imposing disadvantage on attack rolls against it. A hit disrupts the illusion until the end of its next turn. The illusion also fails while the kitten is incapacitated or its speed is 0.
sections.Actions: Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 2 bludgeoning damage plus 2 piercing damage.
sections.Star and the Getaway Gang: Will of the Feywild, an Oni in disguise, keeps Star as a pet. He abandons Star if his curse ends. Showing the kitten Dirlagraun’s mirrored ball excites it. If told about Star’s parent, Will agrees to return the kitten if the party helps free the children in Loomlurch.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, pp. 108–109 (Little Oak).

name: Elkhorn
description: An aging dwarven fighter of Valor’s Call. He trained against ogres and trolls and still refuses to retire.

sections.Traits: Special Equipment. Elkhorn carries a +1 Longsword.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks chosen from Dagger and +1 Longsword.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage. A Large or larger creature takes an extra 5 (1d10) piercing damage.
+1 Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 4 (1d8) slashing damage with one hand or 5 (1d10) with two hands. A Large or larger creature takes an extra 5 (1d10) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions:
Feint (Recharge 5–6). Choose one visible creature within 5 ft. Elkhorn has advantage on his next attack against it before this turn ends. A hit adds 7 (2d6) damage of the weapon’s type.
Second Wind (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). Elkhorn regains 12 hit points.
sections.Valor’s Call: Elkhorn is Strongheart’s longtime companion. His challenge rating assumes he uses Feint to improve his sword attacks. He is especially dangerous to larger foes.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 224 (Appendix B).

name: Endelyn Moongrave
description: The youngest Hourglass Coven hag rules Yon from her mountaintop theater. She shows visitors terrible futures in exchange for a piece of their free will and believes she will die during a solar eclipse.

sections.Traits:
Boon of Immortality. Endelyn cannot age through any effect or die of old age.
Eclipsed Doom. Endelyn dies at 0 hit points only during a solar eclipse or within 60 ft. of a symbolic solar eclipse. Otherwise, at 0 hit points she vanishes in inky smoke with all worn and carried items, then returns 24 hours later at the same spot or the nearest open space.
Uncanny Awareness. Endelyn cannot be surprised.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Puppeteer’s Lash attacks.
Puppeteer’s Lash. Melee or ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. On a hit, deal 17 (4d6 + 3) psychic damage. If the target is Large or smaller, Endelyn telekinetically moves it up to 10 ft. in any horizontal direction.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell with Charisma (save DC 14) and no material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Mage Hand.
2/day each. Augury, Polymorph.
1/day. Plane Shift (self only).
sections.Hourglass Coven: While Endelyn, Bavlorna Blightstraw, and Skabatha Nightshade are all within 30 ft. of one another, any of them can spend an action to cast Detect Thoughts, Dispel Magic, Finger of Death, Glibness, Locate Creature, or Mass Suggestion without material components (save DC 14). Each spell has one shared use until the next dawn.
sections.Motherhorn: Glister of the Selenelion Twin act can stage a symbolic eclipse by standing behind the theater’s wooden moon prop while wearing her sun mask. The twins can also embody the sun and moon together. When threatened, Endelyn can flee on her Ornithopter of Flying. If the coven has regrouped and risks capture or death, the hags flee for the Palace of Heart’s Desire.
sections.Orrery of Tragedies (M14):
Creatures on the balcony and on the floor below have three-quarters cover against attacks from the other level. Touching the central lightning rod, entering the device’s space for the first time on a turn, or starting a turn there triggers a DC 15 Dexterity save. Take 44 (8d10) lightning damage on a failed save or half on a success. Make the save with disadvantage in metal armor.
At least eight components must be destroyed to wreck the device. Each is a Large object with AC 19, 27 HP, and immunity to lightning, poison, and psychic damage. The central rod has eight segments, each AC 17 and 25 HP with the same immunities. Destroying a segment drops the ones above it. If at least three are lost, the orrery shuts down after 1 minute until the rod is rebuilt. Antimagic Field suppresses the device while in contact. Dispel Magic (DC 19) shuts it down for 1 minute, but it stays charged.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, pp. 150, 161–165, 215, 217 (Motherhorn and Appendix B).

name: Envy
description: An iron lion created to guard Zybilna’s garden alongside Wrath, the iron hart. Envy demands that intruders kneel before it.

sections.Traits: Trampling Charge. If Envy moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hits it with Bite on the same turn, that creature must pass a DC 16 Strength save or fall prone. If the target is prone, Envy can make one Claws attack against it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 18 (2d12 + 5) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 16 (2d10 + 5) slashing damage.
Petrifying Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, it begins turning to stone and is restrained. It repeats the save at the end of its next turn. Success ends the effect. Failure leaves it petrified until Greater Restoration or other magic frees it.
sections.Palace guardian: Envy uses the 2014 Gorgon as its base, with speech and the Bite and Claws attacks shown here. Zybilna’s magic prevents the two guardians from harming one another. Envy orders disrespectful visitors to leave and attacks those who refuse.
sections.Crown of needles: Placing the silver crown on Envy banishes it and the crown to its demiplane until Zybilna recalls them. Wrath turns the silver crown to gold. Gold on Envy unlocks lion-marked palace doors even if Envy is dead. To borrow the gold crown, offer a lei of palace flowers. It takes 1 hour for one person to make, divided among contributors. Each contributor may make a DC 15 Intelligence (Nature) check. A success earns the crown temporarily. A total of 25 or higher earns it whenever requested.
sections.Printing note: The adventure changes the Gorgon’s Hooves into Claws and explicitly replaces bludgeoning with slashing damage.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, pp. 178–179 (P9), and Monster Manual (2014), p. 171.

name: Flying Rocking Horse
speed: 0 ft., fly 40 ft. (only while mounted, hover)
description: A wooden rocking horse animated by the Hourglass Coven. It can fly with a rider, and a depression in its forehead marks where its unicorn horn once grew.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Traits:
False Appearance. If motionless when combat starts, the horse rolls initiative with advantage. A creature that has never seen it move or act needs a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to recognize it is alive.
Flying Mount. The horse can carry a Medium or smaller rider and flies only while mounted.
Unusual Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep, and recovers neither hit points nor Hit Dice after a long rest.
sections.Actions: Head Butt. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Breaking Elidon’s curse: A creature within 5 ft. notices the depression in the horse’s forehead. A successful DC 10 Intelligence check identifies it as the former site of a horn. Place Elidon’s lost horn on the brow while the horse has at least 1 HP. It transforms into Elidon, a Unicorn at full health. A DC 17 Charisma (Persuasion) check persuades him to join the party instead of returning directly to Lamorna. Before leaving, he offers Healing Touch, one teleport per day for himself and up to three willing party members to a location in Thither up to 1 mile away, and Pass without Trace at will for himself and the party (concentration, up to 1 hour).
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 121 (L6).

name: Glass Pegasus
description: One of two glass pegasi that pull Zybilna’s flying crystal carriage. The carriage key wakes them and gives the driver reins made of starlight.

sections.Armor: AC 15 while animated, AC 13 while inanimate.
sections.Languages: Understands Celestial, Common, Elvish, and Sylvan but cannot speak.
sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Carriage harness: Hold the carriage key within 3 inches of either door to reveal a keyhole. Turning it clockwise unlocks both doors and animates the pegasi. The driver gains starlight reins and can move the carriage 40 ft. on land or 80 ft. in flight. While the carriage is stationary on the ground, turning the key counterclockwise locks the doors and returns the pegasi to statues. The vehicle and both pegasi shatter if the carriage leaves the Feywild.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 181 (P11), and Monster Manual (2014), p. 250.

name: Glasswork Golem
description: An animated knight of stained glass that can step out of its window frame, sword in hand.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft. The golem is blind beyond that distance.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Traits:
False Appearance. The golem has advantage on initiative if it starts combat motionless inside a window. A creature that has never seen it move or act needs a successful DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to tell that it is animate.
Immutable Form. Spells and effects cannot change the golem’s form.
Regeneration. The golem heals 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes bludgeoning or thunder damage, it skips that healing at the start of its next turn. It is destroyed only if it starts its turn at 0 hit points and does not regenerate.
Unusual Nature. The golem needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Glass Sword attacks.
Glass Sword. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. A hit deals 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Dazzling Light (recharge 5–6). Magical colored light fills a 15-ft. cone. Creatures in it must pass a DC 10 Constitution save or be blinded for 1 minute. Each affected creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Palace encounter: While seated on the throne in P31, Kelek can use a bonus action to speak the coven’s rhyme. Four stained-glass knights leave the windows in the marked turrets and defend him as glasswork golems. Survivors return to their windows after 10 minutes.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, chapter 5, pp. 192–193. Stat block on p. 193.

name: Gloam
description: Bavlorna’s stuffed cat comes to life when someone opens her potion cabinet. It once belonged to Endelyn and is hostile to everyone except Bavlorna.

sections.Traits: Keen Smell. Gloam has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use smell.
sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +0 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. A hit deals 1 slashing damage.
